postings.title: Senior Technical Product Manager - Keet (100% Remote)
postings.descriptionText:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:
Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
Keet is a fully peer-to-peer messaging and video calling app built on Holepunch's P2P stack. There are no servers, no middlemen, and no data harvesting. People talk directly to each other, with end-to-end encryption by design.
We are looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager to own the vision for Keet and lead it to a billion users, competing head-on with WhatsApp and Telegram. This is not a maintenance role. You will define where Keet goes, convince the board and the team that it is the right direction, and then drive the execution that gets it there.
You are a rare combination of three things. You are a product visionary who has shipped consumer chat or calling apps at scale. You are a technologist who can go deep on P2P architecture and the Pear / Holepunch stack (docs.pears.com). And you are a hands-on builder who uses AI tools to prototype and prove concepts in days, not months. You set the bar high, move at incredible speed, and lead from the front.
You will also be the person who catches what others miss. The PM who thrives here reads every ticket, tracks every dependency, asks the uncomfortable question before it becomes a launch incident, and keeps five workstreams moving simultaneously without losing the thread on any of them.
If you prefer a PM role where you set strategy and delegate execution, this is not the right fit. If you want to build something that ships to real users, moves markets, and carries your fingerprints from concept to production, we want to hear from you.

Responsibilities

Vision & Strategy

• Own and articulate the long-term product vision for Keet as the world's leading private, peer-to-peer communication app, with a clear path to 1 billion users.

• Analyze WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal, LINE, WeChat and emerging competitors to identify where P2P gives Keet an unfair advantage, and build the roadmap around it.

• Present product vision, strategy, metrics and progress to the board and executive leadership with clarity and conviction.

Define a growth strategy across acquisition, activation, retention and virality, with measurable targets at every stage.

Technical Product Leadership

• Develop a deep working understanding of the Holepunch P2P stack (Pear runtime, Bare, Hypercore, Hyperswarm, HyperDHT, Autobase, Hyperbee) and translate its capabilities and constraints into product decisions.

• Partner with core engineering on hard P2P problems at scale, including NAT traversal, offline sync, multi-device support, large groups, push notifications, and battery and data efficiency on mobile.

• Own the real-time calling experience (1:1 and group voice and video, plus screen sharing) to a quality bar that matches or beats Google Meet and Zoom.

• Define clear feature tiers with explicit labels for stable versus experimental functionality.

Rapid Prototyping with AI

• Use AI coding and design tools to build working prototypes and demos that prove concepts before committing engineering resources.

• Turn ideas into something the team, users and the board can see and touch within days.

Execution & Team Leadership

• Lead the product team and run the sprint cadence end to end, covering planning, prioritization, standups, reviews and retrospectives.

• Own deliverables from conception through release, testing and post-launch iteration, ensuring core functionality works reliably every time.

• Maintain issue trackers and roadmaps that accurately reflect priorities and sprint commitments.

• Coordinate across engineering, QA, design, marketing and business stakeholders, and manage cross-team dependencies across the Holepunch and Tether ecosystem.

• Provide transparent updates on status, risks and timeline changes, and hold direct conversations about accountability when needed.

Mobile & Distribution

• Own the mobile release process across iOS and Android. This includes App Store and Google Play submissions, review guidelines, compliance, store listings, ratings and release management.

• Oversee desktop distribution and installers across macOS, Windows and Linux.

• Build crash reporting, debugging and analytics systems, privacy-preserving by design, that turn user reports into actionable engineering data.

Requirements

Mandatory:

• 8+ years of product management experience, including significant time in a senior or lead role owning a consumer product end to end.

• Strong product sense, with a proven track record of setting product vision and driving it to measurable outcomes at scale (tens of millions of users or more).

• Experience leading engineers who ship products, including running sprint cadences with predictable delivery across cross-functional teams.

• Deep JavaScript and React skills. You can read and write production code, review pull requests, and build working prototypes yourself.

• Intuition for distributed and local-first systems. You don't need P2P expertise, because our core abstracts it away, but you should be able to reason about sync, offline behavior and consistency trade-offs.

• Hands-on experience shipping and scaling mobile apps on iOS and Android, with deep familiarity with App Store and Google Play logistics, review processes and release management.

• Experience with real-time voice and video calling products (such as Google Meet, Zoom, FaceTime or WhatsApp calls) and the quality, latency and reliability trade-offs involved.

• Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to rapidly prototype and demonstrate product concepts.

• Exceptional communication skills, with experience presenting vision and strategy to boards, executives and investors.

• A strong understanding of urgency versus importance, and the judgment to make fast, high-quality decisions with incomplete information.

• You thrive in a high-intensity, fast-moving environment, set an exceptionally high bar, and are willing to go above and beyond, including extended hours, when the mission demands it.

•
Excellent written and spoken English.

Nice to have:

• Product leadership experience at a major messaging app such as WhatsApp, Telegram, LINE, WeChat, Signal, Viber or KakaoTalk.

• Experience with peer-to-peer technologies, distributed systems or decentralized protocols. Prior exposure to Holepunch, Pear or Hypercore is a strong plus.

• Experience growing a product in emerging markets or across multiple regions and languages.

• A background in privacy, encryption or security-focused products.

• Familiarity with Electron, React Native or similar cross-platform frameworks, as well as installer systems, boot performance and Linux packaging (Snap, AppImage, Flatpak).

• A solid understanding of testing approaches (unit, integration, end-to-end), test automation and performance testing.

• An engineering background or computer science degree.

• Experience with Git, issue trackers and modern collaboration tools.

Why this role:
The next billion-user communication app will not run on someone else's servers. If you want to be the person who defines it, presents it to the board, prototypes it yourself, and then leads the team that ships it, we want to hear from you.
In your application, include a link to a product you have shipped or a prototype you have built, along with a few sentences on how you would take Keet to 1 billion users.
Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

About the Opportunity

You will oversee managed service providers (MSPs), specialist contractors, and SaaS vendors rather than build or manage an internal IT department. • Oversee external contractors responsible for CRM administration and provide technical governance across CRM and other business systems.

Identity, Security & Compliance

• Manage third-party technology and vendor security assessments, including ongoing vendor oversight.

• Develop and maintain IT and security policies aligned with compliance requirements and operational needs.

Information Management

• Own the corporate information management framework in collaboration with executives and department leaders.

• Establish standards for information ownership, access, retention, sharing, storage, and lifecycle management.

• Ensure corporate systems, processes, integrations, and administrative responsibilities are properly documented and transferable.

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date IT procedures, documentation, and role responsibilities.

AI Governance

• Manage the company's approved AI tools and AI usage policies.

• Evaluate AI tools, agents, connectors, and integrations for security and data-handling risks.

• Monitor AI adoption and spending while identifying opportunities to leverage new AI capabilities.

• Coordinate AI training and enablement as part of the broader IT training program.

What Success Looks Like

• IT support is reliable, responsive, and largely seamless.

• Employee onboarding, offboarding, hardware provisioning, and access changes happen efficiently.

• SOC 2 audits and evaluations are completed successfully with minimal organizational overhead.

• MSPs and external vendors deliver consistent, high-quality service.

• Hardware and endpoint management operate smoothly across countries and time zones.

• SaaS inventories, information ownership, and IT documentation remain accurate and current.

• Corporate systems and integrations are well understood and effectively governed.

• Employees consider IT a responsive, practical, and valuable resource.

• AI tools are adopted and governed responsibly without unnecessary bureaucracy.

• Potential problems are identified and addressed proactively, before requiring executive intervention.

Requirements & Qualifications

Professional Experience

• 5+ years of IT experience, including direct ownership of IT operations in a lean or resource-conscious environment.

• Experience operating as a senior, independent IT professional with responsibility for company-wide systems and infrastructure.

SOC 2 & Security Compliance

• Experience owning or significantly leading a SOC 2, ISO 27001, or comparable security and compliance program.

• Strong understanding of audit processes, evidence collection, control implementation, and remediation.

Identity & Access Management

Microsoft 365 & SaaS Governance

•
Working knowledge of Microsoft 365.

Endpoint Management

General Requirements

We're the all-in-one agentic marketing platform. AI-native from day one. We're not joining a category, we're defining it.
We are looking for a Director of Finance who owns the finance function, leads the team, and makes clear calls. If you want real ownership, move fast, and raise the bar every week, keep reading. If you wait to be told what to do, this isn't the role.

This role is AGENTIC
You build your own AI agents and automations, and use them every day to do real finance work: run analysis, automate the close, reconcile accounts and build reports. What you'll own

Work with our US CPA firm on tax.

•
Deep QuickBooks Online skills

• Strong with SaaS metrics: ARR, NRR, churn

• You speak up, make decisions, and don't wait to be told what to do.

Clear, simple written and spoken English

CPA or CA

You'll thrive here if...

We'll probably give you more to own than you expected. That's on purpose.
We use AI every day, across every function. That's just how we work.

postings.title: Salesforce Administrator
postings.descriptionText:
🌎 Where: Argentina or Colombia - 100% Remote
🤝 Type: Full-time, via our employer of record

About MarketFully Group
We've combined four established companies - MotionPoint, Key Content, GetGloby, and Social Element - into one company: MarketFully .
MarketFully pairs AI technology with real human expertise to help brands create, adapt, and distribute content that reaches the right people in the right way. The result: stronger connections with global audiences, more engaged communities, and better visibility - all leading to marketing results you can actually measure.

The role
We are looking for a Salesforce Admin who is passionate about driving business outcomes as they are about building smart, scalable solutions whether through configuration, automation, or code when needed. In this role, you'll seek to understand how our business works, collaborate with stakeholders to translate real needs into thoughtful Salesforce solutions, and avoid over-engineering in favor of pragmatic, scalable improvements.
You'll be a key partner in helping our internal teams work smarter and faster leveraging Salesforce, automation, and AI. When solutions show measurable impact internally, you'll help us explore how to bring those capabilities to our customers as well.

This is a senior, high-autonomy role. The Operations leadership team sets priorities based on business impact and you'll be trusted to independently design, build, and execute the Salesforce solution itself, without technical guidance from leadership on how to get there. This role requires someone who is curious, grounded, strategic, and able to effectively manage competing requests from across the organization while working with leadership to prioritize based on business impact.

What you'll do

• Partner with business stakeholders to deeply understand needs and translate them into scalable, maintainable Salesforce solutions

• Independently design, build, and execute Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, Agentforce, and other tools - with minimal technical oversight

• Leverage AI and automation to improve employee efficiency and customer-facing applications

• Meet with our assigned Salesforce professional services representative to ask questions and make sure we get the most out of our salesforce investment

• Avoid over-engineering - solve the problem at hand using the simplest effective approach

• Maintain strong documentation and ensure solutions are easy to maintain

• Manage intake and triage of Salesforce-related requests across departments, driving clarity and alignment

• Collaborate with leadership to maintain and evolve a prioritization framework that balances urgency, impact, and strategic value

• Own the full solution lifecycle - from stakeholder discovery through technical design, build, and delivery - with leadership setting priorities, not implementation details

• Support integrations between Salesforce and other platforms used across the business

• Proactively identify opportunities for business process improvements using Salesforce capabilities

What we're looking for

• 6+ years of Salesforce development experience (Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components, Flows, SOQL/SOSL)

• Salesforce certifications: Salesforce Certified Administrator, Agentforce Specialist, Salesforce Certified Platform App Builder, Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I

• Proven experience as a Salesforce Administrator, with a strong understanding of Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and Active Campaign

• Experience in using AI tools and platforms (e.g., Einstein, GPT-based tools) to improve internal workflows

• Solid knowledge of user management, security settings, profiles, roles, and data management within Salesforce

• Experience in creating and maintaining workflows, processes, and automation using flows and process builders

• Proven ability to understand business processes and requirements - you're a listener first, you ask the right questions to refine requiremee, Lightning Web Components, Flows, SOQL/SOSL)nts, and then you build a scalable solution that delights end users

• Demonstrated ability to work autonomously - comfortable taking a business goal from a non-technical stakeholder and independently determining the right Salesforce architecture and build approach, without step-by-step technical direction

• Excellent written and spoken English, with proven experience leading discovery conversations directly with US-based business stakeholders - asking probing questions, surfacing unstated requirements, and pushing back on scope when needed

• A pragmatic, user-first mindset with a track record of delivering high-impact solutions without over-engineering

Why join us

• Help improve the tools and processes that support a globally focused business

• Work with colleagues across teams and contribute to practical, high-impact improvements

• Be part of a customer-first organisation that values different perspectives

The Hiring Process
We’ll share details of the hiring stages with you during the application process. The process may include conversations about your experience and a practical task based on the kind of work you’d do in the role.

Our Diversity, Equality & Inclusion Commitment
We welcome applications from diverse and under-represented groups regardless of background.
We know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates, so even if you feel you don’t fulfill all the requirements, we encourage you to apply. We’d love to hear from you.
We value divergent thinkers who bring different experiences and viewpoints to MarketFully . We strongly encourage members of under-represented groups to apply.
We can also make reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process. Please let us know if there is any additional support you may need.

How To Apply 🖊️
If all this sounds like you, upload your CV or résumé and complete the application form. While a cover letter is optional, we welcome any other way for you to share what draws you to this role and MarketFully Group.
We’re excited to receive your application! ❤️

postings.title: Conservation Support Engineer – Latin America
postings.descriptionText:
Help protected areas across Latin America turn data into conservation impact
EarthRanger is used by more than 1,000 protected areas and conservation programs worldwide, and Latin America is growing fast. National park agencies, NGOs, and community-run reserves from Argentina and Brazil to Costa Rica and Honduras rely on EarthRanger to see what is happening across their landscapes in real time: ranger patrols, wildlife tracking, sensors, and field reports brought together on one map.Setting up a site is a first step. The real work is helping a team go from having EarthRanger to relying on it every day to plan patrols, respond to incidents, and show results to the people who fund and govern their work. That is this job.

What will you do?

Help sites succeed, not just get set up

• Work with protected areas and conservation organizations across Latin America to understand their conservation goals and shape how they use EarthRanger to reach them.

• Own a set of sites in the region that were set up but never became active, and bring them into daily use. This is a first-year goal we will define with you.

• Follow up with sites after onboarding, spot where adoption has stalled, and coach teams through the next step: better patrol coverage, cleaner reporting, smarter use of alerts and analysis.

• Act as the regional voice of the user, feeding what sites need back to our product, documentation, and training teams.

Support and troubleshoot

• Be a first point of contact for user questions and field issues from the region, resolving them through our ticketing system and keeping clear records. Expect roughly half your time here at the start, shifting toward site success work as you build relationships and the region's self-serve resources grow.

• Configure and maintain EarthRanger sites: users, event types, patrol types, maps, and integrations with trackers and sensors.

• Know when a problem needs an engineer, and hand it over with the detail they need.

Train and enable

• Deliver EarthRanger training to rangers, biologists, analysts, and managers, from one-on-one coaching to multi-day workshops, in Spanish and English.

• Help build and translate training materials, help-center articles, and short videos for the region.

Support national and multi-site deployments

• Contribute to large rollouts across many protected areas: scoping, planning, data standards, and follow-through with government and NGO partners.

• Track your projects and communicate status, risks, and decisions clearly to partners and the internal team.

What we are looking for

Required

• A conservation foundation. Either hands-on work in conservation or protected areas (ranger, biologist, park or reserve staff, NGO field or program staff), or a demonstrated commitment to conservation through study, volunteering, or community projects combined with experience supporting people who use software.

• Fluent in spoken and written Spanish and English.

• A track record of helping others succeed with a tool, a process, or a program: training, support, extension work, community engagement, or teaching.

• Comfortable learning web and mobile software and explaining it to people who are not, and open to using AI tools every day for drafting, translating, troubleshooting, and learning. You do not need to be a programmer.

• A self-motivated remote professional with strong time-management skills: able to balance multiple projects simultaneously, structure their own daily schedule, meet deadlines, communicate proactively, and ask for help when needed.

• Able to travel within Latin America less than 10% of the year.

Bonus

• Portuguese.

• Hands-on experience as a user of EarthRanger or SMART. Many sites in the region are moving from SMART to EarthRanger, and knowing how patrol and monitoring data are collected in practice helps a great deal.

• Experience with GPS trackers, camera traps, or other field monitoring technology.

• GIS skills (QGIS, ArcGIS) and comfort working with spatial data.

• Experience working with government agencies or on multi-site, national-scale programs.

• Experience facilitating workshops or building training materials.

• Familiarity with data concepts such as spreadsheets, CSV exports, JSON, or APIs, used for troubleshooting rather than coding.

Why Join Nimble Gravity ?
You'll help leading financial institutions and other clients adopt AI in meaningful ways. You'll work directly with clients, engineers, and AI specialists to turn emerging technology into measurable business outcomes. If you enjoy teaching, facilitating, influencing, and helping people embrace new ways of working, we'd love to talk.
Nimble Gravity is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

postings.descriptionText:

Newsweek reaches 100 million people each month with thought-provoking news, opinion, images, graphics, and video delivered across a dozen print and digital platforms. Headquartered in New York City, Newsweek also publishes international editions in EMEA and Asia.

Senior Product Manager, Ad Tech
Location: Argentina
Reports to: Chief Technology & Product Officer

About Adprime
Adprime Media is a vertically integrated advertising technology company headquartered in New York. Our platform spans a demand-side platform, a programmatic ad exchange, audience, data, and ad products, and campaign intelligence. We work with agencies, brands, and publishers across performance and healthcare verticals, and we are building an AI-first engineering and operations culture.

The Role
Adprime is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own product execution across our ad tech suite. The CTPO owns product strategy; The Senior Product Manager, Ad Tech will own turning that strategy into well-defined, well-researched, shippable products. The ideal candidate should be able to hold their own in strategy discussions and make educated contributions, but the center of this role is execution: research, definition, requirements, and internal enablement.
This role suits a self-reliant PM who knows the programmatic industry well enough to evaluate what competitors offer, decide what belongs in our products, and explain both to a sales team in plain language.

What The Senior Product Manager Will Do:

• Own product definition across the DSP, exchange, audience and data products, and CTV offerings

• Research the ad tech landscape: competitive products, industry standards, and market direction, and turn that research into concrete recommendations on what we build and why

• Write clear product requirements and specs that engineering can execute against, and work with the Director of Technology to scope and sequence delivery

• Partner with sales and marketing in both directions: educate them on product functionality and positioning, and gather client-driven requirements for new products and features

• Contribute to product strategy discussions with the CTPO with well-reasoned, evidence-backed input

• Collaborate with our product manager focused on internal AI tooling to keep internal and client-facing product work coordinated

• Define how each product creates value for Adprime: revenue contribution, differentiation, or operational advantage, and measure whether shipped products deliver it

Requirements:

• 5+ years in product management, including meaningful time in programmatic advertising or ad tech

• Real domain knowledge: you understand how DSPs, exchanges, and data products work, and concepts like RTB, identity resolution, audience segmentation, and supply quality are familiar ground

• Enough technical fluency to work directly with engineers on data-heavy products without a translator

• Strong research and writing skills: your PRDs are specific, your competitive analyses are useful, and your recommendations come with reasoning

• Comfort presenting to and training commercial teams

• Self-reliance: you take direction at the strategic level and come back with finished work, not open questions

What Success Looks Like

• Within six months, every active product has a clear definition, a rationale for why it exists, and requirements engineering trusts. Sales and marketing understand what our products do and are feeding you a steady stream of client-driven requirements.

Newsweek is an equal opportunity employer. We seek employees of diverse backgrounds and are committed to providing an inclusive, equitable and respectful workplace.

Things You Get To Do:

Log Onboarding: Onboard new security log sources across cloud, identity, endpoint, SaaS, and application systems, including parsing, normalization, and data quality checks.

Operational Dashboards: Build and maintain dashboards for alert volume, ingest health, and response status.

Runbooks: Develop and improve alert-handling and incident response runbooks and escalation paths.

Operational Metrics: Track and report security operations metrics, including mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to respond (MTTR).

On-Call: Participate in the Security Operations on-call rotation after onboarding and cross-training.

SOAR and Response Automation:

•
Playbooks: Design, build, and maintain SOAR playbooks that automate repeatable response actions, including enrichment, containment, ticketing, and notification.

•
Triage and Investigation: Triage, investigate, and respond to security alerts across endpoints, identity, cloud, network, and application logs.

Threat Hunting: Run hypothesis-driven hunts based on threat intelligence and incident learnings, and turn findings into new detections.

• 3+ years of experience in Security Operations or detection engineering roles

• Hands-on experience operating and tuning a SIEM

• Experience building SOAR playbooks or equivalent response automation

• Experience onboarding and parsing log sources from cloud, identity, and SaaS platforms

• Strong alert investigation skills across identity, endpoint, network, and cloud environments

• Understanding of common attacker techniques and detection methodologies

• Experience supporting security incidents, including evidence collection, detection queries, and containment

• Create purchase orders and track quantities, delivery commitments, receipts, remaining balances, and invoice discrepancies.
Manufacturing and supplier accountability
• Serve as the brand's operational contact for affiliated manufacturing teams, external manufacturers, and packaging suppliers.
• Obtain clear commitments for production, quality release, pricing, quantities, and delivery dates; follow up and escalate risks promptly.
• Coordinate production priorities, new product launches, reformulations, and transitions with internal teams.
• Maintain a clear record of confirmed commitments, open issues, accountable owners, and next actions.

Packaging, sourcing, and cost savings
• Source and compare domestic and international packaging suppliers, including suppliers in Asia, based on total landed cost, quality, lead times, and minimum orders.
• Coordinate designers, printers, suppliers, and manufacturers to complete artwork and packaging on time.
• Maintain approved specifications, artwork versions, proofs, and production files; verify that each run uses the correct materials.
• Measure realized savings after freight, storage, inventory, and service tradeoffs.

Quality and compliance
• Own operational follow-through for brand-side quality and compliance, including documented product release, hold, and disposition decisions within approved procedures and decision authority.
• Apply familiarity with dietary supplement cGMP, including 21 CFR Part 111, to supplier documentation, product specifications, and outsourced manufacturing responsibilities.
• Coordinate testing and documentation review, label compliance reviews, and final artwork approval, involving qualified quality, regulatory, or legal expertise when needed.
• Maintain lot traceability, complaint records, and recall readiness; coordinate investigations, corrective actions, and customer-facing recall execution with the appropriate teams.
• Ensure manufacturers and warehouses act on the correct product status and escalate issues requiring specialist review.

Warehousing, shipping, and reporting
• Coordinate receiving, inventory accuracy, fulfillment, and exceptions with warehouse and logistics teams, including affiliated operations and external providers.
• Reconcile purchase orders, shipment records, warehouse receipts, and invoices.
• Analyze parcel, freight, fulfillment, and packaging costs; evaluate carrier mix and service options without compromising delivery performance.
• Build useful spreadsheets, dashboards, and SOPs showing stock coverage, at-risk SKUs, purchasing needs, order status, and savings.

What success looks like
Supply risks are identified early, orders have reliable dates and clear owners, inventory records reconcile, packaging is ready for production, quality decisions are documented, and cost reductions are measurable. Leadership can see what needs attention without chasing routine updates.

Requirements

• At least 4 years of hands-on experience in supply chain, purchasing, inventory planning, or production planning for physical consumer products.

• Direct experience coordinating contract manufacturers, suppliers, and warehouse or third-party logistics (3PL) operations.

• Ability to build and maintain forecasts, replenishment plans, and operational reporting in Excel or Google Sheets using formulas, lookups, and pivot tables.

• Experience tracking purchase orders through production, receipt, and invoice reconciliation, with clear follow-through on discrepancies.

• Familiarity with dietary supplement cGMP under 21 CFR Part 111 and a brand's responsibilities when manufacturing is outsourced, including documentation, label reviews, product holds, and recall readiness.

• Sound judgment about quality decisions, documentation, escalation, and when qualified technical or regulatory expertise is needed.

• Professional spoken and written English for working with U.S. suppliers and a globally distributed team.

• Based in Colombia, Mexico, or Argentina and available Monday-Friday, 9:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time, including U.S. daylight-saving changes, with some flexibility.

• Comfortable learning inventory, ERP, warehouse, and accounting systems; organized, proactive, and accountable for results.

• Supplement-industry experience is strongly preferred. Prior regulated-product experience is not required. Experience with U.S. consumer brands, direct-to-consumer operations, and international packaging sourcing is a plus.

Benefits

• Fully remote work with a globally distributed team.

• Paid time off and holidays.

• Direct access to leadership and ownership of meaningful operational improvements.

• Benefit eligibility, including health and dental coverage, depends on location and hiring arrangement and will be confirmed during the hiring process. Employment or engagement terms will also be confirmed during hiring.

postings.title: Senior .NET Engineer (LATAM)
postings.descriptionText:
About the Company
Lateral stands for technology excellence.
We’re a profitable, award-winning design and technology company with over 20 years of experience launching bold ventures and transforming businesses. A globally distributed team of 200+ experts united by a shared purpose: the continuous pursuit of quality.
Our clients come to us for results, quality and craft - and stay because we keep raising the bar.

We do things differently at Lateral
Our mission is simple: design and build great products .
What sets us apart isn’t just the talent of our team - it’s the way we work:

We Have A Bias For Action & Results.
We are doers - we spot the gaps, connect the dots, anticipate what’s around the corner and take action. We move fast, stay focused, and let the results - not the effort - speak for themselves.

We Work On Time, On Budget, On Quality
Discipline is our edge - a commitment we make to each other, to our clients, and to the standards we hold ourselves to.

We Care Deeply.
We care about our work and about each other. Care Is A Competitive Advantage.
Every detail matters. Every design, every line of code, every decision. Thoughtful by default.

We Do Things Right - Because It’s the Right Thing to Do
Right over easy. Integrity isn’t up for negotiation. We hold the bar high even when no one’s watching. We take pride in doing great work the right way - not the easy way.

We Keep Improving
The best teams keep improving and we’re never done learning.
We iterate. We reflect on what’s working and what’s not. Feedback fuels us, we receive it openly, and adapt quickly. Progress over perfection.
We’re Obsessed With Agility, Not The Agile Manifesto
We don’t chase dogma or rituals - we chase momentum. We adapt processes to fit problems, not the other way around.
We Take Ownership
Everyone leads something here. You will have room to run with ideas, and the trust to execute. That trust is built on how you show up: thinking things through, sweating the details, and following through.

What You’ll Do
As a Senior .NET Developer at Lateral, you will:

• Design and build scalable, resilient cloud applications on Azure using C#, .NET and SQL, delivering solutions that are secure, high-performance, adhere to our Coding Standards and “just work”.

• Write clean, clear, and well-tested code, embracing software craftsmanship principles to produce robust, reusable and maintainable systems. You will ensure a high bar for code quality through comprehensive unit tests and attention to detail.

• Take ownership of features end-to-end , from initial concept through deployment. You’ll often drive substantial product features as the key developer alongside an architect or product designer.

• Mentor and support junior engineers , leading by example in code reviews and pair programming. You will offer constructive feedback that helps others grow, fostering a thoughtful, kind, and continuously learning team culture.

• Provide technical leadership in architecture and design discussions, advocating for simple, elegant solutions. You’ll challenge unnecessary complexity and focus on pragmatic results.

• Continuously improve the codebase through refactoring and refinement, balancing new feature development with paying down technical debt. You’ll adopt an iterative approach of tweaking and constantly improving the software to keep the system simple, stable, and adaptable.

• Champion quality , reliability and scalability by implementing best practices in cloud operations (monitoring, security, CI/CD).

Example Projects You May Join:

• Build an AI-powered healthcare platform to help detect diseases earlier.

• Launch a new fintech product from the ground up.

• Scale a global SaaS commerce system with millions of products

Whatever the challenge, you’ll be building software that changes lives and moves industries forward.

How We Measure Success In This Role

In the first two weeks

• You make your first meaningful contribution to the project

• You communicate well async as well as in meetings

In the first 3 months:

• You understand the system architecture well and can work independently or in teams on medium-sized features.

• You design before you code (and produce design artifacts)

• You have shipped code in Production, clean, tested

• You communicate clearly, raising issues early and contributing to reviews.

•
You deliver what you commit to.

After 3 months:

• You take ownership of larger features and improvements from start to finish.

• You help others by sharing knowledge, spotting problems early, and improving processes or tooling.

• You make decisions with both the codebase and business goals in mind.

We measure success through:

•
Evaluating results (what you’ve shipped)

•
Quality and reliability of your code.

•
Consistency in delivery.

•
Feedback from peers and leads.

• Your ability to work independently and unblock others.

What We’re Looking For
We are seeking for team members who are both highly technical and deeply care about their craft and how the work gets done. You must bring:

• 7+ years experience in software development

• Deep expertise in C# and the .NET ecosystem, including: NET Core, ASP.NET Core and .NET 6 or later

• Strong proficiency with Entity Framework Core and MS SQL Server

• Solid understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA), SOLID principles.

• Experience with to cloud-native and distributed systems , ideally including: Azure Service Fabric, Azure Functions, Service Bus, Redis, Azure Storage, Application Insights

• Proven experience building robust, well-structured APIs

• A quality mindset : unit tests, integration tests, automation, defensive programming

• Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills with a hands-on, proactive attitude

• Ability to Design before you code—express decisions through clear diagrams, validate assumptions early, and think through edge cases and trade-offs.

• Ability to quickly understand the nature of the business and clearly communicate with stakeholders (clients, colleagues)

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

• A commitment to making a difference , continuous learning , and collaboration

Bonus points for:

• Experience with Large scale systems or datasets, Performance

•
Graph Technologies

• Clarity in communication and design documentation.

Extra bonus points for:

•
Experience building Infrastructure

Why You’ll Love Working Here

• Real Impact: You’ll work on meaningful products that make a measurable difference - from healthcare and commerce to sustainability and next-gen tech.

• Remote-First, Office Friendly: Work from wherever you’re most productive - whether that’s your home, a co-working space, or one of our offices. We’re a remote-first company, but if you’re near an office, you’re welcome to drop in, collaborate in person, or work onsite regularly.

We prioritize async collaboration, respect your time zone, and focus on outcomes over hours.

• An Outstanding Team: Talented, kind, and hard-working people who care deeply about their craft - and about each other. No egos. No politics. Just professionals doing their best work.

• Growth: You’ll be supported in growing your craft, exploring new paths, and stepping into greater responsibility - at your own pace

• A Culture of Excellence: We care deeply about doing the right thing - for our clients, our team, and ourselves. No burnout. No crunch. Just high-quality work, delivered sustainably.

• Variety & Stability: We’re profitable, independent, and over a decade strong. Yet every project brings a fresh challenge. You’ll never be bored here.

This Role Might Not Be for You
We want to respect your time by being clear about what this role isn’t. You should skip this opportunity if:

• You prefer well defined structure. If you gravitate towards a clear hierarchy, well defined roles and swim lanes, you may find our self-managed style challenging.

• Distributed work isn’t your thing. If you find async communication, design documentation and being proactive without a manager nearby difficult, our setup won’t suit you.

• Feedback doesn't excite you. We’re obsessed with quality and believe in continuous improvement. That means we give feedback that’s sometimes nitpicky. If refining the work until it’s excellent feels over the top, you are likely going to find working here frustrating.

• Change makes you uncomfortable. We’re scaling and maturing. That means not everything is perfect yet. Priorities shift. Processes evolve. If ambiguity is uncomfortable, this may feel bumpy.

However, If this sounds like fuel, we’d love to talk!

How to apply and what to expect in the interview process
01. Your work
Show us the work that reflects you at your best. We’ll look at depth, design thinking, and the logic behind your choices.
02. Lateral team fit
You’ll speak with our Talent team about your career direction, your motivators, and our plans ahead.

03. Work trial
You’ll tackle a take-home challenge that mirrors what we actually do.
04. Engineering deep dive
A collaborative session with our engineers.
05. Project fit
An interview focussed on prioritization, collaboration across disciplines, and how you handle the "messy middle".

postings.title: Sr Tax Associate
postings.descriptionText:
At R2, we believe that small and medium businesses are the productive engine of society. Small and medium businesses (SMBs) make up over 90% of companies in Latin America, yet they face a trillion-dollar credit gap. Our mission is to unlock SMBs’ potential by providing financial solutions that are tailored to their needs. We are reimagining the financial infrastructure of Latin America, where SMBs financial needs are satisfied without ever having to go to a bank.
R2 enables platforms in Latin America to embed financial services that SMBs can then leverage (starting with revenue-based financing). We are a tight-knit team coming from organizations such as Google, Amazon, Nubank, Uber, Capital One, Mercado Libre, Globant, and J.P. Morgan. We are entering a new phase of growth following a strategic investment from Ant International, focused on rapidly expanding our partner footprint, strengthening our credit and underwriting capabilities, and scaling our operations across multiple markets.
As a Senior Tax Analyst (IC3) you will play a key role in improving tax compliance and efficiency across R2’s operations in Mexico, Chile, Colombia, Peru, Brazil, Cayman and the USA, while supporting the company’s growth into new products and markets.

What you’ll work on

• Review monthly tax compliance obligations in Brazil, Colombia, Peru, Chile and Mexico (VAT, income tax and withholding taxes, among others), working with our BPO providers to adjust procedures and improve timing, accuracy and documentation.

• Own the regional tax obligations calendar and tax payments control, ensuring deliverables are on time and that tax files and supporting documents are organized by tax type and country.

• Monitor the tax authorities’ electronic mailboxes in all countries, analyzing notices and information requests and coordinating timely responses with the Tax Manager and external advisors.

• Configure and optimize the tax setup of our ERP as a whole, including electronic invoicing, withholding tax documents and other tax supporting documents, becoming the owner of these processes from a tax perspective.

• Review the group’s transfer pricing policies and calculations, ensuring adherence to the arm’s length principle and that documentation and filings are complete and timely.

• Ensure the correct tax treatment under double tax treaties for cross-border payments, including applicable withholding tax rates, tax residence certificates and supporting documentation.

• Calculate and control thin capitalization and interest limitation (earnings stripping) rules across the group, assessing their impact on the deductibility of financing costs.

• Work on tax projections for the group, estimating the tax impact of the business plan to support budgeting and decision-making.

• Support the tax strategy for new products and market expansion, and drive tax planning and compliance projects with high impact on the company’s goals, partnering with Legal, Finance and Growth teams.

Requirements

Who you are

• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Law, Economics, Business Administration or a related field; a specialization in taxation is a plus.

• You have 5+ years of tax experience, ideally combining Big 4 and multinational.

• You have knowledge of transfer pricing and tax compliance obligations; you don’t need to have worked hands-on with every topic above.

• You want to work in a multi-jurisdictional environment, dealing with different tax systems, languages and cultures every day.

• You have advanced English skills (written and spoken) and feel comfortable working in an international environment. Spanish is a strong plus.

• You are highly organized and detail-oriented, able to manage multiple deadlines and tax obligations across different countries.

• You are proactive and take ownership, anticipating risks and communicating clearly with stakeholders when something requires attention.

• You have strong analytical skills and advanced Excel, and are comfortable working with accounting data and ERP systems (NetSuite is a plus).

Benefits

What We Offer

• The chance to join a high-impact, mission-driven fintech.

• Ownership and impact in a fast-paced, growth-oriented startup.

• Cross-functional collaboration with exceptional teams.

• Exposure to complex regulatory challenges and innovation in embedded finance.

Location: São Paulo, Santiago, Buenos Aires or Bogotá.

📋 Job Details at a Glance

•
Job Title: Financial Controller

•
Job ID: CONCELEA

•
Industry: Commercial Real Estate Investment

•
Location: South Africa or LATAM

•
Job Status: Full Time

•
Work Schedule: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Pacific Time

•
Salary: $5,000 to $6,000 per month

•
Target Start Date: ASAP

🏢 About the Client

The company buys, builds, and operates high-value commercial real estate assets and outdoor wellness resort destinations across the West. Operating as a vertically integrated investment and asset management firm, we handle the entire deal lifecycle in-house, from deal sourcing, acquisitions, and development to capital raising and ongoing operations.
They blend institutional real estate deal execution with a fast-paced, high-energy, and modern work culture. To keep their high-velocity team focused on core growth, they combine structured deal coordination, established payment safeguards, and offshore accounting support with an agile internal team. They value low red tape, proactive problem-solving, tech-forward workflows, and a relentless commitment to operational excellence.
💼 About the Role

The Financial Controller serves as the central financial backbone of the business, taking full end-to-end ownership of numbers across all funds, holding companies, and management entities.

•
Primary Mission: Translate strategic assumptions into clear, dependable financial metrics to guide executive decision-making, manage risk, and optimize cash flow.

•
Core Responsibilities: Overhaul and manage linked operating models, fund-level rollups, and annual budgets. Own rolling cash flow forecasts, intercompany accounting, and quarterly investor distribution waterfalls via InvestNext. Oversee a full-time bookkeeper and run a strict, reliable monthly close. Maintain end-to-end Accounts Payable controls and provide rapid turnaround on lender/investor reporting.

•
Operational Edge: Operates with an AI-first methodology—building, auditing, and automating financial workflows (reconciliations, reports, variance tracking) to maximize leverage.

🎯 Key Responsibilities

📊 Financial Strategy & Modeling

•
Financial Models: Take over existing property-level operating models and fund-level rollups. Keep them linked, formula-driven, and updated with monthly actuals so changes at the property level flow seamlessly to the fund.

•
Budgeting: Build annual budgets for every property and entity, track budget versus actual monthly, and explain key variances.

•
Cash Flow Forecast: Own forward cash forecasting across the portfolio (operating cash, capex/construction draws, debt service, intercompany funding, and distributions). Identify tight months early and present actionable options.

•
Investor Distributions: Calculate quarterly investor distributions through fund waterfalls (preferred returns, splits, fees). Ensure full reconciliation with books and fund documents, and execute payouts via InvestNext (our investor portal).

⚙️ Accounting & Operations

•
Fund & Entity Books: Manage the bookkeeper and run the monthly close for funds, management company, and holding entities (reconciliations, accruals, intercompany balances, and clean consolidations). Review property managers' financials monthly and push back when something doesn't tie.

•
Accounts Payable (AP): Own AP end-to-end (coding, approvals, payment runs, vendor follow-up) with robust controls to prevent errors and fraud.

•
Lender & Investor Reporting: Package clean P&Ls and balance sheets on request so lenders and investors never wait on us.

•
AI-First Systems: Put AI at the forefront of every system you own. Automate data pulls, reconciliations, variance analysis, and reporting to speed up the close and focus team time on decision-making.

✅ Qualifications & Skills

⭐ Must-Haves:

• 5+ years in real estate accounting/finance (ideally as Controller or Senior Accountant at a real estate sponsor, syndicator, or private equity firm).

• Strong multi-entity experience (consolidations, intercompany balances, accrual accounting, clean monthly close).

• Fund accounting experience, including investor distribution waterfalls (preferred returns, profit splits).

• Advanced modeling capabilities in Excel or Google Sheets (operating models, fund rollups, budgets, cash flow forecasts).

• Strong AI proficiency (hands-on experience using tools like Claude/ChatGPT to build/audit models, automate reporting, or accelerate closes).

• Proven experience managing a bookkeeper or small accounting team.

🌟 Nice-to-Haves:

• CPA certification (or progress toward it).

• Hospitality accounting experience (hotels, resorts, glamping, RV parks); familiarity with USALI is a plus.

• Construction accounting expertise (draws, capex tracking, construction loans).

• Experience creating lender packages and managing bank refinances.

🧠 Ideal Candidate Mindset:

•
Owner Mentality: You don't wait for someone to point out errors. You spot them, fix them, and communicate what changed.

•
Skeptical & Analytical: You actively challenge assumptions and push back when numbers don't tie out.

•
Loop Closer: When you say it's handled, it's handled. Deadlines are non-negotiable.

•
Fast & Accurate: High velocity without sacrificing rigor—you understand the appropriate depth required for every task.

•
Clear Communicator: Able to explain financial principles in plain English to operators, lenders, and investors.

•
System Builder: Focuses on scalable process improvements rather than recurring manual spreadsheet fixes.

•
AI-First Mindset: Daily user of AI tools to build, audit, and automate. Every system design starts with: "How much of this can AI do?"

•
Trustworthy: Extremely meticulous with capital protection and fiduciary responsibility.

•
Outdoors Enthusiast: You live and love the outdoor lifestyle brand. (Bonus points if you’ve stayed at a hot spring this year!)

💻 Tech Stack

•
AI Tools: Highly proficient in modern AI automation tools (Claude is the company’s default platform).

•
Accounting & Operations: Standard real estate & corporate accounting platforms, payroll systems, expense management, and investor portals (InvestNext, Quickbooks, Ramp).

🏆 Success Metrics

🚀 First 90 Days:

• Take over existing property and fund models, know them cold, and ship your first round of improvements.

• Monthly close for every fund and entity runs on time with balance sheets and P&Ls tied out.

• A live portfolio cash forecast (by month and entity) is reviewed monthly.

• Annual budgets built for every property and entity for the coming year.

• AP consolidated into a single process with clear approvals and zero late/duplicate payments.

• Quarterly distribution calculations documented, repeatable, and reconciled with books and InvestNext.

• Automated at least two recurring workflows (e.g., budget vs. actual, distribution calculations) using AI.

📈 Ongoing:

• Books are closed and published on time every month.

• Reliable forecasts with zero unseen cash surprises.

• Lender and investor requests turned around in ≤ 2 business days.

• Distributions accurately calculated and paid on time.

• Reduced volume of financial questions reaching the CEO.

🚀 Submit your application today and take the first step toward your next great opportunity!

The reviews include interpretation of Key Risk Indicator (KRI) and/or Key Performance Indicator (KPI) data housed in an analytical tool as well as a comprehensive review of supplemental operational data/trends and issues to be interpreted, reported and presented to the study teams. The Manager, Central Monitoring , will be responsible for supporting several studies within a therapeutic area and program-level. They will work closely with other Central Monitors and Centralized Data Risk Analysts (CDRAs) to ensure effective identification, conduct and reporting of central monitoring activities. • Oversee Central Monitoring Execution: Work with data analysts to configure, implement, and execute the Central Monitoring RBQM system across assigned studies, ensuring effective signal detection.

• Analyze and Interpret Data Trends: Conduct study-level Central Monitoring Reviews using data analysis tools, interpret KRIs/KPIs, and assess trends to identify areas requiring intervention.

• Working knowledge of the clinical drug development process, including ICH, GCP guidelines, and regulatory requirements

• Effective communication and interpersonal skills; ability to build relationships internally and externally

• Demonstrated ability to identify and interpret current and future business trends and apply them to centralized monitoring practices

• Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical and analytical insights in a clear and concise manner

• Aptitude for mathematical concepts, statistical methodologies, and data analytics, with a focus on interpreting KRIs and KPIs

• Knowledge and experience with clinical databases, electronic data capture systems, quality control processes, and auditing procedures

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, with advanced skills in Excel for data manipulation and reporting

• Preferred: Experience using CluePoints or similar centralized monitoring system.

Minimal educational requirements:

• Bachelors Degree or equivalent experience required

Minimum Years of Experience:
At least 7 years of relevant experience in the biotechnology/pharmaceutical industry, with a minimum of 1 year with direct Central Monitoring experience. Site monitoring or data management experience a plus.

Why Partner with Us?
Opportunity to work on impactful projects with a growing company.
Collaborative and supportive team environment.

Flexible work arrangements.

How to Apply:

• Your Resume/CV outlining relevant experience.

Availability: Please indicate your earliest start date and estimated weekly availability.

Contract Terms:
This is a contractor/vendor role. You will not be an employee of Panopto . You must be able to invoice us for services rendered and be responsible for your own taxes and benefits. All deliverables must comply with our confidentiality/IP/data handling policies.

Use of Artificial Intelligence (AI)

Panopto AI Use Policy:
Panopto ’s AI Use Policy is committed to a hiring process that is thoughtful, fair, and centered on human connection. As artificial intelligence (AI) becomes more prevalent in the workplace, we believe that it is important to describe our use of AI in the hiring process, as well as outline to candidates what use of AI is and is not allowed. While AI can be a valuable tool, it cannot replace genuine human interaction or an individual’s unique perspective, experience, and voice.

Company Use of AI:
Panopto may utilize tools to enhance the efficiency, objectivity, and quality of our recruitment and evaluation process. These tools assist our team throughout the hiring lifecycle by focusing on four key areas:

• Content Creation: Providing a starting point for crafting job descriptions and assisting in building tailored interview questions.

• Resume Parsing: Analyzing candidate skillsets and resume alignment to efficiently identify qualified candidates.

• Interview & Assessment Insights: Providing interview transcription, summarization, and identifying key insights from candidate assessments in relation to specific role requirements.

• Data Organization: Organizing and storing information gathered during assessments to help our team make informed, data-driven decisions.

Ultimately, these tools are used to support—not replace—our team in assessing skills, generating insights, and identifying the best talent for Panopto .

To ensure fairness and transparency:
Human-Centric Decisions: Please be assured that AI tools are used to support our team, and all final hiring decisions are made by human reviewers. Panopto hiring teams will thoroughly review your application and assessment results. AI is not used to make final decisions regarding your candidacy.
Bias Mitigation: We are committed to algorithmic fairness. Our AI-assisted tools undergo regular independent audits to detect and mitigate bias, with the goal of keeping our processes equitable and inclusive. Our methodology aligns with global best practices and regional digital ethics standards to provide every candidate with a fair and merit-based evaluation.
Your Rights & Accommodations: We provide inclusive access for all applicants. If you require a reasonable adjustment due to a disability, or if you prefer a non-automated review of your application, please contact Panopto Talent Attraction. We respect your right to request human intervention; please note that opting for a manual review may impact the standard processing timeline.

Data Privacy and Security:
Your personal data and recordings are processed securely in compliance with global privacy and employment regulations (including EEOC, GDPR, and other local or regional privacy laws, as applicable).
To facilitate our recruitment and evaluation process, limited candidate data may be shared securely with trusted third-party vendors and service providers acting on our behalf. We retain candidate data only as long as necessary to fulfill the recruitment purpose or as required by applicable statutory retention periods. Once this purpose is met, or the retention period expires, your data is securely deleted or anonymized in accordance with our data governance policy.
Panopto is dedicated to a fair and equitable hiring process for all candidates.

Use of AI:

Statement of Transparency:
At Panopto , we embrace the transformative power of AI to enhance productivity and learning. We believe in providing a level playing field where candidates can use modern tools to put their best foot forward, provided those tools support, rather than replace, their authentic voice and expertise. While we encourage the use of AI as a tool for growth and preparation, we require transparency and authenticity to ensure a fair evaluation for all.

Acceptable Use:

• AI-Assisted Preparation: You are encouraged to use Generative AI (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini) as a mock interviewer or coach to refine your speaking points.

• Research & Knowledge Gathering: Using AI to synthesize industry trends or company background is permitted and viewed as proactive preparation.

• Career Guidance Tools: Simulation tools that help you practice the STAR method or identify skill gaps are acceptable.

Prohibited Use:

Bonus points for asset management or commercial real estate experience, familiarity with systems such as Yardi, MRI, RealPage, Argus, VTS, or CoStar, building analytics-ready models for BI tools (Power BI in particular), AWS Glue or EMR alongside Snowflake, exposure to workflow automation tools (Power Automate, UiPath), and a track record of mentoring other engineers.

Why You'll Love Working Here
Real impact. You'll work on meaningful products that make a measurable difference.
An outstanding team. Talented, kind, hard working people who care about their craft and about each other. No egos. No politics.
Growth. You'll be supported in growing your craft, exploring new paths, and stepping into greater responsibility, at your own pace.
A culture of excellence. We care about doing the right thing for our clients, our team, and ourselves. No burnout. No crunch. Just high quality work, delivered sustainably.
Variety and stability. We're profitable, independent, and over two decades strong. Yet every project brings a fresh challenge. You'll never be bored here.

This Role Might Not Be for You
We want to respect your time by being clear about what this role isn't. You should skip this opportunity if:

• You prefer well defined structure. If you gravitate toward a clear hierarchy and well defined roles and swim lanes, you may find our self-managed style challenging.

• Feedback doesn't excite you. We're obsessed with quality and believe in continuous improvement. That means feedback that's sometimes nitpicky. If refining work until it's excellent feels over the top, this won't be a fit.

• Change makes you uncomfortable. Priorities shift and processes evolve. If ambiguity is uncomfortable, this may feel bumpy.

However, if this sounds like fuel, we'd love to talk.

How to Apply and What to Expect in the Interview Process

• Your work. Show us the work that reflects you at your best. We'll look at depth, the quality of your thinking, and the logic behind your choices.

• Lateral team fit. You'll speak with our Talent team about your career direction, your motivators, and our plans ahead.

• Work trial. You'll tackle a take-home challenge that mirrors what we actually do.

We’re Obsessed With Agility, Not The Agile Manifesto
We don’t chase dogma or rituals - we chase momentum. We adapt processes to fit problems, not the other way around.
We Take Ownership
Everyone leads something here. You will have room to run with ideas, and the trust to execute. That trust is built on how you show up: thinking things through, sweating the details, and following through.

What You’ll Do
As a Senior Front End Developer at Lateral, you will:

• Craft delightful digital experiences: Design, implement, and maintain front-end features using React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript. You’ll create reusable UI components and craft polished, responsive interfaces with a focus on quality

• Collaborate & communicate: Work closely with designers, back-end developers, and product managers in an asynchronous workflow. You’ll regularly communicate with clients to clarify requirements, demo features, and ensure we’re building the right thing.

You’ll have the freedom to introduce new ideas and best practices that raise the bar for our front-end, whether it’s improving our build process or adopting an innovative UI approach – all justified by real benefit to the team and product.

• Mentor and learn: Guide and mentor junior developers by sharing your expertise and providing constructive feedback. At the same time, stay curious and keep up with industry trends, frameworks, and standards. You’ll be encouraged to continuously learn and bring in knowledge, evaluating new technologies thoughtfully to see if they can enhance our product or developer experience (we love learning, but avoid “innovation for innovation’s sake”). In short, you’ll help shape a culture of excellence, ownership, and growth on the team.

Example Projects You May Join:

• Large scale B2B2C Commerce Platform: Help build a responsive, mobile-first experience for an international e-commerce client. For example, you might lead a dynamic multi-faceted search or a smooth checkout flow

You might use libraries like AGCharts to visualize large data sets, implement live updates via websockets, and ensure the interface remains highly performant and user-friendly.

Whatever the challenge, you’ll be building software that changes lives and moves industries forward.

How we measure success in this role

In the first two weeks

• You've set up your development environment and tools.

• You’ve pushed your first meaningful contribution (bugfix, UI tweak, or minor feature).

• You’re familiar with our async workflows and communication style.

• You’ve participated in your first client sync and started understanding the project's context.

• You’ve led development on a significant feature or initiative.

• You’ve actively mentored a teammate or shared knowledge through code review or documentation.

• You’ve authored or contributed to architectural decisions and design documents.

• You’ve established trust with clients through clear communication and technical guidance.

• You’ve improved performance, code structure, or tooling in meaningful ways.

After 3 months:

• You’re recognized as a technical leader in your project or team.

• You’ve initiated a broader improvement across projects (e.g., shared component library, new testing standard).

• You’re frequently unblocking teammates, elevating code quality, and proactively identifying risks.

• You balance speed and quality, delivering with care and clarity.

We measure success through:

• The impact and scope of your technical contributions.

• Your ability to lead initiatives, mentor others, and improve team practices.

• Code quality, performance, and maintainability.

• Positive feedback from peers, clients, and design/engineering leadership.

• Your growth mindset, communication skills, and influence on team culture.

What We’re Looking For
We are seeking for team members who are both highly technical and deeply care about their craft and how the work gets done. You must bring:

• 7+ years of professional front-end development experience building digital applications. Experience with modern Javascript libraries and tooling (e.g. React, npm, webpack...). Fluency in CSS and first-principles understanding front end technologies.

• Proven ability to craft , polish , delight , sweat the details.
You have an eye for design and UX. Pixel-perfect isn’t just a phrase to you – you care about creating beautiful, intuitive interfaces that make users happy. An understanding of design principles and attention to details like accessibility and responsive layout is important.

• Quality and reliability
You take pride in building high-quality software. You’re diligent about testing and documentation, and you proactively debug issues before they become problems. ￼ Performance and browser compatibility matter to you – you know how to make a web app fast and handle the quirks of different environments ￼. Ultimately, you balance speed of delivery with maintainability, ensuring the code you ship today won’t be tech debt tomorrow.

You’re a proactive problem solver who can break down complex problems, propose solutions, and drive them to completion. We trust our team members to be “managers of one” who take initiative and deliver results.

En dropea queremos potenciar nuestro crecimiento orgánico. Ya contamos con canales, contenido, recursos e iniciativas de marketing. postings.descriptionText:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca 's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role:
We are seeking an AI Security Engineer to own the technical security controls for how Alpaca uses AI. The scope includes identity for AI agents and automations, security requirements for AI tools and integrations, guardrails, and security logging. You will also assist in developing AI-powered security tooling.
You will keep those controls consistent as AI adoption grows, and you will work with the teams building with AI so security is part of the design.
This role reports to the Enterprise Security Architect and works closely with AI Enablement, Engineering, DevOps, GRC, and the wider Security team.
The Security Team is 100% distributed and remote.

Things You Get To Do:
The core responsibilities of the AI Security Engineer are focused on AI access controls, secure AI platforms, guardrails, visibility into AI usage, and AI-powered security tooling.

AI Identity and Access Controls:

• Agent Identity: Define how AI agents, bots, and automations authenticate, what they can access, and how their actions are attributed and audited.

• Tool Access: Own security requirements for AI tool integrations, including least-privilege access and credential handling.

• AI Assistant Controls: Define and enforce security settings for approved AI tools, including data handling and access policy.

• Least Privilege: Limit each agent and integration to the access it needs, and review that access when the integration changes.

Secure AI Platform, Tooling, and Response:

• Security Requirements: Define security requirements for internal AI applications, including identity, data handling, secrets, and review of new integrations.

• Guardrails: Design and implement guardrails for AI applications and agents.

• Design Reviews: Review new AI applications and integrations for security risks, and give builders clear, practical requirements.

• Security Tooling: Assist Security Operations in developing AI-powered tooling that supports detection, investigation, and response work.

• Safe Use in Security: Apply the same identity, data handling, and logging requirements to security team AI tools as to the rest of the company.

• Telemetry Requirements: Define the security logging AI systems must produce, and work with Security Operations on detection.

• Approved Use: Maintain visibility into AI tool usage and confirm it follows approved configurations.

• Incident Support: Lead the AI-specific aspects of security incidents, such as agent misuse or data exposure through AI tools.

• On-Call: Participate in the Security Operations on-call rotation after onboarding and cross-training.

Governance:

• Standards: Turn AI security standards into technical controls.

• GRC Partnership: Partner with GRC on AI governance and provide technical evidence for control design.

Who You Are (Must-Haves):

• Excited about Alpaca ’s mission and what we’re building

• 2+ years of experience in security engineering, application security, or cloud security roles

• Hands-on experience securing LLM applications, AI agents, or AI developer tools

• Understanding of AI-specific risks, such as prompt injection, data leakage, excessive agency, and insecure tool use (for example, the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications)

• Experience with identity and access controls for services and non-human identities, including OAuth, service accounts, and secrets management

• Programming experience in Python or another general-purpose language

• Experience with CI/CD security checks and cloud-native deployments

• Experience with security operations or incident response

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, especially when explaining risk to non-security builders

• Comfortable working cross-functionally and making pragmatic security decisions

• Willing to participate in an on-call rotation

• Experience building AI-assisted workflows for security operations

• Experience building security telemetry for AI systems

Who You Might Be ( Nice-to-Haves):

• Experience securing financial, trading, or other highly regulated platforms

• Experience securing enterprise AI coding tools and AI integrations

• Experience with policy-as-code and Kubernetes

• Familiarity with AI governance frameworks, such as the NIST AI Risk Management Framework or ISO 42001

• Ability to balance security rigor with operational efficiency and business needs

How We Take Care of You:

• Competitive Salary & Stock Options

• Health Benefits

• New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500

• Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.

postings.descriptionText:
Company Overview
Voted #1 EHR by PC Mag, WRS Health delivers fully integrated cloud-based EMR and practice management solutions to its clients. We continuously enhance our products and services, including EHR, practice management, marketing, patient coordination, and billing.

Job Overview
We are seeking a Product Discovery & Project Manager to lead early-stage product development by identifying client needs, gathering requirements, and translating business challenges into actionable product solutions.

This role emphasizes product discovery, design thinking, requirements gathering, and project management, with product design supporting the development of user-centered solutions.
