Product Discovery & Research

• Lead discovery sessions, client interviews, and user research, applying design thinking methodologies to identify business challenges, understand user needs, and uncover opportunities for product improvement.

• Conduct market and competitor research, analyze client feedback, and use design thinking principles to explore, evaluate, and validate potential solutions before development.

Requirements Gathering & Analysis

• Gather, analyze, and document client and business requirements, translating them into functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, and workflows.

• Collaborate with stakeholders and technical teams to clarify requirements, evaluate feasibility, and ensure alignment on project scope and expected outcomes.

Project Management & Execution

• Manage project scope, timelines, milestones, deliverables, and priorities from discovery through implementation.

• Coordinate cross-functional teams, monitor progress, resolve blockers, and communicate project updates to clients and leadership.

Product Strategy & Solution Development

• Translate research findings and business requirements into product recommendations aligned with user needs and company objectives.

• Collaborate with product leadership and technical teams to evaluate, prioritize, and plan product improvements.

Product Design & Prototyping

• Apply human-centered design principles to develop practical, intuitive, and user-friendly product solutions.

• Create or collaborate on wireframes, user flows, and basic prototypes to communicate concepts and validate requirements.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

• Serve as a liaison between clients, business stakeholders, and technical teams to maintain clear communication and alignment.

• Manage stakeholder expectations, address conflicting requirements, and facilitate discussions to support project decisions.

Leadership & Process Improvement

• Establish and improve processes, documentation standards, and best practices for product discovery, requirements gathering, and project management.

• Promote accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement across product development

A Day in the Life
Your day may involve meeting with clients to understand their workflows and gather requirements, applying design thinking techniques to explore potential solutions, and collaborating with developers to clarify technical specifications. You may also conduct product research, create workflow diagrams or basic prototypes , coordinate project priorities and timelines, and provide project updates to leadership.
Your primary focus is ensuring that client needs are clearly understood, product opportunities are thoroughly explored, requirements are well-defined, and projects move efficiently from discovery to delivery.

Success Metrics

• Product Discovery & Design Thinking: Effective identification, exploration, and validation of client needs and product opportunities before development.

• Requirements Quality: Clear, complete documentation that minimizes misunderstandings and development rework.

• Project Delivery: Timely completion of project milestones and deliverables.

• Stakeholder Satisfaction: Effective communication and alignment between clients, leadership, and technical teams.

• Product Improvements: Delivery of solutions that improve client workflows, usability, and business outcomes.

• Process Efficiency: Continuous improvement in discovery, requirements gathering, and project management processes.

Job Details

• Job Type: Full-time | Independent Contractor

• Location: Remote

• Hours: Must be available during standard US business hours (9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST or 8:30 AM – 4:30 PM EST)

Compensation will be based on location, experience, and qualifications.
This job description outlines the general responsibilities of the role and is not exhaustive. Additional duties may be assigned as needed to support business operations.
WRS Health is an equal opportunity employer.

postings.title: Visual / UI Designer (Digital Content Production)
postings.descriptionText:
Dura Digital is a global technology services company on a mission to ignite AI-enabled transformation and realize our client’s AI-powered future, empowering them through our global delivery studios and services. We bring together world-class talent across AI, engineering, human-centered design, data, and product delivery to help organizations accelerate innovation and create meaningful business outcomes.
The Visual / UI Designer (Digital Content Production) joins our Human-Centered Design Studio and is embedded with the content and production team of a leading global video game publisher. You will turn franchise key art and brand guidelines into high-impact web, email, and in-game experiences for some of the world’s most-played sports and entertainment titles—working at the speed of live game marketing and delivering work while the client’s North American team is offline.

Role Details

• Location: Remote, Latin America (Uruguay, Argentina, Brazil, or other locations with strong UK time-zone overlap).

• Schedule: Early-start working hours with substantial overlap with the UK business day, plus partial overlap with Eastern and Pacific time.

• Engagement: Embedded, full-time engagement of 6 to 9 months, with potential to extend.

• Openings: 2 to 3 designers, hired at two levels: Visual Designer (production and execution) and Senior Visual Designer (concept development through execution).

Key Responsibilities

Visual Design & Production

• Translate franchise key art, layouts, and brand guidelines into engaging web hero assets, including assets with motion that make pages more immersive as users scroll.

• Adapt creative across owned channels—email, in-game placements, and web—so the player journey feels cohesive from discovery to landing page.

• Select in-game characters, environments, and moments that make compelling hero banners and storytelling modules.

• Produce high volumes of polished, on-brand assets on tight timelines, maintaining quality as priorities shift.

Design Systems & UI

• Work within and contribute to the client’s Figma design system, extending components and templates while staying true to each franchise’s brand.

• Apply strong UI fundamentals—typography, layout, color, hierarchy, and accessibility (WCAG)—to every asset.

• Partner with UX designers to ensure visual work is usable and consistent across channels and devices.

• Keep all web assets organized, documented, and stored in Figma so the team can find and reuse them.

Concept Development (Senior level)

• Lead creative concepts from brief to final execution for campaigns, launches, and live-service moments.

• Present concepts and rationale to creative directors and marketing stakeholders, and iterate quickly on feedback.

• Elevate brand guidelines into fresh, engaging digital executions rather than simply reproducing them.

Collaboration & Ways of Working

• Work as an embedded member of the client team, building direct relationships with game studio creative directors and marketing leads in the UK, Canada, and Europe.

• Collaborate closely with the project coordinator to receive clear briefs, track assets, and hand off work for review.

• Hand off completed work at the end of your day so it is ready for the North American team at the start of theirs.

• Use AI tools, including Claude, to speed up exploration, versioning, and production where appropriate.

• Ensure your work reflects Dura Digital ’s values: curious, vocal, trusted, creative, available, respectful.

What You Bring

• 3+ years of experience in visual, UI, or digital design (5+ years for the Senior level), ideally in gaming, entertainment, sports, or consumer brands.

• A portfolio showing high-visual digital work: web heroes, landing pages, email, banners, or in-product placements.

• Advanced Figma skills, including working within and contributing to design systems.

• Strong Adobe Creative Cloud skills, especially Photoshop; After Effects or motion design experience is highly desirable.

• Solid understanding of usability and accessibility standards.

• Experience with, or genuine interest in using, AI tools such as Claude in creative workflows.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities and same-week turnarounds.

• Advanced written and spoken English (C1 or higher); comfortable presenting work to senior stakeholders.

• Passion for video games is a strong plus.

Why join Dura Digital

• Work on globally recognized game franchises and see your work in front of millions of players.

• Be embedded in a world-class creative team while being supported by Dura Digital ’s Human-Centered Design Studio.

• Be part of a remote-first, collaborative international culture across Canada, the United States, and Latin America.

• Grow your craft in design systems, motion, and AI-enabled creative production.

• Competitive compensation, supportive leadership, and significant opportunity for impact and career growth.

Dura Digital is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are based on merit and business needs, and not on the basis of race, color, religion, citizenship, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, veteran status, family care status, sex, or any other basis protected by federal, state, or local law.

postings.descriptionText:
Why Blue Coding ?
At Blue Coding , we specialize in hiring excellent developers and amazing people from all over Latin America and other parts of the world. For the past 11 years, we’ve helped cutting-edge companies in the United States and Canada build great development teams and develop great products. Large multinationals, digital agencies, Saas providers, and software consulting firms are just a few of our clients. Our team of over 150 engineers, project managers, QA, UX/UI designers, and many more is distributed in more than 10 countries across the Americas. We are a fully remote company working with a wide array of technologies, and we have expertise in every stage of the software development process.
Our team is highly connected, united, and culturally diverse, and our collaborators are involved in many initiatives around the world, from wildlife preservation to volunteering at local charities. We stand for honesty, fairness, respect, efficiency, hard work, and cooperation.

This position is open to candidates based in Argentina, Brazil, Colombia, Peru, and the Dominican Republic.

What are we looking for?

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join one of our US clients, a life insurance company serving the middle American market, on work focused on security vulnerability remediation. You’ll triage findings from Snyk, fix the ones that can be fixed quickly and safely, and escalate the ones that need deeper design work. Most of the applications are built in Ruby, with ongoing work to modernize them into Python, plus some legacy .NET projects. The work covers open source dependencies, first-party code, containers, and infrastructure as code.

You’ll be embedded in the engineering teams that build and support the applications you work on, so you’ll have their support from day one. If you have a few years of development experience, are fluent in English, are careful with details, and are comfortable working in code you didn’t write, we’d like to hear from you. Our jobs are fully remote, and you will be integrated directly into the client’s team.

Here are some of the exciting day-to-day challenges you will face in this role:

• Review and triage findings from Snyk Open Source, Snyk Code, Snyk Container, and Snyk IaC, separating real, reachable issues from false positives.

• Prioritize findings by severity, exploitability, and exposure against remediation SLAs, and route them to the right team through Jira.

• Fix vulnerabilities across Ruby, Python, and .NET applications: dependency upgrades, first-party code fixes, container base image updates, and infrastructure as code corrections.

• Test every change to confirm the vulnerability is closed and nothing else broke, and add unit and integration tests where coverage is thin.

• Submit clear pull requests that explain what was found, what changed, and how you verified it, and respond to review feedback.

• Write risk-accept or ignore recommendations with a clear justification for the owning team lead to approve.

• Keep Snyk projects, Jira tickets, and remediation status up to date so progress against SLAs can be reported accurately.

• Escalate findings that need breaking upgrades, architectural changes, or cross-team coordination instead of working around them.

• Join team ceremonies (stand-ups, sprint planning, reviews, and retros) and document recurring fixes so other engineers can reuse them.

You will shine if you have:

• A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

• 3+ years of software development experience.

• Solid hands-on experience with Ruby.

• Experience with Python.

• Experience with dependency management (Bundler/RubyGems, pip) and an understanding of how version upgrades can introduce breaking changes.

• Strong knowledge of Git and pull request workflows.

• Experience with relational databases.

• Experience writing unit and integration tests.

• The ability to work carefully in unfamiliar code in established systems and make small, well-tested changes.

• Fluent English and strong written communication, especially when writing tickets and pull requests.

• Availability to work US time zone hours in a fast-paced, agile team.

It doesn’t hurt if you also:

• Have some experience with C#/.NET, as you may occasionally touch legacy .NET projects.

• Know security fundamentals such as CVEs, CVSS scoring, the OWASP Top 10, and secure coding practices.

• Have used Snyk or similar tools (Dependabot, Mend, Veracode, SonarQube).

• Have worked with Docker, AWS, or infrastructure as code tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.

• Have experience with CI/CD pipelines.

• Use AI coding tools (Claude, Kiro, GitHub Copilot) hands-on, and know how to review and verify AI-generated changes before submitting them.

What we offer:

• Salary in USD

• 100% Remote

Ready to learn more? Apply below!

postings.title: Head of People Operations
postings.descriptionText:
About IOMETE
IOMETE is the Sovereign Data+AI Platform: a self-hosted platform for data and AI, built on open standards like Apache Iceberg and Apache Spark, that enterprises run on-premises, in their own cloud, or hybrid — always under their own control. We serve organizations for whom data ownership and security are non-negotiable, including central banks, government ministries, large financial institutions, and global enterprises. IOMETE was recognized in the Gartner® Market Guide for Data Lakehouse Platforms.
We are a US C-Corp with a fully remote team of 30+ people, most of them engineers, spread across multiple countries. We are growing quickly, and we intend to keep the things that made us good while we do it: high trust, high ownership, low bureaucracy.

About the role
Until now, our co-founders have handled every contract, compliance question, hire, and offsite themselves. That worked for 10 people. It does not work at 30, and it will break at 60. We are hiring our first dedicated People leader to own the full employee lifecycle — from how we find and hire great people, to how we pay and contract them compliantly across countries, to how we keep a distributed team connected.
This is a builder role. You will inherit working-but-manual processes and turn them into a system that scales. You will be hands-on every day: drafting contracts, running hiring loops, and booking offsite venues are all part of the job. You will also have real influence on how IOMETE grows, working directly with the founders.
We want to be transparent from day one: the role currently spans three areas. As we grow, we expect recruiting to become a dedicated function. When that happens, you will help define and hire for that role, and you may have the opportunity to lead it, depending on how the role and the company develop.

What you will own

1. People Operations (roughly 50% of your time)

• Own all employment and contractor agreements across countries, working through Deel (our global HRIS and EOR platform) and with external counsel where needed.

• Ensure compliance with local labor law in every country where we employ or contract people: correct worker classification (employee vs. contractor), statutory benefits, notice periods, termination rules, and data privacy for employee records.

• Design and maintain our compensation framework: levels, salary bands by role and geography, equity guidelines, and a consistent process for offers, raises, and promotions.

• Run onboarding and offboarding end to end, so that a new engineer is productive in week one and a departing team member leaves cleanly and compliantly.

• Build and document core people processes: performance reviews, leave and time off, policies and the employee handbook, and an HR calendar.

• Keep people-related data accurate in Deel and produce simple reporting for the founders (headcount, cost, attrition, time to hire).

• Be the trusted, confidential point of contact for team members on people matters.

2. Recruiting (roughly 35% of your time)

• Fix our hiring process. Today, hiring managers do too much of it themselves. You will build a structured, repeatable process: intake meetings, role scorecards, interview loops, candidate communication, and fast, well-documented decisions.

• Own the recruiting toolstack and pipeline, and run sourcing for priority roles, with a focus on senior engineering and go-to-market talent across multiple regions.

• Partner with hiring managers to write job descriptions, calibrate the bar, and train interviewers.

• Manage external recruiters and agencies when we use them.

• Make sure every candidate, hired or not, has a professional and respectful experience with IOMETE .

• Track and report on core recruiting metrics: pipeline health, time to hire, offer acceptance rate, and source of hire.

3. Culture, Events & Internal Operations (roughly 15% of your time)

• Plan and run our company offsites end to end: location, budget, travel and visas, agenda, and logistics.

• Organize other company events and moments that matter for a remote team, both virtual and in person.

• Help build and protect a healthy, high-performance culture: rituals, recognition, internal communication, and listening to how the team is really doing (engagement surveys, stay interviews, exit interviews).

• Take on cross-functional projects for the founders where a people-minded operator is the right person to drive them.

What success looks like

In your first 90 days:

• You have audited all current contracts and worker classifications and fixed or flagged every compliance gap.

• Onboarding and offboarding run from a documented checklist, not from founders' memories.

• A structured hiring process is live and hiring managers are using it for every open role.

• The founders spend materially less time on people administration.

In your first 12 months:

• A compensation framework with levels and bands is in place and used for every offer and review.

• We have scaled headcount significantly with a strong quality bar and a good candidate experience.

• At least one successful company offsite has taken place.

• A first performance review cycle has been completed.

• The scope and job description for a dedicated recruiting role are ready.

What we are looking for

Must-haves:

• 5+ years in People Operations, HR, or a People generalist role, including at least 3 years at a fast-growing startup or scale-up.

• Highly organized, discreet, and comfortable owning many moving parts with little supervision.

• Hands-on experience employing people across multiple countries, using an EOR or global HRIS platform such as Deel, Remote, Rippling, or Oyster.

• Working knowledge of employee, EOR vs. contractor classification and the practical differences in labor law across jurisdictions — and the judgment to know when to call counsel.

• Proven experience running recruiting end to end, ideally including technical hiring.

• Experience designing or running a compensation framework.

• Excellent written and spoken English. Our company language is English, and much of this role is written communication.

• A builder's mindset: you prefer creating a simple process that works over waiting for the perfect one.

Nice to have:

• Experience at a remote-first company or a B2B software company.

• Experience organizing international events or offsites, including travel and visa logistics.

• HR certification (e.g., SHRM, CIPD) or a legal background.

Working hours and location
This is a fully remote role. We are hiring people who live in Latin America, with a preference for the UTC-3 time zone. Our team is distributed across several time zones, so we ask for a reliable daily overlap of at least three hours with colleagues in Europe and further east, which in practice means starting early in your local day.
You will be engaged through Deel, either as an employee or as a contractor depending on your country of residence.

What we offer

• Compensation: $36k - $48k annually, depending on experience.

•
Equity in IOMETE .

• A fully remote setup with flexible working hours within the overlap window.

• Direct access to and partnership with the founders, and real ownership of a function you will build from the ground up.

• The opportunity to grow with the company as the People function grows.

Our hiring process

• Interview with Piet, Co-Founder & COO (45 minutes)

• Interview with one or two hiring managers (30 minutes each)

• Interview with Vusal, Co-founder & CEO (30 minutes)

•
Reference checks and offer

postings.title: Customer Success Manager - Americas
postings.descriptionText:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role:

As a Customer Success Manager at Alpaca, you are the front line in our pursuit of enabling financial markets access for everyone on the planet. You'll work with our partners (customers) from contract signature through renewal, ensuring they have a positive experience leading to successful outcomes.

Reporting to the Director, Success, this role supports Alpaca's B2B brokerage and crypto offerings, helping customers launch and scale US securities and crypto trading applications worldwide.

We're looking for someone who brings hands-on experience in the brokerage, crypto exchange, or trading-platform industry and understands the unique operational, regulatory, and technical challenges of supporting customers in financial markets.

Things You Get To Do:

• Act as the primary contact for B2B/enterprise customers, accountable for building and maintaining strong relationships with key contacts throughout the customer lifecycle

• Ensure customer satisfaction, retention, and success

• Manage escalations, internally and externally, with a focus on customer empathy

• Maintain regular contact with customers to understand their business priorities, monitor their progress toward achieving key results, and continually identify and mitigate risks (relationship, commercial, etc.)

• Work with partners to accurately forecast growth and identify and monitor progress toward shared goals

• Drive adoption of Alpaca features (new and existing) among our Live Partners

• Identify and disseminate best practices and pitfalls

• Represent the partner internally across multiple groups, including Marketing, Product, and Operations

• Maintain positive relationships, internally and externally, to drive overall success and overcome obstacles

• Provide internal communication and reporting on overall account status, health, and risk

• Develop a success strategy for ensuring customer success

• Identify areas and consider solutions for improvement and optimization within Alpaca

• Deliver QBRs and executive reports that align customer goals with platform outcomes

• Serve as a trusted advisor to customers’ leadership teams, aligning Alpaca capabilities with their go-to-market strategy

• Own the full customer lifecycle post-signature, including onboarding, activation, expansion, and renewal

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Sales, and our Broker-Dealer to leverage process understanding, champion partner needs, and influence roadmap priorities

• Perform ad-hoc duties and responsibilities as assigned

Who You Are (Must-Haves):

• 4–6 years of experience in a customer success role managing customer relationships

• Direct professional experience working at a brokerage, broker-dealer, crypto exchange, or trading platform

• Hands-on understanding of brokerage or crypto trading operations, including customer onboarding, account funding, trading workflows, and the operational or compliance challenges associated with financial markets

• Comfortable working US hours (ET) in a remote setup

• Understanding of and experience with key technology concepts, such as SaaS and APIs

• FinTech experience, especially within the broker-dealer business

• Experience working with both large and small companies

• A dedicated interest in Alpaca's mission to enable financial services access to everyone on the planet

• Ability to work remotely and independently and to self-manage time and obligations

• Flexibility to jump in where and when needed to help drive Alpaca's growth

• Desire to learn

• Ability to manage customer relationships across companies of various sizes

• A team player who thrives on ownership, transparency, and being relentlessly partner-first. We move fast, support each other, and aim to grow together.

Who You Might Be (Nice-to-Haves):

• Experience supporting B2B brokerage-as-a-service, embedded investing, or trading API platforms

• Familiarity with US securities brokerage infrastructure, including clearing, custody, settlement, and broker-dealer compliance.

• Experience supporting API integrations or technical onboarding for trading applications.

• Experience working with international B2B clients or fintech partners launching financial products across multiple markets.

• Experience managing institutional trading customers or strategic fintech partnerships.

• Startup mindset suited to a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

How We Take Care of You:

• Competitive Salary & Stock Options

• Health Benefits

• New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500

• Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.

Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

About the Role

Alpaca is looking for a collaborative and detail-oriented Due Diligence Analyst - Americas (ET hours) to join our Risk team. In this role, you will support the onboarding of new partners, including international fintechs and financial institutions, by helping ensure that required due diligence, risk, compliance, and AML standards are met before launch.

This is a hands-on, partner-facing role that sits at the intersection of risk management, third-party due diligence, compliance, operations, and project execution. You will help evaluate prospective partners, review key documentation, coordinate internal requirements, and guide partners through the onboarding process.

The ideal candidate is organized, analytical, comfortable communicating with external stakeholders, and able to manage multiple onboarding workstreams in a fast-paced environment.

What You’ll Be Doing:

• Support due diligence reviews for new and existing partners, including fintech companies, financial institutions, vendors, and other third-party service providers.

• Communicate regularly with prospective and onboarding partners globally to help them understand requirements, timelines, and outstanding documentation needs.

• Conduct and support third-party risk management processes, including KYC, KYB, enhanced due diligence, policy and procedure reviews, customer onboarding flow reviews, and risk assessments.

• Review partner-provided documentation for completeness, consistency, and potential risk indicators.

• Track partner onboarding progress, follow up on outstanding items, and help ensure required documents are submitted ahead of launch deadlines.

• Respond to partner questions related to the onboarding and due diligence process, escalating requests or issues as appropriate.

• Work closely with internal teams, including Operations, Compliance, AML, Legal, Product, and Project Management, to ensure partner integrations meet internal requirements.

• Identify process gaps, recurring partner questions, or documentation issues, and contribute to improvements in the partner onboarding and diligence process.

• Maintain accurate records of diligence reviews, decisions, approvals, and supporting documentation.

What You’ll Need:

• Experience: 2–3+ years of experience in risk management, operational risk, third-party risk, compliance, AML, financial crime, or related functions within financial services, fintech, brokerage, or another regulated industry.

• International Mindset: Comfort working with international partners and reviewing diligence materials across different jurisdictions and regulatory environments.

• Analytical Skills: Strong critical thinking skills with the ability to identify anomalies, inconsistencies, gaps, and potential risk indicators in documentation, data, and partner responses.

• Organizational Skills: Strong project management and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple partner onboarding processes simultaneously.

• Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain requirements clearly to external partners and internal stakeholders.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Ability to work effectively across Risk, Compliance, AML, Operations, Legal, Product, and Project Management teams.

• Proactive Ownership: A self-starter mindset with strong accountability, sound judgment, and the ability to operate independently in a rapidly evolving environment.

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Economics, Risk Management, Criminal Justice, International Relations, or a related field.

Nice to Haves:

• Familiarity with financial services regulatory expectations, including BSA/AML, KYC, KYB, enhanced due diligence, and third-party risk management practices.

• Experience supporting partner, vendor, or third-party onboarding in a fintech, brokerage, payments, banking, or financial services environment.

• Understanding of operational resilience, business continuity, cybersecurity, data protection, or outsourcing risk frameworks.

• Experience reviewing policies and procedures related to AML, sanctions, customer onboarding, fraud, compliance, or operational controls.

• Familiarity with broker-dealer, introducing broker, or embedded finance models.

• Experience using case management, GRC, CRM, or project tracking tools.

How We Take Care of You:

• Competitive Salary & Stock Options

• Health Benefits

• New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500

• Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

postings.title: Territory Manager (Montana Central)
postings.descriptionText:
ABOUT HALTER

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard. 

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund https://foundersfund.com, Bessemer Venture Partners https://www.bvp.com/, BOND, https://www.bondcap.com/ DCVC https://www.dcvc.com/, Blackbird https://www.blackbird.vc/, Promus Ventures https://www.promusventures.com/, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures https://www.icehouseventures.co.nz/?utm_term=icehouse%20ventures&utm_campaign=Brand+Keywords&utm_source=adwords&utm_medium=ppc&hsa_acc=4064636360&hsa_cam=16902737884&hsa_grp=134004309485&hsa_ad=592971340272&hsa_src=g&hsa_tgt=kwd-1082530126230&hsa_kw=icehouse%20ventures&hsa_mt=b&hsa_net=adwords&hsa_ver=3&gclid=Cj0KCQjw2v-gBhC1ARIsAOQdKY0J0DepRVFDmjQlAkJPbZuQnLSA5UVzUzOXYiPxkjX-SeVa513_BhkaAr-MEALw_wcB.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/halter-limited & Instagram https://www.instagram.com/lifeathalter/.

About Halter

Ever dream about being in tech but aren’t quite ready to trade in your cowboy boots? Look no further than Halter! As the leading provider of virtual fencing technology, Halter is on a mission to enable 50% of the world’s landmass to be more productive and sustainable. This role is paramount for our growth aspirations and will enable us to continue making an impact on ranches across the US.

As a Territory Manager at Halter, you will play a critical role in driving new business growth and ensuring customer success within your designated territory. You will be responsible for executing sales strategies, building strong customer relationships, and meeting ambitious growth targets, all while acting as Halter’s on-the-ground representative. This role requires a proactive and hands-on approach, with a focus on both expansion and long-term customer satisfaction. In this role, you will prioritize daily efforts that optimize performance and drive value for your customers. Working closely with cross-functional teams, including Product, Support, and Customer Onboarding, you’ll share field insights to ensure Halter’s technology continues to meet the needs of US farmers.

Your day-to-day could include being on horseback, helping customers gather their cattle, on a side-by-side traversing their pastures, talking about how Halter could benefit their pastures, or attending industry events like CattleCon or your local Livestock Association
meetups.

 

This role covers the Central region of Montana. Frequent travel is required as apart of this role.

 


WHAT YOUR DAY COULD LOOK LIKE

 - Prospecting New Business: You’re driving up driveways, attending local cattle auctions, meeting with your local Livestock, Cattlemans, Stockmans associations, building your new business pipeline through outbound lead generation efforts. You’re fielding inbound leads in a timely manner, prioritizing administrative tasks with your in-field activities.

 - In-Field Sales: You don’t mind getting your hands and boots dirty. Halter is best discussed over a coffee at a kitchen table, in the horse saddle, or on a side-by-side in a pasture. You’re out on the ranch helping potential customers before diving into the value of Halter. You’re dropping off coffee during calving season. You value the magic moments that make all the difference to our customers.

 - Expanding Existing Opportunities: You’re always looking for new opportunities, and that includes expanding your existing customers with Halter. You find value in expanding relationships and finding new ways to increase value over time. Not every rancher will collar all of their cows, so you see this as a unique opportunity to meet your goals.

 - Hitting Sales Targets: High-growth sales targets don’t scare you; you step up to a challenge and like shooting high. You’re an expert pipeline manager and don’t second-guess unqualifying a lead. You’re able to manage today’s deals while keeping next month in your sights.

 - Customer Account Management: Building relationships is more than just making the sale to you. After the sale, you aim to maintain close relationships with your customers to ensure their ongoing satisfaction, provide support, and address any challenges they face with Halter’s products. You’ll also ensure a smooth handoff from sales to customer onboarding and deployment of Halter, helping customers get the most value from Halter’s solutions.

 - Territory Ownership: You have a high level of ownership and take pride in what you build. Owning an entire territory means giving treatment to every corner and leaving no stone unturned. You value being the face of your territory, meeting with high-level stakeholders from various local, state, and federal agencies to build lasting relationships with regional agricultural groups.

 - Customer Onboarding: Your high level of ownership doesn’t stop after the sale. You dive in to make sure your customers have the very best onboarding experience possible. You actively own the end-to-end customer experience during onboarding and deployment of Halter’s product, ensuring a smooth transition from sales to implementation even when you’ve handed off the customer to different teams across Halter.

 - Field Learnings & Feedback: Feedback is not only paramount to the companies you want to work for, but it’s also ingrained in how you would own your territory. Serving as the primary point of contact for gathering customer feedback in your territory, you work tirelessly to advocate for what your customers need.

 - Collaborating with Support Teams: You’re a natural collaborator, seeking out partners across Halter to resolve any issues your customers encounter, and quickly. You escalate problems as needed and ensure that customers in your territory feel fully supported.

 - Attending Industry Events: You leverage opportunities at relevant industry and Halter events to generate leads and deepen relationships with existing customers. You’ll participate in demonstrations and network to expand Halter’s influence in the market.

 - Contributing to the US Sales Strategy: You strongly believe that a team can only be stronger when they work together. You strive to work with the broader team to optimize and evolve the sales process, ensuring it fits the US market. As we scale, your input will help drive greater efficiencies.



YOU’LL BE GREAT IF YOU EXHIBIT

 - Driven Attitude & Communication skills: Results-driven, motivated, and adaptable, you excel in high-stakes environments. You’re well-prepared and skilled at communicating with customers and internal teams alike. You are proactive and do not wait to act.

 - Ranching / Cattle Experience: You know the ropes (and the reins) of ranching or cattle operations, understanding the unique challenges of the industry. This experience allows you to connect meaningfully with customers about what matters most.

 - Sales & Customer Success Expertise: You have a strong history of creating new business opportunities, negotiating a value-based sales conversation, and have a background in building lasting customer relationships. You build relationships versus transactional sales, aiming for the long-term success stories and can expand existing relationships through upsell opportunities.

 - Territory Management experience: Experience managing a large territory with a balanced focus on sales and customer success, ideally within agriculture or technology.

 - Problem Solving & Collaboration ability: Resourceful and quick-thinking, you work well with cross-functional teams to address challenges and drive solutions.

 - Willingness to Travel: Frequent travel within your territory to engage with customers and prospects.

 


BONUS THINGS YOU COULD BRING ALONG TO THE ROLE

 - Familiarity with precision agriculture or virtual fencing technologies.Background in customer-facing roles within agriculture technology.

 - Background in selling software (SaaS) solutions in a B2B environment.


OUR BENEFITS

 - Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP): Own a part of Halter and share in our growth and success

 - 401(k): 100% match on the first 3% contributed, plus 50% match on the next 2% (up to a 4% employer match), with immediate vesting

 - Comprehensive health benefits: Medical, dental, and vision coverage starting the first day of the month after you join (with most premiums covered, including 100% of employee-only health premiums on select plans)

 - Employee Assistance Program (EAP) & paid wellness leave: Access confidential support through JustWorks plus 3 paid wellness days per year

 - Personal growth fund: $750 USD per year to support learning, development, or personal growth goals

 - Unlimited PTO: Take time off when you need it—no accrual required, available from day one

 - Parental leave: 16 weeks paid leave for birthing parents and 8 weeks paid leave for non-birthing parents

 - Onboarding travel to New Zealand: Fly to NZ for onboarding at Halter HQ in Auckland—meet the team, visit a test farm, and immerse yourself in all things Halter

The annual OTE salary range for this role is $140,000 - $165,000. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Halter and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location.


JOIN OUR TEAM

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page https://www.halterhq.com/careers for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/halter-limited & Instagram https://www.instagram.com/lifeathalter/.




WHY OUR TEAM LOVES WORKING AT HALTER:

 - Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

 - Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges

postings.title: Revenue Manager
postings.descriptionText:
Maximizar el RevPAR y los ingresos de hospedaje de los hoteles del cluster, anticipando la demanda y proponiendo estrategias de precio, mix de clientes y distribución que aseguren el cumplimiento del presupuesto.

Responsabilidades principales
Análisis y datos

• Construir y mantener una base de datos confiable para los análisis de revenue.

• Analizar la producción histórica por hotel, segmento y canal, e identificar tendencias.

• Monitorear el mercado, la performance del set competitivo (benchmarking) y el comportamiento de reserva del cliente.

Previsión y estrategia

• Prever la demanda por segmento, período y día de la semana, y mantener actualizado el forecast de cada hotel.

• Definir la estrategia de optimización: gestión del mix de clientes, precio dinámico, restricciones y apertura/cierre de canales.

• Actualizar e interpretar las recomendaciones de venta (RevMix) y asegurar su aplicación en los canales directos e indirectos (sistema de reservas, channel manager, OTAs).

Planificación y comercial

• Participar en la elaboración de los planes de marketing, ventas y presupuesto de cada hotel.

• Acompañar el proceso anual de pricing y contracting (cuentas corporativas, agencias y operadores) de los hoteles del cluster.

• Acompañar las cotizaciones de grupos y tripulaciones, definiendo tarifas y condiciones según la demanda esperada.

• Acompañar la elaboración del presupuesto anual de hospedaje.

Gestión y reporte

• Preparar los reportes de resultados (OTB vs presupuesto y año anterior, RevPAR, ADR, ocupación, índices del set competitivo) y presentarlos en las revisiones mensuales (BRM).

• Aplicar las recomendaciones en el sistema de reservas (Tars) y en las ventas directas de cada hotel.

• Evaluar los resultados y proponer acciones correctivas.

• Trabajar en conjunto con los equipos comerciales, de reservas y operaciones de cada hotel.

Requisito
Detalle

Graduado/a en Administración, Economía, Hotelería, Turismo o carreras afines.

Deseable 2 años en revenue management o yield management hotelero (en el cargo o en el área)
Idioma: inglés

Herramientas
Excel avanzado; sistemas de revenue y reservas (Revtool, RevMix, Tars, PMS/CRS); channel manager y herramientas de benchmarking

Experiencia en cadenas hoteleras internacionales y en gestión de más de un hotel

• Oportunidad para desarrollar su talento y crecer dentro de su hotel y en todo el mundo!

Diversidad e Inclusión para Accor significa recibir a cada uno y respetar sus diferencias, dando prioridad solamente a las cualidades y habilidades. Women in Sales Force LATAM es una experiencia regional de desarrollo para atraer y preparar talento femenino en etapa inicial de carrera, con interés en construir una trayectoria en posiciones comerciales y técnico-comerciales. • Desarrollar un proyecto práctico alineado con las prioridades de la Unidad de Negocio o Target Market.

• Completar la ruta de aprendizaje técnica, comercial y de habilidades definida para el programa.

postings.title: Jefe de Tratamiento de Aguas Residuales
postings.descriptionText:
Misión:
Asegurar el funcionamiento eficiente, seguro y conforme a los estándares de calidad y normativas legales de los procesos de tratamiento de aguas residuales y productos derivados, mediante la gestión técnica, presupuestaria y humana del área, promoviendo la mejora continua, el cumplimiento de objetivos industriales y el desarrollo de un entorno laboral profesional y respetuoso.

Principales funciones:

• Respeta y hace respetar las políticas de la empresa.

• Colabora con el cumplimiento de los objetivos de la empresa.

• Pone en aplicación las instrucciones dadas por la Dirección Industrial.

• Participa en la definición de los objetivos de su departamento.

• Elabora el presupuesto de gastos fijos de su departamento.

• Recopila e interpreta con frecuencia semanal los resultados de su departamento.

• Responsable de cumplir el presupuesto para su departamento.

• Contribuye en mantener un ambiente de trabajo profesional, agradable y respetuoso.

• Dar soluciones a problemas de proceso, de funcionamiento de equipos, de calidad y de personal.

• Propone y lidera la aplicación de las acciones preventivas o correctivas a implementar.

• Responsable del nivel de calidad del producto en curso de elaboración y terminado en cuanto a cremas se refiere.

• Responsable de la calidad de productos derivados y de la performance del tratamiento de efluentes.

• Responsable del buen funcionamiento (procesos, calidad, limpieza, orden, disciplina, seguridad) en sus talleres.

• Responsable de la productividad de sus áreas y de ratios de consumos de materias primas y/o material de envase.

• Responsable de la actualización de la base de procedimientos inherentes a los talleres a su cargo.

• Colabora con Mantenimiento e Ingeniería en el estudio de modificaciones y/o proyectos.

• Coordina con Mantenimiento las intervenciones mayores en equipos.

• Responsable de asegurar el mantenimiento del orden y limpieza de los talleres a su cargo.

• Analiza junto con Mantenimiento las causas y soluciones a fallas importantes y repetitivas de equipos.

• De ser necesario, participa en la evaluación y aprobación de proveedores o nuevas materias primas.

• Elabora y es responsable de hacer cumplir el planning de producción.

• Responsable de la programación, y coordinación de equipos de trabajo acordes al planning de producción.

• Advierte desvíos reales y/o potenciales relacionados a la inocuidad de productos o incumplimientos de índole legal.

Formación:

• Ingeniero o Lic. Químico, Electromecánico, Mecánico, en Biotecnologías o en Agroalimentación (con experiencia en procesos productivos).

Experiencia:

• Tres años de experiencia en el área o tres años en puestos de similar responsabilidad transitados en empresas de alimentación o químicas de mediana o grande envergadura, o experiencia adquirida en el Grupo Lesaffre en posición similar.

Conocimientos:

• Conocimiento profundo de Procesos, y particularmente del tratamiento de Aguas Residuales y Evaporación.

• Debe estar familiarizado con el entorno del laboratorio industrial y ser capaz de asimilar de forma eficaz grandes cantidades de datos.

• Se requieren sólidos conocimientos de matemáticas, química y microbiología

• Conocimiento fehaciente de procesos productivos.

• Conocimientos de normas ISO y sistemas de gestión de inocuidad alimentaria.

• Normas de manejo y almacenamiento de químicos.

• Normas de gestión de residuos industriales.

• Normas de gestión de derrames.

• Manejo de PC avanzado.

• Normas básicas de seguridad en Industria (EPP, orden y limpieza, etc.).

• Lectura y comprensión de una MSDS.

• Conocimiento básico de BPM.

Habilitades Técnicas:

• Capacidad de liderazgo y manejo de personal.

• Aptitud para relacionarse a distintos niveles

• Iniciativa y capacidad de comunicación.

• Alta motivación.

• Amplia disponibilidad horaria.

• Conjunto de aplicaciones ofimáticas de Microsoft (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), Power Bi deseable.

• Buenas habilidades de comunicación

• Dominio de idioma inglés (nivel intermedio o superior).

• Dominio de idioma francés (nivel intermedio o superior), no excluyente.

Te ofrecemos un entorno laboral pensado para tu bienestar:
Beneficios:

• Almuerzo – Opciones variadas para una alimentación saludable.

• Obra social para tu grupo familiar – Protegemos tu bienestar y el de los tuyos.

• Vacaciones extendidas – A partir de los 3 años, accede a 21 días corridos de descanso.

• Bono anual – Reconocemos tu compromiso con una recompensa especial.

• Bonda Plataforma de descuentos exclusivos – Accede a beneficios especiales en distintos rubros pensados solo para vos.

• Programa de Bienestar – Plataforma de asistencia Psicológica y Legal gratuita al Colaborador.

• Día del Cumpleaños Libre – Disfruta tu día como más te guste.

Únete a una empresa familiar con una larga trayectoria y valores centrados en las personas, con una misión clara: Nutrir y Proteger nuestro Planeta.

Podrás desarrollar tu carrera en un entorno de trabajo enriquecedor y en un contexto multicultural que promueve el aprendizaje continuo y la colaboración.
Te ofrecemos un entorno laboral pensado para tu bienestar:
En Lesaffre, la diversidad es una fortaleza que enriquece nuestra cultura y nuestros equipos.

Estamos comprometidos con ofrecerte un entorno laboral donde puedas desarrollarte plenamente, sin importar tu origen, género, edad o capacidades.

Valoramos todas las candidaturas, porque creemos que las perspectivas diversas fortalecen nuestra capacidad de innovar y enfrentar los desafíos del futuro.
Gracias por tu interés en formar parte de nuestro equipo:

postings.title: INGENIERO PROYECTO
postings.descriptionText:
En YPF buscamos personas que quieran ser parte de un gran equipo que transforma desafíos en oportunidades y que actúa con excelencia para generar valor. Con más de cien años de historia, somos la compañía energética líder de la Argentina, impulsando el desarrollo y la innovación tecnológica del país.

¡Sumarte a YPF es unirte a un proyecto que combina experiencia, pasión y la energía necesaria para seguir construyendo nuestro futuro!

¿Qué buscamos?

Nos encontramos en la búsqueda de Ingenieros/as Junior con ganas de sumarse a un equipo colaborativo que se potencia, para desarrollarse en el rol de Ingeniero/a de Proyectos para la Gerencia de Proyectos Industriales, de la Vicepresidencia de Infraestructura.

¿Cuáles serán tus principales desafíos?



• Participar y desarrollarse progresivamente en la gestión, supervisión, planificación y revisión de los proyectos de diseño y construcción de nuevas instalaciones, ampliaciones y modificaciones de las instalaciones actuales, contribuyendo a prever con suficiente antelación la dotación de recursos requeridos para el cumplimiento de las especificaciones, presupuestos, plan de mejora y mantenimiento, de acuerdo con la legislación y normativas vigentes, las políticas de Seguridad, Calidad, Medio Ambiente y Energía de la Compañía y las directrices de la Unidad de Negocio correspondiente.


• Participar y colaborar en el estudio de las propuestas de proyectos de inversión, contribuyendo a la definición de las especificaciones técnicas y valoraciones económicas de los mismos, a fin de aportar lineamientos e información que contribuyan a la ejecución óptima de los proyectos.


• Participar en la coordinación y seguimiento de las tareas de ingeniería, compras y contratos, inspección y activación, control de costos y control de programación de acuerdo con la estrategia de ejecución del proyecto, desarrollando progresivamente una visión integral del proyecto y de las interfaces entre los distintos involucrados.


• Participar y brindar soporte en la elaboración del Plan de Ejecución del Proyecto, en las fases de ingeniería y ejecución, contribuyendo a que el plan se ajuste a la estrategia y alcance definidos y adquiriendo progresivamente conocimientos sobre la coordinación de las áreas involucradas en su elaboración.


• Participar en el proceso de gestión de riesgos de las distintas fases del proyecto, colaborando en la identificación, evaluación y seguimiento de riesgos y acciones preventivas necesarias para el cumplimiento de los objetivos del proyecto.


• Participar del proceso de estimación económica poniendo a disposición la información requerida para la elaboración de los estimados de costo y plazo, colaborando en el análisis de su consistencia con el alcance y estrategia seleccionada y en el seguimiento de su evolución entre las distintas fases del proyecto.


• Participar y brindar soporte en el proceso de elaboración de pliegos, tanto en la definición del alcance de la contratación como en sus lineamientos contractuales y comerciales; y participar en el proceso de revisión de ofertas y propuestas de adjudicación de contratos y provisiones, realizando la elaboración de los informes correspondientes.


• Participar en grupos de trabajo que abarquen las distintas especialidades del proyecto, generando las reuniones necesarias entre las distintas áreas intervinientes, colaborando en el seguimiento de definiciones, compromisos e interfaces, a fin de contribuir a la alineación de los equipos para el logro del objetivo común.


• Controlar la revisión de la información contenida en los planos de ingeniería, listados de materiales y especificaciones técnicas que aplican a los mismos, con la finalidad de contribuir al desarrollo de una Ingeniería apta para construcción.




¿Qué valoramos como diferencial?



• Formación académica: Ingeniero graduado (excluyente), preferentemente de especialidades vinculadas con proyectos industriales. Se valorará formación o conocimientos iniciales en Gestión de Proyectos.


• Experiencia laboral: hasta 2/3 años de experiencia profesional. Se valorará experiencia inicial, pasantías o prácticas profesionales vinculadas con ingeniería, proyectos, planificación, costos, compras, contratos, construcción u obras industriales.





• Buscamos a una persona con un perfil analítico, proactivo, orientado a resultados, con buenas relaciones interpersonales y ganas de sumarse a un equipo con espíritu colaborativo, interés por aprender y desarrollarse en gestión integral de proyectos y disposición para ampliar progresivamente sus conocimientos hacia distintas disciplinas y negocios.





• Idioma: inglés avanzado, con capacidad para interpretar documentación técnica (valorable).






Información del puesto



• Lugar de trabajo: Microcentro (Bs As)


• Modalidad: 4x1


• Equipo a cargo: No


• Disponibilidad para viajar: si ocasionalmente.

Apply now and let’s shape the future of technology together! 🧑‍💻

postings.title: Editing AI Content Producer
postings.descriptionText:
Who We Are:

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

***This is an independent contractor position (Per-Project Basis).

Disclaimer: We're currently on the lookout for potential candidates to join our talent pool via this job listing. Your qualifications will be assessed for both present positions and future opportunities. Should your skills align with a role and an opening arise, our recruitment team will reach out to you promptly. However, please keep in mind that this doesn't guarantee immediate placement or communication.

A day in the life:

• Power Digital is looking for a Content Producer to assist in the daily execution of our cross-functional video content needs—including AI-assisted image and video generation—in support of our brand vision and business goals through performance marketing. You will be working in a fast-paced, creative environment that offers an opportunity to be part of building a rapidly growing agency.

Responsibilities:

• Work closely with a team of editors, designers, and ACDs in the execution of all video editing deliverables for your pod and owned accounts

• Collaborate with our Creative & Marketing teams to craft creative & engaging designs/content across various marketing channels

• Create engaging, performance-driven video content to support our creative & marketing efforts

• Collaborate with our Production & Strategy teams to craft both original and iterative ads for various marketing channels, including Instagram, Meta, TikTok, and YouTube

• Leverage AI tools to generate marketing-ready image and video concepts and assets (e.g., concept exploration, storyboards, style frames, cutdowns/variations), translating ideas into on-brand creative that performs

• Use AI to accelerate creative iteration at scale by producing multiple versions for testing (hooks, thumbnails, captions, formats, aspect ratios) while maintaining quality and brand consistency

• Continuously optimize output by applying learnings from performance metrics, external references, and popular trends across social platforms

• Follow department workflows and best practices for project management, project file organization, file naming, etc.

• Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes

• Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department

Role Requirements:

• 4+ years of video editing experience (motion graphics a plus)

• Proficient in professional video editing and post-production tools (Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, etc.)

• AI-proficient with image and video generation tools and workflows used to create marketing-ready assets and iterations (e.g., Veo, Nano Banana, Higgsfield, Midjourney, Flora, Weavy, Adobe GenAI, and similar platforms)

• Demonstrable video editing ability with a strong portfolio of work examples (including performance-driven creative where possible)

• Deep understanding of digital trends, platform-native best practices, and editing principles (hook-first storytelling, pacing, sound design, typography, etc.)

• Ability to multitask and work toward several milestones on various projects simultaneously

• Creative and innovative thinker with a test-and-learn mindset

• Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills

• Strong prompt and concept development skills, with the ability to translate a brief into AI-assisted storyboards/style frames and scalable creative variations

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• 100% ownership of post production execution work for assigned account stack

• Brand/QA Pass Rate: 95%+ of deliverables pass internal QA and client brand standards on first submission (or within one revision cycle)

• AI-Assisted Iteration Velocity: Consistently produces multiple high-quality creative variations for testing when requested (e.g., hooks, thumbnails, cutdowns, style frames) while maintaining brand consistency

• Zero (0) Avoidable Errors

• Zero (0) Late Submission

Most Important Things (MITs)

• Output quality meets both internal and client brand standards

• Ability to incorporate AI-generated imagery/video into the creative workflow with strong QA (brand alignment, consistency, compliance/usage rights, and technical specs)

• Understanding of best practices for performance-driven creativity & ability to apply these insights in your work

• Ability to actively communicate and collaborate with Strategists & Production teams across multiple projects to deliver the best possible creative output.

Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees' points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

Please be aware of fictitious job openings, consulting engagements, solicitations, or employment offers from suspicious sources. These engagements may be an attempt to obtain private information, or to induce you to pay a fee for services related to recruitment or training. Power Digital does NOT charge any application, processing, or training fee at any stage of the recruitment or hiring process. All genuine job openings will be posted on our careers page at https://powerdigitalmarketing.com/company/careers/ . If you have any doubts about the authenticity of any messaging behalf of Power Digital, please send us an email at recruiting@powerdigital.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

postings.title: Growth & Commercial Strategy Senior Consultant
postings.descriptionText:
At AlixPartners, we solve the most complex and critical challenges by moving quickly from analysis to action when it really matters; creating value that has a lasting impact on companies, their people, and the communities they serve. By understanding, respecting, and honoring the needs of our employees, clients, and communities, AlixPartners actively promotes an inclusive environment. We strongly believe in the value that diversity brings to our experiences and are committed to the perpetual enhancements of initiatives, policies, and practices. We hold ourselves accountable by providing the space for authenticity, growth, and equity for everyone.

AlixPartners has embraced a hybrid work model to provide flexibility and support our employees’ work-life integration. Our hybrid model combines a mix of in-person (at client site or AlixPartners office) and remote working. Travel is part of this position, but the frequency may vary based on client, team, and individual circumstances.

What you'll do

Are you passionate about a future that exceeds your expectations? Here, at AlixPartners your passion becomes your career. We work in smaller and more senior teams that bring deep industry and functional knowledge to our clients. You will sit shoulder-to-shoulder with clients to address the issues that sit at the top of their agendas - and often become front-page news. 

AlixPartners is expanding its Growth team, within the Performance practice, in Buenos Aires. In this role, you will be delivering growth strategies and commercial excellence outcomes for external clients, working closely with colleagues across geographies.

You will be a part of workstreams that drive top-line growth and EBITDA improvement for clients in industrial, distribution, services, and consumer-facing sectors, across healthy, underperforming, and distressed situations. Typical work includes:

• Price diagnostics, including waterfall and leakage analysis, discount and rebate effectiveness, and price dispersion

• Price strategy and governance, including price architecture, deal approval processes, and price increase programs

• Value-based pricing, elasticity analysis, and customer and product profitability (cost-to-serve)

• Customer segmentation, coverage and channel strategy, and route-to-market redesign

• Distributor and partner management

• Growth opportunity sizing and commercial business cases for clients and PE sponsors

• Sales productivity diagnostics, including territory and account design, sales capacity, and pipeline management and KPIs

• Incentive compensation, sales process, and CRM-enabled sales operations

The Role We Need

PadSplit is looking for a Member Sales Manager to build and lead the sales engine that turns prospective renters into PadSplit members. As we grow, we need someone who can increase bookings, improve conversion, and manage the cost of acquiring each member while ensuring our member growth keeps pace with our host growth. This person will own the process, performance, and people responsible for delivering those results.

The Person We Are Looking For

We're looking for a proven sales leader who knows how to build, manage, and scale a high-volume inside sales team. You're equally comfortable developing a repeatable sales process, managing performance through data, and rolling up your sleeves to coach agents and work alongside the team. You're an owner who sets clear expectations, holds people accountable, and isn't afraid to make changes when the results aren't there.

Here's What You'll Be Doing Day-to-Day

• Sales Playbook: Build and continuously improve the member acquisition process, including call scripts, objection handling, follow-up cadences, and lead routing from first contact through move-in.

• Speed to Lead: Establish response-time expectations and lead coverage strategies that ensure prospective members receive timely outreach across the hours and time zones we serve.

• Team Performance: Establish daily and weekly activity and booking targets, maintain a transparent performance scoreboard, and hold agents accountable for delivering results.

• Sales Coaching: Review call recordings, provide actionable feedback, coach agents on specific behaviors, and step in to demonstrate effective selling when needed.

• Conversion Optimization: Analyze lead quality, connection rates, conversion rates, and cost per booking to identify opportunities and continuously improve sales performance.

• Data & Reporting: Establish reliable reporting and attribution across lead sources, agent performance, and bookings while identifying opportunities to automate manual processes.

• Team Development: Hire, train, develop, and manage a high-performing sales team, making timely performance decisions and determining when additional headcount is justified.

• Cross-Functional Partnership: Work closely with Sales Leadership, Sales Ops, Product, Marketing, Member Experience

Here's What You'll Need to Be Successful

• Sales Leadership: 5+ years of experience in inside sales, high-volume outbound sales, or contact center leadership, including at least 2 years managing a team of 15 or more.

• Proven Results: A demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets through team performance, with measurable results you can speak to.

• Process Building: Experience building or rebuilding sales cadences, lead routing models, service-level agreements (SLAs), and incentive structures.

• Remote Leadership: Experience managing, developing, and holding distributed, remote, or offshore sales teams accountable.

• Funnel Analytics: Strong understanding of sales funnel metrics, including time to contact, connection rates, conversion rates, and cost per booking, with the ability to translate data into action.

• Coaching Expertise: Experience coaching sales representatives using call recordings, performance data, and specific behavioral feedback.

• Sales Technology: Comfort working with CRMs and sales or support platforms such as HubSpot, Zendesk, or Intercom, building reports, and leveraging tools such as power dialers and sales engagement platforms.

• Ownership & Adaptability: A hands-on, data-driven leadership style, strong communication skills, and the ability to operate in an evolving environment, make decisions quickly, and adjust strategies based on results.

Interview Process:

• Your application will be reviewed for possible next steps by the Hiring Manager.

• If warranted, the next step would be a video interview with our Revenue Ops Lead for 45 minutes.

• If warranted, the next step would be a video interview with our Head of Sales for one (1) hour.

• If warranted, the final step would be a video panel interview with key stakeholders at PadSplit for two (2) hours.

• The panel interview will require a candidate to work on a sales assessment where you will showcase your manager skills to the panel for discussion.

• If warranted, then we move to offer!

Compensation

Compensation is based on the role's scope, market benchmarks, the person's expertise and experience, and the impact of their contributions to our business goals.
