postings.title: Staff Software Engineer, Product/AI
postings.descriptionText:
Hi, I'm Paul, VP of Engineering at Customer.io . We're looking for a staff product engineer — not a generalist who happens to touch frontend and backend, but someone who thinks like a product owner and ships like an engineer.

About Customer.io

Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive.

We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data. Under the hood: Go, React, and AI help us ship fast and scale with confidence.

What We Value

End-to-end ownership

You take on the problems nobody's claimed — the ones that span squads with no obvious owner — and carry them from a fuzzy first conversation to what's actually live. If it touches the customer, it's yours to chase down.

Comfort in ambiguity

Half-formed problems and conflicting signals are your starting material, not a blocker. You define the problem before you solve it, form a point of view on what's worth building, and move without waiting for someone else to de-risk the call.

Customer-first, always

You think from the customer's problem backward, not the codebase forward. Every technical call traces back to what it does for the person on the other end of the message — and you can explain that connection to people who don't write code. Given the choice, you ship the thing that changes their experience, not the thing that's merely elegant.

A healthy skepticism for "the way things are done"

You retire practices that have outlived their usefulness, including ones you helped build. Best practices matter — but never more than forward motion.

Force multiplication

Shipping your part isn't the bar. You bring in the right people before a problem becomes theirs to clean up, and you leave enough behind — docs, patterns, delegation — that the team keeps moving without you in the room.

What You'll Do

• Own important, ambiguous problems from initial framing through launch and iteration. Set direction, align partners, and stay accountable for the result.

• Partner with product, design, and data to shape priorities, scope the work, and define how success will be measured.

• Lead technical decisions across the stack, including architecture, performance, reliability, and maintainability.

• Lead work across teams and systems. Build alignment, resolve technical disagreements, and keep complex initiatives moving.

• Improve engineering practices through mentorship, reusable patterns, and clear technical guidance.

• Use AI throughout your engineering work, with sound judgment about where it helps, where it falls short, and how its output should be reviewed. Help the team improve by testing new workflows, sharing what works, and identifying useful opportunities for automation.

• Participate in an on-call rotation as required, supporting the systems the team builds.

What we're looking for

• A track record of leading complex work across teams or systems and delivering meaningful customer, business, or engineering outcomes.

• Strong backend engineering experience, with the ability to work across the stack and lead end-to-end technical decisions.

• Strong product and technical judgment, especially when the problem or path forward is unclear.

• The ability to influence experienced peers and align teams without formal authority.

• Experience using metrics, experimentation, and observability to guide decisions and improve production systems.

• Regular, hands-on use of AI across the software development lifecycle, with the judgment to adapt as tools change while remaining accountable for quality, security, and outcomes. Experience improving how a broader team uses AI is a strong plus.

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in transparency. Starting salary for this role is $200,000 - $280,000 USD (or equivalent in local currency) depending on experience and subject to market rate adjustment. This role also carries a 10% annual bonus target. In addition to base salary, this role includes an equity grant in the form of stock options, so you share in the success you help build.

We know our people are what make us great, and we're committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family. We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO, stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more.

See full benefits here →

Our Process

No gotchas, no trick questions - just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision.

• Application - We review everyone with care. Tell us why you're interested.

• Recruiter Call (30 mins) - Let's chat about what you're looking for and how we work.

• Hiring Manager Interview (60 mins) - Talk with one of our hiring managers about your working style and a product you've owned end-to-end, plus a short AI-assisted coding exercise.

• System Design Interview (60 mins) - A collaborative conversation that moves between product tradeoffs and system design — how you'd scope something ambiguous and how you'd build it.

• Take-Home Assignment - Complete a short, realistic task similar to what you'd work on here.

• Assignment Review Call (60 mins) - Walk us through your work and discuss tradeoffs, priorities, and how you'd iterate.

All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process.

Customer.io recognizes the stifling impact of systemic injustice on diverse communities. We commit to using our influence to increase inclusion and equity within the tech industry. We strive to build an inclusive team culture, implement bias-free hiring practices, and develop community partnerships to expand our global impact.

Zoom is the only video conference platform that we use, virtual interviews will be conducted using the video capability (i.e., not via the chat), and offers will be extended in writing on official Customer.io letterhead. Please be vigilant in all of your job search activity, and if you have any questions please contact jobs@customer.io .

Join us!

We believe in empathy, transparency, responsibility, and, yes, a little awkwardness. If you're excited by what you read and want to build software that makes communication better for everyone—apply now.

You'll be working closely with our clients and ensuring they get the most impact out of their solutions with us. These solutions include Mirantis Container Cloud, Mirantis Kubernetes Engine, Mirantis Secure Registry, and Mirantis Container Runtime.

You’ll be the client’s key contact, handling important conversations, keeping billing, admin, and contracts on track, and stepping in with a calm head if the unexpected happens. A big part of your role is communicating and keeping people aligned both internally and externally. Running client meetings and syncs, showing clients how their setup is performing with real numbers, and flagging potential concerns based on what the data is telling you. Internally you’ll act as the central link between our tech, product, and finance teams to make sure client onboardings, handoffs, and everyday requests are dealt with effectively.

Mirantis ’ Customer Success team’s goal is to delight millions of developers and system administrators who rely on the Mirantis Container platform to build, share, and run their distributed applications all over the world. Our customer base spans from individuals to SMBs to large global enterprises. As Mirantis continues to grow and serve more and more enterprise clients globally, our team is setting our sights on finding creative ways to scale efficiency while simultaneously increasing customer satisfaction.

Working Location:
This is a fully remote position, however we do require you to be based in an Americas Time Zone

(UTC - 4 to UTC - 7)

What you'll do:

•

Own the client relationship

Be the primary point of contact for your clients day to day. Act as the direct liaison for client escalations and negotiate client communication with tact and diplomacy. Serve as the driver of internal alignment and communication on client topics and updates, and ensure client invoicing and administration is up to date and accurate.

•

Drive client health and awareness

Monitor Key Performance indicators, and run client "kick off" meetings, regular (monthly) update calls, and Quarterly Business Reviews. Ensure the clients are well looked after, engaged, and fully in the loop on the health of their infrastructure and hosting with data backed metrics. Use this data to keep clients up to date with concerns or future challenges - focusing on business impact and solutions.

•
Collaborate and Coordinate

Project lead client on and offboardings and ensure internal alignment across the onboarding teams. Ensure client feedback reaches product managers, and coordinate across Support, Engineering, Finance, Sales, and Product to ensure client requests, deliverables, and commitments move forward without getting stuck.

•

Further embed our offering

Work with your clients to understand their concerns, wishes for new offerings or services, and future events or hosting changes to prepare for. Identify growth opportunities within your existing clients to further embed the Mirantis offering

•

Travel as required

Undertake occasional domestic and international travel to meet with clients, strengthen customer relationships, and collaborate with internal teams as required.

What you'll bring:

• Experience as a Project Manager or Account Manager managing enterprise clients within a cloud hosting environment.

• A general understanding of cloud hosting concepts and infrastructure, and experience working closely with technical teams.

• An empathetic and collaborative nature, which allows you to bring stakeholders together under common goals.

• An ability to create your own structure - building meetings agendas, briefing cross-functional teams before meetings, tracking deliverable deadlines across Jira/ticketing tools, and methodically tracking and addressing items.

• You communicate in an effective and clear manner, can engage technical and non technical stakeholders equally as well, and enjoy working directly with other humans and solving challenges together.

• Comfort and professional fluency in the English language.

Mirantis is dedicated to providing a work environment of trust, transparency, and inclusion for everyone. We are heavily committed as an Equal Opportunity Employer, striving to maintain a work environment where we can all feel comfortable, valued, and free to achieve our best.
As a remote first company we offer flexibility when it comes to working hours and location, helping you to manage personal circumstances and work/life harmony. Here's more details on what to expect.

What we’ll bring:

• The autonomy to manage your time and space through flexible working hours and fully remote working

• Frequent exposure to novel challenges and technologies, directly impacting the narrative and direction of open-source and AI innovation

• A collaborative and open team and environment to work within, support, and learn from

• Support for your development and growth, through growth plans, training, conferences, working groups, hackathons, and more.

• A competitive compensation package, alongside a benefits plan that supports peace of mind and security (401(k), Healthcare, Dental, Vision, disability benefits etc.)

What’s next?:
Apply! Send us your CV and cover letter showcasing who you are, your skills and experience, and anything else you think we should know. Our team will reach out to you to let you know it’s been received, and we’ll review your application.

• Work for an established leader in the Cloud Native industry with over 800 enterprise customers, HQ’d in Silicon Valley.

• Work with exceptionally passionate, talented, and engaging colleagues, helping Fortune and Global 2000 customers implement modern open-source cloud technologies.

• Be a part of cutting-edge, open-source innovation.

• Thrive in the high-energy environment of a young company where openness, collaboration, risk-taking, and continuous growth are valued.

• Flexible working schedule and remote / or hybrid work environment.

• Receive a competitive compensation package.

Mirantis ranked in the top 50 of G2's Best IT Cloud Products of 2021!
We are a Leader for Container Management in G2 (#2 after AWS)!

postings.title: Bookkeeper & AR Specialist | Marketing Agency | Remote (LATAM) 📊
postings.descriptionText:
Company Overview
Our client is a newsletter growth agency. It runs paid Meta ads for newsletter and media brands, large personal brands and founders, and turns readers into revenue. Fees partly move with ad spend and contract terms. The founder launched it in early 2024, and it has grown from 0 to 30+ people in two years. The founder writes tactical posts and hosts a podcast. The team works remotely, and you'd talk with the founder and your manager on calls and in the finance channel on Slack.

Your Role
You're the person who gets the company paid. You own client invoicing, collections and the books in QuickBooks Online, working fully remote on US Eastern hours as a full-time contractor, reporting to the Operations Manager. The company went from 0 to 30+ people in two years, few finance steps are written down, and no senior finance person checks the work every day. So you run the whole loop and write the procedures as they settle. You start with the daily Mercury and Stripe check and the 4-week invoice cycle. The hardest balance is speed against accuracy: invoices go out on time, and the variable fees in them are calculated and checked before a client sees them. Get that right and cash arrives on schedule, the books close clean for the accountant or CPA, and the founder can trust the numbers.

What You'll Own

• Run Stripe invoicing every 4 weeks, in advance, so each client gets a correct bill on time.

• Work out variable fees from the contract and the ad spend report so every amount is right before it goes out.

• Chase late payments every 3 working days and escalate quiet clients so cash comes in sooner.

• Apply each incoming payment to the right invoice and keep the AR aging report current so the team sees who owes what.

• Keep the QuickBooks Online books, reconcile bank, credit card, AR and AP, and run the monthly close so the outside accountant or CPA reviews clean numbers.

• Set up new clients in Stripe, prepare final bills for leavers and support DocuSign contract admin so billing starts and ends cleanly.

• Write down finance steps and maintain the trackers so the team can rely on them and the next hire can follow them.

A Week in the Role

• You open Mercury and Stripe early and spot a failed charge and a renewal coming up. You post both in the start of day update on Slack, so the team knows what needs chasing.

• A client is 3 working days past your last reminder. You send the next one from the shared AR mailbox, in the same thread, and add a dated note to the billing sheet. If the client goes quiet, you escalate.

• A client on a variable fee comes due. You read the contract, pull the ad spend report, work out the fee and check it before sending. The invoice goes out right the first time.

• A payment arrives that doesn't match its invoice. You trace it through the invoice, the payment and the bank line, then post what you found in the finance channel.

• A new client signs. You create the payment link and subscription in Stripe and write down their billing terms, so the first invoice and every one after it use the same facts.

• At month end you reconcile the bank and credit card accounts, close the books and hand them to the accountant or CPA. You write down any step you had to figure out along the way.

You Bring

• A bachelor's degree in accounting or a related field, and three or 3 years in bookkeeping, billing or accounts receivable, including billing or collecting for dozens of active clients.

• Experience running the full billing-to-cash cycle for recurring clients: sending invoices, tracking them on an AR aging report, chasing late payers, applying payments and reconciling.

• Invoices you calculated from ad spend, usage or contract terms.

• Working knowledge of QuickBooks Online (bank and credit card reconciliation, chart of accounts, AR and AP) and Excel, including a billing tracker you built or maintained.

• A billing sheet, tracker or aging report that other people used, kept current with a date and the action taken on each entry.

• Collections on a schedule with a set point for escalating, and a mismatch between an invoice, a payment and a bank line that you traced to its source.

• Clear written and spoken English for client emails, daily updates and calls with the founder and your manager.

Bonus Points

• Stripe for subscriptions, payment links and failed charges.

•
Mercury or another online business bank.

• Invoicing in USD or work with US clients.

•
Multi-currency bank reconciliation.

What's Offered

• What we'd estimate for a role like this: 1,000 to 1,500 USD a month, based on experience.

• Fully remote from Latin America, on US Eastern hours.

•
Paid time off

Interview Process
1. First call: 30 minutes with us at atomic HR on what you have built, working terms and what you want next.
2. First interview: a conversation with the Operations Manager, who would be your manager, on how you have run invoicing, collections and month-end, and how the day-to-day of the seat would go.
3. Short practical test: a task drawn from the seat's own work, done on your own time. It checks that the amounts come out right and that you show how you got to them. We confirm the format and rough time before you start.
4. Call with the founder: a conversation on how you would work together on cash collection and the numbers, and on any questions you have about the company.

postings.title: Software Product Manager
postings.descriptionText:
Job Overview:
Work from home! We will teach you everything you need to know in this role.
Are you looking for a high tech challenge but also to have some fun and work with cool, genuine and super smart people? Headquartered in beautiful Bend, Oregon, RecruitingDash () is the largest provider of services and proprietary software for Oracle Taleo Business Edition (TBE) - a recruiting system that thousands of companies worldwide use.
In addition to our very successful market leading Taleo Consulting practice, RecruitingDash sells our proprietary Taleo metrics, reporting and analytics dashboard software as a service (SaaS) technology, and our Taleo Inbox product, to customers worldwide.
We are launching our third software product in 2023 which will also take our product and services to new platforms beyond the Taleo recruiting system market - it's an exciting time for us!

This is where you come in:
We are looking for a smart, hard-working, well-spoken individual with great presentation skills that we can train in every aspect of product management. We have had a great track record of success teaching smart and hard working people to be successful at our company. A recent college graduate seeking to learn all aspects of software product management may be an ideal fit.
As the RecruitingDash Product Manager, you will work closely with our CTO, founder, and head of software development to manage RecruitingDash 's existing software products (ReportingDash and Taleo Inbox) as well as participate in every aspect of the design, development, testing and go to market of new software products which are currently in the earliest stages of product development.
Almost all of the skills for this position you will learn on the job by working closely with the founders of RecruitingDash . The incumbent who served in this role for over 9 years was able to learn the necessary skills to be successful through time in this position, and was instrumental in launching our two existing, very successful, SaaS software products. Therefore, we know that this role is a perfect fit for someone who wants to learn new skills, understand on a deep level how software works and is designed, developed, tested and brought to market, and someone who thrives on solving tough problems, being intellectually challenged and working hard.
Oversee and Manage NEW Software Product Development in Collaboration with the RecruitingDash Chief Technology Officer
The RecruitingDash Product Manager is responsible for the success of our software products - this is both a strategic and tactical role. If you have an interest in learning every aspect of software product management, from defining specifications to development through testing and launch, this is the role for you.

• Drive the product and business-planning process through the software product development lifecycle

• Use an iterative process and customer discovery best practices to analyze customer needs and translate them into prioritized product features and benefits

• Assess current competitor offerings, seeking opportunities for differentiation

• Develop, implement, and maintain production, testing, and go-to-market timelines across multiple disciplines such as software development, customer discovery, beta testing, product testing, marketing, product release/go-to-market activities and customer support

• Develop the new customer onboarding and implementation protocols, process, tools and procedures

• Develop product positioning and messaging to be used comprehensively for the new product, such as on mico-websites, in sales and marketing collateral, and other marketing channels.

• Execute post launch marketing activities to support sales efforts

• Manage bug escalations, customer feedback, and feature requests as required

• Partner with the RecruitingDash sale team to support their efforts in selling the product(s)

• Develop and drive the documentation process for any new product(s)

• Design, develop and implement customer support operations as the customer base for the new product(s) grows

Oversee and Manage the Portfolio of EXISTING RecruitingDash Software Products

• Become an expert in both ReportingDash and Taleo Inbox products so that you:

• Have a broad overview of how each of the products work technically

• May effectively onboard and implement the SaaS products for new customers and provide basic sales support to the RecruitingDash sales executives who continue to sell the products

• Assist with overseeing comprehensive customer support for the existing portfolio of SaaS software products

• Provide day to day product management for exception handling and escalations, with our CTO and Co-founder as the escalation point

•
RecruitingDash continues to do development for these products so there is a small amount of time focused on the following:

• Managing, exploring and validating existing customer feature requests

• Writing up JIRA issues, which is our bug and issues management system, for bug fixes and new releases/feature ideas

• Doing regression testing for new releases / features

• Provide "State of the Union" overviews of each of the existing products, periodically and as needed to the RecruitingDash founders

What We're Looking For...

• Smart people, who have a penchant for learning something every day.

• Problem solver.

• A self-motivated results-driven go-getter that works hard.

• Demonstrated success at a top college with an undergraduate degree.

• Highly effective communication skills are required to interface with high-level client executives and the RecruitingDash founders.

• Excellent presentation skills.

• Highly organized with strong project management skills.

• Previous knowledge of recruitment & HR or software development is a bonus, but not required.

• Flexibility - we go the extra mile for our customers, who are located all over the world (at times this may not be a 9 to 5 job).

What Will Grab Our Attention...

• College degree from a top tier school is strongly preferred.

• Initiative - we will give you as much responsibility as you can handle.

• Problem solving & practical thinking - every customer and technology system is unique, and we often have to get creative to craft the right solution to a particular problem.

• Attention to detail.

• Strong writing and grammar skills.

• Strong project management skills.

• Self-direction - we all work hard to get stuff done and be efficient without micro-management.

• Planning & organizing skills galore.

• Personal learning - "Never make the same mistake twice..."

• Customer focus - you gain personal satisfaction from turning customers into raving fans.

• Great judgment & common sense - you make the right call at the right time.

• Calm under pressure - we are growing fast - at times it can be crazy.

• Drive for results - you love to deliver, on time, even when it's tough.

Working at RecruitingDash ...
RecruitingDash is one of the most innovative recruiting technology companies in the industry. Get ready to learn, build, teach and grow fromanywhere in the worldwith the Dashers where our teamwork creates value beyond the sum of our parts.

•
RecruitingDash is a completely remote company – work out of your home, a hotel, or a beach, anywhere you have internet and a phone!

• We seek to continually simply and improve processes, procedures and activities.

• We always deliver the best solution.

• We treat everyone with respect and dignityat all times.

• We always do the right thing.

postings.title: Member Sales Manager
postings.descriptionText:
The Role We Need

PadSplit is looking for a Member Sales Manager to build and lead the sales engine that turns prospective renters into PadSplit members. As we grow, we need someone who can increase bookings, improve conversion, and manage the cost of acquiring each member while ensuring our member growth keeps pace with our host growth. This person will own the process, performance, and people responsible for delivering those results.

The Person We Are Looking For

We're looking for a proven sales leader who knows how to build, manage, and scale a high-volume inside sales team. You're equally comfortable developing a repeatable sales process, managing performance through data, and rolling up your sleeves to coach agents and work alongside the team. You're an owner who sets clear expectations, holds people accountable, and isn't afraid to make changes when the results aren't there.

Here's What You'll Be Doing Day-to-Day

•
Sales Playbook: Build and continuously improve the member acquisition process, including call scripts, objection handling, follow-up cadences, and lead routing from first contact through move-in.

•
Speed to Lead: Establish response-time expectations and lead coverage strategies that ensure prospective members receive timely outreach across the hours and time zones we serve.

•
Team Performance: Establish daily and weekly activity and booking targets, maintain a transparent performance scoreboard, and hold agents accountable for delivering results.

•
Sales Coaching: Review call recordings, provide actionable feedback, coach agents on specific behaviors, and step in to demonstrate effective selling when needed.

•
Conversion Optimization: Analyze lead quality, connection rates, conversion rates, and cost per booking to identify opportunities and continuously improve sales performance.

•
Data & Reporting: Establish reliable reporting and attribution across lead sources, agent performance, and bookings while identifying opportunities to automate manual processes.

•
Team Development: Hire, train, develop, and manage a high-performing sales team, making timely performance decisions and determining when additional headcount is justified.

•
Cross-Functional Partnership: Work closely with Sales Leadership, Sales Ops, Product, Marketing, Member Experience

Here's What You'll Need to Be Successful

•
Sales Leadership: 5+ years of experience in inside sales, high-volume outbound sales, or contact center leadership, including at least 2 years managing a team of 15 or more.

•
Proven Results: A demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets through team performance, with measurable results you can speak to.

•
Process Building: Experience building or rebuilding sales cadences, lead routing models, service-level agreements (SLAs), and incentive structures.

•
Remote Leadership: Experience managing, developing, and holding distributed, remote, or offshore sales teams accountable.

•
Funnel Analytics: Strong understanding of sales funnel metrics, including time to contact, connection rates, conversion rates, and cost per booking, with the ability to translate data into action.

•
Coaching Expertise: Experience coaching sales representatives using call recordings, performance data, and specific behavioral feedback.

•
Sales Technology: Comfort working with CRMs and sales or support platforms such as HubSpot, Zendesk, or Intercom, building reports, and leveraging tools such as power dialers and sales engagement platforms.

•
Ownership & Adaptability: A hands-on, data-driven leadership style, strong communication skills, and the ability to operate in an evolving environment, make decisions quickly, and adjust strategies based on results.

Interview Process:

• Your application will be reviewed for possible next steps by the Hiring Manager.

• If you meet eligibility requirements, the next step would be a phone screen with a member of the PeopleOps team for about thirty (30) minutes.

• If warranted, the next step would be a video interview with our Revenue Ops Lead for 45 minutes.

• If warranted, the next step would be a video interview with our Head of Sales for one (1) hour.

• If warranted, the final step would be a video panel interview with key stakeholders at PadSplit for two (2) hours.

• The panel interview will require a candidate to work on a sales assessment where you will showcase your manager skills to the panel for discussion.

• If warranted, then we move to offer!

postings.title: Senior AI Engineer, Marketing
postings.descriptionText:
OPSWAT , a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.

The Position
We are looking for an innovative engineer for the GTM Product Team to strengthen the technology beneath OPSWAT 's marketing operations. Marketing runs on HubSpot today, and it works hard for us: 1.1 million contacts, 817 active workflows, and the integrations that connect it to SugarCRM, Salesloft, My OPSWAT , websites and our data master. Your first job is to make that foundation more reliable — keeping the integrations healthy, resolving the sync and data-quality issues that slow the team down, and giving Marketing Operations a technical partner who understands their platform from the inside.
From there, you will help us build the next generation of that capability in house. The four functions HubSpot performs for us are the roadmap: marketing automation and email; lead capture from web, portal, events and webinars; lead management, meaning scoring, lifecycle and routing; contact data governance and consent and tight integration with our OPSWAT Data Master (ODM). Along the way you will bring AI into the product to enable smarter lead qualification, routing and scoring and more automated campaign managements.

What You Will Be Doing

Build the Platform

• Build one governed front door for every lead, whatever the source — web forms, My OPSWAT , webinars, field events, partner and list imports — so each lead is validated, de-duplicated, consented and enriched once, at the gate, and nothing reaches the CRM or the data spine any other way.

• Build AI-native lead qualification: a model that reads fit and engagement across every signal we hold — product usage in My OPSWAT , Academy progress, web behavior, intent, firmographics — ranks the whole database with real resolution, explains every score in plain language, and learns from what SDRs actually convert.

• Build intelligent lead routing: the right lead to the right rep at the right moment, with territory, capacity, availability and priority held as data that Marketing Operations can shape and preview themselves, and a decision record behind every assignment so anyone can see why a lead went where it did.

• Make every hand-off dependable: each lead tracked from capture to first touch, stalls surfaced automatically, every priority tier followed up, and nothing lost between systems.

• Give Marketing Operations a self-service campaign layer: per-campaign behavior — routing, priority, nurture — configured in minutes with a preview of what it would have done to yesterday's leads, so new campaigns stop requiring new workflows and old overrides expire on their own.

• Build the platform AI-native from day one: expose its data and actions through an MCP server so OPSWAT 's internal agents and assistants can look up a lead, explain a routing decision, or trigger a campaign action in natural language — and design every capability so an agent can use it as readily as a person can.

• Make consent and suppression a single source of truth, enforced at the gate and impossible to bypass, and stream every signal and every decision into OPSWAT Data Master so marketing, product and sales data finally join in one place.

• Build the seams to SugarCRM, the email service provider, visitor identification, enrichment and My OPSWAT so that a failure in any one of them is contained, retried and visible — never silent, never lossy.

• Leveraging OPSWAT Agentic SDLC — use the Platform team's agentic coding platform as your primary means of production, own the quality and security of what ships, and document the system as you go so it stays knowable.

Keep HubSpot Running Through the Transition

• Own the health of HubSpot's existing integrations until each one is retired: the SugarCRM sync through the Sugar Data Tool, Salesloft, the My OPSWAT feed (portal and Academy), 6sense enrichment, web forms and the Forms API.

• Triage and resolve integration incidents across HubSpot and its neighbors — root-cause them, fix them permanently, and write down what happened.

• Make safe, minimal changes in HubSpot when the business needs them, and hold the line against new workflow and list sediment that the migration would only have to unwind.

• Build the Forms Gateway pull-forward so website capture decouples from HubSpot early, and run the interim enrollment connector that keeps Salesloft working through cutover.

• Reconcile HubSpot and platform data continuously during the parallel run so drift is caught long before a cutover gate.

What We Need From You

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.

• 6+ years building and operating production backend systems, with at least 3 in Python

• Demonstrated, recent, daily practice building software with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot agent mode, Codex or similar). You can show us the workflow, the review and test loop, and something real that shipped through it.

• Production support of a marketing automation platform's integrations — HubSpot strongly preferred; Marketo or Pardot considered — including its APIs, its data model, and its sync to a CRM. You have kept one of these healthy while other things changed around it.

• Production experience with event-driven and durable-execution patterns: message queues, outboxes, idempotency keys, replay. Temporal or a comparable workflow engine strongly preferred.

• Hands-on integration engineering against real vendor APIs — REST, webhooks, OAuth 2.0, rate limits, retries — built and operated, not configured through a wizard.

• PostgreSQL to a strong level: schema design, JSONB, partitioning, migrations with Alembic, and query performance work you can describe.

• Cloud deployment on Azure or AWS: containers, infrastructure as code (Terraform or Bicep), CI/CD with GitHub Actions, secrets management, observability.

• Experience shipping LLM features into a product: structured outputs, evaluation discipline, confidence thresholds, fallbacks and guardrails — consuming a provided model gateway rather than building the infrastructure.

• Excellent written and spoken English, and the skill to explain a technical trade-off to a marketing operations lead in their terms.

It Would Be Nice If You Had

• SugarCRM logic hooks and REST API, or another CRM's server-side extension model; Salesforce Apex or triggers transferable.

• Marketing technology domain knowledge: lead scoring and routing, consent and suppression, deliverability and ESP warm-up, campaign attribution.

By giving people greater choice over how and when they pay, and helping eligible on-time payments build a positive credit history, Flex puts households back in control of their cash flow.

You will own multiple workstreams that tie directly to critical business KPIs. You will serve as a key technical partner to Product, business leadership, and cross-functional teams (such as Lifecycle Marketing (LCM), Legal & Compliance, and Risk) to drive outcomes across your workstreams. You will also represent Consumer engineering and New Verticals in Flex -wide architecture and quality initiatives, ensuring we build solutions that scale across Flex as a whole.

Our Engineering Teams

• Consumer Engineering: Builds the APIs and backend systems powering Flex ’s consumer-facing mobile and web apps. This team focuses on delivering high quality, delightful and trustful customer experiences.

• Partner Integrations Engineering: Owns the backend services and integrations that connect Flex to financial partners and payment networks, ensuring secure, reliable payment flows and partner-facing experiences.

Operational Ownership

• Improve observability, scalability, and incident response a

Who You Are
Beyond the qualifications below, you are a generalist, enabler, and problem solver who leads through engineering management. High ownership and drive are your default. postings.title: Strategic WFM Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
About Clipboard

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.

Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

Role Overview

The Strategic WFM Analyst lives in the Core Workforce Management (WFM) Planning & Operations Strategy team and is responsible for owning centralized forecast, capacity planning, workforce cost optimization, and strategic headcount trade-offs across all lines of business (LOBs). Moving beyond traditional scheduling and intraday monitoring, this role acts as a high-judgment governance function, translating complex demand forecasts into defensible FTE, BPO, and overtime spend strategies, modelling capacity risks, and aligning executive stakeholders across Finance, Product, and Operations. You are exceptionally strong in WFM maths and financial analytics, exhibit deep strategic curiosity, navigate messy raw data effortlessly, and communicate recommendations with executive-level clarity.

What You’ll Do

•
Translating multi-LOB demand forecasts into monthly and quarterly capacity, headcount, and budget requirements.

•
Modelling workforce and financial trade-offs across internal FTEs, BPO partners, overtime spend, bonus hours, productivity shifts, and shrinkage.

•
Analyzing demand-funnel changes (e.g., product feature roll outs, AI bot deflection shifts) and quantifying their exact capacity and dollar blast radius.

•
Partnering directly with Finance, Product, and Operations to validate baseline assumptions, enforce input SLAs, and align on staffing commitments.

•
Drafting concise, decision-ready executive memos and Weekly Business Reviews (WBRs) for Directors and leadership.

•
Conducting deep-dive root-cause analyses whenever operational actuals deviate from capacity plans and establishing corrective action paths.

•
Standardizing capacity planning frameworks, modeling templates, and operating standards across LOBs.

•
Maintaining deep forecasting competency to audit models, challenge underlying assumptions, and provide seamless coverage across the broader central WFM engine.

What We’re Looking For

•
Strategic WFM Maths: Exceptionally strong quantitative background with deep expertise in WFM fundamentals (capacity modelling, Erlang, shrinkage, AHT, SLA/ASA trade-offs) and advanced proficiency in Google Sheets, SQL, or Python.

•
Business & Financial Judgement: Demonstrated ability to connect operational queue dynamics directly to dollar exposure, hiring velocity, BPO costs, and SLA risk.

•
Executive Communication: Superior strategic writing skills with a natural instinct to distil complex, multi-variable workforce analytics into scannable, 1-2 page decision memos.

•
Cross-Functional Influence: Proven ability to establish governance frameworks, challenge bad assumptions with back tested data, and align Finance, Product, and Operations leadership without formal authority.

•
Blank-Page Ownership: High comfort operating in ambiguous environments with incomplete data, verifiably isolating what materially matters without requiring step-by-step direction.

•
WFM Analyst Profile: Strong core WFM domain expertise with a strategic/Ops spike, not a generalist and not a passive traditional scheduler.

Hiring Process

•
Application

•
Diagnostic Case Study

•
Case Study Interview - Technical & Capacity Interview

•
Executive Judgement & Strategic Interview

•
Culture Interview (People Ops)

•
Offer

Quick Note on Scammers:

Clipboard would never ask you for money or your bank details to participate in our hiring process. Report any scammers impersonating the Clipboard hiring team members here .

postings.descriptionText:
About Clipboard

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.

Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

About the Role

The Collections team under Billing is responsible for collecting payments from workplaces (e.g., healthcare facilities). The Billing Representative (BR) is responsible for ensuring that the assigned workplaces pay their invoices quickly and on time. Cash is the lifeline of any company. This is a very critical role to ensure that the cash flows for the company are smooth. The BR will reach out to the workplaces through phone and email to follow up on payments, get a commitment of payment ("promise to pay"), and ensure that the workplaces honor these commitments. The BR will work with the workplaces and the respective internal teams to ensure any roadblocks in collecting the payments are removed. The role will require cross-functional collaboration with Billing Disputes, Sales, Customer Support, and other teams to achieve the desired goals.

Responsibilities

•
Monitor accounts to identify outstanding debts.

•
Call and email accounts payable contacts, administrators, and others as needed to ask about their overdue payments and upcoming dues.

•
Build relationships with workplaces (e.g., properly set expectations about our billing policy, explain NET & Dispute Terms, etc.).

•
Identify the root cause of non-payment and resolve billing concerns.

•
Report on collections updates and accounts receivable status.

•
Identify critical accounts and devise SMART action plans to address issues.

Requirements and Skills

General

•
Professional and clear communication (verbal and written).

•
High attention to detail.

•
Receptive to feedback (highly coachable).

•
Preferred: experience with Google Drive suite, Slack, Salesforce, soft phone software like Amazon Connect.

Technical

•
Comfortable with math and data (e.g., calculating payment plan instalments).

•
Ability to build relationships with customers.

•
Strong judgment in customer-facing decisions and live interactions.

•
Negotiating skills.

Qualifications

•
Open to candidates of all experience levels—what matters most is your ability to handle business customers professionally and solve problems effectively.

•
No specific degree required—we care about what you can do, not just what’s on your résumé.

Why Join Clipboard?

•
100% Remote. Work from anywhere in the world.

•
Fast-Paced Startup Environment. Join a company that values curiosity, independence, and growth.

•
A hiring process that rewards skills, not just experience. Every applicant gets a fair shot—our selection is based on real-world problem-solving ability, not just credentials.

•
Opportunity to make a significant impact with our workplace customers.

System Requirements

To succeed in this role, you must have:

•
A reliable laptop/desktop (no Chromebooks or Linux OS).

•
Minimum 20 Mbps wired internet connection.

•
Wired headset for clear communication.

•
A quiet, distraction-free workspace.

•
Stable power and internet connectivity.

Hiring process

•
Application form: This includes basic billing rep skill-based questions. Some questions result in automatic rejection, so please approach these with diligence as they assess your ability to handle real problems and client situations.

•
Case Study: Collections scenarios (identifying at-risk accounts, action plans, email writing)

•
Interview 1: Collections simulation

•
Interview 2: Collections simulation

•
Offer

You will receive an email with the next steps in the process within 2 days of your application. Please check your spam folder! If you don’t see the email, make sure it hasn’t been filtered out or blocked.

Clipboard would never ask you for money or your bank details to participate in our hiring process. Report any scammers impersonating the Clipboard hiring team members here .

postings.title: Creative Director
postings.descriptionText:
Our client, a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Health Care space is seeking a commercially minded Creative Director to lead the creative function across our ecommerce business.
This role will own the complete creative direction of the brand across paid advertising, website and landing pages, email, organic social media, marketplaces, product launches, and other customer-facing channels.
The Creative Director will be responsible not only for maintaining a strong and consistent brand identity, but also for improving commercial performance. The primary objective of the role is to develop creative strategies and assets that increase conversion rates, improve advertising performance, strengthen customer engagement, and support profitable growth.
This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can combine creative judgement, customer insight, performance data, and strong team management.

Key Outcomes

Improve Ecommerce Conversion Performance

• Develop creative strategies that improve conversion across paid media, websites, product pages, marketplaces, and email.

• Turn customer insights, performance data, and competitor research into clear briefs and testable concepts.

• Partner with ecommerce teams to improve client acquisition and conversion.

• Establish a structured process for creative testing and optimisation.

Lead Performance Creative Strategy

• Own creative strategy across paid social, video, display, and other acquisition channels.

• Build a consistent pipeline of concepts, hooks, angles, scripts, and formats.

• Ensure sufficient creative volume and variation for testing and scaling.

• Use performance data to identify, improve, and scale winning concepts.

• Balance direct-response effectiveness with strong brand presentation.

Strengthen Website and Product Pages Creatives

• Lead creative direction across the website, landing pages, collection pages, and product pages.

• Improve how product benefits, differentiation, use cases, and customer proof are communicated.

• Create clear visual and messaging hierarchies that make pages more persuasive.

• Collaborate with ecommerce, UX, development, copywriting, and CRO teams on improvements and testing.

• Ensure consistency between advertising and onsite customer experience.

Own Brand Creative Across All Channels

• Maintain a consistent creative direction across paid media, website, email, organic content, marketplaces, packaging, and launches.

• Develop practical brand guidelines that support quality, consistency, and speed.

• Ensure creative work reflects the brand's positioning, audience, and commercial goals.

• Raise the overall standard of design, copy, video, photography, and storytelling.

• Protect brand consistency while encouraging experimentation.

Build and Lead a High-Performing Creative Team

• Lead and develop designers, editors, creators, copywriters, freelancers, and agencies.

• Set clear responsibilities, quality standards, workflows, and performance expectations.

• Provide constructive feedback and support team development.

• Manage the balance between internal and external creative resources.

• Build a culture of accountability, speed, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Improve Creative Operations and Output

• Build an efficient process from research and briefing through production, approval, launch, and iteration.

• Establish clear systems for priorities, deadlines, feedback, approvals, and asset management.

• Ensure projects are delivered on time and aligned with business priorities.

• Maintain an organised creative asset library.

• Improve output and efficiency while maintaining quality and brand consistency.

• Manage creative budgets and external resources effectively.

Lead Product Launch and Campaign Creative

• Develop creative strategies for product launches, promotions, seasonal campaigns, and major events.

• Translate product positioning into strong customer-facing concepts.

• Define clear messaging, creative direction, asset requirements, and channel execution.

• Coordinate creative production across paid media, website, email, marketplaces, and organic content.

• Review results and apply learnings to future campaigns.

Responsibilities

• Own the overall creative vision and execution across the ecommerce business.

• Translate company goals into clear creative priorities and plans.

• Develop quarterly and monthly creative roadmaps.

• Lead creative concept development and campaign planning.

• Review and approve high-priority creative assets.

• Create clear, actionable briefs for internal and external creative teams.

• Partner with growth, marketing, ecommerce, product, customer service, and leadership teams.

• Analyse creative performance using advertising, website, email, and marketplace data.

• Monitor customer behaviour, category trends, competitors, and emerging creative formats.

• Present creative strategies, results, challenges, and recommendations to senior leadership.

• Ensure the creative team remains focused on work that has the greatest commercial impact.

Key Performance Indicators

• Website and landing-page conversion rate.

• Product-page conversion rate.

• Advertising creative performance.

• Customer acquisition cost.

• Return on advertising spend.

• Click-through rate and hook rate.

• Creative testing volume and testing velocity.

• Percentage of creative tests producing meaningful improvements.

• Revenue generated from new creative concepts.

• Email engagement and conversion performance.

• On-time completion of creative projects.

• Creative production efficiency.

• Brand consistency and quality across channels.

• Performance and development of the creative team.

Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate is both creatively ambitious and commercially disciplined. They understand that ecommerce creative must capture attention, communicate value quickly, address customer objections, and motivate action.
They are comfortable moving between high-level strategy and detailed execution. They can confidently lead a team, evaluate creative work, interpret performance data, and collaborate with commercial stakeholders.
They do not rely solely on personal taste. They use customer insight, brand strategy, testing, and business results to make decisions.

Required Experience

• Significant experience in a senior creative leadership role within ecommerce, DTC, retail, consumer products, or a performance-focused agency.

• Demonstrated experience improving conversion and advertising performance through creative strategy.

• Strong understanding of ecommerce customer journeys, product pages, landing pages, paid social, email, and organic content.

• Experience leading multidisciplinary creative teams.

• Strong portfolio demonstrating both brand-building and performance-focused creative work.

• Experience creating and evaluating direct-response advertising concepts.

• Ability to interpret creative, advertising, and ecommerce performance data.

• Strong understanding of design, copywriting, video, photography, content production, and visual storytelling.

• Experience managing multiple projects, deadlines, stakeholders, and production partners.

• Excellent communication, presentation, and feedback skills.

Preferred Experience

• Experience working with physical consumer products.

• Experience with Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Amazon, Shopify, and email marketing platforms.

• Experience with conversion-rate optimisation and structured experimentation.

• Experience producing user-generated content, creator-led advertising, product demonstrations, and testimonial creative.

• Experience managing external agencies, freelancers, studios, photographers, and creators.

• Familiarity with creative analytics and project-management tools.

• Experience scaling an established ecommerce brand across multiple products, markets, or countries.

What Success Looks Like
Within the first 90 days, the Creative Director will have assessed the current brand, creative team, workflows, performance data, customer journey, and existing asset library. They will have identified the largest creative and conversion opportunities and introduced a clear testing and production roadmap.
Within six months, the company should have a stronger creative pipeline, clearer brand direction, faster testing cycles, improved collaboration between creative and growth teams, and measurable improvements in conversion and creative performance.
Within the first year, the Creative Director will have built a scalable creative function that consistently produces high-quality, commercially effective work across every major ecommerce channel.

What We Offer:

• Full-time remote position in a rapidly growing international company.

• A senior leadership role with direct ownership of the company's ecommerce creative direction and growth.

• High level of autonomy and the opportunity to shape creative strategy, processes, and team development.

• Direct impact on ecommerce performance, conversion, and creative effectiveness across multiple channels.

• Opportunity to build and lead a high-performing multidisciplinary creative team.

• A performance-driven and feedback-oriented culture where creative decisions are connected to business results.

• Competitive compensation based on experience.

• Bonuses.

• Paid Time Off.

• Long-term growth opportunities aligned with company expansion.

This is an excellent opportunity for a commercially minded Creative Director who wants to take ownership of a growing ecommerce creative function, combine creative leadership with performance-driven decision-making, and build a scalable creative operation with a direct impact on business growth.

About FreedUp

FreedUp places talented Executive Assistants with founders and executives at growing US companies. We free leaders up by saving them time and effort so they can focus on the work only they can do. For our EAs, we aim to be one of the best US companies for LATAM and Filipino talent, with a supportive environment and real room to grow.

About the role
We're looking for a sharp, proactive Executive Assistant to be the "second brain" for a fast-moving US entrepreneur. He runs a growing private aircraft sales business, where many leads come in through his social media content, and he co-owns a pool services company.
You'll own his CRM, keep his sales team on track, stay on top of his calendar, files and travel, and help with the personal details that make life run smoothly. You won't just follow instructions: he wants someone who audits how things are done, spots gaps without being told, and suggests what to hand off next. This is a behind-the-scenes role. He handles all client calls and onboarding himself.
Compensation: 1,000 to 1,700 USD (Depends on Experience)
Location: Remote, LATAM
Job Type: Full-time

What you'll do

1. Own the Notion CRM (ramps up gradually)

• Keep the aviation sales pipeline watertight: deal stages, last-contact dates and next steps always current.

• Add new and missing deals, including aircraft that go under contract, and flag stale records (for example, "last contact was months ago").

• After each recorded sales Zoom call, use the transcript and Claude to create the CRM entry with the contact's details, write next steps and delegate follow-ups to the right sales rep.

• Take over the CRM step by step as you learn the nuances of the business.

2. Coordinate the sales team

• Follow up with the two sales reps so they stay on top of their leads and keep their deals updated in the CRM, without adding extra admin work to their plate.

• Make sure every deal has clear next steps and that aircraft listings get the visibility they need.

• Send him consolidated status overviews so he can see the whole pipeline at a glance.

3. Manage Dropbox filing (from day one)

• Move aircraft photos, videos, spec sheets, sales brochures, maintenance status reports, contracts, LOIs, APAs and deposit confirmations from email into the right Dropbox folders as soon as they arrive.

• Follow a clear SOP and keep everything consistent as the team grows. Much of this material is sensitive or client-facing, so accuracy matters.

4. Manage his calendar and reminders

• Manage his Outlook calendar and his availability for calls booked through Calendly.

• Handle reschedule requests and send short scheduling emails to clients when needed.

• Send a proactive end-of-day "here's tomorrow" text with his meetings, addresses, links, documents or waivers to sign, and anything he needs to bring, plus a suggested time for his daily workout around a busy schedule.

5. Book travel

• Plan two to three mostly domestic trips a month, comparing options on Kayak and booking through airline apps.

• Follow his saved preferences: direct flights, no very early departures and exit row seats, with his traveler details on file.

• Handle booking, check-in and confirmations so everything is ready on his phone.

6. Handle personal and admin tasks

• Take care of waivers, vehicle registrations and other paperwork for his trucks and businesses.

• Remember birthdays and anniversaries, and arrange flowers and gifts for his wife and kids within a set budget.

• Process payroll for his pool company (about six people).

• Possibly monitor GoHighLevel for new pool leads during your working hours and send quick text replies.

Please note: this role does not include client calls or onboarding. He handles all client conversations himself. Beyond these tasks, he wants you to audit his systems, spot the low-hanging fruit and tell him what else you can take off his plate.

Our hiring process

• Apply online

• Record a short Loom video introducing yourself/ Prescreen call with a recruiter

• Final Interview with our Recruiting Lead

• Complete a work evaluation

• Final interview with the client

Requirements

Must-haves

• At least 3 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Sales Coordinator or in a similar support role.

• A very proactive "second brain" who audits systems and spots gaps without being told.

• Highly organized and detail-oriented.

• Fast and responsive. He should never be left waiting.

• Disciplined and professional.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

• Comfortable handling both business and personal tasks.

• High discretion with client, financial and payroll information.

• Available full-time from 9 AM to 5 PM US Central Time.

• Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet home office setup.

Nice-to-haves

• A good sense of humor and a likable personality.

• Experience with Notion as a CRM.

• Comfort using AI tools, especially Claude.

• Sales operations or high-ticket sales support experience.

• Experience with GoHighLevel.

Tools & Communication: Notion, Claude, Outlook, Dropbox, Zoom, Calendly, DocuSign, GoHighLevel, and Kayak and airline apps. Communication is mainly by text, with phone calls when needed (no Slack).

Benefits

• Compensation in USD

• Health insurance allowance

• PTO + Holidays

• Training and ongoing support from the FreedUp team

postings.title: Freelance Recruiter – Commission Only (€400–2,400 per placement) – Buenos Aires
postings.descriptionText:
Recruit for Europe from home, paid in euros per placement. Your own hours, your own methods. Open to recruiters based in Buenos Aires and across Argentina.
Read all of this before you apply. It's long on purpose. If this isn't you, that's completely fine, and it saves us both time.

Who we are
BC Recruitment places people in jobs across Europe: multilingual customer service, sales and support roles with some of the biggest international employers, in cities like Athens, Lisbon, Porto, Braga and Sofia. Many of these jobs come with relocation help, which makes them easier to sell to candidates.
We have around 60 open roles right now, in Dutch, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Polish, Turkish, the Nordic languages and more. Alongside those we have specialist roles, like compliance, legal and tech, that pay a lot more per placement.
You don't need to speak the candidates' languages. Every role needs English, and English is what we work in. What matters is that you know where to find people and how to get them excited about a job abroad.

Who we're looking for
People who are hungry, driven and excited about this opportunity, and who believe they can earn more on commission than they do now.
We don't care how many years you've been recruiting. Someone with 6 months of hunger can beat someone with 10 years of experience. We care about what you have personally delivered: how many placements, for what kind of roles, and how many a month.

You'll probably fit if:

• You understand that every nationality is found differently. If one channel doesn't work for a market, you know where those people really are and go there.

• You already have your own tools: LinkedIn, laptop, phone, and whatever else you use to recruit.

• You want freedom: your own hours, your own place, your own methods, no boss.

• You have real numbers: placements or sales you made yourself, and you know your monthly average.

• You've done global or international recruitment, ideally for similar companies or the same kind of candidates: customer service, call centres, multilingual roles, relocation, tourism, hospitality.

• You're a natural seller who finds people on your own, without leads or hand-holding.

This is NOT for you if

• You need us to pay for tools before you can work. We don't cover anything at the start.

• You want something to try "when you have time".

• You need someone to tell you what to do every day.

• You'll blame others when a client pauses a role or a candidate drops out. That's part of recruitment.

• Most of the people you can reach need a visa. Most of our roles require candidates who can already work in the EU, and we don't offer visa support on most jobs.

• You need a fixed income soon. There is no salary, retainer or paid trial at the start.

What you earn

•
Minimum €400 per placement. Most roles pay €400–750, and specialist roles up to €2,400.

• You see the exact payout on every role before you work on it.

• A placement counts once your candidate has started and the employer has paid us. Someone who accepts and then drops out is not a placement.

• Payment usually comes 1–3 months after your candidate starts, depending on the employer. We pay by bank transfer or whatever works for you.

•
Money you've earned is always paid. We know many recruiters are afraid of not being paid. Think about it from our side: a recruiter who delivers is worth far more to us over time than any single placement. This whole system is built on trust, and we'd lose by breaking it.

If you deliver, we deliver back
Nothing is given up front. Everything grows with your results, for proven partners and agreed case by case:

• Once you deliver, we cover tool costs such as monthly subscriptions.

• Proven recruiters can get earlier payouts, arranged with you.

• Consistent performers can earn a monthly base on top of commission.

The rules bend toward the people who prove themselves. This job gets better the more you deliver.

What you get from day one

• Proper onboarding: we explain everything, the employers, the roles and how we work, and answer all your questions before you start, so you begin with confidence.

• Full role details and answers to the questions candidates usually ask.

• Direct contact with us whenever you have a question about a role or a candidate.

• Total freedom over how, when and where you work.

What's realistic

• The first weeks are about building your pipeline.

• Once you're up and running, a below-average recruiter makes about 1 placement a month, a good recruiter 2–5, and our best recruiters 5–10. It gets easier over time: you build a pool of candidates to come back to, and people start recommending you.

• We expect at least one placement a month once you're up and running.

How we choose

• You answer the questions below. We read every answer.

• If your answers are strong, we have a video call.

• If we're a fit, we onboard you.

Everyone starts with a 30-day trial. Show real progress in that month, with candidates submitted and in interviews, and you stay and grow. If not, we part ways with no hard feelings.

To apply, answer these questions

•
Your numbers. How many placements have you made per month on average, and for which roles and countries? What was your best month?

•
The task. We have a Dutch-speaking customer service role in Athens, and candidates must already be allowed to work in the EU. Where exactly would you find 5 of them within two weeks, and how? Name the real channels, groups or searches you'd use.

•
Commission. Why do you prefer being paid per placement over a salary, or over how you've been paid before?

•
Your setup. Which tools and channels do you use today? How many hours a week can you put in, and what else are you working on right now?

Apply here with your CV. Then email your answers to , with your name and country in the subject. Applications without answers aren't reviewed.
Optional: attach a voice note or video answering "Why should we pick you?" It's the quickest way for us to get to know you.
Be specific: numbers, names, real examples. Answers that sound AI-written, or that just say what you think we want to hear, are rejected.

postings.descriptionText:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
But that’s just the beginning:
Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
The Senior Strategic Sourcing Specialist is a role responsible for driving end-to-end sourcing events, commercial negotiations, and contract structuring across key technology spend categories, including IT infrastructure, software, IT services, and staffing agencies. In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor to internal stakeholders, owning the entire sourcing lifecycle from initial market analysis and RFP execution to final contract drafting and vendor onboarding, ensuring optimal value and mitigated risk for the business.
“Negotiates high-value tech contracts and ensures we only pay for delivered results”

Responsibilities

• Lead single-source negotiations and competitive RFPs across multiple technology and services spend categories.

• Negotiate and secure favorable tier discounts, pricing models, and commercial terms with key technology and service vendors.

• Structure complex Statements of Work (SOWs), ensuring that agency fee disbursements are strictly tied to measurable delivery milestones and performance metrics.

• Standardize contractor rate cards and implement labor caps across all staff augmentation and external consulting engagements.

• Conduct comprehensive market analysis to inform sourcing strategies and benchmark pricing.

• Draft, review, and refine contract terms in close collaboration with Legal, Security, and Finance teams.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders, aligning sourcing strategies with broader organizational goals.

• 5+ years of proven experience in strategic sourcing, procurement, or vendor management, with specific expertise in technology categories (Cloud, SaaS, IT Services, Staffing).

• Exceptional negotiation skills with a history of driving cost savings and favorable commercial terms.

• Deep understanding of contract structures, particularly in milestone-based SOWs and standardized labor rate cards.

• Strong analytical skills to evaluate market trends, pricing models, and total cost of ownership.

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams in a fast-paced, remote-first environment.

• Comfortable managing end-to-end sourcing processes without relying on heavy, legacy ERP systems.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

About the role:
You will own the inference backbone behind QVAC's local AI stack: the C++ systems layer that makes models run fast, reliably, and predictably on real user hardware. The role is centered on engineering quality at runtime level, including startup behavior, memory pressure, throughput/latency balance, and long-session stability. You will define and evolve the core abstractions that inference features depend on, so new capabilities can be added without sacrificing performance or maintainability. This is a role for someone who enjoys low-level problem solving, clear technical ownership, and building infrastructure that other teams trust in production. Your work directly enables private, on-device AI experiences and helps set the technical foundation for QVAC's next generation of peer-to-peer AI products.

About the job
You'll work on the C++ layer that powers local AI, porting and enhancing inference engines like llama.cpp or similar, to run efficiently on edge devices. Your focus is on the runtime: making models load faster, run leaner, and perform well across different hardware. You'll ensure that the inference layer is stable, optimized, and ready for integration with the rest of the stack.
This role is for engineers who want to work close to the metal, enabling private and fast on-device AI without relying on cloud infrastructure.

Responsibilities

• Work on deploying machine learning models to edge devices using the frameworks: llama.cpp, ggml

• Collaborate closely with researchers to assist in coding, training and transitioning models from research to production environments

• Integrate AI features into existing products, enriching them with the latest advancements in machine learning

• Strong programming skills in C++

• Strong experience with Llama.cpp and ggml inference engines, which facilitates the deployment of models to specific GPU architectures

• Experience with any GPU framework between Cuda, Vulkan, Metal, OpenCL

• Good understanding of deep learning concepts and model architectures

• Experience with transformers, LLMs, Diffusion models

• Demonstrated ability to rapidly assimilate new technologies and techniques

• A degree in Computer Science, AI, Machine Learning, or a related field, complemented by a solid track record in AI R&D

Bonus points if:

• You know how to train/fine-tune a LLM

• You have productionized models

• You have research experience in new model architectures

• You have experience with distributed systems

• Javascript experience
