postings.title: Jefe Mantenimiento Mecánico
postings.descriptionText:
Jefe/a de Mantenimiento Mecánico

Acerca del Rol:
Buscamos personas que vivan nuestros valores, que no tengan miedo de desafiar, innovar, experimentar y desenvolverse en un entorno dinámico. Siempre estamos buscando nuevas formas de mejorar nuestros productos y de seguir desarrollándonos. Si esto te representa, nos encantaría conocerte.
Como Jefe/a de Mantenimiento Mecánico , serás responsable de liderar y gestionar el mantenimiento mecánico y neumático de las líneas de producción y de los servicios auxiliares de nuestra planta de Wilde, asegurando la continuidad operativa, la confiabilidad de los equipos y el cumplimiento de los objetivos de seguridad, calidad, productividad y costes.
Se trata de una posición de liderazgo con un fuerte componente técnico y de gestión. Requiere combinar conocimientos sólidos de mantenimiento, planificación, análisis de información, liderazgo de equipos y orientación a la mejora continua , manteniendo siempre la seguridad como prioridad.
El rol liderará un equipo de mecánicos y cuchilleros/afiladores que brinda soporte a una operación de producción continua. Por ello, buscamos a una persona cercana a la operación, capaz de acompañar técnicamente al equipo, tomar decisiones ante situaciones críticas y desarrollar una gestión de mantenimiento cada vez más planificada y preventiva.

Responsabilidades del Puesto:

• Liderar el proceso de mantenimiento mecánico y neumático de las líneas de producción y de los servicios auxiliares de la planta, gestionando personas, máquinas y sistemas para asegurar el cumplimiento de los indicadores de productividad establecidos.

• Coordinar las tareas de mantenimiento correctivo, preventivo y programado, asegurando una respuesta eficaz ante averías y la correcta ejecución de las intervenciones durante paradas de equipos y planta.

• Liderar, acompañar y desarrollar al equipo de mecánicos y cuchilleros/afiladores, promoviendo su autonomía, desempeño, formación técnica y crecimiento profesional.

• Gestionar la cobertura operativa del equipo, incluyendo la planificación de turnos, vacaciones, recursos, capacitaciones y matrices de habilidades.

• Impulsar la implementación y mejora del pilar de Mantenimiento Preventivo dentro de la metodología TPM, realizando seguimiento de los planes, análisis de averías y acciones de mejora.

• Planificar y administrar el mantenimiento mediante SAP, incluyendo la creación y seguimiento de órdenes de trabajo, relevamiento y actualización de equipos, planificación de tareas y gestión de la información de mantenimiento.

• Gestionar el mantenimiento de servicios auxiliares y equipos de planta, coordinando rutinas preventivas, registros técnicos y servicios tercerizados con proveedores.

• Administrar la estrategia de repuestos, identificando necesidades, criticidad y niveles de stock para asegurar la disponibilidad de componentes y minimizar riesgos para la operación.

• Asegurar el cumplimiento de los estándares y procedimientos relacionados con seguridad, salud, medioambiente, higiene, calidad, productividad y costes.

• Promover una cultura de seguridad, asegurando que todas las tareas de mantenimiento se ejecuten de acuerdo con las normas, procedimientos y comportamientos definidos por Essity.

• Trabajar de manera transversal con Operaciones, Ingeniería, Seguridad, Calidad, Compras y proveedores, asegurando una adecuada coordinación de las actividades de mantenimiento.

• Participar en investigaciones de causa raíz, análisis de incidentes y fallos, así como en la definición y seguimiento de acciones correctivas y preventivas.

• Acompañar ensayos, iniciativas de innovación y mejoras de equipos orientadas a incrementar la eficiencia, velocidad, confiabilidad y productividad de las líneas.

• Gestionar los recursos y presupuestos asociados al área, participando en su planificación, seguimiento y control.

• Participar activamente en los sistemas de reuniones de la compañía, presentando avances, indicadores, necesidades y planes de acción del área.

• Brindar soporte técnico y liderazgo ante contingencias relevantes de la operación, considerando las necesidades propias de una planta de producción continua.

Quién eres:

• Eres profesional de Ingeniería Mecánica, Ingeniería Electromecánica, Ingeniería Industrial o una carrera técnica/profesional afín.

• Cuentas con al menos 3 a 5 años de experiencia en mantenimiento de líneas de producción, preferiblemente en plantas industriales de proceso continuo.

• Posees conocimientos técnicos sólidos en mecánica, neumática y mantenimiento de equipos industriales.

• Tienes experiencia liderando equipos técnicos y gestionando su desempeño, planificación, capacitación y desarrollo.

• Cuentas con experiencia en planificación y gestión de mantenimiento mediante SAP, incluyendo órdenes de trabajo, equipos y planes de mantenimiento.

• Tienes conocimientos y experiencia en metodologías de gestión de manufactura y mejora continua, especialmente TPM. Se valorarán también conocimientos de Lean Manufacturing, 5S, Kaizen y/o Six Sigma.

• Posees experiencia gestionando mantenimiento preventivo y correctivo, análisis de averías, causa raíz y planes de acción.

• Sabes trabajar con indicadores de mantenimiento y productividad, utilizando datos e información técnica para establecer prioridades y tomar decisiones.

• Cuentas con conocimientos de seguridad industrial, normas de calidad y buenas prácticas aplicables a entornos de manufactura.

• Tienes experiencia en gestión de repuestos, proveedores, servicios tercerizados, costes y presupuestos de mantenimiento.

• Destacas por tu liderazgo cercano, comunicación, capacidad de negociación y toma de decisiones, pudiendo construir relaciones de confianza con equipos de amplia experiencia técnica.

• Eres una persona planificada, analítica y orientada a resultados, con capacidad para gestionar prioridades y responder con criterio ante contingencias operativas.

• Tienes una marcada orientación a la seguridad y comprendes que ninguna urgencia operativa justifica omitir los procedimientos o estándares establecidos.

• Te caracterizas por un estilo de trabajo hands-on: puedes liderar desde la gestión y, cuando la situación lo requiere, involucrarte y acompañar técnicamente al equipo en planta.

• Cuentas con disponibilidad para brindar soporte ante contingencias críticas, intervenciones programadas o necesidades excepcionales propias de una operación de producción continua.

• El conocimiento de inglés será valorado para participar en reuniones e iniciativas regionales y globales.

Qué podemos ofrecerte
En Essity, creemos que el aprendizaje y el desarrollo profesional de cada persona son únicos, y queremos brindar a nuestros colaboradores las herramientas y oportunidades necesarias para alcanzar su máximo potencial dentro de una cultura ganadora, inspirada por un propósito poderoso.
Cultura colaborativa e inclusiva | Líderes que empoderan y generan compromiso | Trabajo con propósito e impacto sostenible | Aprendizaje y crecimiento profesional | Bienestar y vida laboral sostenible | Innovaciones que cambian vidas | Compensación total competitiva

About the Role
Are you passionate about data, reporting, and delivering an outstanding client experience?
We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical professional to join our team as a Client Reporting Data Analyst . In this role, you will play a key part in ensuring the accurate and timely delivery of reports, supporting client requests, validating data quality, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to provide exceptional service.
This position is ideal for someone who enjoys working with data, solving problems, managing multiple priorities, and building strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

What You'll Do

• Generate and deliver recurring and ad hoc reports for clients while ensuring accuracy and quality.

• Review and validate data according to established quality standards and verification processes.

• Analyze client requirements and collaborate with internal teams to ensure deliverables meet expectations.

• Investigate and resolve data discrepancies, reporting issues, and client inquiries.

• Support client-facing meetings by preparing reporting deliverables and insights.

• Assist with invoice tracking, payment processing, contract administration, and budget-related activities when required.

• Monitor project timelines and ensure timely completion of assigned deliverables.

• Maintain accurate documentation and records within internal systems.

• Build strong relationships with clients and internal stakeholders to support business objectives.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Life Sciences, Healthcare, or a related field.

• 2+ years of professional experience in reporting, data analysis, customer support, operations, finance, or related functions.

• Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office Suite.

• Experience working with large datasets and performing data validation activities.

• Excellent organizational and time-management skills.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Customer-focused mindset with strong problem-solving abilities.

• Advanced English communication skills.

Join Nortal for your next big adventure. We are seeking a Project Manager to join our team, grow with us, and teach us a few things along the way.

Why join Nortal

• Say Goodbye to Micromanagement: We champion autonomy, open communication, and respect for diversity as our core values.

• Outcomes Over Hours: We believe in a work model focused on impact, providing you with the flexibility to balance your professional success with your personal well-being.

• Vibrant Community: Join our close-knit LATAM remote team and connect through tech talks, virtual coffee breaks, and team-building activities.

• Support from Day One: Our People Care team is here to support you throughout your journey, from wellness check-ins to professional growth.

Our benefits ✨

• Competitive USD salary.

• 100% remote work: While you can work from anywhere, you’re always welcome to connect with teammates and grow your network at our coworking spaces across LATAM.

• Paid time off & national holidays: Take the time you need according to your country’s regulations while receiving your full salary.

• Sick leave: Focus on your health without stress. Take the necessary time to recover and feel better.

• Annual credit: Spend it on the perks you love to enhance your work-life balance.

• Team-building activities: Join us for coffee breaks, tech talks, and after-work gatherings to bond with your Nortal family and feel part of our vibrant community.

• Birthday off: Enjoy an extra day off during your birthday week to celebrate in style with friends and family.

About the project

At Nortal, you'll help deliver Adobe and marketing technology engagements for a strategic enterprise client. You'll coordinate the people and priorities behind successful delivery, build trusted client relationships, and help identify where our teams can provide additional support.

You'll own assigned engagements and work closely with account leaders, project managers and technical specialists. This role gives you direct involvement in both delivery decisions and conversations about the client's business needs.

Your focus will be approximately 40% workforce coordination and 60% leading relationships within an assigned client business area and helping develop the account. Priorities may evolve as engagement needs change.

What you’ll do

• Build client relationships and identify opportunities

• Understand your client's priorities, challenges and delivery needs, and build productive relationships with key stakeholders.

• Recognize opportunities for additional support and work with account leadership to explore them.

• Bring your Adobe understanding into solution discussions, connecting business needs with the right technical specialists.

• Support discovery, pre-sales and proposals when needed, coordinating input on requirements, scope, delivery approach and staffing.

• Coordinate teams and resources

• Work with delivery and account teams to align people's skills and availability with client commitments.

• Support onboarding and engagement transitions, follow up on team and client feedback, and help resolve emerging issues.

• Keep staffing needs, capacity and delivery risks visible, taking action within your scope and escalating when wider support is needed.

• Guide delivery and keep stakeholders informed

• Manage plans, priorities, dependencies and risks, adapting your approach to fixed-price projects, time-and-material services or team-extension engagements.

• Track progress, staffing needs and relevant budget information, and communicate decisions and next steps clearly.

• Improve coordination and follow-through across teams. Depending on engagement needs, you may also take on billable project work within your agreed allocation.

What makes you a great fit

• Experience managing IT or digital projects in client-facing roles, with the ability to own assigned engagements independently.

• Working familiarity with the Adobe ecosystem and how it supports business needs, so you can contribute to solution and opportunity discussions. Experience in comparable enterprise ecosystems may also be considered where you bring transferable knowledge and sufficient Adobe understanding for the role.

• A consultative and commercial mindset: you listen, ask thoughtful questions, and recognize where additional services could address a client's needs.

• Clear communication and strong relationship-building skills, including sound judgment when managing expectations or raising concerns.

• Experience coordinating distributed teams, staffing needs and delivery priorities.

• An organized, proactive approach to resolving issues and following through on commitments.

• Working knowledge of agile and traditional delivery practices, resource planning and basic project financials, with flexibility across engagement models.

• Fluent written and spoken English.

Global Impact, Local Culture 🌍

For over 25 years, we’ve been shaping digital transformation, delivering complex solutions for global enterprises and public sector organizations. Today, we are at the forefront of an AI-driven transformation era, helping organizations turn data into real business value. By combining deep domain expertise with data and AI, we design solutions that create immediate impact while scaling for the future.

We believe complexity doesn’t have to mean complicated, and that the best solutions are those that work in the real world, not just on paper. That’s why our clients trust us with their most ambitious, business-critical initiatives.

Apply now and let’s shape the future of technology together! 🧑‍💻

This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.

We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.



Overview


📍 Remote Global - Caribbean

 

We are seeking a WFM Central - Real Time Analyst to serve as the central governance layer for live operations across multiple Lines of Business (LoB). This is not a traditional monitoring role; it is designed for a high-caliber, forensic operator who functions as an operational architect. You will be a trusted partner to operational leadership, responsible for continuing to evolve our operations to a standardized, and fiscally sound control model.


The ideal candidate possesses the technical "know-how" of a forensic analyst and the communication prowess of a business consultant, capable of telling a compelling story through data to stakeholders ranging from Team Leads to Directors. You won't just report that a queue is at risk; you will diagnose the business impact, identify the root cause, and prescribe the specific levers leadership must pull to preserve SLA and the customer experience. You will be the owner of all aspects of the support queues and ensure we are meeting our customers where they need us.


Responsibilities

 - Stakeholder Storytelling: Distill complex, "noisy" operational signals into high-impact narratives. You must be able to share in-depth observations and supporting data that tell a clear story to stakeholders, at all levels of leadership, on exactly what actions must be taken.

 - Business-Level Analysis: Go beyond the "what" and the "why" to analyze long-term business trends. Evaluate the financial efficiency of SLA safeguarding and the fiscal impact of current staffing vs. demand density.

 - Operational Control & Forensic Auditing: Serve as the authoritative "voice of reason" during incidents. Conduct forensic audits of agent behaviors such as "On Hold" abuse or status irregularities to ensure hidden capacity drains are eliminated.

 - Centralized Core Governance: Enact queue management playbooks for real-time levers across multiple LoBs, ensuring aggressive SLAs are preserved through structured accountability.

 - Strategic Planning & Optimization: Partner with WFM to create a concise feedback loop for continued improvement in planning and scheduling.


Qualifications

 - Exceptional Communication: Proven ability to translate complex data into a clear jargon-free business story. You must be comfortable presenting actionable insights to senior leadership under high-pressure conditions.

 - Advanced Forensic Analysis: Expert proficiency in Google Sheets is required, familiarity with Metabase preferred. You must be able to build complex, automated tracking tools and forensic audits from scratch. Not just for basic queue health, but also analyzing business data that influences our operations.

 - Strategic Judgment: Demonstrated experience making high-judgment decisions that impact the entire business, particularly in environments with aggressive SLAs and fluctuating volume patterns.

 - Operational Architecture: Take ownership in documenting best practices into governed frameworks and playbooks.

 - Resilient Mindset: Comfortable operating autonomously in a 24/7 environment, with the flexibility to adapt to operational needs as part of a high-impact, interdependent team.

 - Systems Fluency: Familiarity with Amazon Connect, Zendesk Omnichannel routing, and Assembled WFM is highly preferred.


What Success Looks Like

 - Operational anomalies are quickly investigated, with root causes clearly identified and communicated, reducing repeat issues and leadership uncertainty

 - You evolve queue management processes from reactive to a documented, standardized, and predictive operating model.

 - Champion of the team’s brand with Operational Leadership. You are looked to as the primary source of truth, relying on your data-driven stories to make critical staffing and operational decisions.

 - Live queues remain stable, governed, and resilient across all supported lines of business, even during unexpected spikes, outages, or incidents

 - Stakeholders receive timely, clear updates during incidents that explain impact, cause, and corrective actions in a concise and actionable manner.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. We are hiring a Public Cloud Solution Architect to drive Canonical’s joint initiatives and technical engagements with major public clouds. This role will act as the technical counterpart to Canonical’s Cloud Alliance GTM Lead, working closely with engineering, sales, and product management teams across Canonical and our cloud partners. While not a sales role, it demands both technical expertise and commercial awareness, as well as the ability to prioritize and navigate the strategies of both parties.

Location: This role will be based remotely in the AMER region.

The role entails

• Collaborating with product, engineering, and alliance teams at public cloud partners to align on open-source strategies.

• Ensuring Canonical’s product requirements are clear and delivery is executed as planned.

• Maintaining relationships with engineering teams to integrate and optimize Ubuntu on public clouds.

• Acting as a product champion and point of contact for named cloud partners.

• Coordinating with marketing and product teams on messaging, content creation, and launch plans.

• Creating partner- and customer-facing materials like webinars, presentations, videos, and white papers.

• Driving Ubuntu adoption across cloud products, advocating its benefits to stakeholders.

• Delivering first-party offerings with subscription components with cloud providers.

• Leading in making Canonical products the default choice for our cloud partners to build on and accelerating adoption of our technology by end users on their platforms.

What we are looking for in you

• Working understanding and strong interest in public cloud technologies.

• Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university, with an undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path.

• Confidence to respectfully speak up and exchange ideas without hesitation.

• Driven to meet commitments and achieve results, evidenced by a track record of delivering beyond expectations.

• A commitment to leadership, skills development and mentorship.

• Passion for technology evidenced by personal as well as business pursuits.

• Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability.

• Outstanding business English writing and presentation skills.

• Appreciative of diversity, effective in a multicultural, multi-national organisation

• Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long.

Nice-to-have skills

• Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred), Azure, AWS, GCP, devops, containers, open source technologies.

• Product management background or a desire for a future in product management.

• Strategic partner management or development experience.

• Understanding of marketing and go-to-market strategy.

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Kreative Media is hiring an AI Video Editor to produce scroll-stopping video ads for brands in India and abroad. You will blend traditional editing with generative AI tools to ship many ad variations a week, on brand and ready to test.
Location: Remote (open to candidates in India and worldwide). Company HQ: New Delhi, India.
Employment type: Full-time (contract-to-hire possible)
Responsibilities:

• Edit short-form video ads (Reels, Shorts, TikTok, Meta/YouTube ads) with strong hooks, pacing, captions and sound

• Generate AI footage, B-roll, avatars and voiceovers with Kling, Seedance, Runway, Veo, HeyGen, ElevenLabs and Midjourney

• Produce several hook and format variations per brief for A/B testing

• Do brand-polish passes: colour, motion, typography and copy alignment

• Keep prompt libraries and project files organised so the team can reuse what works

• Work with the creative lead on briefs and act on performance feedback

Requirements:

• 2+ years of video editing (Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, After Effects or CapCut)

• Hands-on work with AI video, image and voice tools; a portfolio showing AI-generated ad work is required

• A strong eye for ad structure: hook, proof, CTA

• Good written English and reliable remote communication

• Can deliver to deadlines (typical turnaround is 48 hours)

Nice to have:

• Motion graphics or 3D skills

• UGC-style ad experience for D2C or SaaS brands

• Basic prompt-engineering or ComfyUI workflows

Salary:

• India: ₹30,000 – ₹70,000 per month (INR), based on experience

• Global/US remote: US$3,500 – US$6,000 per month, based on experience and location

How to apply: Email with the subject "AI Video Editor — Kreative Media". Include your CV, portfolio or links to your work, and your notice period.
About Kreative Media:
Kreative Media () is an AI-powered creative agency based in New Delhi, India, producing high-performance marketing creatives for modern brands: AI video ads with AI avatars and voices, AI static ads, and brand-aligned creative built with specialized AI workflows (Midjourney, Kling, Seedance). Jitendra Vaswani is the investor and CEO of Kreative Media. He is also the founder of BloggersIdeas, AffiliateBooster, SchemaNinja and DigiExe, and has spent more than a decade in SEO, affiliate and digital marketing. Our process: a 30-minute brief, AI generation and scoring, brand-polish editing, then production-ready files with a testing playbook. We work remotely with brands in India and around the world.

postings.title: Junior Video Editor: Direct Response Ads
postings.descriptionText:
Junior Video Editor: Direct Response Ads
Remote | Full-time independent contractor | $2,000 to $3,000 USD a month | At least 4 hours a day overlapping 10am to 6pm Dubai time
You can cut a great ad. Now find out which ones actually win.
Most editors send off their work and never see the result. Here, you'll work alongside our Senior Video Editor on real ads for real brands, and see how they perform.
Eyeball Factory is a Dubai performance creative agency working with fast-growing e-commerce and health brands on Meta and TikTok. Our founders built and sold a 7-figure e-commerce brand and grew a media company to 95,000 newsletter subscribers. We run on AI and we move fast.
The job

• Work with our Senior Video Editor on the same ads and the same output

• Cut fast-paced direct response ads: VSLs, UGC and creator cuts, hook stacks, AI UGC, AI explainers and animated ads

• Use AI tools (avatars, voice, AI b-roll, image-to-video) to make formats a typical editor can't

• Bring your own ideas for hooks, structures and visual concepts

Your KPI: 20 minutes of edited video per week, the same as the senior role.
The pay
$2,000 to $3,000 USD a month, depending on experience.
You're a fit if

• You have [1+ years] editing paid social ads, ideally for e-commerce, direct response, supplements, info products or affiliates

• You can show ads that actually ran

• You've made AI UGC, AI avatar or AI-generated ads, or you pick up new AI tools fast

• Multiple ads a day doesn't scare you

• You take feedback well and turn it around quickly

• Your English is strong enough to follow scripts precisely

• You can give at least 4 hours a day overlapping 10am to 6pm Dubai time

You're not a fit if

• Your portfolio is mostly brand films, weddings or vlogs

• You only want to edit and never think about why an ad works

• You need days to turn around one ad

How to apply

• Record a 2–3 minute Loom: pick one ad you edited and walk us through it. What was the hook, why did you choose that structure, and what would you change now?

• Fill out our application form with your portfolio link (ads only) and your Loom link:

• No Loom, no review. We watch every one.

Our process
Application with Loom, intro interview, call with our founder, paid 2-week trial, final interview, offer.

postings.title: Sales Manager
postings.descriptionText:
HighGrowth.io builds outbound sales teams for founder-led, bootstrapped, B2B companies ($500K to $5M ARR) in the US and Europe. We need an additional Sales Team Implementation Manager to help us scale.

In this role, you’ll lead and manage client sales team implementations end-to-end, while partnering closely with our founder on strategy, priorities, and continuous improvement of our outbound playbook.

This is a high-ownership seat: part client delivery, part sales operations oversight, and a key right hand to a strategic executive.

The ideal candidate must be a strong sales leader, but also must be able to work with and alongside other strong personalities. Why?

Your sales leadership experience will allow you to slot directly into this role, since you already know the general management principles of dialing and sales teams. However, you'll be following the HighGrowth.io playbook and working with the HighGrowth.io founder to adjust that playbook to the realities of the specific client.

Additionally, you'll be interacting with the founder (or founders) on the client side. If it's not already clear, bootstrapped founders tend to have very strong personalities.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Lead outbound sales implementations for a HighGrowth.io client.

• Translate our outbound sales playbook into practical hiring, onboarding, metrics, and performance systems for the client.

• Directly manage offshore dialers and salespeople, maintaining accountability through scorecards and simple performance rhythms.

• Run performance reviews with the client team, assess progress, and work with the HighGrowth.io founder to adjust strategy as needed.

• Work closely with our founder on non-client-facing founder priorities: process upgrades, internal projects, and playbook refinements.

• Keep implementation projects organized, including timelines, deliverables, handoffs, and documentation.

• Coordinate meetings, reporting, and other lightweight activities that keep delivery running smoothly.

We’re Looking For Someone Who Has

• Four-plus years of outbound B2B sales management experience, as a leader or coach.

• Strong operational discipline: you like metrics, routines, and making performance visible.

• Confidence running multiple workstreams without dropping details.

• A founder-friendly mindset: proactive, structured, reliable, and comfortable with fast shifts.

This is a full-time, remote role. Your work hours will need to overlap with 9am to 4pm US Eastern Time.
We rely heavily on Apple devices, applications, and services. You should have a post-2021 Mac for this job.

Salary: $2,000 – $3,000 / month Originally posted on Himalayas

postings.title: V107 - Billing and Collection Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
For ambitious, culturally diverse, curious minds seeking booming careers, Job Duck unlocks and nurtures your potential. We connect you with rewarding, remote job opportunities with US-based employers who recognize and appreciate your skills, allowing you to not just survive but thrive.
As a lifestyle company, we ensure that everybody working here has a fantastic time, which is why we’ve earned the Great Place to Work Certification every year since 2022!

Job Description:
The Billing Specialist is the person who walks beside the client through
the financial side of the hardest experience of their life. You are their guide. You help them understand where their money is going, why it matters, and how every dollar they invest connects to the outcome they're working toward for themselves and their family. You are part of their walk, connecting their payment to their goal.

Teaching people how to use the service, showing them the value of what their legal team is doing, and making the financial side of their case feel manageable instead of terrifying. When you do that well, collections happen naturally. Clients who feel informed and cared for pay.

The people who thrive in this role are someone who genuinely likes people and is energized, organized without being rigid, and does not wait to

be told what needs to happen,

• Compensation Range: 1,015 USD to 1,100 USD

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

• When a client says they cannot pay, walk through every available option: credit cards, personal loans, family support, employer assistance, legal fee financing programs. Explore before you accept.

• When attorneys communicate retainer reductions or billing pauses, document the instruction in Clio at the matter level the same day.

• Flag any matter below the trust threshold to the assigned attorney the same day.

• Within five (5) business days of a new client retaining the firm, deliver a billing tutorial covering retainer structure, evergreen replenishment, invoice format, and what to expect at each stage of their case.

• Maintain accounts receivable below 2% of total billings.

• Lead every collections conversation with a brief case update: what was accomplished, what is upcoming, how the work moves the client closer to their goal. Then address the balance.

• Log every billing complaint in the tracker with a documented timestamp and route it to the responsible attorney via email.

• Keep Trust Accounts Funded and Clients Informed

• Provide specific dollar ranges for upcoming cost events, so the client is never surprised.

• Produce a weekly deliverable every Friday: complaints resolved this week and

complaints still awaiting attorney response.

• Check attorney calendars for upcoming hearings, mediations, and trials. Initiate

additional retainer requests.

• Call every client before sending a replenishment request. No replenishment email goes out without a phone call attempt.

• Confirm all credits, write-offs, and billing holds in writing before any related bill is finalized.

Requirements:

• 2+ years in billing, collections, or accounts receivable in a professional services environment. Law firm experience strongly preferred.

• Comfort with outbound phone calls and client-facing conversations.

• Proficiency with practice management software (Clio Manage preferred)

• Ability to read and interpret legal invoices, time entries, trust account statements, and engagement agreements.

• Strong written communication for documented escalations, client correspondence, and weekly deliverables.

• Proficiency with Google Workspace (Gmail, Sheets, Calendar, Drive).

• Prior use of LawPay, Dialpad, or Clio Grow.

postings.title: Senior Business Architect
postings.descriptionText:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role:

We're seeking a Senior Business Architect (Canada) for ACCC: someone who can go deep on brokerage operations across accounts, trading, clearing, settlement, custody, and asset servicing, and can turn that operating knowledge into clear requirements and turn that into clear requirements Product and Engineering can build.

You are the bridge between how the Canadian brokerage actually works and the product roadmap. You lead structured discovery with counterparts and work out how partner firms, account opening, clearing, custody, and day-to-day operations fit together, then write that down as epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, edge cases, and open decisions.

Success is measured by: requirements and designs teams can build without guessing; a clear split between what the system does and what people still do at launch; solution options that Product and Engineering can sequence; and a backlog tied to ACCC milestones and capabilities.

What You'll Walk Into

You won't be starting from zero. You'll be owning live problems:

• Operations scope: defining what ACCC must support across accounts, trading, clearing, settlement, custody, books and records, and asset servicing.

• Partner firm handoffs: what partners send us, what we send back, and who does what across accounts, trades, cash, and securities.

• Account and trade lifecycle: account opening, settlement in Canada through CDS, failed trades, transfers, and corporate actions such as dividends and splits.

• Platform gap analysis: comparing today's Alpaca platform with Canadian brokerage operations requirements to decide what we reuse, change, or build.

• Launch scope: separating what must work on day one from what follows, including registered accounts (TFSA, RRSP, RESP), more products, and more partner services.

• Open decisions: logging each one with an owner so it gets closed or consciously deferred.

What you’ll own

Requirements across ACCC’s brokerage operations, and what comes next:

• Map brokerage operations end to end across these areas: broker onboarding, account carrying, trade clearing/settlement, custody of cash/securities, books & records, financing (if in scope), corporate actions, transfers, exceptions, and reporting

• Help define target operating models and capability designs: what the platform must do, what stays manual (for now), what is control vs. feature, what is Canada-specific vs. reusable globally

• Turn regulatory and operational obligations into product requirements: what the platform must do, what stays manual (for now), what is control vs. feature, what is Canada-specific vs. reusable globally

• Write epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and edge cases that Product and Engineering can build against.

• Produce the artifacts teams actually use: process maps, capability matrices, requirement specs, data/field definitions, state machines, exception catalogs, RACI for build vs. run, and decision logs

• Work with Product Managers and Engineering to sequence MVP → launch → scale: must-haves for go-live vs. post-launch backlog across these operating areas (e.g. additional account types, asset classes, IB services, automation)

• Interface across Product, Engineering, Ops, and Compliance: translate business need into buildable scope; escalate open decisions with clear owners and options

• Run structured discovery: workshops, SME interviews, gap analysis vs. current Alpaca platform, peer operating models where useful

• Keep requirements automation- and AI-aware : flag where STP, rules, and AI-assisted exception handling should be designed in—not bolted on later

• Flag where straight-through processing, rules, and AI-assisted exception handling should be designed from the start.

• Maintain a living requirements backlog tied to ACCC milestones, risks, and open decisions

Who you are (Must-Haves)

• Excited about what Alpaca is building and about standing up Canadian brokerage operations.

• Comfortable operating as a senior IC reporting to the President — driving clarity across Product, Engineering, Ops, and Compliance without needing a formal team.

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, finance, or equivalent.

• 8+ years as a business architect, business analyst, consultant or in product operations within brokerage, clearing, custody, or capital markets.

• Comfortable translating brokerage operating processes and regulatory requirements into product language (you don’t need to be a lawyer or CCO)

• Strong structured analysis: flows, entities, states, exceptions, controls, and what breaks if a step is missing.

• Clear writing: specs, diagrams, and decisions others can execute against.

• Collaborative with Ops SMEs, PMs, Engineering, and Compliance; curious enough to dig; disciplined enough to close loops

• Bias to precision over vague “requirements fluff”; you know when something is a product change vs. an ops procedure vs. a policy decision

• Judgment to tell a product change from an operating procedure or a policy decision.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills across operations, product, engineering, and compliance.

Who you might be (Nice-to-Haves)

• Experience on a carrying, self-clearing, or custody build.

• Canadian dealer, carrying broker, or introducing broker experience.

• Prior business architecture or enterprise/solution architecture exposure in capital markets

• Familiarity with CDS or Canadian settlement workflows.

• Experience with registered accounts or Canadian tax requirements (TFSA, RRSP, RESP).

• Background with API or platform brokerage products.

• Experience working at a fintech, startup, or greenfield launch.

• AI-native workflow: recurring use of tools like Cursor, Claude, or ChatGPT in spec drafting, discovery synthesis, and gap analysis.

• Experience shaping greenfield capability roadmaps with executive sponsors

How We Take Care of You:

• Competitive Salary & Stock Options

• Health Benefits

• New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500

• Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.

postings.descriptionText:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role:

As a Staff Software Engineer, you will be responsible for architecting, designing, and implementing the systems and services that form Alpaca's foundation and empower millions of users who trade billions of dollars worth of assets. You will serve as a technical leader with extensive influence that goes beyond the immediate team to affect the entire product's technical direction. You will be the founding technical lead for Singapore and the broader SEA region: leading regional recruitment, leading cross-functional projects, mentoring talent on our engineering principles and practices, and fostering Alpaca culture in the region. As the lead, you will also serve as the operational reliability and engineering lead and the incident commander during regional business hours, ensuring proactive 24x7 stability.

For this role, we are seeking a backend engineer who has built the middle- and back-office systems that are a broker-dealer's system of record — customer account management and KYC, pre-trade controls such as buying-power validation, post-trade processing, double-entry ledgers and books-and-records, clearing and settlement, custody, corporate actions, reconciliation, and regulatory reporting — for a firm serving end investors. This is not a front-office trading-systems role: experience limited to sell-side market-making, low-latency/high-frequency execution, quantitative trading strategy, or exchange-side trading infrastructure is not sufficient on its own. The ideal candidate has a track record of architecting solutions that span multiple products or services, acts as a mentor and consultant providing strategic technical insights, and can take a platform into new markets repeatedly as Alpaca expands across SEA.

Things You Get To Do:

•
Architect and design highly scalable, mission-critical brokerage systems spanning multiple products or services.

•
Develop and enhance middle- and back-office systems, including gRPC microservices, APIs, and third-party vendor integrations.

•
Build customer account/PII systems, KYC/CDD/AML controls, and pre-trade multi-currency buying-power and margin engines.

•
Partner with core teams to extend frameworks for regional languages, currencies, and regulations, starting with Singapore and expanding to SEA markets.

•
Provide strategic technical insights and mentor engineers to shape the long-term engineering roadmap and foster technical growth.

•
Lead cross-functional projects and establish engineering standards, code review practices, and decision-making frameworks.

•
Serve as incident commander and operational reliability lead during regional business hours to ensure proactive 24/7 stability.

•
Participate in on-call rotations and ensure timely response to production issues.

•
Attend meetings held during Singapore business hours and occasional meetings with teams in other regions (including Japan, US, and EU).

•
Lead technical integrations and recruitment for market launches, engaging with regional stakeholders and regulators like the MAS.

Who You Are (Must-Haves):

•
Business-level English fluency, with the ability to collaborate effectively in English-only team meetings, design discussions, code reviews, and written documentation.

•
Extensive hands-on experience building broker-dealer middle- and back-office systems of record (clearing, settlement, custody, corporate actions, reconciliation) serving end investors rather than trading desks.

•
Proven track record architecting and developing complex financial systems grounded in a double-entry ledger and books-and-records model.

•
Deep experience engineering customer account management infrastructure with sensitive PII handling, alongside KYC/CDD/AML and sanctions screening across the full account lifecycle.

•
Demonstrated experience implementing pre-trade risk and eligibility controls, including real-time multi-currency buying-power calculation, margin requirements, and order validation.

•
Advanced proficiency in Go or similar modern backend languages, with extensive production experience designing high-throughput REST and gRPC microservices.

•
Deep architectural background in domain-driven design (DDD) and event-driven distributed systems for high-availability financial applications.

•
Thorough familiarity with Singapore regulatory requirements (MAS, Securities and Futures Act, MAS Notice SFA04-N02 on AML/CFT) and broader Southeast Asian financial markets.

•
Working knowledge of regional data protection laws and compliance standards for sensitive client data, specifically the Singapore PDPA.

•
Proven ability to balance hands-on architecture with leadership, mentoring engineers, driving technical decisions, and shaping roadmaps beyond the immediate team.

•
Ability to lead and troubleshoot incidents or bugs with authority during Singapore business hours.

Who You Might Be (Nice-To-Haves):

•
Residence in Singapore

•
Experience launching products in multiple SEA markets (e.g., Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, Vietnam, Philippines)

•
Proficiency in an additional regional language (e.g., Mandarin, Bahasa Indonesia/Malay, Thai, Vietnamese)

•
Experience working in a startup or fast-growing technology company

•
Experience managing vendors and organizational budgeting

•
Experience with microservices, service mesh, and distributed systems at scale; cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, Azure) and Kubernetes

postings.title: Strategic Enterprise Business Development
postings.descriptionText:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Strategic Enterprise Business Development to our Sales Development team in Buenos Aires !

The Strategic Enterprise Business Development drives pipeline growth and new business generation within an assigned prospecting territory with a high level of autonomy. This role manages the end-to-end outbound and inbound cycle, running deep qualifying and discovery-level conversations to uncover strategic corporate pain points, map decision-makers, and communicate complex value propositions compellingly. Beyond consistently achieving monthly qualified-meeting quotas and maintaining rigorous CRM, the Representative analyzes personal performance data to inform short-term territory planning and to propose optimization strategies for the broader team's outreach cadences.

YOUR IMPACT

• Own a prospecting territory within the ICP universe: build account lists owned by SOPs, prioritize by strategic fit, and run high-quality outbound sequences independently.

• Qualify accounts at depth: validate company HR challenges, decision-maker map, timing, and budget potential before booking the AE meeting.

• Conduct discovery-level conversations to surface corporate wellness pain points and position Wellhub's value proposition compellingly.

• Maintain pipeline hygiene in Salesforce: accurate contact records, opportunity stage, and activity logs at all times.

• Consistently achieve monthly qualified-meeting quota and contribute to team pipeline goal. Identify and propose improvements to outbound cadences or ICP targeting based on personal prospecting data; share winning approaches with the team.

• Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE

• 3+ years of experience in outbound prospecting, business development, or sales for large/complex Strategic accounts.

• Previous experience with CRM & sales-engagement tools (Salesforce, Salesloft/Outreach); comfort directing AI-assisted outreach; LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

• Experience with the Argentinian and Latam Market is mandatory.

• Fluent English — you’ll interact with global teams and resources.

• A true team player who loves collaborating to reach ambitious goals.

• Organized and self-motivated — you can handle multiple priorities in a fast-growing organization.

• Coachable, curious, and always seeking to learn and improve.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore whether you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience with the Argentinian market, outbound prospecting, and with sales tech stack like CRM, AI, and Sales Navigator are mandatory requirements .

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

HEALTHCARE: Health and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a home office equipment reimbursement and a monthly work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive a minimum of 25 days off per year with an additional day for each year of tenure (up to 5) in addition to annual holidays (including an extra holiday on your birthday!)

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here.

Want to see what it’s really like to work here? Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on YouTube !

Wellhub was named a Top Sales Team of 2025!
This is a recognition of the collaboration and impact we create together every day. Ready to be part of a team that’s making a real difference? Read more about the award here.

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We’re proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. Read more about it here.

Caylent is an AI-first cloud services company that helps organizations turn ambitious ideas into meaningful business impact. As an AWS Premier Tier Services Partner and a charter member of Anthropic’s Claude Partner Network, we combine deep expertise in AWS, artificial intelligence, and Anthropic’s Claude platform to help customers modernize their technology, build intelligent products, and move AI from experimentation into production.

Our capabilities span generative and agentic AI, cloud migration and modernization, cloud-native application development, data and analytics, DevOps, managed services, security and compliance, and customer experience transformation. At Caylent, our people always come first.

We are a fully remote global company with employees in Canada, the United States and Latin America. We celebrate the culture of each of our team members and foster a community of technological curiosity. Come talk to us to learn more about what it means to be a Caylien!

The Mission

We are seeking a talented Senior IT Engineer to join our growing internal IT team. The right candidate is a highly motivated individual who thrives in a dynamic environment and is passionate about delivering innovative, top-notch IT support and infrastructure solutions.

Your mission will be to support and maintain our IT pipeline, strategy, infrastructure, and processes, while identifying and analyzing gaps in key processes to develop effective solutions. As a Senior IT Engineer, you’ll be tasked with managing and monitoring IT issues and requests, ensuring timely troubleshooting and resolution, while providing exemplary service. You will also play a crucial role in the implementation of IT projects, contributing to the design and deployment of new systems and services. You’ll work with the latest tech resources and with technologically-seasoned teammates who are eager to share valuable insights for growth.

Your Assignment

• Manage IT support tickets for internal employees, which includes troubleshooting and fixing issues related to internal IT infrastructure.

• Lead implementation of IT projects, including the design and deployment of new IT systems and services.

• Monitor performance of SaaS and IT solutions to make recommendations for improving overall IT infrastructure.

• Support and maintain IT infrastructure strategy, architecture, and process.

• Analyze gaps in key processes to help develop solutions for IT needs.

• Assist with strategies for improving existing IT infrastructure, including testing and optimizing new and existing hardware and software.

Soft Skills

postings.title: Product Manager - Remote, Latin America
postings.descriptionText:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.

What we are looking for
• 5+ years of experience as a Product Manager/Product Owner.

• Strong background in utilizing metrics, OKRs, and KPIs to drive decision-making and measure product success.

• Strong knowledge of the process involved in building SaaS products.

• Familiarity with Agile Software development methodologies and practices.

• Product Support Knowledge – understand the importance and process of evaluating and prioritizing product support issues to a development team.

• Project/Outsource Management Knowledge – understand the process of successful project management to meet deliverables on time and on budget.

• Product Management Knowledge – understand the product management processes, including requirements gathering and user story writing.

• Experience in the overall architecture of software applications for products and solutions.

• Experience with contemporary SDLC tools similar to our adopted choices of Jira, GitHub, Travis CI, Zendesk, etc.

• Excellent Communicator – Able to facilitate meetings and present findings clearly, articulating with stakeholders to obtain buy-in. Collaborates with the internal team and with the business.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

• Product / User Interface Design Skills – working knowledge of best practices from human factors and usability perspective a plus.

• Zeal to pursue perfection from yourself, your customer(s), your team, and your product.

• Energetic with a good, positive attitude. Quick learner and excellent team player.

• Forensic attention to detail.

Company Benefits
• Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.

• Generous paid-time-off policy

• Flexible working hours

• Work remotely

• Continuing education, training, conferences

• Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.
You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!
If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

postings.title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager (Remote LATAM or US)
postings.descriptionText:
Hi, I'm Joe, Head of Customer Success at Whippy. I'm hiring an entrepreneurial Enterprise Customer Success Manager to retain and grow a dedicated book of customers.

This role is for someone with 5+ years of experience. You'll own a focused book of our largest and most complex accounts, where a single customer can be worth six figures in ARR and involve executives, recruiters, and operations teams across many branches.

 


WHY I'M HIRING

At Whippy, we view Customer Success as a revenue engine, not a cost center, because if customers don't get value from a tool, they'll leave. Whippy has six incredible products today because we've always built alongside our customers. That's how we evolved from a simple texting platform to now powering calls, texts, email, AI agents, and complex messaging and business automations for over 1,000 businesses. We ship fast to meet our customers' needs.

Most customers start with one use case, like a staffing firm using an AI voice agent to screen candidates. They stay and grow because they see real ROI, then expand use cases until Whippy becomes the infrastructure their business runs on. Your job is to drive that growth: make their first outcome happen during onboarding and implementation, uncover the next problem, and help them get even more value.

In this role, you'll mainly work with customers in the staffing industry. Their data flows into Whippy from their ATS, most often TempWorks, Avionte, Aqore/Zenople, Crelate, or Bullhorn, so you'll learn how staffing firms recruit and place talent, and how to build on top of their data.

Our customer success team has taken staffing customers from an initial $12K deal to $180K ARR because customers like Your Employment Solutions https://www.linkedin.com/company/your-employment-solutions/ are getting over $1M in ROI using Whippy to augment their teams and beat the competition.

You'll help us grow more customers by deeply understanding their desired outcomes, helping them achieve those outcomes, and providing an exceptional experience along the way.

This is one of those rare jobs with massive growth and learning opportunities: there's no bureaucracy here, and we're still early in building a world-class customer success team. You'll have a crucial role to play, and fresh ideas, feedback, and experimentation are always encouraged because we double down on wins and quickly pivot when ideas don't work out.

You'll work alongside our six-person customer success team and report directly to me. I'll provide the support, coaching, tools, and data to do the best work of your career here, plus the variable comp to get well rewarded when you deliver results.

I'm looking for someone who wants to be technical, strategic, and commercial, all in one. Technical as in you enjoy mastering the product and finding the best solutions for our customers. Strategic as in you deeply understand your customers' pain points and always have a plan to solve them. Commercial as in you have pricing awareness and understand the retention and expansion risks and opportunities in your book.

 


SOME THINGS YOU'LL DO

 - Own a book of business end to end, from onboarding through renewal and expansion, as the single point of contact and trusted advisor.

 - Run a proactive cadence on every account: prepared calls, clear agendas, mutual success plans, and follow-through.

 - Become a product and customer expert. Master Whippy's products and know your customers' business well enough to build the workflows, AI agents, and automations that solve their problems.

 - Run multi-stakeholder relationships across executives, recruiters, and operations teams at our largest customers, with account plans to match.

 - Pick up the phone. Reach out proactively, ask the question instead of guessing, and get ahead of problems before they turn into escalations.

 - Own your gross and net revenue retention, and get rewarded for beating targets.

 - Tie usage to business outcomes, and report value back in the metrics customers actually care about.

 - Spot expansion signals and hand warm leads to sales when usage outgrows the contract.

 - Turn wins into case studies, references, and testimonials that help sales win the next customer.

 - Tell customers the truth, steering them away from work that won't move their business and toward the work that will.

 - Advocate for the customer. Feed what you hear to product, sales, and engineering so we build the right things.

 - Experiment and iterate. If you have an idea to do something better, do it and document what you learn.

 


OUR CUSTOMER SUCCESS VALUES

This is a high-performance environment, and I'll coach and support you through it. You'll be challenged, coached, and you'll always know where you stand. CS is a team sport, so it's okay to ask for help, experiment, fail, and pivot. A few things that are true here:

 - Everyone is a builder. Our team builds in the product without engineering, and the best product ideas come from you, the person closest to the customer. We use AI to move fast, but we own our work, verify every fact, and don't ship slop.

 - We lead with expertise, not order-taking. We get curious about the why behind every request, and we say no when no is the right answer.

 - We work like owners, not clock-watchers. We care about outcomes, not hours. We take initiative, pick up the phone, and work obsessively on the problem in front of us.

 - CS is a revenue engine, not a cost center. We treat it as the growth engine of the company and pay for results.

 


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Communication above all. This is the number one predictor of success in this role. You overcommunicate by default with customers, your team, and me. You're clear in writing and on calls, you set expectations, and you never leave people guessing.

 - Fast and proactive. You process information quickly, ask for what you need instead of waiting, and show up to every call prepared.

 - Curious, coachable, and low-ego. You're a fast learner who wants feedback, digs into the why behind every request, and gets better quickly.

 - Comfortable getting technical. You don't need to code, but you're the kind of person who enjoys taking a tool apart, figuring out how it works, and building something useful with it.

 - Strategic and commercial. You see usage and growth, not just tickets, and you're comfortable owning a number and an upgrade conversation.

 - Opinionated about customer experience. Good strategic advice needs well-formed views, so have them.

 - Self-directed. You take initiative, stay organized without being told, and run your own book without anyone managing your calendar. Calm under pressure.

 - 5+ years in customer success or account management at a technical SaaS product, including owning large accounts with multiple stakeholders and significant revenue on the line. If your path is unconventional and you can explain how it'll help you succeed in this role, I welcome you to apply.

 - Bonus points for experience in the staffing industry or with TempWorks, Avionte, Aqore/Zenople, Crelate, or Bullhorn.

 - Based in Latin America or the US, with fluent written and spoken English, and able to work Eastern hours (we start at 8am ET).

 


YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF...

 - You're technical and love to build.

 - You're entrepreneurial. You treat your accounts like your own business and get energy from building from scratch.

 - You're a consultative problem solver. You dig into the why behind what a customer asks and recommend the right solution, even when it's not the one they came in asking for.

 - This sounds like fun to you: a customer wants to launch a complex, time-sensitive campaign across calls and texts, isn't sure how to structure it, and their team is stretched thin. You roll up your sleeves, map their goal to the product, and build it with them.

 - You thrive in a fast, evolving startup and you're excited to help build a customer success program from the ground up.

 


ABOUT WHIPPY

Whippy is a communication, automation, and AI agent platform. You reach customers across calls, texts, and email, at scale through personalized blasts and automated drips, with every message landing in one shared inbox. Replies get auto-assigned to a teammate, picked up by an AI agent, or carried forward by an automation. Once a conversation wraps, Whippy pushes the data you care about back into your systems in the exact format you need. It's true two-way dialogue on every channel that cuts the repetitive work and frees teams to focus on the human work that drives revenue, without adding headcount.

We're industry agnostic, with our biggest wins so far in staffing, healthcare, and other in-person businesses going through digital transformations. We're bootstrapped, profitable, and growing fast, with over 1,000 businesses using Whippy worldwide. In staffing alone, we've helped firms cut screening costs by 95% and save over a million dollars a year.

Whippy was founded in 2021 by CEO David Daneshgar and CTO Jack Kennedy. Jack is an engineering machine and a marathon runner. David started BloomNation in 2011 after winning $27,205 in a poker tournament, grew it into a platform generating billions in sales for florists, then left to build something bigger with Jack.

 

Location

This is a remote role open to candidates based anywhere in Latin America or the US. Our workday starts at 8am ET, so you'll need to work Eastern hours.

 

Compensation

Competitive compensation based on experience, including monthly performance bonuses and more.

 

Hiring Process

 1. Apply with a Loom video. The Loom is required. Applications without one won't be considered.

 2. A 30-minute call with me to get to know each other better.

 3. A 30-minute call with our CEO, David.

postings.descriptionText:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
But that’s just the beginning:
Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
We’re looking for a detail-oriented Junior Analyst to support our Legal and Compliance team. In this role, you will work with internal teams and external stakeholders to provide accurate, timely, and compliant responses to legal and regulatory requests pertaining to asset recovery inquiries. This position provides a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience at the intersection of law, compliance, investigations, and blockchain technology.
You will thrive in this role if you enjoy analyzing complex cases, managing multiple priorities, collaborating across teams, and continuously learning in a fast-paced, global environment.

Responsibilities

• Case Intake & Triage: Verify the authenticity and completeness of asset recovery requests, assign them to the appropriate team, and track deadlines for timely resolution.

• Collaboration & Risk Management: Work closely with internal teams and external stakeholders to progress cases, identify risks, and escalate complex issues when needed.

• Legal & Investigative Analysis: Synthesize findings, prepare recommendations for management, and oversee implementation of approved decisions.

• Documentation & Compliance: Maintain thorough case records, communication trails, and ensure adherence to internal and regulatory protocols.

• Regulatory Awareness: Stay updated on developments in digital asset regulations (e.g., stablecoins) and support updates to internal processes and cross-border compliance activities.

• Bachelor’s degree in Law, Legal Studies, Compliance, Finance, or a related field.

• 1–3 years of experience in legal, compliance, or investigative roles.

• Solid understanding of AML/KYC, sanctions compliance, and digital asset regulations.

• Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to manage multiple tasks.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in investigations, asset recovery, or legal casework.

• Exposure to regulatory authorities, prosecutors, or law enforcement agencies.

• Familiarity with international legal frameworks, cross-border compliance, and digital asset regulations.

• Knowledge of blockchain analytics or compliance technology is a plus.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.
