Senior Designer

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Designer to create thoughtful, visually compelling digital experiences and campaigns for a global sports brand. This role combines strong design craft, digital expertise, and independent creative thinking, helping translate brand ideas and business objectives into polished, cohesive experiences across digital touchpoints.

You’ll work closely with Creative Directors, designers, strategists, copywriters, UX, technology, production, and account teams to develop work from early concepts through final execution. You’ll bring a strong point of view to the work, contribute meaningfully to creative direction, and take ownership of design projects while collaborating closely with the broader team.

The ideal candidate is an accomplished designer with excellent visual judgment, strong digital and UI sensibility, and a high level of craft. You’re comfortable taking a design problem from a blank page to a polished solution, presenting your thinking to clients and internal teams, giving and receiving thoughtful feedback, and getting hands-on in Figma to bring ideas to life. You’re curious about emerging technologies, AI, culture, and new approaches to design, and you’re interested in how they can expand what’s possible creatively.

Responsibilities:

• Develop high-quality visual concepts and design solutions across digital campaigns, websites, mobile experiences, e-commerce, products, and other digital touchpoints.

• Translate creative briefs, brand strategy, business objectives, and creative direction into clear, compelling visual solutions.

• Take ownership of design projects from initial exploration and concept development through refinement, prototyping, and final delivery.

• Establish a strong visual point of view and contribute to the overall creative direction of assigned projects.

• Apply a high level of craft across typography, composition, hierarchy, layout, color, imagery, interaction, and digital storytelling.

• Create polished designs and prototypes in Figma, working across responsive layouts, components, interactions, and digital experiences.

• Explore multiple creative approaches to a problem, knowing when to push an idea further and when to refine and simplify.

• Collaborate with Creative Directors and other designers to develop work that is strategically grounded, visually distinctive, and appropriate to the brand.

• Partner with strategy, copy, account, UX, technology, production, and other disciplines to develop integrated creative solutions.

• Participate actively in brainstorms, design critiques, creative reviews, workshops, and collaborative working sessions.

• Respond to feedback and evolving project requirements while maintaining the integrity and quality of the design.

• Design within established brand systems while also identifying opportunities to evolve visual language and create new expressions of the brand.

• Work with existing design systems, component libraries, and digital guidelines, contributing improvements when appropriate.

• Consider usability, accessibility, performance, scalability, localization, translation, and technical constraints throughout the design process.

• Collaborate with developers and production teams to ensure design intent is accurately translated into final experiences.

• Provide thoughtful feedback and informal mentorship to more junior designers, helping strengthen their design thinking, craft, and attention to detail.

• Stay informed about contemporary design, digital experiences, visual culture, technology, and emerging creative trends.

• Contribute to a collaborative, curious, and high-performing design culture.

About You

The essentials:

• 5+ years of experience in digital design, visual design, art direction, or a related creative discipline.

• A strong portfolio demonstrating sophisticated design craft, visual thinking, and high-quality digital work across multiple channels and formats.

• Demonstrated experience taking digital design projects from concept through final execution.

• Strong proficiency in Figma, including hands-on experience with visual design, prototyping, responsive layouts, and component-based design.

• Advanced understanding of design fundamentals, including typography, grid, hierarchy, composition, layout, color, imagery, interaction, and visual storytelling.

• Strong digital and UI sensibility, with an understanding of UX principles and the ability to create experiences that are both visually compelling and intuitive.

• Experience translating brand identities and creative direction into cohesive digital experiences.

• Strong conceptual thinking and the ability to develop multiple creative approaches in response to a brief or business challenge.

• Demonstrated ability to work independently, make sound design decisions, and take ownership of projects with appropriate creative guidance.

• Ability to balance creative ambition with practical considerations including usability, accessibility, technical requirements, timelines, and production constraints.

• Experience working closely with multidisciplinary teams, including creative, strategy, UX, copy, technology, production, and account.

• Strong presentation and communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate design decisions and creative rationale to both creative and non-creative audiences.

• Ability to give and receive constructive feedback and use critique to strengthen the work.

• Experience collaborating with developers and production partners to bring digital designs through implementation.

• Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and evolving project requirements.

• Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

• Hands-on experience with AI tools or emerging technologies as part of the creative and design process.

• Strong cultural curiosity and an informed perspective on contemporary design, technology, digital behavior, and visual culture.

• Collaborative, low-ego approach with a genuine interest in contributing to the growth and quality of the broader design team.

Not a must, but a plus:

• Experience working with athletic, apparel, footwear, fashion, lifestyle, retail, or other culturally relevant consumer brands.

• Experience designing for large-scale global brands and complex digital ecosystems.

• Experience working across e-commerce, product launches, seasonal campaigns, and high-traffic consumer digital experiences.

• Experience using AI beyond image generation, including AI-assisted prototyping, code, or emerging creative workflows and automation.

• Experience with motion design, 3D, WebGL, or other forms of interactive design.

• Experience developing or governing enterprise-scale design systems.

Overview

We are looking for a highly analytical Senior Specialist, FP&A who thrives at the intersection of Corporate Finance, Strategic Analysis, and Data Engineering. In this role, you will report numbers and will be the strategic voice that interprets them.

You will bridge the gap between complex financial processes and executive decision-making. Your mission is to maintain a robust global financial data pipeline while providing deep-dive analyses that help stakeholders understand the "why" behind the results.

Key Responsibilities

• Strategic Reporting & Analysis: Lead the month-end closing analysis, providing clear commentary on variances (Actuals vs. Budget/Forecast). You will transform raw data into executive-level reports that highlight trends, risks, and opportunities for the NAMER and Global regions.

• Stakeholder Management: Act as a key finance partner for Regional Directors and Department Heads. You will translate complex technical logic and financial data into actionable insights, helping non-finance leaders manage their budgets and headcount effectively.

• P&L Architecture & Profitability: Build and optimize multi-dimensional P&L reporting. You will analyze profitability down to the Client and Departmental level, ensuring that global allocations and intercompany markups are both accurate and strategically aligned.

• Systems Integration & Automation: Develop and maintain API connections (Workday, Salesforce, Greenhouse) to automate data flow.

• Data Ingestion & SQL Modeling: Architect complex SQL queries within BigQuery to consolidate global data. You will ensure that the "Actuals vs. Forecast" reconciliations are seamless and require minimal manual intervention.

• Process Integrity & Governance: Act as the final gatekeeper for data accuracy. You will identify logic errors or "noise" in financial models before they reach executive reviews, ensuring 100% confidence in the numbers presented to the CFO.

Technical & Professional Requirements

• Finance Foundations: Advanced understanding of P&L structures, Budgeting/Forecasting cycles, and the nuances between Management and Statutory reporting.

• Data Engineering & Scripting: Proficiency in SQL (BigQuery) is essential. Experience with Python or Javascript/Apps Script for API handling and workflow automation is highly valued.

• BI & Visualization: Proven track record of designing executive dashboards in Looker Studio (or similar) that drive strategic decision-making.

• Systems Expertise: Familiarity with ERPs ( Netsuite/Lucanet ) and CRM/HRIS tools ( Salesforce, Workday, Greenhouse ).

• Advanced English.

Who We Are:

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A day in the life:

This role focuses on delivering high-quality audience analyses to support new business appraisals. You will gain an understanding of the business and goals to identify the target audience including behavior, preferences, and trends. These insights will be used to inform planning, targeting, and creative strategies for campaigns. You play a critical role in the Power Digital new business process and will work collaboratively across multiple teams. Overview


📍 Remote Global - Central and South America

 

We are seeking a WFM Central - Real Time Analyst to serve as the central governance layer for live operations across multiple Lines of Business (LoB). This is not a traditional monitoring role; it is designed for a high-caliber, forensic operator who functions as an operational architect. You will be a trusted partner to operational leadership, responsible for continuing to evolve our operations to a standardized, and fiscally sound control model.


The ideal candidate possesses the technical "know-how" of a forensic analyst and the communication prowess of a business consultant, capable of telling a compelling story through data to stakeholders ranging from Team Leads to Directors. You won't just report that a queue is at risk; you will diagnose the business impact, identify the root cause, and prescribe the specific levers leadership must pull to preserve SLA and the customer experience. You will be the owner of all aspects of the support queues and ensure we are meeting our customers where they need us.


Responsibilities

 - Stakeholder Storytelling: Distill complex, "noisy" operational signals into high-impact narratives. You must be able to share in-depth observations and supporting data that tell a clear story to stakeholders, at all levels of leadership, on exactly what actions must be taken.

 - Business-Level Analysis: Go beyond the "what" and the "why" to analyze long-term business trends. Evaluate the financial efficiency of SLA safeguarding and the fiscal impact of current staffing vs. demand density.

 - Operational Control & Forensic Auditing: Serve as the authoritative "voice of reason" during incidents. Conduct forensic audits of agent behaviors such as "On Hold" abuse or status irregularities to ensure hidden capacity drains are eliminated.

 - Centralized Core Governance: Enact queue management playbooks for real-time levers across multiple LoBs, ensuring aggressive SLAs are preserved through structured accountability.

 - Strategic Planning & Optimization: Partner with WFM to create a concise feedback loop for continued improvement in planning and scheduling.


Qualifications

 - Exceptional Communication: Proven ability to translate complex data into a clear jargon-free business story. You must be comfortable presenting actionable insights to senior leadership under high-pressure conditions.

 - Advanced Forensic Analysis: Expert proficiency in Google Sheets is required, familiarity with Metabase preferred. You must be able to build complex, automated tracking tools and forensic audits from scratch. Not just for basic queue health, but also analyzing business data that influences our operations.

 - Strategic Judgment: Demonstrated experience making high-judgment decisions that impact the entire business, particularly in environments with aggressive SLAs and fluctuating volume patterns.

 - Operational Architecture: Take ownership in documenting best practices into governed frameworks and playbooks.

 - Resilient Mindset: Comfortable operating autonomously in a 24/7 environment, with the flexibility to adapt to operational needs as part of a high-impact, interdependent team.

 - Systems Fluency: Familiarity with Amazon Connect, Zendesk Omnichannel routing, and Assembled WFM is highly preferred.


What Success Looks Like

 - Operational anomalies are quickly investigated, with root causes clearly identified and communicated, reducing repeat issues and leadership uncertainty

 - You evolve queue management processes from reactive to a documented, standardized, and predictive operating model.

 - Champion of the team’s brand with Operational Leadership. You are looked to as the primary source of truth, relying on your data-driven stories to make critical staffing and operational decisions.

 - Live queues remain stable, governed, and resilient across all supported lines of business, even during unexpected spikes, outages, or incidents

 - Stakeholders receive timely, clear updates during incidents that explain impact, cause, and corrective actions in a concise and actionable manner.

Who We Are
At Jobsity , we believe great talent should not be limited by geography.
Jobsity is a nearshore staffing partner that connects leading U.S. companies with top talent in Latin America for software engineering, contact center operations, and BPO services. Our footprint spans over 20 countries across the Americas, and we deliver fully integrated, enterprise-ready teams.
From scaling specialized tech infrastructure to delivering bilingual front-line customer service, Jobsity provides an all-in-one staffing solution including recruitment, onboarding, payroll, compliance, and more.

Why Work With Jobsity

We match standout professionals across Latin America with high-impact opportunities at leading U.S. companies. Joining Jobsity is about finding a rewarding remote role and working with innovative teams. It also means you get to become part of a community that values your experience, supports your ambition, and invests in your ongoing professional growth.
Whether you are looking for your next challenge, seeking greater flexibility, or ready to elevate your career, Jobsity gives you the platform and partnership to thrive on your terms.

Job Description
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to build and maintain production applications in Go, Python or Node.js on AWS, working closely with the Tech Lead and the infrastructure/DevOps teams. You will troubleshoot issues directly in the codebase, contribute to CI/CD pipelines and deployments, and use Terraform day to day to author, modify and maintain the infrastructure behind those applications.

Responsibilities

• Develop and maintain production applications (Go, Python or Node.js).

• Troubleshoot application and deployment issues directly in the codebase.

• Author and maintain Terraform configuration for the infrastructure that supports the applications.

• Create and modify Terraform modules and reusable variable-driven configurations.

• Implement infrastructure changes with Terraform and apply them safely in production environments.

• Manage Terraform state, including state migrations when required.

• Troubleshoot and update Terraform-managed infrastructure when requirements change.

• Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and application deployments on AWS.

• Work with containerized, cloud-native applications.

• Collaborate with infrastructure/DevOps teams to support reliable, available and resilient deployments.

• Work closely with the Tech Lead on technical decisions, and contribute to (but not own) the broader multi-region architecture.

Key Requirements

• Strong software development experience, with production applications built in Go, Python or Node.js.

•
Practical, hands-on, day-to-day Terraform experience, including:

• Authoring Terraform configuration, not only consuming existing infrastructure.

• Implementing infrastructure changes with Terraform.

• Managing infrastructure as code in production environments.

•
Creating or modifying Terraform modules.

• Working with variables and reusable infrastructure configurations.

• Maintaining existing Terraform-managed infrastructure.

• Troubleshooting and updating Terraform configurations when infrastructure changes are required.

• Understanding how Terraform changes are applied and managed in a real production environment.

What We Offer
At Jobsity , we know that a positive professional experience goes beyond the role itself.
Depending on the position, client, country, and type of contract, professionals may have access to different benefits, programs, and resources designed to support their well-being, development, and remote-work experience.

These may include:

● Paid time off or vacation days
● Paid holidays, depending on the client and country
● Professional development and learning opportunities
● Ongoing support from our People Experience team
● Recognition initiatives and internal activities

● Remote-work flexibility
● Opportunities to collaborate with international teams
● Access to tools and resources that support your work
● Career growth opportunities based on performance, business needs, and available roles
Because each opportunity is different, the specific benefits associated with a position will always be communicated during the recruitment process.

postings.title: Full-Stack Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
About Onfleet

Onfleet 's mission is to power the future of commerce by enabling businesses of all sizes to move goods more efficiently and delightfully. Our product includes intuitive smartphone apps for drivers, a powerful modern web application and dashboard for logistics teams, and automatic notifications and real-time tracking for recipients. Onfleet powers millions of deliveries every week for thousands of businesses around the world across a range of industries, from grocery and prepared meals to pharmacy, flowers, and furniture.

About the role

Onfleet is hiring a Full-Stack Engineer based in Latin America or Canada to join one of our cross-functional teams as we build out our Orchestration capabilities. You'll be a core contributor across new feature development, architectural improvements, and system integrations. Your work will span our core platforms, APIs, webhooks, and other integration surfaces, evolving courier and orchestration functionality, and improving internal tooling and developer experience.

The majority of backend work is in Node.js, with a growing Rust codebase in our newer projects. Front-end work is in React, with a mix of JavaScript and TypeScript. You'll work across a blend of greenfield development and continual, thoughtful development and refinement of existing systems: creating high-quality, well-tested code, contributing to a healthy Scrum cadence, and helping tame legacy complexity by putting code under test, isolating change boundaries, and simplifying tangled implementations.

Everyone on the team owns quality. Automated tests are part of our Definition of Done, and nothing goes to production without being well reviewed by humans and AI agents. If you bring deeper testing or automation experience, that is a real advantage in this seat and we will put it to work, but it is not a prerequisite.

If you have strong Computer Science fundamentals, care deeply about quality and craft, and bring a scrutinizing, questioning mindset, we'd love to hear from you.

How we work

Our engineers combine Computer Science fundamentals with a principled approach to software development that sets a high bar for quality. We're pragmatic, quality-driven, and deliberate about the tools and practices we adopt.

We code using agents, and nearly 100% of our code is written this way. Success here takes a scrutinizing, questioning mindset: the engineers who thrive are the ones who avoid slop, catch the wrong call before it ships, and drive quality and the right engineering choices forward. Generating code is the easy part; knowing what good looks like, and holding the bar, is the job. To be successful in this role you will need enough expertise in the languages we use to challenge both the code an agent writes and the architecture it proposes.

We also expect every engineer to be an active contributor to how we work, not just a consumer of existing workflows. Improving our agentic workflows, orchestration, and tooling is a core part of the role; we're always looking for ways to raise the team's quality and efficiency, and that's expected from everyone. Desire and excitement for the application of AI to software development are critical to this role. We are seeking candidates who want to work in and maintain leading-edge agentic workflows, and stay there as the models and tools evolve.

What you'll do

• Build and continually improve your own agentic development workflow, and help raise the team's. This goes far beyond prompting for code: we use AI across the whole path, from PRDs to technical specs, epics, and tickets, into development plans, and finally into high-quality code with thorough unit and integration tests.

• Drive quality through disciplined verification and both agentic and human code review, on your own code and your teammates'. Extend our agentic review tooling as you go, and hold the bar on what gets merged.

• Apply your agentic workflow in both greenfield and legacy code, meeting the different challenges each presents.

• Design and implement high-quality, scalable software in parallel with the tests that validate it.

• Drive and show ownership of features end to end: research/planning, design, implementation, validation, deployment and monitoring in production.

• Continuously refactor and simplify code to improve clarity, maintainability, and long-term system health, including making hard-to-reach code testable.

• Develop and refine our APIs, webhooks, and other integration surfaces.

• Work in a healthy Agile/Scrum cadence: reliable estimates, proactive and clear communication, and follow-through on commitments.

• Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues, including participation in the on-call rotation.

• Collaborate with product and cross-functional partners to prioritize features and bug fixes, and lift the people around you through pairing, thorough reviews, and writing things down.

What you'll bring (required)

•
A scrutinizing, questioning mindset: you don't accept output, your own or an agent's, at face value, and you surface problems early. You’re open and honest when you see a problem, and seek opportunities to help all of us improve.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience, and strong CS fundamentals: data structures, database fundamentals, API design, testing, and an instinct for clean, maintainable code.

• Front-end and back-end experience, having shipped multiple features that cross the full application stack from ideation to production use by real customers.

• Automated testing experience across unit, integration, and end-to-end layers, including hands-on experience with a browser or end-to-end framework such as Playwright or Selenium.

• 4 or more years of hands-on professional software engineering experience building, shipping, and operating production-quality, reliable systems.

• At least 3 years of professional experience in our core stack: Node.js and React, in TypeScript or JavaScript.

• Experience with creating software using disciplined agentic flows, from prompt-instructing to complete development orchestrations.

• Excellent written and spoken English. You can work entirely in English on a distributed team, explain complex technical ideas clearly, and write docs and code reviews your teammates rely on. This is roughly equivalent to a C1 level of English.

Nice to have

Especially valuable for this seat. We don't require these, but candidates who bring them will stand out from the crowd.

• Prior experience building comprehensive automated test suites, going beyond testing your own tickets to building coverage a team relied on. Bonus points for having worked as a Software Developer in Test (SDET).

• Hands-on CI ownership: you have created, configured, fine-tuned, or troubleshot a CI pipeline (GitHub Actions or equivalent), not just consumed one that someone else built.

• Test-Driven Development (TDD) experience.

• Experience with test data and environment management: getting a realistic system into a known state quickly and repeatably.

• Experience with a statically typed, compiled language other than TypeScript, for example Rust, Go, Java, C#, or C++.

• Deeper front-end specialization in React, for example design systems, accessibility, or performance work.

• Familiarity with cloud service design patterns and modern software architecture.

• Familiarity with AWS and cloud-native services; microservices and containerization.

• Proficiency with NoSQL and other modern data-storage technologies.

• Experience working remotely as part of an international team whose common working language is English, collaborating day-to-day with teammates in other countries.

Location and Benefits

• This is a remote role, open only to candidates based in Latin America or Canada.

•
Onfleet offers flexible work arrangements; you can work from home or anywhere with a reliable internet connection.

• The team works on US Pacific Time. You'll need to reliably work a schedule that frequently matches US Pacific business hours (9am–5pm PT).

• Flexible PTO

• Laptop and work-from-home setup stipend

• Monthly technology stipends (internet and AI tooling)

Onfleet is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Onfleet 's culture is one that strongly values diversity in its workplace and we are committed to working with potential team members who can bring diverse perspectives and experience to our company and culture.

We do not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, sex, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other basis protected by applicable local, state or federal law.

We highly encourage members of underrepresented groups to apply and we will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is $60K USD to $80K USD per year, depending on experience, skills, and background. Where an offer lands within that range reflects the engineering level and the depth of experience a candidate brings to the role.

How we hire

You need an identity-verified LinkedIn profile to apply. That's the free "Verified" badge, the shield icon next to your name. We check for it, and applications without it don't move forward.

Before any offer, we verify your identity and work history. That includes a live video ID check and reference calls. We use AI, automated systems, and a person to review applications: every application that meets the requirements is also read by an engineering leader or a recruiter. If you misrepresent your identity or experience, the process ends.

About the role:

The role is centered on engineering quality at runtime level, including startup behavior, memory pressure, throughput/latency balance, and long-session stability. You will define and evolve the core abstractions that inference features depend on, so new capabilities can be added without sacrificing performance or maintainability. This is a role for someone who enjoys low-level problem solving, clear technical ownership, and building infrastructure that other teams trust in production. Your work directly enables private, on-device AI experiences and helps set the technical foundation for QVAC's next generation of peer-to-peer AI products.

Your focus is on the runtime: making models load faster, run leaner, and perform well across different hardware. You'll ensure that the inference layer is stable, optimized, and ready for integration with the rest of the stack.
This role is for engineers who want to work close to the metal, enabling private and fast on-device AI without relying on cloud infrastructure.

You have productionized models

Javascript experience

Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

Stand.earth is seeking a Research Manager to play a key role in Stand.earth campaigns and research projects. If you are passionate about Stand.earth's mission, like taking on big challenges, and have a depth and breadth of experience in investigative research, then read on! This might be the perfect role for you.

You will be joining an international team of strategists, negotiators, campaigners, and activists that achieves outsized results and is bursting with creativity, innovation, and untapped potential.

We encourage applicants to apply by Monday, November 30th, 2026. This position is open until filled.

About Stand.earth

Stand.earth is a nonprofit environmental organization working to create a world where respect for people and the environment comes first. Our campaigns challenge destructive corporate and governmental practices, demand accountability, and create solutions that support all of us — and the environment and climate upon which we depend. Stand’s strategic approach and fierce determination have yielded extraordinary results: Since 2000, we’ve secured the protection of millions of acres of wilderness, shifted billions of dollars of corporate purchasing toward responsible options, and transformed the environmental practices of more than 100 major U.S. corporations. Stand.earth operates in the United States and Canada.

Stand recognizes and respects the sovereignty of First Nations and tribes, and the rights of Indigenous Peoples and frontline communities. These communities are often first and most directly impacted by environmental pollution and climate change, and they provide critical leadership in developing solutions.

Pollution, climate change, and corporations’ bad behavior disproportionately hurts the most marginalized people in society — including people of colour, people from working-class backgrounds, people with disabilities, women, and LGBTQ+ people. To develop transformative solutions, these communities must be centered in the work we do. Hence, we strongly encourage applications from people with these identities or who are members of other historically marginalized communities. If you require assistance applying to this opportunity, please contact .

The Position

The Research Manager is responsible for conducting comprehensive research on a variety of topics related to Stand’s work. This includes designing research plans, collecting and analyzing data, writing reports, and drafting data visualizations. The ideal candidate has deep experience in relevant research fields and a passion for holding governments and corporations accountable for their impacts on climate and the environment.

This is a full-time position. Salary is commensurate with experience and location, and will likely be within the range of $87,000 - $99,450 USD or $100,050 - $114,367.5 CAD. Stand.earth offers a generous and comprehensive benefits package including excellent health and dental insurance, 4 weeks paid vacation in the first year (increases in future years), 20 paid holidays, 4-day workweek, and a 3-month paid sabbatical after 7 years of continuous full-time employment. We also encourage employees to make use of our mindfulness sessions and professional development training opportunities that we offer. All staff can expect to travel periodically for in-person team meetings, retreats, and work events.

The location for this position is fully remote in the Americas, with a preference for working hours compatible with Pacific to Eastern time zones. There is an option of working out of our Bellingham, Washington, Vancouver, British Columbia, or Toronto, Ontario office if you are located in one of those cities.

Responsibilities

•
Conduct complex research and investigations: Managing projects from concept to execution, collaborating with stakeholders and proactively addressing emerging issues and opportunities.

•
Clearly articulate research findings in written and visual formats: Producing high-quality analysis briefs, written reports, and data visualizations using in-house tools or custom solutions. A solid track record of publishing complex research findings in accessible ways.

•
Explore new innovative ways to conduct research and investigations: Proactively engage with the latest methodologies and innovations relevant to Stand’s work and champion new experiments within the team.

•
Communicate with clients, partners and allies: Including scoping out research questions, building relationships, presenting findings and suggesting new areas for research.

•
Support profile building for Stand’s research work: Producing blogs, email content, presentations, and other assets used in funding pitches and across marketing. Actively championing Stand in relevant networks and collaborating with the team on building the team’s profile.

Required Skills and Qualifications

• A master’s degree with 6+ years, or a Bachelor's degree with 8+ years, of related research experience

• Experience in managing research projects, reviewing academic literature, integrating complex datasets, and translating findings into evidence-based conservation strategies.

• Natural inclination for innovation and for lateral and creative thinking

• Passion for learning new things

• Familiarity with one or more of the following focus areas: deforestation-driver commodities, oil and gas, supply chains, data centers, financial markets, and the environmental and social impacts of natural resources extraction.

• A highly organized work style and incredible attention to detail.

• Commitment to Stand.earth’s principles of equity, authentic communication, and continual learning

• Top-notch writing, editing, and spoken communication skills

• Excellent time management

• Ability​ ​and​ ​willingness​ ​to​ ​travel

Desired, but not required

• Experience with research extension, including supporting Indigenous advocacy and responding to research needs from frontline communities.

• Experience working or volunteering on issues of climate, environmental protection and/or environmental justice.

• Additional language skills, particularly a working knowledge of a second language, are highly desirable.

• Experience with GIS and spatial data analysis.

postings.title: Remote Cybersecurity Consultant
postings.descriptionText:
Category: IT Services

Location:

This is a hands-on role. We are not looking for someone to only advise us and leave the work to our team: you will do a large part of the security work yourself, working inside our repositories, pipelines and cloud accounts alongside our engineers. You will configure tools, fix and harden things, write the processes and documents, and run the sessions, while showing our team how it is done along the way.

Our goal is a company that runs a secure development lifecycle on every project, has its own house in order, is well on the way to ISO/IEC 27001 certification, and has an internal Security Lead who can work with you and gradually take over day-to-day ownership. This is a part-time role.

Responsibilities

Assessment and governance

• Run the security maturity assessment yourself (for example OWASP SAMM), review our repositories, pipelines and cloud setup, and turn the findings into a prioritized roadmap.

• Write our core security policies and procedures: access control, acceptable use, secure development, incident response, vendor and AI tool usage.

• Set up and maintain the security backlog, risk register and progress metrics, and report progress to management monthly.

Company security ("secure the house")

• Configure and enforce SSO and MFA across email, Git hosting, cloud consoles, CI/CD and Passbolt.

• Review and fix access rights, and set up onboarding and offboarding checklists.

• Harden our Passbolt setup and implement a secrets manager for applications and pipelines, including migrating existing secrets out of code and CI variables.

• Implement baseline hardening for laptops, cloud accounts, backups and logging.

• Write the incident response plan and run tabletop exercises with the team.

Secure software development

• Build our standard Secure SDLC, based on OWASP ASVS and OWASP SAMM, and roll it out on real client projects.

• Configure and tune our SecOps platform: reduce false positives, set up pipeline quality gates and triage findings together with the teams.

• Add the missing scanning to our CI/CD pipelines yourself: SAST, SCA, secrets scanning, IaC and container scanning, DAST and SBOM generation.

• Run threat modeling sessions on active projects and document the results.

• Do security code reviews of high-risk changes and help developers fix vulnerabilities.

• Perform internal security testing of our applications before releases, and scope and coordinate external penetration tests.

Regulation and compliance

• Map how the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), NIS2 and relevant local regulations affect us and our clients.

• Write and implement our vulnerability handling and disclosure process, including support for clients' CRA reporting obligations.

• Do the hands-on ISO/IEC 27001 preparation work: scope, risk assessment, Statement of Applicability, policies and evidence, and work with the certification body.

Client offering

• Help define security service tiers we can include in client proposals.

• Fill in client security questionnaires and build a reusable answer set.

• Join selected client meetings or calls as a senior security voice when needed.

People and knowledge

• Work side by side with our internal Security Lead so they learn by doing.

• Run short internal workshops on key topics (for example OWASP Top 10, threat modeling, secure CI/CD).

• Recommend training and certification paths for developers, Security Champions and DevOps engineers.

Requirements

Must have

• 8+ years of experience in information security, with recent hands-on work in application security, DevSecOps or cloud security.

• Comfortable doing the work yourself: configuring security tools, writing pipeline configuration, reviewing code, testing applications and writing policies.

• Practical experience setting up a secure development lifecycle and integrating security tools into CI/CD pipelines.

• Good knowledge of cloud security in at least one major cloud (AWS, Azure or GCP).

• Ability to explain security risks in plain language to both engineers and management.

• Fluent English, written and spoken.

• Kubernetes and container security experience.

• Knowledge of security risks in AI and LLM-based applications.

Nice to have

• Experience with the EU Cyber Resilience Act, NIS2 and GDPR in a software vendor or supplier context.

• Experience building security offerings for clients in an agency or outsourcing environment.

• Experience implementing or auditing ISO/IEC 27001 (or a comparable framework such as SOC 2).

Certifications (one or more preferred)

• Hands-on certifications such as OSCP, BSCP, CDP or CKS

• ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor

• Cloud security certification (AWS Security Specialty, AZ-500 or Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer)

• CISSP, CISM or CSSLP

The Secret Ingredients That Make Us Special:

• Your growth is our growth. We invest in your future with paid training and other professional opportunities.

• We're industry innovators at the forefront of change. Equipped with the latest technologies and a team of knowledgeable colleagues by your side, you'll embrace new and interesting challenges.

• Your location. Your schedule. Pick your time zone, choose your preferred hours, and work from the place where you feel most at home.

• Flexibility and freedom are in our DNA! As long as you have a stable internet connection and the drive to thrive, you can travel and work from anywhere you like.

• A workload you can rely on. We'll set you enough tasks to keep that mind busy! At Scopic , we'll ensure you always have a consistent flow of engaging, challenging work to do.

• Recognition and reward. We acknowledge diligence and hard work through annual pay increases for good performance.

Down to Business!

• Your starting rate is negotiable depending on your skills and experience.

• This is an hourly paid position.

• Contractors are paid monthly via wire transfer.

Our Values:

Scopic is an equal-opportunity employer. We value diversity and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, marital status, national origin, gender, veteran status, sexual orientation, age, or disability status.

Have the skills, the drive, and the passion to join the Scopic family? Apply today to join our growing team of remote professionals from around the world.

Terms of Application

By submitting an application:

• I consent that the data provided in this form, and the attached CV, will be used for Scopic 's recruiting purposes and email communications.

• I consent to Scopic conducting an identity verification process as part of the hiring process. I understand that my personal information may be collected and processed for the purpose of verifying my identity in compliance with applicable laws.

This hands-on technical leadership role will turn ambiguous business needs into reliable product capabilities, establish practical standards for agentic development, and influence technical direction across teams. The position is remote within the Americas.

In this role, a typical day will look like:

• Shape the AI roadmap with product and engineering leaders, make architectural decisions, resolve cross-team dependencies, and connect technical choices to measurable business value.

• Lead hands-on development of agents, tool integrations, retrieval systems, and AI-enabled workflows connected to enterprise APIs and data, from discovery and prototyping through deployment, monitoring, and improvement.

• Design evaluation datasets, baselines, and controlled experiments that measure quality, reliability, latency, cost, and user outcomes, then use the evidence to decide what to scale, revise, or stop.

• Establish repeatable agentic software development practices, shared tooling, reference architectures, and deployment patterns for evaluation, versioning, observability, staged releases, rollback, security, privacy, and incident response.

• Mentor engineers through design and code reviews, documentation, and training on AI-assisted development, generated-code validation, test coverage, maintainability, and responsible human oversight.

• Partner with engineering, legal, compliance, and security leaders to manage AI economics, translate relevant regulations and standards into engineering practices, and implement responsible AI controls and audit evidence.

The essential requirements of the job include:

• Substantial experience delivering production software, including technical leadership across teams and ownership of complex initiatives from architecture through ongoing operation.

• Hands-on experience building and operating LLM-based and agentic systems, including tool use, orchestration, retrieval, evaluation, and agentic harnesses.

• Strong software engineering expertise in API and system design, data modeling, automated testing, code review, CI/CD, observability, and secure development, with production proficiency in Python or C#.

• Experience deploying cloud services and integrating enterprise APIs and data while managing reliability, security, performance, and operating cost.

• Bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical field or equivalent practical experience, plus the ability to travel occasionally for department meetings, company events, seminars, or networking events.

It would be a plus if you also possess:

• Experience delivering AI-enabled enterprise SaaS products, particularly on Microsoft Azure.

• Experience creating shared AI platforms, evaluation infrastructure, or internal developer tooling used by multiple teams.

• Familiarity with enterprise data governance and compliance requirements; food, beverage, or supplements industry experience is a plus.

Why you’ll want to join us:
TraceGains offers a fully remote work environment, flexible paid time off available on your date of hire, comprehensive health and welfare benefits, paid parental leave, a 401(k) plan with company match, company-paid volunteer days, and opportunities to grow your career and advance from within.

TraceGains is proud to be part of the Product Quality & Innovation segment of Veralto (NYSE: VLTO), a global leader dedicated to ensuring access to clean water, safe food and medicine, and trusted essential goods. When you join Veralto’s global network, you join a culture where purpose meets possibility and where your work has an everyday impact on the resources and essentials we all rely on. Together, we’re Safeguarding the World’s Most Vital Resources™ and building rewarding careers along the way.

TraceGains provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment based on any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. Employment is subject to applicable work authorization and background-screening requirements.

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, and medical/dental/vision insurance to eligible employees.

The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, benefits, or any other form of compensation and benefits that are allowable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole discretion, consistent with the law.

Virtual interviews may be transcribed using an AI-enabled note-taking tool to assist with interview documentation. Hiring decisions are made by human interviewers.

This position is for a new role within our team.
At Veralto, we value diversity and the existence of similarities and differences, both visible and not, found in our workforce, workplace and throughout the markets we serve.Our associates, customers and shareholders contribute unique and different perspectives as a result of these diverse attributes.

About Pearl Talent

Pearl works with the top 1% of candidates from around the world and connects them with the best startups in the US and EU. Our clients have raised over $5B in aggregate and are backed by companies like OpenAI, a16z, and Founders Fund.
Hear why we exist, what we believe in, and who we’re building for: Watch here

About the Client
A healthcare technology company that builds AI-powered workflow software for independent neurology practices is looking for a Clinical Referral Coordinator to own the review and qualification of incoming patient referrals.
Founded in 2023, the company supports 7 neurology practices and more than 140 providers. Its platform automates about 80% of referral processing. The remaining cases need a trained reviewer who can read clinical documents and apply each practice’s rules accurately.

About the Role
Day-to-day, you will review referrals in the company’s internal system, read clinical notes and imaging reports, and decide whether each referral is accepted, needs more information, or is denied. You will also call patients to schedule approved appointments and collect missing information. A co-founder reviews every decision during your ramp. Success means qualifying 50–60% of straightforward referrals on your own by day 30 and handling the full queue independently by day 90.

Core Responsibilities

Clinical Referral Qualification

• Review incoming neurology referrals and decide to accept, request more information, or deny based on practice-specific rules

• Read multi-page clinical documents, including MRI reports, prior neurologist notes, and primary care summaries, to find details that change a decision

• Confirm all required documents are present before a referral moves to scheduling

• Record the rationale for every decision in the internal comments field

Patient Communication & Scheduling

• Call patients to schedule appointments once referrals are approved

• Contact patients or referring offices to collect missing clinical or insurance information

• Log call outcomes and follow-ups in the referral system

Quality & Ramp

• Qualify 50–60% of straightforward referrals independently within the first 30 days

• Apply feedback from full decision review to reduce errors through day 90

• Escalate unclear or edge-case referrals before making a decision

• Learn and apply new qualification rules as additional practices are onboarded

Requirements

Must-Have

• 2+ years in a healthcare operations role with clinical document review in scope (referral coordination, prior authorization, utilization review, or medical records review)

• Hands-on review of multi-page clinical documents, including physician notes, specialist assessments, and MRI or imaging reports

• Experience applying clinical or practice-specific criteria to accept, deny, or request more information on referrals or authorizations

• Working knowledge of medical terminology, including telling document types apart (e.g., imaging report vs. imaging order)

• Outbound patient call experience for appointment scheduling or collecting missing information

• Experience supporting US-based healthcare providers, practices, or health systems

• English at C1+ (CEFR) for live, unscripted calls with US patients

Nice-to-Have

• Neurology or other complex specialty referral experience (oncology, multi-specialty)

• Athena Health EHR, or another named US EMR such as Epic or eClinicalWorks

• Healthcare BPO background serving US specialty or multi-specialty practices

• Experience working with automated or AI-assisted intake or referral systems

Benefits

• Competitive Salary: Based on experience and skills

• Remote Work: Fully remote—work from anywhere

• Team Incentives: Recognition for maintaining 100% CRM hygiene and on-time reporting

• Generous PTO: In accordance with company policy

• Health Coverage for PH-based talents: HMO coverage after 3 months for full-time employees

• Direct Mentorship: Guidance from international industry experts

• Learning & Development: Ongoing access to resources for professional growth

• Global Networking: Connect with professionals worldwide

Our Recruitment Process

• Application

• Screening

• Skills Assessment

• Topgrading Interview

• Client Interview

• Job Offer

• Client Onboarding

Ready to Join Us?
If you’re empathetic, organized, and passionate about improving patient experiences through operational excellence, this role is for you. Apply now to help make specialized healthcare more accessible to patients across the U.S.

OPSWAT , a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.

Why This Role Matters
At OPSWAT , protecting the world’s critical infrastructure is real, urgent, and growing. MetaDefender Managed File Transfer (MFT) is a security-first MFT platform trusted by customers in finance, life sciences, government, and critical infrastructure to move sensitive files safely across IT and OT environments. We are now ready to take MFT to the next level and win against established MFT vendors. As a member of OPSWAT ’s product leadership team, you will help set company-level product strategy, influence investment decisions across the portfolio, and be accountable for
the business performance of MFT. This Senior Director role is a rare opportunity to shape the future of MFT, including a next-generation MFT Gateway and a lightweight automation offering, while scaling commercial impact and deepening customer value. You will operate at the intersection of product strategy, engineering execution, and go-to-market success, with clear ownership and visible impact. It is also a chance to redefine what product management looks like in the AI era. We are not looking for someone who talks about AI. We want a leader who already uses it every day to work faster and smarter, and who can build a team of PMs that does the same. If you are energized by building, innovating, and owning outcomes, this role was designed for you.

As Senior Director of Product Management, MFT, you will be the executive owner of MFT’s product strategy,
business performance, and growth trajectory. You will:

team operates:

• Use AI to compress the path from customer signal to shipped feature: synthesizing customer calls, support tickets, win/loss data, and competitive intel into clear insights in hours, not weeks.

more time with customers and engineers.

• Prototype workflows and UI concepts with AI to validate ideas with customers before engineering commits.

• Build AI-assisted competitive and market analysis so the team always knows where MFT wins and why.

• Identify where AI belongs inside the product itself, from intelligent automation and anomaly detection to policy recommendations and natural-language administration.

• Define practical guardrails for using AI safely in a security company, protecting customer data and IP.

Grow and Lead a Team of PMs
You will build and develop a high-performing product team as MFT grows:

• Hire, coach, and grow product managers across regions, raising the bar on product judgment, customer empathy, and execution.

• Create a clear career path and a culture of ownership, where PMs own outcomes, not just backlogs.

• Establish lightweight, repeatable product processes for discovery, prioritization, and launch that scale with
the business.

• Make every PM on the team AI-fluent through hands-on enablement, shared playbooks, and leading by
example.Develop future product leaders who can take on new product lines as OPSWAT grows.

What Success Looks Like
In your first 12–18 months, success will look like:

• A clear, compelling MFT roadmap aligned to market demand and customer value.

• Measurable growth in bookings and pipeline tied directly to product strategy.

• Competitive wins displacing legacy MFT solutions in strategic accounts.

• Strong, trust-based partnerships with Engineering and GTM teams.

• Delivery of the MFT Gateway and automation offerings that position MFT for long-term growth.

• An AI-native product team with measurably faster discovery, documentation, and release cycles.

• A growing, engaged team of PMs with clear ownership and visible development.

• AI-powered capabilities in the MFT roadmap that customers value and competitors lack.

• A product organization that moves with urgency, clarity, and accountability.

• Recognition as a trusted executive voice for MFT inside OPSWAT and across the market.

Who You Are

• Deep, hands-on experience using AI in your daily product work, and a clear point of view on how AI changes the PM role. Be ready to show us how you use it.

• Familiarity with the competitive MFT landscape and the compliance needs of regulated industries.

• A track record of partnering effectively with Engineering to deliver complex products.

• Executive presence, with clear, confident communication and the ability to influence peers, executives, and customers at the C-level.

Why OPSWAT ?
OPSWAT is a fast-growing cybersecurity company with a strong culture of ownership and innovation. We build products that matter, support leaders who take initiative, and invest in those who want to grow. In this role, you will:

• Own a revenue-generating product with a large market and meaningful runway.

About Seamless Assist

Seamless Assist is a US recruiting agency based in Bellevue, Washington. We recruit local onsite and remote talent for US healthcare employers, and we place AI-fluent virtual assistants with growing businesses.
Healthcare is a core focus. For one multi-site US cardiology group, we have placed about 21 people: registered nurses, care coordinators, care and patient navigators, chronic care management and remote patient monitoring staff, a pharmacist, and a program director — most of them in local, onsite roles.
We interview every candidate ourselves before an employer ever sees them. That standard is at the core of what you will be selling.

The role
You will be the person who brings new healthcare employers to Seamless Assist . You will find US employers with open roles, start the conversation, sell them on us as their recruiting agency, and win their job orders — for both local onsite roles and remote roles.
This is a high-activity outbound role. You will build your own lead lists and work them every day with cold calls, email and text follow-up, and LinkedIn. Once you win a job order, you run the discovery call, capture exactly what the employer needs, and brief our recruiting team. Then you stay the employer's point of contact through to placement.
You will report directly to our Founder & CEO. Our recruiting team handles sourcing and screening, so you can focus on selling.

What you will do

Generate leads

• Build target lists of US healthcare employers hiring nurses, care coordinators, navigators, care management staff, pharmacists and clinical leaders

• Reach the people who own hiring: practice administrators, directors of nursing, HR and talent leaders, operations and program directors

Reach out — calls, email and text

• Make cold calls every day and follow up every warm lead by phone

• Run email sequences in Apollo and text message follow-up through our CRM

• Run LinkedIn outreach through Sales Navigator

• Write outreach that sounds like a person, not a template

Sell and close

• Show employers what we have already delivered for healthcare clients

• Handle objections and negotiate fee agreements within approved terms

• Where it fits, also offer our remote VA and medical admin talent

Run discovery and brief the recruiting team

• Lead discovery calls to capture every detail of each role — duties, onsite or remote, licensure, systems, schedule, pay, must-haves and why it has been hard to fill

• Turn each call into a clear written brief our recruiters can act on right away

Own the account

• Stay the employer's single point of contact from job order to start date

• Relay feedback on candidates quickly so searches stay on track

• Grow each account — the next opening, the next location, the next department

• Track your activity and pipeline in our CRM and send a short weekly update to the Founder & CEO

What you bring

Required

• 3+ years in sales or business development at a US recruiting or staffing agency, winning job orders from employers

• Experience selling recruiting or staffing services to US healthcare employers

• Proven sales results — quota attainment, job orders won and revenue closed, with numbers you can share and a former manager who can confirm them

• Strong outbound skills — daily cold calling, email sequences and text outreach

• Working knowledge of US healthcare roles and the basics of state licensure and credentialing

• Experience running discovery calls and turning them into clear written requirements

• Hands-on experience with Apollo.io and LinkedIn Sales Navigator

• Daily AI tool user (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) for research, outreach and writing — be ready to show us how

• Excellent written and spoken English, and confident on calls with US decision-makers

• Able to work US business hours, Pacific Time, full-time

Nice to have

• Background at a US healthcare staffing agency — permanent placement, travel nursing, per diem or allied health

• Familiarity with chronic care management or remote patient monitoring programs

• Knowledge of agency fee models — contingency, retained, contract and contract-to-hire

• Experience with GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Bullhorn or Manatal

• HIPAA basics

• Startup or fast-moving remote team experience

You will thrive here if you

• Love the phone and build pipeline from nothing

• Take rejection in stride and keep dialing

• Ask sharp questions before you pitch

• Sweat the details so recruiters never chase the wrong profile

• Own your numbers and speak up early when something is off

Your first 90 days

•
Day 30: set up in our tools, know our track record and the roles we fill, target lists built, outreach running, first discovery calls held

•
Day 60: discovery calls every week, first job orders won and briefed to the recruiting team

•
Day 90: a steady flow of job orders across local and remote roles, repeat business from at least one employer, and your first placement in sight

Why join

• Uncapped commission — your results drive your earnings

• Fully remote

• A recruiting team behind you that handles sourcing and screening

How to apply
Apply through this posting. Upload your resume and include a short note (under 150 words) covering:

• The recruiting or staffing agency you sold for, and the US healthcare employers you sold to

postings.title: GEO Expert - Hybrid
postings.descriptionText:
Clara is the leading platform in Latin America for companies to execute and manage every payment operation. More than 50,000 leading and fast-growing businesses run on our corporate cards, bill pay, financing and B2B payments, and in 2025 the Financial Times named Clara the region’s fastest-growing company. We’re passionate about helping every company we work with become more effective—and, through that, raising the region’s competitiveness. We’re ~400 people, backed by Notable Capital, Coatue, Kaszek, monashees, DST Global, ICONIQ, General Catalyst and Goldman Sachs, among others.

GEO Expert

Location: Mexico, Brasil, Colombia or Argentina

What you'll do

The way people find companies is changing: search is increasingly a conversation with an LLM. You'll own how Clara shows up in that conversation, making sure Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and other AI engines surface Clara accurately and favorably when people ask about corporate cards, bill pay, or spend management in LatAm. You'll work alongside our website and SEO team to build this function from the ground up, using AI not just as a research aid but as the core engine of how you build, test, and ship.

Your responsibilities

• Own GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) for clara.com and other sites: how our content, structure, and data get cited, summarized, and recommended by AI search and answer engines.

• Audit how Clara currently appears (or doesn't) across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and other LLM-powered search surfaces, and build a baseline to measure against.

• Design and run experiments: structured data, content formatting, citation-worthy page design, llms.txt-style approaches, and other emerging GEO tactics, then measure what actually moves the needle.

• Build AI agents and automated pipelines to do this at scale: automated citation and brand-mention tracking across LLM engines, agents that audit and rewrite content for machine readability, and automation tools (n8n, Make, Zapier, or similar) that turn one-off tasks into repeatable systems.

• Use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, v0, or similar) to build your own tooling: scrapers, dashboards, scoring scripts, or internal apps that track GEO performance.

• Use AI daily as your core workflow: prompting LLMs to audit how they currently see Clara, orchestrating multi-step agent workflows for content analysis, and generating or restructuring content at scale, not just using AI to speed up manual work.

• Build growth-hacking style tests, fast, scrappy, and quantified, to find what earns visibility in AI answers before best practices are established industry-wide.

• Create benchmarks and reporting that show leadership what's working, so we can judge whether this function should grow, ideally through a self-serve dashboard you build yourself.

• Stay ahead of a field that changes monthly: new engines, new ranking signals, new agent frameworks, and new ways AI models decide what to cite.

Must haves

• Experience optimizing a website or content for search, whether traditional SEO, content growth hacking, or early GEO work, with a track record of experiments that moved real metrics (traffic, rankings, citations, qualified leads).

• Real AI-building experience , not just prompting: you've built agents, automations, or pipelines (n8n, Make, Zapier, custom scripts, or AI coding tools) that do real work without you in the loop every time.

• Active, daily use of AI tools as part of your real workflow: using LLMs to research, test hypotheses, audit content, and build at speed.

• Analytical: comfortable setting up your own tracking, reading results honestly, and killing tests that don't work.

• Creative: this field has no playbook yet. You'll generate hypotheses nobody has tried, not just apply someone else's checklist.

• Able to move fast and scrappy: this is a new, unproven function, and you're building the process as you go.

• Comfortable communicating results and tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to haves

• Engineering background or comfort with code: structured data (schema.org), working with APIs, or writing your own scripts and tools. Not mandatory, but a real advantage in a field this technical.

• Experience with AI agent frameworks or orchestration (multi-step agents, MCP-based workflows, custom GPTs, or similar).

• Experience with llms.txt, structured data, or other emerging standards for AI-readable content.

• Experience building programmatic content pipelines (content generated and published at scale via automation).

• Traditional SEO experience (technical SEO, content strategy, link building) as a foundation to build GEO on top of.

• Fintech, payments, or B2B SaaS experience.

• Fluency in more than one of Spanish, Portuguese, or English, given the multi-market, multi-language nature of clara.com.

Why Clara

• A high talent-density team driven to make an impact in Latin America — low ego, high ownership.

• Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one.

• An annual learning budget and accelerated development paths.

• English is our working language, with Spanish and Portuguese every day.

How we work

• Clarity — Open and direct communication: we say what we mean and give context where it matters.

• Simplicity — If it can be simpler, it should be.

• Ownership — We own everything we do, end to end. When something needs to happen, we don't wait.

• Pride — We hold ourselves to a high standard, and it shows in what we deliver.

• ABC (Always Be Changing) — We adapt fast, embrace change, and keep learning.

• Inclusivity — Diverse ideas, stories and perspectives build a better Clara.

If you meet the must-haves, apply — the nice-to-haves are a bonus, not a requirement.

postings.title: Grupo QuintoAndar I Sr Revenue and Pricing Management Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
Acerca del Grupo QuintoAndar

Somos el Grupo QuintoAndar, el ecosistema inmobiliario más grande de América Latina . Guiados por el propósito de ayudar a las personas a amar el lugar donde viven , creamos tecnología y soluciones que simplifican toda la experiencia de la vivienda, desde el alquiler hasta la compra y venta.

Estamos presentes en 6 países (Brasil, México, Argentina, Perú, Ecuador y Panamá) y contamos con un hub de tecnología en Portugal , reuniendo a más de 3.100 personas unidas por el desafío de transformar el sector. Con el respaldo de inversionistas globales como SoftBank, General Atlantic y Kaszek, hemos levantado más de US$ 755 millones y hoy somos una compañía valuada en US$ 5,1 mil millones .

Lideramos la transformación del mercado siendo pioneros en la aplicación de Inteligencia Artificial a gran escala en el sector inmobiliario. Nuestras plataformas suman más de 50 millones de visitas al mes, administrando más de 350 mil contratos de alquiler activos y movilizando R$ 20 mil millones al año.

Si buscas resolver problemas complejos con autonomía, tecnología de punta e impacto a gran escala, adelante, estás en tu casa.

Para conocer más sobre nuestra historia, ingresa a: grupoquintoandar.com/es/

Ubicación y Modelo de Trabajo

Nuestro equipo de Estrategia trabaja bajo el modelo “híbrido”, siendo necesario estar presencialmente en la oficina, ubicada en Buenos Aires, 2 veces por semana.

Sobre el Equipo y el Desafío

El rol de un Sr de Revenue and Pricing Management Analyst es fundamental dentro de la empresa, enfocado en maximizar los ingresos y la rentabilidad mediante la toma de decisiones basada en datos. Este objetivo se logra a través de un enfoque estratégico que combina el análisis cuantitativo, la previsión de la demanda ( forecasting ), la optimización dinámica de precios, la gestión de inventario y el despliegue efectivo en el mercado.

El Revenue Management trasciende el simple ajuste de tarifas: se trata de vender el producto o servicio adecuado, al cliente adecuado, en el momento oportuno, por el canal de distribución más rentable y al precio óptimo.

Tus Responsabilidades

• Análisis y Previsión (Forecasting)

• Análisis de Datos: Recopilar, depurar y analizar grandes volúmenes de datos históricos (ventas, precios, demanda, elasticidad y comportamiento del consumidor) para identificar patrones y tendencias clave.

• Previsión (Forecasting): Proyectar la demanda futura por segmento, canal y producto/servicio para diferentes ventanas temporales, considerando estacionalidad, eventos especiales y condiciones del mercado.

• Monitoreo de la Competencia: Rastrear y evaluar de manera continua las estrategias de precios, promociones y ofertas del mercado para sostener una ventaja competitiva.

• Estrategia de Precios, Canales y Go-to-Market (GTM)

• Optimización de Precios: Diseñar y aplicar esquemas de pricing dinámico y estructuras tarifarias adaptadas a la demanda prevista y a los movimientos del sector.

• Estrategia y Liderazgo de Go-to-Market: Diseñar y liderar el lanzamiento ( Go-to-Market ) de nuevas propuestas y esquemas de precios, definiendo el cómo , cuándo y a quién se presentan para maximizar la adopción, la retención y la captura de valor.

• Gestión y Rentabilidad de Canales: Evaluar el rendimiento, las comisiones y los márgenes de los distintos canales de distribución (directo, intermediarios, digital, etc.) para priorizar los de mayor rentabilidad.

• Ejecución, Colaboración e Informes

• Implementación Operativa: Asegurar la correcta parametrización y despliegue de las reglas y tarifas en los sistemas de gestión pertinentes.

• Colaboración Interdepartamental: Trabajar de manera estrecha con los equipos de Producto, Comercial, Operaciones y Finanzas para alinear el lanzamiento de precios con el roadmap de producto y los objetivos comerciales de la compañía.

• Métricas y Rendimiento: Desarrollar tableros de control y reportes de KPIs de ingresos, evaluando el impacto posterior al lanzamiento de cada estrategia para presentar hallazgos y ajustes a la dirección.

Lo que buscamos (Requisitos)

• Educación: Licenciatura o grado en Economía, Administración de Empresas, Ingeniería Industrial, Finanzas, Marketing Cuantitativo o carreras afines.

• Experiencia previa:

• 3 a 5 años de experiencia comprobable en roles de Revenue Management, Pricing, Commercial Strategy o Analytics.

• Deseable experiencia en industrias dinámicas (Tech, SaaS, Startups, Consultoría).

¿Cómo es nuestro Proceso de Selección?

Diseñamos un proceso transparente, directo y enfocado en evaluar tu potencial técnico y comportamental, dándote la oportunidad de conocer a nuestros equipos y rutas de carrera:

•
Postulación y Revisión de Perfil

•
Entrevista de Alineación (Equipo de Reclutamiento)

•
Evaluación Técnica (Caso Práctico, Desafío o Evaluación de Código)

•
Entrevista de Encaje Cultural y Liderazgo

•
Propuesta y ¡Bienvenido/a!

Importante: Evaluamos todas las postulaciones de manera individual y garantizamos respuesta para todas las personas. Toda la comunicación se realiza por correo electrónico, así que asegúrate de revisar tu bandeja de entrada y permitir los correos del dominio @quintoandar.com.br .

Beneficios

• Plan médico.

• Wellhub.

• Licencia parental extendida.

• Reintegro de Guardería.

• Gastos de teletrabajo (monto mensual).

• Descuentos en servicios del día a día.

• Día libre por cumpleaños, Día del Padre y Día de la Madre.
