postings.title: Operations Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role:

As Operations Analyst for Market Data, you will be responsible for managing the data licensing, usage reporting and entitlements that underpin Alpaca’s market data product, keeping us compliant with all of our data sources while we deliver market data to millions of users.

After successful and rapid growth with our Trading API and Broker API, Alpaca is now building out our market data product. The team is rapidly growing, and we work with a growing number of exchange groups and data providers, as well as brokers and partners who redistribute our data to their own customers.

We’re looking for someone highly organized and detail-oriented to own the operational backbone of our market data business. You’ll work closely with our data sources and broker/partner customers, as well as internal teams across market data, sales, legal, finance and engineering.

Things You Get To Do:

• Manage new data licenses and renewals with all of our data sources, including exchange groups and other data providers

• Track license terms, renewal dates and obligations so that nothing lapses

• Prepare and submit accurate, on-time monthly usage reporting for each data feed to each of our data sources

• Monitor the licensing of brokers/partners redistributing our data, maintaining current evidence of distribution licensing/authorization for each one

• Enable and disable data feeds for broker/partner customers in line with their licensing and contracts

• Respond to data source audits and inquiries, keeping our licensing records and documentation complete and up to date

• Identify opportunities to improve and automate our licensing, reporting and entitlement processes

• Assist with customer support queries regarding data feeds or licensing

Who You Are (Must-Haves):

• 2+ years of experience in operations, ideally in market data administration, data licensing or vendor management within financial services

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills

• Highly organized, able to manage many recurring deadlines across multiple counterparties

• Ability to read and interpret contract and licensing terms

• Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills

• Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy

Who You Might Be (Nice-to-Haves):

• Familiarity with exchange market data policies and usage reporting (e.g. NYSE, Nasdaq, Cboe, OPRA, CTA/UTP)

• Experience with market data inventory and usage reporting tools

• SQL or scripting experience to help automate reporting

• Experience or understanding of financial markets

• Experience working in a fast-paced environment and able to self-manage

• Comfortable working remotely

How We Take Care of You:

• Competitive Salary & Stock Options

• Health Benefits

• New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500

• Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.

About the Role

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Reference Data team, you will build services that form the data backbone of Alpaca’s brokerage infrastructure. Almost every service at Alpaca needs information about the assets it operates on. Our team provides that information and supports the events that affect those assets throughout their lifecycle.

The team owns two core areas: Security Master , the central source of information about tradable assets, their characteristics and whether, when, and how they can be traded; and corporate actions , which involves ingesting third-party information about dividends, stock splits, mergers and other events, then calculating the changes and transactions needed to reflect them in customer and partner holdings.

You will work across both areas, helping Alpaca enter new markets, expand its portfolio of products and improve the reliability, performance and operability of existing systems. This is a hands-on backend engineering role focused on distributed systems, data modelling and correctness across interconnected services. You will take open-ended problems from scoping and design through implementation, rollout and production support, working closely with the teams that depend on reference data.

Things You Get To Do

•
Design, build and maintain distributed backend services, APIs and data models for Security Master and corporate actions.

•
Extend reference data systems to support new instruments, asset classes and market-specific requirements, including futures and prediction markets.

•
Build reliable workflows for ingesting, validating and processing third-party instrument and corporate action information.

•
Develop internal tools and automation that reduce manual work and improve the reliability of reference data operations.

•
Help redesign how foundational asset information is structured and shared across Alpaca, contributing to architectural decisions with company-wide impact.

•
Work closely with engineering and business teams that consume reference data, coordinating changes across services.

•
Own complex features and technical decisions from design through production, including testing, troubleshooting and continuous improvement.

Who You Are (Must-Haves)

•
Strong experience building and operating event-driven, distributed backend systems.

•
Strong database and data-modelling skills, with an understanding of eventual consistency and data replication.

•
Excellent system design fundamentals, including designing and evolving APIs.

•
Proficiency in a strongly typed programming language and willingness to work in Go.

•
Experience taking complex or ambiguous problems from initial requirements through delivery and production operation.

•
Ability to explain technical decisions and trade-offs clearly, collaborate across teams and reason through cross-system dependencies.

•
Senior-level engineering judgement and ownership; we assess capability and impact rather than applying a fixed years-of-experience threshold.

Who You Might Be (Nice-to-Haves)

•
Experience in trading, brokerage, capital markets, crypto infrastructure or related financial technology.

•
Experience with reference data, Security Master, instrument or asset data, or corporate action processing.

•
Understanding of financial instruments, particularly options, futures and other derivatives.

•
Experience with third-party data ingestion, internal tooling and workflow automation.

•
Experience guiding other engineers and working across interconnected services and teams.

How We Take Care of You:

• Competitive Salary & Stock Options

• Health Benefits

• New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500

• Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

This role focuses on building and supporting scalable business process solutions, integrating workflow applications with enterprise systems, and ensuring the reliability, performance, security, and maintainability of existing applications.

Coderio designs and develops scalable digital solutions for global companies. We combine deep technical expertise with a product-driven mindset to lead complex software initiatives end-to-end. Working with international clients, we value autonomy, clear communication, and long-term relationships built on technical excellence. 🌍 Learn more:coderio.com
Role Overview
We are looking for an MLOps Engineer to take ownership of the full lifecycle of our Machine Learning models. In this strategic role, you will face a key technical challenge: managing and supporting our legacy processes (based on AWS SageMaker and Apache Flink) while driving the transition and adoption of our new tech ecosystem based on Databricks (Lakehouse, Feature Store, and Model Serving).
What To Expect In This Role (Responsibilities)
Feature Management & Deployment: Coordinate the creation, deployment, and rollout of new features and variables to strengthen core business models (Fraud, Payments, FX).
Maintenance & Lifecycle: Design strategies for the preventive and corrective maintenance of production models, ensuring their retraining, stability, and performance.
Continuous Monitoring: Oversee model observability to detect anomalies, performance degradation (data/concept drift), and real-time latency issues.
Legacy Support: Ensure the operational continuity of current pipelines built on AWS SageMaker and streaming data flows with Apache Flink.
Migration Strategy: Plan a secure, frictionless transition of legacy processes and infrastructure toward the company's newly defined technologies.
Requirements
Experience: 4+ years of experience working with Machine Learning models in large-scale production, ideally in transactional or data streaming environments.
SageMaker Stack: Hands-on experience managing and implementing flows in AWS SageMaker (pipelines, training, endpoints).
Familiarity or experience with real-time data processing using Apache Flink (or similar streaming tools like Kafka / Spark Streaming).
DevOps & Infrastructure: Solid experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and CI/CD automation tools.
Language Proficiency: Fluent English (mandatory) for seamless daily communication with global, multicultural teams.
Nice to Have
New Tech Ecosystem: Highly desirable experience working within the Databricks ecosystem focused on Machine Learning, including knowledge/implementation of Databricks Feature Store, Lakehouse architectures, and deploying models via Databricks Model Serving.
Industry Background: Coming from the Fintech, Payment Processing, or Fraud Prevention industries.
Certifications: Holding official Databricks certifications (e.g., Databricks Certified Machine Learning Professional).
Benefits
Long-term commitment with autonomy and impact on global, high-scale projects.
Strategic, high-visibility role within a modern engineering culture.
Collaborative, multicultural environment with strong technical leadership.
Career growth path and continuous learning opportunities within Coderio.

postings.descriptionText:
About Welocalize 
Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
 
Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com 


Overview 
The Senior Project Manager will be responsible for managing assigned accounts end-to-end, including project planning, execution, monitoring, delivery, and closure in line with Welocalize’s standard processes and tools. In addition, the Senior Project Manager will partner with the Operations Squad Lead to support large enterprise accounts.
This role will serve as the primary project-level contact for clients, building strong customer relationships while collaborating closely with Welocalize account directors and production teams to maximize delivery performance, client satisfaction, quality, and profitability.
The ideal candidate is a motivated and dependable professional with strong relationship-building skills across cross-functional teams. They should bring the adaptability, resilience, and energy needed to succeed in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

postings.descriptionText:
ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en


ABOUT THE ROLE

Nubank is scaling rapidly across Latin America, and our Mexico division is central to empowering millions of people with intuitive, transparent, and accessible financial services. To support our sustained customer growth and expand our product ecosystem reliably, we need senior technical leaders who can translate high-level business vision into resilient, scalable distributed architectures.

In this role, you will serve as a strategic technical anchor across the Mexico division, collaborating closely with engineering leadership and cross-functional teams spanning Growth, Operations, and Core Value Proposition. You will bridge local market dynamics with Nubank's global platform ecosystem, steering architectural decisions that directly impact how prospects seamlessly transition into engaged Nubank customers.

Operating with a country-wide horizontal perspective, you will guide technical roadmaps across multiple business units and squads, untangle complex domain boundaries, and elevate engineering standards across chapters. By pairing architectural vision with pragmatic delivery, you will ensure our systems remain resilient, extensible, and prepared for exponential scale.



RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Define and execute the long-term architectural vision for the Mexico division using Domain-Driven Design (DDD) principles to decouple complex systems and eliminate single points of failure.

 - Steer technical strategy across squads in Growth, Operations, and Core Value Prop, ensuring local business flows integrate seamlessly with Nubank’s global platform foundation.

 - Mentor and develop senior engineering talent across chapters, cultivating technical excellence, architectural rigor, and operational best practices.

 - Partner with engineering directors and executive leadership to translate commercial objectives into scalable system designs and actionable execution roadmaps.

 - Drive cross-team technical consensus on mission-critical initiatives, advocating for sound trade-offs between delivery velocity and platform extensibility.

 - Champion operational resilience and observability across customer acquisition funnels, proactively identifying bottlenecks to optimize conversion latency and system reliability.


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Demonstrated track record of technical leadership as a Staff-level engineer (or equivalent scope) guiding distributed systems architecture across multi-team engineering organizations.

 - Deep practical expertise applying Domain-Driven Design (DDD) to design, decouple, and scale event-driven microservices.

 - Proven ability to influence cross-functional technical roadmaps across globally distributed platform and product teams without direct hierarchical authority.

 - Experience architecting mission-critical, high-throughput systems where fault tolerance, reliability, and low-latency performance are essential.

 - Professional working proficiency in English, with demonstrated success communicating complex architectural concepts to both technical and executive audiences.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Professional working proficiency in Spanish or prior engineering experience building digital products tailored for the Latin American market (specifically Mexico).

 - Background designing high-conversion growth, onboarding, or acquisition engines within large-scale consumer technology or high-growth fintech environments.

 - Hands-on experience with modern cloud-native ecosystems, functional programming paradigms (e.g., Clojure, Scala), or distributed event streaming architectures (e.g., Apache Kafka).

 - Track record of building and scaling systems at top-tier global technology companies.


LOCATION & WORK MODEL

This role is based in Buenos Aires, Argentina on a Hybrid model at our Buenos Aires office. Work model: Hybrid,3 times per week.

Willingness and ability to travel to our Mexico City office approximately once per quarter for cross-team planning and collaboration.


DIVERSITY & INCLUSION / EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

At Nubank, we believe that diversity is essential to building the best products and services. We are committed to creating a welcoming work environment that respects and values diversity in all its forms, and we encourage people from all backgrounds to apply. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

For information on how we process your personal data throughout the recruitment process, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice on our careers page.



Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers.

To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here https://script.google.com/a/macros/nubank.com.br/s/AKfycbwvrewE58oGSbRWIVv8CyCWN68GLxpPVsfYYXv-ZHg94QFsTJmi82rF1x0yt-OTs2W0DQ/exec

postings.title: Marketing Data Analyst (Python & SQL)
postings.descriptionText:
This role is open to candidates based in LATAM, Africa, and Eastern Europe. Please note that as this role supports U.S.-based clients, candidates must be available to work during U.S. business hours aligned with the client’s time zone.

 

Our client is a marketing analytics technology company that runs marketing mix models (MMM) for hundreds of brands across Shopify, Amazon, TikTok Shop, and retail channels. Its platform helps brands evaluate marketing performance through automated modeling, data analysis, and channel-level insights.




ROLE OVERVIEW

The Marketing Data Analyst (Python & SQL) will investigate production model alerts, troubleshoot data and modeling issues, and optimize marketing mix model configurations to maintain accurate and reliable results.

This role sits within the Data Science team and focuses on investigating anomalies, validating model performance, and using AI coding agents to accelerate analysis. The ideal candidate has strong analytical judgment, familiarity with statistical modeling concepts, and the ability to interpret Python and SQL while translating complex findings into actionable recommendations.




LOCATION

Fully Remote (Work from Home) | 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


MODEL MONITORING & INVESTIGATION

 - Investigate production model alerts, including declining model fit, unusual Return on Ad Spend (ROAS), and Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) spikes.

 - Develop hypotheses, analyze relevant data, test potential causes, and document findings and recommendations.

 - Distinguish modeling issues from data problems such as broken feeds, incorrect campaign labels, or reporting delays.

 - Prioritize investigations and maintain accurate records of findings and resolutions.
   
   


MARKETING MIX MODEL OPTIMIZATION

 - Review and adjust production model configurations, including priors, seasonality, holidays, promotions, trends, and channel labeling.

 - Evaluate adstock, Hill saturation, and other modeling parameters when investigating performance issues.

 - Compare candidate configurations against live models based on model fit and channel plausibility.

 - Promote validated configurations or document why proposed changes were rejected.

 - Maintain accurate records of model changes and configuration decisions.
   
   


AI-ASSISTED DATA ANALYSIS

 - Use AI coding agents, including Claude Code, to investigate model behavior and data discrepancies.

 - Review Python and SQL code to understand modeling pipelines and troubleshoot issues.

 - Validate AI-generated analyses, calculations, and recommendations against underlying data.

 - Use AI-assisted workflows to accelerate investigations while maintaining analytical accuracy.
   
   


CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION & DOCUMENTATION

 - Collaborate with Data Science and Customer Success teams to communicate investigation findings.

 - Translate complex modeling issues into practical recommendations for marketing stakeholders.

 - Track investigation queues and technical issues in Jira.

 - Maintain concise investigation notes, model change logs, and documentation to support follow-up and handoffs.
   
   


QUALIFICATIONS


EXPERIENCE

 - 3+ years of professional experience in marketing analytics, data analysis, applied data science, or a related analytical role.

 - Experience investigating data discrepancies, performance anomalies, or issues within analytical systems.

 - Experience reviewing Python and SQL code to understand data pipelines and analytical workflows.

 - Experience working with statistical modeling concepts, including Bayesian regression, seasonality, attribution, adstock, or saturation.

 - A degree in statistics, economics, mathematics, engineering, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent hands-on experience.

 - Experience in marketing analytics or media buying, including evaluating channel-level ROAS, is preferred.

 - Experience with marketing mix modeling (MMM) or causal inference in a vendor, agency, or in-house environment is preferred.

 - Experience analyzing e-commerce and advertising data from Shopify, Amazon Ads, TikTok Shop, Meta, or Google Ads is a plus.
   
   


SKILLS

 - Strong ability to read, interpret, and lightly modify Python code and work with SQL.

 - Understanding of Bayesian regression, marketing attribution, seasonality, adstock, and saturation concepts.

 - Ability to investigate complex modeling pipelines and identify potential sources of errors.

 - Strong analytical judgment when distinguishing data quality issues from modeling problems.

 - Proficiency in directing AI coding agents through investigations and validating their findings.

 - Ability to evaluate model configurations based on statistical fit and business plausibility.

 - Familiarity with PyMC and Bayesian marketing mix modeling concepts.

 - Ability to document hypotheses, investigation findings, and recommendations concisely.

 - Strong attention to detail and ability to prioritize investigations based on business impact.

 - Familiarity with Jira and AWS S3 is preferred.

 - Familiarity with tools such as AWS Athena, BigQuery, Hex, Claude Code, and GitHub is a plus.
   
   


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - Alert Triage: Every new model alert is reviewed, with an initial hypothesis documented within 1 business day.

 - Alert Resolution: Root causes and recommendations are documented within 3 business days.

 - Investigation Accuracy: At least 90% of investigations are correctly classified as data-related or model-related issues.

 - Configuration Documentation: Every approved or rejected model configuration change is documented with model fit and plausibility comparisons.

 - Independence: Independently manage the complete model alert investigation process by day 60.

 - Cross-Functional Trust: Data Science and Customer Success teams can rely on accurate, timely investigation findings and recommendations.
   
   


OPPORTUNITY

The Marketing Data Analyst (Python & SQL) will have the opportunity to work directly with production marketing mix models used by hundreds of brands, investigating complex analytical issues and improving model reliability.

This role offers hands-on exposure to Bayesian modeling, AI-assisted analysis, and marketing performance measurement while contributing directly to the accuracy of customer-facing insights.


APPLICATION PROCESS:


TO BE CONSIDERED FOR THIS ROLE THESE STEPS NEED TO BE FOLLOWED:

 - Fill in the application form

 - Record a video showcasing your skill sets

You will work directly with stakeholders to understand their needs, translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions, and take ownership of projects from initial discovery through deployment and optimization.

What You'll Lead and Build

• Work directly with clients and stakeholders to understand business challenges, technical requirements, and operational needs.

• Design, develop, and deploy customized software solutions that address complex business problems.

• Take ownership of end-to-end technical implementations, from requirements gathering and solution design to deployment and ongoing optimization.

• Build scalable applications, APIs, integrations, and automation solutions using modern technologies.

• Collaborate with product managers, software engineers, and business teams to translate client requirements into actionable technical solutions.

• Integrate internal platforms with third-party systems, databases, APIs, and cloud services.

• Troubleshoot complex technical issues, identify root causes, and implement effective solutions.

• Develop prototypes and proof-of-concept solutions to validate technical approaches and accelerate delivery.

• Adapt existing products and platforms to meet specific client requirements while maintaining scalability and performance.

• Support cloud-based deployments, system integrations, and production environments.

• Create clear technical documentation, implementation guidelines, and solution architecture diagrams.

• Identify opportunities to improve system performance, automate workflows, and optimize technical processes.

• Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Collaborate with international teams using agile methodologies to ensure successful project delivery.

• Gather client feedback and share insights with engineering and product teams to support continuous product improvement.

What You Bring to the Table

• Advanced English (C1) – excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• 3+ years of experience in Software Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or similar technical roles.

• Strong software development skills , with hands-on experience in Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, or similar programming languages.

• Solid understanding of software architecture, system design, and scalable application development.

• Experience building and integrating REST APIs, microservices, and third-party platforms.

• Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

• Knowledge of relational and non-relational databases, including SQL and NoSQL technologies.

• Experience with modern development frameworks and tools.

• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Git, Docker, and modern software deployment practices.

• Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and analytical problem-solving skills.

• Ability to translate complex business requirements into practical technical solutions.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills , with the ability to work directly with clients and international stakeholders.

• Strong ownership mindset, autonomy, and ability to manage projects from concept to production.

• Excellent time management and organizational skills, with the ability to handle multiple priorities.

• Knowledge of agile methodologies and experience working in fast-paced environments.

• Adaptability, curiosity, and willingness to learn new technologies based on project requirements.

• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.

Benefits that Move you Forward.
We’re here to amplify your brilliance, not contain it.

• Work from anywhere with true flexibility and freedom.

• Earn in USD with compensation that matches your expertise.

• Recharge confidently with dedicated paid time off.

At Pearster, your journey matters, and we’re here to help you go further than you imagined.

postings.title: Coordinador de equipo de Operaciones
postings.descriptionText:
🟣 En Accenture, la tecnología impulsa nuestra transformación. Buscamos personas con ganas de aprender, crecer y trabajar con herramientas de vanguardia para resolver desafíos reales. Integramos inteligencia artificial generativa (GenIA) en nuestros proyectos para acelerar la innovación, optimizar procesos y generar impacto en múltiples industrias. Contamos con más de 1.600 profesionales dedicados exclusivamente a GenIA, respaldados por una red global de más de 40.000 expertos en datos e inteligencia artificial. Este enfoque se potencia con inversiones estratégicas, más de 35 alianzas tecnológicas y más de 25 estudios GenIA distribuidos globalmente. Sumate a nuestros equipos de Technology y descubrí cómo podés ser parte de esta evolución.

Buscamos un/a Coordinador/a de Operaciones IT Senior con experiencia en liderazgo de equipos técnicos y gestión de operaciones de infraestructura, orientado/a a garantizar la disponibilidad, estabilidad y mejora continua de los servicios.
La posición tendrá responsabilidad sobre la operación diaria, el cumplimiento de SLAs, la gestión y escalamiento de incidentes críticos y la coordinación de mallas de procesamiento Batch utilizando Control-M .

🎯 Principales desafíos
Gestión de Operaciones

• Supervisar las operaciones diarias de infraestructura, incluyendo redes, servidores, almacenamiento, cloud y soporte.

• Garantizar la disponibilidad y performance de los sistemas dentro de los SLAs establecidos.

• Coordinar la atención y resolución de incidentes críticos P1/P2, actuando como punto de escalación técnica y organizacional.

• Facilitar la comunicación entre IT Operations y equipos de Desarrollo, Seguridad y Negocio.

Liderazgo de Equipo

• Coordinar y desarrollar al equipo técnico, incluyendo distribución de tareas, seguimiento, feedback y capacitación.

• Definir turnos, guardias y esquemas de on-call para garantizar la cobertura de la operación 24/7 cuando corresponda.

• Gestionar el desempeño del equipo, identificar brechas de conocimientos y acompañar su desarrollo profesional.

Gestión de Batch y Control-M

• Supervisar la operación diaria de las mallas de procesamiento Batch , asegurando la correcta ejecución de los jobs críticos.

• Gestionar Control-M , incluyendo scheduling, definición y monitoreo de jobs, dependencias y alertas.

• Detectar y coordinar la resolución de fallas en ejecuciones Batch, incluyendo reruns, hold/force y ajustes de dependencias.

• Coordinar la incorporación de nuevos jobs, cambios de schedules y calendarios operativos.

• Monitorear ejecuciones asociadas a procesos críticos, cierres de día, cierres de mes y fechas especiales.

• Generar reportes de cumplimiento de mallas y realizar seguimiento de jobs completados, fallidos o ejecutados fuera de ventana.

• Participar en las pruebas de modificaciones de mallas Batch en ambientes no productivos antes de su implementación en producción.

Mejora Continua & Gobierno

• Identificar oportunidades de automatización y optimización de los procesos operativos.

• Elaborar y presentar KPIs de operación como uptime, MTTR, MTBF y ticket backlog .

• Mantener actualizada la documentación técnica, runbooks y procedimientos operativos.

🛠 Skills mandatorios

• Network Operations Center (NOC): P2 - Intermediate

• Incident Management: P2 - Intermediate

• Dynatrace APM: P1 - Beginner

• Nagios: P1 - Beginner

• Batch Scheduling Tools & Techniques: P1 - Beginner

• English: B2 - Advanced

✅ Requisitos

• Experiencia mínima de 3 años coordinando o liderando equipos técnicos .

• Conocimientos sólidos en redes LAN/WAN , sistemas operativos Linux/Windows y virtualización con VMware y/o Hyper-V .

• Experiencia trabajando con herramientas de monitoreo como Zabbix, Nagios, Dynatrace, Datadog o similares .

• Experiencia comprobable en administración y operación de Control-M (BMC) : scheduling, definición de jobs, manejo de dependencias, alertas y SLA Management.

• Conocimiento del ciclo de vida del procesamiento Batch: diseño de mallas, ventanas de ejecución, calendarios y procedimientos de recovery ante fallas.

• Conocimiento de gestión de incidentes y cambios bajo marcos ITIL .

• Capacidad para trabajar bajo presión y tomar decisiones frente a situaciones críticas, especialmente durante cierres de lote y ejecuciones de fin de día o fin de mes.

➕ Deseables

• Certificación ITIL .

• Conocimientos de automatización con Ansible, Terraform y/o CI/CD .

• Experiencia trabajando con tecnologías Cloud como AWS, Azure o GCP .

🤝 Soft Skills

• Pensamiento analítico y orientación a la resolución de problemas.

• Proactividad y autonomía para liderar mejoras.

• Buenas habilidades de comunicación y documentación.

• Capacidad de trabajo colaborativo con equipos técnicos y no técnicos.

🚀 Oportunidades de crecimiento
Fomentamos el desarrollo profesional y el crecimiento continuo a través de capacitaciones, certificaciones y proyectos desafiantes para avanzar en tu carrera.

Accenture promueve la diversidad, la innovación y un equilibrio trabajo-vida personal.

postings.title: Manager, Paid Social
postings.descriptionText:
Job Description:
ROLE PURPOSE
You will work on the strategy, implementation, execution, and analysis of campaigns on Paid Social platforms, including involvement in setting objectives, monitoring results, preparing reports, recommending optimizations, and overseeing billing. Your role will help ensure a superior level of service for our clients, fostering long-lasting and trustworthy relationships.
This position is for the Offshore Team of Dentsu Argentina, and works for teams located in Dentsu's agencies in other countries. Has a local support team that leads the integration and relationship with the other members of the Offshore Team in Argentina.

TASKS AND RESPONSABILITIES
Define strategic guidelines under the supervision of your superior and be responsible for meeting the established KPIs.
Monitor the performance of campaigns and ensure KPIs are met.
If required, eventually supervise the work of more junior team members directly responsible for implementation.
Prepare reports and analyze data on results.
Monitor optimization results and provide new recommendations.
Ability to build strong relationships with the teams you work with.
Ability to build strong relationships with clients through precise and timely communication.
Develop and maintain relationships with media partners to promote growth in campaign performance.
Ability to collaborate in creating and executing media plans with other channel areas with a comprehensive and consistent approach to client brand communication.
If required by your team, train junior members, supporting their development and task execution.
As part of the Offshore Team of Dentsu Argentina, you must actively participate in the weekly virtual networking meetings with other members of the Argentina offshore team.
You must also participate in the Offshore Team's peer-to-peer engagement activities held periodically in our Buenos Aires offices, except for those who are not located in that city.

QUALIFICATIONS
2 to 4 years of experience.
A bachelor's degree, preferably in marketing, advertising, finance, or analytics, will be valued.
Proficiency in the Paid Social Meta Ads platform and other Paid Social platforms.
Strong knowledge and understanding of Performance Marketing concepts.
Good knowledge of the Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
Experience and ability to manipulate, analyze, and interpret large amounts of data.
Enthusiastic about data analysis and curious about the topic.
Accuracy in execution, quality control through Q&A, and compliance with deadlines.
Organizational skills and project management capability.
Strong numerical and analytical skills.
Ability to handle multiple projects and prioritize responsibilities in an agile environment.
Problem-solving skills.

PERSONAL SKILLS
Strong communication skills, both verbal and written.
Ability to build strong relationships with the teams you work with.
Proactivity and collaboration with colleagues.
Attention to detail and precision in your work style.
Integrity, autonomy, and self-motivation.

postings.title: Sr Associate, Paid Social
postings.descriptionText:
Job Description:
PROPÓSITO DEL ROL

Trabajará en la implementación, ejecución y recomendación de mejoras de campañas en plataformas de Paid Social, incluyendo su involucramiento en la estrategia, la carga de campañas, su seguimiento, reportes y sugerencia de optimizaciones, como así también la reconciliación para facturación, colaborando en garantizar una prestación de servicios de nivel superior a nuestros clientes que garantice una relación duradera y de confianza.
Este puesto es para el Equipo Offshore de Dentsu Argentina y trabaja para equipos ubicados en las agencias de Dentsu en otros países. Cuenta con un equipo de soporte local que lidera la integración y la relación con los demás miembros del Equipo Offshore en Argentina.

TAREAS Y RESPONSABILIDADES

Estrategia.

• Provisión de recomendaciones al equipo de trabajo para la definición de las estrategias de campañas en aspectos tales como:

• Análisis del negocio del cliente, el target, el producto, la competencia, el brief de campaña, el presupuesto.

• Selección de plataformas a utilizar y tipo de campañas según los objetivos.

• Selección de segmentaciones.

• Selección de ubicaciones y formatos de anuncios.

• Asignación de presupuestos por plataformas, campañas y grupos de anuncios.

• Insights en base a resultados de performance de las campañas.

• Realización de experimentos de campaña.

Implementación.

• Carga de campañas, controles de calidad usando Q&A.

• Creación de anuncios de texto y extensiones para Búsqueda.

• Trafficking de anuncios, carga y cambios.

• Implementación de audiencias personalizadas y retargeting.

• Implementación del pixel.

• Seguimiento diario de campañas controlando el pacing, consumo de presupuestos, forecast.

• Ajustes de presupuestos de campañas, reasignación en base al delivery de las mismas.

• Seguimiento de resultados de los KPIs versus objetivos.

• Provisión de recomendaciones al equipo de trabajo en la definición de optimizaciones de campaña

• Implementación en plataformas de las optimizaciones de campañas definidas por el equipo de trabajo.

• Reconciliación de lo ordenado y emitido, y resolución de discrepancias para la facturación.

Reporting.

• Realización de reportes de control de delivery de campañas.

• Realización de reportes de resultados de KPIs de campañas.

• Análisis de resultados.

Desarrollar buenos vínculos con los equipos de trabajo de la agencia, los partners de medios y los clientes en el caso que tenga participación en la relación con ellos.
Buen nivel de autonomía para desarrollar sus tareas.

Job Overview
Under general supervision, perform tasks at a country level associated with site activation activities in accordance with applicable local and/or international regulations, standard operating procedures (SOPs), project requirements and contractual/budgetary guidelines.

• Independently draft, review, and negotiate standard clinical trial agreements (e.g., CTAs, CDAs, amendments) with investigative sites and institutions.

• Identify and proactively address contract-related delays, working to resolve issues and minimize impact on study timelines.

• Ensure all contracts comply with applicable regulatory requirements, sponsor guidelines, and company policies.

• Support audit and inspection readiness by maintaining complete and accurate contract files.

• Contribute to continuous process improvements aimed at enhancing contract cycle times and quality.

postings.title: Associate Sales Executive (Legal)
postings.descriptionText:
Job Description

El Associate Sales Executive será responsable de impulsar el crecimiento de nuevos negocios dentro del segmento Mid Market Legal de Thomson Reuters en Argentina. Esta posición está enfocada en la venta de soluciones legales a estudios jurídicos pequeños y medianos, incluyendo productos habilitados con inteligencia artificial, contenido de investigación jurídica y soluciones de software adaptadas al mercado legal.

Esta posición requiere un profesional altamente proactivo, con fuerte orientación comercial, capaz de gestionar el ciclo completo de ventas de principio a fin, desde la prospección en frío y la generación de oportunidades, hasta las demostraciones de producto, negociación y cierre. La persona ideal deberá sentirse cómoda trabajando en un entorno comercial dinámico, donde el éxito depende de una actividad de prospección constante, resiliencia y capacidad para construir relaciones sólidas con profesionales del sector legal.

Key Responsibilities

• Generar nuevas oportunidades de negocio dentro del mercado legal en Argentina.

• Prospectar y contactar clientes potenciales mediante llamadas en frío, correos electrónicos y reuniones virtuales.

• Gestionar el ciclo completo de ventas, incluyendo generación de leads, calificación, demostraciones de producto, conversaciones de precio, negociación y cierre.

• Construir y mantener un pipeline comercial sólido, con foco en adquisición de nuevos clientes.

• Dar seguimiento a leads entrantes generados por marketing o equipos de prospección, cuando aplique.

• Comercializar soluciones legales de Thomson Reuters, incluyendo herramientas con inteligencia artificial, bases de datos jurídicas y software para estudios jurídicos pequeños y medianos.

• Desarrollar relaciones sólidas con clientes y representar a Thomson Reuters de manera profesional en todas las interacciones.

• Participar en eventos comerciales, actividades con universidades, colegios de abogados y visitas de campo ocasionales cuando sea necesario.

• Utilizar herramientas CRM como Salesforce para gestionar actividades, oportunidades y visibilidad del pipeline.

• Aplicar herramientas de inteligencia artificial y recursos digitales para mejorar la productividad, la preparación y la efectividad comercial.

• Colaborar de manera cercana con el manager y stakeholders internos para alcanzar los objetivos de facturación y negocio.

Required Qualifications

• Experiencia comprobable en ventas, desarrollo de negocio o adquisición de nuevos clientes.

• Fuerte perfil comercial, con capacidad para generar oportunidades de manera proactiva.

• Experiencia gestionando o participando en el ciclo completo de ventas, desde la prospección hasta el cierre.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y presentación.

• Alto nivel de resiliencia y capacidad para manejar el rechazo en un entorno comercial de alta actividad.

• Comodidad en el uso de sistemas CRM como Salesforce o similares.

• Interés y apertura para utilizar inteligencia artificial como parte del trabajo diario.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experiencia vendiendo soluciones legales, tecnología, SaaS u otros servicios intangibles.

• Experiencia vendiendo a estudios jurídicos o profesionales del sector legal.

• Formación académica en Derecho o estudios jurídicos.

• Conocimiento o exposición previa al mercado legal argentino.

• Experiencia en entornos de ventas outbound con fuerte expectativa de prospección.

#LI-AC1

¿Qué te ofrecemos?

• Modelo de Trabajo Híbrido: Hemos adoptado un entorno de trabajo híbrido y flexible para nuestros roles en oficina, ofreciendo una experiencia fluida que está conectada digital y físicamente.

• Flexibilidad y Equilibrio entre Trabajo y Vida Personal: "Flex My Way" Consiste en un conjunto de políticas de apoyo en el entorno laboral, diseñadas para facilitar la gestión de las responsabilidades personales y profesionales, ya sea atendiendo a la familia, participando en actividades comunitarias o dedicando tiempo al descanso y la renovación personal. Estas políticas se basan en nuestro enfoque flexible de trabajo, que permite a los empleados trabajar desde cualquier lugar hasta 8 semanas al año, promoviendo así un equilibrio ideal entre sus compromisos laborales y personales.

• Desarrollo y Crecimiento Profesional: Fomentamos una cultura de aprendizaje continuo y desarrollo de habilidades, preparando a nuestro talento para enfrentar los desafíos del futuro y ofrecer soluciones reales. Nuestro programa "Grow My Way" y el enfoque en habilidades garantizan que tengas las herramientas y conocimientos para crecer, liderar y prosperar en un futuro habilitado por la inteligencia artificial.

• Beneficios Competitivos del Sector: Ofrecemos planes de beneficios integrales que incluyen seguros de gastos médicos, dos días de descanso por salud mental a nivel de la empresa, programas de incentivos para empleados y recursos para el bienestar mental, físico y financiero.

• Cultura: Reconocida globalmente con una reputación premiada por inclusión y pertenencia, flexibilidad, equilibrio entre trabajo y vida personal, y más. Vivimos nuestros valores: Obsesión por nuestros Clientes, Competir para Ganar, Desafiar nuestro Pensamiento, Actuar Rápido / Aprender Rápido, y Más Fuertes Juntos.

• Impacto Social: Genera un impacto en tu comunidad con nuestro Instituto de Impacto Social. Ofrecemos a los empleados dos días de voluntariado pagados anualmente y oportunidades para involucrarse en proyectos de consultoría pro bono e iniciativas de Medio Ambiente, Sociales y de Gobernanza (ESG).

• Haciendo un Impacto Real en el Mundo: Somos una de las pocas compañías a nivel global que asiste a sus clientes en la búsqueda de justicia, verdad y transparencia. Trabajando en conjunto con los profesionales e instituciones a los que servimos, contribuimos a sostener el estado de derecho, fomentar el comercio, detectar a los infractores, informar sobre los hechos y ofrecer información confiable e imparcial a personas en todo el mundo.

Quiénes somos

Thomson Reuters marca el camino hacia el futuro al reunir contenido confiable y la tecnología que las personas y organizaciones necesitan para tomar decisiones correctas. Servimos a profesionales en los sectores legal, fiscal, contable, de cumplimiento, gubernamental y de medios. Nuestros productos combinan software altamente especializado e información para capacitar a los profesionales con los datos, inteligencia y soluciones necesarias para tomar decisiones informadas y ayudar a las instituciones en su búsqueda de justicia, verdad y transparencia. Reuters, parte de Thomson Reuters, es un proveedor líder mundial de periodismo y noticias confiables.

Contamos con el talento de 26,000 colaboradores en más de 70 países, donde todos tienen la oportunidad de contribuir y crecer profesionalmente en entornos de trabajo flexibles. postings.title: INGENIERO ESTIMULACION
postings.descriptionText:
Sumá tu energía a la compañía que contribuye al desarrollo de nuestro país.

En YPF buscamos personas que quieran ser parte de un gran equipo que transforma desafíos en oportunidades y que actúa con excelencia para generar valor. Con más de cien años de historia, somos la compañía energética líder de la Argentina, impulsando el desarrollo y la innovación tecnológica del país.

¡Sumarte a YPF es unirte a un proyecto que combina experiencia, pasión y la energía necesaria para seguir construyendo nuestro futuro!





¿Qué buscamos?

Un/a profesional de Ingeniería proactiva, autónoma y con alta capacidad de adaptación a contextos dinámicos. Se necesita sólidas habilidades de trabajo en equipo y comunicación efectiva, orientadas a desempeñarse en el rol de Ingeniera/o de Estimulación dentro de la Vicepresidencia de P&WO del Upstream.



¿Cuál será su desafío?

Serás responsable de realizar las tareas que componen todo el proceso de Estimulación: definición de candidatos, definición de diseños, planificación y ejecución de programas de estimulación, evaluación de performance de producción, seguimiento de pilotos e implementación de nuevas tecnologías.

Brindarás soporte a los equipos transversales: completación, sala de monitoreo, equipo de Estudios y equipo de proyectos. Asegurando que se cumplan con los KPI de Estimulación, los diseños planificados, siguiendo los estándares de YPF y que las operaciones se realicen velando por la integridad del reservorio.



¿Cuáles serán sus principales tareas?

Participar en los proyectos de Desarrollo y Exploración en los que se haya determinado la necesidad de estimulación, definiendo diseños y mejores prácticas.

Participar en la elaboración de los entregables de Estimulación para cada una de las fases de los proyectos de desarrollo (ej: base de diseño y playbook de Estimulación), en línea con los estándares técnicos definidos.

Participar, con ingenieros de reservorios, geomecánicos y geólogos de estudios, en la evaluación y selección de pozos a estimular. Utilizar todos los datos disponibles de las zonas de interés para definir la metodología y estrategia de estimulación adecuada, incluyendo la definición y revisión de la posición, altura y la metodología de punzado.

Analizar la respuesta del reservorio a la estimulación integrando todas las variables de subsuelo (geofísica, geomecánica, petrofísica, relaciones padre/hijo, etc.).

Evaluar las operaciones ya realizadas y ajustar el plan de estimulación estipulado en caso de desvíos.

Dar soporte al equipo de Terminación para la confección de los programas de terminación, basándose en los programas de estimulación y de punzados establecidos por PDDP (ej: definición de cañería, cabezal de pozo, método de aislamiento entre etapas).

Buscar e introducir nuevas tecnologías, monitorear sus resultados para contribuir a la excelencia operacional. Mantenerse actualizado a través de papers, conferencias, workshops, etc.

Colaborar en la revisión técnica de los estudios realizados en las áreas no operadas dentro su ámbito, en coordinación con la Gerencia de Relación con Socios y No Operadas, emitiendo las recomendaciones y alertas pertinentes. Participar de workshops y comités técnicos a los cuales sea convocado.

Colaborar con WO en propuestas de optimización de modalidades contractuales de estimulación, que capturen beneficios técnico-económicos acordes con nuevas tendencias de diseño basadas en un mejor entendimiento del subsuelo.

Coordinar la actividad de ensayos y control de calidad de fluidos y agente sostén. Organizar capacitaciones para supervisores y/o personal asignado al monitoreo de estimulaciones de YPF.

Validar y resguardar en bases de datos corporativas los entregables de la operación de Estimulación (programa del trabajo, ASCII de la operación, reporte de campo, informe final).





¿Qué Valoramos?



• Formación académica: Preferentemente Ingeniería grado de especialidad afín (Petróleo/ Industrial /Reservorios /Eléctrico /Químico, etc.)


• Experiencia profesional: más de 2 años en operaciones de fractura en campo.


• Herramientas informáticas: Office, MS Project, Power Bi.


• Otros requisitos: Inglés Intermedio/Avanzado (deseable)





Información del puesto

Lugar de trabajo: Oficinas centrales de Neuquén. Lunes a Viernes de 8 a 17hs 4 días presencial un día home office.

Encuadre gremial: Fuera de convenio

Disponibilidad para viajar: si, eventualmente







Si sos una persona que:






• 
Trabaja con excelencia y profesionalismo.

Da lo mejor cada día, valora la meritocracia y busca siempre la milla extra.

Vive los desafíos como oportunidades para innovar y aprender.

Disfruta del trabajo en equipo y del intercambio de distintos puntos de vista.

Encara los proyectos con pasión y compromiso.










• 
Promueve un buen clima de trabajo, con empatía, escucha activa y respeto.









¡Este puesto es para vos!





¿Qué ofrecemos?




Un entorno donde podés aportar lo más valioso que tenés: tu energía. Esa energía que impulsa, que se adapta, que aprende, que suma, que transforma.

• Gestionar el seguimiento de sumideros: información de pozos inyectores, dimensionamiento para nuevos proyectos, playbooks, estándares y tableros, en coordinación con Reservorios e Inyección.

postings.title: ANALISTA CIBERSEGURIDAD
postings.descriptionText:
Sumá tu energía a la compañía que contribuye al desarrollo de nuestro país.






En YPF buscamos personas que quieran ser parte de un gran equipo que transforma desafíos en oportunidades y que actúa con excelencia para generar valor. Con más de cien años de historia, somos la compañía energética líder de la Argentina, impulsando el desarrollo y la innovación tecnológica del país.






¡Sumarte a YPF es unirte a un proyecto que combina experiencia, pasión y la energía necesaria para seguir construyendo nuestro futuro!






¿Qué buscamos?






Nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un Analista de Ciberseguridad de Datos e Inteligencia Artificial con visión integral, pensamiento analítico y orientación a riesgos, capaz de integrar controles de seguridad, privacidad y uso responsable de IA en todo el ciclo de vida de los productos digitales, articulando con negocio, producto, datos, arquitectura, desarrollo, operaciones y ciberseguridad.






¿Cuál será tu misión?






Integrarse a las torres y células de productos y plataformas digitales como referente de ciberseguridad de datos e IA, coordinando la incorporación oportuna de controles y actividades de seguridad durante todo el ciclo de vida del producto.

Su desafío será actuar como facilitador entre los equipos de negocio; tecnología, datos y las especialidades de ciberseguridad, promoviendo una colaboración efectiva, dando visibilidad a los riesgos y compromisos, y contribuyendo a que los productos evolucionen de manera segura, ágil y sostenible














¿Cuáles serán tus principales tareas?









Desempeñarse como facilitador y punto de referencia de ciberseguridad de datos e IA en el desarrollo, implementación y operación de soluciones de datos e IA en la Vicepresidencia de Tecnología.



· Acompañar productos de datos y soluciones de IA durante ideación, diseño, construcción, pruebas, despliegue, operación y retiro, asegurando identificación temprana de riesgos y evidencias de control.



· Participar en el diseño y evaluación de controles de ciberseguridad para aplicaciones, datos e integraciones, tanto on-premise como cloud.



· Definir requerimientos de seguridad y criterios de aceptación para cada etapa del ciclo de vida, verificando evidencias antes de las decisiones de avance o puesta en producción.



· Coordinar la ejecución de las actividades necesarias de las áreas de la Dirección de Ciberseguridad, planificar las actividades, realizar el seguimiento de la ejecución en base a las prioridades acordadas y con una visión transversal en la implementación de los requerimientos respecto a ciberseguridad.



· Analizar casos de uso, flujos de información, fuentes de datos, modelos, prompts, agentes, herramientas, permisos e integraciones para evaluar exposición, privacidad, confidencialidad y uso responsable.



· Realizar evaluaciones de riesgo para nuevos casos de uso de datos e IA y recomendar controles proporcionales que habiliten la innovación de manera segura. Proponer alternativas que permitan adoptar IA de forma segura, con controles de acceso, minimización de datos, protección de información sensible, monitoreo, trazabilidad y supervisión humana según el riesgo.



· Evaluar riesgos asociados a LLMs, agentes y automatizaciones, tales como prompt injection, fuga o uso indebido de datos, respuestas no confiables, abuso de herramientas, permisos excesivos y dependencia de terceros.

Protocolos de ruteo dinámico, preferentemente OSPF y BGP.

Segmentación de red mediante VLANs, VRFs, subredes y políticas de conectividad.

Soluciones SD-WAN, conectividad distribuida y gestión de enlaces de telecomunicaciones.

postings.title: Especialista en Financiamiento Comercial
postings.descriptionText:
Ciudad : San Isidro 

País : Argentina (AR) 
Número de Requisición : 49181 








Objetivo del puesto

Potenciar las ventas y la rentabilidad de la compañía mediante el desarrollo de herramientas financieras, la generación de alternativas de financiamiento para clientes y la originacion y gestión activa de una cartera de créditos y activos financieros. La posición actuará como nexo entre las áreas comerciales, clientes y entidades financieras, transformando necesidades del negocio en soluciones que generen valor, reduzcan riesgos y contribuyan a los resultados económicos de la compañía.



Principales responsabilidades:



Gestión y desarrollo de herramientas financieras



• Administrar convenios y programas de financiamiento comercial con bancos, SGR, ALyCs, fintechs y fondos de inversión.


• Mantener una relación activa con entidades financieras para negociar condiciones comerciales e identificar nuevas oportunidades de negocio.


• Evaluar la conveniencia económica y el impacto comercial de diferentes alternativas de financiamiento.


• Diseñar, desarrollar e implementar nuevas soluciones financieras, coordinando su puesta en marcha con las áreas de Créditos, Finanzas, Contabilidad, Legales y Sistemas.



Originación y gestión de cartera de créditos



• Identificar, estructurar y ejecutar oportunidades de financiamiento que generen rentabilidad para la compañía.


• Originar, administrar y monitorear una cartera de créditos y activos financieros, maximizando el retorno ajustado por riesgo.


• Coordinar con las áreas Comercial, Créditos y Finanzas el análisis, instrumentación y seguimiento de operaciones.


• Definir estrategias de pricing, fondeo, renovación y distribución de riesgo.


• Detectar oportunidades de negocio que permitan generar soluciones de financiamiento innovadoras para clientes y para la compañía.



Soporte comercial y desarrollo de negocios



• Asesorar a clientes internos y externos sobre herramientas y alternativas de financiamiento.


• Participar en reuniones, visitas a clientes y eventos del sector para identificar oportunidades comerciales.


• Colaborar en el diseño e implementación de acciones comerciales vinculadas a soluciones financieras.


• Fortalecer el vínculo entre el negocio comercial y las herramientas financieras disponibles.



Reporting y mejora continua



• Elaborar reportes de gestión, utilización, rentabilidad y desempeño de programas financieros y cartera administrada.


• Gestionar la relación con plataformas financieras y herramientas tecnológicas vinculadas al negocio.


• Brindar soporte y capacitación a usuarios internos.


• Proponer e implementar mejoras operativas y de gestión que contribuyan a la eficiencia y al crecimiento del negocio.





Perfil técnico requerido





• Graduado/a en Economía, Administración de Empresas, Finanzas, Contador Público o carreras afines (Excluyente).


• Maestría en Finanzas finalizada o en curso (Excluyente).


• Experiencia mínima de 4 a 5 años en posiciones vinculadas a finanzas corporativas, financiamiento, mercado de capitales, banca, créditos o negocios financieros (Excluyente).


• Experiencia en análisis financiero, estructuración de operaciones de financiamiento y gestión de cartera de créditos (Excluyente).


• Manejo avanzado de Excel (Excluyente).


• Disponibilidad para realizar viajes frecuentes (aproximadamente 2 veces al mes) (Excluyente).


• Licencia de conducir vigente (Excluyente).


• Conocimientos de SAP (Deseable).


• Conocimientos de Tableau o herramientas de Business Intelligence (Deseable).





Competencias valoradas





• Fuerte iniciativa y orientación a la acción.


• Perfil analítico y capacidad para identificar oportunidades de negocio.


• Interés por desarrollar nuevas soluciones y desafiar procesos existentes.


• Excelentes habilidades de relacionamiento interpersonal y negociación.


• Orientación a resultados y visión comercial.


• Curiosidad, dinamismo y actitud proactiva.





Ubicación:



San Isidro, Buenos Aires.
Modalidad de trabajo híbrida. Disponibilidad para realizar viajes frecuentes dentro del país (aproximadamente dos veces al mes).

En Bunge (NYSE: BG), nuestro propósito es conectar a los agricultores con los consumidores para entregar alimentos, piensos y combustibles esenciales al mundo. Como proveedor líder de soluciones agroindustriales, nuestro equipo de ~34,000 empleados dedicados se asocia con agricultores de todo el mundo para trasladar los productos agrícolas desde donde se cultivan hasta donde se necesitan, de manera más rápida, inteligente y eficiente. Somos un líder mundial en originación, almacenamiento, distribución, procesamiento y refinación de oleaginosas, que ofrece una amplia cartera de aceites, grasas y proteínas de origen vegetal. Trabajamos junto con nuestros clientes en ambos extremos de la cadena de valor para ofrecer productos de calidad y desarrollar soluciones innovadoras y personalizadas que aborden las necesidades cambiantes de los consumidores. Con más de 200 años de experiencia y presencia en más de 50 países, estamos comprometidos a fortalecer la seguridad alimentaria mundial, promover la sostenibilidad y ayudar a las comunidades a prosperar donde operamos. Bunge tiene su domicilio social en Ginebra, Suiza, y su sede corporativa en St. Louis, Missouri. Obtenga más información en Bunge.com.



Cada día, nuestra gente ejemplifica estos valores, que representan la esencia de Bunge:


• SOMOS UN ÚNICO EQUIPO – Colaborativos, respetuosos, inclusivos
• LIDERAMOS EL CAMINO – Ágiles, empoderados, innovadores
• HACEMOS LO CORRECTO – Con seguridad, sustentabilidad e integridad



Reconocemos que nuestro éxito depende de las diversas perspectivas que cada uno de nuestros colaboradores aporta a Bunge. Nos esforzamos por promover acciones que fomenten una cultura de pertenencia. A nivel global, apoyamos iniciativas como los Principios para el Empoderamiento de las Mujeres, de ONU Mujeres. Colaboramos con organizaciones como Disability:IN, un referente en la inclusión de personas con discapacidad y trabajamos continuamente en pro de nuestro compromiso de dejar un legado positivo en todas las comunidades en las que operamos.

Si esto le suena bien, ¡únase a nosotros! Valoramos e invertimos en personas que creen en nuestro propósito y están entusiasmadas por vivirlo cada día: personas que están #OrgullosasDeSerBunge.

postings.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Most boards and executives are currently flying blind when it comes to cyber risk. They are guessing. At Safe, we’ve built an AI-driven engine that finally gives the C-Suite a clear, quantified, and real-time view of their security posture. We don’t just provide data; we provide certainty .

We are a $170M Series C-funded category leader. We don’t play in the mid-market; we operate at the highest levels of global enterprise. Today, we are proud to serve 10% of the Fortune 500 , protecting global icons such as Apple, Netflix, AT&T, Verizon, and Victoria’s Secret .

As we scale toward our next chapter, we are looking for high-performers who want to do the best work of their careers at the intersection of AI and Cybersecurity.

The Culture Memo: Our Operating System

Safe is not a typical corporate environment. We are a high-intensity, mission-driven team. We value builders who want to define a category and work alongside people who are equally committed to excellence.

•
Extreme Ownership: We don’t do "not my job." We hire people who see a gap and own the solution from start to finish.

•
The Elite Standard: We serve the most sophisticated companies on the planet. Our work must be bulletproof. Whether it’s a line of code or a sales deck, we aim for Tier-1 quality every time.

•
Methodology & Rigor: We don’t wing it. From Force Management and MEDDICC in sales to data-driven sprints in engineering, we rely on proven frameworks to stay disciplined and predictable.

•
Radical Candor: We move too fast for politics or sugar-coating. We value direct, honest feedback that helps us find the right answer quickly.

•
The Series C Hustle: We have the stability of a well-funded leader but the heart of a startup.

The Perks & Ownership:

We want our team to feel like owners because they are owners. We trust our people to manage their results and their time.

•
Meaningful Equity: Every "Safestar" is a shareholder. You aren’t just an employee; you are a partner in our success.

•
Unlimited Leaves: We don’t believe in clock-watching. We offer unlimited leave because we trust you to take the time you need to recharge while staying committed to the mission.

•
Comprehensive Benefits: We provide top-tier medical insurance and wellness benefits to ensure you and your family are well cared for.

•
Career Trajectory: We are growing aggressively. For high-performers, the path for advancement moves at the speed of your ambition.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you are the implementation owner of a customer’s success with SAFE, from the first onboarding call to a working, trusted deployment delivering value as a key part of their business processes. You sit between the customer's implementation teams and SAFE's engineering teams, understanding all sides well enough to translate between them. You have detailed product knowledge to be able to implement customers' business needs using existing features, and create customisations as needed.

In this role you will have a strong understanding of SAFE/Industry best practice, guiding the customer to achieve their outcomes on the SAFE Platform, This will include educating and enabling the customer, as well as a technical implementation.

You build the scripts, configure the platform, integrations, agents and automations that get a customer live. You diagnose what stands in the way of a customer's success, and where necessary engage internal teams with a clear, evidenced problem statement with an agreed outcome. You hold the end-to-end picture of how SAFE works, so a conversation between a customer and SAFE teams reaches a decision quickly.

You use AI tooling every day to engage with customers more effectively, work with more autonomy and enable others, improving existing processes and tooling to achieve rapid deployments and value realisation.

What you'll do:

Own customer onboarding and delivery

•
Lead technical onboarding for assigned customers: scope, plan, configure, integrate and confirm the customer is getting value.

•
Own each engagement to a defined outcome. Keep the customer and internal teams informed on progress, risks and next steps.

•
Travel to customer sites for workshops, deployments and escalations.

•
Write scripts and lightweight automations that speed up onboarding, data loading, integration set-up and repeat tasks.

Technical implementation

•
Collect technical details from customers about their environment, data sources and integrations: authentication, permissions, network constraints, payload formats and expected behaviour.

•
Configure and customise the SAFE platform to meet customer business needs, making direct product fixes where appropriate.

•
Build and test customer-specific workflows and AI agents, using SAFE and third-party APIs as needed.

•
Build custom solutions to achieve customer outcomes where product gaps exist.

•
Create tooling to accelerate delivery processes and automate repetitive tasks.

•
Diagnose failed or incomplete integrations and data flows.

Debug and troubleshoot

•
Reproduce and investigate issues using logs, platform telemetry and platform knowledge. Work methodically from symptom to evidence to cause, with or without AI tooling

•
Present each issue to engineering with the evidence: what happens, what should happen, who it affects, and what you have already ruled out.

•
Stay with the issue until the customer has a resolution or an agreed workaround.

Bridge the customer and engineering

•
Talk to engineering stakeholders as a peer. Define the outcome a customer needs, not the implementation.

•
Join customer and internal technical calls to provide expert guidance and drive project deliverables to completion.

•
Spot patterns across customers. Raise them as product feedback with the customer's business outcome and their own words.

•
Act as an internal customer, working closely with Product teams to ensure that new features are understood and have a clear route to deliver customer value.

Use AI tooling to scale your work

•
Use AI tools to analyse logs, draft scripts, summarise issues and prepare customer-facing material, using your experience to refine outcomes.

•
Turn repeated tasks into reusable scripts, AI skills or automations that the wider team can use.

What you'll bring:

Essential

•
Ownership and accountability. You take a problem as yours until it is closed, and you say so early when something slips.

•
Creative thinking and problem-solving. You find a route to success, resolving issues as you hit them.

•
Curiosity. Not everything is documented. You explore, discover and experiment to achieve an outcome.

•
Experience in script building, product delivery and working directly with customers. This can come from a customer-facing technical role or substantial project work.

•
Product onboarding experience. You have taken customers or users from set-up to live use of a technical product.

•
API fluency. You can read API documentation, call and chain endpoints, handle authentication, and interpret responses and errors.

•
Debugging and troubleshooting skills. You work methodically from symptom to evidence to cause, respecting customer data handling requirements.

•
Excellent written/verbal communication. You explain technical findings and concepts clearly to the level of the target audience, backed by an expert understanding of the system architecture.

•
Development. You write scripts that call APIs, process data, and automate customer tasks using Python as a preferred language. You understand code generated by AI tools for human review and challenge.

•
Cloud Services. You understand core cloud-based services and how they can be implemented at customers and used by SAFE.

postings.title: Enterprise Sales Executive, AI Solutions
postings.descriptionText:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce .

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

As an Enterprise Sales Executive at Toptal, you will be a key driver of growth within our AI Solutions business. In this role, you will identify, develop, and close opportunities with enterprise clients by helping them solve complex business challenges through forward-deployed AI solutions, AI software and platforms, AI services, and AI-enabled transformation.

You will develop tailored solutions that help clients move from AI strategy and experimentation into production, combining Toptal’s capabilities across AI Strategy & Transformation, Agentic Solutions, Data Services, AI Platforms, Industry Solutions, Joint Partner Solutions, and Managed Services to achieve measurable business outcomes.

This role is designed for true hunters who thrive in a high-performance, client-facing environment. It is ideal for individuals who have successfully sold enterprise AI solutions and are passionate about building a book of business from the ground up, forging executive relationships, and creating long-term client value. Success in this role is measured by your ability to convert new enterprise relationships into durable revenue and establish Toptal as a core AI services provider embedded in your clients’ most critical initiatives.

Enterprise AI has shifted rapidly from experimentation to execution. Companies are investing in models, agents, AI platforms, data infrastructure, and AI-enabled applications, but many are struggling to translate those investments into production systems and measurable business outcomes.

The challenge is no longer simply selecting an AI model or platform. Enterprises must identify the right workflows, connect AI to their proprietary data and knowledge, integrate existing systems, build and deploy agents and applications, establish evaluation and control frameworks, drive adoption, and continuously operate and improve AI in production.

Toptal brings together world-class AI and domain talent, forward-deployed solution delivery, AI platforms and capabilities, strategic technology partners, expert-in-the-loop operations, and managed services to help enterprises move from AI promise to production.

This role exists to convert that market opportunity into new enterprise relationships and position Toptal as a strategic partner for companies deploying AI across their organizations.

This is a remote position with significant client-facing fieldwork across the US. Applicants who reside within commutable distance of a major metropolitan area are strongly preferred. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

*The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

You will be responsible for building a targeted portfolio of accounts via identifying, prioritizing, and developing your own book of business rather than inheriting an existing one. Once you have signed net new customers, you will partner with Client Partners to deepen and expand those strategic relationships over time.

Net new accounts may begin with a specific AI initiative, workflow, platform implementation, or business problem requiring a disciplined approach to defining the opportunity and matching the right Toptal capabilities to the client’s needs. As relationships mature, accounts become more complex, with deeper engagement across multiple business units, workflows, technology platforms, and senior executive relationships.

These accounts demand a highly consultative, strategic approach that includes navigating cross-functional priorities, understanding the client’s AI and technology environment, aligning solutions to evolving business objectives, and demonstrating credibility at the C-suite level. Success will require the ability to adapt your engagement style to the maturity and complexity of each account while consistently driving measurable client value and long-term growth.

• Own and build a portfolio of enterprise AI accounts, with direct accountability for new logo acquisition, revenue growth, and client outcomes.

• Prospect, pitch, negotiate, and close new opportunities in close partnership with our Sales Development Representatives (SDRs), while expanding the relationships you establish.

• Define and execute account strategy, including opportunity creation, pipeline development, and multi-year growth planning.

• Lead AI solution development and deal execution in partnership with AI Services leadership, Industry GMs, Practice Leaders, Pursuits, Partnerships, and Delivery teams.

• Partner with Client Partners to drive coordinated account expansion and maximize total account value as accounts mature.

• Shape AI solutions that apply Toptal’s capabilities across AI Strategy & Transformation, Agentic Solutions, Data Services, AI Platforms, Industry Solutions, Joint Partner Solutions, and Managed Services to clients’ most important business and operating challenges.

• Maintain disciplined pipeline and account intelligence to support accurate forecasting and informed decision-making.

• Lead strategic conversations with prospective and existing clients, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.

In the first week, expect to:
