What you’ll be doing:

• Create and refine lighting setups for characters, props, and environments in Blender , ensuring shots meet the project's artistic vision, visual style, and storytelling goals.

• Collaborate with other departments to optimize lighting and scenes for rendering, ensuring efficiency while maintaining visual quality and consistency across shots.

• Work closely with the CG Supervisor, Leads, and other departments to maintain continuity of lighting, shading, colour, and mood throughout the project.

• Identify and troubleshoot technical issues related to lighting, shading, and rendering in Blender , and implement creative solutions to overcome them.

• Work within established lighting templates, tools, and workflows, contributing to improvements where appropriate to enhance efficiency, consistency, and quality.

• Manage lighting and rendering tasks, including setting up appropriate render settings and passes, optimizing scenes, and ensuring efficient render times.

• Conduct rigorous quality-control checks to ensure that final shots meet the project's artistic and technical standards, with particular attention to the visual quality and consistency of the stylized look.

Requirements

Ce que vous apporterez :

• 3 ans ou plus d’expérience professionnelle en tant qu’Artiste éclairage dans l’industrie de l’animation ou des effets visuels, avec une expérience en animation de longs métrages fortement souhaitée.

• Bonne maîtrise de Blender , particulièrement pour l’éclairage et le rendu dans un environnement de production ou sur des projets personnels, constitue un atout.

• Expérience avec des templates d’éclairage, des pipelines de production et des workflows établis; une expérience avec des pipelines basés sur Blender constitue un atout.

• Bonne compréhension des matériaux, du shading, des paramètres de rendu et de la relation entre l’éclairage et le look development , idéalement dans Blender.

• Familiarité avec les workflows de compositing et des logiciels tels que Nuke ou un équivalent.

• Expérience ou intérêt pour l’animation stylisée.

• Disponibilité pour commencer dès que possible dans le cadre d’un mandat de 8 semaines.

• Un reel d’éclairage démontrant un travail de qualité dans Blender constitue un atout.

What you’ll bring:

• Working proficiency in Blender , particularly lighting and rendering within a production environment or personal projects, is an asset.

• Experience working with established lighting templates, production pipelines, and workflows; experience with Blender-based pipelines is an asset.

• Strong understanding of colour theory, composition, cinematography, and lighting principles , with the ability to apply them to stylized animation.

• Strong understanding of materials, shading, render settings, and the relationship between lighting and look development , preferably in Blender.

Availability to start as soon as possible for an 8-week engagement .

postings.title: Quantitative Trading Analyst (part-time, equity-only)
postings.descriptionText:
About Qompyl

Qompyl is an early-stage fintech startup building a no-code, mobile-first platform that enables users to create, backtest, analyze, and monitor trading strategies.
Our mission is to make sophisticated quantitative trading tools more intuitive, visual, and accessible. We help traders turn ideas into rules they can test, understand how indicators behave, and evaluate strategy performance.

Role Overview
We are looking for a Quantitative Trading Analyst to research indicators, build and backtest systematic trading strategies, and validate the financial logic behind Qompyl ’s tools.
You will turn trading ideas into explicit, testable rules, evaluate how those rules perform across different assets and market conditions, and investigate results that don’t match expectations. You will work closely with our Product and Trading teams to document what you find and turn it into improvements to our indicator library, Strategy Builder, and backtesting experience.
You will also engage with traders and beta users to understand how they use the platform, where they run into friction, and what would help them test and interpret their strategies more effectively.

Core Responsibilities

Indicator Research & Validation

• Research and develop indicators for Qompyl . Specify their formulas, inputs, parameters, signal rules, and expected behavior.

• Verify indicator calculations and outputs against reference calculations or known examples. Investigate discrepancies and edge cases, including insufficient data, missing values, and signal timing.

• Evaluate how indicators behave across assets, timeframes, and market regimes. Document their limitations and the conditions that affect how traders should interpret them.

• Work with Product and Trading to translate validated indicator logic into functionality that traders can use in the Strategy Builder.

Systematic Strategy Research & Backtesting

• Translate trading hypotheses into rule-based strategies with clear entry, exit, execution, and position-sizing logic. Build and test them in Qompyl ’s Strategy Builder.

• Analyze returns, P&L, drawdowns, volatility, and risk-adjusted performance in the context of the strategy’s objectives and assumptions.

• Review how fees, slippage, and execution assumptions affect results. Identify potential sources of bias, including look-ahead bias and overfitting.

• Assess whether results hold across different market regimes, parameter settings, and out-of-sample periods where appropriate.

• Investigate unexpected results to determine whether they stem from market behavior, strategy assumptions, data quality, or platform logic. Document the steps needed to reproduce findings and propose improvements.

Product & Trader Collaboration

• Bring quantitative findings and a trader’s perspective to decisions about new indicators, Strategy Builder features, and how Qompyl presents backtest results.

• Engage with traders and beta users to understand how they formulate strategies, interpret metrics, and use the platform.

• Translate recurring questions and pain points into proposals for indicators, product improvements, or educational resources.

• Explain indicator behavior, performance metrics, and backtest limitations clearly to both traders and non-technical teammates.

Required Skills & Experience

• Practical knowledge of financial markets and trading mechanics, including order logic, position sizing, risk, returns, P&L, and drawdowns.

• Hands-on experience developing and backtesting systematic, rules-based trading strategies using historical market data.

• Ability to define and validate quantitative indicators or trading signals, including how they are calculated and when they trigger.

• Ability to interpret performance metrics, assess the assumptions behind a backtest, and identify results that warrant further investigation.

• Ability to document methodology, results, and limitations so others can reproduce your work and act on it.

• Strong communication skills and an interest in working with traders and product teams in a remote, asynchronous startup.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience using Python, Pine Script, SQL, or similar tools to analyze market data, prototype indicators, or independently verify calculations.

• Familiarity with TradingView or other strategy-building and backtesting platforms.

• Experience working across asset classes such as equities, ETFs, futures, forex, cryptocurrencies, or other derivatives.

• Experience contributing to a fintech or trading product, or supporting a community of traders.

Working Style & Culture
You enjoy following a trading idea from hypothesis to test results, investigating why something behaves unexpectedly, and making your findings clear enough for others to use. You take ownership of your work, are comfortable challenging assumptions, and collaborate with a globally distributed team as Qompyl ’s product and community evolve.

Time Commitment & Compensation
This is a fully remote, part-time role requiring approximately 12–15 hours per week, with scheduling flexibility.
Compensation is currently equity-only. Our goal is to introduce cash compensation alongside equity as Qompyl reaches key funding, product, and business milestones.

Argentina, Brazil
We are seeking an experienced Financial Crime Expert with deep subject-matter expertise in Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Counter-Terrorist Financing (CFT), sanctions compliance, and financial crime risk management. The successful candidate will translate complex regulatory requirements and business objectives into effective transaction monitoring strategies, detection scenarios, AI-driven models, and risk-based controls. This role requires a combination of regulatory expertise, analytical thinking, model validation experience, and customer advisory capabilities.

Regulatory Compliance & Advisory

• Serve as a subject-matter expert on global AML/CFT and sanctions regulations, including the Bank Secrecy Act (BSA), USA PATRIOT Act, EU AML Directives, OFAC requirements, and other applicable regulatory frameworks.

• Provide guidance to customers on regulatory expectations, financial crime risks, and effective compliance monitoring strategies.

• Support customers in aligning monitoring programs with regulatory obligations and industry best practices.

Financial Crime Detection & Risk Management

• Apply deep knowledge of money laundering, fraud, sanctions evasion, terrorist financing, and emerging financial crime typologies to enhance detection capabilities.

• Assess customer risk profiles and identify gaps in existing monitoring frameworks and controls.

• Evaluate detection coverage and recommend enhancements to improve effectiveness and mitigate financial crime risks.

Transaction Monitoring & Solution Optimization

• Translate business, operational, and regulatory requirements into transaction monitoring scenarios, sanctions screening rules, alert thresholds, and AI-driven detection models.

• Configure and optimize monitoring solutions to improve risk coverage, investigative efficiency, and alert quality.

• Support continuous enhancement of detection strategies based on evolving threats, regulatory changes, and customer requirements.

Model Validation & Performance Analysis

• Conduct model testing, validation, back-testing, and Above-the-Line/Below-the-Line (ATL/BTL) analysis to evaluate model effectiveness.

• Analyze detection performance, false-positive rates, and alert quality to improve monitoring outcomes.

• Validate AI and analytics-driven financial crime detection models and recommend tuning adjustments to enhance performance.

Banking & Payments Expertise

• Apply knowledge of banking operations, customer behavior, and payment processing workflows to support effective transaction monitoring.

• Utilize expertise in payment messaging standards and banking data structures, including SWIFT, ISO 20022, ACH, and wire transfers.

• Collaborate with technical teams to ensure accurate ingestion, mapping, and interpretation of financial transaction data.

Documentation & Model Governance

• Develop Model Methodology Guides (MMGs), model validation reports, risk assessments, and governance documentation.

• Ensure compliance with Model Risk Management (MRM) frameworks, validation standards, audit requirements, and internal governance processes.

• Support regulatory reviews, internal audits, and customer documentation needs.

Customer Engagement & Stakeholder Management

• Act as a trusted advisor to customer compliance, risk, and financial crime teams.

• Present findings, recommendations, validation results, and risk assessments to business and executive stakeholders.

• Lead workshops and discussions on financial crime trends, detection effectiveness, regulatory expectations, and monitoring best practices.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner closely with Compliance, Risk, First Line of Defense (1LoD), Second Line of Defense (2LoD), Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Customer Success teams.

• Support the design, implementation, validation, and continuous optimization of financial crime detection solutions.

• Contribute to product enhancements and innovation initiatives focused on AML, sanctions screening, and transaction monitoring.

Required Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience in AML, CFT, sanctions compliance, financial crime risk management, transaction monitoring, or regulatory compliance.

• Strong knowledge of global AML/CFT regulations and sanctions frameworks, including BSA, USA PATRIOT Act, EU AML Directives, and OFAC requirements.

• Deep understanding of financial crime typologies, including money laundering, sanctions evasion, fraud, terrorist financing, and suspicious transaction behaviors.

• Hands-on experience with transaction monitoring systems, sanctions screening platforms, detection scenarios, and AI-driven monitoring solutions.

• Proven experience in model testing, tuning, validation, back-testing, and ATL/BTL analysis.

• Strong understanding of banking products, financial transaction data, payment systems, and messaging standards, including SWIFT, ISO 20022, ACH, and wire transfers.

• Experience conducting financial crime risk assessments and evaluating monitoring and detection coverage.

• Knowledge of Model Risk Management (MRM), model governance frameworks, validation methodologies, and audit requirements.

• Experience creating Model Methodology Guides (MMGs), validation reports, risk assessments, and audit-ready documentation.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.

• Excellent customer-facing communication, presentation, and stakeholder-management abilities.

• Ability to collaborate effectively with compliance, risk, business, data science, and technical teams.

• Fluent English and Spanish, both written and spoken, are required.

Preferred Qualifications

• CAMS (Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist), CGSS, CFE, ICA, or equivalent financial crime certifications.

• Experience working within banks, fintech companies, payment providers, consulting firms, or financial crime technology vendors.

• Familiarity with machine learning, AI-powered risk detection, and model governance frameworks.

• Experience supporting regulatory examinations, independent validations, and model risk reviews.

• Knowledge of customer risk rating methodologies, KYC, CDD, EDD, sanctions screening, and adverse media monitoring.

Why Join Us?
You will work alongside a global team of technology and financial crime professionals helping leading financial institutions strengthen their AML, sanctions, and transaction monitoring capabilities. This role offers the opportunity to influence innovative AI-powered compliance solutions, partner directly with customers, and contribute to the evolution of financial crime detection technology.

At Matrix, our people are at the center of our success. We foster a collaborative, inclusive, and growth-oriented culture that values innovation, continuous learning, and professional development.
Join a winning team where your expertise will help organizations combat financial crime, improve compliance effectiveness, and drive meaningful business impact.

Description
SUMMARY
​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​The Senior Clinical Data Manager will lead and manage multiple clinical studies, ensuring that data are collected, managed and reported clearly, accurately and securely. In addition, this position is required to conduct all these activities in conformance with applicable regulatory requirements, industry guidelines, and Innovaderm standard operating procedures (SOPs) while respecting Indero ’s commitment to sponsor’s requirements and timelines

.
RESPONSIBILITIES
More specifically, the Senior Clinical Data Manager must:
· Adhere and promote company organizational values and related expected behaviors, follow company SOPs and processes for all deliverables, and ensure all trainings assigned to oneself are completed on time.

• Be the data management liaison to the project team, sponsor and external vendors, as needed.

• Be able to manage three to four concurrent studies independently, with minimal supervision.

• Be able to take decision with minimal support from manager.

• Attend meeting with sponsor and answers Data Management related question.

• Provides input for timelines and monitor scope of work to ensure timely and within budget completion of assigned tasks.

• Be responsible for the development of electronic case report form (eCRF) specifications (including data capture screens and edit check specifications) needed to build a study-specific clinical database/electronic data capture (EDC) system.

• Be responsible for or assist in the programming and ongoing maintenance of the clinical database.

• Be responsible for the validation and testing of the clinical database (e.g. User Acceptance Testing).

• Be responsible for the development of eCRF completion guidelines and other training material required to train site users and monitors.

• Conduct training for site users/monitors on the clinical database.

· Develop data transfer agreements and specifications with vendors providing external data (e.g. laboratory results).

• Conduct reconciliation between external data and data in the EDC system to ensure consistency, including reconciliation with sponsor safety databases for adverse events/serious adverse events data (if needed).

• Provide support to study team in the development of external systems capturing clinical data, e.g. ePRO or IWRS, and ensuring that any data transfer requirements between these systems and EDC are documented and tested appropriately.

• Be responsible for the development of the data management plan (DMP), and other clinical data management related documentation.

• Be responsible for ongoing data review/cleaning during study conduct and also during preparation for database lock/close.

• Code medical terms in the clinical database, as required.

• Generates data listings and reports needed for data review by the project manager (or other study team members) in preparation for database close/lock.

• Monitor study status (e.g. enrollment, CRFs monitored/approved, etc.) on an ongoing basis and provides data status reports to the project team, as needed.

• Ensure that data management documentation is complete and up-to-date in the trial master file (TMF).

• Respond to users requiring assistance with the EDC system.

• Be responsible for archiving of the clinical database and related documents.

• Participate in the definition, writing and updating of data management Work Instructions

• Mentor and train Clinical Data Coordinators, as needed.

• Provide basic support to less experienced Clinical Data Managers, as needed.

· For any studies where any of the above activities have been outsourced to an external service provider:

•

• Oversee/manage the vendor to ensure that timelines and deliverables meet with sponsor and protocol requirements;

• Ensure that their work is done in accordance with effective work orders and Innovaderm SOPs (if applicable).

Employee may be assigned to other responsibilities that do not pertain to their former description, if they have the required experience, are qualified and/or have received adequate training.

Requirements
· B.Sc. or in a related field of study.
· M. Sc. or in a related field of study is an asset;
· 5 to 8 years of clinical data management experience in clinical research in the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or contractual research organization (CRO) industry.
· Understanding of the drug development process and of applicable regulations, including Good Clinical Practices, ICH Guidelines.
· Extensive experience working with EDC systems, and/or database structures.
· Demonstrated skills in database programming an asset.
· Good understanding of CDISC SDTM/CDASH standards;
· Highly organized and detail-oriented with effective project planning and time management skills.
· Strong verbal and written communication skills in English, French an asset.

· Good knowledge of MS Excel.
· Knowledge of SAS or similar, an asset;
· Excellent problem solving abilities;
· Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with demonstrated agility to organize and prioritize multiple competing demands.
· Knowledge of MedDRA and WHODrug dictionaries.
· Good knowledge of good clinical practices, and applicable Health Canada and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations/guidelines.

Our company
The work environment
At Indero , you will work with brilliant and driven colleagues. Our values are collaboration, innovation, reliability, and responsiveness. We offer a stimulating work environment and attractive advancement opportunities.
In this position, you will be eligible for the following perks:

• Permanent full-time position

• Flexible schedule

• Vacation

• Home-based position

• Ongoing learning and development

About Indero
Formerly known as Innovaderm, Indero is a world-renowned expert and clinical research leader in dermatology. We have more than two decades of experience serving a broad range of indications, patient populations, administration routes, and drug classes, and a global footprint.
Indero is a dual-focus CRO for dermatology and rheumatology, with 25+ years’ experience in clinical research and trial delivery. Our full-service approach – which includes everything from protocol design and patient recruitment to trial monitoring and biometrics – provides biotech and pharmaceutical sponsors with the rigorous scientific foundation and tailored expertise their studies need to reach the finish line efficiently and effectively. With capabilities in North America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Latin America; vast, continuously growing relationships with investigators and patients; and a dedicated research clinic through which we design and execute our own studies, Indero is the ideal CRO partner for clinical needs at global scale.
Indero is committed to providing equitable treatment and equal opportunity to all individuals. As such, Indero will provide accommodations throughout the recruitment and selection process to applicants with disabilities, upon request.

Tech Stack

postings.title: Remote Academic Coach & Student Assistant (Part-Time)
postings.descriptionText:
We're Hiring
Remote Academic Coach & Student Assistant (Part-Time, ~10 hours/week)
The steady partner who helps a high-achieving student master hard material and never miss a deadline.

About the Role
Seamless Assist is hiring a part-time Academic Coach & Student Assistant for a US-based family. You will work one-on-one, online, with their daughter, a motivated high-school student taking classes a year ahead of her grade, including several college-level Advanced Placement (AP) courses. This role reports to the student's parent.

Why This Role Exists
The student doesn't need to be taught from scratch. She is carrying a demanding, writing-heavy course load, and the pressure is in the volume: essays, problem sets, labs, tests and extracurricular deadlines all landing in the same week. This role exists to give her a sharp, organised partner who can keep up with advanced material, help her work through the hardest parts, and keep her schedule under control so nothing slips.

Her Current Classes

• AP Microeconomics & Macroeconomics

• AP Biology

• AP English Language & Composition

• AP US History

• Pre-Calculus

• Spanish 4

• Journalism & News Production

You don't need to be an expert in every subject. You do need to be strong in several of them, especially writing-heavy courses (AP English Language, AP US History) and at least one of economics, biology or maths.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

Academic coaching (about 70% of your time)

• Run live one-on-one video sessions to work through homework, problem sets, essays and test preparation.

• Explain difficult concepts clearly and check that she can explain them back.

• Review essays and written work for argument, structure, evidence and citations, including AP-style timed essays.

• Build practice questions, review plans and study guides ahead of tests and the AP exams in May.

• Learn how each course is taught and graded (syllabi, teacher rubrics, the College Board AP course frameworks) and coach to them.

• Coach, never complete. Her work must always be her own, in line with her school's academic integrity rules.

Planning and student assistant support (about 30% of your time)

• Run a weekly planning session: map every class's assignments, tests and deadlines into a shared calendar and task list.

• Keep her schedule current across classes, activities and appointments, with study time blocked in.

• Send short reminders before deadlines and confirm work was actually submitted.

• Track grades and flag early when something starts to slip.

• Send the parent a short weekly progress update.

Schedule
About 10 hours per week. Sessions fall on weekday afternoons and evenings, US Pacific Time (roughly 3:30–8:30 pm PT), plus one short weekend planning session. You must be reliably available in that window.

Who Will Succeed in This Role
This is a high-trust role with a bright, busy teenager. You will need real subject depth, patience, and the organisational discipline of a strong executive assistant.

• You explain things clearly and can tell the difference between "I get it" and actually getting it.

• You are a strong writer and can give specific, useful feedback on an argumentative essay.

• You run your own life from a calendar and a task list, and you follow up without being asked.

• You are warm, steady and encouraging, and you hold a high standard.

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree or higher, ideally in education, English, history, economics, biology, mathematics or a related field.

• At least 2 years of tutoring or teaching high-school or first-year university students.

• Strong command of the material in several of the subjects listed above.

• Excellent written and spoken English. Your writing will be assessed during screening.

• Uses AI tools in your daily work (for example Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini) to build study materials and plan faster, and can teach a student to use them responsibly and within school rules.

• Able to work US Pacific Time afternoons and evenings, about 10 hours per week.

• Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet workspace, a webcam and a backup power or internet plan.

• Willing to complete a national police clearance or background check and provide two professional references before starting.

Nice to have

• Experience with the US Advanced Placement (AP) programme, or strong AP, SAT, IB or A-Level results of your own.

• Conversational or better Spanish.

• Journalism, editing or newsroom experience.

• Comfortable in Google Workspace (Calendar, Docs, Drive) and a task tool such as Notion or Todoist.

How We Work
Because this role involves working one-on-one with a teenager, clear safeguards apply. All sessions run on a family-owned video account and are recorded. All messages go through a group channel that includes a parent. There is no private messaging or social-media contact with the student. A background check and references are required before the first paid session.

Pay
Competitive hourly pay, paid monthly in USD. Pay varies by country.

How to Apply
Apply with your CV. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a short AI-led video interview, a written subject task, an interview with the family and a paid trial session.

Key Responsibilities:

• Capture precise motion data using your smartphone’s IMU sensors during specified physical activities.

• Record synchronized video footage to ensure data accuracy and enhance the integrity of all collected motion data.

• Follow detailed technical protocols to consistently meet strict quality, labeling, and determinism standards.

• Deliver a minimum of 10 hours of high-quality, approved video data each week throughout the project’s duration.

• Communicate clearly and proactively with the team to clarify requirements and share insights on data collection practices.

• Maintain timely and reliable delivery of your outputs, aligned with project milestones and expectations.

• Participate in device compatibility checks and an innovative, AI-enabled interview process as part of onboarding.

Required Skills and Qualifications:

• Access to a head strap to be able to record both hands within 48 hours of the start date.

• Supported devices include the iPhone 12 and later, Google Pixel 6 and later, and Samsung Galaxy S21 and later.

• Meticulous attention to detail and a proven record of following standardized protocols.

• Demonstrated ability to consistently manage output and meet deadlines in a dynamic, data-driven environment.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills essential for documentation and remote collaboration.

• Advanced tech-savviness and experience with mobile devices for sensor and video data capture.

• Physical ability to engage in repetitive movement tasks safely and effectively.

• Access to a compatible smartphone capable of high-fidelity data collection.

•
Note: Applications submitted with a Gmail address are strongly preferred for seamless tool integration.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Background in robotics, kinesiology, sensor-based data collection, or related technical disciplines.

• Experience with human motion analysis, activity segmentation, or machine learning dataset labeling.

• Familiarity with structuring large-scale datasets for AI and robotics applications.

Compensation Structure
Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per recorded video that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply: videos must be at a specific length defined by the project, and experts must submit a minimum of 10 to 15 hours of video per week .

Start Timeline & Availability
We typically fill roles within 48 hours , so we’re looking for teammates who are ready to jump in. If selected, we’d love for you to start your first task as soon as you move forward with your application. The expectation is to begin within ~24 hours of completing onboarding.

Equipment Requirements

Mobile:
Tasks for this project must be performed from a mobile device (smartphone) . Experts will record their workflow directly from the mobile device while completing tasks.
Head Strap / Wearable: Tasks for this project must be performed using a head-mounted camera (head strap setup) . Experts will record first-person video of physical tasks. The required head strap and any accompanying equipment specifications will be shared during onboarding.

IMPORTANT DISCLAIMER:
Candidates who meet the project’s location and equipment requirements will be contacted soon to complete an identity verification process. Selected candidates should be able to complete this ID verification within 48 hours of being contacted. Successful verification is required before the contract can be issued for signature.

uPhone was founded on a simple belief: staying connected abroad should not be expensive, complicated, or stressful. The company sources eSIM data plans from multiple suppliers across 150+ countries so travellers can get a fair price — without hidden fees, locked contracts, roaming charges, or the plastic waste of a physical SIM card.
What uPhone eSIM is, in practice: an eSIM is a digital SIM profile built into the phone. Customers choose a country, regional, or global data plan (5,000+ plans are listed, including unlimited-data options and a Globetrotter plan covering 150+ countries on one eSIM), pay securely (card or PayPal; other methods, including crypto on the Crypto eSIM checkout, are listed on the site), and receive a QR code by email — typically within seconds. They scan it in iPhone or Android settings and can be connected in under two minutes, with no store visit. The physical SIM stays in the phone, so the home number remains available. Plans are listed from about $2, with no contract.
uPhone publishes 24/7 customer support via live chat and email (the help centre cites a typical response time under two minutes), a 30-day unused-eSIM refund if the QR code has not been scanned and the eSIM has not been installed or activated, and a rating of 4.8/5 from 50,000+ travellers who trust the service.

The role
We are hiring a Customer Service Manager to lead uPhone's support operation.
Travellers contact us when they are about to fly, when they have just landed, or when a plan will not activate. The site promises 24/7 support by live chat and email, with a typical response time under two minutes, plus a clear 30-day unused-eSIM refund policy. Your job is to make that promise real: build and run the team, the coverage, the quality, and the processes behind it.
This is a fully remote, full-time, player-coach role on a small team — you can work from anywhere in the world. You will handle complex cases yourself, coach agents, set standards, and feed traveller issues back to product and suppliers so the same problems are not answered twice.
Responsibilities
- Lead day-to-day customer service across live chat and email, including coverage planning for 24/7 support, on a small remote team.
- Set and track service standards (response time, resolution time, quality, refund accuracy, and tone). Protect the published typical response time of under two minutes, or recommend an honest change if that standard cannot be met.
- Coach and develop support staff, including onboarding, macros and quality reviews, feedback, and performance management, and contribute to hiring as the team grows.
- Own the support knowledge base and macros so answers about installation, device compatibility, coverage, top-ups, refunds, and troubleshooting stay accurate as plans and policies change.
- Handle and escalate complex cases: failed activations, APN or device issues, carrier locks, payment or refund disputes, and supplier outages — and make sure travellers are not left mid-trip without a path to a fix.
- Apply the 30-day unused-eSIM refund policy consistently (full refund only if the QR code has not been scanned and the eSIM has not been installed or activated; installed or activated eSIMs are non-refundable even if no data was used), and flag edge cases.
- Report volume, themes, and product or supplier issues to the rest of the team, and propose changes that reduce repeat contacts.
- Use the team's live-chat, email, and knowledge-base tools to keep quality and reporting consistent.
Requirements
- Experience leading or supervising a customer service or support team, preferably in a 24/7, chat-and-email, or travel / e-commerce / telecom environment.
- Able to design rotas, quality standards, and simple processes that still work when the team is small and remote.
- Excellent written English and a calm, precise tone with customers who may be stressed or offline at an airport.
- Strong judgement on refunds, policy exceptions, and when to escalate a technical or supplier issue.
- Comfortable being hands-on with tickets as well as managing the function.
- You can be based anywhere in the world; there is no country restriction. You should have the legal right to work from where you live. Because support is 24/7, you should be comfortable coordinating coverage across time zones.
Nice-to-haves
- Experience with eSIM, mobile connectivity, travel, or consumer marketplaces.
- Additional languages, especially those used by travellers in Europe and Asia.
- Experience running QA, help-centre content, or support-to-product feedback loops.
- Familiarity with support platforms and reporting (for example live chat, a shared inbox, or an ITSM / helpdesk tool).
- Experience handling payments, chargebacks, or refund operations.
What we offer
- This is a fully remote, full-time role. You can work from anywhere in the world; there is no country restriction.
- Flexible hours, with the coordination needed to cover 24/7 support across time zones.
- Travel perks, as described on uPhone's careers page.
- Real ownership and impact on a small team, with little unnecessary process.
- Competitive pay, negotiable based on experience.
Reference: UPH-CSM-2611
How to apply
Email . Applications sent without the code word in the subject line will not be considered — this is how we check that candidates follow directions.
How to find the code word
1. Search uPhone eSIM on Google.
2. Open the official site, ().
3. Go to the About Us () page.
4. Find the code word on that page.
5. Put that exact word in your email subject line.
Subject line format: UPH-CSM-2611 — Customer Service Manager — [code word from the About Us page]
Please include
- A short note on why you want to work at uPhone, and what you would do in this role.
- Your CV / résumé (PDF).
- Optional: a LinkedIn profile, portfolio, or relevant work samples.
Do not ask us to tell you the code word. If you have followed the steps above, you will have it.

postings.descriptionText:
Remote, Latin America (minimum 4-hour overlap with US Eastern hours) | Engineering | Reports to: Technical Lead
Time Doctor is hiring a Senior DevOps Engineer to run and scale the cloud infrastructure behind our platform. Most of it runs on Google Cloud, with our main workloads on Cloud Run, all defined in Terraform across 40+ environments. Some legacy systems still run on AWS. Your job is to keep it secure, available and quick to change, and to give our DevOps coverage a base in the Americas so that issues during US business hours have an owner in the room.

Who we are
Time Doctor is a workforce analytics platform that gives distributed teams the visibility they need to improve trust and performance. We serve remote, hybrid and outsourced organisations worldwide, with particular strength in BPO, healthcare and tech services. We are bootstrapped, profitable and fully remote, with team members across 30+ countries. We built a durable business on customer revenue rather than venture capital, and we are now focused on growing it.

The role
You will design, build and operate the infrastructure behind our production, staging, sandbox and customer-specific deployments. You own it hands-on, from Terraform modules and CI/CD pipelines to monitoring, security and your place on the on-call roster.

Three things define this seat.

• The platform. Google Cloud is home. Our main workloads run on Cloud Run, alongside GKE, Cloud Functions, Cloud Build, VPC networking, Cloud Armor and Load Balancers, all managed as code. You need real depth on a major cloud. If that depth is on AWS or Azure, we expect it to carry over to GCP quickly.

• The coverage. Our DevOps team works from time zones a long way from most of our customers. This seat exists to cover US Eastern hours, which is why we are hiring in Latin America.

• The operating model. Infrastructure as code, GitOps and automation by default. If a task gets done twice, it gets scripted.

Who you are

• You treat production as yours. When something breaks, you own it until it is fixed and written up.

• You design, not just build. You pick the right services for each workload, with cost and security in mind, and you can explain the trade-offs.

• You stay calm in an incident and you are clear in the follow-up afterwards.

• You think in modules and environments, not one-off changes.

• You automate repetitive work in Bash, Python or Go.

• You care about security: least-privilege access, secrets in Secret Manager, nothing sensitive in code.

• You communicate clearly in English, live and async.

• You are organised and self-directed. You thrive fully remote.

What you will own

• Infrastructure as code. Terraform across 40+ environments, reusable modules that follow DRY principles, and multi-environment management through GitOps workflows and Terraform Cloud.

• GCP services. Cloud Run, where our main workloads run, plus GKE, Cloud Functions, Cloud Build, VPC networking, Cloud Armor and Cloud Load Balancers. Debugging serverless services in production is part of the job.

• CI/CD. Pipelines in GitHub Actions, Helm or Cloud Deploy that let our engineers ship safely and often.

• Data infrastructure. Redis (Cloud Memorystore) for caching, session management and real-time features.

• Security. IAM, Secret Manager and our security services, and acting on what security scans find.

• Observability and on-call. Proactive monitoring and alerting with GCP Monitoring, Grafana and similar tools, and a place on the on-call support roster.

• Our AWS footprint. Keeping the legacy systems we still run on AWS stable.

This role may not suit you if

• You've touched many cloud services but haven't designed and run production infrastructure end to end yourself.

• You prefer clicking through a console to defining infrastructure as code.

• You want to work purely async. This seat needs real overlap with US Eastern hours.

• You are not willing to be part of an on-call roster.

• You need detailed direction before you can move.

What a realistic week looks like
A Terraform module refactor that lets a new customer-specific environment come up from a pull request. A pipeline change that cuts deploy time. A secret moved out of code and into Secret Manager without breaking the services that read it. An alert tuned so it fires before customers notice anything. A handover with teammates in New Zealand, and live collaboration during US Eastern hours.

Requirements

Your experience

• 5+ years of hands-on DevOps experience running production cloud environments, including designing infrastructure yourself, not only building to someone else's design.

• Deep production experience on at least one major cloud, ideally Google Cloud. That includes running and debugging serverless container workloads (Cloud Run, or an equivalent such as AWS ECS Fargate or Azure Container Apps), Kubernetes, VPC networking, load balancing, IAM and secrets management.

• Terraform for complex multi-environment setups, including writing your own modules.

• CI/CD with tools such as GitHub Actions, Helm or Cloud Deploy.

• Scripting in Bash, Python or Go to automate infrastructure work.

• Setting up proactive monitoring and observability with GCP Monitoring, Grafana or similar tools.

• Fluent English for technical discussions and incident calls.

• A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• Based in Latin America, with at least four hours of daily overlap with US Eastern hours, and available for the on-call roster.

Nice to have

• Google Cloud as your main production platform.

•
AWS experience, for our legacy systems.

•
Terraform Cloud and GitOps workflows.

• Google Cloud certifications, such as Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer.

• Experience running customer-specific or single-tenant deployments for a B2B SaaS product.

The team you are joining
You will report to our Technical Lead and join a small DevOps team working from other time zones, including New Zealand. You will be the team's first member in the Americas, and you will work closely with the engineering teams who rely on the platform every day.

How we will measure success

• Platform availability and incident response during your coverage hours.

• Infrastructure changes delivered as code: reviewed, repeatable and documented.

•
Faster, safer deployments through CI/CD.

• A stronger security posture across secrets, access and scan findings.

• Less manual work because of the automation you build.

Why this role

• You own real production infrastructure for a SaaS platform used by thousands of organisations.

• A modern GCP stack, all in Terraform, across 40+ environments.

• We are profitable and bootstrapped. Your budget comes from customers, not from a burn rate.

• Professional development resources and a learning budget.

• Fully remote and flexible, working with talented people in 30+ countries.

Our hiring approach
This is a full-time, 100% remote role. We are an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status or disability.
We hire globally, and this particular role requires you to be based in Latin America with at least four hours of daily overlap with US Eastern hours. Our Talent Attraction team will walk you through the details during your first conversation.

postings.title: Transfer of Knowledge & Technology Manager
postings.descriptionText:
Transfer of Knowledge & Technology Manager

About Satellogic

Satellogic (NASDAQ: SATL) builds the infrastructure for Persistent Global Intelligence (PGI): continuous, proactive awareness of the places, assets, and activities that matter. We're leading the transition from episodic Earth observation — buying an image after something happens — to persistent monitoring programs that give customers earlier awareness, faster decisions, and greater control over mission-critical information.
We do it through a coordinated stack that combines high-cadence satellite collection, fit-for-purpose satellite economics, AI-accelerated workflows, and sovereign-trusted architecture. Our vertically integrated approach and patented optical design make our satellites 10x more affordable with 10x more capacity than industry standard, which is what makes persistent monitoring at global scale economically viable in the first place.
We serve allied defense and intelligence agencies, civil governments, and select commercial markets that manage large portfolios of mission-critical sites, assets, and operations. Customers can begin with discovery, expand into persistent monitoring, and build toward dedicated capacity or sovereign-controlled infrastructure as their mission requirements grow.
With a globally distributed team, we bring together expertise in satellite engineering, software, data science, manufacturing, operations, and go-to-market. We're purpose-driven builders who value ownership, curiosity, and execution — and who work with humility, honesty, and empathy.

Role overview
The Transfer of Knowledge and Technology (ToK/ToT) Manager will lead the design, planning, and execution of customer capability-development programs.
The role will translate Satellogic ’s technical knowledge and real-world experience into customer’s organizational know-how and enduring capabilities (ToK); and Satellogic ’s cutting edge technology into customer’s full sovereign capability to design, manufacture and operate space missions (ToT). More than classroom-based training, ToK programs may cover the full lifecycle of an Earth observation mission, including space systems engineering, satellite design and qualification, assembly, integration and testing, mission design, satellite and mission operations, ground systems, and data processing.
The ToT/ToK Manager will work closely with Satellogic ’s engineering, operations, product, program management, IP, Compliance and commercial teams, as well as customer organizations, universities, and other external partners.

Key responsibilities

• Own the end-to-end planning and delivery of customer ToT, ToK, and sovereign capability-development programs.

• Develop structured curricula covering relevant areas of the satellite and mission lifecycle, including:

• Space systems engineering principles and processes.

• Mission analysis and mission design.

• Satellite architecture and subsystem design.

• Design reviews and technical decision-making.

• Qualification and verification methodologies.

• Assembly, integration, and testing engineering.

• Satellite commissioning and in-orbit validation.

• Satellite and mission operations.

• Ground-segment systems and operations.

• Payload data processing and product generation.

• Program management, configuration management, and quality assurance.

• Design OJT programs based on practical engineering activities, representative scenarios, and lessons learned from the development, qualification, manufacturing, launch, and operation of Satellogic ’s Newsat platform.

• Convert the knowledge held by Satellogic subject-matter experts into repeatable training modules, practical exercises, case studies, technical documentation, and evaluation materials.

• Coordinate technical instructors and mentors across Satellogic , ensuring that their contributions are properly planned and that training commitments do not create unmanaged disruption to ongoing programs.

• Define learning objectives, competency frameworks, participant prerequisites, assessment methods, and completion criteria for each program.

• Tailor curricula and delivery models to customer objectives, starting capabilities, facilities, regulatory environment, and desired level of operational or industrial autonomy.

• Manage all logistics associated with training execution, including scheduling, facilities, travel, access requirements, equipment, training environments, materials, and participant coordination.

• Develop and manage partnerships with universities, research institutions, and specialized training organizations to complement Satellogic ’s internal expertise and support long-term customer capability development.

• Work with program managers to ensure that training activities, contractual deliverables, acceptance criteria, dependencies, risks, and milestones are properly defined and tracked.

• Establish metrics to evaluate training effectiveness, knowledge retention, participant progression, and readiness to perform the targeted functions independently.

• Support commercial and proposal teams in defining ToT/ToK scope, delivery schedules, resource requirements, assumptions, and pricing.

• Ensure that training programs comply with Satellogic ’s intellectual-property, export-control, security, confidentiality, and technology-transfer requirements.

• Capture lessons learned and continuously improve Satellogic ’s standard ToT/ToK offering.

Qualifications

Required

• Professional experience in the space industry or a closely related aerospace or high-technology sector.

• Strong understanding of satellite programs and the lifecycle of space-system development, integration, qualification, deployment, or operations.

• Experience managing complex technical programs involving multiple disciplines and stakeholders.

• Demonstrated ability to structure complex technical knowledge into clear learning paths, work plans, and deliverables.

• Strong planning, coordination, and project-management capabilities.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to work effectively with engineers, executives, government customers, academic institutions, and international partners.

• Ability to manage multiple workstreams, instructors, locations, and customer dependencies simultaneously.

• Professional fluency in English and willingness to travel internationally.

Preferred

• Academic, teaching, technical-training, or curriculum-development experience.

• Experience developing or delivering OJT programs in engineering or operational environments.

• Experience with systems engineering, satellite AIT, mission operations, ground systems, or Earth observation data processing.

• Experience working on international technology-transfer, industrialization, localization, or sovereign capability-development programs.

• Experience establishing partnerships with universities or research institutions.

• Familiarity with export controls, intellectual-property protections, and security constraints affecting international space programs.

• Advanced degree in aerospace engineering, systems engineering, another relevant technical field, education, or program management.

Profile
The ideal candidate combines enough technical depth to understand a complete space program with the organizational and educational skills required to turn that knowledge into an effective capability-development journey. They should be comfortable coordinating senior technical experts without needing to be the leading specialist in every domain.

postings.title: Engineer II
postings.descriptionText:
Hello! We are Cashea 👋 and our mission is to give Venezuelans back the opportunity to access credit through a BNPL business model. Since our launch in 2022, we have been dedicated to promoting financial inclusion. Today we have more than 9 million active users, both consumers and merchants, and we have become a trusted brand in Venezuela, winning hearts and minds.

About the role
We’re looking for a Senior Cloud Engineer who builds the platform the rest of engineering relies on. You’ll own our Infrastructure-as-Code on Google Cloud Platform : the modules, wrappers, networking, and pipelines that let dozens of teams ship services safely across our domains.
This is hands-on building. We run everything on GCP with OpenTofu and Terragrunt , a layered and versioned IaC platform of reusable modules and opinionated wrappers, consumed by a live repo that defines what runs in dev, staging, and production. You’ll design that platform, extend it as we grow, and answer for how it behaves when teams use it. The engineers who grow fastest here go deep, codify sensible defaults, and leave the platform safer and easier to use than they found it.

Overall you will…

• Design and build reusable IaC modules and wrappers in OpenTofu (Terraform) and Terragrunt , with sensible, governed defaults.

• Provision and evolve our GCP estate: Cloud Run, GKE, Cloud SQL (PostgreSQL), Memorystore Redis, Pub/Sub, BigQuery, Datastream, Cloud Composer, and GCS.

• Own our network architecture, including Shared VPC, per-domain subnets, Cloud NAT, Cloud DNS, firewall policies, private connectivity (PSA/PSC), and internal and external load balancing.

• Design least-privilege IAM with service accounts, Workload Identity, and keyless auth, so least privilege is the default for every workload.

• Build and maintain CI/CD for infrastructure with GitHub Actions , Workload Identity Federation, plan-on-PR and apply-on-comment flows, and policy and security checks (TFLint, Trivy).

• Make architectural and system-design decisions across our multi-environment, multi-region setup (us-east1 with us-west1 for DR), and own the trade-offs behind them.

• Manage Terraform and Terragrunt state, versioning, and the safe rollout of platform changes across many consuming teams.

• Raise the engineering bar through code reviews, clear standards, and documentation that makes the platform self-serve.

• Mentor engineers and lead technical discussions, leaving the team stronger than you found it.

Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 5+ years of cloud and infrastructure engineering experience, with strong hands-on depth in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) .

• Production experience with Terraform or OpenTofu , and ideally Terragrunt , building reusable and versioned infrastructure rather than only consuming it.

• Solid grasp of GCP networking: VPCs (ideally Shared VPC), subnets, Cloud NAT, DNS, firewall policies, and private connectivity (PSA/PSC).

• Strong IAM fundamentals: least privilege, service accounts, and Workload Identity or federation.

• Experience operating managed GCP services such as Cloud Run, GKE, Cloud SQL (PostgreSQL), and Memorystore Redis.

• Comfort with Git-based workflows and CI/CD (GitHub Actions or similar), and treating infrastructure changes with the same rigor as application code.

• A track record of making architectural calls and owning infrastructure end-to-end in a fast-moving context.

• Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly, and to mentor others effectively.

• Excellent problem-solving and analytical thinking, with genuine curiosity about new technology.

Desirable skills

• Experience with GKE specifics such as private and regional clusters, Workload Identity, Dataplane V2, and managed Prometheus.

• Familiarity with data and messaging services: Pub/Sub, Cloud Tasks, BigQuery, Datastream (CDC), and Cloud Composer (Airflow).

• Experience with API platforms such as Apigee , plus Artifact Registry and Cloud Build.

• Secrets management with GCP Secret Manager .

• Scripting in Bash or Python for operational tooling and automation.

• Experience building in fintech, payments, or credit.

•
Spanish and English proficiency.

Why you'll love working at Cashe
At Cashea , we have a work culture based on trust and purpose. If you need a clue as to why we are a good choice, these are our core values:

• We don't work on autopilot. Everything we do is intentional. We love to develop ideas with full awareness of the impact they can have on our users.

• Your creativity and curiosity are our most important assets.

• Your voice matters. We listen and make space for ideas and feedback. Everyone belongs, and what's important to you is important to us.

• We value transparency. Clarity keeps us connected and grounded.

• Last but not least, we focus on real impact.

If you want to work with us, fill out the application. We'd love to meet you!

postings.descriptionText:
Who We Are:

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A day in the life:
You'll sit on the fusepoint Marketing Science Team and own the data behind Power Digital's measurement products: Media Mix Modeling (MMM) and incrementality testing (Matched Market Testing, MMT). Our measurement tools are used by internal and external teams to read model results, plan budgets, pick test markets and report on incrementality tests. Your job is to make sure the data needed for measurement analysis is clean, reconciled and ready for modeling, so the analysts and data scientists spend their time on modeling, not cleanup.
You'll work closely with the Data Team to support, maintain, and engineer data sources related to measurement and marketing metrics.

Key Responsibilities:

•
Own the MMM data layer in Snowflake. Build and maintain model-ready daily and weekly marts for each client that combine paid media (spend, impressions, clicks by channel and campaign), ecommerce revenue and orders (new vs. returning, gross and net, refunds, discounts), site and email/SMS data from GA4, and any non-media drivers. Every mart has consistent channel groupings, currencies and timezones.

•
Own the MMT geo data layer. Build geo-level media and sales tables at DMA (or Comscore), state and zip level for every major platform (Meta, Google, TikTok, Pinterest, Amazon, Microsoft, Programmatic, etc.) and for CMS/CRM/Amazon/Retail Datsets, with standard market names that line up across sources. These tables feed automated market selection, pre-period validation, synthetic control models and test readouts.

•
Build and automate a data quality process . Turn the checks we currently run manually into automated Snowflake/dbt tests and alerts: date gaps, zero-spend or zero-revenue days, cost without impressions (and the reverse), duplicated or unmatched markets, outlier spikes, restatement drift and source freshness. Problems should be flagged before a model is trained or a test is read out.

•
Own and maintain model logs and exported model outputs (contributions, response curves, adstock, optimization results) well structured, versioned and easy to query.

•
Support onboarding of new measurement clients. Own and maintain a repeatable, mostly automated process: map their data feeds, check history depth and quality, and flag gaps before modeling starts.

•
Handle client-specific data needs as they come up. You are not responsible for client workflow, but you may need to jump in to assist the team as things come up.. Write client-specific overrides, channel mappings and marts when a client needs them, and decide whether each piece of logic belongs in the shared core or in the client's own layer.

• Use AI coding tools to work faster (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Hex's AI agent), and document the patterns that work so the team adopts them.

Role Requirements:

• 3+ years in data or analytics engineering, including 1+ year owning a production dbt project of meaningful size.

• Advanced SQL and Python, with production-grade pipeline code.

• Deep dbt expertise: incremental models vs. full refreshes, Jinja and macros, tests, snapshots, source freshness, exposures, and keeping a large DAG under control.

• Strong Snowflake skills: semi-structured/VARIANT data, dynamic per-client queries, query and cost tuning, permissions across separate client databases.

• Hands-on marketing and ecommerce data experience: ad-platform APIs, UTMs, attribution windows, platform-reported vs. warehouse-reported conversions, Shopify order and refund logic.

• An understanding of what measurement models need from data: a continuous time series, consistent granularity, stable channel definitions, enough history, and the reasons one bad week or market can skew results.

• Experience building multi-client data models, with the judgment to know when logic belongs in the shared core and when it belongs in a client layer.

• Git and CI/CD with automated testing you trust.

• Real adoption of AI-assisted development workflows.

• Comfort shipping iteratively based on feedback from analysts and app users.

Helpful but not required

• Direct MMM or incrementality experience (Meridian, Robyn, PyMC-Marketing, synthetic control/causal impact, geo-lift).

• Experience with geographic data: DMA/zip mappings, population and market-size data.

• Hex experience (SQL/Python notebooks, semantic models, published apps), or similar BI/notebook tools.

• Experience at an agency, consultancy or martech company.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• MMT coverage: Geo-level MMT tables for all data sources are created and in use by the Measurement team in the first 3 months of the role

• Measurement-ready data: Within 6 months, ≥95% of active MMM and MMT clients have automated, tested Snowflake marts feeding Hex, with no client-specific cleaning logic left in app notebooks for core sources.

• Data quality: ≥99% completeness and accuracy on critical measurement fields. Zero model refreshes or test readouts delivered with an undetected date gap, duplicated market or unreconciled revenue source.

• Reliability: ≥95% success rate for scheduled measurement pipelines, excluding documented vendor outages.

• Speed and efficiency: Cut new-client measurement onboarding time (data mapping and validation) by 30% within 12 months. Measurably reduce load and refresh times for the main Hex measurement apps.

• Client requests: Deliver ≥90% of client-specific measurement data requests within the agreed turnaround

• AI-assisted development: At least 1 reusable AI-assisted development pattern documented within 120 days and 2 within 12 months, each used in at least 2 production workflows.

Most Important Things (MITs)

• Deliver clean, model-ready MMM and MMT data in Snowflake so the measurement team’s data can be trusted without extra cleanup.

• Build a process to catch data issues before they reach a model or test readout.

• Build a single, documented measurement data foundation that grows with the client list and is ready for AI use.

Benefits & Perks:

• Base salary paid in USD + commission opportunities

• Unlimited Time Off available on day one

• Fully flex work environment: full-remote, in-office, or hybrid

• Offices in Buenos Aires, Medellin, San Diego, New York, Atlanta

• Healthcare stipend: $50/month to support your healthcare or insurance costs

• National Holidays + 2 Mental Health Recharge Days per year

• Unlimited opportunities for growth & leadership within a rapidly growing firm

• Ongoing employee development programs for personal and professional growth (Hedgehog and Vital 5s)

• Quarterly awards including prize money and recognition for outstanding performance

• Opportunities to be involved in company DEI initiatives

Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees' points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

postings.descriptionText:
Coinspaid Solutions is a fintech company building blockchain payment infrastructure for the global economy.
We design, implement, and scale payment systems that connect digital assets with real-world financial operations. Our solutions help businesses and financial institutions operate efficiently in the evolving digital asset landscape.
For over 11 years, we’ve been developing products that bring crypto payments closer to mainstream adoption. Today, our team includes 400+ professionals working remotely across multiple countries.
We combine the pace of fintech with a long-term approach to building products, teams, and careers. As a remote-first company, we give people flexibility in how they work while maintaining strong collaboration and shared ownership across teams.
🏆 In 2026, Coinspaid was recognized as Best Corporate Culture in the Blockchain Industry in Europe, reflecting our focus on ownership, trust, and collaboration.

About the Role

Role purpose

We are looking for a senior operational leader to build and continuously evolve a scalable operating model across the company and the wider group.
The role will own how the organisation operates end-to-end: ensuring that cross-functional and cross-entity processes are clear, efficient, measurable and fit for a regulated fintech environment.
The COO will work closely with Product, Engineering and business functions to remove operational bottlenecks, establish clear accountability and prepare the organisation for effective automation and AI adoption.

Key Responsibilities

• Own and continuously improve the company operating model across functions and legal entities.

• Review existing and legacy processes, identify operational gaps, bottlenecks, duplication and unnecessary bureaucracy.

• Establish clear ownership, accountability and decision-making mechanisms across the organisation.

• Build effective cross-functional processes connecting Business, Operations, Product and Engineering.

• Own complex cross-company and cross-entity processes within the holding.

• Ensure new processes are designed for scalability rather than simply adding additional layers of control.

• Drive operational effectiveness and ensure the organisation is able to execute strategic priorities consistently.

• Lead change management and operational transformation initiatives.

• Establish appropriate operational governance, including OKRs, KPIs, performance metrics and management routines.

• Ensure operational processes comply with relevant regulatory and compliance requirements.

• Identify opportunities for automation and AI while ensuring underlying processes are redesigned and optimised before technology is applied.

• Introduce appropriate operational/process-management tools where they create measurable business value.

• Partner with the CEO and C-level team on organisational priorities and translate strategy into executable operating mechanisms.

Profile

We are looking for someone who has already operated in a COO / Head of Operations / Business Operations leadership capacity, ideally within fintech, payments, banking or another regulated technology business.
The person should have experience with complex organisations, ideally involving multiple legal entities and cross-company processes, and be comfortable operating in environments where responsibilities are distributed across multiple functions.
Strong exposure to Product and Engineering is important: this should not be a traditional administrative Operations leader.
The right candidate combines:

• strong operational and process architecture;

• business and commercial thinking;

• regulatory understanding;

• technology and automation mindset;

• ability to drive execution across functions without necessarily owning all of them directly;

• strong ownership and ability to resolve situations where multiple functions are involved but nobody owns the outcome.

Why join CryptoProcessing by Coinspaid

You’ll be joining a company that is actively shaping its space – with enough scale to matter and enough room to make an impact.

At Coinspaid, people are expected to think, contribute, and take ownership – and are supported in doing so.

We focus on flexibility, wellbeing, and long-term growth – without overcomplicating how benefits work.

Flexible Benefits

Benefit Bar – up to €230/month

A flexible monthly budget you can use for what matters most to you – from sports and mental health to coworking, home office, or medical-related expenses.

Work & Flexibility

•
Fully remote work from almost anywhere

•
Optional offices and relocation support

•
Flexible, async-friendly environment

Growth & Learning

• Budget for courses, certifications, and professional development

•
Language learning support

• Cross-team learning and knowledge sharing

Wellbeing & Support

• Medical insurance or reimbursement depending on location

•
Access to mental health support

• Financial support for important life events

Extras

•
Merch shop with rewards system

•
Team offsites and company events

Sounds good? Well then, we can’t wait to see your resume!

To learn more please visit: &

• Experience marketing scientific, industrial, biotechnology, or other technical products is a plus.
