As the global leader in high-speed connectivity, Ciena builds the critical infrastructure powering the AI era. We’re a technology company shaping the future of networking, guided by innovation, integrity, and collaboration. Through development opportunities, meaningful work, and flexibility, Ciena supports growth and well-being—on and off the job. Connect with a career that matters.

This role sits at the center of Ciena ’s most critical commercial decisions, shaping how complex opportunities are structured, governed, and executed across the Americas. As the senior commercial authority for the region, this leader influences deal strategy, strengthens financial discipline, and builds a high‑performing Commercial Management organization that enables profitable growth and long‑term customer success.

How you will make an impact:

• Serve as the senior commercial authority for the Americas, providing end‑to‑end leadership across the commercial lifecycle from opportunity qualification through post‑award governance

• Shape commercial strategy for complex, high‑value opportunities, advising on pricing frameworks, business case assumptions, revenue models, risk mitigation, and deal structuring

• Establish and enforce regional commercial guardrails that enable competitive, scalable, and compliant deal execution

• Lead regional deal governance, ensuring alignment with Ciena operating model standards, financial approval requirements, and corporate risk policies

• Partner closely with Sales, Services, Product Line Management (PLM), Finance, Operations, and Legal to align commercial strategy with financial and operational objectives

• Represent Ciena ’s commercial strategy in executive‑level customer engagements, strategic reviews, and escalated negotiations

• Build, develop, and mentor a high‑performing Commercial Management team, strengthening commercial rigor, consistency, and capability across the region

The must haves:

• 10–12+ years of progressive experience in commercial management, deal desk leadership, or strategic commercial operations

• Proven expertise in complex deal strategy, commercial governance, pricing, revenue models, and financial risk assessment

• Strong financial and analytical acumen, including pricing analysis, profitability assessment, and P&L evaluation

• Extensive experience in contract structuring, commercial negotiations, and risk management

• Demonstrated ability to influence and challenge senior leaders and executive stakeholders

• Experience operating effectively in complex, ambiguous, and fast‑paced environments

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, or a related field

Nice to haves:

• Master of Business Administration (MBA) or equivalent advanced degree

• Experience in telecommunications, networking, or related technology sectors

• Executive‑level customer negotiation experience across products, services, software, and integrated solutions

• Prior people leadership experience building and scaling commercial or deal management teams

• Experience partnering with global commercial organizations in a matrixed environment

Pay Range:
The annual pay range for this position in US is $104,600 - $167,000.

Pay ranges at Ciena are designed to accommodate variations in knowledge, skills, experience, market conditions, and locations, reflecting our diverse products, industries, and lines of business. Please note that the pay range information provided in this posting pertains specifically to the primary location, which is the top location listed in case multiple locations are available.
Non-Sales employees may be eligible for a discretionary incentive bonus, while Sales employees may be eligible for a sales commission. In addition to competitive compensation, Ciena offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision plans, participation in 401(K) (USA) & DCPP (Canada) with company matching, Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), Employee Assistance Program (EAP), company-paid holidays, paid sick leave, and vacation time. We also comply with all applicable laws regarding Paid Family Leave and other leaves of absence.

At Ciena , we are committed to building and fostering an environment in which our employees feel respected, valued, and heard. Ciena values the diversity of its workforce and respects its employees as individuals. We do not tolerate any form of discrimination.
Ciena is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status.
If contacted in relation to a job opportunity, please advise Ciena of any accommodation measures you may require.

postings.title: Junior Creative Strategist
postings.descriptionText:
This version has bold titles in normal text and extra space between sections. Copy it straight from here, not from a code box, so the bold carries over:

The role at a glance
We’re hiring a sharp, AI-native Junior Creative Strategist to make sure every video ad we launch is the best version of itself.

•
Role: Junior Creative Strategist

• Salary: $27,500 - $35,000 USD base, depending on experience

• Location: Remote-first, based in Argentina

•
Hours: Full-time, flexible

•
Reports to: a Senior Creative Strategist

About Elavate

Elavate is a UK multi-collagen brand for women 40+, built to help them feel like themselves again through menopause and beyond.
We launched in 2024 and have grown into one of the fastest-growing DTC brands in the UK. We’re fully bootstrapped and have grown almost entirely through performance ads.
It started when our founder, Alex, got fed up of buying his mum overpriced, low-quality, bad-tasting collagen. So he made one that actually works, tastes great and is affordable.
Creative is the engine of the business. Our strategists, in-house video editors and agency partners put out 100+ new ad concepts a month across influencer, UGC, high-production, AI and animation formats.

The role
Our goal is simple: launch the best ads possible, as fast as possible.
Our strategists write the scripts and brief the concepts. Our video editors, in-house and agency, build the ads. You own everything in between: you take a raw script and make sure it becomes a finished, launch-ready video ad, on time and with zero mistakes.
That means reviewing every edit, giving editors notes that make the ad better, keeping the pipeline moving, and using AI to make the whole process faster every week.
The bar: when you sign off an ad, it should be ready to go straight live, with no second check needed. Our north star is a concept briefed this week and live in the ad account by the following Thursday.

What you’ll actually do
Most of your week goes on reviewing edits and working with editors. The rest goes on the pipeline, learning from live ads, AI and scripts.

Review every ad before it goes live

• Watch every first draft from our in-house editors and agency partners, and leave timestamped notes in .

• Catch everything: captions, typos, clipped words, audio levels, pacing, weak B-roll, hooks that don’t stitch into the body, the product showing too early.

• Push past “correct” to “better”: stronger hook visuals, music, SFX, text styles and cuts.

• Plan 3-6 cutdowns and extra hook variations for each ad, so we test more versions of every idea.

Make our editors better

• Turn scripts into clear briefs, with a short Loom showing the dream edit.

• Give specific feedback (“change X because Y”) so the same note never comes up twice.

• Run weekly check-ins with your editors, match work to their strengths and keep output on track.

Keep the pipeline moving

• Own the production board in Notion: assign edits, chase deadlines and reassign when someone’s off.

• Get influencer content over the line: every hook, every file and whitelisting access, tracked and ready.

• Hand final files to media buying, named and labelled so launches are clean.

Learn from what’s live

• Read the comments on our live ads for objections, questions and new hook ideas.

• Know which ads are winning and why, and bring those patterns into the next edit.

• Keep a swipe file of the best DTC ads and new formats worth testing.

Build the AI workflow

• Help build our AI editing pipeline, using tools like Claude Code, Higgsfield and ElevenLabs.

• Keep teaching the system: feed it new formats, references and examples so the output improves every week.

• Help editors adopt new tools, and check AI edits as closely as human ones.

Write and improve scripts

• Review agency scripts and fix logic or flow issues before anything gets filmed.

• Write bottom-of-funnel scripts, hooks and variations using our copy frameworks and AI tools.

What you’ll bring

• Strong with AI. You use Claude every day, you’re comfortable in Claude Code, and you’ve built automated workflows that save real time.

• A ruthless eye for detail. You spot a typo, a clipped word or a flicker on the first watch.

• Clear, specific feedback. You can explain exactly what to change and why, in writing or on a Loom.

• Technical confidence. You understand how video editing works (Premiere, CapCut, DaVinci or similar) and you pick up new tools fast.

• Taste for direct response. You watch a lot of ads, you know why a hook stops the scroll, and you care whether an ad sells, not just how it looks.

• A team player. You’ll work under our senior strategists, so you’re collaborative, responsive and active on Slack.

• Ownership and speed. You juggle several projects, chase people without being chased, and figure things out before you ask.

• No ego. You take blunt feedback well and act on it fast.

•
Based in Argentina, working remotely.

Nice to have

• A background in video editing, content creation or creative strategy. Any one of these is a great fit.

• Experience at a DTC brand or performance agency. No supplement experience needed.

• An understanding of acquisition numbers: ad spend, cost per purchase and what makes an ad scale.

• An interest in direct response copywriting.

• Something you’ve built yourself: a side project, a small business or a startup.

Where this goes
This is a junior role with a path to Creative Strategist.
You’ll have access to sharp senior strategists and creative minds who’ll help you improve your own skills. The progression is simple: you get better at creative yourself, and keep developing into a stronger strategist.
Our current junior strategists already run weekly editor meetings, review agency work and are moving into scripting.

Pay, perks and how we work

• $27,500 - $35,000 USD base, depending on experience

•
30 days off a year

•
Private health insurance

• A learning budget for courses, communities and coaching

•
Paid AI tools, including Claude

•
Remote-first, with flexible hours

•
Direct access to the founder

•
Free Elavate products

At Elavate we move fast, own our work and hold each other to a high standard. In return, you’ll learn faster about creative here than almost anywhere else.

How to apply

Send us:

• Your CV/Cover Letter to

• A short Loom video (3-5 mins max) reviewing one of our ads from our Facebook Ad Library. Tell us what you think is working in the ad and what you’d improve (visually or in the script).

postings.title: Director of SEO
postings.descriptionText:
This is a remote position.
This company looks for people who show up as their whole selves, take ownership without being asked twice, and want more responsibility than their current title gives them. If that sounds like you, keep reading. They provide marketing services exclusively to independent professionals and brands in the automotive detailing, paint protection film, ceramic coating, and window tint industries. They are not a general agency. They understand this market's customers, how they search, and what turns a Google search into a booked job. They currently manage roughly 100 SEO accounts through outside white label vendors, and they are on pace to launch around 225 new client websites a year. That volume is outgrowing what a packaged vendor relationship can give them in quality control, scope flexibility, and client communication. This role exists to change that.
Why This Role Exists Now SEO, and local SEO specifically, is one of the highest value services they sell and deliver for their clients. Right now, most of that work is executed through outside white label vendors. This hire changes that relationship. They need someone who can run those vendors, evaluate whether their contracts and scopes of work still make sense for the company, and start building the internal team and processes that let them bring the highest value work in house over time.

• They need more control over quality, scope flexibility, and client communication than a packaged white label model can provide.

• They need someone who can evaluate their current vendors on their merits: cost, scope, turnaround, and quality, and make a clear recommendation on each.

• They want an internal SEO leader who can document how the work should be done, train others to do it, and build a department that integrates tightly with web development & support.

About The Role They are hiring a Director of SEO to own their SEO strategy end to end: local SEO delivery for their small business clients, their growing use of AI in search, and the relationships they currently hold with white label SEO vendors. You will start executing and advising from week one. In the first 45 to 60 days, you will audit their current white label vendor contracts and performance, and begin identifying and building out a handful of scopes of work they can bring in house, work that either mirrors or improves on what those vendors deliver today, along with the standard operating procedures that make that work repeatable. As you prove out results and judgment, this role is built to grow into leadership over an internal SEO team. You will also serve as the company’s internal SEO consultant on website development builds, working with their web team early in the build process so new sites launch search ready rather than getting audited and fixed after the fact. This is an advisory role on the web side. They are not asking you to manage web development vendors, only SEO vendors.
You'll Love This Job If...

• You'd rather own outcomes than tickets; you want to be the person a shop owner's rankings live or die by, and you take that seriously.

• You're already thinking about how AI search (AI Overviews, LLM citations, zero-click behavior) changes local SEO, and you want a place to actually test that thinking.

• You can look at content someone else wrote and make it meaningfully better; structurally, not just line edits, without needing to write every word yourself.

• You want a leadership track, not just a bigger workload. You're motivated by eventually building and running a team, not just doing more of the same work solo.

You'll Dislike This Job If...

• You want a fully built department, existing SOPs, and someone checking your work daily; none of that exists yet. You're building a chunk of it.

• You see vendor management or contract review as beneath your role. Evaluating what they are paying for and deciding what to bring in house is core to this job, not a side task.

• You need certainty about title and comp progression on day one and the growth path is real but earned, not guaranteed on a calendar.

Core Responsibilities
White Label Vendor Oversight and Evaluation

• Own the working relationship with the company’s current white label SEO vendors: scope, deliverables, turnaround, and quality.

• Evaluate vendor contracts on their merits, pricing, scope of work, service levels, and exclusivity or termination terms, and provide the company with a clear recommendation on each: keep, renegotiate, or replace.

• Within a 45 to 60 day span, identify a small set of scopes of work to begin bringing in house, ones that mirror or enhance what their vendors currently deliver, and start building the standard operating procedures that make those scopes repeatable without you personally in the loop on every account.

Local SEO Execution

• Own Google Business Profile optimization, map pack ranking strategy, and on-page SEO for a portfolio of small-business (automotive detailing, PPF, tint) client accounts.

• Diagnose ranking issues and build a prioritized action plan per client, not a generic checklist.

• Track and report on local ranking movement, map pack visibility, and organic traffic using Ahrefs and other tools.

AI and Answer Engine Optimization Strategy

• Build and evolve their point of view on how AI Overviews, LLM-based search (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini), and zero-click behavior affect local SEO for small businesses.

• Translate that strategy into concrete, testable deliverables: content structure, schema/structured data, citation-worthy page formats, not just trend commentary.

• Track algorithm and AI search changes, and proactively adjust client strategy in advance.

Content Direction & Editing

• Direct and edit SEO content produced by writers and contractors; briefs, structure, on-page optimization, and quality control before publication.

• Make sure content ties back to each client's actual ranking and conversion goals, not just word count.

Tools, Reporting & Communication

• Use Ahrefs (required) for keyword research, competitor analysis, and rank tracking; comfort with Local Falcon or a similar local-rank tool is a plus.

• Report results in plain language that a shop owner can act on; no jargon, no fluff.

• Analyze performance trends and translate insights into actionable improvements for future campaigns.

Their Core Values Before you apply, make sure these land for you. They don't just post values on a wall; they hire, fire, and celebrate based on them.

• Delivering a WOW experience through service

• Embrace and drive change

• Create fun and a hint of weirdness

• Be adventurous, creative, and open-minded

• Pursue growth & learning

• Build a positive team and family spirit

• Create open and honest relationships built on communication

• Be humble

• Never be afraid to ask for help

• Do it right, or don't do it at all.

What Success Looks Like First 45 Days

• Completed a full audit of the company’s current white label SEO vendor contracts and performance, with a clear keep, renegotiate, or replace recommendation for each.

• Identified two to four scopes of work to begin bringing in house, chosen because they mirror or enhance what their vendors currently deliver, and started drafting the standard operating procedure for at least one of them.

• Independently managing Google Business Profile, map pack, and on page SEO for your assigned client portfolio.

• Embedded as SEO consultant on at least one active website development build.

First 90 Days

• Shown measurable ranking or map pack improvement across your client portfolio.

• Built a documented process for content briefs and editing standards that another writer could follow.

Long-Term

• Own SEO strategy across all client accounts.

• Help hire, train, and lead additional SEO team members as the department grows.

• Help them settle the right long term mix of internal and vendor delivered work, informed by what the first internalized scopes of work actually prove out.

Requirements

• 6+ years of hands-on SEO experience with demonstrable results improving local/SMB rankings (map pack position, GBP visibility, organic traffic); bring examples, not just a resume line.

• Working knowledge of Ahrefs and or Comparable Tool: keyword research, rank tracking, competitor, and gap analysis.

• Competence across the range of what modern SEO now covers: traditional technical and on page SEO, local map grid tracking, AI driven SEO, and answer engine optimization. You do not need to be a master of every one of these. You do need to know enough in each to direct the work, judge whether it is good, and recognize when you should bring in outside expertise or hire someone who covers a gap you do not.

• Experience editing or directing content written by someone else, with a clear point of view on what actually makes SEO content rank and convert.

• A genuine, current interest in AI-driven search, not just awareness that it exists.

• Comfortable working independently in a remote, contract-to-hire structure with limited existing infrastructure.

• Proven ability to translate high-level SEO strategy into measurable business results.

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain the impact of SEO to non-technical stakeholders and clients.

​ Nice to Have

• Management or team-lead experience, though we're weighing trajectory and hunger to lead over a management title you've already held.

• Background working with local or small-business clients, ideally in a service industry.

• Familiarity with Local Falcon, Google Search Console, or other local-rank and search-performance tools.

Benefits

• $3800 - $6000 USD/monthly

• 100% remote from anywhere in Latam

postings.title: Referente Técnico de Seguridad - Salesforce Specialist (ARG)
postings.descriptionText:
Estamos en búsqueda de Referente Técnico de Seguridad - Salesforce Specialist que resida en Argentina , sin inglés para sumarse a importante Compañía de medicina prepaga.

REQUISITOS TÉCNICOS:

Excluyentes:

• Formación académica terciaria o universitaria en carreras de Sistemas/Tecnología.

• +4 años de experiencia en el ecosistema Salesforce (como Administrador Senior, Desarrollador o Consultor de Salesforce).

• +2 años de experiencia dedicándote específicamente a la gestión de seguridad, accesos y gobernanza de la plataforma Salesforce.

• Seguridad y gestión de accesos en Salesforce: Conocimientos avanzados de modelos de permisos, perfiles, roles, reglas de compartición y seguridad a nivel de campo. Experiencia/conocimientos en Salesforce Shield (Platform Encryption, Event Monitoring y Field Audit Trail).

• Seguridad en desarrollo e integraciones: Conocimientos de seguridad en Apex y Lightning Web Components (LWC), identificación de vulnerabilidades y gestión segura de integraciones, autenticación y aplicaciones conectadas.

• Identidad, autenticación y auditoría: Conocimientos de SSO, SAML, OAuth 2.0 y MFA. Manejo de herramientas de auditoría y análisis de seguridad como Salesforce Health Check, PMD, DigitSec o CodeScan.

• Protección de datos: Conocimientos de normativas de protección de datos personales (Ley 25.326, GDPR) y regulaciones aplicables al tratamiento de información sensible.

Valorables

• Experiencia directa implementando Salesforce Shield, diseño de esquemas de permisos complejos, auditorías de seguridad en orgs de gran escala, resolución de vulnerabilidades en código Apex e integración de logs con SIEM corporativo

• Cursos de especialización en Ciberseguridad, Seguridad Cloud o Arquitectura Salesforce.

• Certificaciones oficiales altamente valoradas: Salesforce Certified Administrator, Salesforce Certified Identity and Access Management Designer, Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I, Salesforce Certified Security Specialist (o superbadge equivalente), o certificaciones generales de ciberseguridad (CompTIA Security+, Certified Cloud Security Professional - CCSP).

Soft Skills

• Pensamiento analítico y atención al detalle.

• Proactividad y orientación a la prevención de riesgos.

• Capacidad de resolución de problemas y toma de decisiones.

• Comunicación efectiva y capacidad para transmitir conocimientos.

• Trabajo colaborativo, negociación y orientación al negocio.

PROPUESTA:

• Rango salarial: a convenir según seniority y experiencia

• Tipo de contratación: Relación de dependencia

• Duración del contrato: por tiempo indeterminado

• Horario: L a V, de 7 a 16 hs

• Modalidad de trabajo: remoto con posibilidad de encuentros eventuales en Sunchales.

DESCRIPCIÓN DEL ROL
Quien se sume al equipo tendrá un rol clave en la protección del ecosistema Salesforce y de la información de clientes, afiliados y operaciones comerciales de la organización. Será responsable de garantizar la seguridad de la plataforma mediante el diseño, implementación y auditoría continua de controles de acceso, protección de datos, desarrollos e integraciones, velando por el cumplimiento de las políticas corporativas de ciberseguridad y las normativas de protección de datos personales. Se espera que promueva una cultura de seguridad por diseño, anticipándose a posibles vulnerabilidades y asegurando que la evolución de la plataforma no comprometa la seguridad ni la agilidad operativa.

RESPONSABILIDADES:

• Gobernar el modelo de visibilidad y control de accesos en Salesforce: Diseñar, configurar y auditar la jerarquía de roles, perfiles, conjuntos de permisos ( Permission Sets ), grupos de conjuntos de permisos ( Permission Set Groups ), valores predeterminados de la organización ( OWD - Organization-Wide Defaults ), reglas de compartición ( Sharing Rules ) y seguridad a nivel de campo ( FLS - Field-Level Security ).

• Implementar y administrar la suite de seguridad Salesforce Shield: Configurar y supervisar los módulos de cifrado de plataforma ( Platform Encryption ), monitoreo de eventos en tiempo real ( Real-Time Event Monitoring ) y seguimiento de auditoría de campos ( Field Audit Trail ) para la protección de datos sensibles (PII/PHI).

• Supervisar la seguridad en portales y usuarios invitados ( Experience Cloud / Sites ): Auditar continuamente las configuraciones de seguridad, permisos de usuarios invitados ( Guest User Access ), reglas de compartición pública y endpoints expuestos en portales externos para prevenir filtraciones no deseadas de información.

• Auditar y revisar la seguridad en código personalizado (Apex / LWC): Evaluar el código fuente escrito en Apex y componentes Lightning (LWC) para detectar y mitigar vulnerabilidades como inyecciones SOQL/SOSL, violaciones de control de acceso (omisión de palabra clave with sharing o controles de CRUD/FLS en código) y vulnerabilidades de Cross-Site Scripting (XSS).

• Gestionar la seguridad de integraciones y aplicaciones conectadas (Connected Apps): Auditar los esquemas de autenticación basados en OAuth 2.0 y SAML, gestionar los certificados, controlar los alcances ( scopes ) de las aplicaciones conectadas y verificar los conectores con el bus de integración corporativo (MuleSoft / APIs externas).

• Ejecutar análisis periódicos con Salesforce Health Check y herramientas SAST : Realizar escaneos frecuentes de la postura de seguridad mediante Salesforce Health Check y soluciones automatizadas de análisis de código/configuración (ej. PMD, DigitSec, CodeScan), gestionando los planes de remediación técnica.

• Garantizar la protección de datos en entornos Sandbox y procesos de Release: Definir e implementar políticas de enmascaramiento y anonimización de datos ( Data Masking ) en entornos de desarrollo y prueba (Sandboxes) para evitar el uso de datos de producción no protegidos.

• Monitorear eventos de seguridad y apoyar en la respuesta a incidentes: Analizar logs de eventos ( Event Monitoring logs ) y métricas de comportamiento para detectar actividades sospechosas (ej. descargas masivas de informes, exportaciones anómalas o inicios de sesión desde ubicaciones no autorizadas) y colaborar con el SOC en la contención de incidentes.

• Gobernar la instalación de soluciones de AppExchange: Evaluar los riesgos de ciberseguridad y privacidad de aplicaciones y paquetes de terceros antes de su instalación en la organización de Salesforce.

• Gestión de políticas de sesión y autenticación en la plataforma: Configurar requerimientos de contraseñas, políticas de expiración de sesión, restricciones por rango de IP corporativo y autenticación de doble factor (MFA / Salesforce Authenticator) en coordinación con el sistema central de SSO corporativo.

• Velar por el cumplimiento regulatorio sobre los datos del CRM: Asegurar que el almacenamiento y procesamiento de datos en Salesforce cumpla con normativas de protección de datos personales (Ley N° 25.326 de Argentina, GDPR) y regulaciones del sector salud/financiero (HIPAA).

• Brindar capacitación técnica en seguridad de Salesforce: Entrenar a administradores, desarrolladores y consultores externos en pautas de configuración segura, desarrollo seguro en la plataforma y buenas prácticas para la preservación de datos.

🩺 Plan de Salud para vos y tu familia

•
🚀 Programa de Movilidad Interna

¿QUÉ TE HARÁ DESTACAR FRENTE A OTROS CANDIDATOS?
Que tu perfil esté actualizado con tus principales hitos técnicos. Que puedas mostrar resultados concretos y el impacto que tu trabajo generó en las diferentes Compañías.

postings.title: SOC Analyst (12:00–21:00 UTC)
postings.descriptionText:
About the job
The SOC Analyst is responsible for the continuous monitoring, triage, and investigation of security events across the organization's environment, as part of a global follow-the-sun Security Operations Center. This position reports to the SOC Lead. The role goes beyond acknowledging alerts: the focus is on understanding what each alert means, investigating suspicious activity end to end, responding to real threats, and handing over cleanly between regions so that nothing is lost across shifts. The ideal candidate has solid SOC experience, a strong investigative mindset, and thrives in a fast-paced, fully remote setting where accuracy, discipline, and security are essential. Hands-on engineering experience with core security platforms is a big plus.

Responsibilities

• Monitor, triage, and analyze security alerts and events from the organization's security stack, including SIEM, Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Security Service Edge (SSE), and Web Application Firewall (WAF) platforms.

• Investigate security incidents end to end, from initial triage through analysis, containment, eradication, and post-incident documentation, coordinating with relevant teams throughout.

• Determine the scope, severity, and impact of security events, separating true positives from false positives and escalating confirmed incidents according to defined procedures.

• Execute response actions within the security platforms, such as isolating endpoints, blocking indicators, disabling compromised accounts, and enforcing access restrictions.

• Ensure structured, high-quality shift handovers across regions in the follow-the-sun model, so that open investigations, ongoing incidents, and pending actions continue seamlessly around the clock.

• Proactively threat hunt across endpoint, network, and log data to uncover suspicious activity that existing detections may have missed, mapping findings to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.

• Provide feedback on detection quality and contribute to the tuning of SIEM correlation rules, EDR custom detections, and WAF rules to reduce noise and improve coverage.

• Enrich investigations with threat intelligence, including indicators of compromise, attacker techniques, and emerging campaigns relevant to the organization.

• Develop and maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and incident response playbooks.

• Collaborate with IT, infrastructure, application, and security engineering teams to resolve incidents and support day-to-day operations.

• Support vulnerability management and drive continuous improvement of the organization's overall security posture.

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

• At least 3 years of hands-on experience as a SOC Analyst, triaging alerts and investigating security incidents in a production environment.

• Solid working knowledge of core security technologies such as EDR, SSE, SIEM, and WAF, and of how to use them to investigate and respond to threats.

• Hands-on experience implementing, configuring, and tuning these platforms, or writing and tuning detection content, is a big plus.

• Experience with incident response and threat hunting, ideally with familiarity with the MITRE ATT&CK framework.

• Excellent understanding of network security, endpoint security, cloud security, and Zero Trust principles.

• Relevant certifications such as Security+, CySA+, GCIA, GCIH, BTL1, or vendor-specific credentials are a plus.

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with a high attention to detail.

• Ability to handle sensitive information responsibly and securely.

• Good written and verbal communication skills in English, and the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams and across time zones.

About You
You are a hands-on security analyst who wants to understand what is really happening behind an alert, rather than only closing tickets. You dig into the data, follow the evidence, and know when and how to escalate. If you have also stood up or tuned the tools you work with, or written your own detections, even better. You are structured, reliable, and comfortable working independently in a remote, follow-the-sun team, and you take pride in leaving a clear handover for the next shift. You are curious about new threats and technologies, and you enjoy working closely with both technical teams and end users to raise the security bar across the environment.

postings.title: Vice President, Products — Diodes
postings.descriptionText:
OPSWAT , a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.

The Position
Join a pre-IPO, global cybersecurity leader at the forefront of innovation. We protect the unseen — the infrastructure that powers our way of life. OPSWAT protects the world’s critical infrastructure across IT, OT, and ICS environments, trusted by more than 2,000 organizations, governments, and institutions worldwide.
We are seeking a Vice President, Products to own OPSWAT ’s diode business end to end. You will operate much like a general manager would — accountable for the full business — strategy, portfolio, hardware and software product management, partnerships, go-to-market, and commercial results. You lead the product management function for diodes as a player-coach, with product managers reporting to you, while personally owning every decision that moves the business forward.

The Product & Portfolio
OPSWAT ’s diode portfolio — the MetaDefender Optical Diode and MetaDefender NetWall families, expanded through the acquisition of Fend — delivers hardware-enforced, one-way and controlled data transfer that protects OT, ICS, and segregated networks while keeping operational data flowing to where it is needed.

•
Hardware-enforced data diodes: optical diodes across a range of form factors and performance tiers, from rack-mount to DIN-rail and compact industrial models, built for demanding operational environments.

•
Unidirectional and bilateral security gateways: gateways that pair one-way enforcement with protocol handling and replication for OT systems, with connectivity spanning Ethernet, serial, and cellular for modern and legacy networks.

•
The software layer: management, configuration, protocol connectors, monitoring, and integration with the broader MetaDefender platform — the experience customers live with every day.

•
Certifications and assurance: the security, safety, and regulatory certifications that customers in critical infrastructure, government, and defense depend on.

Customers span energy and utilities, manufacturing, transportation, government, and defense — environments where reliability, assurance, and long product lifecycles matter as much as features.

About This Role
This is a hands-on, business-ownership role — not a pure strategy seat. You are the single owner of the diode business: you set its direction, run it with a general manager’s breadth and accountability, and are accountable for growth, margin, and customer success. At the same time, you lead the product management function as a player-coach, building and developing a team of product managers while staying in the details yourself.
You are equally at home in hardware and software product management. You work closely with hardware engineering and supply chain on everything from evaluating and validating hardware vendors and components to final selection, sourcing, and lifecycle — and with software engineering on the experience that runs on top. You build the partnerships and go-to-market motion that carry the entire business, grounded in a thorough understanding of the diode market, its customers, and the comparable vendors within it.
You will work alongside OPSWAT ’s Diode CTO, who brings deep technical insight and strategic perspective and helps shape critical decisions, as you continue to drive OPSWAT ’s success in this space. You bring an AI-first mindset, embracing AI-transformed product management processes across the team — from research and requirements to the user experience and the packaging experience.

What You Will Be Doing

•
Own the business end to end: take end-to-end ownership of the diode business, with the breadth a general manager would bring — owning strategy, revenue, margin, forecasting, and investment decisions, and accountable for commercial outcomes across the portfolio.

•
Set portfolio strategy and roadmap: define the vision and multi-year roadmap across hardware and software, balancing new products, platform evolution, and lifecycle management for long-lived installed bases.

•
Lead hardware product management: own the hardware lifecycle — requirements, new product introduction, BOM cost and margin targets, certifications, product transitions, and end-of-life planning.

•
Lead software product management: own the software experience — management, configuration, protocol connectors, monitoring, and integration with the MetaDefender platform — so the product is as easy to deploy and operate as it is secure.

•
Manage hardware vendors with engineering and supply chain: partner with the hardware engineering and supply chain groups to evaluate, validate, qualify, and select hardware vendors, contract manufacturers, and key components — managing cost, quality, lead times, and supply risk.

•
Build business and partnerships: develop OEM, technology, system-integrator, and channel partnerships that extend the portfolio’s reach, and identify business development opportunities that strengthen OPSWAT ’s position.

•
Own go-to-market: lead positioning, pricing, packaging, and launches; arm sales and channel teams with the story and the proof; and engage directly with key customers, partners, and field events.

•
Know the market: maintain a rigorous, current view of the diode and cross-domain market — customer needs, buying criteria, competitive offerings, and the strengths and weaknesses of comparable vendors — and use it to guide portfolio decisions.

•
Partner with the Diode CTO: work alongside the Diode CTO on technical direction, strategy, and critical decisions, combining business ownership with deep technical insight.

•
Drive AI-transformed product management: embed AI across the team’s daily work to raise speed and quality, and apply it to how the team shapes the user experience and the packaging experience — from commercial packaging and licensing to the out-of-box and deployment experience.

•
Lead the team as a player-coach: hire, develop, and lead the diode product managers while personally owning the most important work.

•
Communicate with stakeholders: clearly articulate strategy, performance, and results to executive leadership, customers, and partners, fostering alignment and confidence.

What We Need From You

•
End-to-end business management: extensive end-to-end business management experience — comparable in scope to running a business unit or a product line as a general manager — with accountability for revenue, margin, and strategy. 12+ years in product and business leadership is typical.

•
Hardware and software product management: a well-rounded product management background spanning both hardware and software, including taking hardware products from requirements through manufacturing, certification, and lifecycle.

•
Hardware vendor and supply chain experience: a strong track record working with hardware vendors and contract manufacturers — from validation to selection — alongside hardware engineering and supply chain teams.

•
BD, partnership, and GTM leadership: demonstrated success building partnerships and leading go-to-market — pricing, packaging, channel, and launches — for a business you owned.

•
Diode market knowledge: full knowledge of the data diode and cross-domain market space, including customers, competitive offerings, and the strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, and threats of comparable vendors.

•
Player-coach leadership: experience leading product managers while staying hands-on and owning outcomes directly.

•
AI-first ways of working: you fully embrace AI-transformed product management processes and apply AI to your own and your team’s daily work.

•
Critical infrastructure customers: experience serving customers in OT/ICS, energy, utilities, manufacturing, government, or defense, and an understanding of their assurance and lifecycle expectations.

•
Exceptional communicator: outstanding executive presence and communication skills, with credibility across engineering, sales, partners, and customers.

•
Travel: willingness to travel regularly to customers, partners, hardware vendors, and R&D sites.

•
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field; MBA is a plus.

It Would Be Nice If You Had

•
Certification experience: hands-on experience bringing products through security and industry certifications such as Common Criteria or IEC 62443.

•
OT protocol depth: familiarity with industrial protocols and the systems diodes connect to, such as historians and SCADA.

•
Government and defense: experience working with government and defense customers; eligibility for a security clearance is a plus.

•
Integration experience: experience integrating an acquired product line or bringing hardware and software teams onto a common platform.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

• Run a complete business — hardware, software, and go-to-market — with real ownership at a pre-IPO, global cybersecurity leader.

• Work alongside a seasoned Diode CTO and dedicated hardware, software, and supply chain teams.

• Protect the networks that power energy, manufacturing, transportation, and national security.

• Shape how AI transforms product management in a hardware-and-software business.

• Attractive compensation with regular performance assessments and flexibility for the right candidate.

Website | X/Twitter | LinkedIn

Who Are Massive Rocket ?

Massive Rocket is a rapidly scaling Braze and Snowflake agency on a mission to transform how digital marketing, product, and engineering teams connect. In just five years, we’ve grown at speed and are now gearing up for our next big milestone: hitting $100M in revenue. We build human experiences at scale, powered by cutting‑edge web, mobile, cloud, data, and AI technologies. If you’re excited by innovation, love solving complex challenges, and want to help shape the future of digital experiences, you’ll feel right at home here.

Every role at Massive Rocket is entrepreneurial. The people who thrive here don’t just focus on their own remit — they understand the goals of the teams around them and actively contribute to the success of their colleagues, customers, and partners. We’re building a culture of ownership, collaboration, and growth, and we’re looking for people who want to make a real impact.

Who Are We Looking to Add to Our Team?

As a Senior CRM Data Analyst at Massive Rocket , you’ll be the single, hands-on owner of analytics for your client accounts. You’ll take a request from the client’s first message all the way to a readout without supervision, and your insights, outcomes reporting and strategic perspective will be something both our CRM team and our clients can trust.

You’ll be part of our data team and work inside a CRM pod, where the pod’s Lead Consultant sets day-to-day priorities. You’ll partner closely with the Lead and Senior Consultants on the account, Account Management and Project Management, as well as the client’s marketing, loyalty and data teams. Your focus is analysis, insight and reporting rather than Braze builds, campaign execution or data engineering.

You’ll thrive here if you care about every number being right, can turn analysis into recommendations people can act on, and know when a request fits the agreed hours and when it needs scoping as a project.

What Will You Do?

• Own the analytics workstream on your accounts, running request intake and prioritisation within the agreed hours and flagging early when a request is project-sized

• Act as the client’s go-to contact for data questions, testing whether each question is framed fairly before you run the analysis

• Write production-quality SQL in the client’s warehouse (Snowflake, Databricks or similar) and develop the transformation logic behind your analysis

• Trace data lineage, fix gaps in existing reports, SQL and data events, and reconcile metrics across systems, including the client’s analytics tool (Amplitude, GA4)

• Run cohort, behavioural and decomposition analysis on transaction and loyalty data, covering first vs repeat purchase, ATV, revenue, frequency, retention, LTV and offers

• Build or use propensity and segmentation models, and connect insights on segments, offers, channels and seasonality to revenue, efficiency and cost savings

• Design and report on tests independently, from sample size and holdout design to incremental uplift and results by segment, using AI to make your analysis and testing faster and more effective

• Build and maintain dashboards in the client’s BI tool (Power BI, Tableau, Looker or similar) and own the KPI definitions behind them

• Validate and document every figure before it reaches the client, and present findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders in clear, strategic stories

• Review other analysts’ SQL, coach consultants on using data, manage 1–2 junior analysts as the team grows, and build reusable assets that work across accounts

What Makes You a Great Fit

• Production-quality SQL in Snowflake or another cloud warehouse (Databricks, Redshift or similar)

• Experience building dashboards and reporting in a BI tool such as Power BI or Tableau, plus advanced Excel

• Experience with a product or digital analytics tool (Amplitude, GA4, Mixpanel)

• Hands-on cohort and behavioural analysis on customer, transaction or loyalty data

• A strong grasp of data quality, validation and governance

• Experimentation and statistics in Python or R, including test design, sample size, significance and incremental uplift

• Experience building or using a propensity or segmentation model, such as recency and frequency tiers or 90/180/365-day activity tiers

• CRM, loyalty or customer analytics experience, with the commercial sense to challenge a flawed question

• Clear client-facing English, with the ability to explain findings to non-technical audiences in writing and in person

Bonus points if you have:

• Experience with Braze, SFMC or Adobe Campaign, and an understanding of how segments and insights are used in them

• Experience with a CDP such as Hightouch, Segment or similar

• QSR, restaurant or retail experience

• Uplift modelling experience

• Agency or consultancy experience (in-house candidates who work closely with stakeholders are very welcome too)

Why You’ll Love Working Here

Rocket‑Fuelled Growth – Big challenges, fast learning, and the chance to level up quicker than anywhere else

A Culture That Actually Gives a Damn – Supportive, positive, and built around people who want to see you win

A Global Crew – Collaborate with brilliant teammates across Europe, the US, and beyond

Remote‑First for Life – Work from wherever you feel your best

Real Career Momentum – Clear progression, real ownership, and space to grow into your next chapter

Moments That Matter – Meetups, events, and team experiences that make the journey unforgettable

A Few Things to Know Before We Get Started

Bring Your Own Device – We operate a BYOD policy, so you’ll use your own kit for work

Right to Work – You’ll need a valid work visa; we’re not able to offer sponsorship at the moment

ID Checks – We may ask for proof of identity (passport, ID card, or a recent utility bill)

References – We may request two references, so have names, relationships, and contact details ready

For Contractors – Proof of incorporation and up‑to‑date insurance is required

A Quick Note on Applications

We receive a high volume of applications, and while we’d love to reply to everyone personally, it’s not always possible. If you haven’t heard from us within two weeks, it sadly means you haven’t been successful this time. But don’t let that stop you—we’re growing fast, and new opportunities open up all the time.

postings.title: Senior Associate, Conserving the Pantanal and Gran Chaco Wildlands
postings.descriptionText:
Senior Associate, Conserving the Pantanal and Gran Chaco Wildlands
The Environment Portfolio at The Pew Charitable Trusts
For more than 30 years, Pew has been a major force in engaging the public and policy makers about the causes, consequences, and solutions to some of the world’s most pressing environmental challenges. Our environment work spans all seven continents with more than 250 professionals working at the local, national, and international levels to reduce the scope and severity of global environmental problems, such as the erosion of large natural ecosystems that contain a great part of the world’s remaining biodiversity, and the destruction of the marine environment. Pew’s global environmental program focuses on science-based, nonpartisan, and sustainable solutions to help protect the planet and people. We work in partnership with governments, Indigenous rights holders, intergovernmental organizations, non-governmental organizations, local stakeholders, scientists, and other researchers to advance public policy so that nature and communities can thrive.
Since 1990, Pew has worked in North America, South America and Australia to protect large and critically important terrestrial ecosystems, including rivers and other freshwater resources, coastal temperate rainforests, interior mountain ranges, the northern boreal forests, Australia’s Outback, and Chilean Patagonia. We work to ensure these natural systems remain bountiful, functioning, and resilient, providing essential ecological services such as clean air and clean water, sustenance and food security for local communities and more broadly for the welfare of current and future generations. Our work relies on the sciences of conservation, sociology, biology, and economics to advocate for practical and durable solutions to the loss of biodiversity.
In the sea, reforms to how our oceans are managed are essential to address overfishing, pollution, and loss of habitat. Pew began its oceans program in the United States, focusing on ending overfishing and protecting fragile marine habitat. Starting in 2005, Pew’s ocean conservation program expanded around the world and played a significant role in reforming marine fisheries management in the European Union and on the high seas and creating large scale marine reserves around the world. Our work is grounded in the best available science and pursues domestic and international conservation measures that are long-term and provide permanent, durable protections for marine ecosystems. We also work to address systemic threats to the ocean, including from plastics, over-and-illegal fishing, seabed mining, and climate change.

Conserving the Pantanal and Gran Chaco Wildlands
South America’s Pantanal and Gran Chaco regions are among the most ecologically significant tropical wetlands and dry forests on Earth. This area spans parts of Brazil, Bolivia, Paraguay, and Argentina and contains thousands of plant and animal species and provides vital aquatic habitat, nutrient renewal, migration routes, and flood control for millions of animals and people living downstream. The region’s extensive ecosystems are currently threatened by deforestation, drought and intensification of wildfires related to climate change, and thus urgently need conservation action.

The project works with the policy framework in each country to solidify and expand protection of the extraordinary biodiversity of the Pantanal-Gran Chaco region. Pew partners with local and international conservation organizations, government agencies, and Indigenous governments and organizations to improve management of and expand protected areas, support Indigenous organizations and communities in the management of their territories, promote sustainable management for ranching lands, and to advance long-term conservation financing mechanisms for durable protections.

Position Overview
Reporting to the Project Director, Conserving the Pantanal and Gran Chaco Wildlands, the Senior Associate, Conserving the Pantanal and Gran Chaco Wildlands will manage contracts with partner non-governmental organizations (NGOs) and consultants, act as a liaison with other Pew units, facilitate planning and evaluation, and generally monitor workflow across the team.
The Senior Associate will support the Project Director in ensuring adequate project management with a primary focus on managing contracts and coordinating workflow. This will also include backstopping other team members to cover key gaps as they arise. A secondary focus will include facilitating communications and managing relationships with strategic partners and key stakeholders.
The Senior Associate will be located either in Santa Cruz, Bolivia; or elsewhere within the South America region following evaluation by Pew.

Responsibilities:

• Foster a work environment that inspires excellence, values impact, encourages transparency, builds mutual trust and respect, embraces and values diversity, and is collaborative, caring and compassionate. Under the Project Director’s leadership, provide project management and coordination to the Pantanal and Gran Chaco team.

• Support the Project Director in establishing and cultivating strategic alliances and managing joint initiatives with international organizations, foundations, other non-governmental organizations (NGOs), government agencies, and other institutions in the region.

• Promote best practices and innovations in project management across team activities.

• Manage contracts with consultants and partner organizations using Pew’s platforms and internal procedures to guarantee quality and timeliness.

• Monitor the status of the initiative’s objectives, deliverables, and activities, and provide timely feedback to the Project Director and team.

• Coordinate annual planning exercises and other strategic planning for the project.

• Contribute to the planning and organizing of periodic staff workshops and participation in external events and represent the project as needed.

• Collaborate on the production and dissemination of communications products.

• Support the Project Director in coordinating key activities with staff and partner organizations.

• Participate in activities that support program and Pew-wide objectives.

Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required.

• Generally, 4 years of applicable experience.

• Fluency in English and in either Spanish or Portuguese.

• Significant experience in project management, including planning and evaluation, budgeting, and contracting, and similar areas.

• Significant experience working with non-profit organizations.

• Knowledge and field experience within the Latin American region with preference for Bolivia, Brazil, and Argentina.

• Experience in conservation, environmental policy, development or related fields is strongly desired.

• Acute political awareness and understanding of issues from a non-partisan perspective.

• Demonstrated experience building relationships among individuals and organizations with a range of interests and perspectives.

• Capacity to lead group discussions with individuals working in different roles and countries; skilled in training and guiding team members with a high degree of cultural sensitivity.

• Demonstrated experience meeting deadlines and effectively developing and moving projects forward with a high degree of independence and autonomy.

• Effective professional writing skills in both English and Spanish/Portuguese. Effectively communicates ideas, thoughts and concepts clearly and concisely and in a compelling way, both written and orally.

Travel
Travel up to 20% of the time to cities and remote locations in Bolivia, Brazil, Argentina as well as in the United States as necessary.

Work Authorization
Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country for which they are seeking employment without visa sponsorship.

Salary Range
The salary range represents a reasonable estimate of the annual salary based on Pew’s commitment to provide equitable and market-competitive pay. The actual salary offered will take into consideration many factors including but not limited to job-related knowledge, skills and experience, internal pay equity, and business need.

Total Rewards
This position offers a competitive salary and benefit program.
Pew is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, ethnicity, gender, or any other protected characteristics.

About the role

In this role, you'll focus primarily on identifying, exploiting, and helping remediate security vulnerabilities across our applications, APIs, and backend services. You'll work closely with engineering teams to understand how our systems operate, uncover complex security weaknesses, and translate your findings into meaningful improvements.

• Contribute to our security-by-design approach by sharing offensive security insights that help engineering teams identify and prevent vulnerabilities earlier in the development lifecycle.

• Help strengthen our security testing capabilities through automation, improved testing methodologies, and continuous improvements to our security processes.

• Have meaningful ownership and autonomy, with the opportunity to influence security practices, challenge existing approaches, and make a tangible impact on the security of our products.

What we are looking for:

• Proven experience performing manual penetration testing on web applications, REST APIs, and backend services.

• Strong understanding of OWASP Top 10 and OWASP API Security Top 10.

• Hands-on experience identifying and exploiting authentication, authorization, IDOR/BOLA, SSRF, injection, and business logic vulnerabilities.

• Advanced proficiency with Burp Suite and offensive security tools. Ability to review source code and identify security vulnerabilities.

• Practical knowledge of DevSecOps, CI/CD pipelines, and Secure SDLC practices. Familiarity with SAST, DAST, and SCA security tools.

• Experience with GitHub, GitHub Actions, or similar CI/CD platforms. Scripting and automation skills using Python or Bash.

• Experience collaborating with software engineers to remediate vulnerabilities.

Nice to have:

• AWS and Cloud Security experience. Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform.

• Experience with Semgrep, Snyk, SonarQube, Checkmarx, or similar tools.

• Participation in Bug Bounty programs, CTF competitions, or vulnerability research. Certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, eWPTX, or equivalent.

• Previous experience in fintech, banking, or financial services.

What we value:

• Strong offensive security mindset and technical curiosity.

• Ability to independently conduct end-to-end penetration testing engagements.

• Experience demonstrating the real-world impact of security vulnerabilities.

• Strong risk assessment and prioritization skills. Effective communication with engineering teams.

• A proactive approach to security automation and continuous improvement.

Important: Penetration testing is the primary focus of this role. DevSecOps knowledge is a complementary capability, not the main specialization.

Our offer to you:

• Chance of earning Klar stock options

• Computer devices

Before you apply, spend ten minutes on our website and LinkedIn. In your Loom we will ask what we do, where you found out about us, and why you want to work at Drop Zero Digital . Answers that could be about any company will not pass.

The role
We are Drop Zero Digital , a lifecycle marketing agency. We are hiring one person who is good at deciding. Our AI image service is our fastest-growing service, and whichever area you own, you will be helping it grow.
You will own one named area. Which one is decided during the trial rather than now, based on what you turn out to be strong at. It will be one of these two:

• The hiring machine. How we find, screen and hire people. Running the funnel end to end, sourcing, chasing, scheduling, keeping our tracker honest, and telling us when the process itself is broken.

• Client delivery operations. How work gets planned, briefed, chased and shipped for our clients. Holding timelines, briefing the team properly, and making sure nothing quietly stalls.

Both are the same job underneath: you notice what has slipped, you decide what to do, and you close it without being asked.
This is not an assistant job and it is not a coordinator job. You will make real calls every day, and you will be judged on the quality of those calls rather than on how much you got through.
We are building a team of people who decide well without being managed. If you want to be told what to do each morning, this job is not for you.

What we are looking for

• You make decisions and you own them, including the ones that go wrong.

• You can tell which calls are yours and which are not, and you get that split right in both directions.

• You take feedback as information and change, without folding on something you have good reason to believe.

• You get better fast. We would rather have someone at seventy percent climbing than someone flat at eighty five.

• You spot when something is failing and say so, including when it is our process and not your work.

• You write clearly and honestly, especially about problems.

On experience
We do not ask for a number of years. We check your work history against what you tell us, and a false answer ends the application.
Whatever employment you do list, we verify: employer, dates, title and paid status, evidenced by contract and payslips, in one exchange. You need to have held a full-time job at some point in the last 12 months. Beyond that there is no minimum, and a short history costs you nothing here. Misrepresenting the history you do have is disqualifying. Tell us the true version and you will not be penalised for it.

How the process works, and we tell you all of it now

• Application with a short Loom video. Research us first.

• A short test by email: one real decision task, your internet speed, your computer, and a paragraph on your work history.

• A 15 minute call with the founder.

• A recorded video interview. One take, no re-records. We verify the work history you've told us about.

• Aptitude tests. These inform us, they do not decide.

• A paid trial of six to eight weeks doing the real job.

The trial is where the decision actually gets made, including which of the two areas you end up owning. From the first week you will be making calls on live work, and we will tell you straight how each one landed. It is paid from day one: half rate for the first two weeks while you find your feet, full rate from week three onward, and a completion payment when you finish the trial, whether or not we hire you. If we stop early, you are paid for the days you worked.

Requirements

• Full time once hired, and this is your only job. During the paid trial you work 4 hours a day with us, 2 of them at a fixed time inside our working day, and you can keep your current job. If you pass, you give notice and join us full time within 30 days.

• Reliable internet, at least 30 Mbps down and 5 Mbps up, tested live with us.

• Strong written English.

• Based in Argentina.

• You track your working time with our time tracking tool from day one.

Benefits
2100 USD per month from day one, set by responsibility and demonstrated capability, not by how long you have worked.

On top of that:

• A one-month annual bonus.

• 15 days of paid leave a year, rising with tenure, plus your own country's public holidays.

• Paid sick leave.

Location: Buenos Aires - Argentina

About the role:

En OLIVER Agency nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un/a Business Lead que lidere la gestión estratégica y operativa de las marcas que atendemos. Es un rol clave para la operación: lidera parte de los proyectos, negocia con el cliente el alcance de nuestros servicios y desarrolla propuestas de venta a partir de las necesidades y urgencias que surgen día a día.

Trabajarás de cerca con equipos multidisciplinarios y con stakeholders internos y externos, tomando decisiones que impactan directamente en los resultados del negocio y en la calidad de la ejecución.

What you will be doing:

• Liderar la estrategia de marca con una mirada integral, que combine lo creativo y lo comercial.

• Dirigir y motivar al equipo, optimizando los recursos para cumplir los objetivos del negocio.

• Negociar con el cliente el alcance de la operación y desarrollar propuestas de venta alineadas con sus prioridades.

• Tomar decisiones diarias que mejoren la ejecución y los resultados de las campañas.

• Liderar la planificación, el seguimiento y el análisis de resultados, ajustando las estrategias cuando sea necesario.

• Supervisar el rendimiento y promover la innovación en las campañas y acciones de marketing.

• Asegurar una comunicación fluida y alineada con stakeholders internos y externos.

What you need to be great in this role:

• Experiencia comprobada liderando proyectos de marketing, publicidad o gestión de marcas, preferentemente en entornos in-house o agencias.

• Experiencia liderando equipos multifuncionales.

• Capacidad estratégica y operativa, con toma de decisiones bajo presión.

• Orientación a resultados y visión de negocio.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y negociación.

• Adaptabilidad frente a los cambios del mercado.

Idioma

• Inglés FLUIDO (Excluyente)

¿Qué ofrecemos?

• Day off por día de cumpleaños.

• Flexibilidad horaria y disposición para trabajar de manera híbrida.

• Licencia extendida por paternidad.

• Concepto de refrigerios.

• Días hábiles de vacaciones.

Req ID: 19098
Nuestros valores dan forma a todo lo que hacemos, puntualizando:

• Ser ambiciosos para alcanzar el éxito.

• Ser imaginativos para superar los límites de lo posible.

• Ser inspiradores para realizar un trabajo innovador.

• Estar siempre aprendiendo y escuchando para comprender.

• Estar enfocado en los resultados para superar las expectativas.

• Ser activamente pro inclusivos y antirracistas en nuestra comunidad, clientes y creaciones

Nosso processo de recrutamento não utiliza inteligência artificial para seleção. Utilizamos a IA para apoiar a eficiência e a consistência, e não para substituir o julgamento humano. A avaliação e a seleção de candidatos são realizadas sem o uso de IA para triagem ou tomada de decisão. Estamos comprometidos com uma experiência justa, cuidadosa e equitativa para cada candidato.

OLIVER, que forma parte del Grupo Brandtech, es un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades y se compromete a crear entornos de trabajo inclusivos en los que se motive a todos los empleados a alcanzar su máximo potencial, valorando y respetando las diferencias individuales. Todos los candidatos serán tenidos en cuenta sin distinción de raza, etnia, religión, sexo, orientación sexual, identidad de género, edad, neurodivergencia, estado de discapacidad o cualquier otra característica protegida por la legislación local.

OLIVER ha establecido ambiciosos objetivos medioambientales en torno a la sostenibilidad, con objetivos de reducción de emisiones basados en la ciencia. Colectivamente, trabajamos para cumplir nuestra misión, integrando la sostenibilidad en todos los departamentos y en todas las fases del ciclo de vida de los proyectos.

postings.title: DAR - Principal, Art Direction
postings.descriptionText:
WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

THE ROLE:

We’re looking for a talented and strategic Principal, Art Director to join a fast-paced, high-performing team supporting one of our most visible, dynamic clients. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who brings conceptual thinking, sharp visual design capabilities, and video-first experience to the table.

As a key leader within the creative department, you will not only translate strategy into smart, engaging creative but also mentor a multidisciplinary team of designers and creators. You’ll partner closely with Copywriters, Video Editors, and Content Creators, reporting to the Creative Director to ensure design excellence from kickoff through delivery. You’ll play a crucial role in owning your workstream, managing junior talent, and consistently raising the creative bar.

This role is perfect for someone who thrives in creative collaboration, is autonomous in ideation, enjoys rolling up their sleeves to execute, and has a strong point of view on what makes effective content in the digital world.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

• Deliver High-Impact Creative: Concept and design best-in-class digital creative across social, and video, with a strong focus on visual storytelling and performance.

• Mentor & Lead: Act as a direct supervisor and mentor to junior and mid-level Art Directors and Designers. Provide clear, constructive feedback to creatives across disciplines (for example, to copy) to elevate the team's output and foster professional growth.

• Support Video + Content Production: Contribute to pre-production planning, support on-set shoots, and collaborate with editors and designers in post to ensure work comes to life as intended.

• Partner Across Disciplines: Work closely with copywriters, strategists, producers, project managers, and client teams to ensure creative aligns with brief goals, brand voice, and business objectives.

• Manage Creative Execution: Own the work from end to end. Concepting and producing polished on-brand, performance-minded assets that meet timelines and briefs. As an Associate Director, Art Direction, you will lead by doing, driving execution while strategically delegating portions of our projects to our junior team members to support efficiency, mentorship and delivery while remaining accountable for the final output.

• Be a Problem Solver: Navigate ambiguity with CD support, adapt to shifting priorities, and bring proactive solutions to creative and production challenges. These solutions should come in the form of daily brainstorming and inspiration sharing with the team.

• Cultivate Culture: Foster an inclusive, high-energy environment. Lead daily brainstorms and inspiration-sharing sessions to keep the team’s creative pulse sharp.

WHAT YOU BRING:

• 5+ years of experience in visual design with a strong portfolio showcasing digital campaigns, social-first content, and video-driven work.

• Prior social agency experience or relevant experience with a track record of navigating high-volume, high-visibility accounts.

• On-set and content production experience (domestic or international), including working with video directors, editors, and producers.

• Strong client presentation and communication skills - you can confidently present ideas, take feedback in stride, and advocate for great creative.

• Excellent design sensibility and a strategic eye for layout, typography, motion, and branding. Additionally, deep knowledge of social best practices for optimal performance.

• A proactive, collaborative mindset - you bring energy to brainstorms, jump in where needed, and support your teammates with generosity and respect.

• A creative portfolio that shows your eye for design, your range in digital, video, and ability to turn strategy into scroll-stopping creative.

TAKE INTO ACCOUNT:

• You will have to communicate with your team members abroad, therefore fluency in English and excellent communication skills (both written and verbal) are a must for this role.

• This role will require you to work EST hours .

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

• We enjoy spending time together, working closely with other local colleagues, and getting to know one another. Our Buenos Aires offices (Villa Crespo or Mar del Plata) are fully equipped with refreshments and great common spaces!

• Premium healthcare through OSDE for the employee and their immediate family members

• Mendel prepaid card with a monthly allowance for grocery purchases

• Monthly reimbursements for Wi-Fi/electricity expenses

• Monthly reimbursements for training/English classes

• 100% covered “Plan Total” membership at Sportclub

• Access to a our benefits platform through Bonda

• A flexible vacation policy

WE SUPPORT YOU BEING YOU:

DEPT® is an equal opportunity employer (EOE). We believe our work is its best when our people feel safe and free to be themselves. We’re committed to an inclusive and barrier-free recruitment and selection process and workplace, regardless of anyone’s identity, background, beliefs, lifestyle or disabilities. So tell us about any accommodations you need. It’s totally confidential and only used to make sure you feel fully supported at every step.

DEPT® participates in E-Verify, meaning your Form I-9 information will be sent to the federal government to confirm you are authorized to work in the U.S.

We are a B Corp-certified company passionate about purpose-driven work . Our hope is that you can feel good about the contributions DEPT® is making to the world and we always have an open door for your ideas in making the world a better place.

DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Coach, eBay, and OpenAI.

Learn more about DEPT®

DIVERSITY, EQUITY, & INCLUSION

At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.

Want to know more about our dedication to diversity, equity, and inclusion? Check out our efforts here .
