postings.title: Senior Software Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Greenhouse is the first Orchestrated Hiring Ecosystem: a single place that brings the right person and the right role together at the right time. Our mission is to make hiring work for everyone – so we go to great lengths to hire great people because we believe that they’re the foundation of our success. At Greenhouse, you’ll join a team that collaborates purposefully, fosters inclusivity, and communicates with transparency and accountability so we can achieve our mission.

Join us to do the best work of your career, solving meaningful problems with remarkable teams.

Greenhouse has partnered with Deel to be its Employer of Record in Argentina (more information here ). Through this arrangement, Deel is hiring a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to provide services to Greenhouse.

This role will support the design, development, and evolution of the Company’s web-based applications. In this role, you will work across the entire application stack to deliver high-quality features for the Company.

Your work will range from building net-new functionality to improving how data flows across the Company’s services at scale. This is a collaborative role where you will work closely with product, design, and engineering partners to ensure the platform remains performant, reliable, and user-friendly.

Who will love this job

• A Pragmatic Architect - You don’t just write code, you think about how systems connect. You enjoy refining data models and improving system architecture to support long-term scalability.

• A Full-Stack Specialist - You are equally comfortable navigating a PostgreSQL query, styling a React component, or building a robust controller in Rails.

• A Quality Advocate - You believe “done” includes comprehensive automated tests and clear documentation. You take pride in leaving the codebase better than you found it.

• A Collaborative Problem-Solver - You thrive in an environment where code reviews are a dialogue and cross-functional collaboration is the norm.

• An AI fluent engineer – you already use tools like Claude to move faster, and you're excited to build on that experience

What you’ll do

• Build, modify, and maintain features using Ruby on Rails, modern JavaScript frameworks (React), HTML, and CSS

• Execute on high-impact projects

• Ensure code is maintainable and aligned with established engineering standards

• Contribute to the evolution of system architecture, including improvements to data transfer across services and ingestion pathways

• Design and maintain RESTful APIs, webhook-driven integrations, and data exchange pathways with third-party systems

• Diagnose and resolve complex integration issues to improve information flow

• Design and update PostgreSQL data models, refactoring legacy models to improve performance and reduce complexity

• Participate in production support during working hours, addressing bugs and escalations as needed

• Use monitoring and observability tools to maintain application stability and support performance tuning

• Participate in peer code reviews and provide constructive feedback

• Produce technical documentation, including architecture notes, implementation guides, and runbooks

• Write automated tests (unit, integration, and E2E) to ensure reliability and coverage

You should have

• 5+ years of experience writing and maintaining production-level code in a professional environment

• Strong experience with Ruby and Ruby on Rails

• Experience with JavaScript and React, plus solid HTML and CSS fundamentals

• Deep understanding of MVC architecture and backend optimization

• Proven ability to write efficient SQL, design relational data models, and optimize PostgreSQL performance

• Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs and managing third-party integrations via webhooks

• Proficiency with automated testing frameworks (e.g., RSpec, Jest, Cypress) and a commitment to test-driven practices

• Ability to contribute to architectural discussions and implement solutions that operate effectively at scale

• Comfort working in agile environments using standard development tools such as Git, CI/CD pipelines, and observability platforms

• Fluency in agentic coding and with leveraging and configuring AI tooling

Who we are

At Greenhouse, we live by our mission through using our own product to help us hire the right person for the job, every time. We’re committed to designing and responsibly using AI tools to transform how we work while keeping people at the center. We are a remote-first company and have shared office spaces in New York City and Ireland, and optional co-working spaces that give us flexibility to do our best work anywhere. We take an active role in our growth through a performance review program that’s committed to providing actionable feedback, and a bonus structure that rewards great performance. We believe that bringing together a variety of perspectives makes us a stronger company – and we nurture leaders who create an inclusive culture and invest into employee resource groups that celebrate our differences and life experiences. We’re proud to have built an award-winning culture that’s been recognized as Fortune’s Best Places to Work and Inc.’s Best Workplaces multiple years in a row.

If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation during the application process, reach out to accommodations@greenhouse.io.

postings.title: Senior Data Scientist, Research
postings.descriptionText:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role

We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist, Research who is versatile: you model high-stakes business problems—revenue optimization, risk management, and related questions—and you use AI to scale that work. You'll be a senior individual contributor who can go deep statistically, learn a new domain quickly, and rethink how data science problems get solved in the age of AI: not only classical models, but agents and other AI systems that multiply what a small research team can do.

This role is for someone who is deeply curious, strong at analytical thinking and problem solving, and a fast learner—with formal training and a strong statistical foundation. You have tackled revenue and risk problems with modeling before, and you are excited to solve them differently now: building AI agents, automating research workflows, and using modern tools so the science scales. If you want ownership over modelizable, revenue- and risk-critical problems and you already leverage AI to move faster, this is the role.

What You'll Do

• Tackle revenue and risk problems with modeling. Frame ambiguous business questions as quantitative problems; build models that improve revenue, manage risk, and inform decisions.

• Solve them differently in the age of AI. Use AI—including agents and other automation—to scale data science work: accelerate research, extend coverage, and change how models get built, tested, and used.

• Stay statistically rigorous. Bring a strong foundation in statistics and inference so AI-accelerated work is still trustworthy—you know when a result is solid and when it is not.

• Learn the business fast. Ramp quickly across new domains and problems; stay versatile rather than attached to a single method or subject area.

• Turn research into decisions. Communicate findings and trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical partners, including senior leadership.

• Raise the bar. Share practices that help the team use AI to scale DS work without lowering the quality of the science.

• Mentor and set standards. Mentor other data scientists and help grow a culture of curiosity, rigor, and high leverage.

What We're Looking For

• Versatile applied data scientist with experience modeling business problems such as revenue optimization and risk management—not just analyses or dashboards.

• Strong statistical foundation from formal training (statistics, mathematics, or a related quantitative field) and the judgment to apply it under real-world, messy conditions.

• Deeply curious, with strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills; a fast learner who picks up new domains, tools, and methods quickly.

• Practical experience leveraging AI to scale data science work—for example building AI agents, automating research workflows, or otherwise changing how modeling work gets done.

• Strong programming skills in Python and SQL; able to go from question to working analysis or model without a large support structure.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills; able to work with Finance, Risk, Product, and Engineering.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and ship work that gets used.

• Master's or PhD in a quantitative field such as statistics, mathematics, engineering, economics, physics, or a related discipline, and at least 6–10 years of relevant experience. Equivalent industry experience is welcome.

Nice to Have

Background in brokerage, trading, fintech, or another domain where revenue and risk decisions have real consequences.
Experience putting models or agents into production with engineering partners.

How We Take Care of You:

• Competitive Salary & Stock Options

• Health Benefits

• New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500

• Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.

About the Role

Alpaca is seeking a highly motivated and analytical Tokenization Analyst to join our Tokenization department.

This individual will work directly with the General Manager of Tokenization, supporting the development, commercialization, and execution of Alpaca's tokenization strategy.

The role sits at the intersection of strategy, product, business development, and operations. The ideal candidate is a versatile problem-solver who thrives in a fast-paced environment, can navigate ambiguity, and is comfortable taking ownership of projects from conception through execution.

This is a unique opportunity to gain exposure to multiple facets of a rapidly emerging industry while helping build the infrastructure powering the future of tokenized financial markets.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy & Business Operations

• Work directly with the GM of Tokenization to execute the department's strategic priorities and business objectives.

• Track key departmental initiatives, product milestones, and cross-functional dependencies, ensuring accountability and timely execution.

• Monitor departmental KPIs and develop recurring reporting on business performance, including revenue, transaction volumes, partner adoption, and other strategic metrics.

• Prepare executive presentations, business reviews, strategic updates, and other materials for senior leadership.

• Support annual and quarterly planning, including prioritization, business case development, and resource planning.

• Lead special projects and strategic initiatives as assigned by the GM.

Product & Go-to-Market Enablement

• Partner closely with Product teams to develop sales collateral, product presentations, integration guides, FAQs, and other client-facing materials.

• Translate complex technical product capabilities into clear, compelling commercial narratives for prospective clients and partners.

• Support product launches by coordinating internal readiness, external communications, and go-to-market deliverables.

• Gather feedback from Sales, partners, and ecosystem participants to help inform product strategy and prioritization.

Market Research & Ecosystem Development

postings.title: Growth Marketing Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Our Commitment to Our Team

At Pipe17, our values aren’t just words on a wall. They’re how we operate every day.

We are a high-performance team built around ownership , urgency , curiosity , and a strong bias for action .

We set bold goals, hold ourselves accountable, and move fast to solve customer problems. Every team member owns their decisions and drives outcomes. No one waits for permission.

We operate with urgency , but not recklessly. We focus on what matters most, take initiative, and course-correct quickly when needed. We value people who speak up, follow through, and take pride in their work.

Curiosity is how we get better. We ask questions, challenge assumptions, and stay open to new ideas. We don’t default to “how it’s always been done.” We explore, test, and learn. That mindset helps us adapt quickly, solve harder problems, and continuously raise the bar.

We also embrace AI as a force multiplier . We believe great operators don’t compete with AI - they partner with it. We use AI to move faster, think deeper, and remove friction from our work, while still applying human judgement, creativity, and context where it matters most. Thoughtful use of AI is part of how we scale ourselves and our impact.

Finally, teamwork is at our core. We win together, support each other, and celebrate our shared victories. Collaboration across functions is a daily practice, not just something we talk about. We learn from each other, improve constantly, and rally around our mission: unify commerce after the buy button.

If these values resonate with how you like to work, you’ll fit right in.

Type: Individual Contributor · Location: Remote (US) · Reports to: VP Marketing
Experience: 3–5 years · Target OTE: $105k–$115k

This is a hands-on build role, and acts as the connective tissue to our cross-functional GTM team. You will work daily with Sales and Partnerships, because the programs you build feed their pipeline across mid-market brands, enterprise order management, and 3PL.

About the role

Pipe17’s Order Operations Platform is the connected OMS that unifies orders, inventory, products and fulfillment across selling channels (DTC, B2B, retail and agentic), ERPs and fulfillment locations. We sell a technical product to operators, their bosses and the rest of the enterprise buying group, and generic marketing does not work on them.

We need someone who can build the systems that put the right message in front of the right account at the right moment, then run those systems without babysitting. You are part engineer, part marketer: comfortable in APIs, automation platforms, and LLM tooling, and equally comfortable judging whether a play will actually grow qualified pipeline. You will be the only person in this function, reporting directly to the VP of Marketing, with the latitude to build what does not exist yet.

What you'll do

Run account-based marketing execution.

• Build the named account lists for our enterprise and 3PL programs, and map the people inside each account.

• Keep account evidence current, built with agents rather than by hand: what each account runs, who runs it, what it costs them, and what changed.

• Run the mechanics: multi-touch sequences, executive outreach, dinner and event invitations, gifting, and follow-up.

• Own event and conference follow-up as a system. Target list and meetings booked before anyone travels, follow-up inside 72 hours.

• Give Sales and Partnerships what they need to work each account, when they need it.

Build custom nurtures. Replace the single nurture track with custom paths, where treatment rises with intent and decays with time. High-intent visitors get a human fast, light engagement gets agent-drafted outreach keyed to what they did, and stalled or previously-too-small accounts get re-scored and re-contacted on a schedule.

Own HubSpot. Own the roadmap and the admin. Fix the data model so it matches how we actually sell across three segments, clean up source attribution so we can say what produced pipeline, and build reporting the business trusts. Keep the stack small. We are not looking for someone who adds tools.

Build the outbound engine.

• Build automated outbound end to end: signal detection, enrichment, sequencing, reply handling, and CRM sync, using the tools we have in house today (HubSpot, Clay, Propensity, Artisan, Gong).

• Detect the events that mean an account is in play: a replatform, an ERP migration, a 3PL change, a new channel, a second warehouse, a bad peak season, a new operations or technology leader.

• Use LLMs and agents to personalize at volume, grounded in real research about each account.

• Make it run without babysitting, and make it measurable.

Must-have qualifications

• 3+ years in marketing operations, demand gen operations, GTM operations, or revenue operations at a B2B SaaS company.

• You have built an outbound engine from scratch, and can tell us what it produced in meetings or pipeline.

• You have run account-based programs, including building the target list when it did not exist, and are familiar with implementing and enabling use of ABM platforms.

• You have built custom nurtures with differentiated paths, and can show what they did to conversion.

• Deep HubSpot. You have designed the data model around how a business sells, and you are happy doing the admin yourself.

• You build. APIs, data manipulation, LLM tooling, and real depth in automation platforms such as Clay, n8n, Zapier, or Make. You can read API docs and debug when something breaks.

• You did it unprompted. You saw the gap and shipped the fix before anyone asked.

• Commercial instinct. You understand pipeline and conversion, and why reps ignore tools that technically work.

• A doer. Comfortable as the only person in the function, with direct exposure to the founders.

• Fluent in using AI to do the work, not just to talk about it.

Nice to have

• Experience in ecommerce, retail technology, or logistics.

• Enterprise account-based marketing into retail or supply chain buyers.

• Agents or LLM workflows in production against a pipeline outcome.

• Built the function from nothing at a Series A to C company.

• Ran a long enterprise cycle and a fast mid-market cycle in the same system.

• Supported a partner or channel motion, including partner-sourced attribution.

Interview process

You will meet a cross-functional panel, because this role is a shared resource across Marketing, Sales, and Partnerships.

• Recruiter screen with our Head of People.

• Hiring manager interview with our VP of Marketing.

• Homework assignment. A short assignment, deliberately close to the real work.

• Interview loop with Sales, Partnerships, and our CEO/President.

• Final presentation. A 45-minute session with the panel: 20 minutes to present your homework, 25 for discussion.

Compensation (US FTE)

• Competitive salary

• Great healthcare + dental + vision coverage

• Retirement plan

• Pick your own equipment. We'll set you up with whatever Apple laptop + monitor combo you want plus any software you need.

• Unlimited vacation policy. Plus we require you to take at least 2 weeks off each year. We see most employees take 4 weeks off per year. This isn't a vague policy where unlimited vacation means no vacation

About Us

Pipe17 is the AI-native Enterprise Order Operations Platform for brands and 3PLs. We replace the fragmented stack of iPaaS, middleware, and legacy OMS with one unified operational layer that manages orders, inventory, products, fulfillment, and exceptions across every channel and partner.

With 300+ managed connectors, AI-powered workflows, and an industry-first MCP Server for agentic commerce, Pipe17 lets brands go live in weeks, scale into new channels in days, and run post-checkout operations without developer dependency or systems integrators.

Our customers reduce operational costs by up to 85%, cut fulfillment errors by 99%, and launch new channels in days instead of months. Pipe17 is trusted by enterprise brands including Estée Lauder, Allbirds, e.l.f. Beauty, Made In Cookware, Wyze, Olly, Black Rifle Coffee Company, and Dude Wipes, as well as leading 3PLs including Ryder, FedEx, and Barrett Distribution.

Pipe17 is a venture-funded software company headquartered in Seattle, WA with a significant presence in the San Francisco Bay Area. The company is backed by GLP Capital Partners, a leading investor in ecommerce logistics, and with Series A funding.

postings.title: Jr. Firmware Test Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
About Celero

Celero Communications is building the next generation of intelligent optical connectivity for AI infrastructure.

Founded in 2024 by industry pioneers from Broadcom, Inphi, Marvell, and ClariPhy, Celero brings together decades of coherent DSP innovation with a focused mission to deliver the optical performance, power efficiency, and scalability required for tomorrow's AI-driven data centers.

We believe the future of AI infrastructure will be defined not only by speed, but by intelligence, energy efficiency, and the ability to seamlessly move massive amounts of data across increasingly complex networks.

Our mission is to build the technology foundation that makes this possible.

Headquartered in Irvine, California, with engineering teams in Canada and Argentina, Celero develops advanced coherent Digital Signal Processing (DSP) solutions that enable high-bandwidth, low-power optical connectivity for hyperscale AI infrastructure.

About the job

Celero is seeking an enthusiastic, detail-oriented Jr. Firmware Test Engineer to verify and validate the low-level firmware that runs on our coherent optical DSP ASICs for AI data center and hyperscale connectivity. Based in Córdoba, Argentina, you will work closely with hardware, firmware, systems and verification teams to bring up new platforms, test firmware features and debug complex hardware-software interactions on both pre-silicon and post-silicon platforms. Day to day, you will write automated Python tests, run them on boards and lab setups, and track failures down to their root cause, with guidance from senior engineers. This is an early-career role with a clear path to grow into firmware verification and QA, and your work will help get coherent DSP silicon from tape-out through bring-up and into optical modules shipping to hyperscaler customers.

Key Responsibilities

You will write and maintain automated pytest-based tests that verify firmware features on the embedded processors and SoC of our coherent DSP silicon, implementing them from test plans and building on the existing test framework. You will support firmware bring-up and validation on new hardware platforms and silicon revisions, running tests, analyzing results and debugging failures with logs, traces and debuggers, then reporting issues and following them through to resolution. You will set up and maintain test environments, including boards and lab instruments, and implement board-level and SoC-level firmware pieces such as initialization code and basic drivers that support test and validation. You will also contribute to test utilities, regression testing, CI infrastructure and test reporting, follow firmware coding standards, and document tests, procedures, firmware behavior and debugging steps while collaborating with hardware, verification and application teams under the guidance of senior engineers.

Basic Qualifications

• Education: Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Electrical, Computer or Systems Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience

• Experience: 1-3+ years of experience in embedded/firmware development, verification or QA, including basic experience developing and debugging firmware for embedded systems or SoCs

• Programming and Fundamentals: Strong hands-on C/C++, working knowledge of Python for scripting and test automation (pytest or a similar framework), and an understanding of memory management, pointers, data structures and register-level hardware access in embedded environments

• Verification and Tools: Working knowledge of SystemVerilog and UVM-based verification, Git and modular coding practices, DSP and control systems fundamentals, comfort in Linux and Windows, and fluent written and spoken English

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with one or more of the following:

• pytest fixtures, parametrization and markers

• CI/CD and test automation with Jenkins (pipelines, build agents, test reports)

• I2C, SPI, UART and GPIO interfaces, RTOS-based firmware or RISC-V

• Semiconductor validation, chip bring-up or FPGA prototyping

• Coherent optical systems or silicon photonics, and Python data analysis (numpy, pandas) or calling C libraries from Python

What Makes You Successful:

• You are a strong problem solver who stays curious and keeps digging until you find the root cause

• You are eager to learn and welcome feedback from senior engineers

• You work well across hardware, firmware and verification teams

• You are self-driven and comfortable with ambiguity and limited infrastructure in a startup

• You document your work clearly and follow tests through to resolution

Why Join Celero?

You will get hands-on experience across the full firmware lifecycle on real coherent optical DSP silicon, from pre-silicon platforms to post-silicon bring-up. As part of a small, fast-moving team with colleagues in Córdoba, Irvine and Canada, you will see your tests and tools make a direct difference to the chips that power AI data center connectivity, while growing toward firmware verification and QA.

If you're energized by innovation, enjoy solving complex challenges, and want to help define the future of AI connectivity, we'd love to hear from you.

postings.descriptionText:
About Celero

Celero Communications is building the next generation of intelligent optical connectivity for AI infrastructure.

Founded in 2024 by industry pioneers from Broadcom, Inphi, Marvell, and ClariPhy, Celero brings together decades of coherent DSP innovation with a focused mission to deliver the optical performance, power efficiency, and scalability required for tomorrow's AI-driven data centers.

We believe the future of AI infrastructure will be defined not only by speed, but by intelligence, energy efficiency, and the ability to seamlessly move massive amounts of data across increasingly complex networks.

Our mission is to build the technology foundation that makes this possible.

Headquartered in Irvine, California, with engineering teams in Canada and Argentina, Celero develops advanced coherent Digital Signal Processing (DSP) solutions that enable high-bandwidth, low-power optical connectivity for hyperscale AI infrastructure.

About the job

Celero is seeking a hands-on, self-driven Senior Firmware Test Automation & Validation Engineer to extend and evolve the Python-based test framework we use to validate our coherent optical DSP silicon. Reporting the Firmware team in Córdoba, Argentina, you will turn test plans into automated tests, run them on pre-silicon and post-silicon platforms, and drive failures to resolution alongside hardware, firmware, verification and application engineers. Your work sits at the boundary between software and hardware: register-level access to devices, lab instruments and boards, CI regression infrastructure, and cross-functional debugging. The faster and more reliably we validate our coherent DSP ASICs, the faster we can bring up silicon and ship it in optical modules for hyperscale AI data centers. Engineers at any seniority level are welcome to apply.

Key Responsibilities

• Test Framework: Extend and evolve the existing Python-based test automation framework for silicon validation

• Test Implementation: Implement automated tests from test plans, building on existing infrastructure, and keep them current as the silicon and firmware evolve

• Test Execution: Own test execution by running tests, analyzing results, and driving failures to resolution with cross-functional teams

• Failure Debug: Debug failures across software and firmware using logs, traces and debuggers

• Test Environments: Set up and maintain test environments on pre-silicon and post-silicon platforms, including boards and lab instruments

• CI and Reporting: Grow the CI regression and test reporting infrastructure

• Analysis Tools: Contribute to tools for test result analysis and failure categorization

• Improvement and Documentation: Propose improvements to test tools, and document tests, procedures and results

• Collaboration: Collaborate with hardware, firmware, verification and application teams

Basic Qualifications

• Education: Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Electrical, Computer or Systems Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience

• Experience: 2+ years of professional Python development with object-oriented design (classes, inheritance, reusable modules)

• Test Automation: Experience writing and maintaining automated tests with pytest (fixtures, parametrization, markers) or a similar framework

• Lab Hardware Testing: Experience testing hardware in the lab, including register-level access to devices and communication protocols

• Version Control: Experience with Git/GitHub

• CI/CD: Experience with CI/CD and test automation tools, preferably Jenkins (pipelines, build agents, test reports)

• Environments: Comfortable working in both Linux and Windows environments

• Communication: Fluent written and spoken English

• Debugging: Ability to analyze results and debug failures across software and firmware

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with one or more of the following:

• Controlling instruments such as power supplies, multimeters and oscilloscopes from Python (PyVISA/SCPI)

• C and C++, including memory management and pointers

• Databases, preferably non-relational (e.g., MongoDB, Elasticsearch)

• Semiconductor validation, chip bring-up, embedded firmware (RISC-V, RTOS-based firmware) or FPGA prototyping

• Hardware interfaces such as I2C, SPI, UART and GPIO

• UVM-based verification environments and SystemVerilog test methodologies

• DSP fundamentals and control systems

• Coherent optical systems or silicon photonics

What Makes You Successful:

• You have strong problem-solving skills and a real eagerness to learn

• You own tasks end to end and follow them through to resolution

• You propose improvements instead of waiting to be asked

• You work effectively with hardware, firmware, verification and application engineers

• You stay productive in a startup environment with ambiguity and evolving infrastructure

Why Join Celero?

As a Senior Firmware Test Automation & Validation Engineer in Córdoba, you will sit at the center of how we validate coherent optical DSP silicon, from pre-silicon platforms through post-silicon bring-up. Your automation and debugging will directly shape how quickly we find issues and ship chips for AI data center connectivity. You will work onsite alongside firmware, hardware and verification engineers in a small, fast-moving team where your ideas get built.

If you're energized by innovation, enjoy solving complex challenges, and want to help define the future of AI connectivity, we'd love to hear from you.

With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. postings.title: Senior Laravel Developer + React - Remote, Latin America
postings.descriptionText:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.

What we are looking for
• Senior Laravel & PHP Expertise: 5+ years of production experience with Laravel, including modern versions (Laravel 10–13) and PHP 8.3+.

• Core Framework Mastery: Deep command of Eloquent ORM (including query optimization and complex relationships), Laravel’s authentication/authorization ecosystem (Sanctum, Policies, Gates), queues, caching, and database architecture.

• Cloud & AWS Infrastructure: Hands-on experience deploying, scaling, and maintaining Laravel applications on AWS (e.g., EC2, ECS, RDS, S3, SQS, ElastiCache, or Laravel Vapor), including managing CI/CD pipelines and production observability.

• Automated Testing Culture: Strong commitment to code quality with extensive experience writing unit, feature, and end-to-end tests using Pest PHP, PHPUnit, Playwright, or Laravel Dusk.

• API & Full-Stack Architecture: Proven track record designing and building resilient RESTful APIs (or JSON:API) alongside modern reactive frontends using Inertia.js, React, Vue.js, or Laravel Livewire.

• UI Craftsmanship (Bonus): Proficiency with Tailwind CSS and building accessible, responsive component libraries.

• Extreme Ownership: You take end-to-end accountability for your code—from architectural decisions and accurate estimation to deployment and production stability.

• Client-Centric Mindset: Ability to align closely with Bluelight’s clients’ business objectives, translating complex requirements into reliable, on-time deliverables.

• Collaborative & High-Bar Engineering: A proactive, solutions-oriented attitude paired with forensic attention to detail in code reviews, security, and edge-case handling.

Company Benefits
• Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.

• Generous paid-time-off policy

• Flexible working hours

• Work remotely

• Continuing education, training, conferences

• Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.
You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!
If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

postings.title: South Cone Head of Sales - ChatGPT Ads by Aleph
postings.descriptionText:
AtAleph, we’re not just part of the digital advertising landscape—we’re shaping its future. Representing the world’s leading platforms, including TikTok, Amazon, Google, and nearly 55 others, we operate in 130+ markets across new and existing geographies.
 
ChatGPT Ads by Aleph. Now local. And this is your chance to be part of it.
OpenAI has named Aleph its exclusive reseller of ChatGPT Ads in 44 countries, so brands and agencies can contract, pay and get support locally. People come to ChatGPT to learn, explore and make decisions, and ChatGPT Ads gives brands a new way to be part of those moments. At Aleph, you will help make that happen.


About the Role
The Head of Sales leads the commercial business of ChatGPT Ads by Aleph in the South Cone, based in Buenos Aires. The role owns the revenue plan and the Client Partner and CSM team of the subregion, builds executive relationships with agencies and direct advertisers, and works with the Regional Partner Manager and the Agency PODs to execute the regional strategy locally.

What You Will Do
•
Subregional strategy: Define and execute the sales strategy, revenue targets and key account plans for the South Cone, in line with the regional strategy.

•
Team leadership: Lead, coach and develop the Client Partners and CSMs of the subregion, and support hiring and role development.

•
Pipeline & forecast: Own the pipeline and forecast for the subregion, and ensure each country has a complete view of its key accounts.

•
Sales routines: Run weekly sales routines and lead internal and external QBRs for the subregion.

•
Executive relationships: Build and maintain relationships with senior decision-makers at agencies and direct advertisers across the subregion.

•
Agency alignment: Coordinate with the Agency PODs on holding group and agency opportunities, avoiding channel conflict.

•
Partner collaboration: Work with the Regional Partner Manager and the OpenAI partner team on subregional priorities, product adoption and market needs.

•
Market development: Identify and report business opportunities and strategic alliances in the subregion, and build relationships with local industry entities and associations.

•
Commercial negotiation: Lead negotiations and agreements with key agencies and advertisers, with support from Sales Operations.

•
Cross-functional collaboration: Work with Product, Measurement, Marketing, Partnership Operations and Finance to remove blockers and scale the business.

•
Market representation: Represent ChatGPT Ads by Aleph in the South Cone.

What We Are Looking For
Minimum requirements

•
8+ years of experience in online ad sales and digital advertising environments, including 3+ years leading sales teams.

•
Proven track record of reaching and exceeding sales goals and scaling agency and direct advertising investment.

•
Established relationships with agency and advertiser decision-makers in the subregion.

•
In-depth knowledge of the digital and mobile advertising environment, including self-serve, auction and biddable buying.

•
Experience managing forecasts, pipeline and key account plans.

•
Excellent sales, negotiation and presentation skills.

•
Strong leadership and stakeholder-management skills in a highly dynamic environment.

•
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Advertising or Business Administration; MBA is a plus.

•
Advanced English and professional Spanish; Portuguese is a plus.

Preferred skills

•
Direct experience with OpenAI products (ChatGPT, API) or other AI/LLM platforms.

•
Experience at an ad platform, partner or agency in the subregion.

•
Experience working across several countries or time zones.

Why Join Aleph
•
Impact: Own the commercial business of ChatGPT Ads by Aleph in the South Cone and shape how agencies and direct advertisers in the region start advertising with ChatGPT Ads, one of the defining platforms of the AI era.

•
Growth: This is one of three subregional Head of Sales roles in LATAM, with direct exposure to the Regional Partner Manager and the OpenAI partner team, and a clear path to broader regional leadership at a global AdTech company operating across 130+ countries.

•
Team culture: Lead Client Partners and CSMs who are backed by Agency PODs, Performance & Measurement Analysts, Product Specialists and Partnership Operations, so you are never building the machine alone. Hybrid setup, with 2 days a week together in our Buenos Aires office.

•
Industry context: Digital already accounts for close to half of advertising investment in Argentina, and retail media and AI are changing how budgets are planned and measured. You would be building relationships with agencies and advertisers in one of the most digitally mature ad markets in LATAM.

•
Ownership: Take real ownership of the South Cone revenue plan and team, with room to shape how the business is built country by country.

“Share our similarities, celebrate our differences.” – M. Scott Peck
#ALEPH

postings.descriptionText:
🚀 Join Our Remote Data Products & Machine Learning Startup! 🚀
At Muttdata, we build innovative Data Products and Machine Learning solutions that help companies solve complex business challenges. As a fast-growing, remote-first startup, we're passionate about technology, collaboration, and continuous learning.
We are looking for an analytical, curious, and business-minded  Data Scientist Senior 🐶🚀 to join one of our key engagements with a leading beverage company in Mexico. You will be the go-to person for measuring what really works in growth and marketing: designing experiments, estimating causal impact, and turning the results into decisions that drive customer acquisition, retention, and revenue.
This role sits at the intersection of statistics, economics, and marketing. You will work closely with marketing, growth, and commercial stakeholders, as well as with Data Engineers and Analytics Engineers, to move beyond correlations and answer questions like "Did this campaign actually cause an increase in sales?" or "Which promotions and channels deserve more budget?". A strong analytical profile, methodological rigor, and the ability to communicate findings to non-technical audiences are essential. A background in Economics (or similar quantitative fields) is highly valued.

🚀 What We Do
• Leveraging our expertise, we build modern Machine Learning systems for demand planning and budget forecasting.

• Developing scalable data infrastructures, we enhance high-level decision-making, tailored to each client.

• Offering comprehensive Data Engineering and custom AI solutions, we optimize cloud-based systems.

• Using Generative AI, we help e-commerce platforms and retailers create higher-quality ads, faster.

• Building deep learning models, we enhance visual recognition and automation for various industries, improving product categorization, quality control, and information retrieval.

• Developing recommendation models, we personalize user experiences in e-commerce, streaming, and digital platforms, driving engagement and conversions.

• Amazon Web Services

• Astronomer

• Databricks

🌟 Our Values
• 📊 We are Data Nerds

• 🤗 We are Open Team Players

• 🚀 We Take Ownership

• 🌟 We Have a Positive Mindset

🔍 Curious about what we’re up to? Check out our case studies and dive into our blog post to learn more about our culture and the exciting projects we’re working on! 🚀

Responsibilities 🤓
• Design, run, and analyze A/B tests and multivariate experiments (sample size and power calculations, randomization, guardrail metrics, interpretation of results).

• Apply causal inference techniques (Difference-in-Differences, Synthetic Control, Propensity Score Matching, Instrumental Variables, Regression Discontinuity, uplift modeling) to estimate the impact of marketing campaigns, promotions, pricing, and loyalty initiatives when randomization is not possible.

• Measure and optimize marketing performance: incrementality, attribution, ROI/ROAS, customer lifetime value (CLV), and marketing mix modeling (MMM).

• Translate business questions from growth and marketing teams into well-defined analytical problems and experimental designs.

• Develop analyses, features, and models on Databricks (notebooks, Spark, Delta Lake), collaborating with Data Engineers and Analytics Engineers on data pipelines and analytical datasets.

• Build predictive and segmentation models (churn, propensity, customer segmentation) that support targeting and personalization strategies.

Required Skills
• 3+ years of experience in Data Science, Applied Statistics, Econometrics, or similar analytical roles.

• Hands-on experience with Databricks (notebooks, Spark/PySpark, Delta Lake) – required.

• Solid, hands-on experience designing and analyzing A/B tests and online/offline experiments.

• Strong knowledge of causal inference methods and their assumptions, limitations, and practical application (DiD, Synthetic Control, Matching, IV, uplift, etc.).

• Strong foundations in statistics and econometrics (hypothesis testing, regression, Bayesian and frequentist approaches, time series).

• Proficiency in Python (pandas, PySpark, statsmodels, scikit-learn) and advanced SQL.

• Experience applying data science to growth, marketing, or commercial problems (campaign measurement, pricing, promotions, customer analytics).

Nice to Have Skills 😉
• Degree in Economics, Econometrics, Statistics, or related quantitative fields (ideally with a focus on applied microeconomics or causal inference).

• Experience in CPG, retail, consumer goods, or beverage industries.

• Experience with Marketing Mix Modeling (e.g., Meridian, Robyn, PyMC-Marketing) and media attribution.

• Experience with causal libraries (DoWhy, EconML, CausalML) and Bayesian modeling (PyMC, Stan).

• Experience with MLflow and Databricks workflows/jobs.

postings.title: English to Belarusian Review Lead for UI, Marketing & Product Content
postings.descriptionText:
About Welo Global 
Welo Global is a leader in multilingual AI, technology, and content solutions serving over 2,000 clients in 300 languages. The company combines globally scaled multilingual infrastructure, including a network of over 500,000 linguists and domain experts, with advanced NLP, computational linguistics, and best-in-class compliance backed by seven ISO certifications. Welo Global’s five brands—Welocalize (multilingual content and localization services for global enterprises), Park IP (intellectual property and patent translation services for law firms and corporate legal teams), Welo Life Sciences (regulated language and compliance-aligned content solutions for pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device organizations), Adapt (multilingual performance-led digital marketing agency), and Welo Data (multilingual data generation, evaluation, and human data infrastructure for AI systems)—serve distinct customer segments with purpose-built expertise, fit-for-purpose solutions, and supporting technology. weloglobal.com 


The Role 
We are seeking an experienced English into Belarusian Review Lead to serve as the language quality owner and primary client-facing linguistic expert for a leading global technology client. 
You will own the locale’s interpretation of the client’s quality standards and make sure that the Post-Editing Lead, Post Editors, and Reviewers all work to the same shared understanding of “good”. You will be the main point of contact for the client’s Language Manager on quality discussions, arbitration, and escalations, and you will drive consistency, quality governance, and continuous improvement across UI, marketing, product, informational, legal, and support content. 
Project Details 
- Location: Remote (based in one of the approved countries below)
- Expected volume: Approximately 24 hours per month
- Employment type: Freelance / Independent Contract
- Task type: Language Lead Support
- Content types: UI, Marketing, Informational, Legal, Product, Support
- Language pair: English into Belarusian 
What You Will Do 
-Analyse requirements: Review every style guide and glossary update, assess which quality categories and content types it affects, and record the changes. Track what the client’s Language Manager actually corrects and says in calibration and quality calls, not only what is written down.
-Relay expectations: Run regular alignment roundtables with the language community and publish a structured monthly quality digest covering performance, priority improvement areas, style guide updates, and notable errors and arbitration outcomes.
-Manage review quality actively: Coach Reviewers one-to-one using specific examples, run shadowing sessions from real alignment data.
-Improve the standard: Turn recurring justification patterns into well-reasoned style guide proposals, and share cross-locale patterns with the Welocalize Quality Manager.
-Maintain alignment with the client: Treat Language Manager decisions as the standard, raise concerns with evidence at the right forum, and aim for fewer surprises over time.
What You Will Own
-The locale’s review service score, including RQE audit and alignment performance
-The community’s shared understanding of quality 
-The integrity of the arbitration record, ensuring that every arbitration sent to the client is valid and well-evidenced
-The working relationship with the client’s Language Manager, including clarifications, escalations, and expectation tracking
Requirements
- Experience: 3 to 5+ years in Localization Quality Assurance (LQA), Senior Language Lead, or Quality Governance roles
- Client and stakeholder management: Direct experience as the primary point of contact for client Language Managers, managing formal arbitration or escalation processes, and facilitating conflict resolution
- Quality audit frameworks: Deep, practical experience with localization evaluation frameworks, including RQE, LQE, error rubrics, and severity mapping
- Style guide and expectation analysis: Ability to analyse style guide changes, identify implicit client expectations, and map tolerance by content type (for example, Marketing vs. Legal vs. UI)
- Meeting facilitation: Hands-on experience with one-to-one coaching, shadowing sessions, alignment roundtables, and structured monthly quality reporting
- Analytical approach: Skill in tracking error concentrations, severity drift, and alignment scores, and in converting justification patterns into style guide improvements
- Language: Native-level Belarusian and professional-level English
- Preferred: Prior experience supporting major technology localization programs and working with calibration or alignment tools
Additional Key Information 
- Successful candidates will be provided with a dedicated device for project work.
- A background check is required as part of onboarding.
- Candidates must be physically located in one of the approved countries.
Approved countries: Argentina, Australia, Austria, Belgium, Brazil, Bulgaria, Canada, Chile, China, Colombia, Costa Rica, Croatia, Czech Republic, Denmark, Egypt, El Salvador, Finland, France, Germany, Ghana, Greece, Guatemala, Hong Kong, Hungary, India, Indonesia, Ireland, Israel, Italy, Japan, Kenya, Lithuania, Malaysia, Mexico, Netherlands, New Zealand, Nigeria, Norway, Peru, Philippines, Poland, Portugal, Qatar, Romania, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, South Africa, South Korea, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Taiwan, Thailand, Turkey, United Arab Emirates, United Kingdom, United States and Vietnam.  
Why Join Us 
This role offers a long-term partnership with global teams on high-visibility products. You will benefit from steady project volume, comprehensive onboarding and ongoing learning, and access to established linguistic resources. 
If this sounds like the right opportunity, we would love to hear from you. 
Beware of recruitment scams. Welo Global and all of its brands never recruit through direct messages on social media or WhatsApp, and never asks candidates to pay money for a job. Official emails come only from @welocalize.com, @welodata.ai, or @hire.lever.co, and all applications go through jobs.lever.co/weloglobal. Be wary of unexpected offers, generic email addresses (such as Gmail or Yahoo), and requests for fees or sensitive information. Report suspicious messages and learn more: Recognizing Scams and Confirming Legitimate Welocalize Communications – Welo Global

postings.descriptionText:
Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 100,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.


Manager, Production Quality
Location: Remote (US and LATAM)
Team: Product Fulfillment Team
Reports to: Manager, Pro Production
Why This Role Matters
The Manager, Production Quality leads the Quality team and sets the standard for every website we deliver. This isn't just a QA management job. You'll shape how Quality and Production work together as one connected pipeline, with shared expectations around quality, efficiency, SLAs, and the final client experience.
You'll work closely with Production leadership and use what you learn from QA reviews, performance metrics, and recurring production challenges to build training, improve workflows, and put scalable solutions in place. The best version of this role combines a strong eye for design, deep knowledge of the Presence platform, people leadership, and a drive to keep raising the bar.
What You'll Own
Quality Leadership and Design Excellence
Establish and maintain high standards for website design, functionality, compliance, brand consistency, and overall client experience.
Apply strong design judgment to evaluate visual hierarchy, layouts, typography, imagery, usability, and overall cohesion.
Lead quality calibrations and independent website audits, so expectations stay consistent and the team improves quality beyond catching errors.
Team Leadership, Coaching, and Development
Lead, coach, and develop the Quality team, setting clear performance expectations and holding the team accountable for quality, productivity, and turnaround times.
Develop and deliver design workshops, trainings, and best-practice initiatives for the Product Fulfillment Team.
Partner with Production leadership to identify recurring skill gaps, give actionable feedback, and improve quality at the source.
QA Operations and Production Alignment
Own daily QA operations, workload distribution, capacity planning, SLA adherence, and team performance.
Work with Production leadership to improve handoffs, reduce friction between Production and QA, and share accountability for the final product.
Monitor and analyze KPIs, including Website Draft Quality Score, Handling Time, On Time delivery, Pro Passback, and Passback Scores, to drive measurable improvement.
Identify bottlenecks and recurring quality issues, then implement solutions that reduce rework and improve delivery speed without lowering quality.
Innovation and Tooling
Partner with Product Development and Engineering to find opportunities for automation, improve existing tools, and test new solutions.
Help shape how Production and QA roles, responsibilities, and workflows evolve as new technologies arrive.
Turn day-to-day production challenges into scalable improvements that strengthen quality, efficiency, and the production experience.
Cross-Functional Collaboration and Client Experience
Collaborate with Production, Design, Onboarding, and other cross-functional leaders to close quality gaps and improve delivery.
Partner with Quality leadership across Pro Production and DREC to align standards, share learnings, and build organization-wide initiatives.
Champion a quality-first mindset, so every website is polished, functional, aligned with client expectations, and ready to deliver an exceptional experience.
What We're Looking For
Skills and Experience
Experience leading, coaching, and developing teams in website production, quality assurance, design, or a related environment.
A strong understanding of website design principles, including visual hierarchy, typography, spacing, layout, branding, and user experience.
The ability to evaluate website quality, spot opportunities for improvement, and give clear, actionable design feedback.
Experience managing operational performance, SLAs, team capacity, and productivity in a fast-paced environment.
Strong analytical skills and experience using KPIs, quality trends, and performance data to drive improvements.
The ability to design and deliver effective training, workshops, and coaching.
Experience finding process inefficiencies and working on tools, automation, or workflow improvements.
Strong communication, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Comfort navigating change, adapting to new technologies, and helping teams evolve as the business grows.
Mindset
Strong design eye: You recognize what makes a website polished, cohesive, and effective, and you can explain clearly how to improve it.
Ownership and accountability: You take responsibility for team outcomes, address challenges early, and follow through.
Quality-first leadership: You believe quality means delivering an exceptional product, not only finding mistakes.
Coaching mentality: You enjoy developing others and raising the capabilities of the whole production team.
Operational excellence: You balance high standards with efficiency, productivity, and timely delivery.
Innovation and adaptability: You embrace new tools, automation, and evolving workflows, and you help shape the future of Website Production.
Hands-on leadership: You lead by example, stay close to the work, and are comfortable reviewing websites, giving feedback, and solving problems directly.
Data-driven thinking: You use metrics, feedback, and trends to make decisions and drive continuous improvement.


Important note: Please ensure your CV is in English.

Join us in shaping the future of real estate
 
The real estate industry is in the midst of a seismic shift, and the future belongs to those who break new ground. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the proptech and marketing sectors, Luxury Presence challenges the status quo of what technology can do for real estate agents, leaders, and brokerages.
 
We're a team of agile and tenacious innovators working collaboratively to drive the industry forward. Together, we build game-changing products that empower modern real estate entrepreneurs to dominate their markets. From award-winning web design to agile SEO solutions to cutting-edge AI tools, we deliver tech that anticipates market shifts and keeps our clients ahead of their competition.
 
Founded in 2016 by Stanford Business School alum Malte Kramer, Luxury Presence has grown to a global team ranked on the Inc. 5000 fastest-growing companies list three years in a row. We're backed by world-class investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners, NextEquity Partners, Toba Capital, and Switch Ventures, and have raised $89 million to date.
 
More than 20,000 real estate businesses rely on our platform, including 30% of the Wall Street Journal RealTrends top agents and teams. Additionally, many of the industry's most powerful brokerages rely on Luxury Presence as a trusted business partner.
 
Luxury Presence has earned a spot on BuiltIn’s Best Places to Work list every year since 2020. Our founder and CEO was named a 2024 HousingWire Tech Trendsetter, and we’ve won multiple Tech100 Awards. Inman has also honored us twice: with the 2025 Innovation Award for Best AI-Powered Platform and the 2026 title of Best Proptech Company.

The Opportunity
We don't just use AI. We build with it, ship with it, and think with it. With a generous budget for tokens, our engineers use AI agents to write, review, and ship production code every day. We are building toward a world where humans design systems and AI builds them, and we are already far along that path.
We are hiring a hands-on Tech Lead Manager to lead our Mid Market & Celebrity (MMC) team. This team works side by side with our celebrity and mid market customers and the MMC sales org to build the features and customizations that help those customers grow on the platform. You will be the technical voice in the room from the first conversation. The team vets customization use cases on inbound leads before deals close, builds the agreed functionality after close, and turns the best of that work into capabilities every Luxury Presence customer can use.
This role pairs technical leadership with solution engineering. You will work directly with customers and sales to shape what we build, then lead the team that builds it.
What You'll Do
Be the technical partner to MMC sales and customers. Join conversations with prospects, customers, and vendors. Vet customization use cases quickly and explain what is possible, what it takes, and what the tradeoffs are, so deals move forward with confidence.
Practice solution engineering. Turn ambiguous customer needs into clear, scoped, supportable solutions. Translate between customers, sales, product, and engineering, and keep every party aligned.
Build and deliver after close. Plan and schedule the work, and deliver customer functionality with high quality.
Turn one-off builds into platform capabilities. Spot the solutions worth generalizing and graduate them into reusable capabilities for all customers, not only MMC.
Lead and grow the MMC team. Manage 2-4 direct reports. Own coaching, 1:1s, direct feedback, and career development. Treat management as a craft.

 - Planificar, coordinar y supervisar las prestaciones médicas de las cuatro bases operativas ubicadas en Comodoro Rivadavia, Rada Tilly y Puerto Madryn.

 - Controlar y validar honorarios profesionales y procesos administrativos asociados a las prestaciones médicas.

 - Capacidad para tomar decisiones bajo presión y gestionar situaciones críticas.

postings.title: Territory Manager (Southern California)
postings.descriptionText:
ABOUT HALTER

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard. 

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund https://foundersfund.com, Bessemer Venture Partners https://www.bvp.com/, BOND, https://www.bondcap.com/ DCVC https://www.dcvc.com/, Blackbird https://www.blackbird.vc/, Promus Ventures https://www.promusventures.com/, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures https://www.icehouseventures.co.nz/?utm_term=icehouse%20ventures&utm_campaign=Brand+Keywords&utm_source=adwords&utm_medium=ppc&hsa_acc=4064636360&hsa_cam=16902737884&hsa_grp=134004309485&hsa_ad=592971340272&hsa_src=g&hsa_tgt=kwd-1082530126230&hsa_kw=icehouse%20ventures&hsa_mt=b&hsa_net=adwords&hsa_ver=3&gclid=Cj0KCQjw2v-gBhC1ARIsAOQdKY0J0DepRVFDmjQlAkJPbZuQnLSA5UVzUzOXYiPxkjX-SeVa513_BhkaAr-MEALw_wcB.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/halter-limited & Instagram https://www.instagram.com/lifeathalter/.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Ever dream about being in tech but aren’t quite ready to trade in your cowboy boots? Look no further than Halter! As the leading provider of virtual fencing technology, Halter is on a mission to enable 50% of the world’s landmass to be more productive and sustainable. This role is paramount for our growth aspirations and will enable us to continue making an impact on ranches across the US.

As a Territory Manager at Halter, you will play a critical role in driving new business growth and ensuring customer success within your designated territory. You will be responsible for executing sales strategies, building strong customer relationships, and meeting ambitious growth targets, all while acting as Halter’s on-the-ground representative. This role requires a proactive and hands-on approach, with a focus on both expansion and long-term customer satisfaction. In this role, you will prioritize daily efforts that optimize performance and drive value for your customers. Working closely with cross-functional teams, including Product, Support, and Customer Onboarding, you’ll share field insights to ensure Halter’s technology continues to meet the needs of US farmers.

Your day-to-day could include being on horseback, helping customers gather their cattle, on a side-by-side traversing their pastures, talking about how Halter could benefit their pastures, or attending industry events like CattleCon or your local Livestock Association meetups.

 


WHAT YOUR DAY COULD LOOK LIKE

 - Prospecting New Business: You’re driving up driveways, attending local cattle auctions, meeting with your local Livestock, Cattleman's, Stockman's associations, building your new business pipeline through outbound lead generation efforts. You’re fielding inbound leads in a timely manner, prioritizing administrative tasks with your in-field activities.

 - In-Field Sales: You don’t mind getting your hands and boots dirty. Halter is best discussed over a coffee at a kitchen table, in the horse saddle, or on a side-by-side in a pasture. You’re out on the ranch helping potential customers before diving into the value of Halter. You’re dropping off coffee during calving season. You value the magic moments that make all the difference to our customers.

 - Expanding Existing Opportunities: You’re always looking for new opportunities, and that includes expanding your existing customers with Halter. You find value in expanding relationships and finding new ways to increase value over time. Not every rancher will collar all of their cows, so you see this as a unique opportunity to meet your goals.

 - Hitting Sales Targets: High-growth sales targets don’t scare you; you step up to a challenge and like shooting high. You’re an expert pipeline manager and don’t second-guess unqualifying a lead. You’re able to manage today’s deals while keeping next month in your sights.

 - Customer Account Management: Building relationships is more than just making the sale to you. After the sale, you aim to maintain close relationships with your customers to ensure their ongoing satisfaction, provide support, and address any challenges they face with Halter’s products. You’ll also ensure a smooth handoff from sales to customer onboarding and deployment of Halter, helping customers get the most value from Halter’s solutions.

 - Territory Ownership: You have a high level of ownership and take pride in what you build. Owning an entire territory means giving treatment to every corner and leaving no stone unturned. You value being the face of your territory, meeting with high-level stakeholders from various local, state, and federal agencies to build lasting relationships with regional agricultural groups.

 - Customer Onboarding: Your high level of ownership doesn’t stop after the sale. You dive in to make sure your customers have the very best onboarding experience possible. You actively own the end-to-end customer experience during onboarding and deployment of Halter’s product, ensuring a smooth transition from sales to implementation even when you’ve handed off the customer to different teams across Halter.

 - Field Learnings & Feedback: Feedback is not only paramount to the companies you want to work for, but it’s also ingrained in how you would own your territory. Serving as the primary point of contact for gathering customer feedback in your territory, you work tirelessly to advocate for what your customers need.

 - Collaborating with Support Teams: You’re a natural collaborator, seeking out partners across Halter to resolve any issues your customers encounter, and quickly. You escalate problems as needed and ensure that customers in your territory feel fully supported.

 - Attending Industry Events: You leverage opportunities at relevant industry and Halter events to generate leads and deepen relationships with existing customers. You’ll participate in demonstrations and network to expand Halter’s influence in the market.

 - Contributing to the US Sales Strategy: You strongly believe that a team can only be stronger when they work together. You strive to work with the broader team to optimize and evolve the sales process, ensuring it fits the US market. As we scale, your input will help drive greater efficiencies.



YOU’LL BE GREAT IF YOU EXHIBIT

 - Driven Attitude & Communication skills: Results-driven, motivated, and adaptable, you excel in high-stakes environments. You’re well-prepared and skilled at communicating with customers and internal teams alike. You are proactive and do not wait to act.

 - Ranching / Cattle Experience: You know the ropes (and the reins) of ranching or cattle operations, understanding the unique challenges of the industry. This experience allows you to connect meaningfully with customers about what matters most.

 - Sales & Customer Success Expertise: You have a strong history of creating new business opportunities, negotiating a value-based sales conversation, and have a background in building lasting customer relationships. You build relationships versus transactional sales, aiming for the long-term success stories and can expand existing relationships through upsell opportunities.

 - Territory Management experience: Experience managing a large territory with a balanced focus on sales and customer success, ideally within agriculture or technology.

 - Problem Solving & Collaboration ability: Resourceful and quick-thinking, you work well with cross-functional teams to address challenges and drive solutions.

 - Willingness to Travel: Frequent travel within your territory to engage with customers and prospects.



BONUS THINGS YOU COULD BRING ALONG TO THE ROLE

 - Familiarity with precision agriculture or virtual fencing technologies.

 - Background in customer-facing roles within agriculture technology.

 - Background in selling software (SaaS) solutions in a B2B environment.



OUR BENEFITS

 - Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP): Own a part of Halter and share in our growth and success

 - 401(k): 100% match on the first 3% contributed, plus 50% match on the next 2% (up to a 4% employer match), with immediate vesting

 - Comprehensive health benefits: Medical, dental, and vision coverage starting the first day of the month after you join (with most premiums covered, including 100% of employee-only health premiums on select plans)

 - Employee Assistance Program (EAP) & paid wellness leave: Access confidential support through JustWorks plus 3 paid wellness days per year

 - Personal growth fund: $750 USD per year to support learning, development, or personal growth goals

 - Unlimited PTO: Take time off when you need it—no accrual required, available from day one

 - Parental leave: 16 weeks paid leave for birthing parents and 8 weeks paid leave for non-birthing parents

 - Onboarding travel to New Zealand: Fly to NZ for onboarding at Halter HQ in Auckland—meet the team, visit a test farm, and immerse yourself in all things Halter

The annual OTE salary range for this role is $140,000 - $165,000. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Halter and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location.


JOIN OUR TEAM

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page https://www.halterhq.com/careers for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/halter-limited & Instagram https://www.instagram.com/lifeathalter/.




WHY OUR TEAM LOVES WORKING AT HALTER:

 - Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

 - Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

 - You'll grow here. Autonomy, mas

Join Hire Hangar and work with fast-growing global companies while building a long-term career.

Job Title: Senior Recruiter (Client-Facing, Full-Cycle)
Location: Remote
Time Zone: US Time Zones (EST)



Role Overview
We’re looking for a Senior Recruiter to own a set of client accounts and run every search on them from start to finish, on their own. You’ll be your clients’ main point of contact. You’ll take the brief, set expectations, present candidates and close hires. The ideal candidate comes from a recruitment agency or a high-volume hiring environment, has hired for technical roles, and is comfortable running many open roles across several clients at once.



Key Responsibilities

 - Own your client relationships: run intake calls, agree on role requirements, give regular pipeline updates and manage expectations

 - Run the full recruiting cycle on your own: source, screen, interview, coordinate, present candidates and close

 - Manage a high-volume pipeline across multiple open roles and clients at the same time

 - Run structured and technical interviews that test candidates against each client’s needs

 - Advise clients on market conditions, salary ranges and what candidates expect

 - Keep candidates engaged with clear, timely updates at every stage

 - Keep ATS records accurate and report on pipeline progress to clients

 - Suggest process improvements that cut time-to-hire and raise hire quality
   
   

Required Qualifications

 - 3+ years of full-cycle recruiting, ideally at a recruitment or staffing agency, or in high-volume hiring

 - Proven success hiring for technical roles (engineering, data, product or similar)

 - Direct, client-facing experience: comfortable leading calls with hiring managers and senior stakeholders

 - Track record of managing multiple roles and clients at the same time without supervision

 - Strong written and spoken English

 - Prior remote work experience and fluency with Slack, Zoom, Google Workspace and Asana (or similar). Ideally has worked with US or UK-based companies; applications without this experience will not be considered
   
   

Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience in client account management or acting as the main contact for client relationships

 - Experience with recruitment metrics and reporting

 - Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean sourcing and modern ATS platforms (Ashby, Greenhouse, Lever)

Our client is a digital advertising and marketing company providing creative production, media buying, and campaign management services across multiple clients and industries. The company works with creative, media, and technology partners to deliver marketing campaigns and is expanding its use of AI-driven creative and asset management tools.




ROLE OVERVIEW

The Marketing and Production Coordinator will manage production workflows while creating graphic design assets, social media content, and short-form videos for client campaigns.

This hybrid role combines project coordination with hands-on creative execution. The ideal candidate is organized, adaptable, and comfortable managing multiple client projects while producing marketing assets, coordinating vendors, and supporting the Creative Director and company leadership.




LOCATION

Fully Remote (Work from Home) | 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM PST | 30 hours a week




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


PRODUCTION COORDINATION & PROJECT MANAGEMENT

 - Collect and organize client creative assets, campaign specifications, and setup requirements.

 - Place vendor orders and support media buying activities alongside company leadership.

 - Track project deadlines, deliverables, and production status across multiple clients.

 - Participate in internal production meetings and progressively take ownership of meeting coordination.

 - Collaborate with media and programmatic advertising partners.

AI TOOLS & MARKETING OPERATIONS

 - Help develop campaign roadmaps, production workflows, and repeatable processes.

EXPERIENCE

 - Experience working with client brand guidelines and adapting creative assets across different formats.

 - Experience using project management tools to track deadlines and deliverables.

 - Experience supporting creative or marketing teams in a fast-paced environment.
   
   


SKILLS

 - Ability to coordinate with clients, vendors, and internal teams.

PORTFOLIO RECOMMENDATION

A portfolio demonstrating hands-on experience in graphic design, social media content creation, and short-form video production. Relevant samples include digital advertisements, social graphics, Reels, TikToks, carousels, and creative variations across different brands or campaigns.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN THE FIRST 30 DAYS

PPC & CAMPAIGN OPTIMIZATION

• Experiencia trabajando con metodologías ágiles (Scrum/Kanban).
