postings.title: Internal Communications & Engagement - Supervising Associate - EY Global Delivery Services
postings.descriptionText:
The opportunity
The GDS position will support the Americas Consulting BMC team within EY Brand, Marketing and Communications, aligned to the Communications and Engagement internal communications team.
This position will work with the Consulting Communications and Engagement team to support internal communications across Americas Consulting, helping inform, inspire and engage our people around Consulting priorities, leadership messages, business updates and key operational moments. The role will support core communications channels, broad-audience emails and live events, in addition to maintaining editorial calendars and trackers, and coordinating across support stakeholders, such as creative services and production teams.

Your key responsibilities
• Write, edit and format BAU communications, including invites, agendas, speaker briefs, awards, newsletters, intranet/Sharepoint content and other related materials.
• Support webcast and live event operations, including agenda coordination, materials preparation, speaker logistics, production coordination, day-of support and post-event follow-up.
• Manage editorial calendars, communications trackers, metrics and planning tools to track audience, channel, owner, status, approvals, timing and follow-up actions.
• Support distribution lists and mailbox management, including mailbox guidance, test sends, final distribution, archiving and tracker updates.
• Create and maintain Outlook and Marketo email templates for updates, invitations, announcements, newsletters and recurring communications.
• Coordinate across Consulting Communications stakeholders, including Creative Services and other functional teams to manage timelines, requests and logistics.

Skills and attributes for success
• Excellent writing, editing, proofing and quality control skills, with strong attention to accuracy, tone, formatting and stakeholder feedback.
• Strong project management skills, including the ability to manage calendars, trackers, approvals, templates, deadlines and multiple workstreams.
• Ability to support webcast, live event and distribution processes with close attention to timing, logistics and follow-through.
• Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills across Consulting Communications stakeholders and other functional teams, communications colleagues and BMC partners.
• Comfort using templates, trackers, editorial calendars and process documentation to improve consistency, speed and quality.
• Commitment to EY brand standards, established procedures and continuous process improvement.

To qualify for the role, you must have
• 5-6 years’ overall experience, including at least 4 years in internal communications, corporate communications or communications operations.
• Bachelor’s or master’s degree, preferably in English, communications, journalism, marketing or a related field.
• Excellent English writing, editing, proofreading and quality control skills; writing samples or a writing assignment may be required.
• Strong project management skills and ability to partner with onshore BMC team members during US East Coast working hours.
• Experience supporting internal communications channels such as email, newsletters, intranet content, leadership messages, webcasts or live events.
• Experience with editorial calendars, communications trackers, distribution lists, shared mailboxes, Outlook templates, Marketo templates or similar tools.
• Strong attention to detail and ability to manage high-volume, deadline-driven work.

Ideally, you’ll also have
• Business acumen to understand Consulting strategy, leadership priorities and stakeholder needs, and translate them into clear communications deliverables.
• Experience supporting broad-audience communications, leadership forums, webcasts, live events or recurring internal communications channels.
• Experience coordinating across cross-functional teams, including communications, creative, production, digital, Talent, Operations, Quality, Markets, Learning or service line stakeholders.
• Eagerness to learn quickly, improve processes and expand core communications operations skills.

Technologies and Tool s
• MS Office – Word, PowerPoint, Excel and Outlook.
• Microsoft Teams, Teams live events or similar webcast and virtual event platforms.
• Marketo and Outlook email templates.
• Editorial calendars, communications trackers and dashboard tools.
• SharePoint, intranet publishing tools and Daily News or similar internal channels.
• Familiarity with Adobe Experience Management, Power BI, Creative Services request tools, content management systems, video tools and related communications operations platforms.

What we look for

• Creative Quotient
• Communication Skills (Comprehend, Verbal & Written)
• Listening Skills
• Result Oriented
• Time Management
• Customer Focus
• Personal Learning & Development
• Planning and organizing

What we offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy.
We are reshaping careers at EY by supporting increasingly diverse career journeys, empowering you to build your career and proactively seek out the experiences that will help you go further.

What you can expect:
• Drive your career
o Success as defined by you. Your passion amplified by our purpose. Solving the world’s toughest challenges while building a better working world, together.
o We provide the scale, teams and the tech. We'll show you what’s possible, so you’ll see opportunities where others see challenges.
o With our help, you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
o We provide a foundation for you to create and personalize your career, with success defined by you.
• Manage your performance
o Connect with each other through better conversations,
o Find out how we support your career and growth
o We recognize your contributions and efforts to team and serve our clients throughout the year.
• Varied experience
o Challenge the way you experience the world.
o Multicultural thinking, teaming and working are at the heart of our shared success.
• A career as unique as you are. It’s yours to build.

About EY
EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers to the complex issues facing our world today.

If you can demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

The exceptional EY experience. It’s yours to build.

Apply now »

postings.title: Canada Account Support Associate - EY Global Delivery Services
postings.descriptionText:
The opportunity

Join our Finance team to enable EY Canada client account teams and management to run the business effectively. You’ll help to improve engagement profitability, manage enterprise wide risk and support market development activities. You will support EY planning, reporting, and forecasting and analysis, or help EY people manage day-to-day activities, such as administering engagements, pricing and budgeting, time and expense review, or invoicing. You will also work with other parts of our organization, sharing your financial insights to drive better outcomes. You’ll get all the support you need to stay on top of a constantly evolving business environment — and the advice and help to meet your own professional goals.

Your key responsibilities

The Account Support Associate is an expert in the firm's engagement management systems, supports the Client Serving Executive (CSE) with administrative tasks related to engagement oversight and provide a ready resource for financial data and analysis, with overall responsibility for engagement management and economics resting with the CSE.
• Works closely with the CSE to provide pricing support and develop planned metrics
• Works with CSEs and cross-functional teams throughout the pursuit, client acceptance and engagement processes to ensure records contain accurate and up to date information
• Develops client and engagement economic measures
• Develops and monitors possible economic scenarios to be used in monitoring specific engagements
• Performs analysis of inventory balances. Monitors overall inventory levels and aging, and reports findings to the CSE and management teams
• Process adjustments to revenue based on regular discussions with the CSEs on budget updates and strong understanding of our internal systems
• Monitors client invoicing and collections, structures best practices around the same, and proactively encourages billing for "out-of-scope" work
• Works closely with the collection specialist and CSEs to ensure proper collection activities occur
• Performs special projects and ad hoc requests

Skills and attributes for success
• Excellent communication skills, both written and oral
• Ability to influence and persuade others
• Strong balance of interpersonal and analytical skills
• Effective multitasking and prioritization skills

What we look for
• Business oriented B.A. (or equivalent) with 3-4 years (or more) of work experience OR a graduate business degree with a minimum of 2 years of work experience
• Proficiency with the MS Office Applications, in particular MS Excel
• This role involves interaction with internal and external clients and professionals nationally and globally. Professional competency in the English language is therefore a requirement of this role. Bilingualism in both French and English is considered an asset

What we look for

We are looking for candidates who are analytical, strategic thinkers and have a strong attention to detail. The ideal candidate is highly motivated, results-driven, and communicates effectively with all ranks. Being a strong team player is critical with the ability to adapt to changing requirements or deadlines in support of our clients’ goals.

This job posting relates to an existing vacancy within our organization.

Apply now »

postings.title: Business Talent - Talent Consultant, Supervising Associate - EY GDS
postings.descriptionText:
Talent Consultant, Supervising Associate

Everything we do for our clients comes down to having the right business and technical knowledge and experience for every occasion. Naturally, there’s plenty going on behind the scenes to make that happen, and our colleagues across the business look to our Talent team to guarantee that everything runs seamlessly. As a Talent Consultant supervising associate, you’ll be at the heart of that goal, partnering with a diverse team of professionals to provide people-driven HR services. We’re focused on developing the leaders who will support us in building a better working world, and you’ll have the opportunity to influence the change of our programs and development of our people.

The opportunity

Talent has seen a significant investment and growth in our people, and you’ll see that reflected in this role. You’ll develop relationships and team with our leaders, influencing decisions in a culture that recognizes and builds on successes. Our leaders will look to you to provide guidance and solutions on employee relations while driving our talent agenda forward to meet our business strategy. You can expect to be part of a world-class team, where creative thought and innovative ideas are cherished.
Your key responsibilities

You’ll be responsible for coordinating and facilitating human resources activities for a specific population. Working closely with other Talent team members, you’ll implement, execute and influence innovative HR programs and processes in line with our Talent agenda, including performance management, compensation and career development. You’ll address and resolve a wide range of employee inquiries and provide guidance to our business leaders. You’ll also be responsible for collecting and analyzing data related to staffing, headcount, budgets and compensation to identify trends and make appropriate recommendations.

Skills and attributes for success
• A proven ability to manage a diverse portfolio of projects
• Working knowledge of HR laws and practices
• Strong written and verbal communication skills
• Ability to influence leaders around new programs and change

To qualify for the role, you must have
• A bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience
• Five-plus years of relevant experience with working knowledge of United States Labor Laws
• Proficiency in MS Office, including Word, Excel and PowerPoint
• Strong command of English Language (written and oral)
• Cross boarder working knowledge
• Financial Services knowledge (ex. Banking, Capital Markets, Insurance and/or Wealth Management)

Ideally, you’ll also have
• Society for Human Resource Management certification
• Experience working within a professional services industry or complex matrixed environment

What we look for
We’re interested in influencers with a broad and extensive knowledge of HR processes. You’ll need to be comfortable questioning ideas, processes and senior colleagues — all while overseeing multiple projects or employee issues. If you have a genuine passion for talent management and the confidence to take on new responsibilities proactively to stay ahead of demand, this role is for you.

Apply now »

postings.title: IAM AI Automation Engineer - EY GDS
postings.descriptionText:
IAM AI Automation Engineer



Today’s world is fueled by vast amounts of information. Data is more valuable than ever before. Protecting data and information systems is central to doing business, and everyone in EY Information Security has a critical role to play. Join a global team of professionals who collaborate to support the business by protecting information assets. Our Information Security professionals enable the organization to work securely and deliver secure products and services, as well as detect and respond to security events as they happen.

Within Information Security, we blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security and technology solutions across the security lifecycle. You will join a team of security-focused professionals dedicated to supporting, protecting and enabling the business through innovative and secure solutions that provide business value.



The opportunity



As part of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) organization, the Frontier AI - IAM Automation Engineer will design, develop, configure, test and deploy automation solutions that integrate authentication, federation, authorization, DevOps and Artificial Intelligence (AI) capabilities across enterprise, cloud and hybrid environments.

The role combines core IAM engineering fundamentals with the development and deployment of Agentic AI-driven automation for new and existing IAM processes. It spans IAM platform and services which include, but not limited to, Microsoft Entra ID, Agent ID, M365, workload identities, federated identity credentials, authentication and authorization, session management, token protection, and secrets or certificate-based authentication.

The engineer will partner with Architecture, Product, Operations, application teams and vendors to translate requirements into secure, supportable automation solutions that meet IAM standards and align with EY’s global technology and security strategies. He will collaborate to move changes through design, development, testing, production deployment and operational handover.



Your key responsibilities



• Designing and developing automation and agentic AI solution for IAM processes using tools like Azure Automation, Logic Apps, Functions, Power Platform, Ansible, Azure CLI, & Azure Resource Manager (ARM) templates, Copilot Studio, Foundry, scripting in languages like PowerShell, Python, NodeJS, ReactJS, or .Net, and securing Continuous Integration / Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines by managing access controls.

• Developing AI-augmented solutions that enhance the global IAM platforms’ intelligence, automation and adaptive capabilities.

• Design, develop and integrate AI-based features, such as adaptive access control, predictive threat detection and identity analytics, into the IAM automation solution framework.

• Automating compliance and auditing processes for IAM services and establishing monitoring and incident response with Azure Security Center and Azure Sentinel.

• Collaborating with cross-functional teams, effectively working both independently and as part of a team, while liaising with product/service vendors like Microsoft, Ping, Auth0 for service issue escalations.

• Providing advisory services to our internal client on the application of Agentic AI to IAM process automation, user experience and risk reduction.

• Demonstrating a systematic approach to problem-solving and quickly absorbing new technical information as well as ability to quickly grasp technical issues and act on them, resolving or escalating to leadership as necessary.

• Planning and scheduling work to meet targets, ensuring that solutions are well-documented for sustainability, and facilitating the successful transition of project deliverables to support and operations teams, emphasizing the connection between technical solutions and business objectives.

• Actively building rapport with clients, applying a deep understanding of their needs to identify critical outcomes and barriers to success; gather client feedback to provide credible solutions and high-quality deliverables.

• Identifying and leveraging leading practices, diverse perspectives, and lessons learned to enhance technical solutions.



Skills and attributes for success



• Solid understanding of authentication, authorization, identity federation, MFA, SSO and Zero Trust principles.

• Hands-on experience with Microsoft Entra ID, including Azure Automation, Logic Apps, Functions, Power Platform, Azure DevOps services for CI/CD, including Repos, Pipelines, Artifacts, and Boards.

• Good knowledge of Agentic AI architectures (multi-agent systems, LLM orchestration, reinforcement-based agents or decision engines).

• Experience implementing AI, ML or automation technologies within IAM or cybersecurity domains.

• Experience designing and integrating systems using the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or equivalent AI orchestration standards.

• Experience in scripting languages (such as PowerShell, Python, Bash, Ruby, NodeJS, ReactJS, .Net) and ability to work with REST APIs, JSON and certificates.

• Skills in managing Azure Key Vault for secrets and certificates, and proficiency with Microsoft Graph API for accessing Azure AD and Office 365 services.

• Experience with Azure monitoring and logging services, Azure Security Center, and Azure Sentinel for performance insights, threat protection, and incident response.

• Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform, Azure ARM templates, and AWS CloudFormation for cloud infrastructure automation.

• Proficiency with version control systems like Git and experience with CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or CircleCI.

• Knowledge of containerization and orchestration tools like Docker, Kubernetes, or Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) for container management, and experience with secrets management tools like Azure Key Vault.

• Strong troubleshooting, documentation, testing and stakeholder communication skills.

• Understanding of secure software delivery, ITSM, Change Management and production support practices.



To qualify for the role, you must have



• Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

• 3 to 5 years of experience in IAM, authentication engineering, access management, security engineering or enterprise platform support, with 2+ years of experience in developing and implementing cloud automation solutions, and at least 1+ year of experience developing and deploying AI / ML solutions.

• Experience configuring or supporting enterprise authentication and access management solutions.

• Experience delivering controlled changes across development, test and production environments.

• Ability to analyze technical issues, document findings and work effectively with distributed teams.

• The ability to work effectively within a multi-disciplinary, multi-cultural team structure, as well as independently.



Ideally, you’ll also have



• Experience with Microsoft Entra ID platform along with Azure DevOps, CI/CD and infrastructure automation.

• Hands-on experience and familiarity with Agentic AI frameworks (LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen or similar).

• Strong knowledge of authentication, authorization, zero trust principle and software development lifecycle (SDLC).

• Experience with CyberArk, Azure Key Vault or another enterprise secrets management platform.

• Relevant Microsoft, Automation, DevOps, AI / ML, security or ITIL certification.



What we look for



We seek a hands-on engineer who combines sound IAM fundamentals with automation and AI / ML experience and curiosity about emerging technologies. The successful candidate is structured, security-minded and comfortable collaborating across application, infrastructure, architecture and operations teams.



What we offer



As part of this role, you will work in a highly coordinated, globally diverse team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The benefits package focuses on physical, emotional, financial and social well-being. Your recruiter can explain the benefits available in your country.

• Continuous learning: You will develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.

• Success as defined by you: We will provide the tools and flexibility so you can make a significant impact, your way.

• Transformative leadership: We will give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.

• Diverse and inclusive culture: You will be accepted for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact the recruiting team to request accommodations.

We are committed to being an inclusive employer and are happy to consider flexible working arrangements. We strive to achieve the right balance for our people, enabling excellent service while allowing individuals to build their careers without sacrificing personal priorities.

If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.



Join us in building a better working world.

The opportunity
We are seeking an Archer Developer with approximately four years of relevant experience whose primary focus will be configuring, enhancing, and supporting our enterprise InfoSec Archer platform. This role participates in the full software lifecycle under established technical direction, from requirements and solution design through development, testing, deployment, and support.
Archer is the core technology for this role. The developer will configure applications, workflows, calculations, questionnaires, access controls, and reports, and will support integrations, APIs, automation, data services, and selected AI-enabled capabilities that complement Archer. The role is expected to apply established patterns, seek guidance for complex designs, and continue building breadth across adjacent technologies.
Your key responsibilities
The Archer Developer role encompasses a broad spectrum of responsibilities, central to which is the design and configuration of various components using both core and custom Archer modules. The developer will be actively involved in the entire software lifecycle, from analysis to deployment, ensuring that solutions are robustly tested and successfully integrated into the enterprise Archer platform. Collaboration with product owners and program business analyst is crucial for the role, to align solution designs with business needs, including process mapping, module development, and the creation of comprehensive documentation such as layouts, workflows, reports, and user manuals. Additionally, the developer will contribute to the design of integrated data flows, own releases across development stages for their scope of work and provide ongoing maintenance and support. A key part of the role involves staying abreast of Archer’s product roadmap and leveraging Archer's capabilities to optimize and automate business processes. maintain development practices standards, in line with industry trends and organizational objectives.
The Archer Developer configures and enhances Archer applications for defined due diligence, information security, and GRC use cases. Responsibilities include maintaining fields, layouts, workflows, calculations, questionnaires, access roles, reports, and cross-application relationships in line with established standards. The developer may also create or modify scripts, interfaces, and automation using documented patterns and support from senior technical colleagues.
The developer participates across the development lifecycle and supports Archer upgrades and feature releases through impact assessment, targeted regression testing, issue resolution, and documentation. Additional responsibilities include troubleshooting production issues, supporting data quality and access control reviews, and collaborating with product owners, business analysts, senior developers, technical leads, operations, and QA.

• Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills across Archer workflows, permissions, data, integrations, and reporting

• Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a globally distributed team
• Ability to manage assigned priorities, adapt to change, raise risks, and seek guidance when appropriate
To qualify for the role you must have
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
• Approximately four years of relevant technology experience, including at least two years of hands-on experience configuring or developing Archer applications, workflows, access controls, calculated fields, questionnaires, reports, or data relationships
• Solid understanding of Archer platform capabilities, data model concepts, and common enterprise GRC implementation practices
• Experience analyzing requirements and translating them into technical tasks or user stories covering workflow, automation, data, integration, and access needs
• Hands-on development experience with one relevant language or framework, such as JavaScript or TypeScript, Node.js, .NET, C#, or Python
• Working experience with SQL and REST APIs, plus exposure to system integration, authentication, or data troubleshooting
• Exposure to Azure or a comparable cloud platform and a basic understanding of web applications, identity, serverless functions, or data services
• Exposure to generative AI, agentic AI, or AI-enabled automation through coursework, prototypes, integrations, or production support
• Working understanding of software testing, source control, documentation, secure development, deployment, and production support
• Ability to deliver assigned work independently while collaborating with senior colleagues on complex designs and technical decisions
Ideally, you’ll also have

• Experience supporting Archer integrations, custom interfaces, data feeds, or related services
• Exposure to retrieval-augmented generation, prompt engineering, AI agents, model evaluation, or AI monitoring
• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, DevSecOps, infrastructure as code, or automated testing
What we look for
A hands-on Archer developer with a broader technical mindset: someone who can independently deliver well-defined Archer enhancements, connect the platform to other systems using established patterns, and continue developing skills in cloud, automation, data, and AI. The successful candidate will be curious, pragmatic, collaborative, comfortable asking for guidance, and committed to continuous learning and reliable delivery.
What we offer
As part of this role, you will work in a highly coordinated, globally diverse team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. • Diverse and inclusive culture: You will be accepted for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodations.

While our client-facing professionals can be required to travel regularly, and at times be based at client sites, our flexible working arrangements can help you to achieve a lifestyle balance.

Rank 64: Supervising Associate
About EY
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence. Join EY and help build a better working world. We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
The Opportunity
Global Operations Support plays a key role in supporting operational excellence across the Clients & Industries (C&I) organization. This role focuses on enabling strategic priorities, optimizing processes, and facilitating collaboration across domains, functions, and pods to deliver agility and impact.
The C&I organization has six Domains, each with individual needs and differing maturity: Insights, Industry, Demand Generation, Client Excellence, Sales & Commercial Excellence, and Enablement & Technology.
This position sits within the Business Enablement – Business Management Office which supports the C&I organization through three key functions: Strategic Operations, Core Services, and Performance & Data Insights. Strategic Operations works through pods aligned to each of the six domains, working alongside Core Services and Performance & Data Insights to deliver seamless operational support and strategic execution.
Success in this model depends on agility — the ability to learn quickly, adapt as priorities change, and drive execution while staying responsive to evolving demands.
The primary stakeholder is the Domain Strategy Execution Leader, although this role will work with the rest of the Domain team. This position works directly with the Operations Senior Specialist or Operations Specialist.
Key Responsibilities
Strategic Operations
• Manage and execute domain initiatives and projects by working closely with senior stakeholders, applying strong project management discipline.
• Maintain project plans, timelines, documentation, and next steps, ensuring accuracy and timely updates.
• Drive project meetings, coordinate actions across contributors, advance activity as appropriate and track progress against milestones.
• Support preparation of leadership‑ready materials (presentations, updates, trackers), ensuring they meet EY standards and are ready for circulation.
• Identify project risks, dependencies, and opportunities to improve processes, escalating issues as appropriate.
• Act as a single point of coordination with relevant C&I domains and CBS Functions (e.g., BMC, Finance, Technology, AWS) to support delivery of project outcomes.
Operational Excellence
• Support consistent execution of operational processes by maintaining clear documentation, governance artifacts, and reporting.
• Proactively identify opportunities to streamline processes, improve efficiency, and enhance ways of working within the domain.
• Maintain and manage knowledge repositories, databases, SharePoint sites, and content libraries, including regular review and validation of materials.
• Share knowledge, insights, and updates with stakeholders using agreed communication channels.
• Support preparation of status reporting and dashboards, ensuring clarity in coordination with Performance & Data Insights where applicable.

Stakeholder Engagement
• Develop strong working relationships across domains, functions, and pods, anticipating needs and supporting broader team objectives.
• Manage stakeholder communications and expectations, providing clear, timely updates on progress, risks, and next steps.
• Act as a trusted delivery partner to leadership by ensuring follow‑through on actions and high‑quality execution.

• Facilitate coordination across geographically dispersed teams to enable smooth execution and alignment.

• Familiarity with AI/other automation to enhance processes, project outcomes and personal deliverables
What we offer you
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy, and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network, and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

Buscamos profesionales con capacidad para desenvolverse en un entorno dinámico y desafiante, que se distingan por su iniciativa, autonomía, capacidad analítica y orientación a resultados. Personas protagonistas que impulsen oportunidades, gestionen proyectos de punta a punta y generen impacto real en el negocio.



Tu rol será:

Coordinar, negociar, ejecutar proyectos y negocios con operadores de telecomunicaciones y empresas de infraestructura (torreras), actuando como facilitador entre las áreas de Finanzas, Legales, Impuestos, Seguros, áreas técnicas, clientes internos y proveedores. Serás responsable de identificar oportunidades de optimización, impulsar acuerdos estratégicos y asegurar la correcta ejecución de los proyectos.



Tus principales desafíos serán:



• Desarrollar evaluaciones económicas y financieras de proyectos, elaborando análisis comparativos y modelos de negocio que respalden la toma de decisiones estratégicas y la optimización de costos.


• Impulsar activamente los proyectos, anticipando riesgos, identificando oportunidades de mejora y promoviendo soluciones que permitan alcanzar los objetivos comprometidos.


• Dar seguimiento integral a los proyectos para garantizar su correcta ejecución, la disponibilidad de recursos, la gestión de desvíos y la visibilidad de los resultados para los distintos stakeholders.


• Elaborar informes ejecutivos y presentaciones de resultados que permitan monitorear la evolución de los proyectos y facilitar la toma de decisiones.


• Impulsar y gestionar los acuerdos contractuales de los proyectos, coordinando activamente con áreas internas (Legales, Finanzas, Impuestos, Seguros y áreas técnicas) y proveedores para asegurar definiciones claras que acompañen la ejecución y el cumplimiento de los objetivos del negocio.


• Gestionar la carga administrativa en SAP/SYTEX para registrar y actualizar lo acordado en los contratos, asegurando trazabilidad y correcto seguimiento de los servicios.


• Promover una cultura de colaboración, mejora continua y orientación al cliente , trabajando de manera integrada con clientes internos, proveedores y operadores de telecomunicaciones.





Qué necesitamos de vos:



• Lic. en Administración, Economía, Ingeniería o afines.


• Manejo de Excel avanzado.


• Conocimiento de análisis financiero para la evaluación proyectos.


• Se valorará experiencia en gestión de proyectos y metodologías ágiles.


• Se valorará experiencia en el uso de SAP, Sytex, Power BI y herramientas de análisis de datos.


• Autonomía, proactividad e iniciativa. Capacidad para identificar oportunidades, impulsar iniciativas de punta a punta y promover el avance de los proyectos.


• Excelentes habilidades de relacionamiento y negociación, con capacidad para trabajar transversalmente con distintas áreas, clientes internos y proveedores, construyendo acuerdos y consensos.


• Compromiso con el autodesarrollo, la mejora continua y la excelencia, manteniendo altos estándares de calidad, una marcada vocación de servicio y una actitud permanente de aprendizaje.





¿Que esperamos de vos?



• Orientación a Resultados: Que orientes tu gestión y tus esfuerzos al logro de los objetivos del negocio, manteniendo un compromiso permanente con la calidad del servicio y la satisfacción de los clientes. Que impulses el avance de tu gestión definiendo prioridades y haciéndote responsable por los resultados alcanzados, buscando permanentemente oportunidades para generar valor y mejorar la experiencia de nuestros clientes.


• Excelencia : Que trabajes con altos estándares de calidad. Que planifiques tus acciones con precisión, realizando el seguimiento necesario para asegurar resultados sostenibles promoviendo la mejora continua de procesos.


• Integridad : Que actúes con honestidad y coherencia, cumpliendo compromisos y haciéndote responsable por las decisiones y acciones que asumas.





El puesto tiene sede en: Ciudad Autónoma de Buenos Aires

postings.title: Analista de Gestión de Producción_Renova
postings.descriptionText:
Ciudad : Timbúes 
Santa Fe (AR-S) 
País : Argentina (AR) 
Número de Requisición : 49415 






En Bunge buscamos un/a Analista de Gestión de Producción para sumarse al equipo de Producción de Renova . La posición tendrá un rol clave en el análisis, validación y seguimiento de los principales indicadores operativos de planta, transformando información de proceso en datos confiables para la toma de decisiones.



Buscamos perfiles con una fuerte orientación analítica, facilidad para trabajar con números y curiosidad por comprender el proceso productivo detrás de los indicadores. El desafío consistirá en entender qué sucede en planta, detectar tendencias, identificar anomalías y generar información que aporte valor a la operación y a la gestión del negocio.


Principales responsabilidades:



• Auditar y validar reportes diarios de producción, asegurando la calidad y consistencia de la información utilizada para la gestión del sector.

• Analizar indicadores operativos, desvíos, pérdidas, consumos y variables críticas del proceso productivo.

• Calcular KPIs del sector y elaborar reportes diarios, semanales y mensuales destinados a distintos niveles de la organización.

• Participar en el cierre mensual de molienda y en el análisis de desvíos asociados a los resultados operativos.

• Interactuar con Producción, Mantenimiento y otras áreas para validar información, comprender causas raíz y asegurar una correcta imputación de eventos operativos.

• Dar seguimiento a variables de proceso que permitan identificar oportunidades de mejora y apoyar la toma de decisiones.

• Elaborar informes, procedimientos e instructivos relacionados con la gestión y el control de producción.

• Monitorear planes de acción y contribuir a iniciativas de mejora continua dentro de la operación.



Perfil técnico requerido:



• Formación técnica (excluyente). Se valorarán estudios universitarios en Ingeniería Industrial, Mecánica, Química o carreras afines.

• Experiencia en industrias de procesos continuos (deseable).

• Capacidad para trabajar con indicadores de gestión, análisis de datos y reportes operativos.

• Conocimientos intermedios/avanzados de Microsoft Excel (excluyente).

• Interés por comprender procesos industriales y traducir información operativa en análisis de valor para el negocio.



Ubicación:



Timbúes, Santa Fe.

En Bunge (NYSE: BG), nuestro propósito es conectar a los agricultores con los consumidores para entregar alimentos, piensos y combustibles esenciales al mundo. Como proveedor líder de soluciones agroindustriales, nuestro equipo de ~34,000 empleados dedicados se asocia con agricultores de todo el mundo para trasladar los productos agrícolas desde donde se cultivan hasta donde se necesitan, de manera más rápida, inteligente y eficiente. Somos un líder mundial en originación, almacenamiento, distribución, procesamiento y refinación de oleaginosas, que ofrece una amplia cartera de aceites, grasas y proteínas de origen vegetal. Trabajamos junto con nuestros clientes en ambos extremos de la cadena de valor para ofrecer productos de calidad y desarrollar soluciones innovadoras y personalizadas que aborden las necesidades cambiantes de los consumidores. Con más de 200 años de experiencia y presencia en más de 50 países, estamos comprometidos a fortalecer la seguridad alimentaria mundial, promover la sostenibilidad y ayudar a las comunidades a prosperar donde operamos. Bunge tiene su domicilio social en Ginebra, Suiza, y su sede corporativa en St. Louis, Missouri. Obtenga más información en Bunge.com.



Cada día, nuestra gente ejemplifica estos valores, que representan la esencia de Bunge:


• SOMOS UN ÚNICO EQUIPO – Colaborativos, respetuosos, inclusivos
• LIDERAMOS EL CAMINO – Ágiles, empoderados, innovadores
• HACEMOS LO CORRECTO – Con seguridad, sustentabilidad e integridad



Reconocemos que nuestro éxito depende de las diversas perspectivas que cada uno de nuestros colaboradores aporta a Bunge. Nos esforzamos por promover acciones que fomenten una cultura de pertenencia. A nivel global, apoyamos iniciativas como los Principios para el Empoderamiento de las Mujeres, de ONU Mujeres. Colaboramos con organizaciones como Disability:IN, un referente en la inclusión de personas con discapacidad y trabajamos continuamente en pro de nuestro compromiso de dejar un legado positivo en todas las comunidades en las que operamos.

Si esto le suena bien, ¡únase a nosotros! Valoramos e invertimos en personas que creen en nuestro propósito y están entusiasmadas por vivirlo cada día: personas que están #OrgullosasDeSerBunge.

Cerro Vanguardia es una empresa minera argentina dedicada a la exploración y tratamiento de oro y plata en la provincia de Santa Cruz. Desde 1998, funciona como un motor de desarrollo regional, promoviendo la explotación responsable de recursos y el crecimiento de comunidades como Puerto San Julián. postings.title: Optomechanical Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Mechanical Department - Optomechanics Team

Optomechanical Engineer (f/m/d)

About Satellogic

Satellogic is a vertically integrated Earth Observation company that designs, manufactures, and operates satellite systems, delivering decision-grade insights at scale to government and commercial customers.

We build space systems end-to-end, from satellite design and manufacturing to launch and on-orbit operations, giving us the ability to deploy quickly, operate reliably, and support persistent monitoring across regions and priority areas. Our approach moves customers beyond one-off imagery toward continuous awareness and alert-driven decision-making, with flexible pathways that can evolve from managed monitoring to full satellite ownership and sovereign control.

Our technology supports a wide range of use cases across climate monitoring, agriculture, energy, infrastructure, defense and intelligence, helping organizations detect change, manage risk, and plan with confidence.

With a team distributed across five countries, Satellogic brings together expertise in satellite engineering, software development, data science, manufacturing, operations, and go-to-market. We’re a group of purpose-driven builders who value ownership, curiosity, and execution—and who work with humility, honesty, and empathy.

About the team

Our Optomechanics team is responsible for the design, analysis, and verification of the optomechanical systems of the satellite's payload. This includes lens and mirror mounts, telescope support and metering structures, focus mechanisms, and the alignment of optical assemblies, ensuring that optical performance is preserved during launch and in the harsh conditions of space.

The team works at the intersection of optics, mechanical design, analysis, and testing, collaborating closely with the Mechanical Design, Structural and Thermal teams to deliver high-performance, space-qualified hardware. From early-stage concept design through to final alignment and environmental testing, we take a hands-on approach to engineering, ensuring our systems are robust, manufacturable, and aligned with the company's production and mission timelines.

Key responsibilities of the team include:

• Definition of optomechanical requirements, error budgets, and verification & validation plans.

• Designing optical mounts, telescope structures and focus mechanisms for lenses and mirrors.

• Performing structural, thermal and STOP (Structural-Thermal-Optical Performance) analyses to predict optical performance under launch and on-orbit conditions.

• Defining optomechanical interfaces and ensuring proper integration with the optical design and other satellite subsystems.

• Working closely with mechanical design, structural and thermal teams to ensure proper system integration and manufacturability.

• Supporting manufacturing and AIT (Assembly, Integration, and Testing) teams during alignment, integration and environmental testing of optical payloads.

• Continuously improving optomechanical design methodologies and product reliability based on flight heritage and manufacturing feedback.

We value engineers who combine technical expertise with a collaborative mindset and a strong attention to detail. The work we do has a direct impact on mission success—and we're looking for people who are ready to make that impact.

The team is always learning and trying to push the limits, relying in part on the large diversity of people’s profiles and backgrounds.

About the position

We are seeking an Optomechanical Engineer with proven experience in the aerospace sector and a strong background in space optical instruments and telescopes to join our Optomechanics team. You will own the optomechanical design of our telescopes and optical assemblies, including optics of up to 600 mm in diameter, from concept through detailed design, alignment, environmental qualification and flight acceptance. You will work closely with the entire Mechanical Department, absorbing know-how and leveraging capabilities.

The position has strong growth potential, with the possibility of assuming greater responsibilities in the future within the Optomechanics area.

Location

Preferably based in Argentina (hybrid work). Candidates based anywhere in Europe will also be considered. Satellogic’s office locations include Buenos Aires, Barcelona, Montevideo, Cordoba (ARG).

Due to export control regulations (ITAR), this position is not open to U.S. persons.

Willingness and ability to travel domestically and/or internationally to company offices, laboratories, client sites, potential clients, or suppliers as needed. This role will also require travel to our laboratory in Uruguay for alignment, integration and test activities.

Responsibilities

• Design optomechanical assemblies for space telescopes and optical instruments (mirrors, lenses, windows, filters, focal plane interfaces), from conceptual design to detailed design and qualification.

• Design lens and mirror mounts (kinematic, semi-kinematic, flexure-based and bonded) that minimize mount-induced distortion, including large mirrors of up to 600 mm in diameter.

• Design low-distortion flexures, bipods, metering structures and manual/motorized focus mechanisms, applying athermal design principles.

• Select materials and adhesives for precision space optics (CTE matching, dimensional stability, outgassing, bond-line design), such as Zerodur, ULE, SiC, aluminium, titanium, Invar and CFRP.

• Perform structural and thermal finite element analyses of optical systems (modal, quasi-static, random vibration, thermo-elastic) and support STOP analyses together with the Structural and Thermal teams.

• Define and run optomechanical tolerance analyses and error budgets (decenter, tilt, despace, surface figure, stability) in close collaboration with the optical designers.

• Define alignment and integration strategies and support hands-on alignment, integration and environmental testing (vibration, thermal vacuum) in the clean room, correlating test results with analysis models.

• Generate detailed drawings and specifications of optical and mechanical parts applying GD&T and ISO 10110, and act as technical interface with optics and precision-mechanics suppliers.

• Document analyses, generate technical reports, and keep the PLM/CAD system up to date with optomechanical data.

• Work as a team with the mechanical design, structural and thermal teams to ensure an integrated and consistent design.

About you

Experience

• Degree in Mechanical/Aeronautical Engineering, Optical Engineering, Physics or a related field, with a specialization in Optomechanics or Precision Engineering.

• 3 to 6 years of proven experience as an optomechanical engineer in the aerospace sector.

• Demonstrable participation in at least one space or airborne optical instrument project (telescope, camera, spectrometer, radiometer, LIDAR or similar), ideally covering the full cycle from design to qualification testing.

• Proven experience designing optical mounts for lenses and mirrors and telescope support structures.

• Hands-on experience with FEA of optical systems and with environmental test campaigns (vibration, thermal vacuum).

Skills

• Advanced knowledge of optomechanical design principles: kinematic and semi-kinematic mounting, flexure design, athermalization, bonding of optical elements and mount-induced stress control.

• Proficiency in 3D CAD (preferably Siemens NX) and FEA with NASTRAN-compatible solvers.

• Ability to perform STOP (Structural-Thermal-Optical Performance) analyses, including Zernike polynomial fitting of FEA surface deformations and rigid-body motions (e.g., SigFit or in-house tools).

• Strong understanding of materials for precision instruments (thermal expansion, dimensional stability, specific stiffness) and space-qualified adhesives.

• Proficiency in GD&T and optical drawing standards (ISO 10110).

• Ability to work hands-on in the lab with alignment and metrology equipment (interferometers, autocollimators, CMM, alignment telescopes).

• Ability to work in a team, strong interpersonal communication skills, and a willingness to learn.

• Capacity to learn continuously and passion for pushing the limits of space technology.

• Advanced English proficiency levels.

What we value

• Experience with large optics, ideally mirrors and telescopes of up to 600 mm in diameter (large mirror mounting, lightweighted mirrors, gravity sag and 1-g offloading during alignment and test).

• Experience with reflective telescope architectures (Cassegrain, Ritchey-Chrétien, Korsch, Three-Mirror Anastigmat).

• Experience correlating STOP predictions with interferometric measurements on space telescopes.

• Knowledge of Zemax OpticStudio.

• Experience working with the Siemens Simcenter 3D user interface for FEA pre- and post-processing.

• Specialized training in optomechanics (e.g., SPIE courses on optomechanical design and tolerancing, integrated optomechanical analysis, FEA of optics or adhesive bonding of optical elements).

• Technical publications, conference presentations (e.g., SPIE) or patents in optomechanics.

• Knowledge of ECSS / NASA standards, cleanliness and contamination control for space optics.

• Experience in NewSpace or small-satellite environments and design for manufacturability at volume.

Diversity Commitment

Satellogic values diversity and inclusion and is an equal opportunity employer. We are convinced that hiring and developing top talent from around the world for any given discipline will drive innovation, generate new solutions, and deliver a superior product to our global customer base. We work to build an equitable and inclusive environment in which all people, regardless of gender, race, religion, or background, can come together to do their best work.

Please feel free to specify your pronouns following your name on the application.

Learn more about Satellogic

To learn more about us please visit satellogic.com and follow us on twitter ( @Satellogic ) and LinkedIn

Applicant Data Privacy Statement

As part of your application you will be required to confirm Satellogic's Applicant Data Privacy Policy which is available for your review here .

By applying to this position you express, affirmative consent to our collection of your name, address, email address, phone number and relevant application information and the processing of that information. It is important to understand that Satellogic will store your data for the purpose of processing your application for the position, and possibly other compatible positions. You also understand that you have rights to access your Personal Data, as well as rights to request their rectification, completion, update or erasure. You may exercise your rights by sending an email to compliance@satellogic.com.

Consenting to our Applicant Data Privacy Policy is required in order for Satellogic to process your employment application.

postings.title: Transfer of Knowledge & Technology Manager
postings.descriptionText:
Transfer of Knowledge & Technology Manager

About Satellogic

Satellogic (NASDAQ: SATL) builds the infrastructure for Persistent Global Intelligence (PGI): continuous, proactive awareness of the places, assets, and activities that matter. We're leading the transition from episodic Earth observation — buying an image after something happens — to persistent monitoring programs that give customers earlier awareness, faster decisions, and greater control over mission-critical information.

We do it through a coordinated stack that combines high-cadence satellite collection, fit-for-purpose satellite economics, AI-accelerated workflows, and sovereign-trusted architecture. Our vertically integrated approach and patented optical design make our satellites 10x more affordable with 10x more capacity than industry standard, which is what makes persistent monitoring at global scale economically viable in the first place.

We serve allied defense and intelligence agencies, civil governments, and select commercial markets that manage large portfolios of mission-critical sites, assets, and operations. Customers can begin with discovery, expand into persistent monitoring, and build toward dedicated capacity or sovereign-controlled infrastructure as their mission requirements grow.

With a globally distributed team, we bring together expertise in satellite engineering, software, data science, manufacturing, operations, and go-to-market. We're purpose-driven builders who value ownership, curiosity, and execution — and who work with humility, honesty, and empathy.

Role overview

The Transfer of Knowledge and Technology (ToK/ToT) Manager will lead the design, planning, and execution of customer capability-development programs.

The role will translate Satellogic’s technical knowledge and real-world experience into customer’s organizational know-how and enduring capabilities (ToK); and Satellogic’s cutting edge technology into customer’s full sovereign capability to design, manufacture and operate space missions (ToT). More than classroom-based training, ToK programs may cover the full lifecycle of an Earth observation mission, including space systems engineering, satellite design and qualification, assembly, integration and testing, mission design, satellite and mission operations, ground systems, and data processing.

The ToT/ToK Manager will work closely with Satellogic’s engineering, operations, product, program management, IP, Compliance and commercial teams, as well as customer organizations, universities, and other external partners.

Key responsibilities

• Own the end-to-end planning and delivery of customer ToT, ToK, and sovereign capability-development programs.

• Develop structured curricula covering relevant areas of the satellite and mission lifecycle, including:

• Space systems engineering principles and processes.

• Mission analysis and mission design.

• Satellite architecture and subsystem design.

• Design reviews and technical decision-making.

• Qualification and verification methodologies.

• Assembly, integration, and testing engineering.

• Satellite commissioning and in-orbit validation.

• Satellite and mission operations.

• Ground-segment systems and operations.

• Payload data processing and product generation.

• Program management, configuration management, and quality assurance.

• Design OJT programs based on practical engineering activities, representative scenarios, and lessons learned from the development, qualification, manufacturing, launch, and operation of Satellogic’s Newsat platform.

• Convert the knowledge held by Satellogic subject-matter experts into repeatable training modules, practical exercises, case studies, technical documentation, and evaluation materials.

• Coordinate technical instructors and mentors across Satellogic, ensuring that their contributions are properly planned and that training commitments do not create unmanaged disruption to ongoing programs.

• Define learning objectives, competency frameworks, participant prerequisites, assessment methods, and completion criteria for each program.

• Tailor curricula and delivery models to customer objectives, starting capabilities, facilities, regulatory environment, and desired level of operational or industrial autonomy.

• Manage all logistics associated with training execution, including scheduling, facilities, travel, access requirements, equipment, training environments, materials, and participant coordination.

• Develop and manage partnerships with universities, research institutions, and specialized training organizations to complement Satellogic’s internal expertise and support long-term customer capability development.

• Work with program managers to ensure that training activities, contractual deliverables, acceptance criteria, dependencies, risks, and milestones are properly defined and tracked.

• Establish metrics to evaluate training effectiveness, knowledge retention, participant progression, and readiness to perform the targeted functions independently.

• Support commercial and proposal teams in defining ToT/ToK scope, delivery schedules, resource requirements, assumptions, and pricing.

• Ensure that training programs comply with Satellogic’s intellectual-property, export-control, security, confidentiality, and technology-transfer requirements.

• Capture lessons learned and continuously improve Satellogic’s standard ToT/ToK offering.

Qualifications

Required

• Professional experience in the space industry or a closely related aerospace or high-technology sector.

• Strong understanding of satellite programs and the lifecycle of space-system development, integration, qualification, deployment, or operations.

• Experience managing complex technical programs involving multiple disciplines and stakeholders.

• Demonstrated ability to structure complex technical knowledge into clear learning paths, work plans, and deliverables.

• Strong planning, coordination, and project-management capabilities.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to work effectively with engineers, executives, government customers, academic institutions, and international partners.

• Ability to manage multiple workstreams, instructors, locations, and customer dependencies simultaneously.

• Professional fluency in English and willingness to travel internationally.

Preferred

• Academic, teaching, technical-training, or curriculum-development experience.

• Experience developing or delivering OJT programs in engineering or operational environments.

• Experience with systems engineering, satellite AIT, mission operations, ground systems, or Earth observation data processing.

• Experience working on international technology-transfer, industrialization, localization, or sovereign capability-development programs.

• Experience establishing partnerships with universities or research institutions.

• Familiarity with export controls, intellectual-property protections, and security constraints affecting international space programs.

• Advanced degree in aerospace engineering, systems engineering, another relevant technical field, education, or program management.

Profile

The ideal candidate combines enough technical depth to understand a complete space program with the organizational and educational skills required to turn that knowledge into an effective capability-development journey. They should be comfortable coordinating senior technical experts without needing to be the leading specialist in every domain.

postings.descriptionText:
We are hiring a software engineering manager with a passion for developer experience and build tooling to have a positive impact on the day-to-day workflow of thousands of snap and charm publishers. To be successful on this team you'll need to be interested in packaging formats, build systems and automation that can simplify the lives of developers and engineers trying to ship software to the widest possible audience.

We design and maintain specialist Python tools to support the developer build and publication process. The team takes responsibility for tooling that builds snaps , charms and more recently, rocks ( OCI images ).

Snapcraft allows developers to deliver app updates to millions of Linux systems automatically, eliminating the long tail of supported releases and complex install instructions. We work from the very lowest levels of the Linux system - BIOS and boot loaders, firmware, kernel and drivers, all the way up to desktop applications and containers. We work on tiny devices like the Raspberry Pi and new RISC-V boards, all the way up to supercomputers, clouds and Kubernetes clusters. We work on compilers and toolchains, and we work on security, cryptography, performance and documentation. Some of our teams focus on packaging thousands of pieces of software, others focus on deep contributions to a single body of code.

If you are excited about the potential that open source has for humanity and the enterprise, you have outstanding results in your academic career, and you are excited to contribute to the open source stack, this is the best way to apply to Canonical. postings.title: Security Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) Manager
postings.descriptionText:
We are hiring a Security Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) Manager to lead the team that keeps Canonical's security and compliance credible to the Enterprises, Clouds, Telcos and Governments that run on Ubuntu, and to bring our controls and risk management to the standard a public company requires.

Location : EMEA or Americas — fully remote (home-based), with the option to work from our London office.

About our Team

Canonical's customers trust Ubuntu with critical systems. That trust rests on evidence: our ISO 27001 and SOC 2 certifications, how we manage risk, and how we respond as security regulation such as the EU Cyber Resilience Act reaches open source software. The Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) team produces that evidence and makes it real across the company. As Canonical prepares to list on a public exchange, the team is also central to the controls and risk reporting our Audit Committee and Board rely on.

The team is part of Operations and reports to the Chief Operating Officer. It covers both sides of the discipline: keeping us certified and compliant today, and looking ahead at risk across corporate IT, infrastructure and products. It works closely with Engineering, Security Operations, Information Systems, Legal, Finance and Sales.

You will lead the team, set its priorities and operating rhythm, and be the first escalation point for security and compliance decisions.

What you'll do

• Lead and develop a team of GRC engineers: hire, coach and set priorities, and run a roadmap that balances planned work with operational requests, so the team delivers predictably and reports progress clearly to leadership. You own the team’s budget, vendors and tooling.

• Own our ISO 27001 and SOC 2 certifications end to end: audit readiness, evidence collection, auditor relationships and fieldwork, so certifications are renewed on time with clean outcomes.

• Run the risk management framework across corporate IT, infrastructure and products — asset classification, risk assessments, the risk register and key risk indicators — so leadership and the Board can see and decide on the company’s most important risks.

• Own the information security policy framework — annual reviews, new policies, exceptions and risk acceptance — and make the call, or escalate it, when a policy and a business need conflict.

• Partner with Finance on IT General Controls and internal controls over financial reporting — remediation, control execution and Audit Committee reporting — to make Canonical ready for a public listing.

• Turn security regulation and standards — the EU Cyber Resilience Act, NIS2, DORA, the EU AI Act and IEC 62443 — into practical programmes with Legal and Engineering, including our secure software development lifecycle and penetration testing, so our products meet their obligations as they ship.

• Build business continuity and disaster recovery with Information Systems and business owners — impact analysis, plans and tested recovery — so critical services can be restored when it matters.

• Oversee third-party risk, access reviews and the governance of new tools and AI usage, and support customers and colleagues when it counts — security questionnaires, RFPs, our Trust Center, contract security terms and incident response — alongside Sales, Legal and Security Operations.

What we are looking for in you

• Hands-on ownership of ISO 27001 and/or SOC 2 certification through external audit cycles

• Experience designing or running a risk management framework (such as ISO 27005, NIST CSF or ISO 31000), including a risk register and reporting to senior leadership

• Experience with IT General Controls supporting financial audits, under SOX or an equivalent regime

• Experience leading a governance, risk and compliance, security compliance or IT risk team in a software or technology company

• Experience turning regulatory and technical requirements into controls that engineering and business teams you don’t manage actually adopt

• Sound judgement on risk acceptance and policy exceptions, and the confidence to hold a position with senior stakeholders

• Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives

• Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university

• Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills

• Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long

Nice-to-have skills

• Experience preparing a company for a public listing

• Experience with product security compliance for a software vendor (EU Cyber Resilience Act, IEC 62443 or NIST SSDF)

• Business continuity and disaster recovery programme experience

• Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor or Lead Implementer

How we work

We look for a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results, backed by self-motivation and drive. Our people deliver their work precisely, taking care to deliver correctness and clarity. Reliability is at our core, where colleagues deliver high quality work that builds trust and confidence. We make ourselves accessible, collaborating to build products and systems that are usable. Finally we are adroit, blending enthusiasm, knowledge, adaptability, style and character.

We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

• Priority Pass for travel

• Recognition rewards

• Annual holiday leave

• Maternity and paternity leave

• Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Join Nortal for your next big adventure. We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer (Java & Go) to join our team, grow with us, and teach us a few things along the way.

Why join Nortal

Say Goodbye to Micromanagement: We champion autonomy, open communication, and respect for diversity as our core values.

Outcomes Over Hours: We believe in a work model focused on impact, providing you with the flexibility to balance your professional success with your personal well-being.

About the project

Our client is a leading cross-border payments company operating across multiple international markets.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join a small, experienced engineering team responsible for developing and maintaining the technology that supports regulatory compliance across the company's operations.

The platform includes an event-driven rules engine that evaluates transactions against country-specific compliance requirements, a user interface that enables compliance teams to manage rules independently, automated regulatory reporting, identity-data services, and immutable regulatory storage.

You will work primarily with Java, Go, AWS, and event-driven architectures, with opportunities to contribute to React-based frontend applications and data platform integrations.

This is a hands-on engineering role requiring strong technical ownership, autonomy, collaboration, and commitment to software quality.

You will work closely with the team's Technical Referent, contributing to the delivery of reliable, scalable solutions in a highly regulated environment.

What you'll do

Backend Engineering & Architecture

•
Design, develop, and maintain backend services using Java and Go.

•
Build reliable services supporting transaction monitoring, compliance rules, and regulatory processes.

•
Develop and maintain event-driven and queue-based integrations that process high volumes of transactions.

•
Contribute to system design decisions, technical improvements, and application reliability.

•
Work with AWS infrastructure and observability tools to support application operations.

•
Contribute to React-based frontend functionality when required.

End-to-End Software Delivery

•
Own features throughout the development lifecycle, from requirement clarification and estimation to implementation, testing, deployment, and demonstration.

•
Identify unclear requirements, technical dependencies, and potential risks before implementation.

•
Validate changes across relevant environments before considering work complete.

•
Deliver maintainable, well-tested solutions aligned with the team's Definition of Done.

Software Quality & Testing

•
Develop and maintain unit, functional, integration, and end-to-end tests.

•
Apply quality-first engineering practices throughout the software development lifecycle.

•
Participate actively in code reviews, providing thoughtful feedback and reviewing teammates' changes promptly.

•
Support CI/CD processes and help improve engineering standards.

•
Investigate defects, identify root causes, and implement reliable fixes.

Collaboration & Technical Ownership

•
Work closely with the Technical Referent and engineering teammates to deliver high-quality features.

•
Communicate proactively about progress, blockers, risks, and technical decisions.

•
Maintain clear technical documentation to support asynchronous collaboration.

•
Take ownership of assigned work and contribute to continuous improvement in a team with lightweight processes.

•
Collaborate effectively with distributed colleagues across time zones.

AI-Assisted Engineering

•
Use AI-assisted development tools such as Claude or Cursor to improve development productivity.

•
Review, validate, and thoroughly test AI-generated code before integrating it into production systems.

•
Apply engineering judgment to ensure security, maintainability, and correctness.

•
Take part in Nortal's Technical Interviewer Program, conducting technical interviews for your account and other accounts to help build the teams behind Nortal's growth.

What makes you a great fit

•
5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend development expertise.

•
Strong production experience with Java and working knowledge of Go, or strong Go experience with the ability to quickly become productive in Java.

•
Hands-on experience designing and maintaining event-driven or queue-based systems.

•
Experience developing applications that support high-volume data or transaction processing.

•
Strong understanding of software testing, including unit, functional, integration, and end-to-end testing.

•
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and quality-focused code review practices.

•
Hands-on experience with AWS and application observability or monitoring tools.

•
Ability to independently deliver features from requirements through production deployment.

•
Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to identifying technical risks and blockers.

•
Experience working in autonomous engineering teams with lightweight processes.

•
Excellent written and spoken English (C1 or above), including clear technical documentation and asynchronous communication.

•
Ability to maintain the required working-hours overlap with European teams (CET/CEST, exact schedule to be confirmed).

Nice to have:

•
Experience with Rust.

•
Frontend development experience using React and TypeScript.

•
Experience with Databricks or other data platforms.

•
Background in fintech, payments, transaction monitoring, compliance automation, or regulatory reporting.

•
Experience collaborating with distributed engineering teams across multiple time zones.

•
Spanish or Portuguese language skills.

Global Impact, Local Culture 🌍

For over 25 years, we've been shaping digital transformation, delivering complex solutions for global enterprises and public sector organizations. Today, we are at the forefront of an AI-driven transformation era, helping organizations turn data into real business value. By combining deep domain expertise with data and AI, we design solutions that create immediate impact while scaling for the future.

We believe complexity doesn't have to mean complicated, and that the best solutions are those that work in the real world, not just on paper. That's why our clients trust us with their most ambitious, business-critical initiatives.

We have over 1000 Brainlabbers based across the global, all united through the 12 principles laid out in our Culture Code.
