If you want to help play your part in achieving this for the world's biggest brands in an environment that will support and challenge you in equal measure, this is where you do it.

Location: Buenos Aires, Argentina

As a Programmatic Manager your focus is delivering high-quality, best-in-class work for clients within your Practice.

So, tell me about the company 🧠

Brainlabs is culture-first. You’ve probably heard other companies describe themselves as people, clients, or profit first – but we see people, clients and profit as the building blocks of our ecosystem. Culture powers all three and we know that when the ecosystem is balanced, we all win! That's why the culture we cultivate is a culture of winning together.

To learn more about what it’s like to be a Brainlabber, check out our culture code.

In this role you will 🖊️

• Using practice knowledge, you will be responsible for delivering and implementing high-quality strategies aligned with client goals and priorities.

• You'll effectively track and measure results across defined performance metrics.

• You’ll be partnering with our clients on day to day tasks and deliverables.

• You’ll develop and implement, as well as follow guidelines and processes contributing to ideas around automation or process improvement.

• You’ll actively contribute to developing a best-practice roadmap so that our Practice offering is continually developing.

• Be an advocate for the practice with Associates and help to grow knowledge and skills across this population. You will also start to build your knowledge of other Practices.

• Develop ideas for process improvements, innovation and automation that drive measurable impact for your client or Practice.

We’re looking for someone who 🔍

• Has a delivery track record with 2+ years of experience with DV360 and Campaign Manager 360. The Trade Desk and Amazon DSP are a plus.

• Is passionate about growing your career in marketing and the knowledge of others around you. Demonstrable skills in strategy, innovation, and client management.

• Has a good understanding about how other channels work and optimise together.

• Is a confident, dynamic, engaging and authentic communicator with excellent presentation skills.

• Has advancing data analysis and storytelling skills.

• Is someone with strong attention to detail, who is methodical and process orientated and has demonstrated a very high quality of work.

• Is fluent in English (as you will be supporting US / EMEA Accounts)

And this is what success looks like in the role 🏅

• You will live our Culture Code every day!

• You're passionate about digital marketing and growing your career.

• Achieving the goals set by your manager

• Internal targets/metrics on technology adoption and process optimisation met.

• You will hit our quality assurance metrics on all accounts you lead.

• Client satisfaction targets being met (internal & external).

• Learning certifications created and met across the practice.

• Active involvement in mentoring less experienced colleagues.

What's in it for you ✨

• Hybrid salary (50% of your net salary in USD)

• 20 working days vacation plus all Argentina public holidays.

• Private healthcare (OSDE 360).

• Adaptive/hybrid working.

• Free breakfast and lunch when in office.

• Access to learning and development opportunities.

• Mobility programmes - work from another country for up to 30 days!

What happens next?

Therefore, you will participate in a comprehensive interview process that includes skills interviews with our team. The goal of this process is to allow you to get to know us as we learn more about you.

A note on our offices: We pride ourselves in being a company with an office-centric culture and, for the majority of roles we expect people to be in commuting distance of the office and come in for around 3 days per week.

Brainlabs actively seeks and encourages applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds and identities. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace: we are committed to equal opportunity for all applicants and employees regardless of age, disability, sex, gender reassignment, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion, or belief, and marriage and civil partnerships. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation during the application process, please let us know!

For details regarding our data processing activities, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice

Brainlabs will never ask you to transfer money, pay for a job opportunity, or request sensitive information such as Social Security numbers, banking details, or passwords via email, WhatsApp, or unsecured channels. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Brainlabs, do not engage. Instead, forward it immediately to security@brainlabsdigital.com . We're committed to protecting our community and ensuring a safe candidate experience. Thank you for your vigilance.

postings.descriptionText:
What Makes Cloudbeds Unique

At Cloudbeds , we're not just building software, we're transforming hospitality. Our platform powers hotels across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've continually been recognized for excellence, most recently earning top honors at the 2026 HotelTechAwards for Best Hotel Management Software and landing on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again, but we're just getting started.

How You'll Make an Impact:

As a Customer Recovery Coach, you will model our AI Smarts + Hospitality Hearts—the mission for Cloudbeds Customer Success—sitting at the vital intersection of customer retention and product success. You will drive the shift from a reactive support function to an Intelligent Recovery Motion, leveraging early risk detection and firsthand hotel operations experience to turn frustration into loyalty. This role centers on orchestrating the Fire-Team concept—a cross-functional, executive-level intervention designed to deliver decisive issue resolution for our most critical accounts. You will be a Caring Rebel leader who understands that technology should handle the administrative drag, while humans handle the relationship magic. You will leverage AI-driven insights to proactively identify risk and design recovery processes that prove Cloudbeds is central to our customers' business success.

Our Customer Success Team:

Our Customer Success team is where Hospitality Hearts meet Smart Solutions. We are a fully-remote group of former hoteliers and customer experience professionals, focused on removing unnecessary manual work so we can focus on our human magic: building and strengthening relationships with our customers, and ensuring Cloudbeds remains central to their business success and guest service excellence. If you are driven by emotional intelligence, trust building, and delivering deeply personalized hospitality moments instead of repetitive operational work, you will feel right at home here.

What You Bring to the Team:

• Own the customer recovery motion, triaging high-impact queues of at-risk customers with a goal of proactive rescue and structured save motions.
• Champion the core principle: Standardize the repeatable, personalize the meaningful. Use AI and automation tooling to handle administrative tasks, freeing capacity for deep-dive recovery work.
• Drive momentum to value by acting as an internal consultant, coordinating across Sales, Onboarding, and Product to remove technical or operational blockers.
• Own clear, customer-friendly communication, delivering concise and highly personalized updates to customers and internal stakeholders.
• Maintain clean systems and actionable data, logging activities in Salesforce and capturing "voice of the customer" signals to feed back to leadership.
• Identify patterns of friction and propose systemic process improvements to stop issues before they start, ruthlessly eliminating hero-dependency.
• Orchestrate the Fire-Team motion: Serve as the Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for at-risk accounts, mobilizing internal stakeholders across Support, Product, and Engineering to restore trust and ensure the customer never has to ask "Who owns this?"
• Execute the "Recovery Becomes Prevention" feedback loop: Treat cancellation requests as systemic failures rather than simple decision points; document root causes to identify and eliminate the friction points that deplete our customers and teams.
• Implement "Rapid Wins": Prioritize immediate operational stabilization for customers by fixing top pain points first to restore confidence before reaching for perfection.

What Sets You Up for Success:

• Hospitality Roots: 5+ years in a hospitality management role in hotel or resort operations (front office or front desk management, general management, operations, or guest services) at mid-market properties with 100+ rooms. You must understand the real business impact when tech fails.

How You'll Make an Impact:

Cloudbeds is looking for a Senior Customer Support & Onboarding Specialist - Accounting to own our most complex customer accounting work. This role sits at the intersection of hospitality operations, accounting, and technology, guiding properties through the end-to-end accounting flow, from property configuration to integration with their accounting software or ERP.

As the senior member of the team, you’ll take on the hardest implementations and escalations for our key accounts, including multi-property and enterprise customers, joining them from day one as the finance counterpart to the customer’s controller and finance team. You’ll be the go-to expert for Support, Onboarding and Account Management on anything accounting, and help shape how we onboard and support customers’ financial setups as we scale. This is a customer-facing role for someone with deep accounting knowledge at a controller level or equivalent senior level who can legitimately help our customers get their books right.

Our Onboarding & Accounting Integration Team:

Our team thrives at the intersection of hospitality expertise and technical execution. We work alongside Integration Engineering, Support, and Sales to solve real customer challenges with accounting systems. Customers trust us to help them connect their financial backbone to Cloudbeds, and we take that seriously.

What You Bring to the Team:

• Lead complex accounting onboarding engagements for key accounts, including multi-property and enterprise customers: chart of accounts mapping, tax configuration, revenue recognition, reconciliation workflows, and month-end close

• Act as the escalation point for accounting discrepancies, integration sync issues and configuration problems that Support and Onboarding can't resolve, and own them through to resolution

• Guide customers in connecting Cloudbeds to accounting software and ERPs (e.g., QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, local and regional systems) via native integrations and partner solutions

• Serve as the subject matter expert on hospitality accounting for internal teams and customers, coaching other specialists and training Support, Onboarding and Account Management

• Build and own onboarding playbooks, documentation and best-practice resources for hospitality accounting workflows

• Bring recurring customer pain points and product gaps to Product and Engineering with clear evidence, and help shape the accounting roadmap

• Manage multiple complex engagements at once while keeping implementations moving and customers confident

What Sets You Up for Success:

• Controller-level (or equivalent senior) experience in accounting with 8+ years in accounting, bookkeeping, or financial operations, and hotel or resort accounting experience

• Deep understanding of accounting fundamentals: general ledger, accounts receivable/payable, revenue recognition, reconciliation, month-end close, and financial reporting

• Proven track record leading accounting software or ERP implementations end to end, including complex or multi-entity setups, ideally for hotel or hospitality businesses

• Working knowledge of North American (US or Canadian) accounting and tax requirements, including US tax reporting for US-owned properties

• Experience as the go-to expert others escalate to, with the ability to coach and train colleagues

• Strong customer-facing communication skills, confident on calls with owners and senior finance stakeholders, able to explain complex accounting concepts in clear, simple language to hoteliers and translate accountant needs for technical teams

• Strong analytical mindset: trace data flows, identify mapping issues, and troubleshoot integration problems methodically

• Fluent in English, able to communicate clearly in writing and on calls across global time zones

• Night audit, folio management or USALI experience

• Knowledge of regional accounting standards and tax requirements in Canada, the Caribbean or Latin America, and Spanish or Portuguese

About AppDirect

Become a digital, global citizen and enable the new generation of digital entrepreneurs around the world. AppDirect offers a subscription commerce platform to sell any product, through any channel, on any device - as a service. We power millions of subscriptions worldwide for organizations. We do this by our values-driven culture—one that enables you to Be Seen, Be Yourself, and Do Your Best Work.

About You

You are a proactive, detail-oriented, and result-driven Collections Analyst. You will be responsible for managing collections activities, tracking outstanding receivables, following up on overdue accounts, and supporting the organization’s cash flow objectives.

You should have hands-on experience in accounts receivable and collections, strong analytical skills, and the confidence to communicate with customers through calls and emails to ensure timely payment follow-ups and resolution of outstanding issues. The candidate should also be proficient in NetSuite (or similar), MS Excel, and Google Sheets.

What you'll do and how you'll have an impact

• Manage end-to-end collection activities for assigned customer accounts.

• Review aging reports and identify overdue invoices/accounts for follow-up.

• Follow up with customers through calls, emails, and other communication channels to collect outstanding payments and secure payment commitments.

• Investigate payment delays, short payments, and disputed invoices in coordination with internal teams such as Finance, Billing, Sales, and Customer Success.

• Maintain accurate records of collection efforts, customer communication, payment commitments, and follow-up actions.

• Perform account reconciliations and ensure proper allocation of incoming payments.

• Prepare periodic reports/MIS on collections performance, overdue accounts, and dispute status.

• Support month-end closing activities related to receivables and collections

What we're looking for

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, Business Administration, or a related field.

• 2–3 years of experience in Collections, Accounts Receivable, Credit Control, or Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes.

• Experience in customer payment follow-ups, overdue account management, and account reconciliation.

• Prior experience working with NetSuite or a similar ERP/accounting system.

• Strong working knowledge of MS Excel including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, filters, sorting, and basic formulas and proficiency in Google Sheets for maintaining trackers and reports.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills to fell confident and comfortable in making collection calls and speaking with customers professionally.

• Good negotiation and follow-up skills.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving ability.

• Ability to manage multiple accounts, prioritize effectively, and meet deadlines.

postings.title: Data Engineer, Marketing Science
postings.descriptionText:
Who We Are:

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A day in the life:

You'll sit on the fusepoint Marketing Science Team and own the data behind Power Digital's measurement products: Media Mix Modeling (MMM) and incrementality testing (Matched Market Testing, MMT). Our measurement tools are used by internal and external teams to read model results, plan budgets, pick test markets and report on incrementality tests. Your job is to make sure the data needed for measurement analysis is clean, reconciled and ready for modeling, so the analysts and data scientists spend their time on modeling, not cleanup.

You'll work closely with the Data Team to support, maintain, and engineer data sources related to measurement and marketing metrics.

Key Responsibilities:

• Own the MMM data layer in Snowflake. Build and maintain model-ready daily and weekly marts for each client that combine paid media (spend, impressions, clicks by channel and campaign), ecommerce revenue and orders (new vs. returning, gross and net, refunds, discounts), site and email/SMS data from GA4, and any non-media drivers. Every mart has consistent channel groupings, currencies and timezones.

• Own the MMT geo data layer. Build geo-level media and sales tables at DMA (or Comscore), state and zip level for every major platform (Meta, Google, TikTok, Pinterest, Amazon, Microsoft, Programmatic, etc.) and for CMS/CRM/Amazon/Retail Datsets, with standard market names that line up across sources. These tables feed automated market selection, pre-period validation, synthetic control models and test readouts.

• Build and automate a data quality process . Turn the checks we currently run manually into automated Snowflake/dbt tests and alerts: date gaps, zero-spend or zero-revenue days, cost without impressions (and the reverse), duplicated or unmatched markets, outlier spikes, restatement drift and source freshness. Problems should be flagged before a model is trained or a test is read out.

• Own and maintain model logs and exported model outputs (contributions, response curves, adstock, optimization results) well structured, versioned and easy to query.

• Support onboarding of new measurement clients. Own and maintain a repeatable, mostly automated process: map their data feeds, check history depth and quality, and flag gaps before modeling starts.

• Handle client-specific data needs as they come up. You are not responsible for client workflow, but you may need to jump in to assist the team as things come up.. Write client-specific overrides, channel mappings and marts when a client needs them, and decide whether each piece of logic belongs in the shared core or in the client's own layer.

• Use AI coding tools to work faster (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Hex's AI agent), and document the patterns that work so the team adopts them.

Role Requirements:

• 3+ years in data or analytics engineering, including 1+ year owning a production dbt project of meaningful size.

• Advanced SQL and Python, with production-grade pipeline code.

• Deep dbt expertise: incremental models vs. full refreshes, Jinja and macros, tests, snapshots, source freshness, exposures, and keeping a large DAG under control.

• Strong Snowflake skills: semi-structured/VARIANT data, dynamic per-client queries, query and cost tuning, permissions across separate client databases.

• Hands-on marketing and ecommerce data experience: ad-platform APIs, UTMs, attribution windows, platform-reported vs. warehouse-reported conversions, Shopify order and refund logic.

• An understanding of what measurement models need from data: a continuous time series, consistent granularity, stable channel definitions, enough history, and the reasons one bad week or market can skew results.

• Experience building multi-client data models, with the judgment to know when logic belongs in the shared core and when it belongs in a client layer.

• Git and CI/CD with automated testing you trust.

• Real adoption of AI-assisted development workflows.

• Comfort shipping iteratively based on feedback from analysts and app users.

Helpful but not required

• Direct MMM or incrementality experience (Meridian, Robyn, PyMC-Marketing, synthetic control/causal impact, geo-lift).

• Experience with geographic data: DMA/zip mappings, population and market-size data.

• Hex experience (SQL/Python notebooks, semantic models, published apps), or similar BI/notebook tools.

• Experience at an agency, consultancy or martech company.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• MMT coverage: Geo-level MMT tables for all data sources are created and in use by the Measurement team in the first 3 months of the role

• Measurement-ready data: Within 6 months, ≥95% of active MMM and MMT clients have automated, tested Snowflake marts feeding Hex, with no client-specific cleaning logic left in app notebooks for core sources.

• Data quality: ≥99% completeness and accuracy on critical measurement fields. Zero model refreshes or test readouts delivered with an undetected date gap, duplicated market or unreconciled revenue source.

• Reliability: ≥95% success rate for scheduled measurement pipelines, excluding documented vendor outages.

• Speed and efficiency: Cut new-client measurement onboarding time (data mapping and validation) by 30% within 12 months. Measurably reduce load and refresh times for the main Hex measurement apps.

• Client requests: Deliver ≥90% of client-specific measurement data requests within the agreed turnaround

• AI-assisted development: At least 1 reusable AI-assisted development pattern documented within 120 days and 2 within 12 months, each used in at least 2 production workflows.

Most Important Things (MITs)

• Deliver clean, model-ready MMM and MMT data in Snowflake so the measurement team’s data can be trusted without extra cleanup.

• Build a process to catch data issues before they reach a model or test readout.

• Build a single, documented measurement data foundation that grows with the client list and is ready for AI use.

Benefits & Perks:

• Base salary paid in USD + commission opportunities

• Unlimited Time Off available on day one

• Fully flex work environment: full-remote, in-office, or hybrid

• Offices in Buenos Aires, Medellin, San Diego, New York, Atlanta

• Healthcare stipend: $50/month to support your healthcare or insurance costs

• National Holidays + 2 Mental Health Recharge Days per year

• Unlimited opportunities for growth & leadership within a rapidly growing firm

• Ongoing employee development programs for personal and professional growth (Hedgehog and Vital 5s)

• Quarterly awards including prize money and recognition for outstanding performance

• Opportunities to be involved in company DEI initiatives

Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees' points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

Please be aware of fictitious job openings, consulting engagements, solicitations, or employment offers from suspicious sources. These engagements may be an attempt to obtain private information, or to induce you to pay a fee for services related to recruitment or training. About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com .

A Hybrid working model

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

What does a Project Manager do at WPP Production?
  Global MPMs are primarily responsible to ensure timely delivery of all global nameplates launches as well as any other global non-nameplates launches on their market websites. ​

Key Responsibilities

• MPMs are expected to liaise with other functions in the project to ensure timelines are met as per plan ​ .

• MPMs are the single point of contacts for their market clients for DX Projects* (Digital Experience).  ​

• MPMs are also expected to resolve their client’s queries or escalate the issues such as timeline impact or quality issues using the proper channels. ​

• MPMs are re s ponsible for managing market reviews and approvals for Global nameplate launches, including ensuring market amends briefs are clear for DX authoring team.

• MPMs are responsible for managing the market’s creative and authoring requests of the Global DX team.

*DX Projects MPM manages:

Market Project Management team is responsible for driving market-focused projects from Global initiation through to delivery of the client's Websites.

Expected Qualities of MPM

For a Market Project Manager (MPM) role, especially in a regional market context like Brazil and Mexico the most successful MPMs typically demonstrate a mix of strategic, operational, and interpersonal qualities:

Project & Execution Excellence

• Ability to connect local market needs with global strategy

• Prioritisation and risk assessment

• Growth mindset and continuous improvement focus

• Strong project management skills

• Excellent planning and organisation

• Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously

• Attention to detail

• Ownership and accountability

• Proactive problem-solving

• Ability to navigate ambiguity

Stakeholder Management

• Relationship building

• Cross-functional collaboration

• Strong networking skills

• Effective expectation management

• Ability to align diverse stakeholders toward common goals

Communication Skills

• Clear and concise communication

• Active listening

• Ability to tailor messaging for different audiences

• Confidence in executive-level discussions

• Strong written communication

Market Leadership

• Customer-centric mindset

• Deep understanding of local market dynamics

• Cultural awareness and sensitivity

• Advocacy for market needs within global teams

• Balance between local flexibility and global consistency

Personal Effectiveness

• Resilience under pressure

• Adaptability and agility

• Positive attitude

• Curiosity and willingness to learn

• Sound judgment

• Self-motivation

For MPM role as a Market Project Manager for Brazil and Mexico, qualities such as cross-cultural collaboration, stakeholder influence, market advocacy, strategic prioritisation, and proactive execution are often the ones that differentiate high-performing MPMs from good project coordinators.

What does everyday task look like as MPM?

• Manage project timelines and ensure milestones are delivered on schedule.

• Coordinate cross-functional teams such as authoring, Global Project management, Account Management, Product and Market team leads.

• Track project progress and provide regular status updates to stakeholders.

• Identify and mitigate risks that could impact project delivery.

• Represent market requirements and ensure local needs are considered in global plans.

• Join project meetings when required and follow up on actions and decisions.

• Manage stakeholder communication across local clients and global teams.

• Resolve issues and remove blockers to keep projects moving forward.

• Support launch and implementation activities for Global initiatives (as priority) and local campaigns.

• Monitor post launch activities and capture lessons to improve future projects and processes.

A Hybrid working model

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

What does a Motion Designer do at WPP Production?

We are looking for a Motion Designer & Automation Artis with strong technical expertise in Adobe After Effects, expressions, scripting, and AI-assisted development.

This is a production and scalability-focused role rather than a traditional motion design position. The ideal candidate enjoys building efficient systems, solving repetitive production challenges, and finding smarter ways to produce large volumes of high-quality adaptations.

The role requires exceptional attention to detail, patience, organization, and the ability to work consistently across multiple versions, formats, durations, languages, and specifications.

Key Responsibilities

• Produce high-volume resizes, cutdowns, reversioning, localization, and campaign adaptations across multiple formats and platforms.

• Adapt master assets to different aspect ratios, resolutions, durations, languages, and delivery specifications while maintaining visual consistency.

• Create and maintain scalable Adobe After Effects projects designed for efficient versioning and adaptation.

• Use After Effects expressions and scripting to automate repetitive production tasks.

• Identify repetitive manual processes and develop solutions to reduce production time and human error.

• Use AI-assisted coding and vibe coding workflows to create scripts, utilities, and production tools.

• Manage projects with large numbers of deliverables and versions while maintaining rigorous naming, structure, and quality control.

• Troubleshoot technical and production issues independently.

• Perform detailed QC to ensure consistency across all campaign adaptations and deliverables.

• Collaborate with creative, production, and post-production teams to improve the scalability of motion workflows.

Required Skills & Experience

• Advanced proficiency in Adobe After Effects.

• Strong practical knowledge of After Effects expressions and procedural animation techniques.

• Experience with After Effects scripting and automation, including JavaScript-based scripting.

• Experience using AI coding assistants and vibe coding approaches to create or improve scripts, automation tools, and production utilities.

• Strong experience with resizing, reversioning, localization, cutdowns, and multi-format campaign adaptation.

• Ability to work from master creative assets and efficiently generate multiple versions without compromising consistency.

• Strong understanding of aspect ratios, frame rates, resolutions, codecs, render settings, safe areas, and platform-specific delivery requirements.

• Excellent file organization, project structure, naming conventions, and version control discipline.

• Exceptional attention to detail and QC standards.

• Patient and methodical working style, particularly when dealing with repetitive or high-volume deliverables.

• Ability to work autonomously and manage priorities across multiple simultaneous adaptations.

• Excellent English communication skills.

Automation & AI Skills

The candidate should be comfortable using technology not only to execute work, but also to improve how the work is produced.

Experience in some of the following is highly valuable:

• After Effects Expressions

• JavaScript / ExtendScript

• ScriptUI or similar approaches for building After Effects utilities

• AI-assisted coding and debugging

• Vibe coding workflows

• Building small scripts, panels, utilities, or automation helpers

• CSV, JSON, or structured-data-driven production workflows

• Template-based and dynamic content workflows

The expectation is not necessarily for the candidate to be a professional software developer. Rather, they should be technically curious and capable of using scripting and AI tools to solve real production problems.

Nice to Have

• Experience with Adobe Premiere Pro and the broader Adobe Creative Cloud ecosystem.

• Experience with templated or data-driven motion workflows.

• Experience in advertising agencies, production companies, creative production studios, or high-volume content environments.

• Experience with localization and multilingual campaign production.

• Familiarity with APIs, command-line tools, or other automation technologies.

• Experience building reusable After Effects templates for other artists or production teams.

What We're Looking For

A highly technical and operational motion professional, rather than a purely creative animation specialist. Someone who is meticulous, patient, and extremely organized, and who naturally asks: "How can I build this once and make the next 50 versions faster, safer, and more consistent?"

The ideal candidate combines strong After Effects production skills with an automation mindset, using expressions, scripting, structured workflows, and AI-assisted coding to make motion production more scalable.

postings.title: Producer
postings.descriptionText:
About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com .

A Hybrid working model

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

What does a Producer do at WPP Production?
 

The Role

The Audiovisual Producer are responsible for end-to-end project management, management of client relationships, agency relationships while leading a diverse and dynamic team to deliver. They play an important role in ensuring the smooth operations and delivery excellence of their clients’ projects.

He/she is responsible for delivering a completed project on time, on specification, and on budget.

The successful candidate will use their superior problem-solving skills, a passion for production, marketing and advertising and a desire to learn. They are highly organized and accountable leaders, who are able to build relationships and collaborate drawing on the expertise of Hogarth’s resources and capabilities. 

Key Areas of Responsibilities

Communication

• The key day-to-day project contact with lower to mid-level clients and creative agencies

• Possesses accurate sense of client satisfaction level - facilitates the sharing client feedback with the team and management; sensitive to the client's needs and concerns

• Takes accountability to ensure that all team members are aware of timelines and deliverables

Collaboration

• Develops and maintains high levels of team effectiveness (trust, communication, collaboration, productivity diversity and engagement)

• Serves as a mentor/coach to junior producers

 

Process

• Manage medium- to large-sized projects independently, from initiation through completion

• Serve as the production expert on audiovisual campaigns, working with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced agency Must be used to work with people in charge and in several projects at the same time.

• Manages client objectives, budget, expectations, deliverables and timelines and communicating changes/directions to team members

• Keeps projects on track through clear task lists, issue tracking, status reports, and meeting notes

 

Financial Management

• Demonstrates strong commercial abilities and business and financial acumen

• Works with interdisciplinary teams of creative, production and technologists to define and develop scopes and estimates of projects (goals, deliverables, schedule, and budget), helping to translate creative concepts into clear sets of deliverables with proper staffing

• Owns project budget and tracking of all ongoing costs throughout project lifecycle, reconcile estimates to actuals on all projects, and resolution of budget discrepancies between disciplines, vendors and clients

 

Day to day tasks can include

• Develops and maintaining scopes, timelines and budgets

• Coordinates and partners with Hogarth’s global production network to ensure global campaign launches are successful and work is completed

• Manages status documents, agendas, contact reports, trackers and day to day communication with teams and client

• Liaises with clients/agencies/suppliers to obtain schedules, briefs, assets, technical specifications

• Responsible for managing the talent and traffic teams at Hogarth

• Manages of POs, financial reporting, tracking, billing against all project budgets

 

Requirements

• 5+ years of production experience in an integrated agency or production house. Professional experience in Offline, Online and 2D, 3D & compo, audio & media production, shooting, AI, quotation

• General knowledge of the LATAM industry. And unions like SADAIC, SAL, SICA, AAA in Argentina.

• Solid understanding of production, postproduction and the creative development process. Knowledge of the whole postproduction process from start to finish.

• Experience with data handling & assets managements, buyouts and formats

• Successful history of project leadership to clients and account, with demonstrable experience in setting

• Ability to medium to complex projects with varying components, demonstrating ability to deliver on time and on budget

• Proven negotiation skills

• Fluent in English.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, workflow tools, online project management/collaboration/ticketing tools e.g. JIRA, Sharepoint, Smartsheet, etc.

#LI-Hybrid

#LI-NC1

Why work here:
At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP’s unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

Inclusion and Impact
WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

Data
We rely on legitimate interest as a legal basis for processing personal information under the GDPR for purposes of recruitment and applications for employment. When you click the "Submit Application" button at the bottom of this page, this will send all the information you have added to WPP Production. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Privacy st atement . What does a Senior Account Executive do at WPP Production?

Senior Account Executives own the end-to-end project management of projects. They are responsible for intake, delivering a completed project on time and to specification. Senior Project Managers must demonstrate a good understanding of project management tools and best-practice methodology, and the flexibility to lead a diverse and dynamic team to deliver balanced integrated solutions. The Senior Account Executive is everyone's point person for requests they are assigned to. Team members rely on them for everything they need to know about a project: what to expect, what to do next, and to find out where they need to be. Senior Account Executive relay information about the timing, scope, budgets, resources, and changes to the project plan. This role will interact directly with the teams across the South Region (Argentina, Bolivia, Chile, Paraguay, and Uruguay), working on projects with this team during the schedule of 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM.

The successful candidate will use their superior problem-solving skills, possess a strategic mindset, and always strive for continuous improvement. They will have a strong passion for digital marketing and creative development.

Communication

• Serve as the key day-to-day project contact for a variety of stakeholders, both internal and client-side.

• Possess experience in understanding client satisfaction levels; facilitate the sharing of client feedback with the team and management; remain sensitive to client needs and understand the objectives of the assigned campaigns.

• Take accountability to ensure that all team members are fully aware of timelines and deliverables.

• Communicate with teams across the South Region (Argentina, Bolivia, Chile, Paraguay, and Uruguay), as well as internal and external clients, to coordinate work across multiple disciplines and meet team needs.

Collaboration

•
Collaborate with the operations team in the South Region and with internal and external stakeholders to establish and manage clear frameworks and deadlines for requests.

• Lead partnerships with client services, project management, production, and channel leads to ensure a smooth process, proper resource allocation, and a superior end result.

• Foster personal accountability among team members for deliverables and projects, driving active engagement in all assignments toward progress, action, and results.

• Develop and maintain high levels of team effectiveness (trust, communication, collaboration, productivity, diversity, and engagement).

• Independently manage a portfolio of medium- to large-sized projects from initiation through completion.

• Serve as an expert in integrated marketing campaigns, collaborating with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.

• Demonstrate an in-depth understanding of project management techniques and introduce process innovation in how engagements are managed.

• Manage client objectives, expectations, deliverables, and timelines, effectively communicating changes and direction to team members.

• Keep projects on track through robust management in PM tools, issue tracking, status reports, and meeting notes.

• Actively participate in discussions and knowledgeably articulate project status internally and during client interactions.

• Influence the efficiency and quality of work by championing and guiding stakeholders toward improved ways of working.

Task and Resource Management

• Partner with interdisciplinary teams of creative technologists to define and develop project scopes and estimates (goals, deliverables, schedules), helping translate creative concepts into actionable deliverables with proper staffing.

• Own project tracking of all ongoing costs (where applicable) throughout the project lifecycle, reconcile estimates against actuals across all projects, and resolve budget discrepancies among disciplines, vendors, and clients.

Risk Management

• Focus on delivering high-quality work, proactively identifying potential barriers and working to remove them; escalate larger issues to senior management when appropriate.

Daily Tasks

• Liaise with clients, agencies, and vendors to obtain schedules, briefs, assets, and technical specifications.

• Manage intake on incoming requests.

• Develop and maintain scopes, timelines, and budgets in collaboration with internal partners.

• Manage tasks, requests, and workflows within Jira and the Microsoft Suite ecosystem.

• Maintain status documents, agendas, contact reports, trackers, and daily communications with the team.

• Kick off large-scale projects and schedule alignment meetings.

• Keep all teams promptly informed of updates to requests, timelines, and scope.

Requirements

• 5+ years of project management experience in an interactive or integrated agency, or a similar environment.

• Proven experience managing workflows across creative development, content production, technology, QA testing, and marketing methodologies.

• Professional and approachable demeanor, with the ability to thrive in a dynamic, highly matrixed environment.

• Proven track record of managing complex projects, delivering on time and within budget.

• Demonstrated ability to solve problems with balanced solutions that satisfy all stakeholders without compromising the quality of deliverables or the project.

• High level of accountability, composed presence, and self-confidence.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Natural, effective, and collaborative team player.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Suite and Jira.

• Nice to have: Experience with design software and the ability to conduct QC and review creative assets.

About CookUnity:

Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting.

About CookUnity

Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul.

Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world.

If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting.

About the Team:

Our Growth Platform team brings together Engagement and Accounts & Identity to build the experiences and technical foundations that help customers start, deepen, and renew their relationship with CookUnity.

On the Engagement side, we help new customers build lasting habits, keep active customers engaged, grow through referrals, and welcome back customers who have left. On the Accounts & Identity side, we own the services that power customer accounts, authentication, and secure access across our products, providing reliable capabilities that other engineering teams build upon.

Our work spans customer experiences across web and mobile, shared backend services, and the evolution of our platform into scalable, independent systems. We partner closely with Product, Design, Data, and Engineering to experiment, measure outcomes, and turn successful ideas into lasting capabilities. For engineers, this means combining direct customer impact with deep technical ownership, making CookUnity easier to use while helping teams across the company build and move faster.

The role:

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer (Backend oriented) on our Growth Platform team, you will help shape and own the core services behind Accounts & Identity, including authentication, user accounts, and the foundations of a shared notification system.

Working closely with our Staff Engineer, you will take ownership from technical design through implementation, rollout, and operation in production. You will evolve our authentication platform and User Service, build reliable integrations across services, and establish reusable capabilities that enable product teams to deliver timely, relevant notifications across channels.

This role calls for strong backend engineering expertise and sound judgment around distributed systems, database design, performance, and real-time and event-driven architectures. You should be comfortable investigating slow queries, designing APIs and asynchronous workflows, and making practical tradeoffs around consistency, scalability, security, and reliability.

You will partner with engineers across CookUnity to understand their needs and turn them into clear service boundaries and dependable integrations. Your impact will come from both delivering new capabilities and ensuring that the systems other teams depend on remain fast, observable, and easy to build upon.

Responsibilities:

• Own the design, implementation, and operation of core backend services across authentication, identity, and user account management.

• Partner with our Staff Engineer to define technical direction, make architecture decisions, and deliver projects from discovery through production.

• Build the foundations of a shared notification system, including event processing, delivery workflows, and integrations with messaging providers.

• Design APIs and service integrations with clear contracts, reliable failure handling, and well-defined ownership.

• Improve performance and scalability through database design, query optimization, indexing, caching, and efficient data access patterns.

• Build asynchronous and real-time capabilities, accounting for retries, idempotency, ordering, and data consistency.

• Evolve legacy functionality into independent services, planning safe migrations that preserve data integrity and service availability.

• Protect customer data through secure authentication, authorization, and access management practices.

• Establish meaningful automated tests, observability, and rollout strategies, and participate in incident response and the on-call rotation.

• Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to translate business needs into reusable platform capabilities, review code, and mentor other engineers.

Qualifications:

• 5+ years of software engineering experience, with a strong focus on backend services and production systems.

• Strong backend development experience with both Kotlin/Java and Node.js with TypeScript, including building and operating production services. Deep expertise in at least one stack and the ability to contribute independently in the other.

• Solid knowledge of relational databases, including data modeling, indexing, query optimization, transactions, and safe schema migrations.

• Experience building distributed systems and asynchronous workflows, with an understanding of retries, idempotency, and data consistency.

• Experience diagnosing and improving backend performance using metrics, logs, traces, and profiling.

• Familiarity with authentication and authorization concepts, including OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and secure session management.

• Experience integrating internal services and third-party APIs, with thoughtful handling of failures and service dependencies.

• A track record of owning projects from technical design through testing, deployment, and production support.

• Clear communication skills, advanced English, and the ability to collaborate on technical decisions and explain tradeoffs.

Benefits

💸 Get paid in USD

🗺 Work remotely: design the life that you want

⛱ Enjoy 15 days of vacation each year from the start date

🎄 16 fully paid Argentinean holidays

🩺 Healthcare Benefit: Monthly stipend to use in your preferred healthcare provider

🗓️ 5- year Sabbatical: After 5 years with CookUnity, you get a 4-week paid sabbatical

🐣 Paid Family leave

🕯 Compassionate Leave: 3-5 days each time the need arises

🧘🏽‍♀️ Customize the benefits that suit your needs! Access a range of perks tailored to you, including learning opportunities, wellness memberships, delivery apps, and more through our comprehensive benefit platform

🤖 AI-forward workplace: enterprise access to ChatGPT and Claude to help you work smarter and grow faster.

🧑‍🏫 Personalized English coach

If you’re interested in this role, please submit your application, and if we think you might be a fit, we'll get in touch with you. Thank you for your time!

CookUnity is an Equal Opportunity Employer . We are dedicated to creating a community of inclusion and an environment free from discrimination or harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or physical or mental disability.

A quick note for all candidates
We’ve recently seen an increase in recruitment scams across the industry, and we want to make sure you (and your data) stay safe while applying to CookUnity. We also want you to know that we take this seriously — sometimes, as part of our process, we may ask for a brief “proof of humanity” to confirm that we’re connecting with a real person, not an impersonator. Here are a few tips to help you protect yourself and know what to expect from us:

• Apply only through our official channels. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: careers.cookunity.com

• Our recruiters are real people — and easy to verify. You can always find them on LinkedIn with verified profiles. If you’re unsure, feel free to reach out to us on our official LinkedIn Company Page .

• We only communicate through official CookUnity channels. That means emails ending in @cookunity.com and interviews held through official company platforms (Google Meet or Zoom) — never WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS.

• We’ll never ask for payment or personal financial details. If anyone does, please don’t share any information and let us know right away.

If something ever feels off or you’re unsure about a message, we’d much rather you double-check with us. You can always contact us directly through any of our social media channels. We appreciate your interest in joining CookUnity — and we care about keeping your experience (and safety) as genuine as possible.

postings.title: Head of Strategic Pursuits
postings.descriptionText:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenLabs is looking for a Head of Strategic Pursuits to lead our largest, most complex and most transformational enterprise deals around the world, from first executive conversation through signature and into deployment.

This is a global leadership role reporting directly to the Chief Revenue Officer. Strategic Pursuits is not traditional sales support. It is a specialized deal leadership function that partners with Account Executives to win opportunities that require significantly more executive engagement, creativity, and cross-functional coordination than a standard sales cycle. These are the deals that don't fit the playbook. They are structured in new ways, they involve multiple senior stakeholders on the customer side (and sometimes their boards and investors), and they pull in nearly every function at ElevenLabs to get done.

You will own the pursuit strategy for these opportunities. That means shaping the transformation narrative with the customer's C-suite, building the business case, designing the solution and the commercial model, running the negotiation, and bringing Sales, Product, Engineering, FDE, Finance, Legal, Partners, and our own executives together to move the deal forward and clear what's in the way. The AE continues to own the account and the relationship. Your job is to make sure we win the deal and that it's structured to set us and the customer up for long-term success.

The work doesn't stop at one deal. You will turn what we learn from each strategic pursuit into repeatable motions: playbooks the field can reuse, input into how we price and package, signal to Product on what our largest customers need, and clean handoffs into deployment so what we sold is what gets delivered.

This is not a sales operations, deal desk, or program management role, and it is not a quota-carrying territory role. We are looking for someone who has personally led and structured nine-figure-scale, multi-year enterprise deals, is comfortable going well outside the playbook to get them done, and has the executive presence to sit across from a Fortune 500 CEO. While initially a senior IC role, there is the potential to build out a team under this function.



In this role you will

 - Lead strategic deals. Own the pursuit strategy for our largest and most complex enterprise opportunities, partnering with account teams from qualification through close. Help decide which pursuits warrant this level of investment and where your time goes.

 - Build executive engagement. Develop C-suite relationships at our most important customers and prospects, shape transformation narratives, and create compelling business cases tied to measurable outcomes. Bring in the CRO, CEO, and other ElevenLabs executives at the right moments with a clear role for each.

 - Orchestrate cross-functional execution. Bring together Sales, Product, Engineering, FDE, Finance, Legal, Partners, and executive sponsors to accelerate deal progression and remove blockers. Run the pursuit like a program, with a clear plan, owners, and a cadence, without becoming the bottleneck.

 - Structure and win complex transactions. Drive competitive strategy, solution design, commercial models, negotiations, and creative deal structures (multi-year commitments, partnerships, co-development, platform and marketplace models, and others we haven't invented yet) to secure transformational agreements that are good for the customer and for ElevenLabs.

 - Work across senior stakeholders on both sides. Navigate complex buying committees, procurement, legal, and in some cases boards and investors, and keep the deal moving when it gets stuck at the top.

 - Partner on global and strategic accounts. Work closely with regional leaders and account teams on our most important global accounts, bringing a consistent strategy across regions and product lines.

 - Build repeatable winning motions. Turn strategic deals into scalable playbooks, improve pricing and packaging, influence product priorities with evidence from the largest deals in the market, and ensure successful handoffs into deployment.

 - Raise the bar on deal craft across the org. Coach AEs and regional leaders on executive selling, business case development, and deal structuring so the whole Revenue organization gets better at winning big.

 - Be the CRO's partner on big bets. Bring a clear point of view on which deals to pursue, how to structure them, and when to walk away, and represent that view in leadership and executive forums.



Requirements

 - 15+ years of relevant experience in enterprise sales, strategic deals, or business development at technology companies, with a track record of leading and closing very large, complex, multi-year transactions.

 - Deep deal structuring experience. You have personally designed and negotiated creative commercial structures and know how to make the economics work for both sides while protecting the business.

 - Executive presence. You are credible with C-suite executives at the largest enterprises in the world and can hold the room alongside our CRO and CEO.

 - Comfort outside the playbook. You thrive in deals that don't follow a standard process, and you know when to break the playbook and when to rely on it.

 - Cross-functional orchestration. You can rally Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal, and executives around a deal when none of them report to you, and you do it by being prepared, decisive, and easy to work with.

 - Business case and value fluency. You can build a credible, quantified business case tied to customer outcomes and defend it to a CFO.

 - Strong commercial judgment. You understand pricing, margin, and long-term account economics, and you know the difference between a big deal and a good deal.

 - Technical fluency. You understand AI and platform products well enough to shape solution design and hold your own with a customer's CTO.

 - Operator mentality. You care about what happens after signature, and you make sure what we sold gets deployed successfully.

 - Ability to operate globally. You are comfortable leading pursuits with teams and customers across AMER, EMEA, APAC, LATAM, and India.

 - Willingness to travel. Must be willing and able to travel up to 40% of the time, often with customers' and ElevenLabs' executives.



Bonus points

 - Experience building or leading a strategic pursuits, strategic deals, or global accounts function at a high-growth AI, cloud, or enterprise software company.

 - Experience selling AI, voice, conversational AI, or platform/API products to large enterprises.

 - Experience structuring partnerships, marketplace, or co-sell agreements alongside direct deals.

 - Experience in a company where the product and the market move weekly and deals have to keep up.



Location

This is a remote global role within the Revenue organization. You will travel up to 50% for

customer and executive meetings and for working sessions with regional sales leadership.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

Location: Buenos Aires, Argentina

Hybrid

Full-time

As a Senior Business Development Manager B2B, you will join a fast-growing global Fintech company and play a key role in enabling SMBs and professional businesses across the LATAM region to get paid globally through Payoneer’s fast, flexible and secure solutions.

The ideal candidate is a results-driven Senior Business Development with proven experience owning the full sales cycle, from prospecting and lead generation to discovery calls, product demos, negotiation, and closing deals. You are a proactive, commercially minded professional who can build strong client relationships, identify business opportunities, manage a robust pipeline, and consistently drive revenue growth in a fast-paced environment.

What you’ll do:

• Create & articulate compelling value propositions for Payoneer services in coordination with the marketing team

• Regularly interact across functional areas with senior management or executives to ensure unit objectives are met

• Develop long-term strategic relationships with key stakeholders

Who you are:

• At least 6 years of experience in business development, service and/or solution sales, account management, especially in payments, ecommerce or managing large size merchant acquisitions

• Track record of meeting and exceeding business established goals

• Experience in leading complex negotiations with CXOs of SMB accounts

• Ability to drive operational excellence through innovative initiatives

• Fluent in Spanish and English

Not a must but a great advantage:

• Experience in the Payments and Banking industry

• Familiarity with the B2B and SMB Segment

• Experience with direct sales for small businesses engaged in cross border trade

• Experience with data analytics & BI tools

The Payoneer Ways of Working

Act as our customer’s partner on the inside
Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further.

Do it. Own it.
Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do.

Continuously improve
Always striving for a higher standard than our last.

Build each other up
Helping each other grow, as professionals and people.

postings.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Somos redbee, una empresa argentina de tecnología con más de 14 años de experiencia redefiniendo la forma de construir productos digitales en la industria financiera. Nos apasiona co-crear soluciones innovadoras junto a nuestros clientes. Combinamos experiencia, calidad y escalabilidad para desarrollar productos estratégicos y de misión crítica. Nos destaca nuestra obsesión por aportar valor rápido y de calidad.

¿Cuáles serán tus responsabilidades? 
• Diseñar, entrenar, evaluar y desplegar modelos de machine learning en producción, siendo responsable de su ciclo de vida completo.

• Construir y mantener pipelines de entrenamiento, inferencia y reentrenamiento (batch y online).

• Definir e implementar prácticas de MLOps: versionado de modelos y datos, CI/CD, registro de modelos y reproducibilidad.

• Monitorear los modelos en producción (calidad, drift de datos y de concepto, latencia y costo) e implementar alertas y estrategias de mitigación.

• Colaborar con Data Science para llevar prototipos a soluciones robustas, y con Data Engineering para asegurar calidad y disponibilidad de los datos.

• Optimizar el rendimiento y el costo de la infraestructura de entrenamiento e inferencia.

• Documentar arquitecturas, decisiones técnicas y buenas prácticas.
Liderar code reviews y acompañar técnicamente a perfiles más junior.

¿Qué esperamos de vos? 
• Más de 5 años de experiencia en ingeniería de software o datos, con al menos 3 en proyectos de ML en producción.

• Dominio avanzado de Python y de librerías de ML (scikit-learn, PyTorch o TensorFlow).

• Experiencia desplegando modelos como servicios o pipelines productivos (APIs, contenedores con Docker, Kubernetes).

• Experiencia con herramientas de MLOps (MLflow, Kubeflow, Vertex AI, SageMaker u otras) y orquestación (Airflow o similar).

• Experiencia en al menos una nube pública (GCP, AWS o Azure).
SQL avanzado y buen entendimiento de modelado de datos.

• Control de versiones (Git) y prácticas de CI/CD.

• Conocimientos sólidos de estadística y evaluación de modelos.

¿Cuál es nuestra propuesta de valor?

En redbee buscamos crear un espacio de trabajo donde las personas se sientan felices y puedan desarrollarse; por eso ofrecemos 10 días hábiles de vacaciones y adicionamos 5 días hábiles más. Trabajamos con flexibilidad y de forma remote-first y, si vivís en AMBA, nos encontramos una vez al mes en la oficina para compartir, charlar y seguir construyendo vínculos. Sí estás fuera de AMBA el trabajo es full remote. Nos interesa tu comodidad, es por eso que contamos con coworks y brindamos equipamiento para tu espacio de trabajo. Además brindamos un monto mensual de puntos para canjear en una plataforma de beneficios. Sabemos que la familia ocupa un lugar importante: ofrecemos prepaga para vos y tu grupo familiar. También otorgamos licencias extendidas para que puedas estar presente en esos momentos que importan. Creemos en el aprendizaje continuo y en el crecimiento a largo plazo. Vas a tener clases de inglés, acceso a plataformas de capacitación y un plan de desarrollo claro, pensado para acompañar tu viaje dentro de redbee.

En redbee buscamos dejar huella en las trayectorias profesionales y ser una experiencia memorable en tu carrera. Creemos que la calidad técnica y la humana van de la mano, y desde ahí transformamos realidades a través de la tecnología. Si queres ser parte, ¡queremos conocerte!

Ideal candidate

• You create order. You notice what is missing and close the gap without being asked.

• You stay organized when the week does not go as planned, because our season is unpredictable.

• You can tell a crew lead something needs to be corrected, or ask a builder for an update, and keep the relationship strong doing it.

Project quality review
Check projects against quality standards. Record incomplete work, missing documentation, and deviations in our project system. Notify responsible parties the same day and track issues to closure.
Customer and builder billing
Maintain records, confirm invoice receipt and approval status, and follow up on balances and payment dates, mainly by email with occasional calls. Escalate concerns to the Director of Operations. Use a service-first tone, not pressure.
Vendor invoices and payables

Weekly reporting
Deliver accurate, timely reports on work orders, completion, billing, and open balances. Maintain weekly consistency and highlight patterns.
Crew and field coordination
Coordinate schedules, sequencing, and daily logistics. Confirm crews have information, materials, and documentation before starting. Communicate schedule, weather, and scope changes promptly. Be a reliable field contact during working hours. Much of this communication is in Spanish.
As needed
Support licensing and permitting; document and improve processes.

Master the fundamentals, then train as full backup to the Project Coordinator. Progress toward independent ownership of scheduling, material procurement, warranties, builder communication, and job execution. The goal is to master the operation, not remain an assistant. Growth depends on your progress.
