postings.title: Senior Data Scientist, Research
postings.descriptionText:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca 's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role
We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist, Research who is versatile: you model high-stakes business problems—revenue optimization, risk management, and related questions—and you use AI to scale that work. You'll be a senior individual contributor who can go deep statistically, learn a new domain quickly, and rethink how data science problems get solved in the age of AI: not only classical models, but agents and other AI systems that multiply what a small research team can do.
This role is for someone who is deeply curious, strong at analytical thinking and problem solving, and a fast learner—with formal training and a strong statistical foundation. You have tackled revenue and risk problems with modeling before, and you are excited to solve them differently now: building AI agents, automating research workflows, and using modern tools so the science scales. If you want ownership over modelizable, revenue- and risk-critical problems and you already leverage AI to move faster, this is the role.

What You'll Do

• Tackle revenue and risk problems with modeling. Frame ambiguous business questions as quantitative problems; build models that improve revenue, manage risk, and inform decisions.

• Solve them differently in the age of AI. Use AI—including agents and other automation—to scale data science work: accelerate research, extend coverage, and change how models get built, tested, and used.

• Stay statistically rigorous. Bring a strong foundation in statistics and inference so AI-accelerated work is still trustworthy—you know when a result is solid and when it is not.

• Learn the business fast. Ramp quickly across new domains and problems; stay versatile rather than attached to a single method or subject area.

• Turn research into decisions. Communicate findings and trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical partners, including senior leadership.

• Raise the bar. Share practices that help the team use AI to scale DS work without lowering the quality of the science.

• Mentor and set standards. Mentor other data scientists and help grow a culture of curiosity, rigor, and high leverage.

What We're Looking For

• Versatile applied data scientist with experience modeling business problems such as revenue optimization and risk management—not just analyses or dashboards.

• Strong statistical foundation from formal training (statistics, mathematics, or a related quantitative field) and the judgment to apply it under real-world, messy conditions.

• Deeply curious, with strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills; a fast learner who picks up new domains, tools, and methods quickly.

• Practical experience leveraging AI to scale data science work—for example building AI agents, automating research workflows, or otherwise changing how modeling work gets done.

• Strong programming skills in Python and SQL; able to go from question to working analysis or model without a large support structure.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills; able to work with Finance, Risk, Product, and Engineering.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and ship work that gets used.

• Master's or PhD in a quantitative field such as statistics, mathematics, engineering, economics, physics, or a related discipline, and at least 6–10 years of relevant experience. Equivalent industry experience is welcome.

Nice to Have
Background in brokerage, trading, fintech, or another domain where revenue and risk decisions have real consequences.
Experience putting models or agents into production with engineering partners.

How We Take Care of You:

• Competitive Salary & Stock Options

• Health Benefits

• New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500

• Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.

Recruitment Privacy Policy

postings.title: DevOps & Database Engineer (DBA)
postings.descriptionText:
About Klar
We're turning one of the world's largest underbanked markets into something fairer, simpler, and more transparent. 7 million users served since 2019. Uber's first global credit card, built right here in Mexico. Klar Empresarial, a brand-new B2B solution bringing agile credit and smart accounts to SMEs who've been ignored by traditional banks for too long.
And a full banking license on the horizon, because our customers asked for it and we listened.
We move fast, we think big, and we go all in, because as our CEO puts it: "Growing doesn't always mean going further. Sometimes it means going deeper."
Behind all of it is a team of 30+ nationalities, working across Mexico City, Berlin, and Argentina, obsessed with building financial products that are simpler, faster, and fairer than anything that came before.
This is Klar, and we're seeking the people who'll write the next chapter.

Our people
If you join us at Klar, you’ll be welcomed to a team that is rich in many talents and we are very proud! With our head office in Mexico City, and remote tech hubs in Berlin and Argentina, we are always learning something new about another culture or language. With so many people from different backgrounds and walks of life (young professionals, parents, LGBTQ+, neurodivergence), you’ll definitely find your people here!

Our values

• Ownership - We own our successes & our failures as a team.

• Excellence - We do everything to the best of our ability & always seek to achieve a new level of excellence in our work.

• Inclusion - We believe we are stronger together and actively work to promote a safe, diverse, inclusive, and respectful culture.

• Customer Obsession - We understand the value Klar can bring to its customers & it’s always at the forefront of our decisions.

• Klarity - We communicate clearly & with authenticity. It’s in our name & it’s what we do.

About the role
We are looking for a hands-on DevOps & Database Engineer (DBA) who is passionate about building, automating, and maintaining secure, reliable, and scalable infrastructure and database environments.
In this role, you'll combine strong Linux systems administration expertise with database management and DevOps practices to ensure the performance, security, and availability of our production systems.
You'll take ownership of infrastructure automation, vulnerability remediation, database performance and reliability, and virtualization environments, working closely with engineering and security teams to improve operational efficiency.
While Linux administration, PostgreSQL/MSSQL database management, and infrastructure automation will be at the heart of your responsibilities, you'll also contribute to our cloud infrastructure, CI/CD practices, and observability capabilities.

What you can expect:

• Own and maintain our Linux production environments, ensuring their stability, performance, security, and availability across critical infrastructure.

• Drive infrastructure automation and configuration management using tools such as Ansible, Bash, and Python to reduce manual effort, improve consistency, and streamline operations.

• Manage patching and vulnerability remediation at scale, from identifying and prioritizing vulnerabilities to deploying patches and validating remediation across infrastructure fleets.

• Ensure database reliability and performance by administering PostgreSQL and/or Microsoft SQL Server environments, including performance tuning, backups, replication, failover, and disaster recovery.

• Manage and optimize our virtualization infrastructure, working with VMware ESXi, vSphere, and Cisco UCS to support reliable and efficient operations.

• Collaborate with engineering teams to operate and troubleshoot cloud-native infrastructure, including AWS, Kubernetes, and Terraform.

• Strengthen infrastructure monitoring and observability using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, or similar solutions to proactively identify and resolve issues.

• Contribute to secure and reliable infrastructure operations, including networking, certificate management, and CI/CD automation.

• Have meaningful ownership and autonomy, with the opportunity to improve infrastructure reliability, challenge existing processes, and make a tangible impact on our systems.

What we are looking for:

• 3+ years of hands-on experience administering Linux systems in production environments, particularly RHEL and/or Ubuntu, with mid-to-advanced troubleshooting and system administration skills.

• Strong experience with configuration management and infrastructure automation, using Ansible or similar tools, alongside practical scripting skills in Bash and Python.

• Proven experience managing patching and vulnerability remediation across multiple servers, including vulnerability scanning, risk-based prioritization, patch deployment, and remediation verification.

• Hands-on experience administering PostgreSQL and/or Microsoft SQL Server, including performance optimization, backup and recovery, replication, failover, and disaster recovery.

• Practical experience with virtualization technologies, particularly VMware ESXi, vSphere, and Cisco UCS.

• Working knowledge of AWS, Kubernetes, and Terraform, with the ability to operate, troubleshoot, and maintain infrastructure environments.

• Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, or equivalent solutions.

• Solid understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, VPNs, TLS/mTLS, and certificate management.

• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automation workflows using GitHub Actions or similar platforms.

• Good written and spoken English, with the ability to collaborate effectively with technical teams.

Nice to have:

• Experience with Windows Server administration, Active Directory, Group Policy Objects (GPO), Samba, or OpenLDAP.

• Familiarity with Istio, Kafka, or Terragrunt.

• Experience managing multi-region AWS infrastructure and implementing cloud cost optimization initiatives.

• Previous experience working in fintech, banking, or other highly regulated environments.

Our offer to you:

• Competitive salary based on performance and experience

• Chance of earning Klar stock options

• 26 days of paid vacation per year

• Computer devices

• Sponsored coaching and therapy sessions via Mantra Care

• International work environment with amazing and highly skilled people

• A world class team that helps you evolve your skills in areas you're interested in

Klar is a safe place for everyone!
We trust our highly skilled and diverse team and we’re committed to creating a welcoming and inclusive environment for new talents to flourish. We value diversity and welcome all applications regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion/belief, physical abilities, age, sexual orientation and identity.
Should you require any accommodations through the recruitment process, please don’t hesitate to let us know how we can help!

postings.title: English to Belarusian Review Lead for UI, Marketing & Product Content
postings.descriptionText:
About Welo Global

Welo Global is a leader in multilingual AI, technology, and content solutions serving over 2,000 clients in 300 languages. The company combines globally scaled multilingual infrastructure, including a network of over 500,000 linguists and domain experts, with advanced NLP, computational linguistics, and best-in-class compliance backed by seven ISO certifications. Welo Global ’s five brands—Welocalize (multilingual content and localization services for global enterprises), Park IP (intellectual property and patent translation services for law firms and corporate legal teams), Welo Life Sciences (regulated language and compliance-aligned content solutions for pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device organizations), Adapt (multilingual performance-led digital marketing agency), and Welo Data (multilingual data generation, evaluation, and human data infrastructure for AI systems)—serve distinct customer segments with purpose-built expertise, fit-for-purpose solutions, and supporting technology. weloglobal.com

The Role

We are seeking an experienced English into Belarusian Review Lead to serve as the language quality owner and primary client-facing linguistic expert for a leading global technology client.

You will own the locale’s interpretation of the client’s quality standards and make sure that the Post-Editing Lead, Post Editors, and Reviewers all work to the same shared understanding of “good”. You will be the main point of contact for the client’s Language Manager on quality discussions, arbitration, and escalations, and you will drive consistency, quality governance, and continuous improvement across UI, marketing, product, informational, legal, and support content.

Project Details

• Location: Remote (based in one of the approved countries below)
- Expected volume: Approximately 24 hours per month
- Employment type: Freelance / Independent Contract
- Task type: Language Lead Support
- Content types: UI, Marketing, Informational, Legal, Product, Support
- Language pair: English into Belarusian

What You Will Do

• Analyse requirements: Review every style guide and glossary update, assess which quality categories and content types it affects, and record the changes. Track what the client’s Language Manager actually corrects and says in calibration and quality calls, not only what is written down.
-Relay expectations: Run regular alignment roundtables with the language community and publish a structured monthly quality digest covering performance, priority improvement areas, style guide updates, and notable errors and arbitration outcomes.
-Manage review quality actively: Coach Reviewers one-to-one using specific examples, run shadowing sessions from real alignment data.
-Improve the standard: Turn recurring justification patterns into well-reasoned style guide proposals, and share cross-locale patterns with the Welocalize Quality Manager.
-Maintain alignment with the client: Treat Language Manager decisions as the standard, raise concerns with evidence at the right forum, and aim for fewer surprises over time.

What You Will Own

• The locale’s review service score, including RQE audit and alignment performance
-The community’s shared understanding of quality
-The integrity of the arbitration record, ensuring that every arbitration sent to the client is valid and well-evidenced
-The working relationship with the client’s Language Manager, including clarifications, escalations, and expectation tracking

Requirements

• Experience: 3 to 5+ years in Localization Quality Assurance (LQA), Senior Language Lead, or Quality Governance roles
- Client and stakeholder management: Direct experience as the primary point of contact for client Language Managers, managing formal arbitration or escalation processes, and facilitating conflict resolution
- Quality audit frameworks: Deep, practical experience with localization evaluation frameworks, including RQE, LQE, error rubrics, and severity mapping
- Style guide and expectation analysis: Ability to analyse style guide changes, identify implicit client expectations, and map tolerance by content type (for example, Marketing vs. Legal vs. UI)
- Meeting facilitation: Hands-on experience with one-to-one coaching, shadowing sessions, alignment roundtables, and structured monthly quality reporting
- Analytical approach: Skill in tracking error concentrations, severity drift, and alignment scores, and in converting justification patterns into style guide improvements
- Language: Native-level Belarusian and professional-level English
- Preferred: Prior experience supporting major technology localization programs and working with calibration or alignment tools

Additional Key Information

• Successful candidates will be provided with a dedicated device for project work.
- A background check is required as part of onboarding.
- Candidates must be physically located in one of the approved countries.

Approved countries: Argentina, Australia, Austria, Belgium, Brazil, Bulgaria, Canada, Chile, China, Colombia, Costa Rica, Croatia, Czech Republic, Denmark, Egypt, El Salvador, Finland, France, Germany, Ghana, Greece, Guatemala, Hong Kong, Hungary, India, Indonesia, Ireland, Israel, Italy, Japan, Kenya, Lithuania, Malaysia, Mexico, Netherlands, New Zealand, Nigeria, Norway, Peru, Philippines, Poland, Portugal, Qatar, Romania, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, South Africa, South Korea, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Taiwan, Thailand, Turkey, United Arab Emirates, United Kingdom, United States and Vietnam.

Why Join Us

This role offers a long-term partnership with global teams on high-visibility products. You will benefit from steady project volume, comprehensive onboarding and ongoing learning, and access to established linguistic resources.

If this sounds like the right opportunity, we would love to hear from you.

Beware of recruitment scams. Welo Global and all of its brands never recruit through direct messages on social media or WhatsApp, and never asks candidates to pay money for a job. Official emails come only from @welocalize.com, @welodata.ai, or @hire.lever.co, and all applications go through jobs.lever.co/weloglobal. Be wary of unexpected offers, generic email addresses (such as Gmail or Yahoo), and requests for fees or sensitive information. Report suspicious messages and learn more: Recognizing Scams and Confirming Legitimate Welocalize Communications – Welo Global

postings.descriptionText:
Sponsorship Sales Manager (Davos 2027) – Elvoro Ltd
Engagement: Freelance / independent contractor, immediate start through January 2027
Location: Remote, worldwide (USA/EU preferred)
Compensation: To be agreed

About & Mission
Elvoro is a founder-led AI social media marketing and advertising company. In January 2027, we’re hosting a private AI event in Davos during the week of the World Economic Forum Annual Meeting.
We’re looking for a sponsorship sales professional who has won paying event sponsors through direct outreach . You’ll identify companies planning to be in Davos, reach the people who control their sponsorship budgets and give them a clear reason to sponsor our event. You’ll own the sale from first contact through signed agreement and payment, with direct access to Elvoro ’s founder for key conversations.

Responsibilities

• Build a target list of 1,000+ companies attending or relevant to Davos. Prioritize those whose goals fit the event and identify who approves sponsorship spending.

• Run a high volume of personalized outreach by email, LinkedIn and phone. Follow up consistently and book meetings with qualified decision-makers.

• Lead sponsor conversations. Understand what each company wants to achieve in Davos, present a package that serves that goal and agree on a concrete next step.

• Handle objections, negotiate terms and secure signed agreements and payment. Bring in Elvoro ’s founder when their involvement can help close a deal.

• Keep the sponsor pipeline current and report weekly on qualified conversations, proposals, signed sponsors and revenue secured.

Qualifications

• You’ve personally sourced and closed paid corporate sponsorships through outbound outreach , ideally for business conferences, executive events or private gatherings during Davos week.

• You know how to find the budget owner, earn a response from a senior decision-maker and make a sponsorship pitch relevant to that company.

• You communicate and negotiate confidently in English and can manage a large prospect list, follow up reliably and close against a fixed event date.

• Experience selling high-value sponsorship packages and existing relationships with companies active in Davos are strong advantages.

AI-Native Workflow

• Use AI to research companies and draft tailored outreach efficiently. Verify the details and use your judgment before contacting a prospect.

Benefits
Own sponsorship sales for a private AI event in Davos and work directly with Elvoro ’s founder. You’ll have the independence to shape your outreach, get quick decisions on proposals and build relationships with senior decision-makers at international companies. A successful engagement may lead to further sales work with Elvoro .
Elvoro ’s event is independently organized and takes place on the sidelines of the World Economic Forum Annual Meeting. Neither Elvoro Ltd nor the event is affiliated with or endorsed by the World Economic Forum.

postings.title: Senior Staff Site Reliability Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
About SecurityScorecard :
SecurityScorecard is the global leader in cybersecurity ratings, with over 12 million companies continuously rated, operating in 64 countries. Founded in 2013 by security and risk experts Dr. Alex Yampolskiy and Sam Kassoumeh and funded by world-class investors, SecurityScorecard ’s patented rating technology is used by over 25,000 organizations for self-monitoring, third-party risk management, board reporting, and cyber insurance underwriting; making all organizations more resilient by allowing them to easily find and fix cybersecurity risks across their digital footprint.
Headquartered in New York City, our culture has been recognized by Inc Magazine as a "Best Workplace,” by Crain’s NY as a "Best Places to Work in NYC," and as one of the 10 hottest SaaS startups in New York for two years in a row. Most recently, SecurityScorecard was named to Fast Company’s annual list of theWorld’s Most Innovative Companies for 2023 and to the Achievers 50 Most Engaged Workplaces in 2023 award recognizing “forward-thinking employers for their unwavering commitment to employee engagement.” SecurityScorecard is proud to be funded by world-class investors including Silver Lake Waterman, Moody’s, Sequoia Capital, GV and Riverwood Capital.

About the Role:
As a Senior Staff Site Reliability Engineer, you will set the direction for how SecurityScorecard runs production with AI. You will design and lead our move to AI-first operations, where agents triage alerts, investigate incidents, propose and apply fixes under human control, and remove repetitive work from the SRE team. You own the technical strategy for agentic operations, the MCP and agent platform it runs on, and the security and governance model that lets AI act safely in production.
This is a hands-on technical leadership role within SRE. You also remain the senior technical authority for our Kubernetes on AWS (EKS) infrastructure and reliability practices.

What You Will Do:

Lead AI-first operations

• Own the strategy for AI in SRE, updated quarterly and measured by toil removed, MTTR, change failure rate and deploy lead time.

• Build agentic workflows for alert triage, incident investigation, remediation and infrastructure changes, starting with the highest-volume work.

• Architect the agent platform: MCP servers for our observability, cloud, Kubernetes and incident tooling, plus a shared library of SRE skills and workflows.

• Set the autonomy model: what agents do on their own, what needs approval, and how that expands as they prove reliable.

• Build evaluation for agents: test them against replayed incidents before granting new permissions, and track accuracy, cost and impact.

Own AI security and governance

• Partner with Security on the governance framework for AI in production: scoped credentials, approval gates, audit trails, prompt-injection defenses and kill switches.

• Build governance into the platform through policy-as-code and guarded tools, so SRE automation is safe by default.

Advance how SRE uses AI

• Push an already AI-fluent SRE team further: take on harder agentic problems together and share new techniques as tools change.

• Run reviews and demos of agentic work, and publish patterns and anti-patterns.

• Recommend AI tooling for SRE, including build-versus-buy decisions.

Set the reliability and platform direction

• Own the technical direction for Kubernetes on AWS (EKS), IaC and GitOps, and CI/CD with progressive delivery.

• Define the SLO and observability strategy, with telemetry built for people and agents.

• Lead major incidents and postmortems, and turn lessons into fixes and new agent workflows.

Required Qualifications:

• 10+ years in SRE, DevOps or infrastructure.

• Shipped AI automation in operations that measurably cut toil or improved incident response.

• Built AI tooling for infrastructure: MCP servers, agents and tool design.

• Sound judgment on AI risk in production: permissions, approvals, auditability and prompt injection.

• AI-first daily: you write and review most of your code through AI agents.

• Deep platform expertise: Kubernetes, AWS EKS, Terraform, GitOps, observability, Python or Go, and at least one of Kafka, Flink or ClickHouse.

• Influence without authority through clear technical strategy and mentoring

Preferred Qualifications:

• Built evaluation harnesses that score agents against replayed incidents.

• Production experience across Kafka, Flink and ClickHouse.

• Chaos engineering or resilience testing.

• Public work on AI for operations: open-source tools, talks or writing.

Benefits:

Specific to each country, we offer a competitive salary, stock options, Health benefits, and unlimited PTO, parental leave, tuition reimbursements, and much more!
The estimated total compensation range for this position is $150,000 - $160,000 USD (base plus bonus). Actual compensation for the position is based on a variety of factors, including, but not limited to affordability, skills, qualifications and experience, and may vary from the range. In addition to base salary, employees may also be eligible for annual performance-based incentive compensation awards and equity, among other company benefits.
SecurityScorecard is committed to Equal Employment Opportunity and embraces diversity. We believe that our team is strengthened through hiring and retaining employees with diverse backgrounds, skill sets, ideas, and perspectives. We make hiring decisions based on merit and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, sex or gender (including pregnancy) gender identity or expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, age, marital, veteran, disability status or any other protected category in accordance with applicable law.
We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, in accordance with applicable law. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. We work with high-profile clients and founder-led brands to strategize, produce and optimize content that drives engagement, brand visibility and business growth. Our team combines strategy, design, production and performance analysis, and we work AI-first. We are a fast-moving, collaborative remote team that values respect, teamwork and open communication.

What you will own

• A complete file in Drive for every investor and SPV, from first capital call to latest K-1, with gaps flagged with an owner and a date.

• The Fund I close checklist, from subscription documents, side letters, KYC and AML to wires and countersignatures, complete by the January 15, 2027 close.

• The investor tracker and Real Deal CRM, with every touchpoint logged within one business day and a one-page pipeline snapshot ready before the daily partner call.

• Capital calls and fund administrator requests, with notices sent, receipts tracked, wire instructions verified by phone and every request list cleared.

• K-1 distribution, the compliance calendar, and the statement and investor update calendar, so every filing and update goes out on time after validation.

• Data rooms, Carta, entity records and insurance summaries kept current, with one dated final version of each document and access approved and logged.

Who you are

• You come from fund operations or financial operations, such as a fund administrator, VC or PE fund, family office, or an accounting, audit, legal operations or investor relations operations team serving funds.

• You have hands-on experience in at least two of these: capital calls, investor records, K-1 or tax document distribution, investor onboarding, fund administrator requests and entity paperwork.

• You have kept a system of record others trusted, such as a CRM, investor database, cap table or data room, and you check your work before you report it.

• Advanced written and spoken English.

• Spanish, or experience with a US-based leadership team in a remote contractor setup.

• Hands-on use of Carta, Real Deal or a similar CRM, DocuSign and a data room platform.

• Experience supporting a fund close, placement agent work, investor relations, expense and management fee tracking, or plain-language summaries of insurance policies and agreements.

This role is not
Not an investment analyst, fundraiser, controller, signer, payment approver, legal or tax advisor, or HR role.

The stages depend on the case, and usually include:

Job Type: Full-time

At LaunchBrightly, we are on a mission to automate the process of capturing and keeping your product screenshots up-to-date across your help center . Our screenshot automation platform allows you to set up simple automation recipes to auto-generate screenshots of the latest version of your product and continuously update them in your help documentation as your product changes.
Our work is remote, not distant. We're an async-first team that communicates in writing, moves fast, and trusts people to get things done without constant check-ins. No unnecessary meetings, no micromanagement — just clear ownership and focused work.
LaunchBrightly was founded in 2022, and is backed by prominent venture firms including IA Ventures, Tuesday Capital, and B Capital Group — as the Product Setup Specialist will become an integral member of an intimate 10-person team. Job Description
This is a high-volume, detail-oriented role focused on setting up and maintaining product screenshots at scale. You’ll spend most of your time working inside our tool, navigating web applications, and completing structured, repeatable tasks with a high level of consistency and accuracy.
Your primary responsibility is to create screenshot “recipes” using our internal Screenshot Recipe Builder — a point-and-click WYSIWYG tool that records the steps needed to capture specific screens within a customer’s product.
You'll be doing this at volume — often building many hundreds of recipes per month across multiple customer environments. The work is methodical and detail-oriented, and doing it well requires patience, focus, and a genuine interest in getting things right day after day. Much of the work is repetitive by nature — success in this role comes from being able to stay focused, consistent, and detail-oriented across a high volume of similar tasks.
This isn't a data entry job. You'll need to think carefully about each customer's product, make judgment calls about the best way to capture a given screen or feature, and stay sharp when something doesn't behave as expected. But you don't need an engineering background either — if you're comfortable navigating web applications, using browser dev tools occasionally, and can stay organized across a high volume of tasks — you'll be well-equipped for this role.

What you’ll be doing
You’ll be responsible for things such as:

• Creating large volumes of screenshot recipes across customer web applications and help center environments using our Recipe Builder

• Navigating customer web applications to understand their product UI and capturing the steps needed to automate each screenshot using our Recipe Builder

• Identifying when something isn't working as expected and troubleshooting before escalating

• Spotting patterns across customer implementations — noticing what’s slow, what breaks often, and where things could be improved

• Documenting issues, bugs, and friction points clearly so the engineering team can act on them

• Contributing feedback on the Recipe Builder itself — you'll use it every day, so your perspective on what could be improved is genuinely valuable

• Occasionally using tools like the Browser Console and dev tools to inspect or debug issues

What we are looking for
The most important things for this role aren't technical — they're about how you work:

• You're organized and consistent and can maintain quality across repetitive, high-volume tasks without losing focus or cutting corners

• You're detail-oriented and notice when something is off — and you care enough to investigate

• You communicate clearly in writing and can describe a problem or observation in a way that's easy for someone else to act on

• You take ownership and don't wait to be told what to do next — you figure it out and get it done

• You're comfortable working independently in an async environment

• You have a customer-first mentality, with an instinct to imagine how users will react and interact

• You're a team player who thrives in a collaborative environment but doesn't need hand-holding to make progress

Bonus point if you
These aren't required but will help you get up to speed faster:

• Some familiarity with browser dev tools or inspect element

• A basic understanding of HTML and CSS — enough to recognize selectors and read a DOM

• Any experience with QA, testing, or documenting product issues

• Experience using Postman or working with APIs in any capacity

What we offer

• Flexible working hours and locations. Your success is measured on outcomes

• A culture of no meetings that protects focus time and productivity

• Excellent start-up culture with openness and inclusiveness

• True ownership and autonomy over your role and the impact on the company

• Experienced founders with many years of successfully building product across multiple ventures

• Annual meetup as a team in New York City

What to expect in the interview process
Given the remote nature of our work setting, one of the core principles for how we operate as a remote team is written communication. And we therefore run a slightly unique interview process that begins with an email-based exchange to learn more about your background, communication style and overall fit for the role.

• Stage 1 — Email exchange with Josh (Co-founder): We'll start with a written conversation to learn about your background, how you communicate, and why this role interests you.

• Stage 2 — Short practical exercise: We'll ask you to complete a brief hands-on task that mirrors the kind of work you'd be doing in this role.

• Final stage — Video call: With our Senior Implementation Specialist, so we can connect more personally and make sure it's a good fit on both sides.

postings.title: Director, Equity Capital Markets
postings.descriptionText:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

About the Role:

Alpaca is building a differentiated position in primary markets: connecting issuers and lead underwriters to high-quality global retail demand through our brokerage infrastructure and broker-dealer partner network; Equity Capital Markets is a strategic growth engine for Alpaca.

We're looking for a Director, Equity Capital Markets to own Alpaca's ECM franchise: win issuer-selected allocations, deepen relationships with syndicate and ECM desks at major underwriters, and originate the next wave of investment banking opportunities across IPOs, follow-ons, and other primary offerings.

This person will operate at the intersection of capital markets, issuer coverage, and distribution strategy. You will package Alpaca's global retail reach—especially international and partner-driven demand—into a proposition that issuers and banks choose for retail tranches. You will run live-deal execution end to end, from selling-group readiness through allocation quality and post-deal reporting, while building a durable pipeline of future IB opportunities for Alpaca.

This is not a pure coverage or relationship role. You're building Alpaca's seat at the syndicate table and turning distribution into repeatable primary-market wins that compound into broader investment banking relationships.

What you'll do:

• Build and own senior relationships with issuers, sponsors, CFOs, IR teams, and bankers to get Alpaca into retail-platform selection processes, data packs, and management conversations—securing meaningful allocations.

• Develop and deepen coverage of lead underwriters and ECM / syndicate desks across bulge-bracket and select boutique banks; drive selling-group / select-dealer agreements from introduction through execution and operational readiness

• Position Alpaca's distribution story—global retail reach, broker-dealer partner network, geo / demographic targeting, customer quality, and anti-flipping controls—so issuers and banks prefer Alpaca for retail participation

• Originate and grow future investment banking opportunities for Alpaca across IPOs, follow-ons, and related primary offerings, with focus on retail-friendly and high-conviction sectors

• Run live-deal execution: qualify offerings, mobilize partner and end-client demand, coordinate legal / selling restrictions and jurisdictional readiness, manage IOI / order flow, and deliver clean post-deal reporting

• Build a repeatable ECM operating rhythm—pipeline reviews, banker coverage maps, issuer outreach cadence, and deal retrospectives—that scales with deal volume

• Partner closely with Legal, Compliance, Product, Brokerage Ops, Partnerships, and Finance to keep Alpaca deal-ready across agreements, marketing materials, restricted jurisdictions, and allocation methodology

• Represent Alpaca in issuer pitches, banker meetings, exchange / PE channels, and industry conferences; convert introductions into active coverage and signed pathways to allocation

• Define and track ECM success metrics: issuer pitches and data-pack inclusions, signed selling-group relationships, allocation volume and quality, partner / geo coverage per deal, flipping outcomes, and repeat issuer / bank engagement

• Manage and grow the ECM franchise over time, including prioritization of bank coverage, sector focus, and the roadmap from retail distribution into broader IB opportunity capture

What we're looking for:

• 3+ years in equity capital markets, syndicate, equity capital markets origination, or adjacent investment banking / primary markets roles, with clear ownership of issuer and underwriter relationships

• Proven track record securing allocations and influencing issuer/sponsor selection for retail or distribution partners—ideally across IPOs and other equity offerings

• Existing senior relationships with ECM / syndicate desks at major underwriters and comfort operating in selling-group / select-dealer constructs

• Strong issuer coverage instincts: you know how to get into the room with CFOs, IR, sponsors, and bankers, and you can win on substance, not just introductions

• Deep fluency in how retail tranches, allocation decisions, and syndicate processes actually work—and the judgment to navigate high-demand deals where issuer outreach is required

• An exceptional operator who can build the playbook: agreements, materials, deal process, partner mobilization, and post-deal feedback loops

• Clear communicator who can package a differentiated distribution narrative for issuers and banks, align internal stakeholders, and close loops quickly in live deals

• Comfortable collaborating remotely in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment while showing up for high-stakes in-person issuer and banker meetings when it matters

Preferred:

• Experience placing or distributing international / non-US retail demand into US or global equity offerings

• Prior work with broker-dealer networks, introducing brokers, or platform distribution in primary markets

• Background spanning both sell-side ECM / syndicate and buy-side or platform distribution perspectives

• Existing relationships across AI, consumer, or other retail-friendly IPO pipelines, and familiarity with exchange / PE origination channels

• Experience standing up a new ECM or primary-markets function inside a high-growth fintech or brokerage platform

What Success Looks Like:

• Alpaca is consistently included in issuer retail-platform evaluations and wins meaningful allocations on priority deals

• Selling-group / select-dealer relationships with key lead underwriters are signed, operational, and actively used

• A growing pipeline of investment banking opportunities—beyond one-off IPO participation—is originated and advanced for Alpaca

• Live deals run cleanly: partner demand is mobilized, legal / jurisdictional readiness is never the blocker, and post-deal reporting reinforces Alpaca's quality to issuers and banks

• Issuers and underwriters return to Alpaca because distribution quality, allocation outcomes, and coverage reliability compound over time

How We Take Care of You:

• Competitive Salary & Stock Options

• Health Benefits

• New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500

• Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.

postings.title: OT Data Architect
postings.descriptionText:
Total Number of Openings
1

GBS Chevron Global Business Services (GBS), located in Buenos Aires (Puerto Madero), Argentina, is accepting applications for the position of OT Data Architect. Successful candidates will join the IT Organization, which is part of a multifunction service and technical center with a workforce of more than 1800 employees that deliver business services and solutions to the corporation across the globe.

The OT Data team is evolving from a traditional operational data delivery model into a scalable Industrial Data Platform that will support enterprise data products, advanced analytics, digital twins, AI-enabled solutions, and future digital initiatives across Chevron.

We are seeking a Senior Data Architect to define the long-term architecture, governance framework, and data product strategy that will enable this transformation. This individual will play a key role in establishing the standards, reusable models, and strategic direction required to scale OT Data as a foundational enterprise capability. The role will also support initiatives related to PCN data, operational data products, AI, Computer Vision, Robotics, and future industrial digital solutions.

Key Responsibilities

• Define the target architecture and long-term roadmap for the OT Data platform.

• Establish enterprise standards for industrial data modeling, contextualization, governance, and data products.

• Design reusable semantic and asset models that can be leveraged across multiple business domains.

• Define scalable integration and architecture patterns for operational technology data platforms.

• Partner with business and technical stakeholders to align future OT Data capabilities with enterprise digital initiatives.

• Drive architectural decisions that improve reusability, scalability, maintainability, and governance.

• Ensure new solutions contribute to a common platform vision rather than creating isolated point solutions.

• Support the evolution of OT Data toward AI-ready and Digital Twin-ready capabilities.

Required Qualifications

• Hands-on experience with industrial data ecosystems, especially the AVEVA PI System (PI Asset Framework, PI Cloud / AVEVA CONNECT, PI Web API) and time-series data architectures.

• Strong experience with Microsoft Azure data services, including Azure Data Explorer (KQL, performance, capacity planning, and hot/cold storage tiering), Microsoft Fabric / OneLake, and Azure integration services such as Logic Apps and Azure Functions.

• Experience designing event-driven and streaming architectures (MQTT, Unified Namespace, publish/subscribe patterns).

• Proven experience designing common asset models, semantic layers, and ontologies (for example RDF/OWL and knowledge graphs) to support digital twins and AI use cases.

• Experience defining data products, metadata management, data lineage, data quality, and data governance frameworks.

• Solid understanding of OT security architectures, including the Purdue Model, PCN/DMZ segmentation, and ISA/IEC 62443.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with hybrid and edge platforms such as Azure Local, Azure IoT Operations, and Industrial IoT solutions.

Requisitos básicos

What knowledge and experiences will you need to bring to share with our network?

Competencias:

• Habilidad para mediar, resolver tensiones e identificar oportunidades para potenciar resultados.

Requisitos:

• Experiencia mínima de 4 años en liderazgo, ejecución e implementación de proyectos o estrategias en el ámbito educativo o social.

• Experiencia en definición de estrategias alineadas a planes de largo plazo.

postings.title: GEONAVEGADOR
postings.descriptionText:
Sumá tu energía a la compañía que contribuye al desarrollo de nuestro país.

En YPF buscamos personas que quieran ser parte de un gran equipo que transforma desafíos en oportunidades y que actúa con excelencia para generar valor. Con más de cien años de historia, somos la compañía energética líder de la Argentina, impulsando el desarrollo y la innovación tecnológica del país.

¡Sumarte a YPF es unirte a un proyecto que combina experiencia, pasión y la energía necesaria para seguir construyendo nuestro futuro!

¿Qué buscamos?

Profesional para desempeñarse en el rol de Geonavegador/a dentro de la Vicepresidencia Upstream.


¿Cuál será su desafío?

Posicionar los pozos horizontales dentro del intervalo estratigráfico definido, interpretando registros en tiempo real, ajustando modelos geológicos y recomendando modificaciones de trayectoria para optimizar la perforación y maximizar el contacto con el reservorio. Asimismo, será responsable de identificar contingencias de manera temprana, coordinar la comunicación entre las distintas áreas involucradas y asegurar el resguardo de la información técnica generada durante la operación.




¿Cuáles serán sus principales tareas?



• 
Recolectar y analizar información geológica y de subsuelo, incluyendo datos de pozos de correlación, trayectorias, superficies sísmicas y marcadores geológicos.




• 
Construir y actualizar modelos geológicos 2D y 3D para el seguimiento de las operaciones de geonavegación.




• 
Participar y liderar reuniones pre-operativas para validar modelos geológicos, revisar objetivos y acordar planes de contingencia.




• 
Monitorear en tiempo real la perforación de pozos horizontales verificando la calidad de los datos recibidos desde las compañías de servicio.




• 
Interpretar registros LWD y otros datos de subsuelo para actualizar el modelo geológico y realizar recomendaciones de posicionamiento de pozo.




• 
Emitir alertas tempranas ante contingencias operativas y actuar de acuerdo con los procedimientos establecidos.




• 
Elaborar informes diarios y finales de pozo, documentando resultados, conclusiones y lecciones aprendidas.




• 
Gestionar el resguardo y la disponibilidad de la información técnica en repositorios corporativos.




• 
Participar activamente en reuniones multidisciplinarias con equipos de Geología, Geociencias, Perforación y Operaciones.




• 
Contribuir al desarrollo técnico del equipo mediante la transferencia de conocimientos y acompañamiento de profesionales en entrenamiento.








¿Qué valoramos?



• Formación académica: Licenciatura en Geología o carreras afines (excluyente).


• Experiencia profesional: Al menos 1 año de experiencia en Geonavegación de pozos horizontales.


• Herramientas informáticas: Software de Geonavegación y modelado geológico. Se valorará experiencia con herramientas y servicios M/LWD.


• Actitud / Habilidades: Capacidad analítica, orientación a resultados, toma de decisiones en tiempo real, comunicación efectiva, trabajo en equipo, proactividad y aprendizaje continuo.


• Idiomas: Inglés intermedio/avanzado (deseable).






Información del puesto

Lugar de trabajo: Torre Puerto Madero.

Régimen laboral: Diagrama 7x7 12hs rotativo de 6 a 18 y 18 a 6hs.

Encuadre gremial: Fuera de Convenio.
Si sos una persona que:

● Trabaja con excelencia y profesionalismo.

● Da lo mejor cada día, valora la meritocracia y busca siempre la milla extra.

● Vive los desafíos como oportunidades para innovar y aprender.

● Disfruta del trabajo en equipo y del intercambio de distintos puntos de vista.

● Encara los proyectos con pasión y compromiso.

● Promueve un buen clima de trabajo, con empatía, escucha activa y respeto.

¡Este puesto es para vos!



¿Qué ofrecemos?

Un entorno donde podés aportar lo más valioso que tenés: tu energía. Esa energía que impulsa, que se adapta, que aprende, que suma, que transforma.

Sumarte a la #ExperienciaYPF es:

● 🤩 Impulsar tu desarrollo al siguiente nivel con nuevas oportunidades de aprendizaje.

● 💡 Crear soluciones innovadoras que impactan en el país.

● 🤝 Formar parte de una empresa comprometida con la equidad y la inclusión.

● 🧘‍♀️ Disfrutar del acompañamiento integral del Programa Be #BeneficiosYExperiencias.

Programa Be (Beneficios y Experiencias)

· Descuentos exclusivos en combustibles, gimnasios y muchos otros productos y servicios.

· Iniciativas para estar cerca en los momentos familiares claves: ayuda escolar, licencias parentales extendidas y regalo de nacimiento.

· Cobertura médica para vos y tu familia.

· Descuentos especiales en universidades orientados a impulsar estudios de especialización y posgrado.

· Servicios de refrigerio, frutas, snacks y comedor (según locación).

· Día libre de cumpleaños

· Esquema de vacaciones adicionales

¡Te esperamos para seguir generando valor y construyendo juntos el futuro energético de nuestro país!

Junior Full Stack Engineer (Independent Contractor)

Location | Latin America — Remote
Engagement Type | Independent contractor (services agreement)
Availability | General overlap with U.S. Eastern Time

About LoanBud

LoanBud is a fast-growing fintech platform dedicated to SBA financing, connecting entrepreneurs to a nationwide network of lenders and helping small business owners access capital through a streamlined, technology-driven process. We pride ourselves on a collaborative culture, meaningful work, and a strong commitment to supporting the backbone of the economy — small businesses.

Engagement Overview

LoanBud is seeking a junior independent contractor to help build, maintain, and support our proprietary lending and workflow platform. The platform is used by borrowers, loan officers, processors, underwriters, referral partners, lenders, and internal teams.

This is a hands-on engagement for an early-career engineer who wants to grow inside a real production application. You will work mainly in our Java and Spring Boot backend, with contributions to TypeScript front-end work, database changes, and integrations, under the guidance of senior engineers.

Great communication is central to this role. Alongside engineering work, you will support platform users by phone — walking borrowers, loan officers, and partners through issues, gathering clear details about problems, and explaining solutions in plain, friendly language. We are looking for someone who enjoys helping people as much as writing code.

Scope of Services

With support and code review from senior engineers, the contractor will help with:

• User support by phone — take calls from borrowers, loan officers, processors and partners; troubleshoot their issues live; document what you learn; and follow up until the issue is resolved.

• Backend — implement and maintain APIs, business logic and integrations in Java 21 / Spring Boot; learn to update underwriting and business rules in Drools.

• Front end — build and improve TypeScript front-end features and fix UI bugs.

• Data — write PostgreSQL queries and simple migrations (Spring Data JPA, Liquibase).

• Integrations — help connect internal and external services via REST APIs and webhooks; keep OpenAPI specs up to date.

• Async & workflow — monitor background jobs and scheduled processes (JobRunR) and help investigate failed jobs.

• Platform features — contribute to document storage (S3), email and PDF generation, and SMS (Twilio) features.

• Reliability — investigate and fix bugs reported by users, turning support calls into clear, reproducible tickets.

• Delivery — write clean, tested, documented code; take part in code reviews and releases; and share progress, questions and blockers early.

Required Experience

• 1–2 years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent through internships, bootcamps or substantial personal projects.

• Excellent communication skills, including confidence supporting users over the phone — patient, clear and friendly with non-technical people, and able to explain technical issues in simple terms.

• Strong written and spoken English.

• Working knowledge of Java (Spring Boot exposure is a plus).

• Familiarity with SQL and relational databases such as PostgreSQL.

• Some experience with TypeScript or JavaScript front-end development.

• Basic understanding of REST APIs and how authentication works.

• Comfort with Git and an interest in automated testing.

• Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

• Eagerness to learn, accept feedback, and grow within an existing codebase.

• Reliability and accountability: you follow through on what you commit to and keep your team informed.

Nice to Have

• Previous experience in customer support, help desk, technical support or any client-facing role.

• Spring Boot 3, Spring Data JPA, Liquibase or Lombok.

• Exposure to background job frameworks (JobRunR or similar) or rules engines (Drools or similar).

• AWS basics (S3), Docker or CI/CD pipelines.

• Twilio, PDF generation or email templating (Thymeleaf).

• Interest in fintech, lending or regulated industries.

• Spanish or Portuguese in addition to English.

• A GitHub profile or portfolio showing projects you've built.

Working Arrangement

This is a fully remote independent contractor engagement. The contractor sets their own schedule, methods and location, and provides their own equipment, workspace, reliable internet and a quiet setting suitable for phone calls with users.

The contractor should generally be reachable during a window overlapping U.S. Eastern Time business hours. This is when users call for support and when planning, code reviews and team discussions happen; it is not a mandated schedule or minimum-hours requirement.

Engagement Terms

This is an independent contractor engagement, not employment. The contractor is responsible for their own taxes, social contributions, insurance and any registrations required in their jurisdiction, and is not entitled to employee benefits.

Service fees will be based on experience, technical ability and communication skills. Fee structure, invoicing, engagement term and other commercial terms will be discussed during the selection process. The contractor is free to provide services to other clients; exclusivity is not required.

Selection Process

Interested providers should submit a current résumé, along with any work samples or links (GitHub, portfolio) where available.

• Initial HR conversation, including an assessment of spoken English and communication style.

• Short practical technical exercise.

• Support role-play: a simulated phone call with a user reporting a platform issue.

• Conversation with our technical leadership.

• Final conversation on culture, scope and terms.

We'll share details on each step as you move through the process.

Be Part of Our Growth Story

LoanBud is building a better way for entrepreneurs to access capital, and technology is central to that effort. This engagement is a chance to grow your engineering career on a real fintech platform while directly helping the people who use it — borrowers, partners and lenders.

We're looking for someone who communicates clearly, cares about users, and is eager to learn and follow through. Our mission is to empower entrepreneurs to gain access to capital.

• Strong communicator—able to explain risk in terms both engineers and leaders understand, and to align multiple teams to get fixes done.

At Workwize , we’re helping IT teams to easily equip their remote and global teams with all necessary IT equipment. Our automated SaaS platform simplifies hardware deployment, management, and retrieval with fast, reliable deliveries in 100+ countries.
With 50.000 users and 120.000 devices under management, we’re solving hybrid work challenges like laptop deliveries, returns and equipment tracking, allowing IT teams to focus less on manual hassles and more on strategic initiatives.
Join our team to help shape the future of global collaboration. At Workwize , your work will make a real impact in building smarter, more connected workplaces worldwide.
LinkedIn has also recognized Workwize as one of the Top 10 Startups for 2025 in the Netherlands!

About the Role
As a Forward Deployed Engineer you work directly with our most important clients and build what they need on our platform: integrations, workflows and product features that make their IT run itself.
This is a brand new team, set up like a startup inside Workwize . It exists for two reasons. New clients should go live in weeks, not months. And our clients should get an engineer who knows their setup and fixes things fast.
Nobody hands you tasks. There is no product manager writing specs for you. You talk to the client, decide with them what is worth building, build it, ship it, and check with real numbers that it made a difference.
Think of work like this: connecting a client’s HRIS (Personio, BambooHR, Workday) so every new hire gets the right laptop on day one, syncing devices with Intune or Jamf, or automating approvals through Okta or Entra ID. To be clear: this is not a machine learning or AI research role. You use AI tools every day to move fast.

How the work runs

• Discover. Get deep into the client’s IT world: goals, processes, tech environment, governance, and adoption blockers.

• Design. Turn that into engineering solutions: what Workwize owns, what integrates, and how it becomes a durable layer that makes IT simple.

• Deliver. Stay hands-on through onboarding, building, launching and iterating until it is live and the value is real.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead discovery and scoping calls with new and enterprise clients yourself. Agree what “done” looks like and keep everyone updated.

• Decide what gets built. Turn messy requests from calls, Slack and email into small, clear tickets with a measure of success on each.

• Build and ship production-quality code in our product. Not demos, not side forks.

• Say no, or “not yet”, when a request does not bring enough value, and propose the quickest version that solves the real problem.

• Track the impact of your work: faster go-lives, more orders and usage on the platform, fewer support tickets, happier clients.

• Work closely with Onboarding, Customer Success, Operations, Sales and the product teams.

What success looks like in your first 90 days

• You have taken at least one enterprise client live, faster than our current onboarding.

• You have shipped one reusable integration or workflow that more than one client uses.

• You can show the numbers: time to go-live, tickets avoided, or usage gained.

Required Skills & Experience

• Around 4+ years of building and shipping software that real users depend on. You code at the level of a strong product engineer and work across the stack: web apps, APIs and integrations.

• You have led client calls yourself, scoped the work and pushed back when needed. Not through a product manager or account manager.

• You have decided what to build, not only how to build it, and you can explain the business value with a number.

• You use AI across your whole workflow, from discovery and specs to building and review. You know which tool and model you use for what, and when to check the output yourself.

• Fluent English, spoken and written.

Bonus Skills

• Integrations with IT, device management, identity or HR tools such as Intune, Jamf, Okta, Entra ID or an HRIS.

• Experience at an agency, an early-stage startup, or running your own company, where you did a lot with a small team.

• Experience with enterprise clients, and an understanding of how decisions get made (and blocked) inside large organisations.

The Right Mindset

• Pragmatic and fast.

• You think like an entrepreneur and care about the outcome for the client, not the ticket.

• You lead yourself. Clients trust you to run their project.

• You get energy from being on calls and in the room with clients, then going back to build.

• You communicate clearly and directly.

Location & Travel
This role is fully remote for candidates based in Latin America (for example Argentina, Colombia, Brazil, Mexico or Chile) who work during US business hours and speak excellent English. You will mainly support our US clients, working closely with the team in Amsterdam and New York. You might travel to clients once or twice a year.

Workwize Offers

• Flexible hybrid or remote work environment.

• Top-notch tools and equipment provided.

• Vibrant, entrepreneurial culture with opportunities for growth.

• Off-sites and multi-yearly team bonding events.

• Team lunches and surprise events to keep things fun.

• ClassPass corporate membership.

Our Team
Becoming part of Workwize means making an impact. We make sure that we contribute to changing the way of working. For us it is also important that we make an impact on our employees, that they feel challenged and at ease. We consist of a rapidly growing and ambitious team with all different backgrounds. Entrepreneurs, Operational specialists, Developers, Sales gurus — you can find them all at Workwize . We are always on the look-out for the next original ideas to reach more customers and create the best value.
We are looking forward to meeting you and discovering if there is a match with the Workwize team!

Buscamos un ingeniero DevOps con experiencia en Google Cloud para colaborar en la implementación de una plataforma de evaluación educativa para un ministerio de educación nacional en América Latina. Se trata de tecnología moderna: un stack basado en Groovy/Grails/Java (con una antigüedad no mayor a 6 años) y Kubernetes sobre AWS.

Requisitos (indispensables)

• Licenciatura en un área relacionada con TI
- Hablante nativo de español
- Nivel de inglés mínimo B1 (nuestro equipo se encuentra en Argentina, México, Venezuela, EE. UU. y Polonia; el inglés es el idioma común)

El resto de los puestos ya están cubiertos por el equipo actual, pero necesitamos un nuevo experto en DevOps con experiencia en Google. Esta persona trabajará junto a nuestro responsable de DevOps —quien gestiona el entorno en AWS— para realizar la transición hacia Google.

Nice to Have

•
Hands-on experience with Datadog.

• Background working with IoT or real-time device data pipelines.

• Prior experience in a fast-paced startup or healthtech environment.

Additional Engagement Details

• Time Zone Alignment: Must be able to overlap with U.S. Central Time (CT / Arkansas).

postings.title: Research Analyst - Qual/Quant - AllSet
postings.descriptionText:
Research Analyst

Organisation: ALLSET

Location: Remote

Reporting to: Research Lead
Contract: 1-year contract (3 days/week) with a 3-month probation period

ALLSET is a climate preparedness research centre focused on how trust, moral values, and everyday life shape the way communities interpret, respond and recover from extreme weather events. Its focus is on applied research in climate-exacerbated disaster areas. The team has started projects in Northern Sumatra (Indonesia), Rio Grande do Sul (Brazil), El Salvador, Guatemala and Honduras (Central America), France and Greece (Southern Europe) and the Caribbean.
VISION A world where extreme weather events are well understood by the communities who experience them and people have agency over the solutions that address them
MISSION To conduct research focused on the lived experience of extreme weather events and draw upon these lessons to improve preparedness and adaptation efforts, as well as broader education and advocacy opportunities for climate change mitigation.

What we aim to do
ALLSET works with communities affected by extreme weather to understand how people experience disasters, navigate uncertainty and rebuild their lives. We examine how decisions are made under pressure, how local knowledge and trusted relationships shape responses, and how social, cultural and material conditions influence people's ability to prepare, cope and recover.
Our research follows human response across the disaster cycle, from anticipation and immediate action to long-term recovery and adaptation. Using ethically rigorous, trauma-informed and culturally grounded methods, we bring together place-based inquiry, cross-context comparison and longitudinal learning to understand how experiences and behaviours evolve over time.
ONE, ALLSET develops evidence on the human dimensions of extreme weather. We investigate how risk is understood, how people mobilise resources and support, and how formal systems are experienced in everyday life. This reveals the factors that enable or constrain individual and collective capacity, complementing technical and institutional assessments with insights grounded in lived reality.
TWO, we connect this evidence with the organisations and networks that shape disaster response, including public institutions, humanitarian organisations, researchers, civil society, funders and community leaders. Through these relationships, we translate research into insights that can inform policy, practice, investment and public engagement, helping decision-makers design responses that are more responsive to the realities of the people they serve.
Allset is seeking an experienced and driven Research Associate to conduct analysis of human-centered data in the context of extreme weather events.
The Research Associate will strengthen ALLSET’s analytical and research capacity, supporting the rigorous analysis, synthesis and communication of findings across multiple geographies. The role will work closely with the Research Lead to process and interpret large volumes of qualitative and quantitative data, ensuring consistency, methodological rigour and analytical depth across regions.
Research Analysis & Synthesis: The Research Associate will lead and support the analysis and synthesis of incoming qualitative and quantitative data, working alongside the Research Lead to identify patterns, interpret findings and draw connections across contexts. This includes strengthening analytical consistency across regional datasets.
Content, Quality & Storytelling: The role will support the review and quality assurance of regional reports and other research outputs, ensuring findings are accurately represented, analytically coherent and communicated clearly. It will also help translate complex research into compelling narratives suited to different audiences, including researchers, practitioners and decision-makers.
Academic & External Outputs: The Research Associate may contribute to the development of higher-level research outputs, including co-authored academic papers, working papers and other publications.

Key responsibilities

• Translate practitioner and organisational needs into clear, feasible, and ethically robust research questions and designs.

• Oversee qualitative and quantitative analysis to generate clear, relevant, and actionable insights, in collaboration with Research Lead and Project Leads

• Synthesise complex evidence into concise narratives tailored to technical and non-technical audiences.

• Establish and continuously improve research processes, standards, and ethical protocols across projects

Profile we are looking for

• 6-8+ years of experience conducting applied social research

• Strong grounding in both qualitative and quantitative research analysis, and interpretation.

• Experience managing and working with external research agencies or partners for data collection.

• Strong ethical awareness and a demonstrated commitment to responsible research practice.

• Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex research clearly to diverse audiences.

• Interest in new and emerging research methodologies and approaches.

•
Fluency in English

• PhD or commensurate experience in a relevant field.

postings.descriptionText:
Applications can come from any country in the world, and are not limited to geographies with B Lab or Sistema B offices.

The Strategy and Learning team at B Lab is committed to advancing research on B Corps and the B Corp movement. Following two successful rounds, we’re now seeking two to three new Research Fellows to join the program’s third cohort. These fellows will receive in kind support to explore their research questions using the full datasets B Lab has available, subject to necessary data protection steps and measures (see more on this below).

How to apply

In this call, B Lab is inviting scholars to submit a two-page proposal via this application portal explaining the questions they would like to explore using the wide range of B Lab data.

Including a resume is optional. Applications missing a proposal as outlined above will not be considered.

Number of fellowship openings

We’re looking to host 2-3 fellows from diverse geographies.

About B Lab B Lab ™ is the nonprofit behind Certified B Corporations™, a community of businesses that meet verified social, environmental, and governance standards. Together, our movement is working towards a more inclusive, equitable, and fair economic system.

Our history B Lab began in 2006 with the idea that a different kind of economy was not only possible — it was necessary. Our founders Andrew Kassoy, Bart Houlahan, and Jay Coen Gilbert believed there was a better way to do business: better for workers, better for communities, and better for the planet. When our movement’s first 81 Founding B Corps signed the Declaration of Interdependence in 2007, they were not just proposing a better way of doing business. They were proposing a different definition altogether.

What we’ve achieved B Lab became known for certifying B Corporations™, companies that meet verified standards of social and environmental performance, accountability, and transparency.
