For details of the vacancy in English, please click here.
Buscamos contratar a profesionales especializados en desarrollo de audiencias para brindar acompañamiento estratégico y práctico a medios de comunicación independientes que operan en entornos restrictivos en América Latina. Las consultorías tienen como objetivo fortalecer las capacidades de estos medios para producir contenidos accesibles y atractivos, adaptar su producción editorial a formatos multimedia y desarrollar estrategias que permitan ampliar su alcance, visibilidad y conexión con las audiencias.
Buscamos contratar a profesionales con experiencia en una o más de tres áreas de especialización. Cada consultor/a trabajará con los equipos editoriales de los medios asignados, mediante sesiones periódicas de asesoría y acompañamiento práctico, para diagnosticar sus necesidades, diseñar un plan de trabajo adaptado a sus objetivos y apoyar su implementación. El trabajo se centrará en una o varias de las siguientes áreas, según la experiencia y especialización del/de la consultor/a:

• Desarrollo de contenidos explicativos y visibilidad mediante IA: Ayudar a los medios de comunicación a integrar la producción de contenidos explicativos atractivos y accesibles en sus flujos de trabajo editoriales, utilizando formatos de texto y multimedia para facilitar la comprensión de temas complejos y atraer y captar la atención de un público más amplio. Este enfoque también debería sentar las bases para mejorar la visibilidad de su periodismo a través de búsquedas impulsadas por IA y modelos de lenguaje a gran escala (LLM), garantizando que los contenidos se desarrollen teniendo en cuenta estos nuevos hábitos de consumo de información.

• Producción de vídeos para redes sociales: Ayudar a los medios de comunicación a adaptar artículos de actualidad e investigaciones en profundidad a vídeos atractivos y accesibles para el público en las redes sociales, ofreciendo orientación sobre la selección de temas, la narración visual, la producción de vídeo y la edición para ampliar el alcance y el impacto de su periodismo.

• Desarrollo de la audiencia en WhatsApp: Apoyar a los medios de comunicación en el diseño y la implementación de estrategias para aumentar el número de suscriptores y reforzar la participación de la audiencia a través de los canales de información de WhatsApp, lo que incluye definir las audiencias objetivo, las estrategias de contenido, los objetivos de crecimiento y los flujos de trabajo de distribución, así como desarrollar campañas promocionales en otras plataformas, como sitios web y redes sociales, para impulsar las suscripciones y ampliar el alcance.

Cada candidato deberá identificar claramente su área principal de especialización en su solicitud y podrá indicar áreas adicionales en las que haya demostrado experiencia de cara a futuras oportunidades.
Además de prestar apoyo en las áreas mencionadas anteriormente, los consultores también revisarán los materiales elaborados por los equipos editoriales, ofrecerán recomendaciones prácticas adaptadas a sus recursos y colaborarán en la evaluación de las respuestas de la audiencia y las métricas disponibles. Esta labor incluirá la definición de objetivos y el seguimiento de indicadores para perfeccionar el contenido y la distribución, documentar los avances y reforzar las capacidades de los equipos.
Todo el apoyo debe respetar la independencia editorial de los medios de comunicación participantes y cumplir estrictamente con los protocolos de seguridad establecidos por el IWPR.
El consultor deberá mantener una coordinación continua con el IWPR a lo largo de la consultoría y demostrar flexibilidad a la hora de trabajar a distancia con equipos que puedan enfrentarse a limitaciones de conectividad u operar en contextos difíciles.

Alcance de la consultoría:

• Brindar asesoría remota y personalizada en desarrollo de audiencias a equipos de medios independientes que operan en entornos restrictivos de América Latina durante el período de implementación del proyecto.

• Acompañar el diagnóstico, diseño e implementación de un plan de trabajo adaptado al contexto, los recursos y las necesidades de cada medio, según el área de especialidad del/de la consultor/a: explainers, producción multimedia o estrategias de WhatsApp y distribución de contenidos.

• Fortalecer las capacidades de los equipos para explicar temas complejos de manera accesible, adaptar artículos y reportajes a formatos audiovisuales o desarrollar canales de distribución que permitan ampliar y fortalecer la relación con sus audiencias.

• Orientar la definición de públicos, objetivos, indicadores y herramientas de seguimiento que permitan evaluar los resultados y ajustar los contenidos y las estrategias de distribución.

• Aplicar una metodología práctica y orientada a resultados, basada en el acompañamiento continuo, recomendaciones que los equipos puedan implementar con sus recursos y la documentación de avances y productos.

• Garantizar el cumplimiento de los protocolos de seguridad y los requisitos de reporte establecidos por IWPR, respetando la independencia editorial de los medios participantes.

Funciones:

• Cada postulante debe indicar cuál es su área de experiencia demostrable (explainers, multimedia o estratega de Whatsapp).

• Realizar un diagnóstico de las necesidades del medio en el área de especialidad y acordar un plan de trabajo con objetivos e indicadores de seguimiento.

• Brindar sesiones remotas de asesoría, revisar los materiales elaborados por la redacción y entregar recomendaciones prácticas que el equipo pueda aplicar con sus recursos.

• Acompañar la implementación y revisar las respuestas de la audiencia y las métricas disponibles para ajustar contenidos o distribución.

• Coordinar con IWPR, documentar avances y aplicar los protocolos de seguridad del proyecto, respetando la independencia editorial del medio.

Entregables:
Minutas de las reuniones con los medios, informes escritos sobre los avances logrados por cada equipo, las actividades planificadas y, cuando corresponda, recomendaciones estratégicas, utilizando la plantilla proporcionada por IWPR.

CUALIFICACIONES Y EXPERIENCIA REQUERIDAS

• Licenciatura en periodismo, gestión de comunidades o áreas afines y/o MBA, o acreditación de al menos tres años de experiencia comprobada en la materia.

• Amplia experiencia en estrategias de audiencia para medios de comunicación en la zona designada (mínimo tres años).

• Experiencia en el diseño y la facilitación de talleres.

• Amplio conocimiento del entorno de los medios digitales en América Latina y el Caribe.

• Disponibilidad horaria flexible para coordinar reuniones, mentorías y talleres con beneficiarios en diferentes zonas horarias.

• Dominio pleno del español.

• Capacidad para comunicar información compleja de manera clara a diferentes públicos.

• Sensibilidad cultural y capacidad demostrada para trabajar y adaptarse a diversas culturas.

• Ética profesional.

Para presentar tu candidatura:
Envía tu currículum y una carta de presentación en la que indiques a qué especialidad de consultoría te postulas y destaques tus habilidades y experiencia relevantes en ese ámbito.
Fecha límite: 30 de noviembre de 2026. Las solicitudes se revisarán de forma continua y el IWPR se reserva el derecho de cubrir el puesto antes de la fecha límite; por ello, se recomienda encarecidamente enviar la solicitud lo antes posible, ya que las entrevistas podrían realizarse antes de dicha fecha.
Tenga en cuenta que solo se contactará a las personas que sean consideradas para una entrevista.
IWPR is an equal opportunities employer and positively encourages applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of sex, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, religion or belief, marital status, veteran status or pregnancy and maternity.
IWPR will never ask for payment for recruitment.

We're a small team (seed stage, $3M+ raised), headquartered in New York with customers around the world. We care deeply about the craft. We sweat the details operators feel every day, we ship fast, and we use AI in everything we do because it lets a small team build something great.

postings.title: Host Account Manager (Offshore)
postings.descriptionText:
The Role We Need

PadSplit is hiring a Host Account Manager to serve as the dedicated strategic partner and primary point of contact for a portfolio of PadSplit hosts. This is a newly created role at the heart of our Host Success model, designed to shift how we support all hosts from reactive problem-solving to proactive, relationship-driven account management.

You will own the full host relationship from activation through long-term retention. But owning the relationship means more than managing check-ins and reviewing dashboards. It means being atrusted partner and the person your hosts call when something goes wrong, someone who knows the platform, the policies, and the fee structures well enough to provide clear answers on the spot. You will be measured on the outcomes that matter most: your response times, occupancy performance, host satisfaction, churn reduction, and portfolio retention.

This role is critical to ensuring every host in your book of business has what they need to thrive on the platform, and that they feel it.

The Person We Are Looking For

We are looking for a relationship-first operator who leads with data, follows through with hustle, and knows the product, policies, and PadSplit member outcomes well enough to earn a host’s trust in the first conversation. You are proactive by nature, the kind of person who spots a problem in a dashboard before a host ever has to call about it. You are also comfortable in the reactive moments: a confused host on the phone about a payout deduction, a complex situation involving a member that requires judgment and empathy in equal measure, a policy question that does not have a clean answer. You handle those moments with the same professionalism you bring to your scheduled portfolio reviews.

You understand that being a trusted partner requires genuine knowledge. You do not escalate everything, and you do not guess. You build the platform and policy fluency to be the person who actually resolves the issue, and you know when escalation is the right call.

You believe in PadSplit ’s mission and understand what it means to work in the affordable housing space, where the stakes for both hosts and members are real.

Here’s What You’ll Do Day-to-Day

ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT AND RELATIONSHIP OWNERSHIP
• Own and manage a dedicated portfolio of PadSplit hosts, serving as their primary named point of contact for support ticket escalation and resolution, policy adherence and understanding, and overall portfolio direction

• Provide the right information at the right time,becoming a partner and strategic advisor of PadSplit

• Build proactive, trust-based relationships that reduce churn and increase host lifetime value.

• Conduct regular performance check-ins, including structured reviews aligned to host goals and PadSplit benchmarks.

• Drive host accountability on key metrics including attainable occupancy, bookability flags, rejection rates, move-in ratings, and member retention.

• Partner with hosts on portfolio growth, including conversations about adding new properties and expanding their PadSplit footprint.

• Serve as the host’s internal advocate, surfacing feedback and trends to product, operations, and leadership.
PLATFORM, POLICY, AND FINANCIAL FLUENCY

• Maintain deep working knowledge of PadSplit ’s platform, fee structures, payout mechanics, and host-facing policies, with the ability to explain decisions clearly and confidently.

• Serve as a knowledgeable, trusted point of contact for hosts navigating financial questions, policy inquiries, and operational challenges.

• Apply PadSplit policies thoughtfully, explaining both the “what” and the “why” in a way that builds understanding and trust rather than resentment.

• Guide hosts on pricing strategy, occupancy optimization, listing quality, rejection rate management, and platform best practices using both data and platform knowledge.

• Monitor host and property performance using PadSplit ’s data tools, identifying risks and opportunities before they become problems.

NEW HOST ACTIVATION

• Lead an intro call for every new host in your portfolio, establishing the relationship and setting expectations from day one.

• Guide new hosts from the beginning, covering pricing, room standards, rejection rate drivers, and mission-critical success requirements.

• Prepare hosts for their first members: responsiveness standards, room readiness expectations, and move-in experience requirements.

• Educate new hosts on member outcome drivers including safety compliance, pricing discipline, and platform behaviors that directly improve member, host and company outcomes.

ISSUE RESOLUTION AND ESCALATION

• Navigate complex, nuanced host situations that require investigation, sound judgment, and fair resolution.

• Escalate and coordinate resolution of issues that require cross-functional support, working with member support, trust and safety, payments, and legal teams where appropriate.

• Manage emotionally charged conversations with empathy, composure, and directness, holding firm on policy while maintaining the relationship.

• Document ticket details and resolutions accurately, maintaining clear records across all host interactions.

• Identify patterns in host concerns and flag systemic issues to inform process, policy, or product improvements.

TEAM AND PROGRAM DEVELOPMENT

• Contribute to the development of scalable playbooks, talk tracks, macro responses, and best practices as this function matures.

• Participate in weekly team syncs to share what is working, surface friction points, and iterate on the program in real time.

Here’s What You’ll Need to Be Successful

•
Account Management or Customer Success Background: 3+ years of account management, customer success, or high-touch client relationship experience. Background in real estate, property management, hospitality, or a platform-based marketplace is strongly preferred.

•
Platform and Policy Fluency: Ability and willingness to develop deep working knowledge of PadSplit ’s product, fee structures, and policies, and to use that knowledge in live host conversations.

•
Proactive Portfolio Management: Proven ability to manage a large book of relationships with a proactive, not reactive, approach. You spot the problem before the host calls.

•
Data-Driven Communication: Comfortable using data to tell a story and drive a conversation. You can translate performance metrics into clear, actionable guidance a host can act on today.

•
Critical Thinking and Sound Judgment: Ability to analyze incomplete or conflicting information, apply policies thoughtfully in nuanced scenarios, and arrive at fair, defensible decisions.

•
Empathetic Directness: Skill in balancing compassion with clarity, especially when delivering difficult or unpopular outcomes. You hold firm on policy while making the host feel heard.

•
Strong Communication: Clear, confident written and verbal communication tailored to diverse audiences. You build trust quickly and handle difficult conversations without escalating unnecessarily.

•
Organization and Follow-Through: Highly organized with the ability to prioritize across a large portfolio without dropping the ball on high-value or high-risk relationships.

•
Mission Alignment: Genuine belief in PadSplit ’s mission and an understanding of what it means to operate in the affordable housing space.

•
Growth Mindset: Motivated by the idea of building something new and improving it as you go. This function is being built from the ground up and you will help shape it.

The Interview Process:

• Your application will be reviewed for possible next steps by a real human being from the PeopleOps team.

• If you meet eligibility requirements, the next step would be a video interview with a member of the PeopleOps team for about thirty (30) minutes.

• If warranted, the next stage is a video interview and meeting with our Senior Host Experience Manager for about forty-five (45) minutes, where the candidate will participate in a live case interview.

• If warranted, the final step would be a video interview with our Regional Host Experience Manager for thirty minutes (30)

• If warranted, we move to an offer!

Notice to Applicants:

PadSplit participates in E-Verify. All new employees are required to complete an I-9 form and be authorized to work in the United States. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of the E-Verify process.
PadSplit is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca 's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

About the Role:
Alpaca is building a differentiated position in primary markets: connecting issuers and lead underwriters to high-quality global retail demand through our brokerage infrastructure and broker-dealer partner network; Equity Capital Markets is a strategic growth engine for Alpaca .

We're looking for a Director, Equity Capital Markets to own Alpaca 's ECM franchise: win issuer-selected allocations, deepen relationships with syndicate and ECM desks at major underwriters, and originate the next wave of investment banking opportunities across IPOs, follow-ons, and other primary offerings.
This person will operate at the intersection of capital markets, issuer coverage, and distribution strategy. You will package Alpaca 's global retail reach—especially international and partner-driven demand—into a proposition that issuers and banks choose for retail tranches. You will run live-deal execution end to end, from selling-group readiness through allocation quality and post-deal reporting, while building a durable pipeline of future IB opportunities for Alpaca .
This is not a pure coverage or relationship role. You're building Alpaca 's seat at the syndicate table and turning distribution into repeatable primary-market wins that compound into broader investment banking relationships.

What you'll do:

• Build and own senior relationships with issuers, sponsors, CFOs, IR teams, and bankers to get Alpaca into retail-platform selection processes, data packs, and management conversations—securing meaningful allocations.

• Develop and deepen coverage of lead underwriters and ECM / syndicate desks across bulge-bracket and select boutique banks; drive selling-group / select-dealer agreements from introduction through execution and operational readiness

• Position Alpaca 's distribution story—global retail reach, broker-dealer partner network, geo / demographic targeting, customer quality, and anti-flipping controls—so issuers and banks prefer Alpaca for retail participation

• Originate and grow future investment banking opportunities for Alpaca across IPOs, follow-ons, and related primary offerings, with focus on retail-friendly and high-conviction sectors

• Run live-deal execution: qualify offerings, mobilize partner and end-client demand, coordinate legal / selling restrictions and jurisdictional readiness, manage IOI / order flow, and deliver clean post-deal reporting

• Build a repeatable ECM operating rhythm—pipeline reviews, banker coverage maps, issuer outreach cadence, and deal retrospectives—that scales with deal volume

• Partner closely with Legal, Compliance, Product, Brokerage Ops, Partnerships, and Finance to keep Alpaca deal-ready across agreements, marketing materials, restricted jurisdictions, and allocation methodology

• Represent Alpaca in issuer pitches, banker meetings, exchange / PE channels, and industry conferences; convert introductions into active coverage and signed pathways to allocation

• Define and track ECM success metrics: issuer pitches and data-pack inclusions, signed selling-group relationships, allocation volume and quality, partner / geo coverage per deal, flipping outcomes, and repeat issuer / bank engagement

• Manage and grow the ECM franchise over time, including prioritization of bank coverage, sector focus, and the roadmap from retail distribution into broader IB opportunity capture

What we're looking for:

• 3+ years in equity capital markets, syndicate, equity capital markets origination, or adjacent investment banking / primary markets roles, with clear ownership of issuer and underwriter relationships

• Proven track record securing allocations and influencing issuer/sponsor selection for retail or distribution partners—ideally across IPOs and other equity offerings

• Existing senior relationships with ECM / syndicate desks at major underwriters and comfort operating in selling-group / select-dealer constructs

• Strong issuer coverage instincts: you know how to get into the room with CFOs, IR, sponsors, and bankers, and you can win on substance, not just introductions

• Deep fluency in how retail tranches, allocation decisions, and syndicate processes actually work—and the judgment to navigate high-demand deals where issuer outreach is required

• An exceptional operator who can build the playbook: agreements, materials, deal process, partner mobilization, and post-deal feedback loops

• Clear communicator who can package a differentiated distribution narrative for issuers and banks, align internal stakeholders, and close loops quickly in live deals

• Comfortable collaborating remotely in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment while showing up for high-stakes in-person issuer and banker meetings when it matters

Preferred:

• Experience placing or distributing international / non-US retail demand into US or global equity offerings

• Prior work with broker-dealer networks, introducing brokers, or platform distribution in primary markets

• Background spanning both sell-side ECM / syndicate and buy-side or platform distribution perspectives

• Existing relationships across AI, consumer, or other retail-friendly IPO pipelines, and familiarity with exchange / PE origination channels

• Experience standing up a new ECM or primary-markets function inside a high-growth fintech or brokerage platform

What Success Looks Like:

•
Alpaca is consistently included in issuer retail-platform evaluations and wins meaningful allocations on priority deals

• Selling-group / select-dealer relationships with key lead underwriters are signed, operational, and actively used

• A growing pipeline of investment banking opportunities—beyond one-off IPO participation—is originated and advanced for Alpaca

• Live deals run cleanly: partner demand is mobilized, legal / jurisdictional readiness is never the blocker, and post-deal reporting reinforces Alpaca 's quality to issuers and banks

• Issuers and underwriters return to Alpaca because distribution quality, allocation outcomes, and coverage reliability compound over time

How We Take Care of You:

• Competitive Salary & Stock Options

• Health Benefits

• New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500

• Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

postings.descriptionText:
Senior Product Engineer, LeadConduit

Company Overview
ActiveProspect is on a mission to make consent-based marketing the best channel for online customer acquisition. We provide marketers the products they need to acquire qualified customers at scale. Our platform is trusted by thousands of companies engaged in direct-to-consumer marketing, helping them save wasted spend, comply with ever-changing regulations, and manage a constantly evolving partner landscape.
Our flagship product, TrustedForm, is used to certify over 1 billion opt-in digital customer leads every year and is the gold standard for documenting prior express written consent for TCPA compliance. LeadConduit, our real-time lead processing and routing platform, connects lead sellers and buyers and checks consent, data quality, and delivery rules on every lead.

Job Summary
You own customer and business outcomes, not tickets. You work like a forward-deployed engineer: you belong to the LeadConduit team, and you contribute to projects, initiatives, and pods where the problem is, deliver your work across the full stack (Vue/Nuxt and React/Next.js on the frontend, Node.js and TypeScript services on AWS), and improve processes for delivery in future projects. The technical bar is high, but coding ability is only the starting point. What sets this role apart is judgment: knowing the smallest thing worth shipping, when to drop your own idea, and when AI output is good enough versus when to override it. On LeadConduit, that work splits evenly between two areas: keeping today's platform fast and reliable for the customers who run their business on it, and building the next-generation platform, including a new real-time engine for ping/post, call tracking, and buyer optimization.
You'll move between the LeadConduit team and the initiatives you deploy into, shipping early, talking to customers, and deciding fast.

Responsibilities

• Own outcomes end-to-end, wherever you're assigned. Frame the problem, design it, ship it, own the metric. Distill to the cheapest version that works. Prototype in days.

• Work across today's LeadConduit and the next-generation platform. Improve the current product (flows, integrations, reporting) and help build the new real-time engine (field mapping, ping/post, call tracking, buyer optimization).

• Stay close to customers. Shadow sales and support, talk with lead buyers and sellers, join advisory conversations, and let customer reality drive technical decisions. Propose what to build, defer, and drop.

• Own your domain and share it. Its interfaces, reliability, performance, and security, including on-call for the systems you own. Consent, TCPA compliance, and PII handling are central to customer trust. Bring patterns, tooling, and hard-won context back to the wider org rather than hoarding them.

• Build and scale both the product surface and the platform beneath it. Ship responsive, accessible interfaces with a strong UI/UX eye (Vue/Nuxt today, React/Next.js for the new platform), back them with Node.js and TypeScript services and APIs, and keep the real-time, multi-tenant lead and call processing engine reliable and fast as volume grows.

• Architect AI-driven leverage. Build AI-assisted workflows that hold up, evolve the team's practices as tooling changes (Cursor, Claude Code, and whatever comes next), and look for product wins AI unlocks (smarter routing, anomaly detection on lead flow, AI-built integrations, and more).

• Make every team you work with stronger. Mentor on judgment and product sense, not just syntax. Write decision memos and ADRs. Enable Product and Design to self-serve.

Qualifications and Skills

• A track record of shipping something end-to-end that you cared about and owning the outcome, not just the code.

• Product judgment: pushing back on a bad spec, proposing the cheapest experiment, descoping, and collaborating with Product to suggest solutions rather than waiting for a fully specified ticket.

• Comfort embedding with unfamiliar teams and codebases, getting productive fast, and leaving them better than you found them.

postings.title: Asesoramiento en monetización (YouTube y otras redes sociales)
postings.descriptionText:
El Institute for War & Peace Reporting (IWPR) es una organización independiente sin fines de lucro que trabaja para empoderar a las voces locales en primera línea, promoviendo cambios positivos en contextos de conflicto, crisis o transición en todo el mundo. Desde hace más de 30 años, IWPR fomenta el acceso a información confiable y el debate público para contribuir a la construcción de sociedades más estables, justas e inclusivas.
El Institute for War and Peace Reporting (IWPR) busca contratar un/a consultor/a especializado/a en monetización de plataformas digitales, con énfasis en YouTube, para brindar asesoría a medios independientes que operan en entornos restrictivos de América Latina. La consultoría se centrará en fortalecer las capacidades de estos medios para desarrollar e implementar estrategias que les permitan generar y aumentar sus ingresos en dichas plataformas, de acuerdo con su contexto, sus recursos y sus prioridades editoriales.
El/la consultor/a prestará apoyo de asesoramiento continuo y personalizado a los medios de comunicación participantes para evaluar el potencial de monetización de sus canales digitales actuales, identificar oportunidades para generar y diversificar ingresos, y recomendar mejoras en las estrategias de contenido, la frecuencia de publicación y otras prácticas que puedan potenciar la monetización. A partir de estas evaluaciones, el consultor colaborará con cada medio para desarrollar y poner en práctica un plan de monetización a medida, destinado a aumentar los ingresos y reforzar la sostenibilidad financiera.
Asimismo, el/la consultor/a analizará el desempeño de los contenidos y ofrecerá recomendaciones prácticas para mejorar el alcance, la fidelización de la audiencia, la participación y el potencial de ingresos. Esta labor incluirá la definición de objetivos y el seguimiento de indicadores, el análisis de las métricas disponibles y el apoyo a la implementación de ajustes que contribuyan a la sostenibilidad financiera de cada medio.
La asesoría deberá considerar las políticas de monetización, los derechos de autor y las restricciones geográficas o de acceso a pagos que puedan afectar a los medios participantes. Las recomendaciones deberán adaptarse a estas condiciones y a las capacidades de cada equipo, respetando en todo momento su independencia editorial y cumpliendo estrictamente con los protocolos de seguridad establecidos por IWPR.
El/la consultor/a deberá mantener una coordinación permanente con IWPR durante toda la consultoría, documentar los avances y demostrar flexibilidad para trabajar de forma remota con equipos que pueden enfrentar limitaciones de conectividad o desenvolverse en contextos complejos.
Alcance de la consultoría:

• Brindar asesoría remota y personalizada en monetización de plataformas digitales, con énfasis en YouTube, a equipos de medios independientes que operan en entornos restrictivos de América Latina.

• Acompañar el diagnóstico, diseño e implementación de un plan de monetización adaptado al estado de los canales, el contexto, los recursos y las necesidades de cada medio.

• Fortalecer las capacidades de los equipos para gestionar sus canales, optimizar sus contenidos e identificar y aprovechar opciones de monetización que contribuyan a su sostenibilidad económica.

• Orientar la definición de objetivos, metas de ingresos, indicadores y herramientas de seguimiento que permitan evaluar los resultados y ajustar las estrategias de contenido y monetización.

• Aplicar una metodología práctica y orientada a resultados, basada en el acompañamiento continuo, recomendaciones que los equipos puedan implementar con sus recursos y la documentación de avances y productos.

• Garantizar el cumplimiento de los protocolos de seguridad y los requisitos de reporte establecidos por IWPR, respetando la independencia editorial de los medios participantes y considerando las políticas y restricciones aplicables a la monetización en cada plataforma.

Funciones:

• Realizar un diagnóstico de los canales (particularmente Youtube) y las capacidades de cada medio, identificar oportunidades y obstáculos para la monetización y acordar un plan de trabajo con objetivos, cronograma e indicadores de seguimiento.

• Asesorar sobre los requisitos de elegibilidad, las políticas y las opciones de monetización disponibles, considerando los derechos de autor y las restricciones geográficas o de acceso a pagos que puedan afectar a cada medio.

• Acompañar la implementación de las iniciativas de monetización y analizar las métricas de alcance, retención, tiempo de visualización e ingresos disponibles para identificar mejoras y orientar ajustes.

• Fortalecer las capacidades de los equipos para interpretar sus resultados y tomar decisiones que contribuyan a generar ingresos de manera sostenida, de acuerdo con sus recursos y prioridades editoriales.

• Coordinar con IWPR, documentar avances y aplicar los protocolos de seguridad del proyecto, respetando la independencia editorial de los medios participantes.

Entregables:
Minutas de las reuniones con los medios, informes escritos sobre los avances logrados por cada equipo, las actividades planificadas y, cuando corresponda, recomendaciones estratégicas, utilizando la plantilla proporcionada por IWPR.
Requisitos mínimos:

• Licenciatura en Periodismo, Comunicación, Marketing Digital, Administración de Empresas o áreas afines, o acreditación de al menos tres años de experiencia comprobada en monetización de plataformas digitales.

• Experiencia mínima de tres años en el diseño e implementación de estrategias de monetización de plataformas digitales, especialmente YouTube, con resultados demostrables en la generación o el crecimiento de ingresos.

• Conocimiento de las herramientas, los requisitos de elegibilidad y las políticas de monetización de YouTube, incluidos aspectos relacionados con derechos de autor, restricciones geográficas y acceso a pagos.

• Experiencia en el análisis de métricas de desempeño e ingresos y en la optimización de canales y contenidos para mejorar el alcance, la retención de audiencias y los resultados de monetización.

• Experiencia en la asesoría a equipos y en el diseño y la facilitación de talleres o mentorías, con capacidad para formular recomendaciones adaptadas a sus recursos.

• Disponibilidad horaria flexible para coordinar reuniones, mentorías y talleres de forma remota con equipos en diferentes zonas horarias.

• Dominio pleno de español e inglés.

• Sensibilidad cultural y capacidad demostrada para adaptar el acompañamiento a diversos contextos y necesidades.

• Ética profesional.

postings.title: Associate Director, Music Policy, Spotify for Artists
postings.descriptionText:
We’re looking for a leader to manage Spotify ’s Music Policy team, driving our strategy and execution for many of the most important issues facing the music industry for the next decade. As our Head of Music Policy, you will lead the team shaping the rules, standards, and incentives governing Spotify ’s music ecosystem, positively impacting millions of artists around the world.

The music policy team focuses on developing and implementing policies that further our mission to provide a fair and equitable opportunity for artists, songwriters, distributors, labels, and publishers on Spotify — as well as educating the music industry about our approach. The role requires a deep understanding of the music supply chain, and will work heavily in collaboration with our tech and product teams, as well as our artist partnerships team, to build and roll out policy solutions.

The scope of policies include how Spotify ’s $11 billion+ annual royalty pool is allocated; owning policy programs like Verified by Spotify , AI Persona labeling, AI Credits, and Music Spam Filter; tactics to remove incentives for bad actors and spammers; guardrails and rules for content providers around platform integrity and metadata; and strategies to future proof our platform for new trends or technologies in the music industry, like AI. In communicating these policies publicly, our focus is to educate artists and the music industry at scale, so everyone has equal access to information and resources.

In this role, you’ll work with a cross-functional team from Licensing, Marketing, Public Affairs, Product, Engineering, Trust & Safety, Music Partnerships, Music Economics, and more in leading policy initiatives for the Spotify for Artists team — from the strategy, development, and implementation of new policies, to public messaging and education, to industry advocacy and engagement.

What You'll Do

• Lead a high-performing team focused on building a better future for artists, songwriters, and the music industry on Spotify .

• Set and execute against a policy agenda for the team based on the biggest needs for artists, songwriters, music partners, listeners, and Spotify .

• Own strategy and execution around Spotify ’s music policy portfolio, including Verified by Spotify , AI Persona labeling, AI Credits, Music Spam Filter, Preferred Provider Program, and more.

• Develop and implement new policies that equitably impact the music ecosystem on topics like royalty administration, artificial streaming, new music technologies, music platform rules, and more.

• Partner closely with technical and operational teams on content policy — including platform integrity issues, metadata strategy, and music supply chain dynamics.

• Work hand-in-hand with product and engineering to implement technical solutions for our policy agenda.

• Craft clear, informative messaging about existing and new policies — and launch scaled educational initiatives to make sure artists, songwriters, distributors, and rights holders have accurate information about our platform.

• Collaborate with Music Partnerships and Licensing to understand the needs of all the stakeholders on our music platform, to advocate for and explain new policies, and to listen to and incorporate feedback.

• Partner with Data Science and Music Economics to deeply understand platform trends and the potential impact of various policy decisions.

Who You Are

• You have 10+ years of relevant experience in the music industry, policy, legal, or technology platforms.

• You have proven experience in the music industry, working with artists and creators, and with technology platforms. You have a deep understanding of the music supply chain.

• You’re a dedicated people leader, caring deeply about the health and growth of the people on your team.

• You have a deep passion for technology, love getting into the weeds of technical solutions, and have experience working closely with engineering

• You have passion for creating a more rewarding, fairer experience for artists and songwriters around the world. You love music.

• You’re comfortable diving deep into spreadsheets, talking to technical teams, mapping out complex incentive systems, and sweating the details.

• You’re a strong communicator and a strong listener — understanding when to influence others and when to incorporate smart feedback.

• You’re experienced at bringing cross-functional teams together in a shared vision.

Where You'll Be

• We are a distributed workforce enabling our band members to find a work mode best for them!

• Where in the world? For this role, it can be within the Americas region in which we have a work location

• Prefer an office to work from home instead? Not a problem! We have plenty of options for your working preferences. Find more information about our Work From Anywhere options here

• Working hours? We operate within the Eastern Standard time zone for collaboration, and you will be expected to work EST hours, no matter where you are located in the Americas region.

The United States base range for this position is $181,000 – $259,000 USD, plus equity. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six-month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, paid flexible holidays, and paid sick leave. These ranges may be modified in the future.

Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.
At Spotify , we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.

postings.title: Digital Assets Security Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role:

We are seeking a Digital Assets Security Engineer to own security for Alpaca's crypto and tokenization products. The scope includes custody and key management, transaction authorization policies, secure engineering for wallets and tokenization, and monitoring of high-risk asset movements.

Several of the largest digital asset thefts in recent years started with a compromised signer, a manipulated signing screen, or social engineering of the people who approve transactions. This role focuses on those paths: who can move assets, under what policy, and what approvers see before they sign. You will work in both the engineering details and the governance around them.

This role reports to the CISO and works closely with the crypto and tokenization engineering teams, Crypto Operations, Compliance, GRC, and the wider Security team.

The Security Team is 100% distributed and remote.

Things You Get To Do:

The core responsibilities of the Digital Assets Security Engineer are focused on custody and key security, transaction authorization and governance, secure engineering for crypto and tokenization, and monitoring and response.

Custody and Key Security:

• Custody Architecture: Own the security design of wallets, vaults, and signing infrastructure across hot, warm, and cold storage, including MPC and HSM configuration.

• Key Lifecycle: Set requirements for key generation, backup, recovery, rotation, and destruction. Run or oversee key ceremonies and recovery tests with Crypto Operations.

• Signing Integrity: Secure the path from a transaction request to a signature, including API credentials, co-signers, approval devices, and what approvers see before they sign.

Transaction Authorization and Governance:

• Transaction Policies: Review transaction authorization policies, such as Fireblocks TAP, including approval quorums, amount thresholds, destination allowlists, and velocity limits. Recommend changes to Crypto Operations and Compliance, who own and approve them.

• Change Control: Advise on how changes to policies, admins, signers, and allowlisted addresses are proposed, approved, and applied. Confirm every change leaves a reviewable record.

• Access Reviews: Review admin, signer, approver, and API user access on custody platforms on a set schedule, and flag access that is no longer needed for removal.

• Third-Party Risk: Assess custody providers, node and RPC providers, token issuers, and other digital asset vendors with Cyber GRC.

• Standards and Evidence: In collaboration with the Cyber GRC team, write the security standards for digital asset operations, and provide technical evidence for audits and regulatory exams.

Secure Engineering for Crypto and Tokenization:

• Design Reviews: Review architecture and code changes for wallet services, custody integrations, blockchain node infrastructure, and tokenization flows. Give engineers clear, practical requirements.

• Threat Modeling: Threat model minting, redemption, transfers, settlement, and reconciliation between on-chain balances and internal books and records.

• Smart Contract Review: Review token contracts and issuer controls, such as mint and burn authority, upgradeability, admin keys, and freeze functions, for tokens we support or integrate with.

• Service Identity and Secrets: Set requirements for how services authenticate to custody platforms, including HSM-backed signing keys, scoped API credentials, and least-privilege service accounts.

Monitoring and Response:

• Detection: Define alerts for high-risk activity, such as policy and admin changes, new destination addresses, unusual withdrawals, and signer changes. Work with Security Operations to build and tune them.

• On-Chain Monitoring: Monitor the addresses and contracts Alpaca depends on for suspicious activity, with Security Operations and Compliance.

• Incident Response: Lead the digital asset side of security incidents, including suspected key compromise, unauthorized transfers, and malicious approvals. Maintain playbooks to freeze, rotate, and recover.

• On-Call: Participate in the Security on-call rotation after onboarding and cross-training.

Who You Are (Must-Haves):

• Excited about Alpaca's mission and what we're building

• 5+ years of experience in security engineering, including 2+ years securing digital asset, crypto, or blockchain systems

• Hands-on experience with institutional custody, such as MPC or HSM-backed wallets, key backup and recovery, and policy-based transaction controls (Fireblocks,Turnkey, BitGo, Copper, or similar)

• Experience designing or reviewing transaction authorization policies, including approval quorums, amount thresholds, address allowlists, and separation of initiators, approvers, and signers

• Working knowledge of how transactions and signatures work on EVM chains and Solana, including token standards, token approvals, nonces, and finality

• A clear understanding of how digital asset theft happens in practice: signer device compromise, blind signing, social engineering of operators, address poisoning, malicious token approvals, and key exfiltration

• Able to read code and design documents well enough to challenge implementation choices, with programming experience in Python, Go, TypeScript, Rust, or similar

• Experience with cloud security, service identity, secrets management, and KMS or HSM

• Experience writing security standards and producing control evidence for auditors or regulators

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, especially when explaining risk to engineers, operators, and compliance partners

• Willing to participate in an on-call rotation

Who You Might Be (Nice-to-Haves):

• Experience securing broker-dealers, exchanges, custodians, money services businesses, or other regulated financial platforms

• Smart contract security review experience (Solidity or Rust) with tools such as Foundry, Slither, or Echidna

• Experience with tokenized securities, stablecoins, or on-chain settlement and reconciliation

• Experience running key ceremonies or designing custody recovery and disaster recovery procedures

• Experience with blockchain analytics and on-chain monitoring tools

• Ability to balance security rigor with operational efficiency and business needs

How We Take Care of You:

• Competitive Salary & Stock Options

• Health Benefits

• New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500

• Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.

postings.title: Enterprise Sales Manager, Argentina
postings.descriptionText:
ABOUT HALTER

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard. 

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund https://foundersfund.com, Bessemer Venture Partners https://www.bvp.com/, BOND, https://www.bondcap.com/ DCVC https://www.dcvc.com/, Blackbird https://www.blackbird.vc/, Promus Ventures https://www.promusventures.com/, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures https://www.icehouseventures.co.nz/?utm_term=icehouse%20ventures&utm_campaign=Brand+Keywords&utm_source=adwords&utm_medium=ppc&hsa_acc=4064636360&hsa_cam=16902737884&hsa_grp=134004309485&hsa_ad=592971340272&hsa_src=g&hsa_tgt=kwd-1082530126230&hsa_kw=icehouse%20ventures&hsa_mt=b&hsa_net=adwords&hsa_ver=3&gclid=Cj0KCQjw2v-gBhC1ARIsAOQdKY0J0DepRVFDmjQlAkJPbZuQnLSA5UVzUzOXYiPxkjX-SeVa513_BhkaAr-MEALw_wcB.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/halter-limited & Instagram https://www.instagram.com/lifeathalter/.


ABOUT THE ROLE:

You will be contributing to the growth of Halter across the largest farming businesses in Argentina, building relationships with key stakeholders, and playing a key role in the success and growth of existing corporate entities.

You’ll be an expert at building trusting relationships, identifying opportunities within a farming system, and navigating key stakeholders in order to build and progress a pipeline of opportunities. You will know how to build urgency and navigate the constraints of enterprise clients. You’ll thrive in high-pressure environments, using initiative to make results happen, often against the odds. You might find yourself in a boardroom negotiating a million-dollar contract one day, reporting key KPI’s to leadership/exec’s the next day, and working closely with our Account Managers of existing clients to ensure value is being delivered across the business. You’ll masterfully navigate corporate layers, adjusting your communication at each level accordingly, to convey the right context and value to all parties.

This isn’t a typical role. You’ll be playing a critical role in Halter’s growth into the enterprise market segment.

Aside from jumping on the Halter roller coaster of the world's fastest growing, and most transformational AgTech company, you will be making a real-world impact. You will change how large scale farm entities can operate, unlocking a more productive, resilient and sustainable farming system. You will build relationships across the most influential farming leaders in Argentina, while working closely with senior leaders within Halter.

Up for the challenge? Let’s talk.

Please submit your CV and application in English. This role works daily with teams in New Zealand, Australia and the US, so professional working English is essential. This role is to be based in Argentina. Frequent travel is required as part of the position.



WHAT YOUR DAY COULD LOOK LIKE:

Enterprise Sales Meetings:

 - You’ll spend your days engaging with the largest farming operations in Argentina. These businesses often span multiple business units, decision-makers, and territories, and you’ll need to understand their structure, surface critical challenges, and map Halter’s value across the full enterprise. You’ll lead complex sales cycles from end-to-end, guiding stakeholders through discovery, evaluation, and procurement, and navigating multi-layered negotiations all the way through to signed agreements and successful rollouts.


ENTERPRISE PROSPECTING:

 - An active rolling pipeline is core to this role. You’ll be actively developing relationships from farm to board unlocking enterprise opportunities through a mix of strategies: identifying and approaching high-value leaders/stakeholders, activating your network, driving event engagement, and leading outbound efforts. You’ll be expected to own this work and build repeatable systems to fuel a consistent, high-value pipeline.


STRATEGIC ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT & EXPANSION:

 - Once a customer is onboard, you won’t hand them off — you’ll go deeper. You’ll work across divisions, geographies, and leadership levels to strengthen relationships, identify new value levers, and drive strategic expansions. You'll work closely with Halter Account Managers to unlock organisation-wide adoption and ensure our most important customers get the most out of Halter.


ENTERPRISE NETWORKING & INFLUENCE:

 - You're not just selling, you're becoming known. In this role, you'll be expected to build meaningful relationships with board members, operational leaders, and key influencers across each account. You’ll be visible in the community and intentional in how you grow your influence and personal brand in-market.


CROSS-FUNCTIONAL EXECUTION:

 - You’ll be the voice of your enterprise customers within Halter. You’ll partner closely with the Head of Corporate, product, and support teams to align on strategic goals, drive innovation that meets customer needs to ensure best-in-class results for your accounts.


FORECASTING & STRATEGY:

 - Work with the Head of Corporate to provide accurate monthly and quarterly revenue forecasts. You’ll bring precision to your pipeline and clarity to your new business and existing business engagement strategy, making it easier for Halter to plan, invest, and grow.


GROWTH PROJECTS:

You’ll help shape what great looks like. This role isn’t just about delivering numbers — it’s about building scalable systems and strategies that allow us to serve more enterprise customers, more effectively, as Halter scales. You'll collaborate on playbook development, sales process optimisation, and commercial experimentation.



WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR:

 - A true enterprise sales hunter – someone who thrives on complexity, sees opportunity in ambiguity, and knows how to unlock deals in high-stakes, multi-stakeholder environments.

 - Proven experience selling into enterprise or large corporate customers, ideally in agriculture or related systems. You’ve run long sales cycles, influenced at the board level, and expanded accounts over time.

 - Deep industry understanding – ideally, you’ve worked in or around large-scale farming systems, and you understand the language, needs, and pace of this world.

 - A phenomenal attitude, strong ownership, and an unshakable focus on the customer. You bring energy to the room, take responsibility, and don’t let obstacles slow you down.

 - Comfort with autonomy, ambiguity, and pace – we’re growing fast, and you’ll need to move quickly, make great calls, and adjust as we scale.

 - A growth mindset and relentless drive to learn, improve, and lead. This is a chance to grow your career alongside a high-performing, high-impact team.


JOIN OUR TEAM

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page https://www.halterhq.com/careers for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/halter-limited & Instagram https://www.instagram.com/lifeathalter/.




WHY OUR TEAM LOVES WORKING AT HALTER:

 - Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

 - Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

 - You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our personal growth fund.

 - This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

postings.title: AI Operations Coordinator (Marketing)
postings.descriptionText:
This role is open to candidates based in LATAM, Africa, and Eastern Europe. Please note that as this role supports U.S.-based clients, candidates must be available to work during U.S. business hours aligned with the client’s time zone.

 

Our client operates in a fast-paced marketing environment and is developing AI-powered tools to improve team productivity, streamline creative and marketing workflows, and automate everyday operations.

The company is building an integrated AI infrastructure to support customer relationship management, marketing campaigns, digital asset management, and production coordination.




ROLE OVERVIEW

The AI Operations Coordinator will work closely with an in-house engineering team to transform AI-powered tools into practical workflows that improve how marketing and creative teams operate.




LOCATION

Fully Remote (Work from Home) | 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST| Full-Time




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


AI ASSISTANT DEVELOPMENT & PROMPT ENGINEERING

 - Design, build, and maintain custom AI assistants, GPTs, and AI agents tailored to individual team members and their workflows.

 - Develop, test, refine, and document prompts to improve AI output quality and consistency.

 - Identify opportunities to integrate AI assistants into everyday marketing and creative activities.

 - Continuously improve AI workflows based on team feedback and operational needs.
   
   


AI INFRASTRUCTURE & ENGINEERING COLLABORATION

 - Collaborate with the in-house engineering team to translate marketing and operational requirements into practical AI solutions.

 - Test newly developed AI tools and provide feedback on functionality, usability, and workflow integration.

 - Help implement AI-powered systems that improve productivity across marketing and creative teams.

 - Coordinate between engineering and marketing stakeholders to ensure AI solutions address real operational needs.
   
   


AI TOOL IMPLEMENTATION & TEAM TRAINING

 - Support the implementation and adoption of an AI-powered CRM integrated with email and creative project management workflows.

 - Help deploy an AI-powered marketing tool supporting inbound campaigns, outreach, optimization, and A/B testing.

 - Implement and support the use of Air, an AI-enhanced digital asset management platform.

 - Train team members on prompt engineering, AI assistants, and the tools used in daily operations.

 - Serve as the primary point of contact for questions related to AI workflows and tool usage.

 - Develop documentation and practical guidance to support consistent adoption.
   
   


MARKETING WORKFLOW AUTOMATION & OPTIMIZATION

 - Analyze existing marketing and production workflows to identify repetitive tasks and operational inefficiencies.

 - Develop and implement AI-assisted workflows that reduce manual work.

 - Explore integrations between CRM systems, marketing tools, digital asset platforms, and creative workflows.

 - Use automation tools and integrations where appropriate to improve operational efficiency.

 - Monitor workflow effectiveness and refine processes as business needs evolve.
   
   


PRODUCTION & CREATIVE OPERATIONS COORDINATION

 - Gradually take ownership of production coordination as AI workflows become established.

 - Track creative and marketing deliverables, deadlines, and project handoffs.

 - Coordinate with marketing and creative teams to maintain visibility into production activities.

 - Identify workflow bottlenecks and support timely project execution.

 - Help organize production processes as the team expands its use of AI-powered systems.
   
   


AI SOLUTIONS & SERVICE DEVELOPMENT

 - Support the development of AI tools and workflows into services that can be offered to customers.

 - Help document and organize AI solutions for potential customer-facing use.

 - Collaborate with internal teams to translate established workflows into practical service offerings.
   
   


QUALIFICATIONS


EXPERIENCE

 - 3+ years of professional experience in marketing, marketing operations, or a related field.

 - Proven hands-on experience building AI assistants, custom GPTs, or AI agents and implementing them in real business workflows.

 - Experience developing, testing, and refining prompts for practical AI applications.

 - Experience introducing new tools to teams and training employees on their use.

 - Experience collaborating with engineering teams to communicate operational requirements and test technical solutions.

 - Experience independently managing operational initiatives and following through on deliverables.

 - Experience in production coordination or project coordination within a marketing or creative agency is preferred.

 - Experience with AI-powered CRM systems, marketing automation, or digital asset management platforms is a plus.

 - Experience with A/B testing and conversion optimization is preferred.

 - Experience using Zapier, Make, n8n, APIs, or similar automation technologies is a plus.
   
   


SKILLS

 - Strong ability to design, build, and maintain AI assistants, custom GPTs, and AI-powered workflows.

 - Proficiency in prompt engineering, including prompt development, testing, refinement, and documentation.

 - Ability to translate marketing and operational requirements into actionable inputs for engineering teams.

 - Strong understanding of marketing workflows, campaign operations, and creative production processes.

 - Ability to train team members on AI tools and support their adoption across daily workflows.

 - Familiarity with AI-powered CRM systems, email integrations, and marketing automation platforms.

 - Familiarity with Air or similar digital asset management tools is preferred.

 - Understanding of A/B testing and conversion optimization is a plus.

 - Familiarity with Zapier, Make, n8n, and API integrations is preferred.

 - Basic graphic design capabilities using Canva, Figma, or Adobe are a plus.

 - Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

 - Ability to identify inefficiencies and develop practical solutions that improve team productivity.

 - Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and documentation skills.

 - Ability to work independently, respond promptly, and follow through on responsibilities without constant supervision.

 - Proactive, adaptable approach to learning new AI technologies and improving workflows.
   
   


OPPORTUNITY

The AI Operations Coordinator will play a central role in helping a marketing team adopt AI-powered tools and transform its daily operations.

This position offers hands-on ownership of AI assistants, prompt engineering, workflow implementation, and team training, with responsibilities expanding into production coordination as the systems mature.


APPLICATION PROCESS:


TO BE CONSIDERED FOR THIS ROLE THESE STEPS NEED TO BE FOLLOWED:

 - Fill in the application form

postings.title: Senior Software Engineer, Salesflow (Systems & Reliability)
postings.descriptionText:
Senior Software Engineer, Salesflow (Systems & Reliability)
Location: Remote from Mexico, Brazil, or Central/South America, working in US time.

Reporting to: Head of Data
Employment: Full time. Employee in Brazil; independent contractor elsewhere.

About Crimson Education

Crimson Education is the world's leading college admissions consulting firm, with over 1,490 Ivy League offers and 2,410 to the US Top 15. We help ambitious students gain admission to the world's top universities through expert-led guidance and proven, data-driven strategies. We're backed by leading VC firms, recently closed a USD $40M Series D at a USD $640M valuation, and operate across 28 markets worldwide.

The Role
Crimson is replacing Salesforce with Salesflow, an AI-native CRM we build in-house. It runs the whole sales journey: lead intake, meeting scheduling, call transcription analysis, AI-drafted appraisals, contracts and e-signature, and invoicing. It is live for our US sales team today and rolls out to every other market over the coming months.
Our team is small and builder-heavy, and the rate of growth has made it hard to keep the underlying infrastructure and logic clean and tidy. As examples, CI checks things that have been fully deprecated, newly added modules do not always take into account legacy compatibility, and bug fixes are sometimes too narrow in scope, fixing the place the problem was seen and not the underlying cause. Compounding the above is that the code itself is for the most part written by AI – this is what enabled us to build a fully working CRM in a matter of months, but is what makes it very easy to inadvertently cross wires during development.
We are looking for the person who fixes this: you will own the backend view of the system as a whole and maintain the code that glues everything together. That means a system inventory and state transition models, CI that tests only what is needed and does that well, shared guarded entrypoints in place of multiple writers with inconsistent guards, and clear definitions for what is the source of truth when fields are shared among multiple synced systems. Salesflow is live and people depend on it every day, so this is done in steps while it runs: there is no rewrite. This is not a hands-off design role: you will be expected to push code as well as design.
In addition to the above, you'll also help to unblock users – the support team funnel tickets that prevent a user from working and require a backend code change to the dev team, most of whom are not in US time zones. You will join the team and cover the US working day, when the other members are offline.
We fully expect you to use AI to augment your analyses and write code for you but absolutely require that you have the experience to read and write code yourself, and that you know how to use AI to write code (e.g., which questions to ask, what to check, how to build internal memory structures).

What are the main responsibilities for this role?
Your top priority is to build and maintain the view of the CRM as a whole: inventory all functions, edge functions, flows, and integrations with outside systems; build the state transition map and the set of business rules the system is held to; and then ensure that architecture and CI align to this. In practice this can be split into:

• setting up a live and auto-updating inventory and model: the repo has multiple pushes every day; no-one should try updating a model by hand

• coordinating with team members on business rules: the team has, collectively, all the info; your job is to organize it and embed it in the checks

• after the above two, move into implementation: resolve technical debt caused by rapid organic growth without consistent pruning, and set up the infrastructure such that future growth automatically falls into the correct path and does not create new debt.

Aside from this, you will assist in unblocking users during US daytime hours: addressing current bugs will help you gain insight into the system as a whole, informing the main priority.

• Your first 14 days: inventory and build a model of the system; integrate into the ticket queue

• Your first 28 days: start shipping basic sanitation: clean CI and updated CLAUDE.md files (the instructions our AI agents read) so future pushes don't create more problems

• Your first 3 months: the worst of the debt is cleared and guardrails are in place, so a bug that has been fixed does not come back; your time will transition over to building new features

What skills and experience are required?
You think in systems. Shown a new product, you look for the states, the transitions and the rules that must always hold before you look at the code. You can draw how it works on one page, and you can predict from that drawing where it will break.
You learn fast and you know how you learn. You will be dropped into a large codebase you did not write. We care much more about how quickly you build an accurate picture of something unfamiliar, and how you change that picture when a fact contradicts it, than about which frameworks you already know.
You have done this before, hands-on. You have owned something that had to be right: a ledger, a billing system, an order or contract lifecycle, a reconciliation between two systems that disagreed. You ran it in production, you can tell us what went wrong with it, and you can tell us what you changed so it could not go wrong again. Being sharp is not a substitute for having done it.
You have built the checks, not only passed them. You have set up CI, tests or release gates for a team that ships many times a day, and you can tell us which checks earned their place and which ones you deleted.
You are fluent with AI coding tools and you do not trust them. You direct Claude Code or similar every day, you verify what it tells you, and you can explain why a plausible AI-written fix is wrong.
You are strong in PostgreSQL and comfortable in TypeScript. Our stack is React and TypeScript on Supabase (Postgres, edge functions). Your depth should be on the data side; you need to read and change the front end without fear, not to be a front-end specialist.
You can make yourself understood. We work in English, mostly in writing: design notes, review comments, briefs for AI agents, replies to colleagues. You need to explain your thinking, ask questions and follow a technical discussion, in writing and on a call. Your English does not need to be polished, and no other language is required.
You say what you think. You will disagree with people who built this system, and with your manager, and we want you to. Bring the evidence.
Typical background: four or more years building production systems, some of it at a company where money or contracts moved through your code. We will happily talk to someone with fewer years and unusual ability.
Nice to have: Supabase, work with CRM integrations.

How we hire
Our process tests how you think. There are four steps: a short video screen; a timed written exercise on an unfamiliar system (up to 90 minutes, no code to write); an interview with your direct manager; and a technical conversation with our lead engineer.

Why this role
You will have a direct hand in a piece of software that replaces a global company's CRM and defines how it sells for the next decade. The team is small, the system is young, and the part you would own does not have an owner today. What you decide will stick.

Why work for Crimson?

• Rapidly growing company with a flexible working environment where you are empowered to structure how you work

• Limitless development and exposure: internal promotions and role changes made up 33% of all recruitment last year

• $1000 individual training budget per year, we love to 'Level Up' (it's one of our core values)

•
Psychologist on staff

• Insightful fireside chats and workshops to support our high-performing and ambitious team

• Radical Candor is a feedback approach we live by

• We're a global player with 28 markets (and growing) across the globe

If you like understanding how a whole system works and cannot leave a bug alone until you know why it happened, we'd love to hear from you.
Please keep an eye on your spam/junk email folder for correspondence from Team Tailor.

Bring 5+ years of chip-design expertise to review AI training tasks, solutions and evaluations for correctness, feasibility and quality.

 - Location: Remote (LATAM)

 - Type: Contract / Part-time

 - Experience: 5+ years of directly relevant chip-design experience

 - Availability: Immediate start

ABOUT ANYONE AI

At Anyone AI, we create high-quality training and evaluation data for frontier AI models. We're building a team of chip-design engineers and researchers to create technical tasks that teach and test how AI systems reason about semiconductor design.

Contributors work in either digital (RTL design and verification) or analog / mixed-signal IC design, and only need to meet the requirements for their own specialization.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Independently assess technical tasks, solutions and evaluations for correctness and feasibility

 - Identify design and verification issues

 - Make sure outputs meet established engineering standards

 - Give clear, actionable feedback to task creators

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or a closely related field; Master's or PhD preferred

 - 5+ years of professional semiconductor design experience in digital design, design verification or analog / mixed-signal IC design

 - Deep understanding of semiconductor design principles and engineering validation

 - Strong written English and technical documentation skills

Digital design

 - Hands-on Verilog or SystemVerilog in production designs

 - RTL design and/or functional verification experience

 - Experience building and reviewing hardware testbenches and verification environments

 - Familiarity with synthesis, simulation and digital design constraints

 - Tools such as Cadence, Synopsys, QuestaSim, Verilator, Yosys, Icarus Verilog or equivalent

Analog / mixed-signal design

 - Professional experience designing analog or mixed-signal integrated circuits

 - Transistor-level circuit design and simulation

 - SPICE-based simulation (Cadence Virtuoso, Spectre, HSPICE, LTspice or comparable)

 - Ability to judge circuit performance, constraints and design trade-offs independently

NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience mentoring engineers or leading technical design reviews

 - Master's degree or PhD in Electrical or Computer Engineering

 - ASIC, FPGA, SoC or mixed-signal IC development experience

 - Timing closure, formal verification, physical design or PPA optimization

 - Python, C/C++, TCL or engineering automation

 - Experience creating technical benchmarks, test cases or engineering assessments

 - Experience reviewing AI-generated code, hardware designs or engineering solutions

 - Familiarity with open-source EDA workflows and reproducible engineering environments

Fully remote work, regional impact, and the opportunity to help shape the collections process at a growing AI education company.
