postings.title: Senior Backend Software Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
This role is open to candidates based in LATAM, Africa, and Eastern Europe. Please note that as this role supports U.S.-based clients, candidates must be available to work during U.S. business hours aligned with the client’s time zone.

 

Our client is a technology solutions company that develops and supports cloud-based software applications for a diverse portfolio of customers. The company focuses on building scalable, secure, and reliable solutions using modern cloud technologies to deliver exceptional user experiences.




ROLE OVERVIEW

The Senior Backend Software Engineer will lead the design, development, and optimization of cloud-native backend systems built using C# and Microsoft Azure technologies.

This role involves backend architecture, API development, cloud infrastructure optimization, system reliability, and technical leadership. The ideal candidate has extensive experience developing scalable backend applications, solving complex technical challenges, and guiding engineering best practices while collaborating with engineering, product, and infrastructure teams.




LOCATION

Fully Remote (Work from Home) | 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


BACKEND ARCHITECTURE & DEVELOPMENT

 - Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend applications and services using C# and .NET technologies.

 - Lead the development of enterprise-grade APIs and integrations.

 - Evaluate and improve application architecture, performance, and maintainability.

 - Drive the adoption of engineering standards and development best practices.
   
   


CLOUD & AZURE ENGINEERING

 - Architect and support cloud-native solutions within Microsoft Azure.

 - Collaborate on deployment strategies, cloud optimization, and infrastructure improvements.

 - Support application scalability, reliability, and security initiatives.

 - Contribute to cloud modernization and automation efforts.
   
   


TECHNICAL LEADERSHIP

 - Mentor and support junior and mid-level engineers.

 - Conduct code reviews and provide technical guidance.

 - Participate in technical planning and solution design discussions.

 - Help establish development standards and scalable engineering processes.
   
   


PERFORMANCE, RELIABILITY & OPTIMIZATION

 - Troubleshoot and resolve complex production issues.

 - Identify opportunities to improve application performance and system reliability.

 - Support monitoring, logging, and proactive issue resolution initiatives.

 - Ensure backend solutions are designed with scalability and maintainability in mind.
   
   


QUALIFICATIONS


EXPERIENCE

 - 7+ years of professional software development experience.

 - Extensive hands-on experience with C# and .NET/.NET Core.

 - Experience designing and developing large-scale APIs and backend systems.

For over 35 years, we've transacted more than $3.5 billion of real estate, acquiring over 14,648 multifamily units and taking dozens of properties full cycle — on average returning 100% of investor capital plus strong returns. Our focus is acquiring older apartment home communities and creating value by improving the properties, optimizing operations, and fostering human flourishing in each one. Above all, we've learned that success is measured not just by financial gain, but by the quality of the relationships we build along the way. Please read our values https://wearewilkinson.com/about/real-estate-investment-group-values, and if you are aligned, we encourage you to apply. 

 


JOB OVERVIEW: 

We're a US-based investment firm running two brands — an SEC-regulated real-estate investment fund and a family-focused coaching and publishing brand. The Social Media & Community Manager is the maker who owns the social presence and community across both: the daily content cadence, the calendar, organic growth, and the health of every community segment. You execute under the EVP's creative direction and turn it into reels, posts, and stories that ship on schedule and grow a real, engaged audience. You make sure the online community is engaged and supported for both brands. This is a content-and-community operator role — fast, native to the platforms, aware of event promotion and testimonials, and high-output.

Success is measured on reach and engagement: contribute the organic share of roughly 1,000+ new qualified connections per month across both brands — and keep each community growing and healthy. You must find ways to track investors' closes that can be partially attributed to having seen or interacted with social content.

 
 


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own social content across both brands. Own earned-media social execution — all reels and posts — under the EVP's direction; develop stories, reels, and posts for the fund brand; build and run the social launch calendar for both brands.

 - Drive organic growth and community. Run organic distribution and follower growth for the coaching brand; own community management across list segments — legacy clients, advisor comms, comments and DMs — with a cadence that keeps each community healthy.

 - Keep the content engine running. Oversee video edits, scripts, quick productions, and approvals so content ships 3× per week, pulling the video pod when needed.

 - Own event social. Own what gets captured at events and how, and manage Whova, Linkedin, shout-outs, collaborations,reels, shorts, YouTube, Google reviews, Meta (Instagram and Facebook), Twitter and Tiktok.

 - Deliver short video by coordinating these scripts or topics with stakeholders or videographer, be on voice with clever, intelligent, older topics, no emojis.


REQUIREMENTS

 - 3+ years running social and community for a brand or creator, with a portfolio of content you made and an account you grew.

 - Native fluency in current formats and platforms — IG, FB, LinkedIn, YouTube/Shorts, TikTok — and a real feel for what's working this month, not last year.

 - Hands-on content creation: reels, stories, short-form video, posts — you make it, you don't just schedule it.

 - Community management: engagement, comment and DM response, segment health, and a consistent cadence.

 - AI-native creator: you use AI tools to ideate, script, edit, and repurpose at volume — this is core to the role, not a bonus.

 - On-voice writing for two distinct brands targeted at 40-70 year olds, and strong English.

 - Owner's mindset: high-output, resourceful, low-ego, never goes dark on the update cadence.

 - Self-sufficient operator: you know what to do unprompted and learn any tool cold.

 - Reliable remote setup.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Grew a founder, creator, or personal brand — especially in finance, coaching, a movement, or thought-leadership — directly relevant to building the two brands’' presence–one a personal brand and one a corporate brand.

 - Short-form video editing chops (CapCut or similar) — bridges the gap to the video pod.

 - Experience with event/live social capture (Meta Reels or Stories, Whova, etc.).

 - Built AI-assisted content systems — repurposing, scheduling, ideation pipelines.

 - Community-platform experience (groups, memberships, advisor communities including Reddit, Telegram, What’s App, GroupMe).

 - A trend-curious, fast-iterating temperament — ships, learns, ships again.

 - Valid passport and able to travel to the US up to 4× per year

postings.title: Data Services Import Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
What Makes Cloudbeds Unique

At Cloudbeds , we're not just building software, we're transforming hospitality. Our platform powers hotels across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've continually been recognized for excellence, most recently earning top honors at the 2026 HotelTechAwards for Best Hotel Management Software and landing on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again, but we're just getting started.

How You'll Make an Impact:

We are seeking a dynamic Data Import & Reporting Analyst to join our customer success team. This role bridges the gap between data services and business intelligence.

Your mission is two-fold: first, you will orchestrate smooth data migrations, helping new clients transition their historical data (reservations, guest profiles, inventory) from legacy systems to Cloudbeds. Second, you will act as a reporting strategist, coaching clients on how to leverage Cloudbeds’ reporting features to extract meaningful insights, track KPIs, and drive data-backed business decisions from day one.

Our Data Services Team:

We are a collaborative, remote-first team energised by solving complex data puzzles and transforming technical transitions into seamless, empowering experiences for hoteliers worldwide. We thrive on cross-functional teamwork, blending analytical precision with a passion for client education so that no property is left in the dark. If you love deep-diving into spreadsheets just as much as celebrating a client’s "aha!" moment when their data reporting clicks, these are your people.

What You Bring to the Team:

• Lead Data Migrations: Act as the primary technical advisor guiding new clients through the smooth transition of historical data (reservations, guest profiles, inventory) into Cloudbeds.

• Execute Data Manipulation: Extract, clean, map, and validate client data from CSV/Excel formats to ensure flawless system uploads.

• Drive Technical Troubleshooting: Proactively identify and resolve formatting discrepancies or system mismatches before clients go live.

• Empower Clients Through Coaching: Train properties on how to build, customize, and automate operational and financial reports within the Cloudbeds platform.

• Ensure Data Integrity: Guide clients through post-migration audits to validate accuracy across financial histories and occupancy metrics.

• Advise on Best Practices: Consult with property managers on key performance indicators (KPIs) to help optimize their daily operations from day one.

What Sets You Up for Success:

• Hospitality Tech Background: Direct experience working with Hotel Property Management Systems (e.g., Cloudbeds, Opera, Mews, Protel, or similar software).

• Client-Facing Expertise: A proven track record in onboarding, implementation, or Tier 2/3 technical support with a natural ability to teach and guide users.

• Advanced Spreadsheet Proficiency: Power-user skills in Excel and Google Sheets (VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables, advanced formulas, and data cleaning).

• Analytical Mindset: Strong understanding of basic data management principles, data mapping, parsing, and root-cause error analysis.

• Meticulous Attention to Detail: Exceptional precision when handling sensitive historical, financial, and guest records.

• Remote-First Readiness: Highly tech-savvy with cloud-based workflows and equipped with a reliable, high-speed internet connection for video coaching sessions.

• Professional proficiency (verbal and written) in Spanish

Bonus Skills to Stand Out (Optional):

• BI & Analytics Familiarity: Prior experience working with business intelligence dashboards or advanced financial reporting structures.

Work Authorization: Please note that applicants must be currently authorized to work in the location where the position is located without requiring visa sponsorship. At this time, Cloudbeds is unable to provide sponsorship for work visas.

What to Expect - Your Journey with Us

Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team redefining what's possible in hospitality. We're 650+ team members across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, hoteliers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle. Our diverse team speaks 30+ languages, but we all share one language: a passion for innovation and travel. From pioneering breakthroughs in machine learning to revolutionizing how hotels operate, we're not just watching the future of hospitality unfold – we're coding it, designing it, writing it, and shipping it. If you're ready to work alongside some of the brightest minds in tech who are obsessed with using AI to transform a trillion-dollar industry, this is your chance to be part of something extraordinary.

postings.descriptionText:
What Makes Cloudbeds Unique

At Cloudbeds , we're not just building software, we're transforming hospitality. Our platform powers hotels across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've continually been recognized for excellence, most recently earning top honors at the 2026 HotelTechAwards for Best Hotel Management Software and landing on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again, but we're just getting started.

How You'll Make an Impact:

As Manager, Training & Enablement, you will lead the team that empowers Cloudbeds colleagues and customers through product and hotel operations training. You will own the knowledge, content and learning programs behind it, and bring our new knowledge engine to life. You will also build the operations hub for Customer Success knowledge: documented processes, a content library and the standards behind them. You will run an AI-assisted operating model with expert human oversight. This is a hands-on leadership role. You will set the vision for how our teams learn, simplify and speed up how the work gets done, and act as the main liaison between Training & Enablement and our cross-functional partners. You will have the chance to shape functional strategy and scale your impact as the team grows.

Our Training & Enablement Team:

Our team is where Hospitality Hearts meet AI Smarts. We are a fully remote, multilingual group of trainers, writers, localization specialists and hospitality veterans who turn a fast-moving product into knowledge people can use. We test and learn, use AI to strip out drafting and lookup work, and keep people on teaching, judgment and quality. Our principle: standardize the repeatable, personalize the meaningful.

What You Bring to the Team:

• Lead, coach and develop the team across knowledge, delivery and operations. Own hiring, capacity planning and metrics, and set an intake and review framework with a published scope charter.
• Bring the knowledge engine to life. Run a content engine that turns product updates into role-based knowledge assets, linking content to the Jira tickets that carry releases and sourcing release notes from them. Manage knowledge base architecture and tagging so the content library works for two readers, people and AI tools, and hold the line on quality, brand voice and terminology.
• Run an AI- assisted operating model. Sort workflows by automation level, keep human oversight on high judgment work, own the verification of AI-generated content (who reviews it, to what standard, and how errors are caught before publishing), and build the team’s AI skills through continuous learning and smart tooling choices.
• Document how Customer Success operates: processes, escalation paths and hand-offs, and a library of the macros and templates teams use with customers, kept current and searchable.
• Design modular, role-based learning programs for internal teams and customers, built on unified content, covering Cloudbeds processes as well as the product with live training reserved for interactive problem-solving. Add badging and certification to validate product expertise, grounded in practical hospitality context.
• Manage live delivery schedules, global time-zone coverage and contractors, and set localization policy that pairs AI-assisted translation with human review.
• Partner with Product, Engineering, Support, Sales and Ops on release readiness and customer feedback. Oversee enablement platforms and vendors, and use performance data to refine programs and show business value.

What Sets You Up for Success:

• 5+ years in training, enablement, learning and development, learning technology, knowledge management or customer education, with a record of running learning or content programs at scale and measuring outcomes such as time to competence, ticket deflection or content accuracy
• 2+ years leading a team, including specialists across several countries and time zones
• Hands-on AI builder: you have created learning, training or content solutions with AI, can show what you built and explain how you designed it, and know where human review must stay
• Vision and creativity: a fresh point of view on how people learn, an eye for retiring process and speeding things up with new tooling, and a self-driven habit of experimenting with new ways to teach and build
• Confidence with learning and knowledge tools, such as an LMS (for example Docebo) and content platforms, and the judgment to know when to adopt or replace them
• Skill at setting scope and saying no clearly to partners across Product, Support, Sales and Operations without relying on authority, and at turning throughput, survey and support data into priorities and a business case
• Strong written and spoken communication with a global audience, fluent English, and calm, self-directed work in a results-driven, remote-first, fast-growing environment. A “mop bucket” attitude: some days you are the planner, the trainer and the editor in the same afternoon.

Bonus Skills to Stand Out:

• Hospitality or hospitality-technology experience (a PMS or SaaS company, or hotel training)
• Experience commissioning, building or managing a knowledge engine or AI knowledge base, including structuring content and tagging for retrieval
• Experience documenting operational processes or running an operations function for a support or customer success team
• Portuguese, Spanish or Thai

Compensation: Depending on your skills and experience, you can expect your annual compensation to be between $110,000 and $135,000 USD. Please note that we maintain high flexibility, and packages above this range will be considered. ( The salary is only for US-based candidates).

Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team redefining what's possible in hospitality. We're 650+ team members across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, hoteliers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle. postings.descriptionText:
Who We Are:

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A day in the life:

As a Landing Page Strategist, you'll own the execution and optimization of high-performing landing pages that drive business results across lead generation, paid media, and eCommerce campaigns.

You'll work closely with senior strategists, paid media teams, lifecycle marketers, account managers, and creative and development teams to translate campaign objectives into effective landing page experiences. Your responsibilities will span the entire landing page lifecycle, including strategic planning, copywriting, design direction, QA, stakeholder communication, A/B testing, performance analysis, and ongoing optimization.

This is a client-facing, detail-oriented role that requires both strategic thinking and strong execution. You'll be expected to independently identify optimization opportunities, translate performance insights into actionable recommendations, and continuously improve landing page experiences while helping scale one of our most impactful service lines.

Key Responsibilities:

Client Execution & Project Management

• Own the execution of landing page deliverables across strategy, copywriting, design feedback, development handoff, QA, and launch

• Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for internal teams and assist with client communication when needed

• Translate paid media strategy and campaign briefs into high-converting landing page experiences

• Work within structured workflows and project management tools (e.g., Asana) to track deliverables and meet timelines

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Paid Media, Lifecycle, Creative, and Development teams to align messaging, offers, and user experience

• Manage account capacity, resource allocation, and portfolio performance to support the $36K monthly RPE target while maintaining service quality and client outcomes.

Landing Page Strategy & Optimization

• Develop and refine landing page strategies aligned with funnel stages, campaign objectives, target personas, and business goals.

• Conduct CRO audits, scroll map/click map reviews, and post-launch performance analysis to surface insights and optimizations

• Develop, execute, and report on landing page A/B tests in collaboration with relevant channel strategists.

• Apply best practices in messaging hierarchy, user experience, and mobile-first design

• Maintain knowledge of platform and ad network guidelines (Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, etc.)

Content & QA Support

• Draft or refine landing page copy tailored to target personas, offers, and funnel stage

• Review landing pages for accuracy, responsiveness, and proper integration with forms, calendars, pixels, and CRMs

• Work with developers and creative teams to ensure pages meet quality standards prior to launch

• Conduct device and browser testing to validate performance and mobile usability

Collaboration & Growth Enablement

• Work alongside the Managing Director to operationalize best practices and document repeatable workflows

• Help maintain and improve internal tools such as audit templates, performance trackers, and testing roadmaps

• Contribute to ongoing training and resource development for internal teams and freelancers

• Proactively identify areas for improvement across design, process, messaging, or reporting

• Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes

• Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department

Performance Analysis & Optimization

• Own post-launch monitoring and performance analysis for assigned landing pages.

• Analyze conversion rates, user behavior, engagement metrics, and campaign performance to identify optimization opportunities.

• Translate performance insights into actionable recommendations for future landing page iterations and experiments.

• Develop and maintain testing roadmaps aligned with campaign objectives and business priorities.

• Monitor landing page performance against established benchmarks and historical results.

AI & Technology Adoption

• Leverage approved AI tools and Power Digital's Nova ecosystem to improve research, copywriting, performance analysis, reporting, and workflow efficiency.

• Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and improve the scalability of landing page processes.

• Stay current with emerging AI technologies and apply relevant innovations to landing page strategy and execution.

Requirements:

• 3+ years of experience in CRO or running Landing Page projects (agency experience preferred)..

• Portfolio of work examples with proven results

• Experience working with Landing Page & CRM platforms: Unbounce, Hubspot, Marketo, etc

• Experience working with design platforms like Figma

• Experience with user behavior tools like Microsoft Clarity, Hotjar, etc

• Experience analyzing landing page performance using GA4 or similar analytics platforms.

• Understanding of CRO principles, A/B testing methodologies, and experimentation best practices.

• Ability to interpret performance data and translate findings into actionable optimization recommendations.

• Familiarity with AI-powered tools for research, copywriting, analysis, and workflow automation.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

1. Landing Page Delivery & Execution

• Complete ≥90% of assigned landing page milestones (strategy, copy, design feedback, QA, and launch) within agreed timelines.

• Ensure 100% of approved landing pages complete the required QA process before launch.

• Proactively communicate blockers, scope changes, and dependencies before they impact delivery.

2. Landing Page Quality & QA

• Achieve ≥95% first-pass accuracy across pre-launch QA checks, including copy, responsiveness, forms, tracking pixels, integrations, and functionality.

• Deliver zero preventable critical issues to production per quarter.

• Maintain documented QA checklists for 100% of launched landing pages .

3. Performance Analysis & Optimization

• Complete a post-launch performance review for 100% of landing pages within 30 days of launch .

• Identify and document at least 2 actionable optimization opportunities per month across assigned accounts, based on performance data, user behavior, or CRO best practices.

• Track conversion performance against the previous page, campaign benchmark, or established baseline.

4. A/B Testing & Insights

• Support the launch of at least 1 A/B tests per month , when client scope, traffic, and testing opportunities allow.

• Document 100% of completed experiments , including hypotheses, results, key learnings, and next steps.

• Deliver experiment readouts within 5 business days of receiving finalized results .

5. Collaboration & Client Satisfaction

• Maintain ≥4.0/5 internal satisfaction from Paid Media, Lifecycle, Creative, Development, and Account Management.

• Communicate project updates and blockers proactively, responding to internal requests within 1 business day .

• Maintain clear documentation and alignment across active landing page projects.

6. AI Adoption & Efficiency

• Leverage approved AI tools in ≥50% of applicable landing page workflows , including research, copywriting, audits, reporting, documentation, and process automation.

• Implement at least 1 AI-driven workflow improvement per quarter that reduces production time, improves quality, or increases delivery capacity.

• Ensure all AI-generated content and recommendations receive appropriate human review before client delivery.

7. Process Improvement & Growth Enablement

• Implement or contribute to at least 1 process, template, or documentation improvement per quarter .

• Maintain updated landing page playbooks, audit templates, testing roadmaps, and performance trackers.

• Contribute to at least 1 internal training or knowledge-sharing initiative per quarter .

8. Portfolio & Revenue Contribution :

• Manage an assigned account portfolio supporting approximately $36K in monthly RPE , while maintaining delivery efficiency, client satisfaction, and account profitability.

Most Important Things (MITs)

• Execution Excellence: Own landing page deliverables from strategy through launch, ensuring quality and timely execution.

• Conversion-Focused Thinking: Use data, user behavior, and CRO best practices to identify optimization opportunities and improve landing page performance.

• Ownership & Accountability: Proactively manage timelines, identify risks, and resolve execution challenges.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Keep Paid Media, Lifecycle, Creative, Development, and Account teams aligned.

• AI & Continuous Improvement: Leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve efficiency, scalability, and quality.

• Growth Enablement: Build repeatable processes and resources that allow the Landing Page service line to scale while freeing up strategic leadership capacity.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A day in the life:

You’ll join novaX, Power Digital’s innovation team, which builds internal and external products that help our teams and clients make decisions and get work done, such as Signal, Omega and Iris. You’ll sit in the AI/ML squad, which focuses on statistical modeling. This is a full-stack data role: you build the data systems our products run on, build predictive models on top of them, like scores that show which clients are ready to grow, and put both in front of the people who use them. One day you might trace why a number doesn’t match its source, fix the pipeline and add a test so it can’t drift again. The next you might sit with the people who use a model, learn how they make the decision, and ship a better version where they work. AI is how we build: you’ll use AI coding tools for most of what you ship, so you can take an idea from raw data to a production feature on your own. As an innovation team we move fast: we try ideas, keep what works, drop what doesn’t, and priorities can shift quickly. We’re looking for someone hungry to learn and grow with us along the way.

Key Responsibilities:

• Design, build and own the data systems our products and models run on: pipelines, services and APIs that bring together our warehouse, app databases, spreadsheets and third-party APIs.

• Build predictive models and take them all the way to production: frame the question with users, build features, test against a baseline, ship the results where people work and keep them healthy.

• Build with AI every day: use AI coding tools to move faster across the whole stack, and review and test what they produce before it reaches production.

• Hold what you build to production standards (tests, code review, CI/CD, monitoring and alerts) so bad or late data is caught before a user sees it, and fix the root cause.

• Turn vague asks into a clear problem, ship a first version fast and improve it from feedback.

• Share what works (patterns, prompts, tools) so the whole team builds faster.

• Work with sensitive data, including finance and people data, under strict access rules.

• Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes

• Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department

• Design, build and own the data systems our products and models run on: dbt models, pipelines, services and APIs that bring together our warehouse, app databases, spreadsheets and third-party APIs.

• Other applicable or related duties as assigned.

Role Requirements:

• You have 5+ years in data engineering, data science or software roles, with hands-on work that ran in production.

• You’re full-stack across data: you’ve built pipelines or data services, built predictive models, and connected them to something people use. You don’t need to be the deepest expert in each, but you’re comfortable in all of them.

• You build with AI every day (Claude Code, Cursor or similar) and can show how it changed what you ship. You review, test and own what it writes.

• You’ve built and experimented with predictive models, and you’re comfortable with work that needs modeling: framing the problem, building features and evaluating against a baseline.

• You understand statistics well enough to set up a fair test, spot leakage and tell a real effect from noise.

• You write strong SQL and Python, and you know good engineering basics: version control, testing and code review.

• You can walk us through one thing you built end to end: the problem, the data, what you shipped, who used it, what failed along the way, and which parts AI wrote.

• You start from the decision the user is trying to make, not from the data, and you ask until you understand it.

• You’re a problem solver who learns fast and fails fast: you’d rather ship something small this week and learn from it than plan for a month, and you keep picking up new tools and methods.

• You write clearly in English and work well async.

• Nice to have: Snowflake (our warehouse); cloud deployment and orchestration (for example AWS); some Terraform or other infrastructure as code; marketing or client analytics such as churn or expansion; LLM apps or agents.

• You have hands-on dbt experience in production: you've built and maintained models, tests, documentation and incremental builds. Most of our transformation work runs on dbt.

• This is a remote role open to candidates in [the US or Latin America], at [senior, IC4–IC5].

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• Reliability: the systems you own meet their agreed freshness and uptime targets, most issues are caught by your checks before a user reports them, and any that slip are resolved within a week.

• Models in production: every model you ship is monitored, and a change ships only when it beats the current version on held-out data.

• Adoption: everything you ship has a named user and a usage target agreed with your manager, and at the monthly review you’ve hit it or can explain why.

• Engineering bar: what you build is tested, documented and reviewable, and a teammate can run it without you.

Most Important Things (MITs)

• In your first 30 days, ship a fix to a production data flow or model.

• By 90 days, be the go-to owner for one product’s data layer: you review its changes and resolve its issues without escalation. Put one model change into production with a measured before/after.

• By 6 months, own the production path for a model end to end (data, deployment, monitoring) and have improved how the team builds and ships, with a pattern, test or tool others use.

• Unlimited Time Off available on day one

• Healthcare stipend: $50/month to support your healthcare or insurance costs

postings.descriptionText:
Superside is expanding its Production team, and we’re looking for an energized, team-focused, and solutions-oriented Producer to help us grow video production on a global scale. 
 
As a Producer, you’ll be an expert in your field and the go-to person for overall project aspects and milestones. You’ll combine a sharp understanding of multimedia production, profitability, and stakeholder management to deliver exceptional creative work. You’ll champion process, optimize team operations, and help scale Superside’s production offering across traditional and tech-enabled formats - all on time and within budget.

What You'll Do
• Run a range of Specialised Production Services (video, motion, 3D, AR) production projects from brief to delivery, including brand films, digital ads, and modular content for performance marketing

• Partner with our internal Creative Leads, DOPs, editors, and scriptwriters to execute high-quality workCoordinate global shoots - onsite or remote-directed - and manage external vendors as needed

• Support the integration of AI-powered tools for scripting, storyboarding, post-production, and asset creation when relevant

• Manage project budgets, timelines, licensing, and deliverables across channels including social, Connected TV, and digital ads

• Collaborate with Superside’s AR & 3D team on interactive or immersive content, understanding the basic phases of these projects

• Build and maintain a vetted global supplier network across crew, gear, studios, and specialized production services

• Continuously optimize production processes and identify scalable ways of working

• Work closely with Creative Project Managers, Creative Directors, Finance, and directly with customers

• Keep everyone aligned and informed - from scope and planning to shoot and post

What You'll Need To Succeed
• 5+ years of experience in creative production (agency, in-house, or production company)

• Strong experience managing video shoots, post-production , and digital-first content (organic and paid)

• Bonus if you’ve worked with performance marketing teams or optimized content for testing and iteration

• Comfort working in global, remote, and asynchronous environments

• A strong pulse on AI, AR, and emerging creative tools , with a curiosity to test and apply them thoughtfully

• Proven experience managing external vendors, production budgets, and contracts

• A process-minded approach to projects, with a love for structure and efficiency

• Great vibes - you're a doer, problem-solver, collaborator, and communicator

• Flexibility to work with different time zones and occasional irregular schedules

Why Join us?

Superside's vision is to create equal opportunities globally by accelerating the world’s transition to online work. With that in mind, we're building a fully remote company that attracts people where they are.

Remote-first. Customer-led.
Remote isn’t just a perk; it’s how we deliver better for customers. We are fully committing to our customers by hiring top talent and collaborating seamlessly across time zones.
Global team, local impact.
Join a community of 60+ nationalities working across time zones, cultures, and disciplines, all aligned on doing great work for great brands.
High performance, low ego.
Work in a fast-paced, high-trust environment where feedback is direct, growth is constant, and kindness leads collaboration.
Impact meets opportunity.
We’re in the sweet spot — big enough to be stable, small enough for you to shape what’s next. Your ideas will matter here.
Grow fast. Lead well.
You’ll gain mentorship, take on real responsibility, and grow your career while helping us disrupt a global industry.

About Superside

Superside is the leading AI-powered creative company that quickly and cost-effectively enhances in-house functions. We help over 500 ambitious brands get great creative concepts done at scale. Built to be an extension 
of in-house teams, we unbottleneck marketing and creative teams so they can move faster and drive more reliable creative performance. 
Superside is a fully remote company with over 700 team members working across 60+ countries and 13 timezones.

Learn more at superside.com

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

We’re an equal-opportunity company. All applicants will be considered regardless of ethnicity, appearance, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, veteran or disability status.

postings.title: Senior Software Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Who we are:

BigID is an innovative tech startup that focuses on solutions for data security, compliance, privacy, and AI data management. We're leading the market in all things data: helping our customers reduce risk, drive business innovation, achieve compliance, build customer trust, make better decisions, and get more value from their data.

We are building a global team passionate about innovation and next-gen technology. BigID has been recognized for:

• BigID named one of Forbes America's Best Startup Employers 2026 - ranked #15 overall and #1 in Security

• BigID named Hot Company in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning at the Global InfoSec Awards

• Citizens JMP Cyber 66 List of Hottest Privately Held Cybersecurity Companies

• CRN 100 list named BigID as one of the 20 Coolest Identity Access Management and Data Protection Companies (3 years running)

• DUNS 100 Best Tech Companies to Work for

• Top 3 Big Data and AI Vendors to Watch in the 2023 BigDATAwire Readers and Editors Choice Awards

• 2024 Inc. 5000 list for the 4th consecutive year!

• Shortlisted for the 2024 AI Awards in the category of Best Use of AI in Cybersecurity

At BigID, our team is the foundation of our success. Join a people-centric culture that is fast-paced and rewarding: you’ll have the opportunity to work with some of the most talented people in the industry who value innovation, diversity, integrity, and collaboration.

Who we seek:

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer, based in Argentina and working remotely, to build privacy products that help enterprises use their data responsibly in the age of AI.
You'll ship features end to end across dockerized TypeScript and Java services. AI is part of the job twice over: it's a daily tool in how you build software, and it's a core part of the features you'll put into production.
Our products help enterprise companies stay in control of personal and sensitive data as regulations and AI adoption grow. You'll contribute to three areas:

• AI data governance: helping organizations discover, classify and govern the data that feeds their AI models, so they know what goes in and can prove it's allowed.

• Privacy request automation: automating data subject requests (access, deletion, correction) across many systems, from intake to verified fulfillment.

• Consent management: collecting, storing and enforcing user consent and preferences across websites, apps and downstream systems.

What you’ll do:

• Design, build and maintain full-stack features across TypeScript front-ends and back-end services and Java back-end services.

• Build production features powered by AI, such as agentic workflows, with attention to accuracy, cost, latency and safety.

• Use AI coding assistants and agents as a core part of your workflow to design, write, test, review and document code faster, while staying accountable for quality.

• Develop and run services in Docker-based environments, from local development through CI/CD to deployment.

• Write well-tested, secure and maintainable code, and review your teammates' work.

• Work closely with product, design and QA to turn privacy and compliance requirements into clear, usable product experiences.

• Take ownership of what you ship: monitor it in production, troubleshoot issues and keep improving it.

What you’ll bring:

• Experience: 4+ years of professional software engineering experience.

• Technical design and coding expertise: strong architectural design skills for building scalable, consumer-facing products, and solid hands-on coding experience in TypeScript (React, Node.js or similar) and Java (Spring Boot or similar).

• Containers: day-to-day work with Docker and containerized development and deployment.

• APIs and data: designing REST APIs and working with relational and NoSQL databases.

postings.title: AI Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Newsweek is the global media organization that has earned audience time and trust for more than 90 years. Newsweek reaches 100 million people each month with thought-provoking news, opinion, images, graphics, and video delivered across a dozen print and digital platforms. Headquartered in New York City, Newsweek also publishes international editions in EMEA and Asia.

AI Engineer

Applied AI & Data Platforms| Newsweek

About the Role
Newsweek is seeking an AI Engineer to design, build, and operate practical AI-powered applications, intelligent data tools, and automation that support our business teams, editorial workflows, and digital products. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on turning emerging AI capabilities into reliable, measurable solutions-not primarily a research position.
You will work across large language models (LLMs), retrieval and search, Python services, data platforms, and cloud infrastructure. An important opportunity is to extend Newsweek ’s rankings data platform, enabling business users to explore data, develop and test ranking methodologies, calculate scores, and produce explainable ranking outputs through Jupyter notebooks and reusable workflows.
The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering and data skills with good judgment about when to use LLMs, deterministic computation, traditional analytics, or a combination of these approaches. You should be comfortable taking an idea from a prototype through evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and iteration.

What You’ll Do

Applied AI Products & Intelligent Workflows

• Design and build AI-powered applications, assistants, research tools, and workflow automations for internal teams and customer-facing experiences.

• Develop LLM-based capabilities such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), semantic search, grounded question answering, summarization, and structured information extraction.

• Build tool-using AI agents and multi-step workflows where they deliver clear value, with appropriate permissions, human approval, and safeguards.

• Integrate models and AI services through well-designed APIs; use prompt engineering, structured outputs, tool/function calling, and orchestration patterns as appropriate.

• Prototype rapidly, validate with real users, and productionize successful ideas with robust error handling, observability, testing, and documentation.

Rankings, Analytics & Data Platforms

• Contribute to the evolution of Newsweek ’s rankings data warehouse and its ingestion, normalization, validation, and publication workflows.

• Build and maintain Python/Jupyter notebook templates, libraries, and repeatable workflows that empower business teams to explore datasets and develop ranking methodologies with engineering support.

• Implement reproducible scoring, weighting, normalization, segmentation, and ranking calculations; document methodology, assumptions, versions, and data provenance.

• Work with BigQuery, SQL, structured and semi-structured datasets, and cloud-based pipelines to prepare trustworthy inputs and publish validated outputs to downstream systems.

• Create data-quality checks, anomaly detection, result comparisons, audit trails, and human review steps to support defensible rankings.

• Explore AI-assisted data exploration and natural-language querying while ensuring that numeric results come from verifiable data and deterministic calculations.

Engineering, Reliability & Collaboration

• Develop production-quality Python services, APIs, batch jobs, and integrations; collaborate on architecture, code reviews, automated tests, CI/CD, and deployment.

• Evaluate AI solution quality using task-specific metrics, curated test sets, human feedback, and regression tests; monitor accuracy, latency, reliability, and cost.

• Apply security and privacy controls, access permissions, prompt-injection defenses, sensitive data handling, and responsible AI practices.

• Partner with business, editorial, product, data, and engineering stakeholders to translate ambiguous problems into scoped solutions and measurable outcomes.

• Use AI-assisted development tools effectively while independently verifying generated code and technical decisions.

Required Qualifications

• Strong professional software engineering experience, including hands-on development with Python and SQL, APIs, testing, and maintainable production systems.

• Practical experience building and deploying LLM-powered applications using model APIs and modern AI application patterns.

• Experience with RAG, embeddings, vector or hybrid retrieval, prompt/tool design, and techniques for grounding and evaluating model outputs.

• Experience with data processing, analytical workflows, and notebooks (Jupyter or equivalent); ability to translate analytical requirements into reproducible code.

• Working knowledge of relational or analytical databases and data modeling, including experience with a cloud data warehouse or equivalent platform.

• Experience with a major cloud platform (preferably Google Cloud), Gihub, and CI/CD pipelines.

• Understanding AI system tradeoffs: hallucinations, evaluation, model selection, latency, security, privacy, and inference cost.

• Ability to communicate clearly with nontechnical stakeholders, challenge assumptions constructively, and own solutions from design to production.

Nice to Have

• Hands-on experience with Google Cloud services such as BigQuery, Vertex AI/Gemini, Cloud Run, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, or Cloud Functions.

• Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or equivalent orchestration frameworks; familiarity with MCP and tool integrations.

• Knowledge of ranking and scoring models, statistical methods, entity resolution, data-quality tooling, or explainable analytical methodologies.

• Experience building governed self-service analytics workflows for business users, including reusable Jupyter notebooks and controlled publication pipelines.

• Experience with Terraform, data pipeline orchestration, event-driven services, and monitoring/observability.

• Familiarity with search and answer-engine experiences, information retrieval, knowledge graphs, or structured data-enhanced search.

• Experience in digital publishing, media, research, analytics, or data-rich consumer platforms.

What Success Looks Like

• You deliver AI tools that solve real business problems and are actively adopted by their intended users.

• You turn experiments into dependable production systems with measurable quality, performance, and operating cost.

• Business teams can use documented, reusable notebook workflows to develop and validate rankings without relying on engineering for every iteration.

postings.title: Director of Underground Explorers Program
postings.descriptionText:
About SPUN

SPUN (Society for the Protection of Underground Networks) is a startup NGO with a mission to map and protect the mycorrhizal fungal networks that regulate Earth’s climate and ecosystems. These fungi draw down approximately 13 billion tons of CO2 each year, yet they have been largely overlooked by science, policy, and practice.
Since our founding in 2021, we’ve built a global data platform to make these invisible networks measurable. Through our Underground Explorers program and network of over 700 Science Associates across more than 80 countries, with the majority in the Global South, we generate high-resolution biodiversity maps and ML-powered tools that integrate mycorrhizal data into climate, conservation, restoration, and land management decisions.
Our work spans laboratory research, data science, and robotics through to locally led field applications, and we’ve begun working with policymakers and restoration practitioners to apply our findings on the ground. With strong backing from leading foundations and growing momentum in international policy circles, we’re now at an inflection point: scaling these efforts across more landscapes, institutions, and countries over the long term.
Location: This is a remote position. You can work from Africa, Europe, North America or South America.

The Opportunity
SPUN is seeking a Director for our Underground Explorers Program (UEP) to lead its strategic direction, growth and success. The Underground Explorers Program is SPUN 's flagship grant program supporting researchers and local communities to map mycorrhizal fungal networks in their local ecosystems and advocate for their protection. Our aim is to expand our understanding of mycorrhizal fungal diversity globally using a decentralized science approach that is core to our organization.
You will own the vision, quality, and impact of the program: setting funding priorities each cycle, chairing the review and selection process, and ensuring UEP continues to fund scientifically rigorous, Global South focused, locally-led projects. This position will directly supervise the Grants & Operations Coordinator, who manages the program's day-to-day administration, and the UEP Data & Training Scientist on technical and scientific support to grantees. You will also provide program management support for SPUN ’s Ground Truth Collective (GTC), a UEP sub-program that works with local researchers to collect high-resolution data across global restoration projects. You will work closely with SPUN ’s Data Science Lead who manages the research collaboration with GTC teams, and collaborate closely with the SPUN ’s communications team on grantee storytelling. You will work with SPUN ’s CFO on budget and disbursement strategy and the Data team for grantee sequencing support.
We are looking for someone that combines scientific credibility in mycorrhizal ecology or a related field with strong program leadership and people management experience, and who is comfortable representing SPUN externally to funders, partners, and the broader scientific community.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Program Leadership

• Define funding priorities, geographic and thematic focus areas, and targets each grant cycle, using geospatial tools to identify coverage gaps and underrepresented regions or ecosystems.

• Set and revise selection criteria in line with SPUN ’s mission, including geographic underrepresentation, scientific rigor, feasibility, local-PI requirements, and Global South representation.

• Own the program budget in partnership with the CFO, including grant sizing, travel grants, and program support costs.

• Represent the UEP externally to funders, partners, and at conferences and symposia, and contribute to funder reporting and proposals.

• Identify opportunities to evolve the program model, such as new funding tracks, partnerships, or initiatives building on UEP

• Constantly revise and improve the Program reach, design and operations based on grantee feedback.

Review and Selection Oversight

• Chair the internal review committee and oversee recruitment and onboarding of external grant reviewers from the scientific community.

• Lead grantee interviews and bring final funding recommendations to the Executive Director for sign-off.

• Ensure the review process is rigorous, fair, and consistent with program values across all applicant regions.

• Decide, with the review committee, which applications are placed on the waiting list and revisited in the following cycle.

Team and Cross-Functional Leadership

• Directly supervise the Grants & Operations Coordinator: set priorities, provide regular feedback, oversight of general functions and support their professional growth.

• Serve as the escalation point for grantee issues beyond the Coordinator’s scope, including sensitive program or financial matters.

• Partner with the UEP Data & Training Scientist to ensure grantees receive appropriate technical support for sequencing, bioinformatic analysis, etc.

• Work closely with SPUN ’s communication team to design innovative approaches to highlight grantee research across media types.

• Coordinate cross-functionally with Finance/CFO, and legal to keep the program running smoothly.

• Extend UEP program management to the GTC sub-program in collaboration with the Data Science Lead, including sub-grant disbursements with the CFO, tracking sampling schedules and sample shipments, and managing the GTC budget.

Program Quality and Grantee Experience

• Design and continuously improve the grantee experience, including answering special requests from grantees.

• Track grantees access to program benefits and resolve gaps in delivery.

Program Evaluation and Reporting

• Analyze program-level data — grantee demographics, geographic and ecological coverage, and scientific output — to assess impact and identify priorities for future cycles.

• Prepare program updates and impact reports for SPUN ’s Executive Director, board, and funders.

• Work with the Coordinator to ensure the Grantee Tracker and reporting systems support high-quality program evaluation.

What we’re looking for

• PhD or equivalent experience in mycorrhizal ecology, fungal biology, soil science, or a related field.

• Experience in program design and/or grants management, ideally within a scientific, conservation, or research-funding nonprofit.

• Demonstrated experience directly supervising staff and managing cross-functional relationships.

• Track record of designing, launching, or leading a grant, fellowship, or research-funding program end-to-end.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience working with grantees or partners from different countries and cultures, particularly in the Global South.

• Comfortable representing an organization externally: funders, partners, conferences, and the media.

• Fluent in English; proficiency in Spanish or French is a strong plus, given UEP’s grantee base across Latin America and Francophone Africa.

• Strong commitment to equity and inclusion in science.

Bonus, but not required

• Experience with GoodGrants, Ramp, or Notion.

• Hands-on experience in mycorrhizal fungal research, soil biodiversity fieldwork, or environmental DNA methods.

• Existing relationships within the global mycological, soil science, or conservation research community.

Why Join SPUN

We believe in empowering people to do their best work. This is reflected in our benefits that support health, well-being, growth, and balance. They are tailored to local laws so that everyone across our globally distributed team receives the same high standard of support.

What you can expect:
Health Coverage: 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums covered for employees, plus support for dependent coverage.
Time Off: Flexible PTO with a minimum of 25 vacation days per year that we expect you to take, plus local holidays, sick leave, and wellness days.
Volunteer Days: Paid time each year to contribute your skills and energy to causes you care about.
Wellness Support: An annual health stipend, plus a flexible spending account for US-based employees.
Professional Growth: An annual professional development allowance for your learning, skills, and career progression.
Workspace & Tools: A hardware allowance to get you set up, plus monthly work-from-home and annual workspace allowances so you can work well wherever you are.
Exploration & Connection: Opportunities to travel for fieldwork, retreats, and partner collaborations, bringing our team together in person and closer to the ecosystems we work in.
Birthday Celebration: An annual birthday meal stipend, on us.
At SPUN , we embrace diversity as a fundamental pillar of our mission to protect underground ecosystems. Our commitment to decentralized science depends on the diversity of knowledge and experience on our team and among our partners across the globe. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all individuals, regardless of their race, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, or background, feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. We highly encourage individuals from traditionally underrepresented or marginalized groups, including but not limited to women, LGBTQIA+ people, individuals from the Global South, and individuals with Indigenous heritage, to apply to join our team at SPUN .
To learn more about our organization and culture, please visit our website .

Position title: Systems, Knowledge Management & Procurement Officer (Consultancy)

Organization : Aflatoun International

Location : Global (consultancy)

The Organization
Aflatoun International is a non-profit organization, which offers social, financial & entrepreneurship education to children and young people worldwide, empowering them to make a positive change for a more equitable world. Aflatoun creates high-quality curricula for different age groups, which are contextualized to local needs and circumstances, and are implemented by over 300 partner organizations in 101 countries. Aflatoun programmes inspire children to discover their talents and put them to use, to stand up for their rights and those of their communities through active learning and problem solving. They learn how to save, how to budget, and how to set up social and financial enterprises that benefit themselves, their families and their communities. Aflatoun has been recognized globally (Brookings, Harvard, HundrEd, Million Lives Club) for its high-impact, low-cost model, which has been shown to be effective in changing behaviors of participants across the globe.
By using a social franchise model, Aflatoun transfers curricular content, monitoring and evaluation tools, and training capacity to partner organisations, helping them enhance their existing expertise and create an efficient learning ecosystem. Position

The Systems, Knowledge Management & Procurement Officer will help ensure that these systems and processes are well organised, accessible and used effectively across the organisation. The role combines internal systems coordination, knowledge management, procurement administration and practical support to staff.

Role Title: Optomechanical Design Engineer — Precision CNC Parts (Remote)
Role Type: Contractor
Location: Fully remote

Opportunity Snapshot
Pay: $90 -$155/hour
Duration: Initial phase of 20 part packages; production phase to follow
Location: Fully remote, no geographic restrictions
You'll need: 5+ years designing CNC-machined production parts, technical decision authority, and access to parametric CAD software
Your tasks: Author original CAD part packages, and peer review packages from other engineers
micro1 is engaging senior optomechanical and mechanical design engineers to create original CAD part packages for a client project in precision optics and optomechanics. Your engineering judgment is what matters here — no prior AI experience required.
Each package is a new part you design from scratch: a difficult, high-value CNC part with a specific machining challenge, backed by a drawing with full GD&T, a design rationale, and a production scenario you justify from experience. Every part is independently reviewed by three other engineers, and you'll review others' work as well.

What you'll do

• Design original parts in parametric CAD, delivered as native files plus STEP.

• Produce the technical drawing: dimensions, tolerances, GD&T and datums, material and condition, finish, revision, drawing standard.

• Write the design context: intended function, interfaces, operating conditions, the machining challenge, and your material and process rationale.

• Build the production scenario: estimated unit cost and drivers, CNC cycle and setup hours, assumed volume, sourcing difficulty and lead time — with the engineering basis for each estimate.

• Peer review other engineers' packages against technical quality, production realism, and engineering value, with part-specific evidence for every score.

• Revise your own packages against review findings.

What we're looking for

• 5+ years of production engineering experience with comparable CNC parts, materials and processes in precision optics or optomechanics.

•
Technical decision authority: you owned or approved critical design choices — drawing, tolerance or material approval, production release, or enforcing engineering quality standards. Design leads, principal and staff engineers, and technical authorities are the profile.

• Experience at OEMs or specialist suppliers whose engineering standards you can reproduce.

• Strong GD&T and tolerancing judgment, including cost and inspection implications.

• Access to parametric CAD software (SolidWorks, NX, CATIA, Creo or similar) and the ability to deliver native files plus STEP.

• Industry experience, not academic.

Important: originality and IP
Every design must be your own original work. You cannot use designs owned by a current or former employer or customer, and you cannot substitute public or purchased CAD. All deliverables become the client's property. If you're currently employed, check your employment agreement regarding outside work and invention assignment before applying.

How the selection process works

• Apply and complete the screening questions

• Complete the AI interview for this role — it's how your expertise gets in front of the client

• Profile review, including evidence of comparable parts and decisions owned

• Onboarding — our Talent Ops team will get you set up

postings.title: Digital Assets Security Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca 's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role:
We are seeking a Digital Assets Security Engineer to own security for Alpaca 's crypto and tokenization products. The scope includes custody and key management, transaction authorization policies, secure engineering for wallets and tokenization, and monitoring of high-risk asset movements.
Several of the largest digital asset thefts in recent years started with a compromised signer, a manipulated signing screen, or social engineering of the people who approve transactions. This role focuses on those paths: who can move assets, under what policy, and what approvers see before they sign. You will work in both the engineering details and the governance around them.
This role reports to the CISO and works closely with the crypto and tokenization engineering teams, Crypto Operations, Compliance, GRC, and the wider Security team.
The Security Team is 100% distributed and remote.

Things You Get To Do:
The core responsibilities of the Digital Assets Security Engineer are focused on custody and key security, transaction authorization and governance, secure engineering for crypto and tokenization, and monitoring and response.

Custody and Key Security:

•
Custody Architecture: Own the security design of wallets, vaults, and signing infrastructure across hot, warm, and cold storage, including MPC and HSM configuration.

•
Key Lifecycle: Set requirements for key generation, backup, recovery, rotation, and destruction. Run or oversee key ceremonies and recovery tests with Crypto Operations.

•
Signing Integrity: Secure the path from a transaction request to a signature, including API credentials, co-signers, approval devices, and what approvers see before they sign.

Transaction Authorization and Governance:

•
Transaction Policies: Review transaction authorization policies, such as Fireblocks TAP, including approval quorums, amount thresholds, destination allowlists, and velocity limits. Recommend changes to Crypto Operations and Compliance, who own and approve them.

•
Change Control: Advise on how changes to policies, admins, signers, and allowlisted addresses are proposed, approved, and applied. Confirm every change leaves a reviewable record.

•
Access Reviews: Review admin, signer, approver, and API user access on custody platforms on a set schedule, and flag access that is no longer needed for removal.

•
Third-Party Risk: Assess custody providers, node and RPC providers, token issuers, and other digital asset vendors with Cyber GRC.

•
Standards and Evidence: In collaboration with the Cyber GRC team, write the security standards for digital asset operations, and provide technical evidence for audits and regulatory exams.

Secure Engineering for Crypto and Tokenization:

•
Design Reviews: Review architecture and code changes for wallet services, custody integrations, blockchain node infrastructure, and tokenization flows. Give engineers clear, practical requirements.

•
Threat Modeling: Threat model minting, redemption, transfers, settlement, and reconciliation between on-chain balances and internal books and records.

•
Smart Contract Review: Review token contracts and issuer controls, such as mint and burn authority, upgradeability, admin keys, and freeze functions, for tokens we support or integrate with.

•
Service Identity and Secrets: Set requirements for how services authenticate to custody platforms, including HSM-backed signing keys, scoped API credentials, and least-privilege service accounts.

Monitoring and Response:

•
Detection: Define alerts for high-risk activity, such as policy and admin changes, new destination addresses, unusual withdrawals, and signer changes. Work with Security Operations to build and tune them.

•
On-Chain Monitoring: Monitor the addresses and contracts Alpaca depends on for suspicious activity, with Security Operations and Compliance.

•
Incident Response: Lead the digital asset side of security incidents, including suspected key compromise, unauthorized transfers, and malicious approvals. Maintain playbooks to freeze, rotate, and recover.

•
On-Call: Participate in the Security on-call rotation after onboarding and cross-training.

Who You Are (Must-Haves):

• Excited about Alpaca 's mission and what we're building

• 5+ years of experience in security engineering, including 2+ years securing digital asset, crypto, or blockchain systems

• Hands-on experience with institutional custody, such as MPC or HSM-backed wallets, key backup and recovery, and policy-based transaction controls (Fireblocks,Turnkey, BitGo, Copper, or similar)

• Experience designing or reviewing transaction authorization policies, including approval quorums, amount thresholds, address allowlists, and separation of initiators, approvers, and signers

• Working knowledge of how transactions and signatures work on EVM chains and Solana, including token standards, token approvals, nonces, and finality

• A clear understanding of how digital asset theft happens in practice: signer device compromise, blind signing, social engineering of operators, address poisoning, malicious token approvals, and key exfiltration

• Able to read code and design documents well enough to challenge implementation choices, with programming experience in Python, Go, TypeScript, Rust, or similar

• Experience with cloud security, service identity, secrets management, and KMS or HSM

• Experience writing security standards and producing control evidence for auditors or regulators

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, especially when explaining risk to engineers, operators, and compliance partners

• Willing to participate in an on-call rotation

Who You Might Be (Nice-to-Haves):

• Experience securing broker-dealers, exchanges, custodians, money services businesses, or other regulated financial platforms

• Smart contract security review experience (Solidity or Rust) with tools such as Foundry, Slither, or Echidna

• Experience with tokenized securities, stablecoins, or on-chain settlement and reconciliation

• Experience running key ceremonies or designing custody recovery and disaster recovery procedures

• Experience with blockchain analytics and on-chain monitoring tools

• Ability to balance security rigor with operational efficiency and business needs

How We Take Care of You:

• Competitive Salary & Stock Options

• Health Benefits

• New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500

• Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

postings.title: Senior Art Director - Brand Designer [Argentina]
postings.descriptionText:
About JumpSeat

JumpSeat is a hybrid creative agency + advisory organization working alongside B2B marketing and revenue teams to drive growth.

We're a remote-first crew across the US, Buenos Aires and Italy. We care about bold, specific work, and about the people who make it.

The role

We're looking for a Senior Art Director / Brand Designer to join our creative team.

You'll be part of Story, our brand and creative practice. It's where we help B2B companies find the story only they have the right to tell, then make it easier to sell and harder to ignore. That covers brand development, solution storytelling, and creative campaigns, all built from the market signals we uncover for our clients.

You'd sit somewhere between a classic Art Director and a brand designer. You'll get a strategic or conceptual brief, find the idea in it, build a visual world around that idea, and then see it all the way through to the finished piece. Think key visuals, campaign identities, and brand systems that still look great on every touchpoint.

You'll have a lot of autonomy here. We trust you to make good creative calls without someone looking over your shoulder. When feedback comes in, we want you to get what's really behind it, not just tick off the comments.

You'll also help us figure out how AI fits into the way we create. We're excited about new tools and use them to explore more and move faster. But the idea, the taste, and the final call? Those stay with people.

If you've got a strong portfolio across both branding and campaigns, we'd love to talk.

What you'll do

Find the idea.

• Take strategy and messaging and turn them into visual concepts bold enough to stand out. Buyers ignore generic, and so do we.

• Explore a few different creative directions, share them, and know which one is worth fighting for.

• Bring real Art Direction thinking to every brief, not just great execution.

Build brands that scale.

• Design full brand identities and visual systems that help clients own a position competitors can't claim, not just a logo here and a one-off piece there.

• Lead brand refreshes that move things forward without losing what people already recognize.

• Make sure every system has the depth and flexibility to work wherever it ends up.

Bring campaigns to life.

• Create campaign concepts, key visuals, and campaign identities from a blank page, including ABM programs and thought leadership that give accounts already in motion a reason to engage.

• Take one big idea and carry it across websites, decks, social, paid media, events, and whatever comes next.

• Sweat the details: typography, layout, composition, color, and hierarchy.

Create with AI, lead with judgment.

• Use AI to go wider when you're exploring, test ideas quickly, and speed up production.

• Keep the concept in the driver's seat. The tools should serve the idea, not decide it.

• Edit hard and refine by hand until it feels like the brand and meets our bar.

• Share what's working with the team, because the tools keep changing and we learn faster together.

Who you are

• You're a Senior Art Director or Brand Designer with 7+ years under your belt, ideally from a strong agency or studio.

• You think in concepts first. You can tell us the idea behind a project before you show us a single frame.

• You've created original key visuals and campaign identities, not just adapted someone else's.

• You love building systems, and you've designed complete brand systems with real depth.

• You're a little obsessed with craft: typography, layout, composition, color, and visual hierarchy.

• You're independent and decisive. You can go from brief to direction without needing your hand held.

• You're great with feedback. You use it to make the work better instead of applying every comment literally.

• You're curious about new tech, AI included, and you have the eye to tell what's actually good.

• You're fluent in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite.

• You're comfortable working in English with a remote, multicultural team.

Nice to have

• You've used AI image, video, or design tools in your own creative work.

• You've worked at an agency or consultancy across different industries.

• You've done integrated or multi-channel campaigns.

• You've designed for websites and digital.

• You have a feel for motion and animation.

• You're a confident presenter who can stand behind the work.

What we'd love to see in your portfolio

We care more about how you think than how many projects you've done. So show us:

• The idea behind each project.

• How a key visual grew into a full campaign system.

• The directions you explored, not just the one that won.

• Brand systems with depth, and how they play out across formats.

• Consistent, high craft.

• Where you used AI, what you kept, and what you threw out. We love seeing process work.

How we'll get to know you

• A chat with our Talent team.

• A portfolio review, where you walk us through two or three projects from idea to execution.

• A practical case, where you show us how you'd tackle a real-world creative challenge.

• A conversation with some of our senior team.

What's in it for you

•
Real influence. You'll shape how our brands and campaigns look, and how we create them.

•
Great people. A team that will challenge you, inspire you, and have your back.

•
Remote first. Colleagues across the US, Buenos Aires, and Italy.

•
Balance, for real. Unlimited PTO, Summer Firdays, time off between holiday, and more.

Ready to take the seat?

No safe stories. If you want to own both the idea and the craft, we'd really like to hear from you.
