postings.title: Hands-on Engineering Manager (C#/Vue)
postings.descriptionText:
Location : 100% remote (EMEA + South America)
Classification : Full-time
Pay Range : €82,000–140,000; determined by several factors, including location
Miaplaza is looking for two Engineering Managers to lead two of our software development teams. We’re hiring for one existing team of 7 engineers and one new team that we will hire developers into.
This is a management role for someone who wants to grow as a manager while still remaining hands-on with code. You'll split your time roughly 50/50 between leading your team and doing hands-on work alongside them.

About Miaplaza

Miaplaza is dedicated to making education engaging and accessible through innovative online learning platforms. We develop personalized learning experiences for students, helping them grow in a supportive and interactive environment. Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive education curriculum platform where all students can be successful!
As an engineering manager at Miaplaza , your team will build technology with a direct impact on the lives of hundreds of thousands of students. Every step of the way, you will have the opportunity to influence our direction. Through our platforms, we create engaging, safe, and thoughtfully designed learning experiences that help children grow academically, creatively, and personally. Every feature we ship, every system we scale, and every improvement we make contributes to shaping how the next generation learns and discovers their potential. If our platform is down, a child might not go to school that day. We’re looking for leaders who want their work to matter in classrooms and homes, who care about access to quality education, and who are excited to craft technology that makes a difference in young people’s lives. Here, your impact doesn’t just power a product; it shapes future generations!

What you’ll work on
We’re a C# and platform growing towards a scale that no longer matches our legacy architecture. You’ll need to work with your team balancing both product and engineering initiatives. You’ll report to our head of engineering and be expected to split your time roughly 50/50 between people management and hands-on development. Prioritization always goes to leading and supporting your engineers.

How management works at Miaplaza

We're a US-based company, so this may differ from what you've done before:

• You start as an engineer. You’ll onboard as a senior engineer on your own team for two months, begin manager onboarding in month two, and take over the team at around week 10. Both phases matter equally, and this isn’t negotiable.

• You stay hands-on. Around 50% of your time stays hands-on after onboarding, but leading and supporting your engineers always comes first.

• You teach. Growing your engineers and those around you is a core responsibility. You'll have full oversight of your direct reports' work, because you can't teach well without seeing the process behind the output.

• Feedback is the norm. You'll give specific reinforcement and constructive feedback whenever you notice something, and you'll receive it too.

Requirements

What you must bring
We can only move forward with candidates who meet these requirements:

• 7+ years of experience in software development in one or more object-oriented programming languages

• 3+ years of experience with front-end software development in a reactive front-end framework

• 3+ years of experience with software architecture

• 3+ years of experience operating at a Senior, Staff, or Principal Engineer level

• 2+ years of experience being a mentor/leader

• 1+ years leading a team, formally or as a tech lead

• Experience working directly with product and design on scoping and prioritization

• Experience being on-call and resolving production incidents

• A bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience

What makes you stand out

• Experience leading a team through a significant architectural migration

• Experience with consumer platforms at scale

• Experience building in regulated environments

• Experience with DevOps technologies (eg K8s, IaC, sysadmin, build pipelines, etc.)

• Extensive senior front-end development experience

Responsibilities

• Work with your teams to design, develop, and maintain scalable and reliable web applications using primarily C# and Vue.js

• Collaborate with your product trio (PM, UX, EM), product leadership team, and other EMs to scope, prioritize, and deliver features that matter to students and families

• Set the quality bar for your team. You'll have dedicated capacity for reliability and architecture work rather than fitting it around feature delivery, and a strong say in where that capacity goes.

• Manage, lead, and mentor your team while working side by side with them in code quality, clean architecture, soft skills, best practices, etc

• Lead team trainings, set SMART goals, hold performance reviews, and provide individual feedback recurrently to each of your devs

Our hiring process
As a remote company, we receive a large number of applicants, so our process is longer than usual. At every stage we try to respect your time.

• Application and CV review. We review your application answers and CV, then follow up with an update.

• Initial technical screen (20 min). A few administrative questions and short technical questions related to the role.

• Behavioral interview (1 hour). With a member of our HR team, about your experience and approach so far.

• 1st technical interview (1 hour). With a member of the engineering team to answer technical questions tailored to our work.

• 2nd technical interview (1 hour). With a member of the engineering team to dive into a hypothetical scenario and how you’d tackle it.

• Leadership interview (1 hour). With our Head of Engineering or executive leadership.

• Reference check. We contact the 3 references you provide, including at least one former or current manager, a colleague, and a former or current direct report.

• Offer and background check. Once you sign your offer, we run a background check in accordance with applicable law.

We give honest, timely feedback at every step. Job searches are hard; we don't want to make yours harder.

Compensation
The pay range for this role is €82,000 - 140,000. Our compensation philosophy aims for equity and competitiveness while considering regional differences in labor costs. Placement in the range depends on demonstrated skills, internal equity and local labor market rates for your area.
Miaplaza is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. If you need accommodations at any point in the process, just let us know.

postings.title: Principal, Visual Design
postings.descriptionText:
WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

THE ROLE:

The Principal, Visual Design role requires a visionary approach, collaborating with the creative team to not only meet client needs but to establish new benchmarks for conceptual and visual design excellence. A core responsibility is to challenge the team's thinking, pushing beyond conventional problem-solving to deliver transformative, best-in-class solutions.

The ideal candidate is a design expert combining a deep focus on users and an exceptional eye for detail with strong leadership, collaboration, and execution skills. You possess the conviction to lead when necessary and the humility to follow great ideas, regardless of their source. You are committed to meticulous detail and leveraging every challenge as an opportunity for growth.

As part of the creative leadership team, you will play a crucial role in executing the overarching creative and design strategy, ensuring the team's activities align with and significantly contribute to the organization's strategic short and long-term success.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

• Closely collaborate with multidisciplinary teams of talented people.

• Lead and mentor the creative team, fostering a collaborative, optimistic, and proactive culture.

• Bring a fresh, insightful point of view that inspires both the internal team and the client, putting the team and client first.

• Define and implement successful design strategies, setting high visual and conceptual standards for all company efforts (including websites, branding, UX, and content).

• Generate strategic insights and moodboards to facilitate creative innovation.

• Drive complex digital projects from kick-off to completion, ensuring the team's deliverables exceed client expectations and stay within budget and deadlines.

• Establish project direction, craft guidelines, and assist with production as needed.

• Identify key client decision-makers and leverage excellent interpersonal skills to grow and maintain these relationships, collaborating across all internal departments and external stakeholders to achieve desired results.

• Actively contribute to the design discipline through mentoring, conversation, and proposing ideas to elevate company operations and improve processes.

WHAT YOU BRING:

• 5+ years of proven experience in design and interactive work for leading brands, including 2+ years in a leadership role.

• Bachelor’s Degree in Design, Visual Arts, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

• Mastery of Figma (including components, variants, and auto layout) and familiarity with essential collaboration tools (e.g., Hubspot, Google Suite, Slack).

• Strong knowledge and experience in visual design, user-centered experience design, interaction design, and brand development. Experience developing and maintaining a robust design system.

• Demonstrated ability to provide strategic vision and creative inspiration to large, diverse teams.

• Excellent public speaking and presentation skills with the ability to clearly articulate complex information to clients and internal stakeholders.

• Highly detail-oriented, proactive, comfortable navigating complex organizations, and focused on strategic problem-solving and process efficiency

TAKE INTO ACCOUNT:

• You will have to communicate with your team members abroad, therefore fluency in English and excellent communication skills (both written and verbal) are a must for this role.

• This role will require you to work EST hours.

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

• We enjoy spending time together, working closely with other local colleagues, and getting to know one another. Our Buenos Aires offices (Villa Crespo or Mar del Plata) are fully equipped with refreshments and great common spaces!

• Premium healthcare through OSDE for the employee and their immediate family members

• Mendel prepaid card with a monthly allowance for grocery purchases

• Monthly reimbursements for Wi-Fi/electricity expenses

• Monthly reimbursements for training/English classes

• 100% covered “Plan Total” membership at Sportclub

• Access to a our benefits platform through Bonda

• A flexible vacation policy

WE SUPPORT YOU BEING YOU:

DEPT® is an equal opportunity employer (EOE). We believe our work is its best when our people feel safe and free to be themselves. We’re committed to an inclusive and barrier-free recruitment and selection process and workplace, regardless of anyone’s identity, background, beliefs, lifestyle or disabilities. So tell us about any accommodations you need. It’s totally confidential and only used to make sure you feel fully supported at every step.

DEPT® participates in E-Verify, meaning your Form I-9 information will be sent to the federal government to confirm you are authorized to work in the U.S.

We are a B Corp-certified company passionate about purpose-driven work . Our hope is that you can feel good about the contributions DEPT® is making to the world and we always have an open door for your ideas in making the world a better place.

DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Coach, eBay, and OpenAI.

Learn more about DEPT®

DIVERSITY, EQUITY, & INCLUSION

At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.

Want to know more about our dedication to diversity, equity, and inclusion? Check out our efforts here .

postings.title: Head of US, Multimodal Clearing
postings.descriptionText:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

The Team:

This role is to join a "tip of the spear" team that brought Alpaca's ITN to market. We focus on building bleeding edge products that push the envelope for the entire industry. Alpaca's ITN is the world's first and only example of multimodal clearing; we invented the category. You will be joining a winning team that takes products from zero to one in the most authentic sense of the phrase with a track record to prove it. Expectations of excellence and technical competence are extremely high. This is not just any team at Alpaca: this is an elite squad of seasoned serial entrepreneurs with high agency responsible for the very innovations that generate Alpaca's competitive edge.

Your Role:

You are the US lead for Alpaca's multimodal clearing initiative. You hold the design conversations with clearinghouses, venues, blockchains, prime brokers and market makers, and you run the Washington work that a clearing agency needs: the SEC and the industry process around governance for the Longtable Foundation and proposed clearinghouse or partner clearinghouses.

You are the person in the room who can talk market structure with regulated clearinghouses, and then turn that into a build the engineering and product leads can execute. You work with the product, engineering, and legal leads on this team, and with Alpaca leadership.

Things You Get To Do:

• Own the US partner map for the clearinghouse: who we build with, who we clear for, and what we ask of each

• Lead solution design with outside clearing experts and onchain architects, from atomic settlement, netting through

• Represent the project to venues, issuers, and market makers on the roadshow, then drive each follow-up to a signed and scoped partnership

• Hire and direct the US operating core as the license work and the member pipeline grow

Who You Are (Must-Haves):

• Deep US market-structure experience across exchanges, broker-dealers, or clearing agencies

• A track record of getting something through a regulator or a member-owned market utility, not only of advising on one

• Enough technical fluency to argue a clearing design: novation, margin, default waterfall, and where a smart contract can and cannot replace a clearing agency

• Credibility with the people who run US equity market structure today

• Clear writing and a calm way of holding a multi-party negotiation

• Deft ability to use AI to produce prototypes instantly

• Ability to communicate with and manage engineers and gain respect amongst peers for technical depth

• Command of securities and commodities market structure, especially clearing and what essential function clearinghouses perform

• Market microstructure. An unequivocal capability to explain how liquidity flows in capital markets and the nuances of different asset classes and layers of the value chain (custody, brokering, matching, dealing, clearing, settlement, etc.)

• An equal command of tokenization and crypto market structure, specifically tokenized equities, borrow/lending and DEXs, and the differences between execution methods: CLOBs, AMMs, PropAMMs, OTC, RFQ, atomic swaps

• Organizational skills bordering obsessive-compulsive. You are the type of person that takes pride in clean and organized presentation materials

Who You Might Be (Nice-to-Haves):

• Series 7 / 24 or prior clearing-agency, exchange, or FINRA membership work

• Hands-on time with tokenized securities, onchain settlement, or a CCP rulebook

• Existing relationships at the SEC Division of Trading and Markets, DTCC, or a registered clearing agency

• Experience working at a startup

• Experience working remotely and across time zones, async first

How We Take Care of You:

• Competitive Salary & Stock Options

• Health Benefits

• New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500

• Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

postings.descriptionText:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. The Team:

This role is to join a "tip of the spear" team that brought Alpaca's ITN to market. We focus on building bleeding edge products that push the envelope for the entire industry. Alpaca's ITN is the world's first and only example of multimodal clearing, we invented the category. You will be joining a winning team that takes products from zero to one in the most authentic sense of the phrase with a track record to prove it. Expectations of excellence and technical competence are extremely high. This is not just any team at Alpaca, this is an elite squad of seasoned serial entrepreneurs with high agency responsible for the very innovations that generate Alpaca's competitive edge.

Your Role:

As Lead Product Manager, Multimodal Clearing, you will define and build a new category of market infrastructure: a multimodal clearinghouse that nets and mitigates settlement failures across the traditional and tokenized forms of the same security, across venues, token standards, and blockchains. Tokenized equities trade in isolated venues today and depend on market makers pre-funding inventory everywhere they quote. You will own the product that brings post-trade settlement, multilateral netting, and in-kind convertibility to onchain markets, so liquidity can move freely between tradfi and defi. The product builds on Alpaca's Instant Tokenization Network (ITN), which already lets participants mint and redeem tokenized equities against their traditional counterparts instantly and 24/7 within Alpaca. Your job is to take that model industry-wide: an open clearing standard and technology layer that licensed clearinghouses use to serve clearing members, broker-dealers, tokenization agents and token issuers, trading venues and ATSs, onchain RFQ and intent protocols, bridges, market makers, transfer agents, and CSDs. You will work hand in hand with clearinghouse leadership, engineering, risk, legal, compliance, operations, and with external partners and regulators. We're looking for someone who knows how clearing really works (novation, netting, margin, collateral, default management, settlement cycles) and how blockchains really work (smart contracts, oracles, vaults, cross-chain messaging), and who can turn a whitepaper into a shipped, regulated product. You are as comfortable walking a clearing member or regulator through a default scenario as you are reviewing a smart contract design with engineers.

Things You Get To Do:

• Own the product vision, roadmap, and success metrics for the multimodal clearinghouse, from the first live MVP through cross-chain clearing and a fully onchain clearing layer

• In your first 3 months, ship the first production use case: post-trade settlement for atomic onchain RFQ

• Within 12 months, extend the backstop to cross-chain bridging and to share-for-token tradfi interoperability

• Design the clearing mechanics with risk and engineering: a 24/7 settlement cycle, the multilateral netting engine, margin and haircuts for collateral pledged onchain (“in the net”) and offchain (“outside the net”)

• Define the onchain primitives (portfolio margin vaults, margincoins, claim vouchers, oracle-published netting-cycle signatures) and the open source reference smart contracts, such as RFQ solvers, token deployers, and vault adapters, that partners implement. Own the member and partner experience: onboarding for clearing members, tokenization agents, venues, and protocols; certification of implementations against the standard; APIs, documentation, sandbox, and settlement reporting. Partner with legal and compliance on the regulatory path for clearing tokenized securities in the US and internationally, and translate requirements into product, operational design and go-to-market materials. Run discovery with issuers, broker-dealers, CSDs, venues, market makers, and DeFi protocols, and represent the product credibly in partner, industry, and standards conversations.

Who You Are (Must-Haves):

• Visceral understanding of Clayton Christensen's JTBD Framework and a no nonsense approach to achieving product-market fit. Relentless execution towards this singular goal with no time for fluff or scope creep

• Demonstrable evidence of shipping products that people want and generating revenue (b2b) or other unit of value (consumer)

• Deft ability to use AI to produce prototypes instantly

• Ability to communicate and manage engineers and gain respect amongst peers for technical depth. Command of securities and commodities market structure, especially clearing and what essential function clearinghouses perform. Market microstructure: an unequivocal capability to explain how liquidity flows in capital markets and the nuances of different asset classes and layers of the value chain (custody, brokering, matching, dealing, clearing, settlement). An equal command of tokenization and crypto market structure, specifically tokenized equities, borrow/lending and DEXs, and the differences between execution methods: CLOBs, AMMs, PropAMMs, OTC, RFQ, atomic swaps. Organizational skills bordering obsessive-compulsive. You are the type of person that takes pride in clean and organized presentation materials. Project management skills including running cross-functional projects, status updates, monitoring progress and defining OKRs and building cohort retention charts are bread and butter for you.

Who You Might Be (Nice-to-Haves):

• Senior ownership of clearing, settlement, or post-trade infrastructure at a clearinghouse, CSD, clearing broker, exchange, or self-clearing broker-dealer

• Track record of shipping regulated financial products (SEC, CFTC, or non-US equivalents), ideally including clearing agency registration or exemptive relief

• Built on or with DeFi protocols: lending markets and vaults, RFQ intent protocols and solvers, or perpetual futures venues. Familiarity with derivatives clearing, including perpetual futures and portfolio margining. Experience with industry standards bodies, open source protocols, or consortium governance.

• Experience working at a startup

• Experience working remotely and across time zones, async first

postings.descriptionText:
Santex is a global Certified B technology company as well as one of North America's fastest-growing companies, according to the Inc. 5000. It’s present in 18 countries and over 100 cities, and headquartered in Argentina with offices in the United States, Mexico, and Peru.

Its two service lines — AI Tech Consulting and AI-Optimized Engineering — help organizations comprehensively adopt technology, expand their capabilities, and improve business outcomes at scale.

Santex. A company with purpose and judgment. Yes, it's possible.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any of these factors. We strongly encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Job Description: Software Engineer (Backend)
This covers a Mid-Senior Engineer position supporting the various Integration products.
Position: Software Engineer (Full-Stack — Must: Node.js / AWS)
Reports to: Engineering Manager / Engineering Team Lead

Position Summary: We are looking for skilled Mid-Senior Software Engineers to join our Engineering team supporting various Integration initiatives like Digital Payments (Node.js/AWS serverless stack), Data Integration (a SQL Server-backed backend service) and Building APIs. You will work across all three codebases — this is not a single-stack role — moving between a SQL Server-backed backend service and event-driven AWS Lambda microservices provisioned via Terraform, depending on sprint priorities. You will take ownership of engineering quality, architecture, and delivery across these systems, collaborating closely with SDETs and Product to ensure reliable, well-tested releases.

Essential Functions

• Design, build, and maintain features across our Data Integration and payments/API systems.

• Build and connect secure APIs, keeping employee-facing and public-facing access clearly separated.

• Use AI coding tools (Claude, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate development, testing, and documentation.

• Write clean, well-tested code and maintain high quality through code review.

• Optimize application performance, responsiveness, and reliability.

• Debug and resolve issues, including production incidents.

• Participate in Agile ceremonies and collaborate with QA to ensure thorough testing before release.

• Participate in on-call rotation and plan for deployments outside standard business hours.

Skills and Abilities Required
Must-Haves:

• Proficiency in JavaScript/Node.js and building serverless applications on AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, EventBridge etc.).

• Experience with RDS/PostgreSQL or similar relational databases

• Proficiency in T-SQL / SQL Server.

• Hands-on experience with Terraform for infrastructure as code.

• Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Azure Pipelines or equivalent).

• Experience building and consuming REST APIs.

• Understanding of event-driven and microservices architecture.

Nice-to-Haves:

• Experience with SCIM 2.0 or identity/access management systems.

• Experience with Dynatrace or similar APM/observability tooling.

• Experience with DACPAC-based SQL Server deployment workflows.

• AWS certification (e.g., Solutions Architect Associate).

• Experience in payments, fintech, or restaurant/retail technology domains.

Education

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Experience

• 4–8 years of professional software engineering experience.

• Experience delivering production software across multiple, architecturally distinct systems preferred.

• Experience working in Agile or team-based development environments preferred.

Accountability / Scope

• People Management: No.

• Scope: Individual contributor responsible for delivering assigned software components/features across multiple project/products

• Decision Making: Makes implementation decisions within defined designs, standards, and guidance.

• Work Schedule: Requires participation in an on-call rotation and availability for off-hours deployments and incident response.

postings.descriptionText:
Join Our Team
 
Oowlish, one of Latin America's rapidly expanding software development companies, is seeking experienced technology professionals to enhance our diverse and vibrant team.
 
As a valued member of Oowlish, you will collaborate with premier clients from the United States and Europe, contributing to pioneering digital solutions. Our commitment to creating a nurturing work environment is recognized by our certification as a Great Place to Work, where you will have opportunities for professional development, growth, and a chance to make a significant international impact.
 
We offer the convenience of remote work, allowing you to craft a work-life balance that suits your personal and professional needs. We're looking for candidates who are passionate about technology, proficient in English, and excited to engage in remote collaboration for a worldwide presence.


About the Role:
We are looking for an experienced Senior IBM BPM / IBM Business Automation Workflow (BAW) Developer to design, develop, enhance, and maintain business-critical workflow applications in complex enterprise environments.
This role focuses on building and supporting scalable business process solutions, integrating workflow applications with enterprise systems, and ensuring the reliability, performance, security, and maintainability of existing applications.
The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on experience with IBM BPM and/or IBM BAW, business process modeling, enterprise integrations, and production support.
You will collaborate with developers, business analysts, architects, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver high-quality solutions within an Agile development environment.

Responsibilities:
• Collaborate directly with business stakeholders to understand operational processes, data challenges, and opportunities for automation.

• Analyze existing business workflows and identify opportunities to improve efficiency using data engineering and AI.

• Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and integration solutions.

• Build data processing workflows that support AI-powered applications, analytics, and business automation.

• Integrate data from multiple enterprise systems, APIs, databases, and external sources.

• Develop reliable data transformation, validation, and processing solutions.

• Prepare and structure enterprise data for use in AI-powered applications and intelligent workflows.

• Design and implement solutions that connect business data with Large Language Models and AI services.

• Build automated workflows that reduce manual operations and improve business efficiency.

• Translate ambiguous business requirements into technical designs and actionable implementation plans.

• Evaluate data availability, quality, reliability, security, and integration requirements.

• Develop prototypes and proof-of-concept solutions to validate AI and automation opportunities.

• Collaborate with software engineers and stakeholders to integrate data-driven solutions into business applications.

• Implement monitoring, testing, and data quality practices.

• Troubleshoot data pipeline failures, integration issues, and production incidents.

• Take ownership of solutions from initial discovery through deployment and continuous improvement.

• Communicate technical decisions, progress, and business outcomes to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Identify opportunities for continuous improvement in data architecture, automation, and operational efficiency.

Requirements:
• Strong professional experience in data engineering and enterprise data integration.

• Proven experience designing, developing, and maintaining production data pipelines.

• Strong programming skills, particularly with Python, SQL, or comparable data engineering technologies.

• Experience with ETL/ELT processes, data transformation, and data processing.

• Experience integrating data from APIs, databases, and enterprise systems.

• Strong understanding of data modeling, data quality, and data architecture.

• Practical experience developing or integrating AI-powered solutions.

• Solid understanding of LLMs and their application to enterprise data.

• Experience working with cloud-based data platforms and services.

• Experience developing reliable and maintainable production data solutions.

• Understanding of business processes and operational workflows.

• Experience translating business requirements into technical solutions.

• Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

• Experience collaborating directly with business stakeholders or customers.

• Ability to independently own technical initiatives from discovery through delivery.

• Strong communication skills and a product-oriented mindset.

Must Have:
• Strong hands-on data engineering experience.

• Proven experience designing and maintaining production data pipelines.

• Strong programming and SQL capabilities.

• Experience with ETL/ELT and data transformation.

• Experience integrating enterprise data from multiple systems and sources.

• Practical experience developing or integrating AI-powered solutions, applications, or workflows.

postings.title: Talent Specialist - General & Admin - Argentina
postings.descriptionText:
ABOUT HALTER

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard. 

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund https://foundersfund.com, Bessemer Venture Partners https://www.bvp.com/, BOND, https://www.bondcap.com/ DCVC https://www.dcvc.com/, Blackbird https://www.blackbird.vc/, Promus Ventures https://www.promusventures.com/, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures https://www.icehouseventures.co.nz/?utm_term=icehouse%20ventures&utm_campaign=Brand+Keywords&utm_source=adwords&utm_medium=ppc&hsa_acc=4064636360&hsa_cam=16902737884&hsa_grp=134004309485&hsa_ad=592971340272&hsa_src=g&hsa_tgt=kwd-1082530126230&hsa_kw=icehouse%20ventures&hsa_mt=b&hsa_net=adwords&hsa_ver=3&gclid=Cj0KCQjw2v-gBhC1ARIsAOQdKY0J0DepRVFDmjQlAkJPbZuQnLSA5UVzUzOXYiPxkjX-SeVa513_BhkaAr-MEALw_wcB.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/halter-limited & Instagram https://www.instagram.com/lifeathalter/.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Great companies are built by great people, and that’s where you come in.

As a key member of the Talent team, you’ll play a hands-on role in attracting, sourcing, and hiring world-class talent to support our business as we scale globally. You’ll work closely with hiring managers to understand their team needs, anticipate upcoming roles, and manage end-to-end recruitment processes that bring exceptional people into Halter who align with our mission and values.

Reporting to the Talent Lead, General & Admin, you’ll own recruitment across our General & Admin portfolio, spanning Finance, Legal, People, Talent, Commercial Strategy, Marketing, and Executive Operations. You’ll partner with leaders across these critical business functions, managing varied and often specialised hiring needs while building strong pipelines for current and future roles.

You’ll develop and execute tailored recruitment strategies, provide trusted advice to hiring managers, and deliver a world-class candidate experience that reflects the calibre of our product, team, and culture. This role is perfect for someone who enjoys learning about different areas of a business, can confidently navigate a diverse portfolio, and thrives on building trusted relationships with stakeholders.

If you’re curious, commercially minded, energised by variety, and love the thrill of finding exactly the right person, you’ll feel at home here.




WHAT YOUR DAY WILL LOOK LIKE

 - Manage full-cycle recruitment across our General & Admin functions, from sourcing and screening through to coordinating interviews, assessments, and offer processes.

 - Develop tailored sourcing and recruitment strategies for a diverse portfolio of roles, including specialist and leadership positions.

 - Build and maintain strong candidate pipelines for current and future hiring needs, proactively identifying talent through multiple channels.

 - Partner closely with hiring managers and leaders to understand role requirements, team goals, organisational context, and the capabilities needed for success.

 - Provide trusted, data-informed guidance throughout the hiring process, helping managers make confident and effective decisions.

 - Help hiring teams run smooth, effective, and inclusive recruitment processes.

 - Deliver an exceptional and consistent candidate experience at every stage, reflecting Halter’s culture and values.

 - Ensure every communication and interaction contributes positively to our employer brand.

 - Maintain our ATS and recruitment workflows, ensuring hiring activity is accurate, efficient, and well organised.

 - Track and share key metrics, including time-to-fill, pipeline health, source effectiveness, and candidate feedback, to continuously improve our approach.

 - Support broader initiatives across internal mobility, diversity, talent planning, and employer branding.

 - Identify opportunities to improve our recruitment processes, tools, and ways of working as we scale.

 - We’re a fast-moving growth company, so from time to time, other responsibilities will pop up—and you’ll be part of making it all happen!


WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

 - Must be fluent in both Spanish and English 

 - Experience in talent acquisition, ideally within a high-growth or global technology environment.

 - A proven track record of delivering high-quality hires across varied levels, functions, and regions.

 - Strong experience developing tailored sourcing strategies and proactively identifying specialist talent.

 - A strategic business partner who can zoom in and out—from workforce planning and leadership reporting to hands-on sourcing and day-to-day hiring delivery.

 - Excellent interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to advise, influence, and constructively challenge hiring teams.

 - Demonstrated success managing a varied portfolio of roles in a fast-paced environment without compromising the quality of talent or candidate experience.

 - Deep knowledge of sourcing techniques, tools, and channels, with a strong understanding of what it takes to identify and engage exceptional talent globally.

 - Strong reporting and data skills, with the ability to track, analyse, and clearly communicate key hiring metrics and insights.

 - Familiarity with employment law, immigration requirements, and compliance in Argentina —and ideally Uruguay.

 - High emotional intelligence and excellent communication skills.

 - A proactive, solutions-focused approach, with the ability to thrive in ambiguity and take strong ownership and accountability.


OUR BENEFITS

 - Importantly, we offer an inclusive and attractive remuneration package made up of salary, benefits and restricted stock units, so you own a part of what we’re building.

 - Healthy body, healthy mind. You’ll be on the OSDE 410 plan, fully paid by Halter with dependents included, giving you comprehensive maternity cover, dental and vision, and complementary therapies like acupuncture.

 - Mental health matters. You’ll have access to up to 30 sessions per year of individual or group therapy, plus up to 15 sessions per family group for bonding therapy.

 - Our personal growth is important. Halter offers an annual US$750 personal growth fund to be used for anything that fuels personal growth.

 - We offer 26 weeks of paid parental leave for primary caregivers, 4 weeks of paid leave for the other parent, and flexible return-to-work options.


OUR OFFICE FIRST APPROACH

Humans are wired for connection. Being office first is a core pillar of our culture because in-person connections drive your growth, learning, impact, and relationships. Strong relationships make it easier to disagree, give feedback, and do meaningful work together.

We're office first, not office only. Working from the office is our default, but we flex when needed. We have a high-trust culture where everyone is trusted to do what's best for Halter.

Our office vibe is special, the high energy and spectacular people make work enjoyable. Your growth and impact are unlimited here, coming from solving problems, innovating, and constantly learning from each other.


JOIN OUR TEAM

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page https://www.halterhq.com/careers for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/halter-limited & Instagram https://www.instagram.com/lifeathalter/.




WHY OUR TEAM LOVES WORKING AT HALTER:

 - Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

 - Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

 - You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our personal growth fund.

 - This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

This role is open to candidates based in LATAM, Africa, and Eastern Europe. Please note that as this role supports U.S.-based clients, candidates must be available to work during U.S. business hours aligned with the client’s time zone.

 

Our client is focused on improving business efficiency through AI, automation, and system integrations. The company seeks to develop practical AI-powered solutions that connect business tools, reduce manual work, and improve productivity across the organization.




ROLE OVERVIEW

The AI Solutions Specialist will build, implement, and maintain AI-powered solutions, automated workflows, and integrations between business systems.

This is a hands-on technical role focused on developing AI agents, automating business processes, and building internal tools that improve efficiency. The ideal candidate has experience working with APIs, webhooks, and modern AI tools such as Claude, with the ability to translate business requirements into reliable automated workflows.




LOCATION

Fully Remote (Work from Home) | 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


AI & AUTOMATION

 - Build AI-powered automations to streamline business processes.

 - Create AI agents that perform specific tasks and support team members.

 - Use Claude and other AI tools to build practical business solutions.

 - Identify repetitive processes and determine how they can be automated.

 - Test, maintain, and continuously improve AI workflows and agents.
   
   


INTEGRATIONS & APIS

 - Build integrations between different business systems and applications.

 - Work with APIs, webhooks, and data flows to connect platforms.

 - Troubleshoot integration issues and resolve broken workflows.

 - Ensure information moves accurately and reliably between systems.
   
   


WORKFLOW DEVELOPMENT

 - Build automated workflows using platforms such as n8n, Make, Zapier, or similar tools.

 - Translate business requirements into technical workflows.

 - Document automations and ensure they are maintainable.

 - Monitor automated processes and implement improvements as needed.
   
   


TOOLS & PROCESS IMPROVEMENT

 - Build internal tools that reduce manual work and improve team productivity.

 - Evaluate new AI and automation tools and identify practical use cases.

 - Identify opportunities to improve existing workflows through AI and integrations.

 - Collaborate with different teams to understand their processes and recommend automation opportunities.
   
   


QUALIFICATIONS


EXPERIENCE

 - 2+ years of professional experience in automation, AI implementation, technical operations, or a related field.

 - Hands-on experience building system integrations and automated workflows.

 - Experience working with APIs and webhooks.

 - Experience using Claude or other modern AI tools.

 - Experience building or implementing AI agents.

 - Experience with n8n, Make, Zapier, or similar automation platforms is preferred.

 - Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) is a plus.

 - Basic coding or scripting experience is preferred.

 - Experience working with databases and CRM platforms is a plus.

 - Experience building dashboards or automated reporting is preferred.

 - Experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code or Codex is a plus.
   
   


SKILLS

 - Strong understanding of APIs, webhooks, and system integrations.

 - Ability to build, test, maintain, and improve AI-powered automation workflows.

 - Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills to resolve integration and workflow issues.

 - Ability to translate business problems and requirements into practical technical solutions.

 - Strong systems thinking and ability to identify automation opportunities.

 - Ability to work independently and take ownership of projects.

 - Strong attention to detail when developing and maintaining automated processes.

 - Strong technical curiosity and interest in AI and emerging technologies.

 - Ability to quickly learn new platforms and automation tools.

 - Practical, execution-focused approach to reducing repetitive work and improving business efficiency.
   
   


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - Manual processes are consistently identified and automated.

 - AI agents reliably handle defined business tasks.

 - Systems are connected through stable integrations and APIs.

 - Automations reduce manual work and improve team efficiency.

 - AI and automation tools are adopted effectively across the business.

 - Workflows are documented, maintained, and continuously improved.
   
   


OPPORTUNITY

The AI Solutions Specialist will work at the intersection of AI, automation, integrations, and business operations.


APPLICATION PROCESS:


TO BE CONSIDERED FOR THIS ROLE THESE STEPS NEED TO BE FOLLOWED:

 - Fill in the application form

 - Record a video showcasing your skill sets

Our client manages marketing across a growing portfolio of B2C home-service brands, including garage door repair and outdoor remodeling companies. The company focuses on generating qualified local leads through Google Ads, Meta Ads, high-converting landing pages, CRM automations, and reliable tracking infrastructure.

The client has established detailed SOPs, campaign frameworks, AI tools, and custom systems to support marketing execution across multiple brands and locations.




ROLE OVERVIEW

The Performance Marketing Specialist will execute marketing initiatives across multiple brands, locations, and campaigns, focusing on competitor research, localized campaign development, landing-page optimization, AI-assisted creative production, technical tracking, and CRM workflows.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused role suited to someone who understands local-service marketing and can independently complete assignments using established SOPs, tools, and direction. The client will retain ownership of the overall paid-media strategy and advertising budgets, while the Marketing Manager will focus on campaign setup, creative development, landing pages, research, and technical execution.




LOCATION

Fully Remote (Work from Home) | 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


COMPETITOR RESEARCH & CAMPAIGN EXECUTION

 - Research competitor ads, offers, landing pages, lead forms, and creative using Meta Ads Library and Google.

 - Build campaigns for different locations and brands based on existing campaign structures and client direction.

 - Develop ad copy, headlines, offers, and creative variations that align with each brand while remaining distinct across markets.

 - Support Google Ads and Meta Ads campaign setup, including campaign assets, audience structures, location changes, and testing variations.
   
   


LANDING PAGES & CONVERSION OPTIMIZATION

 - Build, update, and optimize landing pages using WordPress, Lovable, and other AI-powered website-building tools.

 - Create localized landing pages for new services, cities, and brands, ensuring distinct visual identities and messaging.

 - Apply conversion-focused principles to page layouts, CTAs, offers, trust badges, reviews, testimonials, videos, forms, and mobile experiences.

 - Review landing-page performance and recommend practical improvements to maintain strong lead conversion rates.
   
   


AI CREATIVE & CONTENT DEVELOPMENT

 - Use approved AI tools to create and adapt ad images, video creative, captions, testimonials, and design assets.

 - Adapt successful campaign concepts into differentiated creative variations for other services, locations, and brands.

 - Edit and organize creative assets for use across campaigns and landing pages.
   
   


TRACKING, CRM & TECHNICAL EXECUTION

 - Set up, audit, and troubleshoot UTM parameters, Meta Pixel, Google Tag Manager, GA4, form tracking, call tracking, and conversion events.

 - Ensure leads are accurately captured, attributed, and routed through the CRM and existing automation workflows.

 - Identify and resolve technical issues affecting campaigns, landing pages, forms, tracking, or website performance.

 - Coordinate with external developers or technical contractors when needed, managing issues through to resolution.
   
   


ORGANIZATION & COLLABORATION

 - Follow established SOPs while maintaining organized campaigns, creative assets, landing pages, and tracking across multiple brands.

 - Provide updates on completed work, outstanding items, testing opportunities, and technical issues requiring approval.

 - Work closely with the client to execute new ideas accurately and efficiently as new campaigns and markets are launched.
   
   


QUALIFICATIONS


EXPERIENCE

 - 3+ years of professional experience in growth marketing, performance marketing, digital marketing, or marketing operations.

 - Experience supporting lead-generation campaigns for B2C, local-service, home-service, or multi-location businesses.

 - Demonstrated experience building and optimizing landing pages that generate qualified form submissions and phone calls.

 - Experience managing marketing activities across multiple brands, accounts, locations, or campaigns simultaneously.

 - Experience with Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager, including campaign setup and asset creation.

 - Experience working with CRMs, lead forms, automated follow-up workflows, and reporting systems.

 - Experience using AI tools to create images, videos, ad creative, copy, and landing-page concepts.
   
   


SKILLS

 - Strong working knowledge of WordPress, Lovable, Webflow, Framer, or similar website-building platforms.

 - Strong understanding of landing-page conversion principles, consumer psychology, and local lead-generation funnels.

 - Proficiency with GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, UTMs, and conversion tracking.

 - Ability to identify and troubleshoot technical tracking, campaign, landing-page, and website issues.

 - Basic knowledge of HTML and CSS is strongly preferred.

 - Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

 - Ability to follow established SOPs and independently execute assignments.

 - Proactive problem-solving skills and ability to investigate technical issues and coordinate solutions.

 - Strong eye for design, messaging, and details that influence conversion.

 - High attention to detail and ability to maintain quality and consistency across brands.

 - Ability to execute marketing initiatives quickly and accurately.
   
   


PORTFOLIO RECOMMENDATION

A portfolio demonstrating hands-on experience with local lead-generation campaigns, landing-page development, conversion optimization, and digital advertising creative.

Relevant examples include localized landing pages, Google Ads and Meta Ads campaign assets, ad copy, AI-assisted images or videos, and creative variations developed for different brands, services, or locations.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - New campaigns, locations, and landing pages are launched accurately and on time.

 - Competitor research and creative testing consistently generate useful ideas for new campaigns and improvements.

Tech Lead - Payment Experience Architecture

#SomosNaranjaX y nos une el propósito de trabajar por la inclusión y la educación financiera de millones de personas. Más de 9.5 millones de clientes nos eligen cada día porque confían en Naranja X para alcanzar sus sueños.

Estamos creando un ecosistema de soluciones tecnológicas financieras que se diferencia por ofrecer la mejor experiencia y facilidad en el acceso.

En el área de Tech Solutions, nuestro objetivo es acelerar el time-to-market de la compañía mediante el diseño y construcción de plataformas, aceleradores y productos cross-funcionales que sirvan de base para múltiples equipos de producto.
Buscamos un/a Tech Leader con perfil de Arquitecto FullStack, con sólidos fundamentos de Frontend y Backend Serverless en AWS Cloud. Tu misión será liderar y mentorear al equipo de ingeniería, definir patrones de diseño modernos, escalables y modulares, optimizar el rendimiento y la observabilidad en el cliente/borde, y asegurar que nuestras soluciones cross eleven el estándar técnico y la velocidad de entrega en toda la organización.

¿Querés ser protagonista de esta historia e impulsar la transformación financiera de millones de personas? ¡Súmate!

¿Qué desafíos vas a encontrar en esta posición?

• Liderazgo Técnico y Gestión de Personas:

-Liderar, guiar y mentorear a un equipo de desarrollo multidisciplinario, fomentando una cultura de excelencia técnica, autonomía y buenas prácticas.
-Facilitar 1:1s técnicos, planes de crecimiento y revisiones de código de alto impacto.
-Promover estándares de ingeniería de software (testing automatizado, CI/CD, linters, convenciones de código y refactorización continua).

• Arquitectura Frontend y Patrones de Diseño:

-Diseñar la arquitectura técnica de aplicaciones web complejas, componentes reutilizables y soluciones cross (librerías compartidas, Design Systems corporativos, arquitecturas modulares o Micro-frontends).
-Definir patrones de diseño para manejo de estado global/servidor, caching, renderizado híbrido (SSR, SSG, ISR) y comunicación frontend-backend.
-Garantizar estándares de accesibilidad, seguridad en el cliente y Core Web Vitals de primer nivel.

• Arquitectura FullStack, Cloud y Observabilidad:

-Diseñar la estrategia de entrega y distribución de assets a través de CDN, caching perimetral y optimización de latencia.
-Definir la integración con servicios backend (APIs REST, Api Gateways, BFF - Backend for Frontend) y servicios cloud AWS.
-Implementar estrategias de observabilidad de punta a punta (monitoreo de errores, trazas, Real User Monitoring - RUM y métricas de rendimiento).

• Estrategia e Impacto Cross:

-Colaborar con Product Managers, diseñadores UX/UI y otros Tech Leads para transformar necesidades transversales en herramientas y frameworks reutilizables.
-Reducir la fricción y acelerar el time-to-market de los distintos squads mediante la adopción de los aceleradores de Tech Solutions.

¿Qué buscamos?

• Liderazgo Técnico:

-+5 años de experiencia liderando técnicamente equipos de desarrollo (mentoring, asignación de tareas, gestión de deuda técnica y facilitación ágil).
-Excelentes habilidades de comunicación para traducir requerimientos de negocio en soluciones técnicas y articular decisiones de arquitectura ante audiencias técnicas y no técnicas.

• Arquitectura Frontend Especializada:

-Amplia trayectoria en el diseño y construcción de arquitecturas complejas con React, Next.js y TypeScript.
-Experiencia avanzada en optimización de rendimiento frontend (Core Web Vitals, code splitting, tree shaking, lazy loading, estrategias de caching).
-Experiencia implementando o gobernando librerías de componentes frontend.

• Fundamentos de Backend:

-Experiencia en desarrollo y diseño de APIs backend (Lambdas, Step Functions, SQS, SNS, Api Gateway, etc). (NodeJS)
-Conocimiento en diseño de contratos de APIs y autenticación/autorización web (OAuth2, JWT, cookies HttpOnly).

• Cloud, Infraestructura y Observabilidad:

-Experiencia en despliegue y distribución en la nube (preferentemente AWS): CloudFront, S3, Route 53, integración con Lambdas o Step Functions.
-Experiencia implementando observabilidad y monitoreo con Datadog (APM, RUM, Logs, Dashboards y configuración de alertas de rendimiento y errores).
-Familiaridad con pipelines de CI/CD y despliegues continuos.

Sumarte a la Experiencia NX es:
📍 Modo Flex: Creemos en la presencia más que en la presencialidad. Trabajá de manera híbrida y flexible: desde casa, oficina o mixto.
🌍 #WorkFromAnywhere: desde cualquier parte del país o el mundo.
🌴 Más días de descanso: Además de vacaciones, tenés días libres NX desde el inicio para elegir cuando quieras.
💸 Ajustes de sueldo periódicos que acompañan el contexto económico.

🍔 Reintegro en compras de supermercado y restaurantes
🤩 Programas de capacitación constante y plataformas de E-learning (Udemy) para potenciar tu desarrollo.
👶 Licencia extendida y flexibilidad al regreso para gestantes y no gestantes. + Licencias especiales para el cuidado de tu familia.
🥰Y una propuesta de valor mucho más amplia pensada para acompañarte en cada momento y desarrollar todo tu potencial.

En Naranja X promovemos un espacio de trabajo seguro e inclusivo, donde podés desplegar tu talento, tus ideas y tu magia.
Nuestras búsquedas son abiertas y equitativas para todas las personas: teniendo en cuenta diversidad de género, etaria, de religiones, ideas y opiniones, nacionalidad, personas con discapacidad, LGBTIQ+. ¡Mientras más diversos sean nuestros equipos, mayor será nuestra capacidad de agregar valor a las finanzas de las personas!

No se trata solo de identificar qué podría hacerse mejor, sino de convertir ese análisis en proyectos concretos, medibles y escalables.

Principales responsabilidades

• Diseñar y liderar proyectos de mejora continua vinculados a Supply Chain.

• Analizar procesos, detectar oportunidades y desarrollar soluciones que mejoren su eficiencia y escalabilidad.

• Diseñar y dar seguimiento a KPIs de nivel de servicio, costos y eficiencia.

• Analizar desvíos, identificar sus causas y transformarlos en acciones de mejora.

• Trabajar sobre inventarios, almacenamiento, reposición y exactitud de stock.

• Participar en mejoras de layout, picking, armado y despacho de pedidos.

• Analizar oportunidades de optimización en distribución y costos de flete.

• Impulsar iniciativas de automatización y simplificación de procesos.

• Trabajar transversalmente con Comercial, Sistemas, Administración y otras áreas.

• Medir el impacto de los proyectos implementados y realizar seguimiento de sus resultados.

¿A quién buscamos?

• Graduados/as o estudiantes avanzados/as de Ingeniería Industrial, Administración o carreras afines.

• Al menos 3 años de experiencia profesional.

• Experiencia en Operaciones, Supply Chain, Logística, Distribución, Procesos o Mejora Continua.

• Experiencia trabajando con procesos, indicadores y proyectos de mejora.

• Excel avanzado.

• Se valorará experiencia con metodologías Lean, 5S o gestión por procesos.

• Se valorará manejo de Power BI.

• Será un plus haber trabajado en consumo masivo, retail, e-commerce o distribución.

¿Por qué sumarte?
Porque no llegás a ocupar una posición ya escrita: vas a tener espacio para construirla.
Es un rol nuevo, con autonomía, contacto directo con la operación y alta exposición a la Gerencia de Operaciones. Vas a poder desarrollar proyectos desde cero y ver concretamente qué cambia después de implementarlos.
Además, el alcance permite trabajar sobre una Supply Chain diversa, atravesada por distribución mayorista, e-commerce y retail.

Lugar de trabajo: Guaymallén, Mendoza

Modalidad: Presencial | Full time

Si sos de esas personas que frente a un proceso automáticamente empiezan a pensar “¿cómo podríamos hacerlo mejor?”, probablemente este desafío te resulte interesante.
Postulate o compartilo con alguien de tu red que tenga experiencia en Supply Chain, Logística, Procesos o Mejora Continua .

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a highly organised Personal Assistant to manage personal travel, logistics and day-to-day administration. You’ll take requests from initial brief to completion, anticipate what needs to happen next and present clear options when a decision is needed. The role involves regular in-person work, driving and occasional international travel. Time-sensitive requests may require evening or weekend support within an agreed schedule.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Manage personal appointments, documentation and administrative deadlines, providing in-person support where needed.

 - Oversee property and vehicle arrangements, coordinating upkeep and following up on outstanding issues.

 - Source and coordinate service providers and support staff. Compare options, agree next steps and make sure work is completed as expected.

 - Organise personal events and activities, and handle day-to-day requests that require hands-on support.

 - Track commitments, deadlines and expenses. Share concise progress updates and flag issues or decisions that need attention.




QUALIFICATIONS

 - Previous experience as a Personal Assistant, with a record of managing travel, logistics and sensitive administrative work independently.

 - Strong written and spoken English and French, and confidence in communicating with service providers and public offices.

 - A valid driving licence and confidence driving as part of the role.

 - Excellent organisation, discretion and sound judgment when handling changing priorities and confidential information.

 - Proficiency with calendars, spreadsheets and task trackers. Experience using ChatGPT or Claude for research and drafting, with the ability to verify outputs.




NICE TO HAVE

LOCATION

Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.




BENEFITS

INTERVIEW PROCESS

This is a place for individuals who thrive under pressure, embrace challenges, and see opportunity in every obstacle. If you’re hungry to achieve, motivated by impact, and want to grow at the speed of your own ambition, Ruby Labs offers the platform to make it happen.

Here, effort is matched with reward. We recognize those who go all in and deliver results, and we create space for people who want more—more responsibility, more growth, and more success.

postings.descriptionText:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
But that’s just the beginning:
Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
We are looking for a Senior DevOps / Infrastructure Engineer with strong hands-on experience in Google Cloud, Terraform and Kubernetes. If you enjoy the challenge of working with globally distributed clusters in an environment where security and scalability are taken seriously, this role is for you.

Our team has invested in a stable, observable platform. The next step is to scale that foundation. That means moving more workloads onto IaC, hardening our security posture, and preparing our services for rapid user growth. This is a hands-on role in a small, senior, fully remote team. You will own services end to end, make pragmatic technical decisions, and help other teams become self-sufficient. If you like keeping things simple, standard, well automated and monitored, come talk to us.

Responsibilities

• Design, build and maintain our Google Cloud infrastructure using Terraform, with the goal of having all production infrastructure defined as code and reviewed through pull requests.

• Strong experience with Terraform, including module design, state management and managing multiple environments.

• Strong Linux and networking fundamentals comfortable scripting Bash.

• Google Cloud certification (for example Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer or Professional Cloud Architect) or a Kubernetes certification (CKA or CKS).

• Experience running infrastructure for environments with strict security requirements.

• Experience with push notification infrastructure (Firebase Cloud Messaging, APNs) at scale.

• Familiarity with peer-to-peer or distributed systems.

• Familiarity with Node.js services and how to run them in production.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.

Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

The HR Business Partner (HRBP) acts as a strategic partner to the business for Haleon’s manufacturing plant in Argentina (San Fernando), supporting Plant Leadership, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and support functions in the execution of the People strategy.

The role is accountable for ensuring the effective implementation of HR policies, processes, and practices, driving business performance, talent development, and a strong employee experience aligned with Haleon’s culture and values within an industrial environment.

Key Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities
Business Partnering

• Act as a trusted strategic partner to plant leaders, providing guidance on organizational effectiveness, talent, and leadership topics.

• Translate business priorities into clear and actionable people plans.

• Support transformation initiatives, organizational change, and continuous improvement efforts.

Talent & Performance Management

• Lead and facilitate performance management processes, including continuous feedback and development planning.

• Support succession planning and development of key talent within the plant.

• Partner with Talent Acquisition to deliver effective hiring for operational, technical, and leadership roles.

• Support learning, upskilling, and leadership development initiatives.

Employee Experience & Culture

• Design and drive initiatives related to engagement, culture, wellbeing, and diversity & inclusion .

• Ensure effective deployment of global and regional employee experience initiatives at the plant level.

• Lead employee engagement surveys and co‑create action plans with leaders.

HR Operations & Compliance

• Ensure effective execution of core HR processes, including headcount management, employee movements, rewards processes, absence management, and disciplinary processes.

• Ensure compliance with internal policies, corporate standards, and audit requirements.

• Work collaboratively with HR Centers of Excellence (Talent, Rewards, Learning) and shared service teams.

Why you?

Basic Qualifications:

We are looking for professionals with these required skills to achieve our goals:

• Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Business Administration, or related field.

• Minimum 8 years of experience in HRBP or generalist HR roles.

• Proven experience in manufacturing or industrial environments .

Nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un Supervisor de Mantenimiento (Mecánico-Eléctrico) · Equipos de workover

Programar y controlar los recursos disponibles para hacer cumplir los planes de mantenimiento de los equipos de workover. Tu trabajo asegura la disponibilidad de los equipos y las instalaciones, con las condiciones de seguridad y cuidado del medio ambiente requeridas. Vas a liderar a un equipo de mecánicos y electricistas, con foco en la seguridad de las personas y en la calidad del servicio.

• Motivar al personal a cargo y capacitarlos para la gestión de mantenimiento en las operaciones a fin de garantizar un adecuado clima de trabajo con un fuerte aspecto constructivo y un trabajo idóneo; para que los trabajos realizados reflejen la calidad solicitada.

Formación Académica: Secundario completo. Formación técnica electromecánica.

Conocimientos técnicos:



• Conocimientos de SAP y manejo de Office, en especial Excel.



Competencias:



• SP-PYWO109-Metodos De Control De Pozo Prevención de contingencias de surgencia durante las operaciones de perforación y workover de acuerdo a lo establecido en el sistema de gestión (políticas normas procedimientos e instrucciones) y a los estándares de excelencia operacional.
