postings.title: Senior SAP Technical Delivery Lead - EY GDS
postings.descriptionText:
Senior SAP Technical Delivery Lead (Assistant Director)

EY Technology:
Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.
EY Technology supports our technology needs through three business units:
Client Technology (CT) - focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology-based opportunities faster, and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
Enterprise Technology (ET) – ET supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit-for-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. ET will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
Information Security (Info Sec) - Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.

The opportunity
We are seeking an experienced SAP Technical Lead / SAP Technical Architect with 10-15 years of experience designing, developing and delivering scalable SAP solutions. The role will provide end-to-end technical leadership across SAP application development, integration, SAP Business Technology Platform (SAP BTP), e-invoicing and SAPUI5/Fiori solutions. The successful candidate will translate business and regulatory requirements into secure, supportable and future-ready technical designs, while leading delivery teams and working with functional, integration, infrastructure, security and external partner stakeholders.
Your key responsibilities
• Own the end-to-end technical architecture and solution design for SAP initiatives, enhancements, integrations and modernization programs.
• Translate business, functional, regulatory and non-functional requirements into robust solution blueprints, technical specifications and implementation roadmaps.
• Lead SAP development across ABAP and modern SAP technologies, including code quality, design reviews, performance optimization, technical standards and reusable development patterns.
• Design and govern solutions on SAP BTP, including integration, extension and application services, with appropriate security, monitoring, scalability and operational support considerations.
• Provide technical leadership for e-invoicing and statutory compliance solutions, including integration with SAP and external tax, clearance or service-provider platforms.
• Architect and oversee SAPUI5/Fiori applications and user experiences, ensuring alignment with SAP standards, accessibility, security and performance expectations.
• Design integrations across SAP and non-SAP platforms using OData Services, SOAP and REST Web Services, APIs, events, middleware and established enterprise integration patterns.
• Assess solution options, identify technical gaps, dependencies and risks, and recommend pragmatic approaches aligned with enterprise architecture and product roadmaps.
• Lead technical delivery through design, build, test, deployment, hypercare and transition to operations.
• Guide and mentor developers and technical specialists; coordinate work across internal teams, managed-service providers and external vendors.
• Validate estimates, delivery plans and technical proposals, and constructively challenge solutions that create unnecessary complexity, cost or support risk.

• Create and maintain architecture diagrams, technical design documents, interface specifications, runbooks and decision records.
• Communicate technical decisions, trade-offs, risks and status clearly to business and technology stakeholders.
Skills and attributes for success
• Deep hands-on expertise in SAP ABAP development, including object-oriented ABAP, enhancements, interfaces, forms, debugging, code review and performance optimization.
• Strong SAP technical architecture experience across application, integration, data, security and operational considerations.
• Hands-on experience with SAP BTP services and extension patterns; experience with SAP Integration Suite is highly desirable.
• Experience designing and delivering e-invoicing or electronic tax-document solutions, including integration with government platforms or third-party service providers.
• Strong experience in SAPUI5 and SAP Fiori solution design and development, including the design, development, configuration and consumption of SAP OData Services.
• Hands-on knowledge of SAP integration technologies and patterns, including OData Services, SOAP and REST Web Services, APIs, IDocs, RFC/BAPI, proxies, files and event-based integration.
• Experience integrating SAP with cloud and on-premises applications and working within hybrid enterprise landscapes.
• Strong understanding of secure development, authorization concepts, transport and release management, monitoring, error handling and recovery procedures.
• Ability to balance strategic architecture with hands-on technical delivery and production support.
• Excellent analytical, stakeholder-management, documentation and communication skills in a global delivery environment.
To qualify for the role you must have
• 10-15 years of progressive SAP technical experience, with substantial hands-on development and solution-design responsibility.
• Proven experience as an SAP Technical Lead, SAP Solution Architect or SAP Technical Architect on complex SAP implementations, transformations or global support programs.
• Demonstrated experience designing and developing SAP solutions across ABAP, OData Services, Web Services, integration and user-experience technologies.
• Practical experience with SAP BTP and at least one modern SAP extension or integration delivery model.
• Experience with e-invoicing, digital tax reporting or statutory compliance integrations.
• Experience with SAPUI5/Fiori development and technical design.
• Experience leading technical teams, reviewing solution quality and coordinating delivery across multiple stakeholders and suppliers.
• Ability to work independently, make informed technical decisions and escalate material risks appropriately.
• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
Ideally, you’ll also have

• Experience with SAP Document and Reporting Compliance or comparable e-invoicing and statutory-reporting platforms.
• Experience designing, publishing, securing, testing and monitoring OData Services and SOAP/REST Web Services for SAP and external application integrations.
• Experience with SAP Cloud Application Programming Model, SAP HANA Cloud, API Management, Event Mesh or related SAP BTP capabilities.
• Experience with DevOps, automated testing, code-quality tooling and continuous integration/continuous delivery for SAP solutions.
• SAP certification in ABAP, SAP BTP, integration, SAP Fiori/UI5 or SAP architecture.
• International delivery experience and the flexibility to collaborate across time zones.
What we look for
We are looking for a hands-on technical leader who can connect architecture with delivery. You will be expected to design clear and supportable SAP solutions, guide development teams, maintain strong engineering standards and work effectively across business, functional and technology groups. Success in this role requires sound technical judgment, ownership, collaboration and the ability to simplify complex SAP and integration challenges.

postings.descriptionText:
En Swiss Medical trabajamos cada día para que las personas vivan más y mejor.

Más de 4 millones de personas confían en nosotros y, detrás de cada historia, hay un equipo de más de 16.500 colaboradores que elige todos los días cuidar, acompañar y transformar vidas.



Para seguir impactando positivamente en la vida de más personas, buscamos sumar a Especialista DevOps (foco en Entrega Continua / CD) en la Dirección de Sistemas y Tecnología de Swiss Medical.



💪 Tu impacto

La innovación solo genera impacto cuando llega a las personas de forma segura.
En este rol, vas a poder hacer posible que cada mejora tecnológica llegue con calidad, continuidad y confianza, ayudando a que millones de personas vivan más y mejor.



Objetivo del puesto

Liderar la evolución de los flujos de Integración y Entrega Continua (CI/CD) de la compañía, con foco especial en la componente de Entrega Continua (CD), definiendo modelos de despliegue seguros, automatizados, auditables y consistentes entre ambientes y plataformas. Diseñar el protocolo de validación y promoción de versiones entre entornos, estableciendo los controles de calidad, trazabilidad y observabilidad necesarios para conocer el comportamiento de cada release antes y después de su publicación en producción — independientemente de la plataforma o herramienta que la sostenga en cada momento.



🔍 Responsabilidades





• Diseñar y evolucionar la estrategia de entrega continua de la organización, llevando los pipelines y flujos de despliegue hacia modelos declarativos, versionados y auditables (hoy sobre herramientas como GitLab CI y ArgoCD, pudiendo evolucionar según necesidad).


• Definir estrategias de despliegue que minimicen riesgo e impacto (blue-green, canary, rolling) y garantizar su aplicación consistente sobre las distintas plataformas de contenedores de la compañía (actualmente ROSA, OpenShift on-premise y ECS/Fargate).


• Colaborar con los equipos de Arquitectura, Seguridad y Desarrollo para embeber controles de calidad, seguridad y compliance dentro del ciclo de entrega, corriéndolos lo más temprano posible (shift-left).


• Impulsar la gestión de infraestructura y configuración como código, de modo que el aprovisionamiento y los cambios de entorno sean reproducibles, versionados y trazables.


• Incrementar la trazabilidad y observabilidad de toda la plataforma de entrega, contribuyendo a medir y mejorar de forma continua los indicadores de performance del proceso de software (métricas DORA: lead time, frecuencia de despliegue, tasa de fallos y tiempo de recuperación).


• Automatizar las pruebas de validación de versiones (funcionales, de integración, de infraestructura) integrándolas al flujo de entrega, para reducir la intervención manual y acelerar el feedback de calidad.


• Evaluar y administrar el ecosistema de herramientas de automatización y control de versiones, proponiendo mejoras, reemplazos o estandarizaciones a medida que la plataforma lo requiera.


• Ser referente técnico y mentor del equipo en temas de entrega continua, transfiriendo conocimiento y elevando la madurez del área.


• Documentar y mantener actualizados los procesos, runbooks y estándares de despliegue.





🎯 Requisitos





• Automatización, CI/CD y GitOps: Git, orquestadores de CI/CD modernos (GitLab CI; valoramos experiencia previa en Jenkins con capacidad de migrar hacia modelos as-code), despliegue declarativo / GitOps (Argo, Helm, Kustomize), gestión de artefactos (Nexus)


• Infraestructura como Código: Terraform / Terragrunt, y automatización de configuración (AWX / Ansible)


• Plataformas y contenedores: OpenShift / ROSA, Kubernetes; Red Hat Stack (EAP, FUSE) como plus


• Cloud: AWS a nivel operativo (IAM, redes básicas, ECS/Fargate, EKS y servicios asociados)


• Lenguajes de programación / scripting: Python, Bash/Shell; se valora experiencia con Java, JavaScript, Go, .Net Core


• Bases de datos: nociones de motores relacionales y no relacionales del ecosistema AWS y on-premise (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL/Aurora, RDS, Mongo/DocumentDB, Redis)


• Observabilidad: herramientas de monitoreo, logging y métricas de plataforma







💫 Beneficios



🤝 Gran oportunidad de desarrollo.

👨‍ ⚕️ Prepaga para vos y tu grupo familiar

🏖️ Días adicionales de vacaciones.

👨🏽‍💻 Beneficio de pago de Conectividad

🙌 Horario flexible y esquema híbrido de trabajo

📚 Licencias Udemy para que puedas capacitarte en lo que quieras.

💌 Acceso preferencial en la contratación de productos y/o servicios de SMG como seguros de caución, hogar, automotor, retiro, vida y ahorro. SMG Cells

💉 Campaña de vacunación gratuita

🏋️‍♀️🏋️‍♂️ Cobertura en Gimnasios a través de la red Wellhub

📌 Descuentos corporativos en cines, teatros, viajes, restaurantes, spas y otros rubros.





📍 Lunes a Jueves de 9 a 18 hs; Viernes de 9 a 17 hs, CABA – Modalidad de Presencialidad hibrida

Orientamos la búsqueda a profesionales graduados de la carrera de Abogacía, con experiencia en gestiones extrajudiciales, laborales o vinculadas a riesgos del trabajo.

postings.descriptionText:
Ciudad : San Isidro 
Buenos Aires (AR-B) 
País : Argentina (AR) 
Número de Requisición : 49539 






En Bunge buscamos un/a Analista de Logística Comercial para sumarse al equipo de Logística Comercial de Fertimport . La posición tiene un rol fundamental en la gestión, control y emisión de documentación vinculada a embarques marítimos de exportación, asegurando la correcta emisión de conocimientos de embarque (Bills of Lading), certificados y documentación asociada a las operaciones internacionales de la compañía.




Buscamos personas con interés por el comercio exterior, la logística internacional y la operatoria marítima, que disfruten trabajar con documentación crítica, interactuar con múltiples actores del negocio y contribuir a la mejora continua de procesos. La posición combina tareas operativas de alta precisión con oportunidades para optimizar procesos y generar eficiencias dentro de un entorno dinámico y exigente.




Principales responsabilidades:



• Gestionar la confección, control, aprobación y emisión de conocimientos de embarque (Bills of Lading), certificados y documentación relacionada con operaciones de exportación marítima.

• Administrar el envío de documentación digital y física a armadores, clientes, agentes marítimos y demás participantes de la operación.

• Controlar documentación original recibida de los distintos actores involucrados en las exportaciones.

• Interactuar con armadores, cargadores, coordinadores logísticos, agentes marítimos y equipos de ejecución comercial para garantizar el correcto flujo documental.

• Emitir y actualizar reportes operativos vinculados a embarques, documentación y seguimiento de buques.

• Identificar oportunidades de mejora y automatización de procesos administrativos y documentales. Basado en las anotaciones del relevamiento.



Perfil técnico requerido:



• Formación en Comercio Exterior, Logística, Operaciones Portuarias o carreras afines (deseable).

• Experiencia previa en comercio exterior, logística internacional, documentación de exportación o agencias marítimas (excluyente).

• Conocimiento de documentación vinculada a embarques marítimos y operaciones de exportación.

• Manejo intermedio/avanzado de Excel (excluyente).

• Inglés avanzado (excluyente).

• Conocimientos de procesos logísticos y operación marítima internacional.

• Interés en automatización de procesos, digitalización e Inteligencia Artificial aplicada a tareas operativas (deseable).



Ubicación:



San Isidro, Buenos Aires.

En Bunge (NYSE: BG), nuestro propósito es conectar a los agricultores con los consumidores para entregar alimentos, piensos y combustibles esenciales al mundo. Como proveedor líder de soluciones agroindustriales, nuestro equipo de ~34,000 empleados dedicados se asocia con agricultores de todo el mundo para trasladar los productos agrícolas desde donde se cultivan hasta donde se necesitan, de manera más rápida, inteligente y eficiente. Somos un líder mundial en originación, almacenamiento, distribución, procesamiento y refinación de oleaginosas, que ofrece una amplia cartera de aceites, grasas y proteínas de origen vegetal. Trabajamos junto con nuestros clientes en ambos extremos de la cadena de valor para ofrecer productos de calidad y desarrollar soluciones innovadoras y personalizadas que aborden las necesidades cambiantes de los consumidores. Con más de 200 años de experiencia y presencia en más de 50 países, estamos comprometidos a fortalecer la seguridad alimentaria mundial, promover la sostenibilidad y ayudar a las comunidades a prosperar donde operamos. Bunge tiene su domicilio social en Ginebra, Suiza, y su sede corporativa en St. Louis, Missouri. Obtenga más información en Bunge.com.



Cada día, nuestra gente ejemplifica estos valores, que representan la esencia de Bunge:


• SOMOS UN ÚNICO EQUIPO – Colaborativos, respetuosos, inclusivos
• LIDERAMOS EL CAMINO – Ágiles, empoderados, innovadores
• HACEMOS LO CORRECTO – Con seguridad, sustentabilidad e integridad



Reconocemos que nuestro éxito depende de las diversas perspectivas que cada uno de nuestros colaboradores aporta a Bunge. Nos esforzamos por promover acciones que fomenten una cultura de pertenencia. A nivel global, apoyamos iniciativas como los Principios para el Empoderamiento de las Mujeres, de ONU Mujeres. Colaboramos con organizaciones como Disability:IN, un referente en la inclusión de personas con discapacidad y trabajamos continuamente en pro de nuestro compromiso de dejar un legado positivo en todas las comunidades en las que operamos.

Si esto le suena bien, ¡únase a nosotros! Valoramos e invertimos en personas que creen en nuestro propósito y están entusiasmadas por vivirlo cada día: personas que están #OrgullosasDeSerBunge.

postings.title: Enterprise Account Executive - Federal
postings.descriptionText:
This is a general track role, hiring for opportunities across all levels of seniority in our Sales Teams.

Apply here if you believe you possess outstanding revenue generating experience from the Technology industry.

Open source software is the new default in the enterprise, and Canonical is the new challenger to major enterprise software vendors.

We deliver better open source from the data center to cloud and edge. Our Linux distribution Ubuntu is now the leading platform for public cloud compute, and the favorite platform for software engineers, data scientists and AI developers. Our mission is to accelerate the adoption and quality of open source globally, and our goal is to ship the most software on the planet by cores. A tidal wave of open source innovation is the next phase of the entire enterprise software industry, and we aim to be the most compelling way to ride that wave.

Our customers include Global 500 enterprises and startups. We are expanding our product range from the base operating system - Ubuntu - to full enterprise solutions in infrastructure and applications. We can deliver software defined storage, private cloud solutions, container runtime environments, as well as databases, message queues, identity, observability, analytics, machine learning and web publishing capabilities. Customers love the idea that they can get security compliance and support for everything open source from a single company. Our goal is to have more solutions on tap than any other vendor, and we have built unique capabilities to make that possible across every cloud, every class of compute and every category of application.

Canonical provides licensed enterprise software products, commercial support, managed services, consulting and training services to customers who are deploying Ubuntu or open source applications on the cloud, in their data center, or to the connected device and IoT ecosystem. We are just over 1,000 colleagues in 70+ countries and $250m in revenue, profitable, on a steady but relentless growth trajectory. We are almost entirely distributed, with leadership spread across many countries. We believe that talent is equally distributed across the globe, and we are excited to hire, develop, promote and ultimately trust a diverse group of exceptional leads to build the best, not biggest, enterprise software company.

We hire carefully and deliberately; our selection process is long and requires substantial work from applicants. It will take successful applicants three to six months to secure an offer. This is not a place to apply if you are in a rush to find a position, it is a worthwhile place to apply if you are ambitious and long-term in your thinking about your career and the dynamics which move the world forward. If you see clearly the rise of open source, and you understand the drivers of enterprise procurement and technical decision making, then you will understand why Canonical has such a tremendous long term advantage. You will also understand, given the ferocity of competition and the challenges of competing in a market of giants, that we have to set a very high bar for hiring and performance. In order to be a world leading company we select for exceptional ability as well as character, and then provide an environment which promotes teamwork and celebrates diligence, collaboration and effectiveness. All of those are easy to say but hard to do - at Canonical we are willing to be uncomfortable in pursuit of that excellence.

In building our sales team, we look for five things:

Empathy for the customer - a real understanding of customer needs, industry-specific challenges, and a desire to help customers solve their business problems

High intellect - the ability to learn quickly, understand very complex subjects, and communicate clearly to build trust and confidence

Passion for technology - a fascination with the state of the art from brilliant people solving hard problems, and fierce competition for large prizes

Teamwork - a willingness to help others, to collaborate well with people from different disciplines, and to balance personal and team ambitions

Energy - the drive to motivate oneself and others to achieve the best result for the team and our customers

Ubuntu is already very widely adopted which gives us a credible basis for conversations in the market. Join Nortal for your next big adventure. We are seeking a Senior Workfront Configuration Engineer to join our team, grow with us, and teach us a few things along the way.

Why join Nortal

Say Goodbye to Micromanagement: We champion autonomy, open communication, and respect for diversity as our core values.

Outcomes Over Hours: We believe in a work model focused on impact, providing you with the flexibility to balance your professional success with your personal well-being.

Vibrant Community: Join our close-knit LATAM remote team and connect through tech talks, virtual coffee breaks, and team-building activities.

Support from Day One: Our People Care team is here to support you throughout your journey, from wellness check-ins to professional growth.

Our benefits ✨

Competitive USD salary.

100% remote work: While you can work from anywhere, you're always welcome to connect with teammates and grow your network at our coworking spaces across LATAM.

Paid time off & national holidays: Take the time you need according to your country's regulations while receiving your full salary.

Sick leave: Focus on your health without stress. Take the necessary time to recover and feel better.

Annual credit: Spend it on the perks you love to enhance your work-life balance.

Team-building activities: Join us for coffee breaks, tech talks, and after-work gatherings to bond with your Nortal family and feel part of our vibrant community.

Birthday off: Enjoy an extra day off during your birthday week to celebrate in style with friends and family.

About the project

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Workfront Configuration Engineer to design, implement, and optimize enterprise workflow management solutions using Adobe Workfront and Workfront Fusion.

This is a client-facing service delivery role that combines technical expertise, business acumen, and strong communication skills. You will work closely with business stakeholders to understand their operational needs and translate complex requirements into customized, scalable, and reliable workflow solutions.

You will join a highly collaborative international team working within Agile delivery environments, helping improve operational efficiency, automate business processes, and maximize the value of Adobe Workfront.

What you'll do

•
Design, implement, configure, and maintain enterprise Adobe Workfront environments based on complex business requirements.

•
Develop and maintain automated workflows and integrations using Workfront Fusion.

•
Configure custom forms, reports, dashboards, workflows, and sharing rules tailored to client needs.

•
Establish solid architectural foundations, ensuring appropriate system configuration, access permissions, and sharing rules.

•
Maintain and enhance existing Workfront environments, including system updates, user management, and feature rollouts.

•
Collaborate directly with clients and business stakeholders to gather requirements, identify process gaps, and translate business needs into technical solutions.

•
Apply Adobe Workfront development and configuration best practices to improve operational efficiency and solution quality.

•
Document technical architectures, configuration decisions, integration workflows, and implementation strategies.

•
Collaborate with project managers to define implementation plans, timelines, and delivery priorities.

•
Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning and story decomposition.

•
Design solutions that are secure, measurable, usable, reliable, flexible, and scalable.

•
Mentor junior engineers and contribute to knowledge sharing, technical standards, and continuous improvement.

•
Stay up to date with Adobe Workfront platform enhancements and industry best practices to identify opportunities for innovation.

•
Take part in Nortal's Technical Interviewer Program, conducting technical interviews for your account and other accounts to help build the teams behind Nortal's growth.

What makes you a great fit

•
5+ years of professional experience designing, implementing, and supporting project management or enterprise work management systems.

•
Strong hands-on experience configuring and maintaining Adobe Workfront environments, including workflows, custom forms, reports, dashboards, and sharing rules.

•
1+ year of hands-on experience with Adobe Workfront Fusion, including system integrations and workflow automation.

•
Experience translating complex business requirements into customized Workfront configurations and scalable workflow solutions.

•
Experience working in client-facing environments, collaborating directly with business and technical stakeholders.

•
Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments, including sprint planning and story decomposition.

•
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, with a solution-oriented mindset.

•
Ability to work independently, take ownership of deliverables, and adapt to evolving business requirements.

•
Strong collaboration, communication, and technical documentation skills.

•
Business-level English proficiency, with the ability to communicate effectively with US-based clients.

•
Availability to collaborate with stakeholders during Pacific Time business hours.

Nice to have:

•
Experience integrating Adobe Workfront with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), Marketo Engage, or Adobe Firefly.

•
Adobe Workfront Developer or advanced Workfront certification.

•
Experience with Adobe Experience Manager development or content management workflows.

•
Familiarity with REST APIs, webhooks, and enterprise integration patterns.

Global Impact, Local Culture 🌍

For over 25 years, we’ve been shaping digital transformation, delivering complex solutions for global enterprises and public sector organizations. Today, we are at the forefront of an AI-driven transformation era, helping organizations turn data into real business value. By combining deep domain expertise with data and AI, we design solutions that create immediate impact while scaling for the future.

We believe complexity doesn’t have to mean complicated, and that the best solutions are those that work in the real world, not just on paper. That’s why our clients trust us with their most ambitious, business-critical initiatives.

Apply now and let’s shape the future of technology together! 🧑‍💻

Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. About CookUnity

Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul.

Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world.

If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting.

About the Team

Chef Marketing helps independent chefs grow their businesses on CookUnity. A chef can invest part of their weekly earnings to introduce a dish to new customers, bring past customers back, or give regulars a reason to order again. In the Chef Portal, chefs can manage campaigns and see how their dishes perform. On the customer side, those decisions show up as featured meals, Add & Save discounts, buy-one-get-one offers, and Cashback credits toward a future order.

The Role

As a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer, you’ll own features from the screen a chef uses to configure an offer to the services that decide whether a customer can redeem it. There’s a particular emphasis on backend engineering. A promotion can span multiple delivery weeks, apply only to certain meals or members. Your job is to keep those rules consistent from menu to checkout and make the outcome clear to both the customer and the chef.

Responsibilities

• Build chef-facing tools in React and TypeScript that make it easy to set up a campaign, understand its results, and decide what to promote next.

• Develop the APIs and data models behind offer eligibility, schedules, and daily limits. Work with Menu, Pricing, and Checkout engineers so the offer a customer sees matches the one they can redeem.

• Use automated tests, feature flags, and staged rollouts to check that existing offers keep working during the transition.

• Partner with Product, Design, Data, and Chef Success to test whether a promotion generates additional sales for a chef and whether customers return to order the dish again.

• Operate what you ship. Trace slow menu requests, investigate discrepancies in discounts or credits, and add monitoring that helps the team catch problems early.

• Lead technical design discussions, review code, and mentor other engineers through implementation and launch.

• Helping to have higher levels of uptime & supporting the on-call rotation that will help the business run 24/7

Qualifications

• 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including ownership of a feature from design through production support.

• Experience shipping web applications with React and TypeScript and building production backend services with Node.js.

• Experience designing APIs and relational data models, tuning SQL queries, and keeping data consistent when requests fail or retry.

• Experience testing user journeys across service boundaries and diagnosing production issues with logs, metrics, and traces.

• Advanced English and the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to engineers, designers, and business partners.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with marketplace promotions, pricing, loyalty programs, or another domain where an incorrect calculation affects a customer’s bill.

• Experience migrating business rules from a legacy application or building event-driven workflows across services.

• Familiarity with GraphQL, AWS, or Kubernetes, or experience using product analytics to evaluate an experiment.

If you’re interested in this role, please submit your application, and if we think you might be a fit, we'll get in touch with you. Thank you for your time!

CookUnity is an Equal Opportunity Employer . We are dedicated to creating a community of inclusion and an environment free from discrimination or harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or physical or mental disability.

A quick note for all candidates
We’ve recently seen an increase in recruitment scams across the industry, and we want to make sure you (and your data) stay safe while applying to CookUnity. We also want you to know that we take this seriously — sometimes, as part of our process, we may ask for a brief “proof of humanity” to confirm that we’re connecting with a real person, not an impersonator. postings.descriptionText:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) are among the most important hires we make. They embed with our largest customers, build and ship voice and agent solutions in production, and shape what we build next. Demand from Latin America is growing quickly, and we need FDEs on the ground who understand these markets, languages, and customers.

This is a high-impact role for someone who knows the LATAM engineering talent landscape, can source creatively, and can close people who are choosing between several offers, including from global tech companies hiring remotely.




YOU WILL

 - Own end-to-end recruiting for Forward Deployed Engineers in LATAM: intake, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, closing, and onboarding handoff.

 - Partner with Engineering, Deployment, and LATAM Revenue leaders to define role profiles, scorecards, and interview plans, and keep calibration tight as the role evolves.

 - Assess technical depth and customer-facing judgment in screens, and give hiring managers clear, honest signal on every candidate.

 - Track pipeline health and market insights in Ashby, and turn them into recommendations on compensation positioning, hiring hubs, and conversion.




REQUIREMENTS

 - Track record of full-cycle recruiting for engineering roles, ideally technical customer-facing roles such as forward deployed, solutions, or sales engineering, with a strong network or sourcing track record in LATAM.

 - Strong technical fluency: you can tell a strong builder from a polished résumé, and hold a credible conversation about APIs, real-time systems, and AI/ML products.

 - Proven ability to source and close passive, in-demand candidates in competitive markets, including early-career talent and senior specialists.

 - Fluent in English and Spanish, with working knowledge of local hiring practices, compensation norms, and employment models across LATAM (for example, Brazil and Mexico).

 - Comfortable in a high-velocity, ambiguous environment, balancing strategic partnership with hands-on execution.

Bonus: 

 - Experience hiring for AI or voice companies or working in a fast-scaling company in LATAM.

 - Experience using our ATS, Ashby.




LOCATION

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Latin America, with the ability to operate in LATAM time zones.
